def _miss_cols(s: "Session", names: list[str], mask: np.ndarray) -> list[tuple[str, np.ndarray]]:
    """Variables with missing values and their missing masks, most missing first."""
    ds = s.data
    cols = [(n, ds.get(n).data[mask] >= SYS) for n in names]
    cols = [(n, m) for n, m in cols if m.any()]
    cols.sort(key=lambda c: -int(c[1].sum()))
    return cols


def _miss_tree(s: "Session", names: list[str], mask: np.ndarray, o: dict) -> None:
    """misstable tree: the nested pattern of missing values. Each variable splits the
    observations of the column on its left into missing (first) and not missing (layout
    VERIFY, case compat 0805)."""
    out = s.output
    cols = _miss_cols(s, names, mask)
    if not cols:
        out.write("(no missing values)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        return
    N = int(mask.sum())
    freq = bool(o.get("frequency"))
    k = len(cols)
    rows: list[list[str]] = []

    def walk(sel: np.ndarray, depth: int, row: list[str]) -> None:
        for missing in (True, False):
            here = sel & (cols[depth][1] if missing else ~cols[depth][1])
            c = int(here.sum())
            txt = f"{c:,}" if freq else f"{100 * c / N:.0f}"
            row[depth] = txt
            if depth + 1 < k:
                walk(here, depth + 1, row)
            else:
                rows.append(list(row))
            row[:] = [""] * k

    walk(np.ones(N, dtype=bool), 0, [""] * k)
    pct = [False] * len(rows)
    if not freq and rows:
        pct[0] = True
    # cells of 10 followed by "%" or a space, indented by 2 (compat 0805; VERIFY long names)
    w = [max(10, len(nm)) for nm, _ in cols]
    out.write("\n  Nested pattern of missing values\n", "text")
    out.write("  " + " ".join(f"{nm:>{wi}}" for (nm, _), wi in zip(cols, w)) + "\n", "text")
    rule = "  " + "-" * (sum(wi + 1 for wi in w) - 1) + "\n"
    out.write(rule, "text")
    for r, pc in zip(rows, pct):
        cells = [f"{x:>{wi}}" + ("%" if pc and x else " ") for x, wi in zip(r, w)]
        out.write("  " + "".join(cells).rstrip() + "\n", "result")
    out.write(rule, "text")
    out.write(" (number missing listed first)\n" if freq else " (percent missing listed first)\n", "text")


def _miss_nested(s: "Session", names: list[str], mask: np.ndarray, o: dict) -> None:
    """misstable nested: chains A -> B meaning "whenever A is missing, B is missing too"
    (wording VERIFY, case compat 0805)."""
    out = s.output
    cols = _miss_cols(s, names, mask)
    if not cols:
        out.write("(no missing values)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        return
    cols = cols[::-1]                         # fewest missing first
    k = len(cols)
    sub = [[i != j and not np.any(cols[i][1] & ~cols[j][1]) for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)]
    # direct successors only (transitive reduction)
    nxt = [[j for j in range(k) if sub[i][j] and not sub[j][i]
            and not any(sub[i][m] and sub[m][j] and not sub[m][i] and not sub[j][m]
                        for m in range(k) if m not in (i, j))] for i in range(k)]
    has_pred = {j for i in range(k) for j in nxt[i]}
    chains: list[list[int]] = []

    def extend(path: list[int]) -> None:
        if not nxt[path[-1]]:
            chains.append(path)
            return
        for j in nxt[path[-1]]:
            extend(path + [j])

    for i in range(k):
        if i not in has_pred:
            extend([i])
    for no, chain in enumerate(chains, start=1):
        text = " -> ".join(f"{cols[i][0]}({int(cols[i][1].sum()):,})" for i in chain)
        out.write(f"{no:>6}.  ", "text")
        out.write(text + "\n", "result")
    s.r = {"K": float(len(chains))}


def _miss_summarize(s: "Session", names: list[str], mask: np.ndarray, o: dict) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    out = s.output
    rows = []
    for n in names:
        if ds.get(n).is_string:
            if o.get("all"):
                rows.append((n, None, None, None, None, None, None))
            continue
        x = ds.get(n).data[mask]
        eq = int((x == SYS).sum())
        gt = int((x > SYS).sum())
        lt = x[x < SYS]
        if eq + gt == 0 and not o.get("all"):
            continue
        rows.append((n, eq, gt, len(lt), len(np.unique(lt)), lt.min() if len(lt) else SYS,
                     lt.max() if len(lt) else SYS))
    if not rows:
        out.write("(variables nonmissing or string)\n", "text")
        return
    out.write("\n" + " " * 63 + "Obs<.\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 48 + "+" + "-" * 30 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>15}|{'':>32}| Unique\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Variable':>14} |{'Obs=.':>10}{'Obs>.':>10}{'Obs<.':>10}  | values        Min         Max\n", "text")
    out.write("  " + "-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 32 + "+" + "-" * 30 + "\n", "text")
    for n, eq, gt, lt, uq, mn, mx in rows:
        out.write(f"{_abbrev(n, 12):>14} |", "text")
        if eq is None:
            out.write(f"{' (string variable)':<32}|\n", "text")
            continue
        uq_t = f"{uq:>7}" if uq <= 500 else "   >500"
        out.write(f"{eq if eq or o.get('showzeros') else '':>10}{gt if gt or o.get('showzeros') else '':>10}{lt:>10}"
                  f"  |{uq_t}  {_num(mn):>9}   {_num(mx):>9}\n", "result")
    out.write("  " + "-" * 77 + "\n", "text")
    num = [r for r in rows if r[1] is not None]
    if num:
        n_, eq, gt, lt, uq, mn, mx = num[-1]
        # return list order (compat 0803); values of the last numeric variable
        s.r = {"vartype": "numeric", "N_lt_dot": float(lt), "min": float(mn), "max": float(mx),
               "N_eq_dot": float(eq), "N_gt_dot": float(gt), "K_uniq": float(uq)}


def _miss_patterns(s: "Session", names: list[str], mask: np.ndarray, o: dict) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    out = s.output
    cols = [n for n in names if np.any(ds.get(n).data[mask] >= SYS)]
    if not cols:
        out.write("(no missing values)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        return
    # variable order: fewest missing first (VERIFY)
    cols.sort(key=lambda n: int((ds.get(n).data[mask] >= SYS).sum()))
    M_ = np.column_stack([(ds.get(n).data[mask] < SYS).astype(int) for n in cols])
    pats, counts = np.unique(M_, axis=0, return_counts=True)
    # complete pattern first, then by frequency (VERIFY)
    order = sorted(range(len(pats)), key=lambda j: (0 if pats[j].sum() == len(cols) else 1, -counts[j]))
    N = int(mask.sum())
    freq = bool(o.get("frequency"))
    k = len(cols)
    # Stata 14 layout (compat 0803)
    out.write("\n" + " " * 3 + "Missing-value patterns\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 5 + "(1 means complete)\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>14}|   Pattern\n", "text")
    head = "    Frequency " if freq else "    Percent   "
    out.write(head + "|  " + "  ".join(str(j + 1) for j in range(k)) + "\n", "text")
    dash = max(13, 3 * k + 7)   # VERIFY with more variables
    out.write("  " + "-" * 12 + "+" + "-" * dash + "\n", "text")
    first = True
    for idx in order:
        c = int(counts[idx])
        if freq:
            val = f"{c:>13,} "
        else:
            val = f"{100 * c / N:>9.0f}" + ("%    " if first else "     ")
        out.write(f"{val}|", "text")
        out.write("  " + "  ".join(str(x) for x in pats[idx]) + "\n", "result")
        if first:
            out.write(f"{'':>14}|\n", "text")
            first = False
    out.write("  " + "-" * 12 + "+" + "-" * dash + "\n", "text")
    out.write((f"{N:>13,} " if freq else f"{'100':>9}%    ") + "|\n\n", "text")
    out.write("  Variables are  " + "  ".join(f"({j + 1}) {n}" for j, n in enumerate(cols)) + "\n", "text")
    s.r = {"N_complete": float(int((M_.sum(axis=1) == k).sum())), "N_incomplete": float(int((M_.sum(axis=1) < k).sum())),
           "K": float(len(pats))}   # VERIFY nomes

"""collapse, contract, expand and fillin ([D] collapse, contract, expand, fillin).

collapse replaces the data with one row per by() group holding the requested
statistics:

    collapse [(stat)] varlist [(stat) ...] [weight] [if] [in] [, by(varlist) cw fast]

and also accepts `(stat) new=old`. The label of each new variable is
"(stat) label-or-name" (VERIFY). collapse prints nothing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import stats as S
from ..core.dataset import Dataset, Variable, check_name, default_format, smallest_type_for
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.grouping import group_ids, first_index
from ..lang.syntax import Parsed, match_options, parse_standard
from ..lang.words import strip_outer_quotes
from ._util import eval_vector, plural, touse
from .registry import command
from .summarize import weights

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

_STATS = ("mean", "median", "sd", "semean", "sebinomial", "sepoisson", "sum", "rawsum",
          "count", "percent", "max", "min", "iqr", "first", "last", "firstnm", "lastnm")
_KEEP_TYPE = ("min", "max", "first", "last", "firstnm", "lastnm")
_STRING_OK = ("first", "last", "firstnm", "lastnm", "count")


def _stat_name(token: str) -> str:
    st = token.strip("() ").lower()
    if re.fullmatch(r"p\d{1,2}(\.\d+)?", st) and 0 < float(st[1:]) < 100:
        return st
    if st not in _STATS:
        raise StataError(198, f"{st} invalid statistic")   # VERIFY mensagem
    return st


def _parse_clist(s: "Session", text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """List of (statistic, new variable, source variable)."""
    toks = re.findall(r"\([^)]*\)|=|[^\s=()]+", text)
    out: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    stat = "mean"
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        t = toks[i]
        if t.startswith("("):
            stat = _stat_name(t)
            i += 1
            continue
        if t == "=":
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        if i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1] == "=":
            if i + 2 >= len(toks):
                raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
            new, src = t, s.expand_varlist(toks[i + 2])
            if len(src) != 1:
                raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
            check_name(new)
            out.append((stat, new, src[0]))
            i += 3
            continue
        for name in s.expand_varlist(t):
            out.append((stat, name, name))
        i += 1
    if not out:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for _, new, _ in out:
        if new in seen:
            # VERIFY mensagem
            raise StataError(198, f"{new} specified more than once")
        seen.add(new)
    return out


class _Groups:
    """Observations used, grouped: `g` is the group id (0..k-1) of each
    observation used, in data order."""

    def __init__(self, ids: np.ndarray, k: int, w: np.ndarray | None, wtype: str):
        self.rows = np.flatnonzero(ids >= 0)
        self.g = ids[self.rows]
        self.k = k
        self.w = None if w is None else w[self.rows]
        self.wtype = wtype


def _compute(stat: str, x: np.ndarray, G: _Groups) -> np.ndarray:
    """Statistic `stat` of x (aligned with G.rows) for each group."""
    k = G.k
    out = np.full(k, M.SYSMISS)
    ok = x < M.SYSMISS
    g = G.g[ok]
    xv = x[ok]
    w = np.ones(len(xv)) if G.w is None else G.w[ok]
    n_obs = np.bincount(g, minlength=k).astype(np.float64)
    sum_w = np.bincount(g, weights=w, minlength=k)
    if G.wtype in ("aweight", "pweight"):
        # weights normalized to sum to the number of observations in the group
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            wn = w * (n_obs / sum_w)[g]
        N = n_obs
    else:
        wn = w
        N = sum_w
    has = n_obs > 0
    if stat in ("first", "last", "firstnm", "lastnm"):
        rows_g = G.g if stat in ("first", "last") else g
        vals = x if stat in ("first", "last") else xv
        idx = np.arange(len(rows_g))
        pick = np.full(k, -1, dtype=np.int64)
        order = idx[::-1] if stat.startswith("first") else idx
        pick[rows_g[order]] = order
        got = pick >= 0
        out[got] = vals[pick[got]]
        return out
    if stat == "count":
        return N.copy() if G.w is not None else n_obs
    if stat == "percent":
        total = N.sum()
        return N / total * 100 if total else np.zeros(k)
    if stat == "rawsum":
        return np.bincount(g, weights=xv, minlength=k)
    if stat == "sum":
        return np.bincount(g, weights=wn * xv, minlength=k)
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        mean = np.bincount(g, weights=wn * xv, minlength=k) / np.bincount(g, weights=wn, minlength=k)
    if stat == "mean":
        out[has] = mean[has]
        return out
    if stat in ("sd", "semean"):
        dev2 = wn * (xv - mean[g]) ** 2
        m2 = np.bincount(g, weights=dev2, minlength=k)
        ok2 = has & (N > 1)
        sd = np.full(k, M.SYSMISS)
        sd[ok2] = np.sqrt(m2[ok2] / (N[ok2] - 1))
        if stat == "sd":
            return sd
        out[ok2] = sd[ok2] / np.sqrt(N[ok2])
        return out
    if stat == "sebinomial":
        ok2 = has & (mean >= 0) & (mean <= 1)
        out[ok2] = np.sqrt(mean[ok2] * (1 - mean[ok2]) / N[ok2])
        return out
    if stat == "sepoisson":
        ok2 = has & (mean >= 0)
        out[ok2] = np.sqrt(mean[ok2] / N[ok2])
        return out
    if stat in ("min", "max"):
        if stat == "min":
            acc = np.full(k, np.inf)
            np.minimum.at(acc, g, xv)
        else:
            acc = np.full(k, -np.inf)
            np.maximum.at(acc, g, xv)
        out[has] = acc[has]
        return out
    # percentis (median, iqr, p#): ordena por (grupo, valor)
    order = np.lexsort((xv, g))
    gs, xs, ws = g[order], xv[order], w[order]
    bounds = np.searchsorted(gs, np.arange(k + 1))
    for j in range(k):
        a, b = bounds[j], bounds[j + 1]
        if a == b:
            continue
        wj = None if G.w is None else ws[a:b]
        if stat == "median":
            out[j] = S.percentile(xs[a:b], 50, wj)
        elif stat == "iqr":
            out[j] = S.percentile(xs[a:b], 75, wj) - S.percentile(xs[a:b], 25, wj)
        else:
            out[j] = S.percentile(xs[a:b], float(stat[1:]), wj)
    return out


def _string_stat(stat: str, x: np.ndarray, G: _Groups) -> np.ndarray | None:
    k = G.k
    if stat == "count":
        return None
    out = np.array([""] * k, dtype=object)
    nonempty = np.array([t != "" for t in x], dtype=bool)
    sel = np.ones(len(x), dtype=bool) if stat in ("first", "last") else nonempty
    idx = np.flatnonzero(sel)
    order = idx[::-1] if stat.startswith("first") else idx
    pick = np.full(k, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    pick[G.g[order]] = order
    got = pick >= 0
    out[got] = x[pick[got]]
    return out


@command("collapse")
def cmd_collapse(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    clist_text = p.varlist if p.exp is None else f"{p.varlist} = {p.exp}"
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "cw": 2, "fast": 4})
    ds = s.data
    items = _parse_clist(s, clist_text)
    by = s.expand_varlist(str(opts["by"])) if opts.get("by") not in (None, True) else []
    for _, new, _ in items:
        if new in by:
            raise StataError(198, f"{new} may not be both a by() variable and a target")  # VERIFY
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    w, wtype, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("aweight", "fweight", "iweight", "pweight"))
    if opts.get("cw"):
        for _, _, src in items:
            v = ds.get(src)
            mask &= (v.data < M.SYSMISS) if not v.is_string else np.array([t != "" for t in v.raw], dtype=bool)
    if not mask.any():
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    ids, k = group_ids(ds, by, mask)
    G = _Groups(ids, k, w, wtype)
    first = first_index(ids, k)
    new = Dataset()
    new.nobs = k
    new.label = ds.label
    used_labels: set[str] = set()
    # the by variables keep the order they have in the dataset (compat 1801)
    for name in sorted(by, key=ds.index):
        v = ds.get(name)
        nv = Variable(name, v.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=v.fmt, label=v.label, value_label=v.value_label)
        nv.raw = v.raw[first].copy()
        new.vars.append(nv)
        if v.value_label:
            used_labels.add(v.value_label)
    for stat, name, src in items:
        v = ds.get(src)
        # label with the name (not the label) of the source and percentiles as "p 50"; the source
        # format is kept (observed in Stata 14)
        shown_stat = f"p {stat[1:]}" if re.fullmatch(r"p\d.*", stat) else stat
        lab = f"({shown_stat}) {src}"
        if v.is_string:
            if stat not in _STRING_OK:
                raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
            res = _string_stat(stat, v.raw[G.rows], G)
            if res is not None:
                nv = Variable(name, v.vtype, res, fmt=v.fmt, label=lab)
                new.vars.append(nv)
                continue
            x = np.array([M.SYSMISS if t == "" else 0.0 for t in v.raw[G.rows]])
        else:
            x = np.asarray(v.data, dtype=np.float64)[G.rows]
        res = _compute(stat, x, G)
        fmt = v.fmt if not v.is_string else ""
        vlab = ""
        if stat in _KEEP_TYPE:
            vtype = v.vtype
            vlab = v.value_label
        elif stat == "count":
            vtype = "long" if np.all(res == np.trunc(res)) else "double"
        elif stat in ("sum", "rawsum"):
            vtype = "double"
        else:
            vtype = "double" if v.vtype == "double" else "float"           # VERIFY origem inteira
        nv = Variable(name, vtype, res, fmt=fmt or default_format(vtype), label=lab, value_label=vlab)
        if vlab:
            used_labels.add(vlab)
        new.vars.append(nv)
    new.value_labels = {n: dict(t) for n, t in ds.value_labels.items() if n in used_labels}
    new.sortlist = list(by)
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# contract
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("contract")
def cmd_contract(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"freq": 1, "cfreq": 2, "percent": 1, "cpercent": 2,
                                     "float": 2, "format": 3, "zero": 1, "nomiss": 5})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    w, wtype, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight",))
    if opts.get("nomiss"):
        for nm in names:
            v = ds.get(nm)
            mask &= (v.data < M.SYSMISS) if not v.is_string else np.array([t != "" for t in v.raw], dtype=bool)
    out_names = {}
    for key, default in (("freq", "_freq"), ("cfreq", None), ("percent", None), ("cpercent", None)):
        val = opts.get(key)
        if val is True:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        if val or default:
            nm = str(val).strip() if val else default
            check_name(nm)
            if nm in names:
                raise StataError(110, f"variable {nm} already defined")
            out_names[key] = nm
    ids, k = group_ids(ds, names, mask)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(ids >= 0)
    ww = np.ones(len(rows)) if w is None else w[rows]
    freq = np.bincount(ids[rows], weights=ww, minlength=k)
    first = first_index(ids, k)
    keys = {nm: ds.get(nm).raw[first] for nm in names}
    if opts.get("zero") and k:
        levels = [np.unique(ds.get(nm).raw[rows].astype(str) if ds.get(nm).is_string
                            else ds.get(nm).raw[rows]) for nm in names]
        grids = np.meshgrid(*levels, indexing="ij")
        combos = [g.ravel() for g in grids]
        have = {tuple(keys[nm][j] for nm in names): freq[j] for j in range(k)}
        freq = np.array([have.get(tuple(c[j] for c in combos), 0.0) for j in range(len(combos[0]))])
        keys = {}
        for nm, c in zip(names, combos):
            v = ds.get(nm)
            keys[nm] = np.array(c, dtype=object) if v.is_string else np.asarray(c, dtype=v.raw.dtype)
        k = len(freq)
    new = Dataset()
    new.nobs = k
    new.label = ds.label
    used = set()
    for nm in names:
        v = ds.get(nm)
        nv = Variable(nm, v.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=v.fmt, label=v.label, value_label=v.value_label)
        nv.raw = keys[nm].copy()
        new.vars.append(nv)
        if v.value_label:
            used.add(v.value_label)
    total = freq.sum()
    ptype = "float" if opts.get("float") else "double"
    pfmt = strip_outer_quotes(str(opts["format"])) if opts.get("format") not in (None, True) else "%8.2f"
    ftype = smallest_type_for(freq) if k else "byte"   # VERIFY type of _freq
    if ftype in ("float", "double"):
        ftype = "long"
    # formats observed in Stata 14: _freq %12.0g and cfreq %10.0g, even for byte
    columns = {
        "freq": (freq, ftype, "%12.0g", "Frequency"),
        "cfreq": (np.cumsum(freq), ftype, "%10.0g", "Cumulative frequency"),
        "percent": (freq / total * 100 if total else freq * 0, ptype, pfmt, "Percent"),
        "cpercent": (np.cumsum(freq) / total * 100 if total else freq * 0, ptype, pfmt,
                     "Cumulative percent"),
    }
    for key in ("freq", "cfreq", "percent", "cpercent"):    # VERIFY order and labels
        if key in out_names:
            vals, vt, fmt, lab = columns[key]
            new.vars.append(Variable(out_names[key], vt, vals, fmt=fmt, label=lab))
    new.value_labels = {n: dict(t) for n, t in ds.value_labels.items() if n in used}
    new.sortlist = list(names)
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# expand
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("expand")
def cmd_expand(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    text = args.strip()
    if text.startswith("="):
        text = text[1:]
    p = parse_standard(text)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 1})
    ds = s.data
    if not p.varlist.strip():
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    gen = str(opts["generate"]).strip() if opts.get("generate") not in (None, True) else ""
    if gen:
        if ds.has(gen):
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {gen} already defined")
        check_name(gen)
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    k = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, p.varlist), dtype=np.float64), (ds.nobs,))
    # VERIFY: non-integer values are truncated; < 1 or missing keep the obs.
    copies = np.where(mask & (k < M.SYSMISS) & (k >= 1), np.trunc(np.minimum(k, 2**31)), 1).astype(np.int64)
    extra = np.repeat(np.arange(ds.nobs), copies - 1)
    n0 = ds.nobs
    if len(extra):
        for v in ds.vars:
            v.raw = np.concatenate([v.raw, v.raw[extra]])
        ds.nobs = n0 + len(extra)
        ds.sortlist = []
        ds.changed = True
    if gen:
        flag = np.zeros(ds.nobs)
        flag[n0:] = 1
        ds.add(Variable(gen, "byte", flag))
    s.output.write(f"({plural(len(extra), 'observation')} created)\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fillin
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("fillin")
def cmd_fillin(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.options.strip() or p.if_ or p.in_:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")   # VERIFY
    if ds.has("_fillin"):
        raise StataError(110, "variable _fillin already defined")
    levels = []
    for nm in names:
        v = ds.get(nm)
        if v.is_string:
            levels.append(np.unique(v.raw.astype(str)).astype(object))
        else:
            levels.append(np.unique(v.raw))
    present = set(zip(*[ds.get(nm).raw.astype(str) if ds.get(nm).is_string else ds.get(nm).raw
                        for nm in names])) if ds.nobs else set()
    grids = np.meshgrid(*[np.arange(len(lv)) for lv in levels], indexing="ij")
    combos = [lv[g.ravel()] for lv, g in zip(levels, grids)]
    missing_rows = [j for j in range(len(combos[0]) if combos else 0)
                    if tuple(c[j] for c in combos) not in present]
    n0 = ds.nobs
    add = len(missing_rows)
    if add:
        ds.set_obs(n0 + add)
        for nm, c in zip(names, combos):
            v = ds.get(nm)
            v.raw[n0:] = c[missing_rows]
    flag = np.zeros(ds.nobs)
    flag[n0:] = 1
    ds.add(Variable("_fillin", "byte", flag))
    from ..core import sorting
    sorting.sort(ds, names)
    s.notify_state()

"""Count-time data and case-control sampling of survival data: ct/ctset, cttost, sttoct and sttocc
([ST] ctset, [ST] cttost, [ST] sttoct, [ST] sttocc).

Details that the manuals do not show carry the VERIFY mark (compat/do/1901_survival.do)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import rng
from ..core.dataset import Dataset, Variable, smallest_type_for
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.grouping import group_ids
from ..estimation.st import _stset, header, require_st, st_data
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ._util import touse
from .strates import _result_dataset

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
_KEYS = ("ct_t", "ct_nf", "ct_nc", "ct_ne", "ct_by", "ct_show")


def _ct(s: "Session") -> dict:
    ch = s.data.chars.get("_dta", {})
    if "ct_t" not in ch:
        raise StataError(119, "data not ct")
    return {k: ch.get(k, "") for k in _KEYS}


def _show(s: "Session", c: dict) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    out = s.output
    name = ds.fullpath or ds.filename
    if name:
        out.write(f"dataset name:  {name}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'time:':>17}  {c['ct_t']}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'no. fail:':>17}  {c['ct_nf']}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'no. lost:':>17}  {c['ct_nc'] or '-- (meaning 0 lost)'}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'no. enter:':>17}  {c['ct_ne'] or '-- (meaning all enter at time 0)'}\n", "text")
    if c["ct_by"]:
        out.write(f"{'by:':>17}  {c['ct_by']}\n", "text")   # VERIFY: alignment of the labels


def _check(s: "Session", c: dict) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    t = ds.get(c["ct_t"]).data
    if np.any(t[t < SYS] < 0):
        raise StataError(459, f"{c['ct_t']} has negative values")   # VERIFY
    for key in ("ct_nf", "ct_nc", "ct_ne"):
        if c[key]:
            x = ds.get(c[key]).data
            if np.any(x >= SYS) or np.any(x < 0):
                raise StataError(459, f"{c[key]} has missing or negative values")   # VERIFY
    if c["ct_ne"]:
        by = c["ct_by"].split()
        gid, k = group_ids(ds, by)
        out = ds.get(c["ct_nf"]).data + (ds.get(c["ct_nc"]).data if c["ct_nc"] else 0)
        ent = ds.get(c["ct_ne"]).data
        for g in range(k):
            if ent[gid == g].sum() != out[gid == g].sum():
                raise StataError(459, "entering and exiting subjects do not balance")   # VERIFY


def cmd_ctset(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "show": 4, "noshow": 6, "clear": 5})
    ds = s.data
    ch = ds.chars.setdefault("_dta", {})
    if o.get("clear"):
        for k in _KEYS:
            ch.pop(k, None)
        return
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    if not names:
        if o.get("show") or o.get("noshow"):
            _ct(s)
            ch["ct_show"] = "1" if o.get("show") else "0"
            return
        c = _ct(s)
        _show(s, c)
        _check(s, c)
        return
    if len(names) > 4:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    for n in names:
        if ds.get(n).is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    by = s.expand_varlist(str(o["by"])) if o.get("by") else []
    c = {"ct_t": names[0], "ct_nf": names[1], "ct_nc": names[2] if len(names) > 2 else "",
         "ct_ne": names[3] if len(names) > 3 else "", "ct_by": " ".join(by),
         "ct_show": "0" if o.get("noshow") else "1"}
    _check(s, c)
    for k in _KEYS:
        ch.pop(k, None)
    ch.update(c)
    _show(s, c)


def cmd_ct(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if args.strip():
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    cmd_ctset(s, "")


def _free_name(ds: Dataset, given, candidates) -> str:
    if given:
        if ds.has(str(given)):
            raise StataError(110, f"{given} already defined")
        return str(given)
    for nm in candidates:
        if not ds.has(nm):
            return nm
    raise StataError(110, "variable already defined; specify wvar() and t0()")   # VERIFY


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cttost
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_cttost(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"t0": 2, "wvar": 1, "clear": 5, "nopreserve": 5})
    c = _ct(s)
    ds = s.data
    if ds.changed and not (o.get("clear") or o.get("nopreserve")):
        raise StataError(4, "no; data in memory would be lost")
    _check(s, c)
    wname = _free_name(ds, o.get("wvar"), ("w", "pop", "weight", "wgt"))
    t0name = _free_name(ds, o.get("t0"), ("t0", "time0", "etime")) if c["ct_ne"] else ""
    tv, nf = ds.get(c["ct_t"]), ds.get(c["ct_nf"])
    n = ds.nobs
    nc = ds.get(c["ct_nc"]).data if c["ct_nc"] else np.zeros(n)
    t, f = tv.data, nf.data
    by = c["ct_by"].split()
    src, tt, dd, ww, ee = [], [], [], [], []
    if not c["ct_ne"]:
        # failures first and then censorings at each time, everyone entering at 0
        for i in range(n):
            for d, cnt in ((1, f[i]), (0, nc[i])):
                if cnt > 0:
                    src.append(i)
                    tt.append(t[i])
                    dd.append(d)
                    ww.append(cnt)
    else:
        ne = ds.get(c["ct_ne"]).data
        gid, k = group_ids(ds, by)
        # each exit draws its entry time at random among the entries before it (VERIFY: Stata
        # does not document the draw)
        for g in range(k):
            idx = np.flatnonzero(gid == g)
            et = np.unique(t[idx][ne[idx] > 0])
            remain = np.array([ne[idx][t[idx] == x].sum() for x in et], dtype=float)
            units = []
            for i in idx[np.argsort(t[idx], kind="stable")]:
                units += [(i, 1)] * int(f[i]) + [(i, 0)] * int(nc[i])
            u = rng.RNG.uniform(len(units)) if units else []
            tally: dict = {}
            for (i, d), ui in zip(units, u):
                avail = remain[:np.searchsorted(et, t[i], "left")]
                if avail.sum() <= 0:
                    raise StataError(459, "entering and exiting subjects cannot be matched")   # VERIFY
                j = int(np.searchsorted(np.cumsum(avail), np.floor(ui * avail.sum()) + 1, "left"))
                remain[j] -= 1
                tally[(i, d, j)] = tally.get((i, d, j), 0) + 1
            for (i, d, j), cnt in tally.items():
                src.append(i)
                tt.append(t[i])
                dd.append(d)
                ww.append(cnt)
                ee.append(et[j])
    cols = [(c["ct_nf"], dd, "%9.0g"), (wname, ww, "%9.0g")]
    if t0name:
        cols.append((t0name, ee, tv.fmt))
    new = _result_dataset(s, by + [c["ct_t"]], src, [])
    for nm, vals, f_ in cols:
        arr = np.array(vals, dtype=np.float64)
        vt = "byte" if nm == c["ct_nf"] else ("double" if nm == t0name else smallest_type_for(arr))
        new.vars.append(Variable(nm, vt, arr, fmt=f_ if vt in ("double", "float") or nm != c["ct_nf"] else "%8.0g"))
    new.nobs = len(src)
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()
    text = f"{c['ct_t']} [fweight={wname}], failure({c['ct_nf']})"
    if t0name:
        text += f" time0({t0name})"
    _stset(s, text, report=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sttoct
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_sttoct(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "replace": 1, "noshow": 6})
    info = require_st(s)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) not in (2, 3):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    for nm in names:
        if ds.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
    by = s.expand_varlist(str(o["by"])) if o.get("by") else []
    sd = st_data(s, touse(s, p))
    rows = np.flatnonzero(sd.mask)
    t, t0, d, w = sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d, sd.w
    gid, k = group_ids(ds, by, sd.mask)
    gid = gid[rows]
    if len(names) == 2:
        keep = _subject_ends(sd, gid, by, ds, rows, info)
    else:
        keep = np.ones(len(t), dtype=bool)
    times = np.unique(np.concatenate([t[keep], t0[keep]])) if len(names) == 3 else np.unique(t[keep])
    out_rows = []
    for g in range(k):
        sel = gid == g
        first = int(rows[np.flatnonzero(sel)[0]])
        for x in (times if len(names) == 3 else np.unique(t[keep & sel])):
            nfail = float(w[keep & sel & (t == x) & (d == 1)].sum())
            ncens = float(w[keep & sel & (t == x) & (d == 0)].sum())
            nent = float(w[sel & (t0 == x)].sum()) if len(names) == 3 else 0.0
            if nfail or ncens or nent:
                out_rows.append((first, x, nfail, ncens, nent))
    firsts = [r[0] for r in out_rows]
    cols = [("t", [r[1] for r in out_rows], "%9.0g")]
    for j, nm in enumerate(names):
        cols.append((nm, [r[2 + j] for r in out_rows], "%9.0g"))
    new = _result_dataset(s, by, firsts, [])
    for nm, vals, f_ in cols:
        arr = np.array(vals, dtype=np.float64)
        new.vars.append(Variable(nm, "double" if nm == "t" else smallest_type_for(arr), arr, fmt=f_))
    new.nobs = len(firsts)
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()
    ch = new.chars.setdefault("_dta", {})
    ch.update({"ct_t": "t", "ct_nf": names[0], "ct_nc": names[1], "ct_ne": names[2] if len(names) == 3 else "",
               "ct_by": " ".join(by), "ct_show": "0" if o.get("noshow") else "1"})


def _subject_ends(sd, gid, by, ds, rows, info) -> np.ndarray:
    """The last record of each subject (all records if there is no id()); checks the conditions
    for the form without newentvar: everyone enters at 0, no gaps, no recurring risk, and by()
    constant within subject (VERIFY the messages)."""
    t, t0, d = sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d
    if sd.ids is None:
        if np.any(t0 != 0):
            raise StataError(459, "sttoct requires newentvar when subjects do not all enter at time 0")   # VERIFY
        return np.ones(len(t), dtype=bool)
    keep = np.zeros(len(t), dtype=bool)
    for sid in np.unique(sd.ids):
        j = np.flatnonzero(sd.ids == sid)
        j = j[np.argsort(t[j], kind="stable")]
        if t0[j[0]] != 0 or np.any(t0[j[1:]] != t[j[:-1]]) or np.any(d[j[:-1]] != 0) \
                or len(np.unique(gid[j])) > 1:
            raise StataError(459, "sttoct requires newentvar for these data")   # VERIFY
        keep[j[-1]] = True
    return keep


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sttocc
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_sttocc(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"match": 1, "number": 1, "nodots": 3, "generate": 1})
    info = require_st(s)
    ds = s.data
    number = int(float(str(o["number"]))) if o.get("number") else 1
    if number < 1:
        raise StataError(198, "number() must be a positive integer")   # VERIFY
    gen = str(o["generate"]).split() if o.get("generate") else ["_case", "_set", "_time"]
    if len(gen) != 3:
        raise StataError(198, "generate() requires three names")
    for nm in gen:
        if ds.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
    mvars = s.expand_varlist(str(o["match"])) if o.get("match") else []
    keep_names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else \
        [n for n in ds.names if n not in ("_st", "_d", "_t", "_t0")]
    sd = st_data(s, touse(s, p))
    rows = np.flatnonzero(sd.mask)
    t, t0, d = sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d
    ids = sd.ids if sd.ids is not None else np.arange(len(t))
    mg = group_ids(ds, mvars, sd.mask)[0][rows] if mvars else np.zeros(len(t), dtype=int)
    cases = np.flatnonzero(d == 1)
    out = s.output
    header(s, info)
    if mvars:
        out.write(f"{'matching for':>19}:  {' '.join(mvars)}\n", "text")
    ft, cnt = np.unique(t[cases], return_counts=True)
    ties = int((cnt > 1).sum())
    if ties:
        out.write(f"There were {ties} tied times involving failure(s)\n", "text")
        out.write("- tied failure times split at random\n", "text")
    out.write(f"There are {len(cases)} cases\n", "text")
    out.write(f"Sampling {number} controls for each case \n", "text")
    order = np.full(len(t), 2.0)
    order[cases] = rng.RNG.uniform(len(cases)) if len(cases) else []
    picked, setid, ctime, is_case = [], [], [], []
    for k, c in enumerate(cases, start=1):
        tf = t[c]
        elig = (t0 <= tf) & ((t > tf) | ((t == tf) & (order > order[c]))) & (ids != ids[c]) & (mg == mg[c])
        cand = np.flatnonzero(elig)

            cand = cand[np.sort(first)]

                out.write(f" Warning: sample requested greater than population. Only {len(cand)} "
                          "controls selected\n", "text")

            cand = cand[np.argsort(u, kind="stable")[:number]]
        for j, flag in [(c, 1)] + [(j, 0) for j in cand]:
            picked.append(rows[j])
            setid.append(k)
            ctime.append(tf)
            is_case.append(flag)

    picked = [picked[i] for i in ordr]
    setid, ctime, is_case = ([x[i] for i in ordr] for x in (setid, ctime, is_case))
    new = _result_dataset(s, keep_names, picked,
                          [(gen[0], is_case, "%8.0g"), (gen[1], setid, "%12.0g"), (gen[2], ctime, "%8.0g")])
    for nm, vt, lab in ((gen[0], "byte", "0 for controls; 1 for cases"), (gen[1], "long", "case-control ID"),
                        (gen[2], smallest_type_for(new.get(gen[2]).data), "analysis time of the case's failure")):
        v = new.get(nm)
        v.vtype = vt
        v.label = lab
    new.sortlist = [gen[1], gen[0]]
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()

"""Phase 1a data commands: set obs, generate, replace, drop, keep,
count, rename, order, sort, gsort, format, compress, input.

Messages follow Stata 14 ([D] manuals); those that depend on undocumented
details are marked VERIFY and have cases in compat/.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import sorting
from ..core.dataset import (NUMERIC_TYPES, STR_MAX, TYPE_ORDER, Variable,
                            check_name, default_format, fit_numeric,
                            is_string_type, smallest_type_for, str_len,
                            str_type_for)
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import is_format, parse_format
from ..core.varlist import expand, resolve_name, unique
from ..lang.expr import evaluate, parse
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lang.vexpr import broadcast, is_str
from ._util import (ObsContext, check_kind, eval_sample, groups, plural,
                    references_subscript, touse)
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session


def _note(s: "Session", text: str) -> None:
    s.output.write(text + "\n", "text")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# set obs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def set_obs(s: "Session", value: str) -> None:
    try:
        n = int(float(s.expand(value).replace(",", "")))
    except ValueError:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    old = s.data.nobs
    if n < old:
        raise StataError(198, f"obs must be at least {old}" if old else "invalid syntax")
    s.data.set_obs(n)
    _note(s, f"number of observations (_N) was {old:,}, now {n:,}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# generate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TYPE_RE = re.compile(r"^(byte|int|long|float|double|str\d+|strL|str)$")


@command("generate", "g", byable=True)
def cmd_generate(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.exp is None:
        raise StataError(198, "=exp required")
    words = p.varlist.split()
    vtype = None
    if len(words) == 2 and _TYPE_RE.match(words[0]):
        vtype, target = words
    elif len(words) == 1:
        target = words[0]
    else:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    vlabel = ""
    if ":" in target:
        target, vlabel = target.split(":", 1)
    check_name(target)
    ds = s.data
    if ds.has(target):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {target} already defined")
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"before": 3, "after": 2})

    mask = touse(s, p)
    value = eval_sample(s, p.exp, mask)
    n = ds.nobs
    want_string = vtype is not None and vtype.startswith("str")
    if vtype is not None:
        check_kind(value, want_string)
    string = is_str(value)

    if string:
        col = broadcast(value, n).astype(object).copy()
        col[~mask] = ""
        longest = max((str_len(x) for x in col), default=1) or 1
        if vtype in (None, "str"):
            vtype = str_type_for(longest)
        elif vtype != "strL":
            cap = int(vtype[3:])
            col = np.array([x.encode("utf-8")[:cap].decode("utf-8", "ignore") for x in col], dtype=object)
        nmiss = int(sum(1 for x in col if x == ""))
    else:
        if vtype is None:
            vtype = s.default_type()
        col = broadcast(value, n).astype(np.float64).copy()
        col[~mask] = M.SYSMISS
        # counts only missing values from the expression and obs excluded by if/in; values out of
        # the type's range also become missing but are not counted (gen byte b = 200 in 1/3 reports
        # 3, observed in Stata)
        nmiss = int(np.sum(col >= M.SYSMISS))
        col, _ = fit_numeric(col, vtype)

    var = Variable(target, vtype, col, value_label=vlabel)
    position = None
    if opts.get("before"):
        position = ds.index(resolve_name(ds, str(opts["before"])))
    elif opts.get("after"):
        position = ds.index(resolve_name(ds, str(opts["after"]))) + 1
    ds.add(var, position=position)
    if nmiss:
        _note(s, f"({plural(nmiss, 'missing value')} generated)")
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# replace
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("replace", "replace", byable=True)
def cmd_replace(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.exp is None:
        raise StataError(198, "=exp required")
    ds = s.data
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    # VERIFY: does Stata require the full name in replace?
    var = ds.get(resolve_name(ds, names[0]))
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"nopromote": 6})
    mask = touse(s, p)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(mask)
    node = parse(p.exp)

    if references_subscript(node, var.name):
        new_values = _replace_sequential(s, var, node, rows)
    else:
        value = eval_sample(s, p.exp, mask)
        check_kind(value, var.is_string)
        new_values = broadcast(value, ds.nobs)[rows]

    old = var.data.copy()
    if var.is_string:
        changed, note = ds.set_string(var, np.asarray(new_values, dtype=object), rows)
        to_missing = int(sum(1 for i in rows if var.raw[i] == "" and old[i] != ""))
    else:
        changed, note = ds.set_numeric(var, np.asarray(new_values, dtype=np.float64), rows,
                                       promote=not opts.get("nopromote"))
        to_missing = int(np.sum((var.data[rows] >= M.SYSMISS) & (old[rows] < M.SYSMISS)))
    if note:
        _note(s, note)
    msg = f"({plural(changed, 'real change')} made"
    if to_missing:
        msg += f", {to_missing:,} to missing"
    _note(s, msg + ")")
    s.notify_state()


def _replace_sequential(s: "Session", var: Variable, node, rows: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """replace x = x[_n-1] ... uses values already replaced in earlier obs."""
    ctx = ObsContext(s, groups(s))
    original = var.raw.copy()
    out = []
    try:
        for i in rows:
            ctx.i = int(i)
            v = evaluate(node, ctx)
            check_kind(v, var.is_string)
            if not var.is_string:
                v, _ = fit_numeric(np.array([v]), var.vtype)
                v = float(v[0])
            var.set_value(i, v)
            out.append(v)
    finally:
        var.raw = original
    return np.array(out, dtype=object if var.is_string else np.float64)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# drop / keep
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _drop_keep(s: "Session", args: str, keep: bool) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    ds = s.data
    if p.varlist and (p.if_ or p.in_):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    if p.varlist:
        names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist))
        if keep:
            names = [n for n in ds.names if n not in set(names)]
        ds.drop_vars(names)
        s.notify_state()
        return
    if not (p.if_ or p.in_):
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    mask = touse(s, p)
    keep_mask = mask if keep else ~mask
    removed = ds.keep_obs(keep_mask)
    _note(s, f"({plural(removed, 'observation')} deleted)")
    s.notify_state()


@command("drop", byable=True)
def cmd_drop(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _drop_keep(s, args, keep=False)


@command("keep", byable=True)
def cmd_keep(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _drop_keep(s, args, keep=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sample
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("sample", byable=True)
def cmd_sample(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """sample # [if] [in] [, count by(groupvars)] ([D] sample): simple random sampling without
    replacement. # is the percentage of observations to keep or, with count, their number.
    Observations outside if/in are kept; with by() or the by prefix, each group is sampled
    separately.

    As observed in Stata 14 (compat 0310): two uniform draws per observation, in the current
    order (the first set orders the observations, the second breaks ties; VERIFY), also with
    by (VERIFY); the data end up sorted by group, then the observations in if/in, then the
    draws, with no sort order recorded; in each group the first n candidates are kept, n being
    # or round(# x size/100). sample 100 and sample #, count with # >= _N draw nothing."""
    from ..core import rng
    from ..core.grouping import group_ids
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.weight is not None or p.using is not None:
        raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed" if p.weight is not None else "using not allowed")
    text = p.varlist.strip()
    if not text:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"count": 5, "by": 2}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    count = bool(o.get("count"))
    try:
        num = float(text)
    except ValueError:
        try:
            num = float(s.eval(text))
        except StataError:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax") from None
    if count and num != int(num):
        raise StataError(126, f"'{text}' found where integer expected")   # VERIFY: rc
    if count and num < 0:
        # Stata 14 explains and carries on, keeping no observation (compat 0310)
        s.output.write(f"{text}:  # must be 0 or positive; with the count option, it represents "
                       "the # of observations to be drawn\n", "text")
        num = 0.0
    elif not count and not 0 <= num <= 100:
        s.output.write(f"{text}:  # must be between 0 and 100 and is interpreted as a percent unless "
                       "option count is also specified, in which case # is interpreted as the number "
                       "of observations to be drawn\n", "text")
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    n = ds.nobs
    mask = touse(s, p)
    if isinstance(o.get("by"), str):
        if s.by_groups is not None:
            raise StataError(190, "option by() may not be combined with by prefix")   # VERIFY
        names = unique(expand(ds, str(o["by"])))
        ids = group_ids(ds, names)[0]
    elif s.by_groups is not None:
        ids = np.asarray(s.by_groups.ids, dtype=np.int64)
    else:
        ids = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    if (not count and num == 100) or (count and num >= n):
        # nothing to drop: Stata does not draw (compat 0310: the stream advances by 2N for
        # sample 0 but not for sample 100 nor for sample #, count with # >= _N; VERIFY with
        # if/in or by, when # covers every group but not _N)
        return
    u1 = rng.RNG.uniform(n) if n else np.zeros(0)
    u2 = rng.RNG.uniform(n) if n else np.zeros(0)
    cand = mask & (ids >= 0)
    # group, then the candidates first, then the draws
    order = np.lexsort((u2, u1, ~cand, ids))
    keep = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    oc = cand[order]
    og = ids[order]
    sel = order[oc]
    gs = og[oc]
    if len(sel):
        starts = np.flatnonzero(np.r_[True, gs[1:] != gs[:-1]])
        sizes = np.diff(np.r_[starts, len(sel)])
        for a_, size in zip(starts, sizes):
            want = min(int(num), size) if count else int(np.floor(num * size / 100 + 0.5))
            keep[sel[a_ + want:a_ + size]] = False
    ds.reorder_obs(order)
    ds.sortlist = []
    removed = ds.keep_obs(keep[order])
    if removed:
        _note(s, f"({plural(removed, 'observation')} deleted)")
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# count
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("count", "count", byable=True)
def cmd_count(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.varlist:
        raise StataError(101, "varlist not allowed")
    mask = touse(s, p)
    if s.by_groups is not None and s.data.nobs:
        g = s.by_groups
        ids = g.ids
        for gid in range(int(ids.max()) + 1 if len(ids) else 0):
            sel = ids == gid
            _by_header(s, int(np.flatnonzero(sel)[0]))
            n = int(mask[sel].sum())
            s.output.write(f"  {n:,}\n", "result")
        s.r = {"N": float(n)} if len(ids) else {"N": 0.0}
        return
    n = int(mask.sum())
    # VERIFY: indentation and thousands separator in count's output
    s.output.write(f"  {n:,}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"N": float(n)}


def _by_header(s: "Session", first_obs: int) -> None:
    """'-> g = 1' header before each group (commands that repeat output)."""
    keys = getattr(s, "_by_keys", [])
    ds = s.data
    parts = []
    for k in keys:
        var = ds.get(k)
        v = var.value(first_obs)
        from ..core.formats import format_value
        shown = v if var.is_string else format_value(float(v), var.fmt, pad=False).strip()
        if not var.is_string and var.value_label:
            lab = ds.value_labels.get(var.value_label, {})
            if float(v) == int(float(v)) and int(float(v)) in lab:
                shown = lab[int(float(v))]
        parts.append(f"{k} = {shown}")
    # the line takes c(linesize) (255 dashes in compat; VERIFY with the default 80)
    width = int(s.settings.get("linesize", 80))
    s.output.write("\n" + "-" * width + "\n", "text")
    s.output.write("-> " + ", ".join(parts) + "\n", "text")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rename / order
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("rename", "ren")
def cmd_rename(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words = args.split()
    if len(words) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    old = resolve_name(ds, words[0])
    ds.rename(old, words[1])
    s.notify_state()


@command("order")
def cmd_order(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    ds = s.data
    names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist, allow_empty=False))
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"first": 5, "last": 4, "before": 3, "after": 2,
                                     "alphabetic": 5, "sequential": 3})
    if opts.get("alphabetic"):
        names = sorted(names, key=str.lower)
    before = resolve_name(ds, str(opts["before"])) if opts.get("before") else None
    after = resolve_name(ds, str(opts["after"])) if opts.get("after") else None
    ds.order(names, last=bool(opts.get("last")), before=before, after=after)
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sort / gsort
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("sort", "so")
def cmd_sort(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    ds = s.data
    names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist, allow_empty=False))
    match_options(p.options, {"stable": 6})
    if p.in_:
        # [D] sort: only the observations in the range are sorted; the dataset is then not
        # marked as sorted (VERIFY: c(sortlist) after sort ... in)
        from ..lang.syntax import parse_in
        lo, hi = parse_in(p.in_, ds.nobs)
        order = sorting.sort_order(ds, names)
        sub = np.arange(lo, hi)
        rank = np.empty(ds.nobs, dtype=np.int64)
        rank[order] = np.arange(ds.nobs)
        full = np.arange(ds.nobs)
        full[sub] = sub[np.argsort(rank[sub], kind="stable")]
        if not np.all(full == np.arange(ds.nobs)):
            ds.reorder_obs(full)
        ds.sortlist = []
        s.notify_state()
        return
    sorting.sort(ds, names)
    s.notify_state()


@command("gsort")
def cmd_gsort(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    ds = s.data
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"mfirst": 2, "generate": 3})
    keys: list[str] = []
    desc: list[bool] = []
    for tok in p.varlist.replace("+ ", "+").replace("- ", "-").split():
        d = tok.startswith("-")
        name = tok.lstrip("+-")
        for n in expand(ds, name):
            keys.append(n)
            desc.append(d)
    if not keys:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    sorting.sort(ds, keys, desc, missing_first=bool(opts.get("mfirst")))
    if opts.get("generate"):
        newname = str(opts["generate"])
        ds.add(Variable(newname, "long", np.arange(1, ds.nobs + 1, dtype=np.float64)))
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# format
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("format")
def cmd_format(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    words = args.split()
    fmt_pos = [i for i, w in enumerate(words) if w.startswith("%")]
    if not fmt_pos:
        # `format varlist` lists the formats
        for n in expand(ds, args):
            s.output.write(f"{n:<16}{ds.get(n).fmt}\n", "text")
        return
    i = fmt_pos[0]
    fmt_text = words[i]
    names = words[:i] if i > 0 else words[i + 1:]
    if not is_format(fmt_text):
        raise StataError(120, f"{fmt_text} invalid %format")
    fmt = parse_format(fmt_text)
    for n in unique(expand(ds, " ".join(names), allow_empty=False)):
        var = ds.get(n)
        if var.is_string != (fmt.kind == "s"):
            raise StataError(120, f"{fmt_text} invalid %format")
        var.fmt = fmt_text
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# compress
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_BYTES = {"byte": 1, "int": 2, "long": 4, "float": 4, "double": 8}


@command("compress")
def cmd_compress(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    names = expand(ds, args) if args.strip() else ds.names
    # numeric first, then strings (order observed in Stata)
    names = [n for n in names if not ds.get(n).is_string] + [n for n in names if ds.get(n).is_string]
    saved = 0
    for n in names:
        var = ds.get(n)
        if var.is_string:
            if var.vtype == "strL":
                continue
            cur = int(var.vtype[3:])
            need = max(1, var.max_strlen())
            if need < cur:
                newt = f"str{need}"
                _note(s, f"  variable {n} was {var.vtype} now {newt}")
                saved += (cur - need) * ds.nobs
                if var.fmt == default_format(var.vtype):
                    var.fmt = default_format(newt)
                var.vtype = newt
            continue
        need = smallest_type_for(var.data)
        if var.vtype == "float" and need == "double":
            need = "float"
        if TYPE_ORDER[need] < TYPE_ORDER[var.vtype]:
            # a float only goes down to an integer type if all values are integers
            _note(s, f"  variable {n} was {var.vtype} now {need}")
            saved += (_BYTES[var.vtype] - _BYTES[need]) * ds.nobs
            if var.fmt == default_format(var.vtype):
                var.fmt = default_format(need)
            var.vtype = need
    # VERIFY: exact format of the summary
    _note(s, f"  ({saved:,} bytes saved)")
    if saved:
        ds.changed = True
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# recast
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _truncate_bytes(text: str, n: int) -> str:
    b = text.encode("utf-8")[:n]
    return b.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")


@command("recast")
def cmd_recast(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    head, comma, opts_text = args.partition(",")
    opts = match_options(opts_text, {"force": 5}) if comma else {}
    words = head.split(None, 1)
    if len(words) < 2:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    newt = words[0]
    if newt == "str":
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    if not (newt in NUMERIC_TYPES or re.match(r"^str(\d+|L)$", newt)):
        raise StataError(198, f"{newt} invalid type")   # VERIFY
    if newt.startswith("str") and newt != "strL" and not 1 <= int(newt[3:]) <= STR_MAX:
        raise StataError(198, f"{newt} invalid type")
    ds = s.data
    for n in unique(expand(ds, words[1])):
        var = ds.get(n)
        if var.vtype == newt:
            continue
        if var.is_string != is_string_type(newt):
            raise StataError(109, f"{n}:  {newt} invalid")   # VERIFY return code
        if var.is_string:
            if newt == "strL":
                new = var.data
                changed = 0
            else:
                width = int(newt[3:])
                new = np.array([_truncate_bytes(x, width) for x in var.data], dtype=object)
                changed = int(sum(a != b for a, b in zip(var.data, new)))
        else:
            new, _ = fit_numeric(var.data, newt)
            same = (new == var.data) | ((new >= M.SYSMISS) & (var.data >= M.SYSMISS)
                                         & (new.view(np.int64) == var.data.view(np.int64)))
            changed = int((~same).sum())
        if changed and not opts.get("force"):
            # VERIFY: text and return code when there is loss without force
            _note(s, f"{n}:  {plural(changed, 'value')} would be changed; not changed")
            continue
        if changed:
            _note(s, f"{n}:  {plural(changed, 'value')} changed")
        # recast keeps the format and the sort order (observed in Stata 14: double %10.0g becomes
        # int %10.0g; "Sorted by" remains)
        var.vtype = newt
        sortlist = list(ds.sortlist)
        if var.is_string:
            var.data = new
        else:
            ds.set_numeric(var, new, promote=False)
        ds.sortlist = sortlist
        ds.changed = True
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# input (the data come in the following lines, up to `end`)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_input(s: "Session", spec: str, rows: list[str]) -> None:
    from ..lang.words import split_words

    ds = s.data
    tokens = spec.split()
    decl: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    pending_type = None
    for t in tokens:
        if _TYPE_RE.match(t) and pending_type is None and not ds.has(t):
            pending_type = t
            continue
        decl.append((t, pending_type or ""))
        pending_type = None
    if not decl:
        # no varlist: enters data into the existing variables
        decl = [(n, "") for n in ds.names]
    created = []
    for name, t in decl:
        if ds.has(name):
            continue
        vtype = t or s.default_type()
        if vtype == "str":
            vtype = "str1"
        if vtype.startswith("str"):
            col = np.array([""] * ds.nobs, dtype=object)
        else:
            col = np.full(ds.nobs, M.SYSMISS)
        ds.add(Variable(name, vtype, col))
        created.append(name)
    vars_ = [ds.get(n) for n, _ in decl]
    start = ds.nobs
    ds.set_obs(start + len(rows))
    for k, line in enumerate(rows):
        values = split_words(line)
        for j, var in enumerate(vars_):
            raw = values[j] if j < len(values) else ""
            i = start + k
            if var.is_string:
                text = raw
                if var.vtype != "strL" and str_len(text) > int(var.vtype[3:]):
                    text = text.encode("utf-8")[:int(var.vtype[3:])].decode("utf-8", "ignore")
                var.set_value(i, text)
            else:
                if raw in ("", "."):
                    v = M.SYSMISS
                else:
                    try:
                        v = M.missing_code(raw) if raw.startswith(".") else float(raw)
                    except ValueError:
                        raise StataError(198, f"'{raw}' cannot be read as a number")
                fitted, _ = fit_numeric(np.array([v]), var.vtype)
                var.set_value(i, fitted[0])
    s.notify_state()

"""Data-management commands of [D]: clonevar, ds, lookfor, inspect, labelbook,
compare, cf, datasignature, insobs, range, ipolate, separate, stack, xpose,

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as _dt
import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.dataset import TYPE_ORDER, Dataset, Variable, smallest_type_for

from ._util import eval_vector, touse

if TYPE_CHECKING:
