SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _missing_text(n: int) -> str:
    return f"({n:,} missing value{'s' if n != 1 else ''} generated)"


def _need_clear(s: "Session", o: dict) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    if ds.changed and ds.nvars and not o.get("clear"):
        raise StataError(4, "no; data in memory would be lost")


def _new_numeric(s: "Session", name: str, values: np.ndarray, vtype: str | None = None) -> Variable:
    return Variable(name, vtype or s.default_type(), np.asarray(values, dtype=float))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# clonevar
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("clonevar", "clonevar")
def cmd_clonevar(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\s*\w+\s*", p.varlist) or not p.exp or not re.fullmatch(r"\s*\w+\s*", p.exp):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    new, old = p.varlist.strip(), s.expand_varlist(p.exp.strip())[0]
    ds = s.data
    src = ds.get(old)
    mask = touse(s, p)
    if src.is_string:
        vals = np.where(mask, np.asarray(src.raw, dtype=object), "")
    else:
        vals = np.where(mask, src.data, SYS)
    v = Variable(new, src.vtype, vals, fmt=src.fmt, label=src.label, value_label=src.value_label,
                 notes=list(src.notes))
    ds.add(v, position=None)
    if old in ds.chars:
        ds.chars[new] = dict(ds.chars[old])
    nmiss = int((~mask).sum()) if not src.is_string else 0
    if p.if_ or p.in_:
        if nmiss:
            _note(s, _missing_text(nmiss))
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ds, lookfor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _spec_match(s: "Session", v: Variable, spec: str) -> bool:
    words = spec.split()
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    kind, pats = words[0], words[1:]
    ds = s.data

    def pat_ok(text: str) -> bool:
        if not pats:
            return bool(text)
        from fnmatch import fnmatchcase
        return any(fnmatchcase(text, p) for p in pats)
    if kind == "type":
        t = v.vtype
        for p in pats:
            if p == "numeric" and not v.is_string or p == "string" and v.is_string or p == t:
                return True
            if p.startswith("str") and "-" in p and t.startswith("str") and t != "strL":
                lo, hi = p[3:].split("-")
                if int(lo) <= int(t[3:]) <= int(hi):
                    return True
        return False
    if kind == "varlabel":
        return pat_ok(v.label)
    if kind == "vallabel":
        return pat_ok(v.value_label)
    if kind == "format":
        return pat_ok(v.fmt)
    if kind == "char":
        names = list(ds.chars.get(v.name, {}))
        return bool(names) if not pats else any(pat_ok(n) for n in names)
    raise StataError(198, f"{kind} invalid")   # VERIFY


@command("ds", "ds")
def cmd_ds(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"not": 3, "alpha": 1, "detail": 1, "varwidth": 4, "skip": 2,
                                  "has": 3, "insensitive": 3, "indent": 3})
    ds = s.data
    names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist)) if p.varlist.strip() else ds.names
    has, nothas = None, None
    if isinstance(o.get("has"), str):
        has = str(o["has"])
    if has is not None and isinstance(o.get("not"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "may not combine options has() and not()")   # compat 1501
    if isinstance(o.get("not"), str):
        nothas = str(o["not"])
    elif o.get("not") is True:
        if not p.varlist.strip():
            raise StataError(198, "varlist required with not")   # VERIFY
        drop = set(names)
        names = [n for n in ds.names if n not in drop]
    if has is not None:
        names = [n for n in names if _spec_match(s, ds.get(n), has)]
    if nothas is not None:
        names = [n for n in names if not _spec_match(s, ds.get(n), nothas)]
    if o.get("alpha"):
        names = sorted(names, key=lambda n: (n.lower(), n) if o.get("insensitive") else n)
    if o.get("detail"):
        if names:
            from .inspect import cmd_describe
            cmd_describe(s, " ".join(names))
    elif names:
        from .summarize import _abbrev
        w = int(o["varwidth"]) if isinstance(o.get("varwidth"), str) else 12   # VERIFY default
        skip = int(o["skip"]) if isinstance(o.get("skip"), str) else 2
        indent = int(o["indent"]) if isinstance(o.get("indent"), str) else 0
        # columns as wide as the longest name shown, plus the skip (compat 1501)
        col = min(w, max(len(n) for n in names)) + skip
        per = max(1, (79 - indent) // col)
        shown = [_abbrev(n, w) for n in names]
        out = s.output
        for i in range(0, len(shown), per):
            line = " " * indent + "".join(f"{n:<{col}}" for n in shown[i:i + per])
            out.write(line.rstrip() + "\n", "text")
    s.r = {"varlist": " ".join(names)}


@command("lookfor", "lookfor")
def cmd_lookfor(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words = [strip_outer_quotes(w) for w in re.findall(r'"[^"]*"|\S+', args)]
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    found = [v.name for v in ds.vars
             if any(w.lower() in v.name.lower() or w.lower() in v.label.lower() for w in words)]
    if found:
        from .inspect import cmd_describe
        cmd_describe(s, " ".join(found))
    s.r = {"varlist": " ".join(found)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# inspect
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("inspect", "inspect", byable=True)
def cmd_inspect(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    ds = s.data
    names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist)) if p.varlist.strip() else ds.names
    mask = touse(s, p)
    out = s.output
    for n in names:
        v = ds.get(n)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        if v.is_string:
            out.write(f"{n}:  {v.label}\n", "text")
            out.write("-" * min(len(n) + 1, 30) + "\n", "text")
            out.write("    (string variable)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
            continue
        x = v.data[mask]
        ok = x < SYS
        xv = x[ok]
        is_int = xv == np.floor(xv)
        rows = [("Negative", xv < 0), ("Zero", xv == 0), ("Positive", xv > 0)]
        hist = _hist_rows(xv)
        # layout of Stata 14 (compat 1501)
        head = f"{n}:  {v.label}"
        out.write(f"{head:<48}Number of Observations\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'-' * len(head):<39}" + "-" * 39 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(" " * 45 + "Total      Integers   Nonintegers\n", "text")
        for i, (lab, sel) in enumerate(rows):
            t, ints = int(sel.sum()), int((sel & is_int).sum())
            out.write(f"|  {hist[i]:<26}{lab:<10}", "text")
            out.write(f"{_dash(t):>11}{_dash(ints):>14}{_dash(t - ints):>14}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"|  {hist[3]:<36}" + "   ".join(["-" * 11] * 3) + "\n", "text")
        t, ints = len(xv), int(is_int.sum())
        out.write(f"|  {hist[4]:<26}{'Total':<10}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_dash(t):>11}{_dash(ints):>14}{_dash(t - ints):>14}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"|  {hist[5]:<26}{'Missing':<10}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_dash(int((~ok).sum())):>11}\n", "result")
        out.write("+" + "-" * 22 + " " * 16 + "-" * 11 + "\n", "text")
        lo = format_value(float(xv.min()), "%9.0g", pad=False).strip() if len(xv) else ""
        hi = format_value(float(xv.max()), "%9.0g", pad=False).strip() if len(xv) else ""
        out.write(f"{lo}{hi:>{max(23 - len(lo), len(hi) + 1)}}{len(x):>27}\n", "result")
        u = len(np.unique(xv))
        out.write(f"   ({u if u <= 99 else 'More than 99'} unique value{'s' if u != 1 else ''})\n", "text")
        nlab = 0
        if v.value_label and v.value_label in ds.value_labels:
            labs = ds.value_labels[v.value_label]
            nlab = sum(1 for val in np.unique(xv) if val == int(val) and int(val) in labs)
            out.write(f"\n   {n} is labeled and {'all' if nlab == u else nlab} values are documented in the "
                      f"label.\n", "text")   # VERIFY wording
        # return list order of Stata 14; N counts the nonmissing values, N_undoc the values
        # without a label (missing when there is no value label) (compat 1501)
        undoc = float(u - nlab) if v.value_label and v.value_label in ds.value_labels else SYS
        s.r = {"N_undoc": undoc, "N_unique": float(u), "N": float(len(xv)),
               "N_posint": float(((xv > 0) & is_int).sum()), "N_pos": float((xv > 0).sum()),
               "N_0": float((xv == 0).sum()), "N_negint": float(((xv < 0) & is_int).sum()),
               "N_neg": float((xv < 0).sum())}


def _dash(n: int) -> str:
    return "-" if n == 0 else f"{n:,}"


def _hist_rows(x: np.ndarray) -> list[str]:
    """Small text histogram: up to 5 columns of '#', 6 rows high, empty bins shown as '.' in
    the last row (compat 1501)."""
    rows = [""] * 6
    if not len(x):
        return rows
    k = min(5, len(np.unique(x)))
    counts, _ = np.histogram(x, bins=k)
    top = counts.max()
    for r in range(6):
        level = (5 - r) / 6 * top
        rows[r] = "   ".join("#" if c > level else ("." if c == 0 and r == 5 else " ") for c in counts).rstrip()
    return rows


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# labelbook
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("labelbook", "labelbook")
def cmd_labelbook(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words, opt = _split_opts(args)
    o = match_options(opt, {"alpha": 1, "length": 3, "list": 2, "problems": 1, "detail": 1})
    ds = s.data
    names = words or sorted(ds.value_labels)
    if o.get("alpha"):
        names = sorted(names)
    L = int(o["length"]) if isinstance(o.get("length"), str) else 12
    out = s.output
    problems = []
    for name in names:
        if name not in ds.value_labels:
            raise StataError(111, f"value label {name} not found")
        lab = ds.value_labels[name]
        vals = sorted(lab)
        texts = [lab[v] for v in vals]
        users = [v.name for v in ds.vars if v.value_label == name]
        real = [v for v in vals if v < 2 ** 31 - 1 - 26]     # extended missing codes are stored high
        gaps = bool(real) and (real[-1] - real[0] + 1 != len(real))
        lens = [len(t) for t in texts] or [0]
        uniq_full = len(set(texts)) == len(texts)
        uniq_L = len({t[:L] for t in texts}) == len(texts)
        null = any(t == "" for t in texts)
        blanks = any(t != t.strip() for t in texts)
        numnum = any(re.fullmatch(r"\s*-?[\d.]+\s*", t) and float(t) != v for v, t in zip(vals, texts)
                     if re.fullmatch(r"\s*-?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*", t))
        if not users or not uniq_L or null or blanks or numnum or gaps and o.get("problems"):
            problems.append(name)
        if o.get("problems"):
            continue
        rule = "-" * int(s.settings.get("linesize", 80))      # c(linesize) (compat 1501)
        out.write("\n" + rule + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"value label {name} \n", "text")
        out.write(rule + "\n\n", "text")
        rng = f"[{real[0]},{real[-1]}]" if real else "[.]"
        rows = [("range:", rng, "string length:", f"[{min(lens)},{max(lens)}]"),
                ("N:", str(len(vals)), "unique at full length:", "yes" if uniq_full else "no"),
                ("gaps:", "yes" if gaps else "no", f"unique at length {L}:", "yes" if uniq_L else "no"),
                ("missing .*:", str(len(vals) - len(real)), "null string:", "yes" if null else "no"),
                ("", "", "leading/trailing blanks:", "yes" if blanks else "no"),
                ("", "", "numeric -> numeric:", "yes" if numnum else "no")]
        out.write(f"{'values':>12}{'labels':>42}\n", "text")
        for a, b, c, d in rows:
            out.write(f"{a:>13}  {b:<16}{c:>24}  {d}\n", "text")
        limit = int(o["list"]) if isinstance(o.get("list"), str) else 32000
        out.write("\n  definition\n", "text")
        for v, t in list(zip(vals, texts))[:limit]:
            out.write(f"{v:>12}   {t}\n", "text")
        out.write("\n" + f"{'variables:':>13}  {' '.join(users)}\n", "text")
    if o.get("problems") or problems:
        if problems and o.get("problems"):
            out.write("\nValue labels with potential problems: " + " ".join(problems) + "\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        elif o.get("problems"):
            out.write(f"\nno potential problems in dataset {s.data.filename or "[unnamed]"}\n", "text")
    s.r = {"names": " ".join(names), "notused": " ".join(n for n in names if not any(v.value_label == n for v in ds.vars))}


def _split_opts(args: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    body, opt = (args, "") if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
    return body.split(), opt


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# compare
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("compare", "compare", byable=True)
def cmd_compare(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    a, b = ds.get(names[0]), ds.get(names[1])
    if a.is_string or b.is_string:
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    mask = touse(s, p)
    x, y = a.data[mask], b.data[mask]
    okx, oky = x < SYS, y < SYS
    both = okx & oky
    d = x - y
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n" + " " * 40 + "---------- difference ----------\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 28 + "count       minimum      average     maximum\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 72 + "\n", "text")

    def line(label, sel, diff=True):
        n = int(sel.sum())
        if not n:
            return
        out.write(f"{label:<23}", "text")
        if diff:
            dd = d[sel]
            out.write(f"{n:>10}{_g(dd.min()):>14}{_g(dd.mean()):>13}{_g(dd.max()):>12}\n", "result")
        else:
            out.write(f"{n:>10}\n", "result")
    an, bn = a.name, b.name
    line(f"{an}<{bn}", both & (x < y))
    line(f"{an}={bn}", both & (x == y), False)     # no difference columns (compat 1501)
    line(f"{an}>{bn}", both & (x > y))
    out.write(" " * 23 + "-" * 10 + "\n", "text")
    line("jointly defined", both)
    line(f"{bn} missing only", okx & ~oky, False)
    line(f"{an} missing only", ~okx & oky, False)
    line("jointly missing", ~okx & ~oky, False)
    out.write(" " * 23 + "-" * 10 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'total':<23}", "text")
    out.write(f"{len(x):>10}\n", "result")


def _g(x: float) -> str:
    return format_value(float(x), "%9.0g", pad=False).strip()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cf
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("cf", "cf")
def cmd_cf(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .combine import load_using
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.using is None:
        raise StataError(100, "using required")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"all": 3, "verbose": 1})
    ds = s.data
    U = load_using(p.using)
    names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist)) if p.varlist.strip() else ds.names
    out = s.output
    bad = 0
    if ds.nobs != U.nobs:
        out.write(f"{'':>13}master has {ds.nobs:,} obs.; using {U.nobs:,}\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        raise StataError(9, "")
    for n in names:
        a = ds.get(n)
        if not U.has(n):
            out.write(f"{n:>13}:  does not exist in using\n", "text")
            bad += 1
            continue
        b = U.get(n)
        if a.is_string != b.is_string:
            diff = np.ones(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
        elif a.is_string:
            diff = np.array([x != y for x, y in zip(a.raw, b.raw)], dtype=bool)
        else:
            diff = ~((a.data == b.data) | ((a.data >= SYS) & (b.data >= SYS) & (a.data == b.data)))
        k = int(diff.sum())
        if k:
            bad += 1
            # "mismatches" also for one; values as shown by %9.0g (compat 1501)
            out.write(f"{n:>16}:  {k} mismatches\n", "text")
            if o.get("verbose"):
                for i in np.flatnonzero(diff):
                    out.write(f"{'':>19}obs {i + 1:,}. {_cfval(a, i)} in master; {_cfval(b, i)} in using\n", "text")
        elif o.get("all"):
            out.write(f"{n:>16}:  match\n", "text")      # VERIFY
    s.r = {"Nsum": float(bad)}
    if bad:
        raise StataError(9, "")


def _cfval(v, i: int) -> str:
    return str(v.raw[i]) if v.is_string else _g(float(v.data[i]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# datasignature
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _signature(ds: Dataset) -> str:
    import zlib
    c1 = c2 = 0
    for v in ds.vars:
        raw = "\x00".join(v.raw.tolist()).encode() if v.is_string else \
            np.ascontiguousarray(v.data, dtype=np.float64).tobytes()
        c1 = zlib.crc32(v.name.encode() + raw, c1)
        c2 = zlib.adler32(raw, c2)
    # VERIFY: Stata's checksum algorithm is undocumented; N:k(width) follow the manual
    return f"{ds.nobs}:{ds.nvars}({ds.width()}):{c1}:{c2}"


@command("datasignature", "datasignature")
def cmd_datasignature(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words, opt = _split_opts(args)
    ds = s.data
    out = s.output
    sub = words[0] if words else ""
    sig = _signature(ds)
    chars = ds.chars.setdefault("_dta", {})
    if sub == "":
        match_options(opt, {"fast": 1, "esample": 2, "nodefault": 5, "nonames": 5})
        out.write(f"  {sig}\n", "result")
        s.r = {"datasignature": sig}
        return
    if sub == "set":
        o = match_options(opt, {"reset": 5, "saving": 6})
        if chars.get("datasignature_si") and not o.get("reset"):
            raise StataError(110, "data signature already set -- specify option reset")   # VERIFY
        stamp = _dt.datetime.now().strftime("%d%b%Y %H:%M").lower()
        chars["datasignature_si"] = sig
        chars["datasignature_dt"] = stamp
        out.write(f"  {sig}       (data signature set)\n", "text")
        s.r = {"datasignature": sig}
        return
    if sub == "confirm":
        match_options(opt, {"strict": 6})
        old = chars.get("datasignature_si")
        if not old:
            raise StataError(9, "data signature not set")   # VERIFY
        if old != sig:
            raise StataError(9, "data have changed since signature was set")   # VERIFY
        out.write(f"  (data unchanged since {chars.get('datasignature_dt', '')})\n", "text")
        return
    if sub == "report":
        old = chars.get("datasignature_si")
        if not old:
            out.write("  (data signature not set)\n", "text")
            return
        out.write(f"  data signature set on {chars.get('datasignature_dt', '')}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"  {'set' :>9}: {old}\n  {'current':>9}: {sig}\n", "text")
        out.write("  (data unchanged)\n" if old == sig else "  (data have changed)\n", "text")
        return
    if sub == "clear":
        chars.pop("datasignature_si", None)
        chars.pop("datasignature_dt", None)
        return
    raise StataError(198, f"datasignature {sub}: invalid subcommand")

@command("insobs", "insobs")
def cmd_insobs(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words, opt = _split_opts(args)
    o = match_options(opt, {"before": 1, "after": 1})
    if len(words) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    k = int(float(s.eval(words[0])))
    if k < 1:
        raise StataError(198, "number of observations must be positive")   # VERIFY
    ds = s.data
    n = ds.nobs
    if isinstance(o.get("before"), str):
        at = int(o["before"]) - 1
    elif isinstance(o.get("after"), str):
        at = int(o["after"])
    else:
        at = n
    if not 0 <= at <= n:
        raise StataError(198, "observation number out of range")   # VERIFY
    ds.set_obs(n + k)
    order = np.concatenate([np.arange(at), np.arange(n, n + k), np.arange(at, n)]).astype(int)
    ds.reorder_obs(order)
    ds.sortlist = []
    s.output.write(f"({k} observation{'s' if k != 1 else ''} added)\n", "text")    # compat 1501
    s.notify_state()


@command("range", "range")
def cmd_range(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words = args.split()
    if len(words) not in (3, 4):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    name = words[0]
    first, last = float(s.eval(words[1])), float(s.eval(words[2]))
    ds = s.data
    n = int(float(s.eval(words[3]))) if len(words) == 4 else ds.nobs
    if n > ds.nobs:
        _note(s, f"number of observations (_N) was {ds.nobs:,}, now {n:,}")
        ds.set_obs(n)
    vals = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
    if n == 1:
        vals[0] = first
    elif n > 1:
        vals[:n] = first + np.arange(n) * (last - first) / (n - 1)
    ds.add(_new_numeric(s, name, vals))
    s.notify_state()

@command("ipolate", "ipolate", byable=True)
def cmd_ipolate(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "epolate": 1})
    if not isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option generate() required")
    ds = s.data
    y, x = ds.get(names[0]).data, ds.get(names[1]).data
    mask = touse(s, p)
    groups = s.by_groups.ids if s.by_groups is not None else np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=int)
    out = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
    for g in np.unique(groups):
        sel = mask & (groups == g)
        known = sel & (x < SYS) & (y < SYS)
        if not known.any():
            continue
        xs, inv = np.unique(x[known], return_inverse=True)
        ys = np.bincount(inv, weights=y[known]) / np.bincount(inv)     # ties: mean of y
        target = sel & (x < SYS)
        xt = x[target]
        val = np.interp(xt, xs, ys)
        outside = (xt < xs[0]) | (xt > xs[-1])
        if o.get("epolate") and len(xs) >= 2:
            lo = (xt < xs[0])
            hi = (xt > xs[-1])
            val[lo] = ys[0] + (xt[lo] - xs[0]) * (ys[1] - ys[0]) / (xs[1] - xs[0])
            val[hi] = ys[-1] + (xt[hi] - xs[-1]) * (ys[-1] - ys[-2]) / (xs[-1] - xs[-2])
        else:
            val[outside] = SYS
        out[target] = val
    new = str(o["generate"])
    ds.add(_new_numeric(s, new, out, "double"))     # a double (compat 1501)
    nmiss = int((out >= SYS).sum())
    if nmiss:
        _note(s, _missing_text(nmiss))
    s.notify_state()

@command("separate", "separate")
def cmd_separate(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .inspect import cell_text
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "generate": 3, "sequential": 3, "missing": 4, "shortlabel": 5})
    if not isinstance(o.get("by"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option by() required")
    ds = s.data
    v = ds.get(names[0])
    mask = touse(s, p)
    by = str(o["by"]).strip()
    if ds.has(by) or (re.fullmatch(r"\w+", by) and s.expand_varlist(by)):
        g = ds.get(s.expand_varlist(by)[0])
        gvals = np.asarray(g.raw, dtype=object) if g.is_string else g.data
        valid = (np.array([t != "" for t in gvals]) if g.is_string else gvals < SYS)
        bylabel = g.name
        is_var = True
    else:
        e = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, by), dtype=float), (ds.nobs,))
        gvals, valid, bylabel, g, is_var = e, e < SYS, by, None, False
    if not o.get("missing"):
        mask = mask & valid
    levels = sorted(set(gvals[mask].tolist()), key=lambda t: (isinstance(t, str), t))
    stub = str(o["generate"]) if isinstance(o.get("generate"), str) else v.name
    created = []
    for k, lev in enumerate(levels, start=1):
        sel = mask & (gvals == lev)
        if o.get("sequential") or g is None or g.is_string:
            suffix = str(k) if o.get("sequential") or g is not None else str(int(lev)) if lev == int(lev) else str(k)
        else:
            suffix = str(int(lev)) if lev == int(lev) and lev >= 0 else str(k)
        new = stub + suffix
        if v.is_string:
            vals = np.where(sel, np.asarray(v.raw, dtype=object), "")
        else:
            vals = np.where(sel, v.data, SYS)
        i = int(np.flatnonzero(sel)[0])
        shown = cell_text(ds, g, i) if g is not None else format_value(float(lev), "%9.0g", pad=False).strip()
        label = f"{bylabel} == {shown}" if o.get("shortlabel") else f"{v.name}, {bylabel} == {shown}"
        vtype = v.vtype
        if not v.is_string:
            # the new variables are compressed, the display format kept (compat 1501)
            need = smallest_type_for(vals)
            if TYPE_ORDER[need] < TYPE_ORDER[vtype]:
                vtype = need
        ds.add(Variable(new, vtype, vals, fmt=v.fmt, label=label, value_label=v.value_label))
        created.append(new)
    from .inspect import cmd_describe
    cmd_describe(s, " ".join(created))
    s.r = {"varlist": " ".join(created)}
    s.notify_state()

@command("stack", "stack")
def cmd_stack(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"into": 4, "group": 1, "clear": 5, "wide": 4, "keep": 4})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if isinstance(o.get("into"), str):
        into = str(o["into"]).split()
        k = len(into)
    elif isinstance(o.get("group"), str):
        G = int(o["group"])
        if len(names) % G:
            raise StataError(198, "number of variables not divisible by group()")   # VERIFY
        k = len(names) // G
        into = names[:k]
    else:
        raise StataError(198, "option into() or group() required")
    if len(names) % k:
        raise StataError(198, "number of variables in varlist not a multiple of into()")   # VERIFY
    _need_clear(s, o)
    keep = s.expand_varlist(str(o["keep"])) if isinstance(o.get("keep"), str) else []
    mask = touse(s, p)
    blocks = [names[i:i + k] for i in range(0, len(names), k)]
    n = int(mask.sum())
    new = Dataset()
    new.set_obs(n * len(blocks))
    stack_id = np.repeat(np.arange(1, len(blocks) + 1), n).astype(float)
    new.add(Variable("_stack", "int", stack_id))
    for j, target in enumerate(into):
        cols = [ds.get(b[j]) for b in blocks]
        if any(c.is_string for c in cols) and not all(c.is_string for c in cols):
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
        if cols[0].is_string:
            vals = np.concatenate([np.asarray(c.raw, dtype=object)[mask] for c in cols])
            width = max(c.max_strlen() for c in cols)
            new.add(Variable(target, f"str{min(max(width, 1), 2045)}", vals))
        else:
            vals = np.concatenate([c.data[mask] for c in cols])
            vt = "double" if any(c.vtype == "double" for c in cols) else s.default_type()
            new.add(Variable(target, vt, vals, label=cols[0].label if not o.get("into") else ""))
    extra = []
    if o.get("wide"):
        extra = [nm for nm in names if nm not in into]
    for nm in keep + extra:
        c = ds.get(nm)
        base = np.asarray(c.raw, dtype=object)[mask] if c.is_string else c.data[mask]
        vals = np.concatenate([base] * len(blocks))
        if o.get("wide") and nm in names:
            # wide: each original variable keeps its values only in its own block
            pos = next(b for b, blk in enumerate(blocks) if nm in blk)
            empty = "" if c.is_string else SYS
            vals = np.concatenate([base if b == pos else np.full(n, empty, dtype=object if c.is_string else float)
                                   for b in range(len(blocks))])
        new.add(Variable(nm, c.vtype, vals, fmt=c.fmt, label=c.label, value_label=c.value_label))
    new.value_labels = dict(ds.value_labels)
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()


@command("xpose", "xpose")
def cmd_xpose(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    opt = "" if c == -1 else args[c + 1:]
    if c == -1 or args[:c].strip():
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax" if c != -1 else "option clear required")
    o = match_options(opt, {"clear": 5, "format": 3, "varname": 4, "promote": 3})
    if not o.get("clear"):
        raise StataError(198, "option clear required")
    ds = s.data
    nums = [v for v in ds.vars if not v.is_string and v.name != "_varname"]
    X = np.column_stack([v.data for v in nums]) if nums else np.zeros((ds.nobs, 0))
    new = Dataset()
    new.set_obs(len(nums))
    vt = "double" if o.get("promote") or any(v.vtype == "double" for v in nums) else "float"
    for i in range(ds.nobs):
        fmt = str(o["format"]) if isinstance(o.get("format"), str) else ""
        new.add(Variable(f"v{i + 1}", vt, X[i, :] if nums else np.zeros(0), fmt=fmt))
    if o.get("varname"):
        new.add(Variable("_varname", f"str{max([len(v.name) for v in nums] + [1])}",
                         np.array([v.name for v in nums], dtype=object)))
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()


@command("expandcl", "expandcl")
def cmd_expandcl(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"cluster": 2, "generate": 3})
    if not isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str) or not isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "options cluster() and generate() required")
    ds = s.data
    exp = (p.exp or p.varlist.lstrip("=")).strip()
    if not exp:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    times = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, exp), dtype=float), (ds.nobs,)).copy()
    mask = touse(s, p)
    cl = s.expand_varlist(str(o["cluster"]))
    keys = [tuple((ds.get(c).raw[i] if ds.get(c).is_string else float(ds.get(c).data[i])) for c in cl)
            for i in range(ds.nobs)]
    # the expansion count must be constant within cluster (VERIFY: message)
    reps = np.where(mask & (times < SYS), np.floor(times), 1).astype(int)
    reps = np.maximum(reps, 0)
    order = []
    newid = []
    nid = 0
    rows_by_cluster: dict[tuple, list[int]] = {}
    for i in range(ds.nobs):
        rows_by_cluster.setdefault(keys[i], []).append(i)
    for key, rows in rows_by_cluster.items():
        k = reps[rows[0]]
        if any(reps[r] != k for r in rows):
            raise StataError(498, "expansion count must be constant within cluster")   # VERIFY
        for rep in range(max(k, 0)):
            nid += 1
            for r in rows:
                order.append(r)
                newid.append(nid)
    created = len(order) - ds.nobs
    for v in ds.vars:
        v.raw = v.raw[np.array(order, dtype=int)] if order else v.raw[:0]
    ds.nobs = len(order)
    ds.esample = None
    ds.sortlist = []
    ds.add(Variable(str(o["generate"]), "long", np.array(newid, dtype=float)))
    if created >= 0:
        _note(s, f"({created:,} observation{'s' if created != 1 else ''} created)")
    else:
        _note(s, f"({-created:,} observation{'s' if created != -1 else ''} deleted)")
    s.notify_state()

@command("outfile", "outfile")
def cmd_outfile(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from pathlib import Path
    import os
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.using is None:
        raise StataError(100, "using required")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"dictionary": 3, "nolabel": 5, "noquote": 5, "replace": 7, "wide": 1,
                                  "comma": 1, "rjs": 3, "fjs": 3, "runtogether": 3, "missing": 2})
    ds = s.data
    names = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist)) if p.varlist.strip() else ds.names
    path = Path(os.path.expanduser(strip_outer_quotes(p.using)))
    if path.suffix == "":
        path = path.with_suffix(".dct" if o.get("dictionary") else ".raw")
    if path.exists() and not o.get("replace"):
        raise StataError(602, f"file {path} already exists")
    if not path.exists() and o.get("replace"):
        s.output.write(f"(note: file {path.name if not os.path.dirname(strip_outer_quotes(p.using)) else path} "
                       "not found)\n", "text")
    mask = touse(s, p)
    from .inspect import cell_text
    sep = "," if o.get("comma") else " "
    quote = not o.get("noquote")
    lines = []
    if o.get("dictionary"):
        lines.append("dictionary {")
        for n in names:
            v = ds.get(n)
            lab = f' "{v.label}"' if v.label else ""
            lines.append(f"\t{v.vtype:<8} {n:<12}{lab}")
        lines.append("}")
    for i in np.flatnonzero(mask):
        fields = []
        for n in names:
            v = ds.get(n)
            if v.is_string:
                t = str(v.raw[i])
                fields.append(f'"{t}"' if quote and not o.get("runtogether") else t)
                continue
            x = float(v.data[i])
            if x >= SYS:
                fields.append("." if not o.get("missing") or x == SYS else M.missing_name(x))
                continue
            if v.value_label and not o.get("nolabel") and x == int(x) and \
                    int(x) in ds.value_labels.get(v.value_label, {}):
                t = cell_text(ds, v, i)
                fields.append(f'"{t}"' if quote else t)
            elif o.get("comma") or o.get("runtogether"):
                fields.append(format_value(x, v.fmt, pad=False).strip().replace(",", ""))
            else:
                # VERIFY: compat 1501 shows two spaces before a %9.0g value after the first
                fields.append((" " if fields else "") + format_value(x, v.fmt, pad=True))
        line = ("" if o.get("runtogether") else sep).join(fields)
        if not o.get("wide") and not o.get("comma") and len(line) > 80:
            # VERIFY: Stata breaks long records over several lines
            parts, cur = [], ""
            for f in fields:
                if cur and len(cur) + 1 + len(f) > 80:
                    parts.append(cur)
                    cur = f
                else:
                    cur = f if not cur else cur + sep + f
            parts.append(cur)
            line = "\n".join(parts)
        lines.append(line)
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

@command("putmata", "putmata")
def cmd_putmata(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..mata.values import MV
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"omitmissing": 4, "replace": 7, "view": 1})
    ds = s.data
    mask = touse(s, p)
    specs = []          # (Mata name, [variables])
    text = p.varlist + (" = " + p.exp if p.exp else "")
    for m in re.finditer(r"(\w+)\s*=\s*\(([^)]*)\)|(\w+)\s*=\s*(\w+)|(\S+)", text):
        if m.group(1):
            specs.append((m.group(1), s.expand_varlist(m.group(2))))
        elif m.group(3):
            specs.append((m.group(3), s.expand_varlist(m.group(4))))
        else:
            for nm in s.expand_varlist(m.group(5)):
                specs.append((nm, [nm]))
    used = [v for _, vs in specs for v in vs]
    if o.get("omitmissing"):
        for nm in used:
            v = ds.get(nm)
            mask &= (np.array([t != "" for t in v.raw]) if v.is_string else v.data < SYS)
    g = s.mata.globals.vars
    for name, _ in specs:
        if name in g and not o.get("replace"):
            raise StataError(110, f"Mata matrix {name} already exists")   # VERIFY
    nvec = nmat = 0
    for name, vs in specs:
        cols = [ds.get(v) for v in vs]
        if any(c.is_string for c in cols):
            if not all(c.is_string for c in cols):
                raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
            arr = np.column_stack([np.asarray(c.raw, dtype=object)[mask] for c in cols])
            g[name] = MV(arr, "string")
        else:
            arr = np.column_stack([c.data[mask] for c in cols]) if cols else np.zeros((int(mask.sum()), 0))
            g[name] = MV(arr, "real")
        if len(vs) == 1:
            nvec += 1
        else:
            nmat += 1
    parts = []
    if nvec:
        parts.append(f"{nvec} vector{'s' if nvec != 1 else ''}")
    if nmat:
        parts.append(f"{nmat} matri{'ces' if nmat != 1 else 'x'}")
    _note(s, f"({', '.join(parts)} posted)")

"""Example datasets, medical codes, ODBC and business calendars: sysuse, webuse
([D] sysuse, webuse), icd9, icd9p and icd10 ([D] icd), odbc ([D] odbc) and bcal
([D] bcal).

sysuse loads OpenDTA's own example datasets (synthetic data built by
tools/make_datasets.py; Stata's example datasets are StataCorp files and are not
included) and datasets in the adopath. webuse downloads a dataset from a URL
prefix (webuse set), by default the public address of Stata's example datasets.
icd9 and icd10 check codes against the public-domain ICD-9-CM (diagnoses) and
ICD-10-CM tables of the U.S. CMS (core/icd.py) and give their descriptions;
icd9p checks procedure codes by their format only. odbc works through the
pyodbc package when it is installed. Messages not shown in the manual are marked
VERIFY and checked in compat/do/1501_datamgmt.do."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.dataset import Dataset, Variable
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options, parse_standard
from ..lang.words import strip_outer_quotes
from ._util import touse
from .data import _note
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
# the public web address of the example datasets of the target version ([D] webuse); the files are
# downloaded by the user on demand, not distributed with OpenDTA
WEBUSE_DEFAULT = "https://www.stata-press.com/data/r14/"
STATA_EXAMPLES = {"auto", "auto2", "census", "lifeexp", "nlsw88", "uslifeexp", "bplong", "bpwide",
                  "cancer", "citytemp", "voter", "pop2000", "sp500", "xtline1", "nhanes2"}


def _split(args: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    body, opt = (args, "") if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
    return [strip_outer_quotes(w) for w in re.findall(r'"[^"]*"|\S+', body)], opt


def _use(s: "Session", path: Path, clear: bool) -> None:
    s.interp._execute_expanded(f'use "{path}"' + (", clear" if clear else ""))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sysuse, webuse
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _sys_dirs(s: "Session") -> list[Path]:
    from ..lang.adopath import adopath, resolve_entry
    return [DATA_DIR] + [resolve_entry(s, e) for e in adopath(s)]


def _find_sys(s: "Session", name: str) -> Path | None:
    from ..lang.adopath import find_file
    fname = name if name.endswith(".dta") else name + ".dta"
    if (DATA_DIR / fname).exists():
        return DATA_DIR / fname
    hits = find_file(s, fname)
    return hits[0] if hits else None


@command("sysuse", "sysuse")
def cmd_sysuse(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words, opt = _split(args)
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    out = s.output
    if words[0] == "dir":
        match_options(opt, {"all": 3})
        names = sorted({f.name for d in _sys_dirs(s) if d.is_dir() for f in d.glob("*.dta")})
        width = max((len(n) for n in names), default=0) + 3
        per = max(1, 76 // width)
        for i in range(0, len(names), per):
            out.write("  " + "".join(f"{n:<{width}}" for n in names[i:i + per]).rstrip() + "\n", "text")
        return
    if words[0] == "describe":
        if len(words) != 2:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        f = _find_sys(s, words[1])
        if f is None:
            raise _not_found(words[1])
        from ..io.dta import read_dta
        from .inspect import cmd_describe
        saved = s.data
        try:
            s.data = read_dta(f)
            s.data.filename = f.name
            cmd_describe(s, "")
        finally:
            s.data = saved
        return
    o = match_options(opt, {"clear": 5})
    if len(words) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    f = _find_sys(s, words[0])
    if f is None:
        raise _not_found(words[0])
    _use(s, f, bool(o.get("clear")))


def _not_found(name: str) -> StataError:
    base = name[:-4] if name.endswith(".dta") else name
    if base in STATA_EXAMPLES:
        # Stata's example datasets are StataCorp files; OpenDTA has its own (sysuse dir)
        return StataError(601, f"file {base}.dta not found\n{base}.dta is one of Stata's example datasets, "
                               f"which OpenDTA does not include; webuse {base} downloads it from Stata's "
                               "website, and sysuse dir lists OpenDTA's own")
    return StataError(601, f"file {base}.dta not found")


@command("webuse", "webuse")
def cmd_webuse(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words, opt = _split(args)
    out = s.output
    if words and words[0] == "set":
        url = words[1] if len(words) > 1 else WEBUSE_DEFAULT
        if not url.endswith("/"):
            url += "/"
        s.settings["webuse_url"] = url
        out.write(f'(prefix now "{url}")\n', "text")
        return
    if words and words[0] == "query":
        out.write(f'(prefix is "{s.settings.get("webuse_url", WEBUSE_DEFAULT)}")\n', "text")
        return
    o = match_options(opt, {"clear": 5})
    if len(words) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    name = words[0] if words[0].endswith(".dta") else words[0] + ".dta"
    url = s.settings.get("webuse_url", WEBUSE_DEFAULT) + name
    import urllib.request
    from ..updater import ssl_context
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30, context=ssl_context()) as r:
            data = r.read()
    except Exception:   # noqa: BLE001
        raise StataError(601, f"file {url} not found")
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="opendta-webuse-")) / name
    tmp.write_bytes(data)
    _use(s, tmp, bool(o.get("clear")))
    s.data.filename = url

# icd9, icd9p, icd10
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_PROBLEMS = {
    # icd10 follows ICD-10-CM: up to 7 characters, letters allowed after the 2nd (VERIFY: Stata's
    # icd10 follows the WHO ICD-10, whose codes have at most 4)
    "icd10": ["Invalid placement of period", "Too many periods", "Code too short", "Code too long",
              "Invalid 1st char (not A-Z)", "Invalid 2nd char (not 0-9)", "Invalid 3rd char (not 0-9 or A-Z)",
              "Invalid 4th-7th char (not 0-9 or A-Z)", "Code not defined"],
    "icd9": ["Invalid placement of period", "Too many periods", "Code too short", "Code too long",
             "Invalid 1st char (not 0-9, E, or V)", "Invalid 2nd char (not 0-9)", "Invalid 3rd char (not 0-9)",
             "Invalid 4th char (not 0-9)", "Invalid 5th char (not 0-9)", "Code not defined"],
    "icd9p": ["Invalid placement of period", "Too many periods", "Code too short", "Code too long",
              "Invalid 1st char (not 0-9)", "Invalid 2nd char (not 0-9)", "Invalid 3rd char (not 0-9)",
              "Invalid 4th char (not 0-9)"],
}


def icd_problem(kind: str, code: str, fmtonly: bool = False) -> int:
    """0 if the code is valid, otherwise the number of the problem (1-based, as listed in
    _PROBLEMS). icd9 and icd10 also check that the code is defined in the public-domain
    ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM tables (core/icd.py), unless fmtonly; icd9p checks the format only."""
    p = _format_problem(kind, code)
    if p or fmtonly or kind == "icd9p":
        return p
    from ..core import icd
    return 0 if icd.defined(kind, code) else len(_PROBLEMS[kind])


def _format_problem(kind: str, code: str) -> int:
    c = code.strip().upper()
    if c.count(".") > 1:
        return 2
    body = c.replace(".", "")
    head = {"icd10": 3, "icd9p": 2}.get(kind, 4 if c.startswith("E") else 3)
    if "." in c and c.index(".") != head:
        return 1
    maxlen = {"icd10": 7, "icd9": 5, "icd9p": 4}[kind]
    minlen = 3 if kind != "icd9p" else 2
    if len(body) < minlen:
        return 3
    if len(body) > maxlen:
        return 4
    if kind == "icd10":
        if not ("A" <= body[0] <= "Z"):
            return 5
        if not body[1].isdigit():
            return 6
        if not body[2].isalnum():
            return 7
        if any(not ch.isalnum() for ch in body[3:]):
            return 8
        return 0
    if kind == "icd9":
        if not (body[0].isdigit() or body[0] in "EV"):
            return 5
        for i, ch in enumerate(body[1:], start=2):
            if not ch.isdigit():
                return 4 + i
        return 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(body, start=1):
        if not ch.isdigit():
            return 4 + i
    return 0


def _icd_info(s: "Session", kind: str, sub: str, rest: str) -> None:
    """icd9/icd10 lookup (codes, ranges a/b and wildcards), search (words in the descriptions)
    and query (the code list in use)."""
    from ..core import icd
    out = s.output
    if sub == "query":
        out.write(f"\n    {kind} codes: {icd.VERSIONS[kind]}, {len(icd.table(kind)):,} codes\n", "text")
        return
    c = find_top(rest, ",")
    body, opt = (rest, "") if c == -1 else (rest[:c], rest[c + 1:])
    o = match_options(opt, {"or": 2, "long": 1, "version": 1})
    t = icd.table(kind)
    codes = sorted(t)
    if sub == "lookup":
        hits = []
        for item in body.split():
            it = icd.norm(item)
            if "/" in it:
                a, b = it.split("/", 1)
                hits += [k for k in codes if a <= k[:len(a)] and k[:len(b)] <= b]
            elif it.endswith("*"):
                hits += [k for k in codes if k.startswith(it[:-1])]
            else:
                hits += [k for k in codes if k == it] or ([it] if icd.defined(kind, it) else [])
        if not hits:
            out.write("(no matches found)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    else:
        words = [strip_outer_quotes(w).lower() for w in re.findall(r'"[^"]*"|\S+', body)]
        if not words:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        test = any if o.get("or") else all
        hits = [k for k in codes if test(w in t[k][2].lower() for w in words)]
        if not hits:
            out.write("(no matches found)\n", "text")
    for k in dict.fromkeys(hits):
        out.write(f"{icd.dotted(kind, k):>10}  ", "result")
        out.write(icd.describe(kind, k, long=bool(o.get("long")) or sub == "search") + "\n", "text")
    s.r = {"N_codes": float(len(dict.fromkeys(hits)))}


def _icd(s: "Session", kind: str, args: str) -> None:
    words = args.split(None, 1)
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub, rest = words[0], (words[1] if len(words) > 1 else "")
    if sub in ("lookup", "search", "query"):
        if kind == "icd9p":
            raise StataError(198, "icd9p lookup, search and query need the ICD-9-CM procedure code list, which "
                                  "OpenDTA does not include; check, clean and generate work by the format")
        _icd_info(s, kind, sub, rest)
        return
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    ds = s.data
    out = s.output
    if sub == "check":
        o = match_options(p.options, {"any": 3, "list": 1, "generate": 3, "summary": 3, "version": 1,
                                      "fmtonly": 3, "system": 3})
        fmtonly = bool(o.get("any") or o.get("fmtonly"))   # VERIFY: meaning of any in Stata 14
        name = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)[0]
        v = ds.get(name)
        if not v.is_string:
            raise StataError(109, f"{name} must be a string variable")   # VERIFY
        mask = touse(s, p)
        codes = [str(x) for x in v.raw]
        probs = np.array([icd_problem(kind, c, fmtonly) if m and c.strip() else 0 for c, m in zip(codes, mask)])
        nmiss = sum(1 for c, m in zip(codes, mask) if m and not c.strip())
        bad = int((probs > 0).sum())
        # layout of Stata 14 (compat 1501; VERIFY: the wording with missing values and for
        # icd10/icd9p)
        tail = "no missing values" if not nmiss else f"{nmiss:,} missing value{'s' if nmiss != 1 else ''}"
        out.write(f"({name} contains {tail})\n", "text")
        if bad == 0:
            out.write(f"\n{name} contains valid codes\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        else:
            out.write(f"\n{name} contains invalid codes:\n\n", "text")
            for i, lab in enumerate(_PROBLEMS[kind], start=1):
                out.write(f"{i:>5}.  {lab:<40}", "text")
                out.write(f"{int((probs == i).sum()):>11,}\n", "result")
            out.write(" " * 48 + "-" * 11 + "\n", "text")
            out.write(f"{'':8}{'Total':<40}", "text")
            out.write(f"{bad:>11,}\n", "result")
        if isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
            ds.add(Variable(str(o["generate"]), "byte", probs.astype(float)))
            s.notify_state()
        if o.get("list") and bad:
            # a list of the code and the problem without its parenthesis (compat 1501)
            from .inspect import cmd_list
            out.write("\nListing of invalid and undefined codes\n", "text")
            short = np.array([_PROBLEMS[kind][k - 1].split(" (")[0] if k else "" for k in probs], dtype=object)
            w = max(len(x) for x in short)
            ds.add(Variable("__prob", f"str{w}", short, fmt=f"%-{w}s"))
            try:
                cmd_list(s, f'{name} __prob if __prob != ""')
            finally:
                ds.drop_vars(["__prob"])
        if o.get("summary"):
            vals, counts = np.unique([c.strip().upper() for c, m in zip(codes, mask) if m and c.strip()],
                                     return_counts=True)
            out.write(f"\n{name:>12} |      Freq.\n" + "-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 11 + "\n", "text")
            for c, n in zip(vals, counts):
                out.write(f"{c:>12} |", "text")
                out.write(f"{n:>11,}\n", "result")
        s.r = {"esum": float(bad)}
        for i in range(len(_PROBLEMS[kind])):
            s.r[f"e{i + 1}"] = float((probs == i + 1).sum())
        return
    if sub == "clean":
        # icd9 and icd9p clean take only dots and pad in Stata 14 (compat 1501)
        allowed = {"generate": 3, "replace": 7, "dots": 3, "pad": 3, "check": 5} if kind == "icd10" \
            else {"dots": 3, "pad": 3}
        o = match_options(p.options, allowed)
        name = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)[0]
        v = ds.get(name)
        if not v.is_string:
            raise StataError(109, f"{name} must be a string variable")   # VERIFY
        if kind != "icd10" and any(str(c).strip() and _format_problem(kind, str(c)) for c in v.raw):
            # clean refuses badly formed codes (compat 1501; VERIFY: icd9p wording)
            raise StataError(459, f"{name} contains invalid ICD-9 codes")
        head = {"icd10": 3, "icd9p": 2}.get(kind, 3)
        new_vals, changes = [], 0
        for c in v.raw:
            t = str(c).strip().upper().replace(" ", "").replace(".", "")
            if o.get("dots") and len(t) > head:
                h = 4 if kind == "icd9" and t.startswith("E") else head
                t = t[:h] + "." + t[h:]
            changes += t != c
            new_vals.append(t)
        if isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
            ds.add(Variable(str(o["generate"]), v.vtype, np.array(new_vals, dtype=object)))
        else:
            v.data = new_vals
            if kind != "icd10":
                # Stata 14 leaves the cleaned variable left-justified in list (compat 1501; VERIFY: the width)
                v.fmt = "%-" + v.fmt.lstrip("%-")
        _note(s, f"({changes:,} change{'s' if changes != 1 else ''} made)")   # VERIFY
        s.notify_state()
        return
    if sub in ("generate", "gen"):
        o = match_options(p.options, {"category": 3, "short": 2, "range": 2, "description": 4,
                                      "addcode": 3, "nodots": 3, "long": 2, "end": 2, "version": 1})
        if not p.exp:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        newname = p.varlist.strip()
        src = ds.get(s.expand_varlist(p.exp.strip())[0])
        codes = [str(c).strip().upper().replace(".", "") for c in src.raw]
        if o.get("description"):
            if kind == "icd9p":
                raise StataError(198, "icd9p generate, description needs the ICD-9-CM procedure code list, "
                                      "which OpenDTA does not include")
            from ..core import icd
            where = str(o["addcode"]) if isinstance(o.get("addcode"), str) else ""
            vals = []
            for c in codes:
                d = icd.describe(kind, c, long=bool(o.get("long"))) if c and icd.defined(kind, c) else ""
                if d and where.startswith("b"):
                    d = f"{icd.dotted(kind, c) if not o.get('nodots') else c} {d}"
                elif d and where.startswith("e"):
                    d = f"{d} {icd.dotted(kind, c) if not o.get('nodots') else c}"
                vals.append(d)
            ds.add(Variable(newname, f"str{max([len(x) for x in vals] + [1])}", np.array(vals, dtype=object)))
        elif o.get("category"):
            k = {"icd10": 3, "icd9p": 2}.get(kind, 3)
            vals = [c[:4] if kind == "icd9" and c.startswith("E") else c[:k] for c in codes]
            ds.add(Variable(newname, f"str{max([len(x) for x in vals] + [1])}", np.array(vals, dtype=object)))
        elif o.get("short"):
            vals = [c[:4] for c in codes]
            ds.add(Variable(newname, f"str{max([len(x) for x in vals] + [1])}", np.array(vals, dtype=object)))
        elif isinstance(o.get("range"), str):
            ranges = []
            for part in str(o["range"]).split():
                a, _, b = part.upper().replace(".", "").partition("/")
                ranges.append((a, b or a))

            def inside(c: str) -> bool:
                return any(a <= c[:len(a)] <= b or (c.startswith(a) and not b) or (a <= c <= b + "~")
                           for a, b in ranges) if c else False
            vals = np.array([1.0 if inside(c) else (SYS if not c else 0.0) for c in codes])
            ds.add(Variable(newname, "byte", vals))
        else:
            raise StataError(198, "category, short or range() required")   # VERIFY
        s.notify_state()
        return
    raise StataError(198, f"{kind} {sub}: invalid subcommand")


@command("icd10", "icd10")
def cmd_icd10(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _icd(s, "icd10", args)


@command("icd9", "icd9")
def cmd_icd9(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _icd(s, "icd9", args)


@command("icd9p", "icd9p")
def cmd_icd9p(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _icd(s, "icd9p", args)

def _pyodbc():
    try:
        import pyodbc
        return pyodbc
    except ImportError:
        raise StataError(198, "odbc needs the Python package pyodbc and an ODBC driver for your database "
                              "(pip install pyodbc)")


def _connect(s: "Session", o: dict):
    pyodbc = _pyodbc()
    dsn = strip_outer_quotes(str(o["dsn"])) if isinstance(o.get("dsn"), str) else s.settings.get("odbc_dsn")
    conn = strip_outer_quotes(str(o["connectionstring"])) if isinstance(o.get("connectionstring"), str) else None
    if not dsn and not conn:
        raise StataError(198, "dsn() or connectionstring() required")
    try:
        return pyodbc.connect(conn or f"DSN={dsn}", autocommit=True)
    except Exception as e:   # noqa: BLE001
        raise StataError(682, f"could not connect to {dsn or conn} ({e})")


_ODBC_OPTS = {"dsn": 3, "connectionstring": 4, "table": 1, "exec": 4, "clear": 5, "noquote": 5,
              "lowercase": 5, "sqlshow": 4, "allstring": 4, "datestring": 5, "user": 1, "password": 4}


@command("odbc", "odbc")
def cmd_odbc(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words = args.strip().split(None, 1)
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub, rest = words[0], (words[1] if len(words) > 1 else "")
    out = s.output
    c = find_top(rest, ",")
    body, opt = (rest, "") if c == -1 else (rest[:c], rest[c + 1:])
    if sub == "list":
        pyodbc = _pyodbc()
        out.write("\nData Source Name                   Driver\n" + "-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
        for name, drv in sorted(pyodbc.dataSources().items()):
            out.write(f"{name:<35}{drv}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
        return
    if sub == "query":
        o = match_options(opt, _ODBC_OPTS)
        if body.strip():
            o["dsn"] = body.strip()
        cn = _connect(s, o)
        out.write(f"\nDataSource: {strip_outer_quotes(str(o.get('dsn', '')))}\n" + "-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
        for row in cn.cursor().tables(tableType="TABLE"):
            out.write(f"{row.table_name}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
        return
    if sub == "describe":
        o = match_options(opt, _ODBC_OPTS)
        table = strip_outer_quotes(body.strip())
        cn = _connect(s, o)
        out.write(f"\nTable:  {table}\n" + "-" * 79 + "\n" + f"{'Variable Name':<35}Variable Type\n"
                  + "-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
        for col in cn.cursor().columns(table=table):
            out.write(f"{col.column_name:<35}{col.type_name}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
        return
    if sub == "load":
        o = match_options(opt, _ODBC_OPTS)
        if s.data.changed and s.data.nvars and not o.get("clear"):
            raise StataError(4, "no; data in memory would be lost")
        if isinstance(o.get("exec"), str):
            sql = strip_outer_quotes(str(o["exec"]))
        elif isinstance(o.get("table"), str):
            cols = ", ".join(body.split()) if body.strip() else "*"
            sql = f"SELECT {cols} FROM {strip_outer_quotes(str(o['table']))}"
        else:
            raise StataError(198, "table() or exec() required")
        if o.get("sqlshow"):
            out.write(f"SQL: {sql}\n", "text")
        cn = _connect(s, o)
        cur = cn.cursor()
        cur.execute(sql)
        names = [d[0].lower() if o.get("lowercase") else d[0] for d in cur.description]
        rows = cur.fetchall()
        ds = Dataset()
        ds.set_obs(len(rows))
        for j, n in enumerate(names):
            vals = [r[j] for r in rows]
            vname = re.sub(r"\W", "_", n)[:32]
            if not o.get("allstring") and all(v is None or isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in vals):
                ds.add(Variable(vname, "double", np.array([SYS if v is None else float(v) for v in vals])))
            else:
                texts = ["" if v is None else str(v) for v in vals]
                ds.add(Variable(vname, f"str{min(max([len(t) for t in texts] + [1]), 2045)}",
                                np.array(texts, dtype=object)))
        ds.changed = True
        s.data = ds
        s.notify_state()
        return
    if sub == "exec":
        m = re.match(r'\s*\((.*)\)\s*$', body) or re.match(r"(.*)", body)
        o = match_options(opt, _ODBC_OPTS)
        sql = strip_outer_quotes(m.group(1).strip())
        cn = _connect(s, o)
        cn.cursor().execute(sql)
        return
    raise StataError(198, f"odbc {sub} is not available in OpenDTA")
