@command("bcal", "bcal")
def cmd_bcal(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..core import bcal
    from ..core.formats import format_value
    words, opt = _split(args)
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub = words[0]
    out = s.output
    from ..lang.adopath import adopath, resolve_entry
    for e in adopath(s):
        bcal.add_path(resolve_entry(s, e))

    def td(x):
        return format_value(float(x), "%td", pad=False).strip()
    if sub == "check":
        o = match_options(opt, {"rc0": 3})
        names = words[1:] or sorted({re.match(r"%-?tb(\w+)", v.fmt).group(1) for v in s.data.vars
                                     if re.match(r"%-?tb\w", v.fmt)})
        ok = True
        for n in names:
            try:
                cal = bcal.get(n)
                users = [v.name for v in s.data.vars if re.match(rf"%-?tb{n}\b", v.fmt)]
                out.write(f"{'%tb' + n:>12}:  defined" + (", used by variable" + ("s" if len(users) > 1 else "")
                                                         if users else "") + "\n", "text")
                if users:
                    out.write(" " * 16 + " ".join(users) + "\n", "text")
            except StataError as e:
                ok = False
                out.write(f"{'%tb' + n:>12}:  {e.message}\n", "text")
        if not ok and not o.get("rc0"):
            raise StataError(459, "")   # VERIFY rc
        return
    if sub == "load":
        if len(words) != 2:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        bcal.clear_cache()
        cal = bcal.get(words[1])
        out.write(f"(calendar {cal.path} loaded)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        return
    if sub == "describe":
        if len(words) != 2:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        cal = bcal.get(words[1])
        n_in = len(cal.days)
        span = cal.hi - cal.lo + 1
        years = span / 365.25
        b_lo, b_hi = -cal.c_index, n_in - 1 - cal.c_index
        out.write(f"\n  Business calendar {cal.name} (format %tb{cal.name}):\n\n", "text")
        if cal.purpose:
            out.write(f"    purpose:  {cal.purpose}\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"      range:  {td(cal.lo):<11}{td(cal.hi)}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{cal.lo:>18}{cal.hi:>11}   in %td units\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{b_lo:>18}{b_hi:>11}   in %tb{cal.name} units\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"     center:  {td(cal.center)}\n{cal.center:>18}   in %td units\n{0:>18}   in %tb{cal.name} "
                  f"units\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    omitted:{span - n_in:>11,}   days\n{(span - n_in) / years:>21.1f}   approx. days/year\n\n",
                  "text")
        out.write(f"   included:{n_in:>11,}   days\n{n_in / years:>21.1f}   approx. days/year\n", "text")
        s.r = {"name": cal.name, "purpose": cal.purpose, "min_date_td": float(cal.lo), "max_date_td": float(cal.hi),
               "ctr_date_td": float(cal.center), "omitted": float(span - n_in), "included": float(n_in)}
        return
    if sub == "create":
        o = match_options(opt, {"from": 4, "generate": 3, "purpose": 4, "dateformat": 5, "range": 3,
                                "centerdate": 6, "excludemissing": 4, "maxgap": 4, "replace": 7, "personal": 4})
        if len(words) != 2 or not isinstance(o.get("from"), str):
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        path = Path(os.path.expanduser(words[1]))
        if path.suffix != ".stbcal":
            path = path.with_suffix(".stbcal")
        if path.exists() and not o.get("replace"):
            raise StataError(602, f"file {path} already exists")
        v = s.data.get(s.expand_varlist(str(o["from"]))[0])
        d = v.data
        days = np.unique(d[d < SYS]).astype(int)
        if not len(days):
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        lo, hi = int(days.min()), int(days.max())
        if isinstance(o.get("range"), str):
            a, b = str(o["range"]).split()
            lo, hi = _td(a), _td(b)
        present = set(days.tolist())
        import datetime as _dt
        epoch = _dt.date(1960, 1, 1)
        all_days = range(lo, hi + 1)
        dows = {(epoch + _dt.timedelta(days=t)).weekday() for t in present}
        drop_dow = [k for k in range(7) if k not in dows]
        names = ["Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa", "Su"]
        center = _td(str(o["centerdate"])) if isinstance(o.get("centerdate"), str) else min(present)

        def ymd(t):
            return (epoch + _dt.timedelta(days=t)).strftime("%Y%b%d").lower()
        lines = ["* Business calendar created by bcal create (OpenDTA)", "version 14",
                 f'purpose "{strip_outer_quotes(str(o.get("purpose")))}"' if isinstance(o.get("purpose"), str) else "",
                 "dateformat ymd", f"range {ymd(lo)} {ymd(hi)}", f"centerdate {ymd(center)}"]
        if drop_dow:
            lines.append("omit dayofweek (" + " ".join(names[k] for k in drop_dow) + ")")
        for t in all_days:
            if t not in present and (epoch + _dt.timedelta(days=t)).weekday() not in drop_dow:
                lines.append(f"omit date {ymd(t)}")
        path.write_text("\n".join(x for x in lines if x) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        bcal.clear_cache()
        out.write(f"\n  Business calendar {path.stem} (format %tb{path.stem}):\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    file {path} saved\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        if isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
            cal = bcal.get(path.stem) if path.parent.resolve() == Path.cwd().resolve() else \
                bcal.parse(path.stem, path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), str(path))
            vals = np.array([cal.bofd(x) if x < SYS else SYS for x in d])
            vals = np.where(np.isnan(vals), SYS, vals)
            s.data.add(Variable(str(o["generate"]), "long", vals, fmt=f"%tb{path.stem}"))
            s.notify_state()
        return
    raise StataError(198, f"bcal {sub}: invalid subcommand")


def _td(text: str) -> int:
    """A date such as 01nov2011 or 2011nov01 in %td units."""
    from ..core import bcal
    for order in ("dmy", "ymd", "mdy"):
        try:
            return (bcal._date(strip_outer_quotes(text), order) - bcal.EPOCH).days
        except (StataError, ValueError):
            continue
    raise StataError(198, f"{text}: invalid date")
files.opendta/commands/datatools.py:
"""Data utilities ([D]): duplicates, isid, levelsof, encode, decode,
destring, tostring, split, mvencode, mvdecode and recode.

Messages follow Stata 14; those marked VERIFY have a case in
compat/do/0306_utilitarios_dados.do.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import sorting
from ..core.dataset import Variable, check_name, smallest_type_for, str_len, str_type_for
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.grouping import group_ids
from ..lang.syntax import Parsed, match_options, parse_standard
from ..lang.words import num_str, parse_numlist, split_words, strip_outer_quotes
from ._util import plural, touse
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session


def _opt_text(opts: dict, key: str) -> str | None:
    v = opts.get(key)
    if v in (None, True):
        return None
    return strip_outer_quotes(str(v).strip())


def _missing_mask(v: Variable) -> np.ndarray:
    if v.is_string:
        return np.array([t == "" for t in v.raw], dtype=bool)
    return v.data >= M.SYSMISS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# duplicates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _dup_header(s: "Session", names: list[str], all_vars: bool) -> None:
    what = "all variables" if all_vars else " ".join(names)
    s.output.write(f"\nDuplicates in terms of {what}\n\n", "text")


@command("duplicates")
def cmd_duplicates(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    parts = args.strip().split(None, 1)
    if not parts:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub = parts[0].lower()
    rest = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    ds = s.data
    all_vars = not p.varlist.strip()
    names = list(ds.names) if all_vars else s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    ids, k = group_ids(ds, names, mask)
    sizes = np.bincount(ids[ids >= 0], minlength=k) if k else np.zeros(0, dtype=np.int64)
    copies = np.where(ids >= 0, sizes[np.maximum(ids, 0)] if k else 0, 0)

    if sub in ("report", "r", "rep", "repo", "repor"):
        match_options(p.options, {})
        _dup_header(s, names, all_vars)
        w = s.output.write
        w("-" * 38 + "\n", "text")
        w("   copies | observations       surplus\n", "text")
        w("----------+" + "-" * 27 + "\n", "text")
        used = copies[mask]
        for c in sorted(set(used.tolist())):
            nobs = int((used == c).sum())
            w(f"{c:>9} | ", "text")
            w(f"{nobs:>12,}  {nobs - nobs // c:>12,}\n", "result")
        w("-" * 38 + "\n", "text")
        s.r = {"unique_value": float(k), "N": float(mask.sum())}
    elif sub in ("tag",):
        opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3})
        gen = _opt_text(opts, "generate")
        if not gen:
            raise StataError(198, "option generate() required")
        if ds.has(gen):
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {gen} already defined")
        check_name(gen)
        _dup_header(s, names, all_vars)
        tag = np.where(mask, copies - 1, 0).astype(np.float64)
        # VERIFY: type of the created variable
        ds.add(Variable(gen, smallest_type_for(tag) if len(tag) else "byte", tag))
    elif sub in ("drop",):
        opts = match_options(p.options, {"force": 5})
        if not all_vars and not opts.get("force"):
            raise StataError(198, "force option required with duplicates drop varlist")  # VERIFY
        _dup_header(s, names, all_vars)
        keep = np.ones(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
        seen = np.zeros(k, dtype=bool)
        for i in np.flatnonzero(ids >= 0):
            g = ids[i]
            if seen[g]:
                keep[i] = False
            seen[g] = True
        removed = ds.keep_obs(keep)
        s.output.write(f"({plural(removed, 'observation')} deleted)\n", "text")
    elif sub in ("list", "l", "li", "lis", "examples", "e", "ex", "exa", "exam", "examp", "exampl", "example"):
        match_options(p.options, {})
        _dup_header(s, names, all_vars)
        _dup_list(s, names, ids, k, sizes, examples=sub.startswith("e"))
    else:
        raise StataError(198, f"invalid subcommand {sub}")   # VERIFY
    s.notify_state()


def _dup_list(s: "Session", names: list[str], ids: np.ndarray, k: int, sizes: np.ndarray,
              *, examples: bool) -> None:
    """list-style table with the group:, obs: (or e.g. obs:) columns."""
    from .inspect import cell_text
    ds = s.data
    dup_groups = [g for g in range(k) if sizes[g] > 1]
    if not dup_groups:
        s.output.write("(0 observations are duplicates)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        return
    order = np.lexsort((np.arange(ds.nobs), ids))
    order = order[ids[order] >= 0]
    rank = {g: j + 1 for j, g in enumerate(dup_groups)}
    rows: list[list[str]] = []
    group_of_row: list[int] = []
    shown: set[int] = set()
    for i in order:
        g = int(ids[i])
        if g not in rank:
            continue
        if examples and g in shown:
            continue
        shown.add(g)
        head = [str(rank[g])]
        if examples:
            head.append(str(int(sizes[g])))
        head.append(str(i + 1))
        rows.append(head + [cell_text(ds, ds.get(n), int(i)) for n in names])
        group_of_row.append(g)
    # with a single group of duplicates Stata 14 omits the group: column (VERIFY with several
    # groups); in examples the title is "e.g. obs" without a colon
    show_group = len(dup_groups) > 1
    if not show_group:
        rows = [r[1:] for r in rows]
    titles = (["group:"] if show_group else []) + (["#"] if examples else []) + \
        (["e.g. obs"] if examples else ["obs:"]) + names
    widths = [max(len(t), *(len(r[j]) for r in rows)) for j, t in enumerate(titles)]
    from .inspect import _left_aligned
    left = [False] * (len(titles) - len(names)) + [_left_aligned(ds.get(n), True) for n in names]

    def fmt(cells: list[str]) -> str:
        return "   ".join(c.ljust(w) if lft else c.rjust(w) for c, w, lft in zip(cells, widths, left))
    inner = len(fmt(titles)) + 2
    w = s.output.write
    w("  +" + "-" * inner + "+\n", "text")
    w("  | " + fmt(titles) + " |\n", "text")
    w("  |" + "-" * inner + "|\n", "text")
    for j, r in enumerate(rows):
        if j and not examples and group_of_row[j] != group_of_row[j - 1]:
            w("  |" + "-" * inner + "|\n", "text")
        w("  | " + fmt(r) + " |\n", "text")
    w("  +" + "-" * inner + "+\n", "text")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# isid / levelsof
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("isid")
def cmd_isid(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"sort": 1, "missok": 5})
    ds = s.data
    if p.using:
        from .combine import load_using
        ds = load_using(p.using)
        from ..core.varlist import expand
        names = expand(ds, p.varlist)
    else:
        names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    if not opts.get("missok"):
        for n in names:
            if _missing_mask(ds.get(n)).any():
                raise StataError(459, f"variable {n} should never be missing")
    _, k = group_ids(ds, names)
    if k != ds.nobs:
        if len(names) == 1:
            raise StataError(459, f"variable {names[0]} does not uniquely identify the observations")
        raise StataError(459, f"variables {' '.join(names)} do not uniquely identify the observations")
    if opts.get("sort") and not p.using:
        sorting.sort(ds, names)
        s.notify_state()


@command("levelsof")
def cmd_levelsof(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"clean": 1, "local": 1, "missing": 1, "separate": 1,
                                     "matcell": 4, "matrow": 4, "hexadecimal": 3})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if len(names) > 1 else 100,
                         "too many variables specified" if len(names) > 1 else "varlist required")
    v = ds.get(names[0])
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    if not opts.get("missing"):
        mask &= ~_missing_mask(v)
    sep = _opt_text(opts, "separate")
    sep = " " if sep is None else sep
    if v.is_string:
        vals = sorted(set(v.raw[mask].tolist()))
        if opts.get("clean"):
            items = [str(t) for t in vals]
        else:
            items = [f'`"{t}"\'' for t in vals]
    else:
        vals = sorted(set(np.asarray(v.data)[mask].tolist()))
        items = [M.missing_name(x) if x >= M.SYSMISS else num_str(float(x)) for x in vals]
    text = sep.join(items)
    s.output.write(text + "\n", "result")
    s.r = {"levels": text}
    if _opt_text(opts, "local"):
        s.macros.set_local(_opt_text(opts, "local"), text)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# encode / decode
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("encode")
def cmd_encode(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "label": 5, "noextend": 5})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    v = ds.get(names[0])
    if not v.is_string:
        raise StataError(108, "not possible with numeric variable")
    gen = _opt_text(opts, "generate")
    if not gen:
        raise StataError(100, "generate() required")   # VERIFY
    if ds.has(gen):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {gen} already defined")
    check_name(gen)
    lname = _opt_text(opts, "label") or gen
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_)) & ~_missing_mask(v)
    lab = dict(ds.value_labels.get(lname, {}))
    rev = {t: c for c, t in lab.items()}
    new_texts = sorted(set(v.raw[mask].tolist()) - set(rev))
    if new_texts and opts.get("noextend") and lname in ds.value_labels:
        raise StataError(459, f"there are values of {names[0]} not in label {lname}")   # VERIFY
    nxt = max(lab, default=0) + 1
    for t in new_texts:
        while nxt in lab:
            nxt += 1
        lab[nxt] = t
        rev[t] = nxt
        nxt += 1
    codes = np.full(ds.nobs, M.SYSMISS)
    for i in np.flatnonzero(mask):
        codes[i] = rev[v.raw[i]]
    ds.value_labels[lname] = lab
    ds.add(Variable(gen, "long", codes, fmt="%8.0g", value_label=lname, label=v.label))  # %8.0g: Stata 14
    s.notify_state()


@command("decode")
def cmd_decode(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "maxlength": 4})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    v = ds.get(names[0])
    if v.is_string:
        raise StataError(108, "not possible with string variable")   # VERIFY
    if not v.value_label:
        raise StataError(182, f"{names[0]} not labeled")
    gen = _opt_text(opts, "generate")
    if not gen:
        raise StataError(100, "generate() required")
    if ds.has(gen):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {gen} already defined")
    check_name(gen)
    lab = ds.value_labels.get(v.value_label, {})
    maxlen = int(_opt_text(opts, "maxlength") or 0) or None
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    data = v.data
    texts = []
    for i in range(ds.nobs):
        x = data[i]
        t = ""
        if mask[i] and x < M.SYSMISS and x == int(x):
            t = lab.get(int(x), "")
        texts.append(t[:maxlen] if maxlen else t)
    longest = max((str_len(t) for t in texts), default=1) or 1
    ds.add(Variable(gen, str_type_for(longest), np.array(texts, dtype=object), label=v.label))
    nmiss = sum(1 for t in texts if t == "")
    if nmiss:
        s.output.write(f"({plural(nmiss, 'missing value')} generated)\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# destring / tostring
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _gen_targets(s: "Session", names: list[str], opts: dict) -> list[str]:
    ds = s.data
    if opts.get("replace") and opts.get("generate"):
        raise StataError(198, "options generate and replace are mutually exclusive")
    if not opts.get("replace") and not opts.get("generate"):
        raise StataError(198, "must specify either generate or replace option")
    if opts.get("replace"):
        return list(names)
    targets = split_words(_opt_text(opts, "generate") or "")
    if len(targets) != len(names):
        raise StataError(198, "number of variables in generate() must equal number in varlist")  # VERIFY
    for t in targets:
        if ds.has(t):
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {t} already defined")
        check_name(t)
    return targets


_NUM_RE = re.compile(r"^[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([eEdD][+-]?\d+)?$")


def _to_number(t: str, *, dpcomma: bool) -> float | None:
    """Text → number; '' and '.'/.a-.z → missing; None if not numeric."""
    u = t.strip()
    if u == "":
        return M.SYSMISS
    if re.fullmatch(r"\.[a-z]?", u):
        return M.missing_code(u) if hasattr(M, "from_str") else M.SYSMISS
    if dpcomma:
        u = u.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
    if not _NUM_RE.match(u):
        return None
    return float(u.replace("d", "e").replace("D", "e"))


@command("destring")
def cmd_destring(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "replace": 7, "ignore": 3, "force": 5,
                                     "float": 5, "percent": 3, "dpcomma": 7})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else list(ds.names)
    targets = _gen_targets(s, names, opts)
    ignore = _opt_text(opts, "ignore") or ""
    verb = "replaced" if opts.get("replace") else "generated"
    w = s.output.write
    for name, target in zip(names, targets):
        v = ds.get(name)
        if not v.is_string:
            # VERIFY texto
            w(f"{name} already numeric; no {'replace' if opts.get('replace') else 'generate'}\n", "text")
            continue
        removed = set()
        vals = np.full(ds.nobs, M.SYSMISS)
        bad = 0
        for i, t in enumerate(v.raw):
            u = t
            for ch in ignore:
                if ch in u:
                    removed.add(ch)
                    u = u.replace(ch, "")
            if opts.get("percent") and u.strip().endswith("%"):
                u = u.strip()[:-1]
                removed.add("%")
            x = _to_number(u, dpcomma=bool(opts.get("dpcomma")))
            if x is None:
                bad += 1
                continue
            if opts.get("percent") and "%" in t and x < M.SYSMISS:
                x /= 100
            vals[i] = x
        # messages observed in Stata 14 (those marked VERIFY are deduced)
        problem = ("contains characters not specified in ignore()" if ignore
                   else "contains nonnumeric characters")
        if bad and not opts.get("force"):
            w(f"{name} {problem}; no {'replace' if opts.get('replace') else 'generate'}\n", "text")
            continue
        vtype = smallest_type_for(vals)
        if vtype == "double" and opts.get("float"):
            vtype = "float"
        if bad:
            w(f"{name} {problem}; {target} {verb} as {vtype}\n", "text")
        elif removed:
            chars = sorted(removed)
            word = "character" if len(chars) == 1 else "characters"
            w(f"{name}: {word} {' '.join(chars)} removed; {verb} as {vtype}\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        else:
            w(f"{name} has all characters numeric; {verb} as {vtype}\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        nv = Variable(target, vtype, vals, label=v.label)
        if opts.get("replace"):
            pos = ds.index(name)
            ds.drop_vars([name])
            ds.add(nv, position=pos)
        else:
            ds.add(nv)
        if bad:
            w(f"({plural(bad, 'missing value')} generated)\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


@command("tostring")
def cmd_tostring(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "replace": 7, "force": 5, "format": 3,
                                     "usedisplayformat": 4})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    targets = _gen_targets(s, names, opts)
    fmt = _opt_text(opts, "format")
    from ..lang.functions import _string
    w = s.output.write
    for name, target in zip(names, targets):
        v = ds.get(name)
        if v.is_string:
            w(f"{name} already string; no {'replace' if opts.get('replace') else 'generate'}\n", "text")
            continue
        use_fmt = fmt or (v.fmt if opts.get("usedisplayformat") else "%12.0g")   # VERIFY default
        data = v.data
        texts = [("" if x == M.SYSMISS else M.missing_name(x)) if x >= M.SYSMISS else _string(float(x), use_fmt)
                 for x in data]
        if not opts.get("force") and not fmt:
            back = [(_to_number(t, dpcomma=False) if t else M.SYSMISS) for t in texts]
            lossy = any(b is None or (x < M.SYSMISS and b != x and abs(b - x) > 0)
                        for b, x in zip(back, data))
            if lossy:
                w(f"{name} cannot be converted reversibly; no "
                  f"{'replace' if opts.get('replace') else 'generate'}\n", "text")
                continue
        longest = max((str_len(t) for t in texts), default=1) or 1
        vtype = str_type_for(longest)
        nv = Variable(target, vtype, np.array(texts, dtype=object), label=v.label)
        if opts.get("replace"):
            w(f"{name} was {v.vtype} now {vtype}\n", "text")
            pos = ds.index(name)
            ds.drop_vars([name])
            ds.add(nv, position=pos)
        else:
            w(f"{target} generated as {vtype}\n", "text")
            ds.add(nv)
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# split
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("split")
def cmd_split(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "parse": 1, "limit": 1, "notrim": 5,
                                     "destring": 4, "ignore": 3, "force": 5, "float": 5, "percent": 3})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    v = ds.get(names[0])
    if not v.is_string:
        raise StataError(108, "not possible with numeric variable")
    stub = _opt_text(opts, "generate") or names[0]
    parse_raw = opts.get("parse")
    seps = split_words(str(parse_raw), keep_quotes=False) if parse_raw not in (None, True) else [" "]
    seps = [x for x in seps] or [" "]
    limit = int(_opt_text(opts, "limit") or 0) or None
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    rx = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(x) for x in sorted(seps, key=len, reverse=True)))
    pieces: list[list[str]] = []
    for i, t in enumerate(v.raw):
        if not mask[i]:
            pieces.append([])
            continue
        u = t if opts.get("notrim") else t.strip()
        parts = rx.split(u) if u != "" else []
        if seps == [" "]:
            parts = [x for x in parts if x != ""]
        if limit:
            parts = parts[:limit]
        pieces.append(parts)
    n_new = max((len(x) for x in pieces), default=0)
    created = []
    for j in range(n_new):
        nm = f"{stub}{j + 1}"
        if ds.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {nm} already defined")
        check_name(nm)
        created.append(nm)
    for j, nm in enumerate(created):
        texts = [x[j] if j < len(x) else "" for x in pieces]
        longest = max((str_len(t) for t in texts), default=1) or 1
        ds.add(Variable(nm, str_type_for(longest), np.array(texts, dtype=object)))
    w = s.output.write
    if created:
        w("variables created as string: \n", "text")   # VERIFY
        w("  ".join(created) + "\n", "result")
    s.r = {"nvars": float(len(created)), "varlist": " ".join(created)}
    if opts.get("destring") and created:
        extra = ", replace"
        for key in ("ignore", "force", "float", "percent"):
            if opts.get(key):
                extra += f" {key}" + (f"({opts[key]})" if opts[key] is not True else "")
        cmd_destring(s, " ".join(created) + extra)
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# mvencode / mvdecode
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _mv_rules(text: str, *, decode: bool) -> list[tuple[list[float], float]]:
    """mv(# | mvc=# [\\ mvc=# ...]) in mvencode; mv(numlist | numlist=mvc ...) in mvdecode.
    Returns (source values, target value)."""
    rules = []
    for part in text.split("\\"):
        part = part.strip()
        if not part:
            continue
        if "=" in part:
            lhs, rhs = (x.strip() for x in part.split("=", 1))
        else:
            lhs, rhs = (part, ".") if decode else ("*", part)
        if decode:
            src = parse_numlist(lhs)
            rules.append((src, M.missing_code(rhs) if rhs.startswith(".") else float(rhs)))
        else:
            src = [M.SYSMISS] if lhs == "." else ([] if lhs == "*" else [M.missing_code(lhs)])
            rules.append((src, float(rhs)))
    return rules


@command("mvdecode")
def cmd_mvdecode(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"mv": 2})
    if opts.get("mv") in (None, True):
        raise StataError(198, "option mv() required")
    rules = _mv_rules(str(opts["mv"]), decode=True)
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else list(ds.names)
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    for name in names:
        v = ds.get(name)
        if v.is_string:
            continue
        x = np.array(v.data, dtype=np.float64)
        new = x.copy()
        for src, dst in rules:
            hit = mask & np.isin(x, src)
            new[hit] = dst
        n = int((new != x).sum())
        if n:
            ds.set_numeric(v, new, promote=False)
            s.output.write(f"{name:>12}: {plural(n, 'missing value')} generated\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


@command("mvencode")
def cmd_mvencode(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"mv": 2, "override": 1})
    if opts.get("mv") in (None, True):
        raise StataError(198, "option mv() required")
    rules = _mv_rules(str(opts["mv"]), decode=False)
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else list(ds.names)
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    for name in names:
        v = ds.get(name)
        if v.is_string:
            continue
        x = np.array(v.data, dtype=np.float64)
        targets = [dst for _, dst in rules]
        if not opts.get("override") and np.isin(x[x < M.SYSMISS], targets).any():
            raise StataError(9, f"{name}: already {num_str(targets[0])} in "
                                f"{int(np.isin(x, targets).sum())} observations")   # VERIFY
        new = x.copy()
        for src, dst in rules:
            hit = mask & ((x >= M.SYSMISS) if not src else np.isin(x, src))
            hit &= new >= M.SYSMISS
            new[hit] = dst
        n = int((new != x).sum())
        if n:
            ds.set_numeric(v, new)
            s.output.write(f"{name:>12}: {plural(n, 'missing value')} recoded\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# recode
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _Rule:
    def __init__(self, text: str):
        if "=" not in text:
            raise StataError(198, f"invalid rule ({text})")   # VERIFY
        lhs, rhs = text.split("=", 1)
        m = re.match(r'^\s*(\S+)\s*(?:"(.*)"|`"(.*)"\')?\s*$', rhs, re.S)
        if not m:
            raise StataError(198, f"invalid rule ({text})")
        self.target = m.group(1)
        self.label = m.group(2) if m.group(2) is not None else m.group(3)
        self.items = split_words(lhs)
        if not self.items:
            raise StataError(198, f"invalid rule ({text})")

    def value(self) -> float:
        t = self.target
        return M.missing_code(t) if t.startswith(".") else float(t)

    def match(self, x: np.ndarray, lo: float, hi: float) -> tuple[np.ndarray, bool]:
        """(matching observations, is the else rule)."""
        hit = np.zeros(len(x), dtype=bool)
        for it in self.items:
            il = it.lower()
            if il in ("else", "*"):
                return np.ones(len(x), dtype=bool), True
            if il in ("nonmissing", "nonm", "nonmi", "nonmis", "nonmiss", "nonmissi", "nonmissin"):
                hit |= x < M.SYSMISS
            elif il in ("missing", "miss", "missi", "missin"):
                hit |= x >= M.SYSMISS
            elif "/" in it:
                a, b = it.split("/", 1)
                av = lo if a.lower() == "min" else float(a)
                bv = hi if b.lower() == "max" else float(b)
                hit |= (x >= av) & (x <= bv)
            elif il == "min":
                hit |= x == lo
            elif il == "max":
                hit |= x == hi
            elif it.startswith("."):
                hit |= x == M.missing_code(it)
            else:
                try:
                    hit |= x == float(it)
                except ValueError:
                    raise StataError(198, "invalid rule")
        return hit, False


@command("recode")
def cmd_recode(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    text = args.strip()
    # varlist (rule) [(rule) ...] [if] [in] [, options]
    start = text.find("(")
    if start == -1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    varlist_text = text[:start]
    rule_texts: list[str] = []
    i = start
    while i < len(text) and text[i] == "(":
        depth, j = 0, i
        while j < len(text):
            if text[j] == '"':
                q = text.find('"', j + 1)
                j = len(text) - 1 if q == -1 else q
            elif text[j] == "(":
                depth += 1
            elif text[j] == ")":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0:
                    break
            j += 1
        if depth:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        rule_texts.append(text[i + 1:j])
        i = j + 1
        while i < len(text) and text[i] in " \t":
            i += 1
    tail = text[i:]
    rules = [_Rule(r) for r in rule_texts]
    p = parse_standard(tail)
    if p.varlist.strip():
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    opts = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 3, "prefix": 3, "label": 3, "copyrest": 4, "test": 4})
    ds = s.data
    names = s.expand_varlist(varlist_text)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    gens = split_words(_opt_text(opts, "generate") or "")
    prefix = _opt_text(opts, "prefix")
    if gens and len(gens) != len(names):
        raise StataError(198, "generate() must contain as many names as varlist")   # VERIFY
    targets = gens or ([prefix + n for n in names] if prefix else names)
    new_var = bool(gens or prefix)
    for t in (targets if new_var else []):
        if ds.has(t):
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {t} already defined")
        check_name(t)
    mask = touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_))
    labelled = [r for r in rules if r.label is not None]
    w = s.output.write
    for name, target in zip(names, targets):
        v = ds.get(name)
        if v.is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")   # VERIFY: recode only accepts numeric variables
        x = np.array(v.data, dtype=np.float64)
        ok = x < M.SYSMISS
        lo = float(x[ok & mask].min()) if (ok & mask).any() else M.SYSMISS
        hi = float(x[ok & mask].max()) if (ok & mask).any() else M.SYSMISS
        new = x.copy()
        done = np.zeros(len(x), dtype=bool)
        for r in rules:
            hit, _ = r.match(x, lo, hi)
            hit &= mask & ~done
            new[hit] = r.value()
            done |= hit
        if new_var and not opts.get("copyrest"):
            new[~mask] = M.SYSMISS
        vtype = v.vtype
        need = smallest_type_for(new)
        from ..core.dataset import TYPE_ORDER
        if TYPE_ORDER[need] > TYPE_ORDER[vtype]:
            vtype = need if not (vtype == "float" and need == "double") else "float"
        # VERIFY: with generate(), counts only the changes within the sample
        changes = int((new != x).sum()) if not new_var else int(((new != x) & mask).sum())
        lname = None
        if labelled:
            lname = _opt_text(opts, "label") or target
            lab = dict(ds.value_labels.get(lname, {}))
            for r in labelled:
                val = r.value()
                if val < M.SYSMISS:
                    lab[int(val)] = r.label
            ds.value_labels[lname] = lab
        if new_var:
            nv = Variable(target, vtype, new, label=f"RECODE of {name}"
                          + (f" ({v.label})" if v.label else ""),   # VERIFY label
                          value_label=lname or "")
            ds.add(nv)
            w(f"({plural(changes, 'difference')} between {name} and {target})\n", "text")
        else:
            if vtype != v.vtype:
                v.vtype = vtype
            ds.set_numeric(v, new, promote=False)
            if lname:
                v.value_label = lname
            w(f"({name}: {plural(changes, 'change')} made)\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()

"""display — manual [P] display.

Supported directives: "string", `"string"', expressions, %fmt, as text|txt,
as result|res, as error|err, as input|inp, in smcl, _newline[(#)] (_n),
_column(#) (_col), _skip(#), _dup(#), _char(#), _continue (_c), _request(macname).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import DISPLAY_NUMERIC, format_value, parse_format
from ..lang.expr import Parser, evaluate
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

_STYLES = {
    "text": "text", "txt": "text",
    "result": "result", "res": "result",
    "error": "error", "err": "error",
    "input": "input", "inp": "input",
}

_DIRECTIVE = re.compile(
    r"_(newline|n|column|col|skip|dup|char|continue|c|request)\b(\s*\(\s*([^)]*)\s*\))?")
_FORMAT = re.compile(r"%-?~?0?\d*(\.\d+)?[a-zA-Z]+c?")


@command("display", "di")
def cmd_display(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    out = s.output
    style = "text"
    fmt = None
    dup = 1
    cont = False
    requested = False
    i = 0
    text = args
    n = len(text)

    # output is accumulated and written only at the end: if there is an error, nothing appears
    pending: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    col = out.column
    last_literal: str | None = None

    def put(piece: str, st: str) -> None:
        nonlocal col
        if not piece:
            return
        pending.append((piece, st))
        nl = piece.rfind("\n")
        col = col + len(piece) if nl == -1 else len(piece) - nl - 1

    def emit(piece: str) -> None:
        nonlocal dup
        put(piece * dup, style)
        dup = 1

    while i < n:
        while i < n and text[i] in " \t":
            i += 1
        if i >= n:
            break
        rest = text[i:]

        m = re.match(r"as\s+(\w+)", rest)
        if m and m.group(1) in _STYLES:
            style = _STYLES[m.group(1)]
            i += m.end()
            continue
        m = re.match(r"in\s+smcl\b", rest)
        if m:
            i += m.end()
            continue

        m = _DIRECTIVE.match(rest)
        if m and m.group(1) == "request":
            # _request(macname): shows what came before as the prompt, reads a line from the
            # console and stores it in the global macname (local when it starts with "_")
            target = (m.group(3) or "").strip()
            if not re.fullmatch(r"_?[A-Za-z_]\w*", target):
                raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
            i += m.end()
            for piece, st in pending:
                out.write(piece, st)
            pending.clear()
            answer = s.request_line()
            out.write(answer + "\n", "input")      # VERIFY: echo of the typed text
            col = 0
            requested = True
            if target.startswith("_"):
                s.macros.set_local(target[1:], answer)
            else:
                s.macros.set_global(target, answer)
            continue
        if m:
            name, arg = m.group(1), m.group(3)
            num = None
            if arg is not None and arg.strip():
                num = s.eval(arg)
                if isinstance(num, str):
                    raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
                num = int(num)
            i += m.end()
            if name in ("newline", "n"):
                put("\n" * (num if num is not None else 1), style)
            elif name in ("column", "col"):
                target = (num or 1) - 1
                if col < target:
                    put(" " * (target - col), style)
            elif name == "skip":
                put(" " * (num if num is not None else 1), style)
            elif name == "dup":
                dup = max(num or 0, 0)
            elif name == "char":
                emit(chr(num or 0))
            elif name in ("continue", "c"):
                cont = True
            continue

        m = _FORMAT.match(rest)
        if m and rest.startswith("%"):
            fmt = parse_format(m.group(0))
            i += m.end()
            continue

        # "text" or `"text"' at the start of a directive is literal text, not the start of an
        # expression: display "a" + 1 shows a1 (observed in Stata); to concatenate strings use
        # parentheses: display ("a" + "b")
        lit = _literal(rest)
        if lit is not None:
            text_value, consumed = lit
            last_literal = text_value
            i += consumed
            emit(format_value(text_value, fmt) if fmt is not None and fmt.kind == "s" else text_value)
            fmt = None
            continue

        # expression
        p = Parser(rest, stop_on_unknown=True)
        if p.at_end():
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        node = p.parse_expr()
        try:
            value = evaluate(node, s.context)
        except StataError as e:
            # display "a" + "b": o Stata responde 'a+"b" invalid name'
            # (VERIFY a regra geral desta mensagem)
            if e.rc == 198 and last_literal is not None and rest.lstrip().startswith("+"):
                raise StataError(198, f'{last_literal}{"".join(rest.split())} invalid name')
            raise
        consumed = p.offset
        if consumed == 0:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        i += consumed
        if isinstance(value, str):
            piece = format_value(value, fmt) if fmt is not None and fmt.kind == "s" else value
        elif fmt is not None:
            piece = format_value(value, fmt)
        else:
            piece = format_value(value, DISPLAY_NUMERIC, pad=False)
        fmt = None
        emit(piece)

    if not cont and not (requested and not pending):
        put("\n", style)
    for piece, st in pending:
        out.write(piece, st)


def _literal(rest: str):
    """If `rest` starts with a quoted string, returns (text, length)."""
    if rest.startswith('`"'):
        depth, j = 1, 2
        while j < len(rest) and depth:
            if rest.startswith('`"', j):
                depth += 1
                j += 2
            elif rest.startswith("\"'", j):
                depth -= 1
                j += 2
            else:
                j += 1
        if depth:
            raise StataError(198, "unmatched quote")
        return rest[2:j - 2], j
    if rest.startswith('"'):
        j = rest.find('"', 1)
        if j == -1:
            raise StataError(198, "unmatched quote")
        return rest[1:j], j + 1
    return None

"""Odds by exposure level and Mantel-Haenszel odds ratios ([ST] epitab: tabodds,
mhodds) and tests of table symmetry ([ST] symmetry). Layout details not shown
in the manual are marked VERIFY and checked in compat/do/1401_epitab.do."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import epi as E
from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from ._util import touse
from .epitab import _p4, _set_r, _strata
from .registry import command
from .summarize import _level, name12, weights

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

NAN = float("nan")
SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _prep(s: "Session", p, case: str, extra: list[str]):
    ds = s.data
    names = [s.expand_varlist(case)[0]] + [s.expand_varlist(n)[0] for n in extra]
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for n in names:
        v = ds.get(n)
        mask &= (np.array([x != "" for x in v.raw]) if v.is_string else v.data < SYS)
    w, _, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight",))
    if w is None:
        w = np.ones(ds.nobs)
    return mask, w


def _levels(s: "Session", var, mask):
    from .inspect import cell_text
    vals = sorted(set(var.data[mask].tolist()))
    labels = []
    for v in vals:
        i = int(np.flatnonzero(mask & (var.data == v))[0])
        labels.append(cell_text(s.data, var, i))
    return vals, labels


def _trend(strata_tables, scores) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Score (Cochran-Armitage / Mantel extension) statistic for a linear trend in the log
    odds, summed over strata: U = sum x_k (a_k - E_k), V its hypergeometric variance."""
    U = V = 0.0
    x = np.asarray(scores, dtype=float)
    for cases, ctrls in strata_tables:
        a = np.asarray(cases, float)
        n_k = a + np.asarray(ctrls, float)
        N, A = n_k.sum(), a.sum()
        if N < 2:
            continue
        U += float((x * (a - n_k * A / N)).sum())
        V += A * (N - A) / (N * N * (N - 1)) * (N * float((n_k * x * x).sum()) - float((n_k * x).sum()) ** 2)
    return U, V


def _homogeneity(strata_tables) -> tuple[float, int]:
    """Generalized Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test that the odds are equal across the K levels
    (K-1 df), summed over strata; with one stratum it is N-1/N times Pearson's chi2."""
    K = len(strata_tables[0][0])
    d = np.zeros(K - 1)
    Vm = np.zeros((K - 1, K - 1))
    for cases, ctrls in strata_tables:
        a = np.asarray(cases, float)
        n_k = a + np.asarray(ctrls, float)
        N, A = n_k.sum(), a.sum()
        if N < 2:
            continue
        d += (a - n_k * A / N)[:-1]
        f = A * (N - A) / (N * N * (N - 1))
        nk = n_k[:-1]
        Vm += f * (N * np.diag(nk) - np.outer(nk, nk))
    keep = np.diag(Vm) > 0
    d, Vm = d[keep], Vm[np.ix_(keep, keep)]
    if not len(d):
        return NAN, 0
    chi2 = float(d @ np.linalg.solve(Vm, d))
    return chi2, len(d)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# tabodds
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("tabodds", "tabodds")
def cmd_tabodds(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if not 1 <= len(names) <= 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"or": 2, "adjust": 3, "base": 2, "cornfield": 4, "tb": 2,

        out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 61 + "\n", "text")

    scores = [float(v) for v in vals]
    U, V = _trend(tabs, scores)
    chi_t = U * U / V if V else NAN
    pt = float(st.chi2.sf(chi_t, 1)) if V else NAN
    res = [("p_trend", pt), ("chi2_tr", chi_t)]
    if adj:
        # with adjust(), no test of homogeneity and a shorter layout (compat 1401)
        out.write("Score test for trend of odds: chi2(1)  =", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f2(chi_t):>8}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"{'Pr>chi2  =':>40}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_p4(pt):>8}\n", "result")
    else:
        # the generalized Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test, (N-1)/N times Pearson's (compat 1401)
        chi_h, df_h = _homogeneity(tabs)
        ph = float(st.chi2.sf(chi_h, df_h)) if df_h else NAN
        out.write(f"Test of homogeneity (equal odds): chi2({df_h})  = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f2(chi_h):>8}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"{'Pr>chi2  = ':>45}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_p4(ph):>8}\n", "result")
        out.write("\nScore test for trend of odds:     chi2(1)  = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f2(chi_t):>8}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"{'Pr>chi2  = ':>45}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_p4(pt):>8}\n", "result")
        res = [("p_hom", ph), ("df_hom", float(df_h)), ("chi2_hom", chi_h)] + res
    if o.get("graph") or o.get("ciplot"):
        _tabodds_graph(s, ev, vals, rows, bool(o.get("ciplot")), bool(o.get("or")))
    _set_r(s, res)


def _f5(x) -> str:
    return "." if x is None or math.isnan(x) or math.isinf(x) else f"{x:.5f}"


def _f6(x) -> str:
    return "." if x is None or math.isnan(x) or math.isinf(x) else f"{x:.6f}"


def _f2(x) -> str:
    return "." if x is None or math.isnan(x) else f"{x:.2f}"


def _tabodds_graph(s: "Session", ev, vals, rows, ci: bool, is_or: bool) -> None:
    from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
    from .graphcmd import finish
    x = [float(v) for v in vals]
    y = [r[0] for r in rows]
    layers = [Layer("connected", x, y, {}, {}, "Odds Ratio" if is_or else "Odds")]
    if ci:
        lo = [r[1] for r in rows]
        hi = [r[2] for r in rows]
        layers.append(Layer("rcap", x, lo, {"y2": hi}, {}, f"{s.settings.get('level', '95')}% CI"))
    opts = {"_xtitle": ev.name, "_ytitle": "Odds Ratio" if is_or else "Odds"}
    finish(s, Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), {})

@command("mhodds", "mhodds")
def cmd_mhodds(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "binary": 3, "compare": 3, "level": 1})
    level = _level(s, o)
    case_n, exp_n, adj = names[0], names[1], names[2:]
    byv = s.expand_varlist(str(o["by"])) if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else []
    mask, w = _prep(s, p, case_n, [exp_n] + adj + byv)
    ds = s.data
    case = ds.get(case_n).data != 0
    ev = ds.get(exp_n)
    vals, _ = _levels(s, ev, mask)
    out = s.output
    z = E.z_of(level)
    compare = None
    if isinstance(o.get("compare"), str):
        parts = [x.strip() for x in str(o["compare"]).split(",")]
        if len(parts) != 2:
            raise StataError(198, "compare() requires two values")   # VERIFY
        compare = (float(parts[0]), float(parts[1]))
    binary = bool(compare or len(vals) == 2 or o.get("binary"))
    hi_v, lo_v = compare if compare else (vals[-1], vals[0])

    def estimate(sel_all, control):
        """(or, lb, ub, chi2, p, b, var(b)) for the observations sel_all, stratified by the
        variables control; b is the log odds ratio (or the score slope)."""
        strata = [("", sel_all)] if not control else _strata(s, " ".join(control), sel_all)[1]
        if binary:
            tabs = []
            for _, sel in strata:
                e1, e0 = sel & (ev.data == hi_v), sel & (ev.data == lo_v)
                if o.get("binary") and not compare:
                    e1, e0 = sel & (ev.data != 0), sel & (ev.data == 0)
                tabs.append((float(w[e1 & case].sum()), float(w[e0 & case].sum()),
                             float(w[e1 & ~case].sum()), float(w[e0 & ~case].sum())))
            est, lo, hi = E.mh_or(tabs, level)
            chi2, pv = E.mh_chi2(tabs)
            b = math.log(est) if est > 0 and not math.isinf(est) else NAN
            vb = ((math.log(hi) - b) / z) ** 2 if hi > 0 and not math.isinf(hi) and not math.isnan(b) else NAN
            return est, lo, hi, chi2, pv, b, vb
        tabs = [([float(w[sel & case & (ev.data == v)].sum()) for v in vals],
                 [float(w[sel & ~case & (ev.data == v)].sum()) for v in vals]) for _, sel in strata]
        U, V = _trend(tabs, [float(v) for v in vals])
        chi2 = U * U / V if V else NAN
        pv = float(st.chi2.sf(chi2, 1)) if V else NAN
        # one-step (score) estimate of the odds ratio per unit of the exposure
        b1 = U / V if V else NAN
        return (math.exp(b1), math.exp(b1 - z / math.sqrt(V)), math.exp(b1 + z / math.sqrt(V)),
                chi2, pv, b1, 1 / V if V else NAN)

    if binary:
        # with by(), the title stays "Maximum likelihood" (compat 1601)
        title = "Mantel-Haenszel estimate of the odds ratio" if adj else "Maximum likelihood estimate of the odds ratio"   # VERIFY
        out.write(f"\n{title}\n", "text")
        cmp = f"Comparing {ev.name}=={_num(hi_v)} vs. {ev.name}=={_num(lo_v)}"
        # one line with the controls (compat 1401)
        out.write(cmp + (f", controlling for {' '.join(adj)}" if adj else "") + "\n", "text")
    else:
        out.write(f"\nScore test for trend of odds with {ev.name}\n", "text")
    if adj and not binary:
        out.write(f"controlling for {' '.join(adj)}\n", "text")
    if byv:
        out.write(f"by {' '.join(byv)}\n", "text")
    if not binary:
        # two lines, the first ending in a space (compat 1601)
        out.write("\n(The Odds Ratio estimate is an approximation to the odds ratio \n"
                  f"for a one unit increase in {ev.name})\n", "text")
    if byv:
        _mhodds_by(s, o, estimate, mask, adj, byv, level)
        return
    est, lo, hi, chi2, pv, _, _ = estimate(mask, adj)
    _mhodds_row(s, level, est, chi2, pv, lo, hi)
    _set_r(s, [("p", pv), ("chi2", chi2), ("ub_or", hi), ("lb_or", lo), ("or", est)])


def _mhodds_row(s: "Session", level: float, est, chi2, pv, lo, hi, lead: str = "\n") -> None:
    indent = "    "
    out = s.output
    out.write(lead + indent + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(indent + f" Odds Ratio    chi2(1)        P>chi2        [{level:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write(indent + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    # indented, the limits with six decimals (compat 1401, 1601)
    ci = f"{_f6(lo):>17}{_f6(hi):>11}"
    out.write(indent + f"{_f6(est):>11}{_f2(chi2):>11}{_p4(pv):>14}" + ci + "\n", "result")
    out.write(indent + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")


def _mhodds_by(s: "Session", o, estimate, mask, adj, byv, level) -> None:
    """by(): the estimate within each group of the by() variables, the estimate controlling
    for them, and a test of homogeneity of the group estimates,
    sum (b_j - b)^2 / var(b_j) on the log odds ratios (layout: compat 1601; VERIFY: Stata's
    limits and test for a two-level comparison differ)."""
    out = s.output
    byname, groups = _strata(s, " ".join(byv), mask)
    out.write("\n" + "-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{name12(byname):>9} | Odds Ratio        chi2(1)         P>chi2       [{level:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 10 + "+" + "-" * 68 + "\n", "text")
    parts = []
    for lab, sel in groups:
        est, lo, hi, chi2, pv, b, vb = estimate(sel, adj)
        parts.append((b, vb))
        out.write(f"{name12(lab):>9} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f6(est):>11}{_f2(chi2):>15}{_p4(pv):>15}{_f5(lo):>16}{_f5(hi):>11}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
    est, lo, hi, chi2, pv, b, _ = estimate(mask, adj + byv)
    out.write(f"\n    Mantel-Haenszel estimate controlling for {' '.join(adj + byv)}\n", "text")
    _mhodds_row(s, level, est, chi2, pv, lo, hi, lead="")
    ok = [(bj, vj) for bj, vj in parts if not math.isnan(bj) and vj > 0 and not math.isinf(vj)]
    chi_h = sum((bj - b) ** 2 / vj for bj, vj in ok) if not math.isnan(b) else NAN
    df_h = len(ok) - 1
    ph = float(st.chi2.sf(chi_h, df_h)) if df_h > 0 and not math.isnan(chi_h) else NAN
    out.write(f"\nTest of homogeneity of ORs (approx): chi2({df_h})   =", "text")
    out.write(f"{_f2(chi_h):>8}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'Pr>chi2   =':>48}", "text")
    out.write(f"{_p4(ph):>8}\n", "result")
    # return list order of Stata 14 (compat 1601)
    _set_r(s, [("chi2_hom", chi_h), ("df_hom", float(df_h)), ("p", pv), ("chi2", chi2),
               ("ub_or", hi), ("lb_or", lo), ("or", est)])


def _num(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:g}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# symmetry
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("symmetry", "symmetry")
def cmd_symmetry(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"notable": 4, "contrib": 4, "exact": 2, "mh": 2, "trend": 2, "cc": 2})
    mask, w = _prep(s, p, names[0], [names[1]])
    ds = s.data
    r, c = ds.get(names[0]), ds.get(names[1])
    levels = sorted(set(r.data[mask].tolist()) | set(c.data[mask].tolist()))
    K = len(levels)
    pos = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(levels)}
    T = np.zeros((K, K))
    for i in np.flatnonzero(mask):
        T[pos[float(r.data[i])], pos[float(c.data[i])]] += w[i]
    out = s.output
    if not o.get("notable"):
        # layout of Stata 14 with three levels (compat 1401); VERIFY: other sizes and wide counts
        inner = 5 + 7 * (K - 1) + 8
        rule = "-" * (11 + inner)
        out.write("\n" + rule + "\n", "text")
        out.write(" " * 10 + "|" + f"{name12(c.name):^{inner}}" + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{name12(r.name):>9} |" + "".join(f"{_num(v):>{4 if j == 0 else 7}}" for j, v in enumerate(levels))
                  + f"{'Total':>9}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 10 + "+" + "-" * inner + "\n", "text")

        def cells(vals):
            return "".join(f"{x:>{5 if j == 0 else 7}.0f}" for j, x in enumerate(vals))
        for i, v in enumerate(levels):
            out.write(f"{_num(v):>9} |", "text")
            out.write(cells(T[i]) + f"{T[i].sum():>7.0f} \n", "result")
        out.write(" " * 10 + "| \n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Total':>9} |", "text")
        out.write(cells(T.sum(0)) + f"{T.sum():>7.0f} \n", "result")
        out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    # Bowker's test of symmetry
    chi_s = 0.0
    df_s = 0
    contrib = []
    for i in range(K):
        for j in range(i + 1, K):
            nij, nji = T[i, j], T[j, i]
            if nij + nji > 0:
                if o.get("cc"):
                    term = (abs(nij - nji) - 1) ** 2 / (nij + nji) if abs(nij - nji) >= 1 else 0.0
                else:
                    term = (nij - nji) ** 2 / (nij + nji)
                chi_s += term
                df_s += 1
                contrib.append((i + 1, j + 1, nij, nji, term))
    p_s = float(st.chi2.sf(chi_s, df_s)) if df_s else NAN
    # Stuart-Maxwell test of marginal homogeneity
    d = (T.sum(1) - T.sum(0))[:-1]
    Vm = -(T + T.T)[:-1, :-1]
    np.fill_diagonal(Vm, (T.sum(1) + T.sum(0) - 2 * np.diag(T))[:-1])
    try:
        chi_m = float(d @ np.linalg.solve(Vm, d))
        df_m = K - 1
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        chi_m, df_m = NAN, K - 1
    p_m = float(st.chi2.sf(chi_m, df_m)) if df_m and not math.isnan(chi_m) else NAN
    if o.get("contrib"):
        # VERIFY: the cells are named by level position
        out.write("\n" + " " * 18 + "Contribution\n" + " " * 19 + "to symmetry\n"
                  "   Cells           chi-squared\n" + "-" * 14 + "  " + "-" * 14 + "\n", "text")
        for i, j, nij, nji, term in contrib:
            out.write(f" {f'n{i}_{j} & n{j}_{i}':<11}", "text")
            out.write(f"{term:>16.4f}\n", "result")
    out.write("\n" + " " * 45 + "chi2     df      Prob>chi2\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 72 + "\n", "text")
    rows = [("Symmetry (asymptotic)", chi_s, df_s, p_s),
            ("Marginal homogeneity (Stuart-Maxwell)", chi_m, df_m, p_m)]
    res = [("N_pair", T.sum()), ("chi2", chi_s), ("df", float(df_s)), ("p", p_s),
           ("chi2_sm", chi_m), ("df_sm", float(df_m)), ("p_sm", p_m)]
    if o.get("mh"):
        # Bickenboller: sum (n_k. - n_.k)^2 / (n_k. + n_.k); no diagonals: (K-1)/K times
        # sum (n_k. - n_.k)^2 / (n_k. + n_.k - 2 n_kk) (match compat 1401; VERIFY: r() names)
        dd = T.sum(1) - T.sum(0)
        tot = T.sum(1) + T.sum(0)
        off = tot - 2 * np.diag(T)
        chi_b = float((dd[tot > 0] ** 2 / tot[tot > 0]).sum())
        chi_n = float((dd[off > 0] ** 2 / off[off > 0]).sum()) * (K - 1) / K
        p_b, p_n = float(st.chi2.sf(chi_b, K - 1)), float(st.chi2.sf(chi_n, K - 1))
        rows += [("Marginal homogeneity (Bickenboller)", chi_b, K - 1, p_b),
                 ("Marginal homogeneity (no diagonals)", chi_n, K - 1, p_n)]
        res += [("chi2_b", chi_b), ("df_b", float(K - 1)), ("p_b", p_b),
                ("chi2_nd", chi_n), ("df_nd", float(K - 1)), ("p_nd", p_n)]
    for label, chi, df, pv in rows:
        out.write(f"{label:<38}|", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f2(chi):>10}{df:>7}{_p4(pv):>15}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 72 + "\n", "text")
    if o.get("exact"):
        # exact significance of the symmetry test: product of conditional binomials over the
        # off-diagonal pairs, enumerated by the statistic (compat 1401 matches)
        p_e = _symmetry_exact([(int(t[2]), int(t[3])) for t in contrib], chi_s)
        out.write(f"{'Symmetry (exact significance probability)':<41}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_p4(p_e):>30}\n", "result")
        res.append(("p_exact", p_e))
    # return list in Stata's order (compat 1401)
    _set_r(s, res[::-1])


def _symmetry_exact(pairs, observed: float) -> float:
    dist = {0.0: 1.0}
    for nij, nji in pairs:
        n = nij + nji
        new = {}
        for k in range(n + 1):
            pk = float(st.binom.pmf(k, n, 0.5))
            term = round((2 * k - n) ** 2 / n, 10)
            for val, pv in dist.items():
                key = round(val + term, 10)
                new[key] = new.get(key, 0.0) + pv * pk
        dist = new
    return min(1.0, sum(pv for val, pv in dist.items() if val >= observed - 1e-9))
