"""Discriminant analysis ([MV] discrim lda, qda, knn, logistic and [MV] candisc) with its estat
subcommands and predict.

The statistics are in core/discrim.py. Layouts follow the manuals' examples; what they do not
show carries a VERIFY mark and is settled by the reference log of compat case 1906."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats as sps

from ..core import discrim as DC
from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import mvtests as T
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lang.words import parse_numlist
from .mvcluster import _measure
from .mvcommon import g as gnum, matrix, numeric_names, post_e, sample
from .mvfactor import _split
from .registry import command
from .tabulate import _categories, _codes

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
_TITLE = {"lda": "Linear discriminant analysis", "qda": "Quadratic discriminant analysis",
          "knn": "Kth-nearest-neighbor discriminant analysis", "logistic": "Logistic discriminant analysis"}


def _groups(s: "Session", p, names: list[str], group) -> tuple:
    """(X, w, weight type, mask, group name, categories, labels, codes) of the estimation sample."""
    if not isinstance(group, str):
        raise StataError(198, "option group() required")
    gname = s.expand_varlist(group)[0]
    gv = s.data.get(gname)
    X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names, extra=[] if gv.is_string else [gname])
    if gv.is_string:
        keep = gv.raw[mask] != ""
        X = X[keep]
        w = None if w is None else w[keep]
        mask[np.flatnonzero(mask)[~keep]] = False
    cats, labels, _ = _categories(s, gv, mask, missing=False, nolabel=False)
    if len(cats) < 2:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient groups")                                     # VERIFY
    return X, w, wtype, mask, gname, cats, labels, _codes(gv, cats)[mask]


def _priors(text, cnt: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """priors(): equal (default), proportional or one value per group."""
    if text is None:
        return DC.priors_from("equal", cnt)
    t = str(text).strip()
    if t in ("equal", "proportional"):
        return DC.priors_from(t, cnt)
    v = parse_numlist(t.replace(",", " "))
    if len(v) != len(cnt) or min(v) < 0 or sum(v) <= 0:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid priors()")                                         # VERIFY
    return DC.priors_from(v, cnt)


@command("discrim", "discrim")
def cmd_discrim(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words = args.strip().split(None, 1)
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub = words[0].rstrip(",")
    if sub not in _TITLE:
        raise StataError(199, f"unrecognized discrim subcommand {sub}")                   # VERIFY
    p = parse_standard(args.strip()[len(words[0]):])
    spec = {"group": 1, "priors": 2, "notable": 5, "lootable": 3, "nopriors": 4}
    if sub == "knn":
        spec.update({"k": 1, "measure": 3})
    o = match_options(p.options, spec) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    X, w, wtype, mask, gname, cats, labels, codes = _groups(s, p, names, o.get("group"))
    G = len(cats)
    extra: dict = {}
    if sub in ("lda", "qda"):
        st = DC.group_stats(X, codes, G, w)
        if np.any(st["n"] < 2):
            raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations in a group")                # VERIFY
        pri = _priors(o.get("priors"), st["n"])
        sc, _ = (DC.lda_scores if sub == "lda" else DC.qda_scores)(X, st, pri)
        P = DC.log_posteriors(sc)
        if sub == "lda":
            extra["cd"] = _canonical(st, names)
    else:
        cnt = np.bincount(codes, minlength=G).astype(float)
        st = {"n": cnt, "means": np.vstack([X[codes == g].mean(0) for g in range(G)])}
        pri = _priors(o.get("priors"), cnt)
        if sub == "knn":
            if not isinstance(o.get("k"), str):
                raise StataError(198, "option k() required")
            meas, power = _measure(o.get("measure"), "L2")
            extra = {"k": int(float(o["k"])), "measure": meas, "power": power}
            P = DC.knn_posteriors(X, codes, G, extra["k"], pri, X, meas, power)
        else:
            P = _logistic_probs(s, p, w, gname, names, mask, extra)
            # the logit model is fitted with the sample proportions as priors; Stata reweights by priors() (VERIFY)
            P = P * (pri * cnt.sum() / cnt)[None, :]
            P = P / P.sum(1, keepdims=True)
    fit = {"sub": sub, "names": names, "gname": gname, "cats": cats, "labels": labels, "codes": codes, "X": X, "w": w,
           "G": G, "priors": pri, "st": st, "P": P, "loo": None, "N": X.shape[0], "mask": mask, "extra": extra,
           "cd": extra.get("cd")}
    if not o.get("notable"):
        _class_table(s, fit, P, "Resubstitution classification summary", o, title=True)
        if o.get("lootable"):
            _class_table(s, fit, _loo(fit), "Leave-one-out classification summary", o)
    _post_discrim(s, fit, args, wtype)


def _logistic_probs(s: "Session", p, w, gname: str, names: list[str], mask: np.ndarray, extra_e: dict) -> np.ndarray:
    """Posterior probabilities of a multinomial logit fitted to the same observations."""
    if w is not None:
        raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed")                                      # VERIFY
    if s.data.get(gname).is_string:
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    cond = (f" if {p.if_}" if p.if_ else "") + (f" in {p.in_}" if p.in_ else "")
    from ..core.output import Capture
    out = s.output
    saved, cap = out._listeners, Capture()
    out._listeners = [cap]
    try:
        rc = s.run(f"mlogit {gname} {' '.join(names)}{cond}")
    finally:
        out._listeners = saved
    if rc:
        raise StataError(rc, "mlogit failed")
    for ln in cap.text.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith("Iteration"):
            out.write(ln + "\n", "text")
    est = s._estimates
    extra_e["ibaseout"] = float(s.e.get("ibaseout", 0))
    keep = [i for i, q in enumerate(est.eqnames) if np.any(est.b[[j for j, r in enumerate(est.eqnames) if r == q]] != 0)]
    extra_e["b"] = est.b[keep].copy()
    extra_e["bnames"] = [f"{est.eqnames[i]}:{est.names[i]}" for i in keep]
    Xd = np.column_stack([s.data.get(n).data[mask] for n in names] + [np.ones(int(mask.sum()))])
    eta = np.column_stack([Xd @ est.b[[i for i, q in enumerate(est.eqnames) if q == e]]
                           for e in dict.fromkeys(est.eqnames)])
    eta -= eta.max(1, keepdims=True)
    return np.exp(eta) / np.exp(eta).sum(1, keepdims=True)


def _loo(fit: dict) -> np.ndarray:
    """Leave-one-out posterior probabilities, computed when first asked for."""
    if fit["loo"] is None:
        sub, G = fit["sub"], fit["G"]
        if sub in ("lda", "qda"):
            sc = DC.loo_scores(sub, fit["X"], fit["codes"], G, fit["w"], fit["priors"])
            fit["loo"] = DC.log_posteriors(sc)
        elif sub == "knn":
            e = fit["extra"]
            fit["loo"] = DC.knn_posteriors(fit["X"], fit["codes"], G, e["k"], fit["priors"], fit["X"], e["measure"],
                                           e["power"], loo=True)
        else:
            raise StataError(198, "leave-one-out classification is not available after discrim logistic")   # VERIFY
    return fit["loo"]


_PAD = " " * 4


def _class_table(s: "Session", fit: dict, P: np.ndarray, caption: str, o: dict, title: bool = False,
                 loo: bool = False) -> None:
    out = s.output
    labs = [str(x) for x in fit["labels"]]
    G = fit["G"]
    Tr = DC.class_table(fit["codes"], DC.classify(P), G, fit["w"])
    if title:
        out.write(f"\n{_TITLE[fit['sub']]}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{caption}\n\n{_PAD}+---------+\n{_PAD}| Key     |\n{_PAD}|---------|\n{_PAD}| Number  |\n"
              f"{_PAD}| Percent |\n{_PAD}+---------+\n", "text")
    W = max(8, max(len(lb) for lb in labs) + 1)
    rule = f"{_PAD}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * (W * G)}+{'-' * 7}"
    bar = f"{'':>17}|{'':>{W * G}}|"
    out.write(f"{'':>17}| {'LOO ' if loo else ''}Classified\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{_PAD}{'True ' + fit['gname']:<12} |" + "".join(f"{lb:>{W - 1}} " for lb in labs) + f"|{'Total':>7}\n{rule}\n", "text")
    rows = list(Tr) + [Tr.sum(0)]
    for i_, (name, row) in enumerate(zip(labs + ["Total"], rows)):
        tot = row.sum()
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{name[:12]:>12} |" + "".join(f"{gnum(x):>{W - 1}} " for x in row) + f"|{gnum(tot):>7}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':>17}|" + "".join(f"{100 * x / tot:>{W - 1}.2f} " for x in row) + f"|{100.0:>7.2f}\n", "text")
        out.write((rule if i_ == G - 1 else bar) + "\n", "text")
    if not o.get("nopriors"):
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{'Priors':>12} |" + "".join(f" {x:.4f} " for x in fit["priors"]) + "|\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")


def _canonical(st: dict, names: list[str]) -> dict:
    """Canonical discriminant functions of the groups in `st`, with the signs of Stata (the first
    coefficient of every function is positive, VERIFY) and the matrices candisc stores."""
    cd = DC.candisc(st)
    coef = cd["coef"].copy()
    for j in range(coef.shape[1]):
        if coef[0, j] < 0:
            coef[:, j] *= -1
    n, means = st["n"], st["means"]
    N = n.sum()
    grand = (n[:, None] * means).sum(0) / N
    S = st["pooled"]
    sd_w = np.sqrt(np.diag(S))
    sd_t = np.sqrt(np.diag(cd["W"] + cd["B"]) / (N - 1.0))
    cd.update({"coef": coef, "std": coef * sd_w[:, None], "totalstd": coef * sd_t[:, None],
               "unstd": np.vstack([coef, -grand @ coef]), "structure": (S @ coef) / sd_w[:, None],
               "cmeans": (means - grand) @ coef})
    return cd


def _post_discrim(s: "Session", fit: dict, args: str, wtype, cmd: str = "discrim") -> None:
    st = fit["st"]
    sub = fit["sub"]
    cn = [str(c) for c in fit["labels"]]
    names = fit["names"]
    G, p = fit["G"], len(names)
    gvals = [c if isinstance(c, (int, float)) else i + 1.0 for i, c in enumerate(fit["cats"])]
    scalars = []
    mats = []
    if sub == "lda":
        cd = fit["cd"]
        f = len(cd["ev"])
        ev = cd["ev"]
        N, nvar = float(st["n"].sum()), p
        rows = []
        cum = 0.0
        for j in range(f):
            r = T.mv_statistics(ev[j:], nvar - j, G - 1 - j, N - G)[0]
            cum += ev[j] / ev.sum()
            rows.append([cd["canon_corr"][j], ev[j], ev[j] / ev.sum(), cum, r["stat"], r["F"], r["df1"], r["df2"], r["p"],
                         {"e": 1.0, "a": 2.0, "u": 3.0}[r["flag"]]])
        fc = [f"function{j + 1}" for j in range(f)]
        Sinv = np.linalg.inv(st["pooled"])
        w_, V_ = np.linalg.eigh(cd["W"])
        C = np.vstack([Sinv @ st["means"].T, (-0.5 * np.einsum("gi,ij,gj->g", st["means"], Sinv, st["means"]) + np.log(fit["priors"]))[None, :]])
        scalars.append(("f", f))
    scalars += [("N", fit["N"]), ("N_groups", G), ("k", p)]
    if sub == "knn":
        scalars.append(("k_nn", fit["extra"]["k"]))
    if sub == "logistic":
        scalars.append(("ibaseout", fit["extra"]["ibaseout"]))
    lab = " ".join(f'`"{c}"\'' for c in cn)
    pred = f"discrim_{sub}_p"
    est_cmd = f"discrim_{sub}_estat"
    title = "Canonical linear discriminant analysis" if cmd == "candisc" else _TITLE[sub]
    macros = [("cmd", cmd), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"), ("cmdline", f"{cmd} " + args.strip())]
    if cmd == "discrim":
        macros.append(("subcmd", sub))
    macros += [("title", title), ("predict", pred), ("estat_cmd", est_cmd)]
    if sub == "logistic":
        macros += [("ties", "missing"), ("grouplabels", lab)]
    else:
        macros += [("grouplabels", lab), ("ties", "missing")]
    macros += [("varlist", " ".join(names)), ("groupvar", fit["gname"]),
               ("properties", "b noV" if sub == "logistic" else "nob noV eigen" if sub == "lda" else "nob noV")]
    if sub == "logistic":
        b = fit["extra"]["b"]
        mats.append(("b", matrix(b.reshape(1, -1), ["y1"], fit["extra"]["bnames"])))
    mats += [("grouppriors", matrix(fit["priors"].reshape(1, -1), ["grouppriors"], cn)),
             ("groupcounts", matrix(st["n"].reshape(1, -1), ["groupcounts"], cn)),
             ("groupvalues", matrix(np.array(gvals, dtype=float).reshape(1, -1), ["groupvalues"], cn))]
    if sub == "lda":
        n = st["n"]
        sscp = [st["covs"][g] * (n[g] - 1.0) for g in range(G)]
        Wm = cd["W"]
        lamS, VS = np.linalg.eigh(Sinv)
        mats += [("C", matrix(C, names + ["_cons"], cn)),
                 ("W_eigvecs", matrix(V_[:, ::-1], names, [f"c{i + 1}" for i in range(p)])),
                 ("W_eigvals", matrix(w_[::-1].reshape(1, -1), ["W_eigvals"], [f"c{i + 1}" for i in range(p)])),
                 ("candisc_stat", matrix(np.array(rows), fc, [f"c{i + 1}" for i in range(10)])),     # VERIFY: columns
                 ("cmeans", matrix(cd["cmeans"], cn, fc)), ("canstruct", matrix(cd["structure"], names, fc)),
                 ("L_totalstd", matrix(cd["totalstd"], names, fc)), ("L_std", matrix(cd["std"], names, fc)),
                 ("L_unstd", matrix(cd["unstd"], names + ["_cons"], fc)), ("L_raw", matrix(cd["coef"], names, fc)),
                 ("Ev", matrix(ev.reshape(1, -1), ["Ev"], fc)),
                 ("sqrtSinv", matrix(VS @ np.diag(np.sqrt(lamS)) @ VS.T, names, names)),
                 ("Sinv", matrix(Sinv, names, names)), ("S", matrix(st["pooled"], names, names)),
                 ("means", matrix(st["means"], cn, names)), ("SSCP_B", matrix(cd["B"], names, names)),
                 ("SSCP_W", matrix(Wm, names, names))]
        mats += [(f"SSCP_W{g + 1}", matrix(sscp[g], names, names)) for g in reversed(range(G))]
        mats += [("SSCP_T", matrix(cd["B"] + Wm, names, names))]
    elif sub != "logistic":
        mats.append(("means", matrix(st["means"], cn, names)))
    post_e(s, "discrim", scalars, macros, mats, fit["mask"], fit["N"],
           estat={"classtable": (5, _estat_classtable), "errorrate": (3, _estat_errorrate), "list": (1, _estat_list),
                  "grdistances": (3, _estat_grdist), "covariance": (3, _estat_cov)},
           predict=_predict_one,
           predict_multi={"pr": lambda ss, ee: _predict_multi(ss, ee, "pr"),
                          "mahalanobis": lambda ss, ee: _predict_multi(ss, ee, "mahalanobis")},
           predict_opts={"classification": 5, "mahalanobis": 3}, extra={"discrim": fit})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# estat
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _fit(est) -> dict:
    return est.extra["discrim"]


def _estat_classtable(s, est, rest):
    fit = _fit(est)
    opt = _split(rest)[1]
    o = match_options(opt, {"loo": 3, "nopriors": 4}) if opt.strip() else {}
    if o.get("loo"):
        _class_table(s, fit, _loo(fit), "Leave-one-out classification table", o, loo=True)
    else:
        _class_table(s, fit, fit["P"], "Resubstitution classification table", o)


def _rate_row(label: str, vals, tot) -> str:
    return f"{_PAD}{label:>12} |" + "".join(f"{gnum(x):>10} " for x in vals) + f"|{gnum(tot) if tot is not None else '':>10}\n"


def _estat_errorrate(s, est, rest):
    fit = _fit(est)
    opt = _split(rest)[1]
    o = match_options(opt, {"pp": 2, "nopriors": 4}) if opt.strip() else {}
    G = fit["G"]
    labs = [str(x) for x in fit["labels"]]
    out = s.output
    rule = f"{_PAD}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * (11 * G)}+{'-' * 10}\n"
    head = "".join(f"{lb:>10} " for lb in labs) + f"|{'Total':>10}\n"
    if o.get("pp"):
        rates = DC.smoothed_error_rates(fit["P"], fit["codes"], G, fit["priors"], fit["w"])
        out.write(f"\nError rate estimated from posterior probabilities\n\n{'':>17}| {fit['gname']}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{'Error Rate':<12} |{head}{rule}", "text")
        out.write(_rate_row("Stratified", *rates["stratified"]), "text")
        out.write(f"{'':>17}|{'':>{11 * G}}|{'':>10}\n", "text")
        out.write(_rate_row("Unstratified", *rates["unstratified"]), "text")
        err, tot = rates["stratified"]
    else:
        Tr = DC.class_table(fit["codes"], DC.classify(fit["P"]), G, fit["w"])
        err, tot = DC.error_rates(Tr, fit["priors"])
        out.write(f"\nError rate estimated by error count\n\n{'':>17}| {fit['gname']}\n{'':>17}|{head}{rule}", "text")
        out.write(_rate_row("Error rate", err, tot), "text")
    if not o.get("nopriors"):
        out.write(rule + _rate_row("Priors", fit["priors"], None), "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    s.r = {"Rate": matrix(np.append(err, tot).reshape(1, -1), ["r1"], labs + ["Total"]),
           "Priors": matrix(fit["priors"].reshape(1, -1), ["r1"], labs)}


def _estat_list(s, est, rest):
    fit = _fit(est)
    opt = _split(rest)[1]
    o = match_options(opt, {"misclassified": 3, "probabilities": 4}) if opt.strip() else {}
    P = fit["P"]
    pred = DC.classify(P)
    sel = np.flatnonzero(pred != fit["codes"]) if o.get("misclassified") else np.arange(fit["N"])
    obs = np.flatnonzero(fit["mask"]) + 1
    labs = [str(x) for x in fit["labels"]]
    G = fit["G"]
    ow = max(4, len(str(int(obs.max()))))
    inner = 8 * G
    line = lambda ch: f"|{ch * (ow + 1)}+{ch * 18}+{ch * inner}|\n"
    out = s.output
    border = f"+{'-' * (ow + 1 + 1 + 18 + 1 + inner)}+\n"
    out.write(border, "text")
    out.write(f"|{'':>{ow + 1}}| {'Classification':<17}| {'Probabilities':<{inner - 1}}|\n", "text")
    out.write(f"|{'':>{ow + 1}}|{'':>18}|{'':>{inner}}|\n", "text")
    out.write(f"|{'Obs.':>{ow + 1}}|{'True  Class.':^18}|" + "".join(f"{lb:>7} " for lb in labs) + "|\n", "text")
    out.write(line("-"), "text")
    for r_, i in enumerate(sel):
        if r_ and r_ % 5 == 0:
            out.write(line("-"), "text")
        star = "*" if pred[i] != fit["codes"][i] else " "
        out.write(f"|{obs[i]:>{ow}} |{labs[fit['codes'][i]][:7]:>7}{labs[pred[i]][:7]:>8} {star} |"
                  + "".join(f" {P[i, j]:.4f} " for j in range(G)) + "|\n", "text")
    out.write(border, "text")
    out.write("* indicates misclassified observations\n", "text")


def _mat_table(out, title: str, corner: str, cols: list[str], rows: list[str], M_, *, lower: bool = False,
               top: str | None = None, trim: int = 0, right: bool = False, fmt=None, blank: bool = True) -> None:
    """Matrix as estat shows it: a stub of 12 characters and cells of 10 followed by a space."""
    fmt = fmt or gnum
    if title:
        out.write(f"\n{title}\n" + ("\n" if blank else ""), "text")
    if top is not None:
        out.write(f"{'':>17}| {top}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{_PAD}{corner:>12} |" if right else f"{_PAD}{corner:<12} |", "text")
    out.write("".join(f"{c:>10} " for c in cols) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{_PAD}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * (11 * len(cols) - trim)}\n", "text")
    for i, r_ in enumerate(rows):
        m = i + 1 if lower else len(cols)
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{r_[:12]:>12} |" + "".join(f"{fmt(M_[i, j]):>10} " for j in range(m)) + "\n", "text")


def _estat_grdist(s, est, rest):
    fit = _fit(est)
    if fit["sub"] != "lda":
        raise StataError(321, "estat grdistances is only available after discrim lda")   # VERIFY
    st = fit["st"]
    G, p, n = fit["G"], len(fit["names"]), st["n"]
    labs = [str(x) for x in fit["labels"]]
    D2 = DC.mahalanobis_sq(st["means"], st["means"], st["pooled"])
    df2 = n.sum() - G - p + 1
    F = np.zeros((G, G))
    for i in range(G):
        for j in range(G):
            F[i, j] = df2 / ((n.sum() - G) * p) * n[i] * n[j] / (n[i] + n[j]) * D2[i, j]
    pv = sps.f.sf(F, p, df2)
    pv[np.arange(G), np.arange(G)] = 1.0
    _mat_table(s.output, "Mahalanobis squared distances between groups", fit["gname"], labs, labs, D2, lower=True,
               top=fit["gname"], trim=1)
    s.output.write("\n", "text")
    s.r = {"dist": matrix(D2, labs, labs), "F": matrix(F, labs, labs), "p": matrix(pv, labs, labs)}


def _estat_cov(s, est, rest):
    fit = _fit(est)
    names = fit["names"]
    if fit["sub"] == "qda":
        s.output.write("\nGroup covariance matrices\n", "text")
        for lb, S in zip(fit["labels"], fit["st"]["covs"]):
            s.output.write(f"\n  {fit['gname']}: {lb}\n", "text")
            _mat_table(s.output, "", "", names, names, S, lower=True)
    else:
        _mat_table(s.output, "Pooled within-group covariance matrix", "", names, names, fit["st"]["pooled"], lower=True)
        s.r = {"Sigma": matrix(fit["st"]["pooled"], names, names)}
    s.output.write("\n", "text")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# predict
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _scores(s: "Session", fit: dict):
    """(posterior probabilities, squared Mahalanobis distances or None, usable rows) for every observation."""
    ds = s.data
    G = fit["G"]
    if fit["sub"] == "logistic":
        if len(fit["mask"]) != ds.nobs:
            raise StataError(198, "the data have changed since discrim logistic")          # VERIFY
        full = np.zeros((ds.nobs, G))
        full[fit["mask"]] = fit["P"]
        return full, None, fit["mask"].copy()
    X = np.column_stack([ds.get(n).data.astype(float) for n in fit["names"]])
    ok = np.all(X < SYS, axis=1)
    X = np.where(ok[:, None], X, 0.0)
    if fit["sub"] == "knn":
        e = fit["extra"]
        return DC.knn_posteriors(fit["X"], fit["codes"], G, e["k"], fit["priors"], X, e["measure"], e["power"]), None, ok
    sc, d2 = (DC.lda_scores if fit["sub"] == "lda" else DC.qda_scores)(X, fit["st"], fit["priors"])
    return DC.log_posteriors(sc), d2, ok


def _predict_one(s, est, stat, mask):
    fit = _fit(est)
    if stat not in ("", "classification"):
        raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")
    P, _, ok = _scores(s, fit)
    gvals = np.array([c if isinstance(c, (int, float)) else i + 1.0 for i, c in enumerate(fit["cats"])], dtype=float)
    note = "" if stat else "(option classification assumed; group classification)"            # VERIFY
    return np.where(ok, gvals[DC.classify(P)], SYS), note


def _predict_multi(s, est, kind):
    fit = _fit(est)
    if kind == "mahalanobis" and fit["sub"] not in ("lda", "qda"):
        raise StataError(198, "option mahalanobis is only available after discrim lda and qda")   # VERIFY
    P, d2, ok = _scores(s, fit)
    A = P if kind == "pr" else d2
    G = fit["G"]
    return G, lambda mask: [np.where(ok, A[:, j], SYS) for j in range(G)]

def _gw(x: float, width: int) -> str:
    """%g with as many significant digits as fit in `width` characters, without a leading zero."""
    for d in range(9, 0, -1):
        t_ = f"{x:.{d}g}"
        t_ = t_.replace("0.", ".", 1) if t_.startswith(("0.", "-0.")) else t_
        if len(t_) <= width:
            return t_
    return t_


@command("candisc", "candisc")
def cmd_candisc(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"group": 1, "priors": 2, "notable": 5, "lootable": 3, "nopriors": 4}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    X, w, wtype, mask, gname, cats, labels, codes = _groups(s, p, names, o.get("group"))
    G = len(cats)
    st = DC.group_stats(X, codes, G, w)
    if np.any(st["n"] < 2):
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations in a group")                    # VERIFY
    pri = _priors(o.get("priors"), st["n"])
    sc, _ = DC.lda_scores(X, st, pri)
    P = DC.log_posteriors(sc)
    cd = _canonical(st, names)
    fit = {"sub": "lda", "names": names, "gname": gname, "cats": cats, "labels": labels, "codes": codes, "X": X, "w": w,
           "G": G, "priors": pri, "st": st, "P": P, "loo": None, "N": X.shape[0], "mask": mask, "extra": {}, "cd": cd}
    ev = cd["ev"]
    N, m, nvar = float(st["n"].sum()), len(ev), len(names)
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nCanonical linear discriminant analysis\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>6}|{'':>33}| Like-\n{'':>6}| Canon.   Eigen-     Variance    | lihood\n", "text")
    out.write("  Fcn | Corr.    value   Prop.   Cumul. | Ratio     F      df1    df2  Prob>F\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  ----+{'-' * 33}+{'-' * 36}\n", "text")
    cum = 0.0
    flags = []
    for j in range(m):
        r = T.mv_statistics(ev[j:], nvar - j, G - 1 - j, N - G)[0]
        cum += ev[j] / ev.sum()
        flags.append(r["flag"])
        out.write(f"{j + 1:>5} | {cd['canon_corr'][j]:.4f}  {_gw(ev[j], 7):>7}  {ev[j] / ev.sum():.4f}  {cum:.4f} | "
                  f"{r['stat']:.4f}{_gw(r['F'], 6):>8}{gnum(r['df1']):>6}{gnum(r['df2']):>7}  {r['p']:.4f} {r['flag']}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  {'-' * 75}\n", "text")
    keys = {"e": "e = exact F", "a": "a = approximate F", "u": "u = upper bound on F"}      # VERIFY: footer with several flags
    note = ", ".join(keys[k_] for k_ in "eau" if k_ in flags)
    left = "  Ho: this and smaller canon. corr. are zero;"
    out.write(f"{left}{note:>{77 - len(left)}}\n", "text")
    fcn = [f"function{j + 1}" for j in range(m)]
    labs = [str(x) for x in labels]
    _mat_table(out, "Standardized canonical discriminant function coefficients", "", fcn, names, cd["std"])
    _mat_table(out, "Canonical structure", "", fcn, names, cd["structure"])
    _mat_table(out, "Group means on canonical variables", gname, fcn, labs, cd["cmeans"], right=True)
    _class_table(s, fit, P, "Resubstitution classification summary", o, title=False) if not o.get("notable") else None
    _post_discrim(s, fit, args, wtype, cmd="candisc")

[MV] rotate, [MV] alpha, [MV] screeplot, [MV] scoreplot) with their estat subcommands and predict.

The statistics are in core/multivariate.py. Layouts follow the manuals' examples; what they do not

from __future__ import annotations

SYS = M.SYSMISS
RULE = "    "


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# tables

def _header(out, title: str, lines: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
    """Title and indented lines on the left, `label = value` on the right (column 50)."""
    out.write("\n", "text")
    for i, (left, right) in enumerate(lines):
        if i == 0:
            left = title
        out.write(f"{left:<49}{right}\n", "text")


def _right(label: str, value: str) -> str:
    return f"{label:<17}= {value:>10}"


def _g6(x: float) -> str:
    """Six significant digits without a leading zero (.716578), as in the eigenvalue tables."""
    if x == 0:
        return "0"
    t = f"{x:.6g}"
    if "e" in t:
        m, e = t.split("e")
        t = f"{m}e{e[0]}{e[1:].lstrip('0').rjust(2, '0')}"
    return t.replace("0.", ".", 1) if t.startswith(("0.", "-0.")) else t


def _g4(x: float) -> str:
    """Four significant digits without a leading zero (.3973), as in %9.4g."""
    if x == 0:
        return "0"
    t = f"{x:.4g}"
    return t.replace("0.", ".", 1) if t.startswith(("0.", "-0.")) else t


def _eig_table(out, name: str, ev, trace: float, head: str = "Eigenvalue", fixed: bool = False,
               oblique: str = "") -> None:
    """Eigenvalue (or variance) table. `fixed` prints the values with 5 decimals (factor); `oblique`
    drops the Difference column and writes the note in its place."""
    rule1 = RULE + "-" * 74
    fac = name == "Factor"
    stub = (lambda x: f"{x:>11}  |") if fac else (lambda x: f"{x:>12} |")
    out.write("\n" + rule1 + "\n", "text")
    if oblique:
        out.write(f"{RULE}{stub(name)}{head:>13}{'Proportion':>13}{oblique:>{34 if fac else 33}}\n", "text")
    else:
        out.write(f"{RULE}{stub(name)}{head:>13}{'Difference':>13}{'Proportion':>{18 if fac else 19}}{'Cumulative':>13}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{RULE}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * 60}\n", "text")
    cum = 0.0
    p = len(ev)
    for j in range(p):
        diff = ev[j] - ev[j + 1] if j + 1 < p else None
        prop = ev[j] / trace if trace else float("nan")
        cum += prop
        f_ = (lambda v: f"{v:.5f}") if fixed else _g6
        if oblique:
            out.write(f"{RULE}{stub(_stub(name, j + 1))}{f_(ev[j]):>13}{prop:>13.4f}\n", "text")
            continue
        d = f"{(f_(diff) if diff is not None else '.'):>13}"
        out.write(f"{RULE}{stub(_stub(name, j + 1))}{f_(ev[j]):>13}{d}{prop:>{18 if fac else 19}.4f}{cum:>13.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write(rule1 + "\n", "text")


def _stub(name: str, j: int) -> str:
    return {"Component": f"Comp{j}", "Factor": f"Factor{j}"}.get(name, f"{name}{j}")


def _table(out, title: str, rows: list[str], cols: list[str], M_, fmt, extra=None, sub: str = "", stub: str = "Variable",
           blanks: float = 0.0, cw: int = 9, tri: bool = False, foot=None, note: str = "") -> None:
    """`title`, then a table whose stub column is headed `stub` and whose cells are fmt(value) right
    aligned in 9 characters followed by a space. `extra` = (heading, [row text], width): a column after a
    second bar, whose rows are pre-formatted."""
    k = len(cols)
    w = (cw + 1) * k
    top = RULE + "-" * (14 + w + (extra[2] + 1 if extra else 0))
    sep = f"{RULE}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * w}" + (f"+{'-' * extra[2]}" if extra else "")
    head = f"{RULE}{stub:>12} |" + "".join(f"{c:>{cw}} " for c in cols) + (f"|{extra[0]}" if extra else "")
    lines = []
    for i, nm in enumerate(rows):
        cells = "".join(f"{'':>{cw}} " if (tri and j > i) or abs(M_[i][j]) < blanks else f"{fmt(M_[i][j]):>{cw}} "
                        for j in range(k))
        lines.append(f"{RULE}{_abbr(nm):>12} |{cells}" + (f"|{extra[1][i]}" if extra else ""))
    if foot:
        lines.append(sep)
        for lab, vals in foot:
            lines.append(f"{RULE}{lab:>12} |" + "".join(f"{fmt(v):>{cw}} " for v in vals))
    out.write("\n" + title + "\n" + (sub + "\n" if sub else "") + "\n" + top + "\n" + head + "\n" + sep + "\n"
              + "\n".join(lines) + "\n" + top + "\n" + (note + "\n" if note else ""), "text")


def _f4(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:.4f}"


def _unexpl_extra(unexpl) -> tuple[str, list[str], int]:
    return (f"{'Unexplained':>12} ", [f"{(_g4(0.0 if abs(u) < 1e-12 else u)):>12} " for u in unexpl], 13)


def _uniq_extra(psi) -> tuple[str, list[str], int]:
    return (f"{'Uniqueness':>13} ", [f"{u:>12.4f}  " for u in psi], 14)


def _abbr(name: str, w: int = 12) -> str:
    return name if len(name) <= w else name[: w - 1] + "~"


def _print_matrix(out, title: str, names: list[str], M_: np.ndarray, cols: list[str] | None = None,
                  fmt=_f4) -> None:
    cols = cols or [_abbr(n, 8) for n in names]
    _table(out, title, names, cols, M_, fmt, stub="")

# pca
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_PCA_OPTS = {"components": 4, "mineigen": 4, "correlation": 4, "covariance": 3, "vce": 3, "means": 4,
             "blanks": 5, "tol": 3, "ignore": 6, "norotated": 5, "level": 1, "novce": 5, "factors": 3}


@command("pca", "pca")
def cmd_pca(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, _PCA_OPTS) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    vce = str(o["vce"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("vce"), str) else "none"
    if vce not in ("none", "normal"):
        raise StataError(198, f"vce({vce}) not allowed")                                    # VERIFY
    if o.get("factors") and not o.get("components"):
        o["components"] = o["factors"]
    X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names)
    means, S, R, sw = mv.weighted_moments(X, w)
    cov = bool(o.get("covariance"))
    if cov and o.get("correlation"):
        raise StataError(198, "options correlation and covariance may not be combined")    # VERIFY
    C = S if cov else R
    fit = mv.pca_fit(C)
    ev, V = fit["ev"], fit["V"]
    pdim = len(names)
    comp = int(float(o["components"])) if o.get("components") else None
    mine = float(o["mineigen"]) if o.get("mineigen") else None
    if comp is not None and (comp < 1 or comp > pdim):
        raise StataError(198, "components() must be between 1 and the number of variables")  # VERIFY
    # VERIFY: with neither option every component is kept (mineigen defaults to 1e-5 of the trace)
    k = comp if comp is not None else (int(np.sum(ev >= mine)) if mine is not None else int(np.sum(ev > 1e-5 * fit["trace"])))
    k = max(k, 1)
    blanks = float(o["blanks"]) if o.get("blanks") else 0.0
    N = int(round(sw))
    unexpl = mv.pca_unexplained(C, ev, V, k)
    rho = float(ev[:k].sum() / fit["trace"])
    out = s.output
    kind = "covariance" if cov else "correlation"
    vres = None
    if vce == "normal":
        mtol = float(o["tol"]) if isinstance(o.get("tol"), str) else 1e-5
        close = ev[-1] < mtol * ev[0] or np.any(np.abs(np.diff(ev)) < mtol * ev[0])
        if close and not o.get("ignore"):
            # VERIFY: message and return code
            raise StataError(498, "eigenvalues are close to zero or to each other; standard errors not computed")
        vres = mv.pca_vce(ev, V, N, k, second_order=True)
        vres.update(mv.pca_lr_tests(C, ev, N))
    if vres is not None and kind == "correlation":
        out.write("(with PCA/correlation, SEs and tests are approximate)\n", "text")
    if vres is not None and not o.get("novce"):
        level = float(o["level"]) if isinstance(o.get("level"), str) else float(getattr(s, "level", 95))
        _pca_vce_display(s, names, kind, N, k, fit["trace"], rho, vres, level)
        if o.get("means"):
            _pca_means(out, X, w, names)
        _post_pca(s, p, args, names, mask, N, C, means, S, ev, V, k, fit["trace"], rho, kind, wtype, w, cov, vres=vres)
        return
    _header(out, f"Principal components/{kind}", [
        ("", _right("Number of obs", f"{N}")),
        ("", _right("Number of comp.", f"{k}")),
        ("", _right("Trace", gnum(fit["trace"]))),
        ("    Rotation: (unrotated = principal)", _right("Rho", f"{rho:.4f}"))])
    _eig_table(out, "Component", ev, fit["trace"])
    A = V[:, :k]
    _table(out, "Principal components (eigenvectors) ", names, [f"Comp{j + 1}" for j in range(k)], A, _f4,
           extra=_unexpl_extra(unexpl), blanks=blanks)
    if o.get("means"):
        _pca_means(out, X, w, names)
    out.write("\n", "text")
    _post_pca(s, p, args, names, mask, N, C, means, S, ev, V, k, fit["trace"], rho, kind, wtype, w, cov, vres=vres)


def _pca_vce_display(s, names, kind, N, k, trace, rho, v, level) -> None:
    """pca, vce(normal): the eigenvalues and the retained eigenvectors as an estimation table, the
    LR tests and the explained variance with standard errors (layout of Stata 14, compat 1929)."""
    from ..estimation.results import CoefRow, coef_table
    out = s.output
    pdim = len(names)
    _header(out, f"Principal components/{kind}", [
        ("", _right("Number of obs", f"{N}")), ("", _right("Number of comp.", f"{k}")),
        ("", _right("Trace", gnum(trace))), ("", _right("Rho", f"{rho:.4f}")),
        ("SEs assume multivariate normality", _right("SE(Rho)", f"{math.sqrt(v['v_rho']):.4f}"))])
    out.write("\n", "text")
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(v["V"]), 0.0))
    rows = [CoefRow("eq", "Eigenvalues")]
    rows += [CoefRow("coef", f"Comp{j + 1}", v["b"][j], se[j]) for j in range(k)]
    for a in range(k):
        rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("eq", f"Comp{a + 1}"))
        rows += [CoefRow("coef", nm, v["b"][k + a * pdim + i], se[k + a * pdim + i]) for i, nm in enumerate(names)]
    coef_table(s, "", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=level)
    for lab, chi, df in (("independence", v["chi2_i"], v["df_i"]), ("  sphericity", v["chi2_s"], v["df_s"])):
        out.write(f"LR test for {lab}:{'':7}{f'chi2({int(df)})':<10}={chi:11.2f}   Prob > chi2 = "
                  f"{chi2_p(chi, df):7.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write("\nExplained variance by components\n\n", "text")
    out.write("  Components | Eigenvalue  Proportion  SE_Prop  Cumulative   SE_Cum       Bias\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'-' * 13}+{'-' * 64}\n", "text")
    for j in range(pdim):
        out.write(f"{'     Comp' + str(j + 1):<13}|{gnum(v['ev'][j]):>11}{v['prop'][j]:12.4f}{v['se_prop'][j]:9.4f}"
                  f"{v['cum'][j]:12.4f}{v['se_cum'][j]:9.4f}{_dec6(v['bias'][j]):>11}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'-' * 78}\n", "text")


def _dec6(x: float) -> str:
    """Rounded to 6 decimals, without trailing zeros or the leading 0 (the Bias column)."""
    t = f"{x:.6f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return t.replace("0.", ".", 1) if t.lstrip("-").startswith("0.") else t


def _pca_means(out, X, w, names) -> None:
    """pca, means: summary statistics of the variables after the results."""
    wt = np.ones(len(X)) if w is None else np.asarray(w, dtype=float)
    out.write("\nSummary statistics of the variables\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  {'-' * 67}\n      Variable |         Mean      Std. Dev.         Min          Max\n"
              f"  {'-' * 13}+{'-' * 53}\n", "text")
    for j, nm in enumerate(names):
        x = X[:, j]
        m = float(np.average(x, weights=wt))
        sd = math.sqrt(float((wt * (x - m) ** 2).sum()) / (wt.sum() - 1))
        out.write(f"  {_abbr(nm):>12} |{gnum(m):>13}{gnum(sd):>14}{gnum(x.min()):>13}{gnum(x.max()):>13}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  {'-' * 67}\n", "text")


def _post_pca(s, p, args, names, mask, N, C, means, S, ev, V, k, trace, rho, kind, wtype, w, cov, rotated=None,
              vres=None):
    pdim = len(names)
    sign, lndet = np.linalg.slogdet(C)
    scalars = [("N", N), ("f", k), ("rho", rho), ("trace", trace), ("lndet", lndet if sign > 0 else SYS),
               ("cond", float(math.sqrt(ev[0] / ev[-1])) if ev[-1] > 0 else SYS)]
    cmdline = "pca " + args.strip()
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline), ("cmd", "pca"), ("title", "Principal components"), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"),
              ("estat_cmd", "pca_estat"), ("rotate_cmd", "pca_rotate"), ("predict", "pca_p"), ("Ctype", kind),
              ("properties", "nob noV eigen"), ("wtype", wtype), ("wexp", f"= {p.weight[1]}" if p.weight else "")]
    unexpl = mv.pca_unexplained(C, ev, V, k)
    comps = [f"Comp{j + 1}" for j in range(pdim)]
    mats = [("sds", matrix(np.sqrt(np.diag(S)).reshape(1, -1), ["sds"], names)),
            ("means", matrix(means.reshape(1, -1), ["means"], names)),
            ("C", matrix(C, names, names)),
            ("Psi", matrix(unexpl.reshape(1, -1), ["Psi"], names)),
            ("Ev", matrix(ev.reshape(1, -1), ["Ev"], comps)),
            ("L", matrix(V[:, :k], names, comps[:k]))]
    if vres is not None:
        # Stata 14 computes p_s with the degrees of freedom of the independence test
        scalars = [scalars[0], ("v_rho", vres["v_rho"]), ("chi2_i", vres["chi2_i"]), ("df_i", vres["df_i"]),
                   ("p_i", chi2_p(vres["chi2_i"], vres["df_i"])), ("chi2_s", vres["chi2_s"]), ("df_s", vres["df_s"]),
                   ("p_s", chi2_p(vres["chi2_s"], vres["df_i"])),
                   ("rank", float(np.linalg.matrix_rank(vres["V"])))] + scalars[1:]
        macros = [(k_, "b V eigen" if k_ == "properties" else v_) for k_, v_ in macros]
        macros.insert(next(i for i, (k_, _) in enumerate(macros) if k_ == "properties"), ("vce", "multivariate normality"))
        eqs = ["Eigenvalues"] * k + [f"Comp{a + 1}" for a in range(k) for _ in names]
        cn = comps[:k] + names * k
        bm = matrix(vres["b"].reshape(1, -1), ["y1"], cn)
        bm.coleq = eqs
        Vm = matrix(vres["V"], cn, cn)
        Vm.roweq, Vm.coleq = eqs, eqs
        stats_ = np.column_stack([vres["prop"], vres["se_prop"], vres["cum"], vres["se_cum"], vres["bias"]])
        mats = [("b", bm), ("V", Vm)] + mats + [
            ("Ev_stats", matrix(stats_, comps, ["Proportion", "SE_Prop", "Cumulative", "SE_Cum", "Bias"])),
            ("Ev_bias", matrix(vres["bias"].reshape(1, -1), ["Ev_bias"], comps))]
    mvd = {"kind": "pca", "names": names, "C": C, "means": means, "sds": np.sqrt(np.diag(S)), "S": S, "ev": ev,
           "V": V, "k": k, "N": N, "trace": trace, "cov": cov, "rot": rotated}
    post_e(s, "pca", scalars, macros, mats, mask, N,
           estat={"loadings": (3, _estat_loadings), "residuals": (3, _estat_residuals), "smc": (3, _estat_smc),
                  "summarize": (3, _estat_summarize), "kmo": (3, _estat_kmo), "anti": (3, _estat_anti),
                  "rotatecompare": (7, _estat_rotatecompare)},
           predict_multi={"score": lambda ss, ee: _pred_scores(ss, ee, show=True), "": lambda ss, ee: _pred_scores(ss, ee, show=True)},
           predict_opts={"fit": 3, "q": 1, "comp": 4}, extra={"mv": mvd})

_FACTOR_OPTS = {"pf": 2, "pcf": 3, "ipf": 3, "ml": 2, "factors": 7, "mineigen": 4, "blanks": 5,
                "heywood": 7, "tolerance": 3, "iterate": 4, "protect": 4, "random": 4, "altdivisor": 3,
                "citerate": 5, "ctolerance": 4, "covariance": 3, "norotated": 5}


@command("factor", "fac")
def cmd_factor(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, _FACTOR_OPTS) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 3)
    methods = [m for m in ("pf", "pcf", "ipf", "ml") if o.get(m)]
    if len(methods) > 1:
        raise StataError(198, "only one of pf, pcf, ipf and ml may be specified")      # VERIFY
    method = methods[0] if methods else "pf"
    for opt in ("random", "altdivisor", "protect", "covariance"):
        if o.get(opt):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {opt} is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names)
    means, S, R, sw = mv.weighted_moments(X, w)
    pdim = len(names)
    N = int(round(sw))
    kreq = int(float(o["factors"])) if o.get("factors") else None
    mine = float(o["mineigen"]) if o.get("mineigen") else None
    heyw = bool(o.get("heywood"))
    tol = float(o["tolerance"]) if o.get("tolerance") else (1e-4 if method == "ipf" else 1e-6)
    # VERIFY: pf and ipf keep the factors with positive eigenvalue, pcf those with eigenvalue >= 1
    if method == "pf":
        fit = mv.factor_pf(R, kreq, 0.0 if mine is None else mine)
    elif method == "ipf":
        fit = mv.factor_ipf(R, kreq, 0.0 if mine is None else mine, tol=tol, heywood=heyw)
    elif method == "pcf":
        fit = mv.factor_pcf(R, kreq, 1.0 if mine is None else mine)
    else:
        if kreq is None:
            # VERIFY: the default number of factors of ml is the number of positive eigenvalues of
            # the principal-factor solution, reduced until the model is identified
            kreq = max(1, mv.factor_pf(R, None)["L"].shape[1])
            while kreq > 1 and ((pdim - kreq) ** 2 - (pdim + kreq)) < 0:
                kreq -= 1
        if ((pdim - kreq) ** 2 - (pdim + kreq)) < 0:
            raise StataError(198, f"{kreq} factors will be too many for {pdim} variables")   # VERIFY
        fit = mv.factor_ml(R, kreq, heywood=heyw, tol=tol)
    L = fit["L"]
    k = L.shape[1]
    if k == 0:
        raise StataError(198, "no factors retained")                                    # VERIFY
    psi = fit["psi"]
    blanks = float(o["blanks"]) if o.get("blanks") else 0.0
    chi_i, df_i = mv.lr_independence(R, N)
    nparams = pdim * k - k * (k - 1) // 2
    out = s.output
    ll = ll0 = SYS
    if method == "ml":
        sign0, ld0 = np.linalg.slogdet(R)
        ll = float(-0.5 * N * fit["F"])
        ll0 = float(0.5 * N * ld0)
    hd = {"N": N, "method": method, "nparams": nparams, "ll": ll}
    out.write(f"(obs={N})\n", "text")
    if method == "ml":
        # the optimizer's own path: only the first and the last values are Stata's (VERIFY)
        for i_, F_ in enumerate(fit["history"]):
            out.write(f"Iteration {i_}:   log likelihood = {gnum(-0.5 * N * F_, '%10.0g')}\n", "text")
    _factor_head(out, hd, "(unrotated)", k)
    ev_show = fit["ev"] if method != "ml" else (L ** 2).sum(0)
    trace = float(fit["ev"].sum()) if method != "ml" else float(ev_show.sum())
    _eig_table(out, "Factor", ev_show, trace if trace else 1.0, fixed=True)
    _lr_line(out, "independent", chi_i, df_i, chi2_p(chi_i, df_i))
    chi_k = df_k = pk = None
    if method == "ml":
        chi_k, df_k = mv.lr_factors(fit["F"], N, pdim, k)
        pk = chi2_p(chi_k, df_k)
        if df_k > 0:
            _lr_line(out, f"{k} factor{'s' if k != 1 else ''}", chi_k, df_k, pk)
        if fit["heywood"]:
            out.write("\n", "text")
            out.write("Beware: solution is a Heywood case (i.e., invalid or boundary values of uniqueness)\n", "text")
    _table(out, "Factor loadings (pattern matrix) and unique variances", names, [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(k)], L, _f4,
           extra=_uniq_extra(psi), blanks=blanks)
    out.write("\n", "text")
    dfr = ((pdim - k) ** 2 - (pdim + k)) / 2.0
    scalars = [("f", k), ("N", N), ("df_m", nparams), ("df_r", dfr)]
    if method == "ml":
        scalars += [("ll", ll), ("aic", -2 * ll + 2 * nparams), ("bic", -2 * ll + nparams * math.log(N))]
    scalars += [("chi2_i", chi_i), ("df_i", df_i), ("p_i", chi2_p(chi_i, df_i))]
    if method == "ml":
        scalars += [("chi2_1", chi_k), ("df_1", df_k), ("ll_0", ll0)]
    scalars.append(("evsum", trace))
    # VERIFY: the macros of the other methods follow the maximum likelihood list of the reference log
    macros = [("cmdline", "factor " + args.strip()), ("cmd", "factor"), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"),
              ("properties", "nob noV eigen"), ("title", "Factor analysis"), ("predict", "factor_p"),
              ("estat_cmd", "factor_estat"), ("rotate_cmd", "factor_rotate"),
              ("factors", f"factors({o['factors']})" if o.get("factors") else ""),
              ("mtitle", _METHOD[method]), ("method", method), ("wtype", wtype)]
    cn = [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(k)]
    mats = [("sds", matrix(np.sqrt(np.diag(S)).reshape(1, -1), ["sds"], names)),
            ("means", matrix(means.reshape(1, -1), ["means"], names)),
            ("C", matrix(R, names, names)), ("Phi", matrix(np.eye(k), cn, cn)), ("L", matrix(L, names, cn)),
            ("Psi", matrix(psi.reshape(1, -1), ["Psi"], names)),
            ("Ev", matrix(fit["ev"].reshape(1, -1), ["Ev"], [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(len(fit["ev"]))]))]
    mvd = {"kind": "factor", "names": names, "C": R, "means": means, "sds": np.sqrt(np.diag(S)), "S": S,
           "ev": fit["ev"], "L": L, "psi": psi, "k": k, "N": N, "method": method, "Phi": np.eye(k), "rot": None,
           "chi_i": chi_i, "df_i": df_i, "nparams": nparams, "ml": (chi_k, df_k, pk, ll, ll0) if method == "ml" else None, "ll": ll,
           "evsum": trace}
    post_e(s, "factor", scalars, macros, mats, mask, N,
           estat={"kmo": (3, _estat_kmo), "smc": (3, _estat_smc), "anti": (3, _estat_anti), "summarize": (3, _estat_summarize),
                  "residuals": (3, _estat_residuals), "loadings": (3, _estat_loadings),
                  "structure": (3, _estat_structure), "common": (3, _estat_common), "factors": (3, _estat_factors),
                  "rotatecompare": (7, _estat_rotatecompare)},
           predict_multi={"": lambda ss, ee: _pred_scores(ss, ee, show=True),
                          "regression": lambda ss, ee: _pred_scores(ss, ee, show=True),
                          "bartlett": lambda ss, ee: _pred_scores(ss, ee, "bartlett", show=True)},
           predict_opts={"regression": 3, "bartlett": 3, "fitted": 3, "residuals": 3}, extra={"mv": mvd})


def _lr_line(out, what: str, chi: float, df: int, p: float) -> None:
    out.write(f"{RULE}LR test: {what:>11} vs. saturated:  {f'chi2({df})':<8} = {chi:7.2f} Prob>chi2 = {p:6.4f}\n", "text")


def _factor_head(out, d: dict, desc: str, k: int) -> None:
    lines = [("", _right("Number of obs", f"{d['N']}")),
             (f"    Method: {_METHOD[d['method']]}", _right("Retained factors", f"{k}")),
             (f"    Rotation: {desc}", _right("Number of params", f"{d['nparams']}"))]
    if d["method"] == "ml":
        N, npar, ll = d["N"], d["nparams"], d["ll"]
        lines.append(("", _right("Schwarz's BIC", f"{-2 * ll + npar * math.log(N):.4f}")))
        lines.append((f"    Log likelihood = {gnum(ll, '%9.0g')}", _right("(Akaike's) AIC", f"{-2 * ll + 2 * npar:.4f}")))
    _header(out, "Factor analysis/correlation", lines)


_METHOD = {"pf": "principal factors", "pcf": "principal-component factors", "ipf": "iterated principal factors",
           "ml": "maximum likelihood"}

def _mvd(est) -> dict:
    return est.extra["mv"]


def _split(rest: str):
    c = find_top(rest, ",")
    body, opt = (rest, "") if c == -1 else (rest[:c], rest[c + 1:])
    return body.strip(), opt


def _estat_loadings(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    body, opt = _split(rest)
    o = match_options(opt, {"cnorm": 2, "blanks": 5, "format": 3}) if opt.strip() else {}
    cn = str(o.get("cnorm", "unit")).strip()
    blanks = float(o["blanks"]) if o.get("blanks") else 0.0
    out = s.output
    if d["kind"] == "pca":
        k = d["rot"]["k"] if d["rot"] else d["k"]
        # components scaled to unit length (default), to length sqrt(eigenvalue) or its inverse
        A = d["rot"]["L"] if d["rot"] else d["V"][:, :k] * np.sqrt(np.maximum(d["ev"][:k], 0))
        norms = np.sqrt((A ** 2).sum(0))
        if cn.startswith("unit"):
            A = A / norms
            how = "1"
        elif cn.startswith("inv"):
            A = A / norms ** 2
            how = "1/eigenvalue"                                                         # VERIFY
        else:
            how = "eigenvalue"                                                           # VERIFY
        _table(out, f"Principal component loadings ({'rotated' if d['rot'] else 'unrotated'})", d["names"],
               [f"Comp{j + 1}" for j in range(k)], A, _g4, stub="", blanks=blanks,
               sub=f"    component normalization: sum of squares(column) = {how}")
    else:
        L = d["rot"]["L"] if d["rot"] else d["L"]
        _table(out, "Factor loadings", d["names"], [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(L.shape[1])], L, _g4, stub="",
               blanks=blanks)


def _estat_smc(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    sm = mv.smc(d["C"])
    _table(s.output, "Squared multiple correlations of variables with all other variables", d["names"], ["smc"],
           sm.reshape(-1, 1), _f4, cw=8)
    s.r = {"smc": matrix(sm.reshape(-1, 1), d["names"], ["smc"])}


def _estat_kmo(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    k_, ov = mv.kmo(d["C"])
    _table(s.output, "Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin measure of sampling adequacy", d["names"], ["kmo"], k_.reshape(-1, 1), _f4,
           cw=8, foot=[("Overall", [ov])])
    s.r = {"kmo": ov, "kmo_j": matrix(k_.reshape(-1, 1), d["names"], ["kmo"])}


def _estat_anti(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    body, opt = _split(rest)
    o = match_options(opt, {"nocovariance": 5, "nocorrelation": 5, "format": 3}) if opt.strip() else {}
    corr, cov = mv.anti_image(d["C"])
    names = d["names"]
    if not o.get("nocorrelation"):
        _print_matrix(s.output, "Anti-image correlation matrix", names, corr)
    if not o.get("nocovariance"):
        _print_matrix(s.output, "Anti-image covariance matrix", names, cov)
    s.r = {"Cov": matrix(cov, names, names), "Corr": matrix(corr, names, names)}


def _estat_summarize(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    out = s.output
    ds = s.data
    mask = ds.esample
    out.write(f"\n  Estimation sample {est.cmd:<23}Number of obs = {d['N']:>10}\n\n", "text")
    rule = "-" * 53
    out.write(f"  {'-' * 13}{'-' * 54}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  {'Variable':>12} |{'Mean':>13}{'Std. Dev.':>15}{'Min':>12}{'Max':>13}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  {'-' * 13}+{rule}\n", "text")
    for n_, m_, sd in zip(d["names"], d["means"], d["sds"]):
        x = ds.get(n_).data[mask]
        out.write(f"  {_abbr(n_):>12} |{gnum(m_, '%9.0g'):>13}{gnum(sd, '%9.0g'):>14}"
                  f"{gnum(x.min(), '%9.0g'):>13}{gnum(x.max(), '%9.0g'):>13}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  {'-' * 13}{'-' * 54}\n", "text")
    if est.cmd == "pca":
        out.write("(PCA of covariance matrix)\n" if d["cov"] else
                  "(PCA of correlation matrix, i.e., based on standardized variables)\n", "text")      # VERIFY covariance


def _fitted(d):
    if d["kind"] == "pca":
        k = d["k"]
        L = d["V"][:, :k] * np.sqrt(np.maximum(d["ev"][:k], 0))
        return L @ L.T
    L = d["rot"]["L"] if d["rot"] else d["L"]
    Phi = d["rot"]["Phi"] if d["rot"] else np.eye(L.shape[1])
    return L @ Phi @ L.T + np.diag(d["psi"])


def _estat_residuals(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    body, opt = _split(rest)
    o = match_options(opt, {"fitted": 3, "obs": 3, "format": 3}) if opt.strip() else {}
    F = _fitted(d)
    names = d["names"]
    what = "covariance" if d.get("cov") else "correlation"
    g7 = lambda v: gnum(v, "%9.0g")
    if o.get("fitted"):
        _table(s.output, f"Fitted {what} matrix", names, names, F, g7, cw=10, tri=True)             # VERIFY
        s.r = {"Fit": matrix(F, names, names)}
    else:
        Rm = d["C"] - F
        _table(s.output, f"Residual {what} matrix", names, names, Rm, g7, cw=10, tri=True)
        iu = np.triu_indices(len(names), 1)
        s.r = {"rmse_off": float(math.sqrt((Rm[iu] ** 2).mean())), "Rm": matrix(Rm, names, names)}


def _estat_structure(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    if d["kind"] != "factor":
        raise StataError(321, "subcommand estat structure is unrecognized")
    L = d["rot"]["L"] if d["rot"] else d["L"]
    Phi = d["rot"]["Phi"] if d["rot"] else np.eye(L.shape[1])
    cols = [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(L.shape[1])]
    _table(s.output, "Structure matrix: correlations between variables and common factors", d["names"], cols, L @ Phi, _f4)
    s.r = {"Lstructure": matrix(L @ Phi, d["names"], cols)}


def _g3(v: float) -> str:
    """Three significant digits without the leading 0 (the cells of estat common)."""
    t = f"{v:.3g}"
    return t.replace("0.", ".", 1) if t.lstrip("-").startswith("0.") else t


def _estat_common(s, est, rest):
    d = _mvd(est)
    if d["kind"] != "factor":
        raise StataError(321, "subcommand estat common is unrecognized")
    Phi = d["rot"]["Phi"] if d["rot"] else np.eye(d["k"])
    cols = [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(Phi.shape[0])]
    # VERIFY: the title without a rotation (with one: compat 1929)
    what = f"the {d['rot']['ctitle']} rotated common factors" if d["rot"] else "the common factors"
    _table(s.output, f"Correlation matrix of {what}", cols, cols, Phi, _g3, stub="Factors",
           tri=True)
    s.r = {"Phi": matrix(Phi, cols, cols)}


def _estat_factors(s, est, rest):
    """estat factors [, factors(#) detail]: log likelihood, AIC and BIC of the maximum likelihood
    models with 1, 2, ... factors ([MV] factor postestimation, example 2)."""
    from ..lang.syntax import match_options
    d = _mvd(est)
    if d["kind"] != "factor":
        raise StataError(321, "subcommand estat factors is unrecognized")
    _, opt = _split(rest)
    o = match_options(opt, {"factors": 3, "detail": 3}) if opt.strip() else {}
    p_, N = len(d["names"]), d["N"]
    # the default maximum is the largest number of factors with df_r >= 0 (compat 1929)
    kmax = max(k_ for k_ in range(1, p_ + 1) if (p_ - k_) ** 2 - (p_ + k_) >= 0)
    if isinstance(o.get("factors"), str):
        kmax = min(int(float(o["factors"])), kmax)
    if o.get("detail"):
        # VERIFY: detail shows each maximum likelihood run; it reruns factor quietly here
        names = " ".join(d["names"])
        for k_ in range(1, kmax + 1):
            s.interp._execute_expanded(f"factor {names} if e(sample), ml factors({k_})")
    rows, heyw = [], []
    for k_ in range(1, kmax + 1):
        fit = mv.factor_ml(d["C"], k_)
        if fit["heywood"]:
            heyw.append(str(k_))
        ll = -0.5 * N * fit["F"]
        dfm = p_ * k_ - k_ * (k_ - 1) / 2.0
        dfr = ((p_ - k_) ** 2 - (p_ + k_)) / 2.0
        rows.append([ll, dfm, dfr, -2 * ll + 2 * dfm, -2 * ll + dfm * math.log(N)])
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nFactor analysis with different numbers of factors (maximum likelihood)\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{RULE}{'-' * 58}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{RULE}{'#factors':>8} | {'loglik':>10} {'df_m':>6} {'df_r':>6} {'AIC':>10} {'BIC':>10}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{RULE}{'-' * 9}+{'-' * 48}\n", "text")
    for k_, r_ in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        out.write(f"{RULE}{k_:>8} | {gnum(r_[0]):>10} {r_[1]:>6.0f} {r_[2]:>6.0f} {gnum(r_[3]):>10} {gnum(r_[4]):>10}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{RULE}{'-' * 58}\n", "text")
    # VERIFY: the wording for a single Heywood model
    out.write(f"{RULE}the models with {' '.join(heyw)} factors are Heywood cases\n" if heyw
              else f"{RULE}no Heywood cases encountered\n", "text")
    s.r = {"stats": matrix(np.array(rows), [str(k_) for k_ in range(1, kmax + 1)], ["loglik", "df_m", "df_r", "AIC", "BIC"])}


def _estat_rotatecompare(s, est, rest):
    """estat rotatecompare: the rotation matrix, then the rotated and unrotated loadings side by
    side ([MV] factor postestimation, [MV] pca postestimation)."""
    d = _mvd(est)
    rot = d["rot"]
    if not rot:
        raise StataError(321, "rotated results not found")                                # VERIFY
    kk = rot["k"]
    pca = d["kind"] == "pca"
    cn = "Comp" if pca else "Factor"
    cols = [f"{cn}{j + 1}" for j in range(kk)]
    T = rot["T"]
    Tshow = np.linalg.inv(T).T if not pca and rot["oblique"] else T
    out = s.output
    _table(out, f"Rotation matrix -- {rot['desc']}", cols, cols, Tshow, _f4, cw=10)
    U = d["V"][:, :kk] if pca else d["L"][:, :kk]
    both = np.column_stack([rot["L"], U])
    w = 11 * kk
    title = "Component loadings" if pca else "Factor loadings"

    def centre(t):                          # the odd space goes to the left
        left = -(-(w - len(t)) // 2)
        return " " * left + t + " " * (w - len(t) - left)
    sub = f"{RULE}{'':>12} |{centre('Rotated')}|{centre('Unrotated')}"
    k2 = 2 * kk
    top = RULE + "-" * (14 + w * 2 + 1)
    sep = f"{RULE}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * w}+{'-' * w}"
    head = f"{RULE}{'Variable':>12} |" + "".join(f"{c:>10} " for c in cols) + "|" + "".join(f"{c:>10} " for c in cols)
    lines = [f"{RULE}{_abbr(nm):>12} |" + "".join(f"{_f4(both[i][j]):>10} " + ("|" if j == kk - 1 else "")
                                                     for j in range(k2)) for i, nm in enumerate(d["names"])]
    out.write("\n" + title + "\n\n" + top + "\n" + sub + "\n" + head + "\n" + sep + "\n" + "\n".join(lines)
              + "\n" + top + "\n", "text")

def _score_weights(d, how: str) -> np.ndarray:
    """Scoring coefficients of the standardized variables (pca: eigenvectors, or the rotated ones
    through the inverse transpose of the rotation matrix; factor: regression or Bartlett)."""
    rot = d["rot"]
    if d["kind"] == "pca":
        k = rot["k"] if rot else d["k"]
        B = d["V"][:, :k]
        return B @ np.linalg.inv(rot["T"]).T if rot else B
    L = rot["L"] if rot else d["L"]
    Phi = rot["Phi"] if rot else np.eye(L.shape[1])
    if how == "bartlett":
        Pi = np.diag(1.0 / d["psi"])
        return Pi @ L @ np.linalg.inv(L.T @ Pi @ L)
    return np.linalg.solve(d["C"], L @ Phi)


def _show_weights(s, d, W, how: str) -> None:
    rot = d["rot"]
    cols = [f"{'Comp' if d['kind'] == 'pca' else 'Factor'}{j + 1}" for j in range(W.shape[1])]
    if d["kind"] == "pca":
        if rot:
            _table(s.output, f"Scoring coefficients for {'oblique' if rot['oblique'] else 'orthogonal'} {rot['ctitle']} rotation",
                   d["names"], cols, W, _f4, stub="Variable", sub="    sum of squares(column-loading) = 1")  # VERIFY orthogonal
        return
    based = f"; based on {rot['ctitle']} rotated factors" if rot else ""
    _table(s.output, f"Scoring coefficients (method = {how}{based})", d["names"], cols, W, lambda v: f"{v:.5f}")


def _pred_scores(s, est, how: str = "regression", show: bool = False):
    d = _mvd(est)
    o = getattr(est, "_pred_opts", {}) or {}
    names = d["names"]
    k = d["k"]
    if o.get("comp"):
        cols = [int(float(x)) - 1 for x in str(o["comp"]).replace(",", " ").split()]
    else:
        cols = list(range(d["rot"]["k"] if d["rot"] else k))
    nreq = len(cols)
    ds = s.data

    def fn(mask):
        W = _score_weights(d, how)
        if show:
            if d["kind"] == "factor" and not (o.get("regression") or o.get("bartlett")):
                s.output.write("(regression scoring assumed)\n", "text")
            _show_weights(s, d, W, how)
        X = np.column_stack([ds.get(n).data.astype(float) for n in names])
        ok = mask & np.all(X < SYS, axis=1)
        Z = np.where(ok[:, None], X - d["means"], np.nan)
        if not (d["kind"] == "pca" and d["cov"]):
            Z = Z / d["sds"]
        Sc = Z @ W
        return [np.where(ok, Sc[:, j], SYS) for j in cols]

    return nreq, fn, f"too few variables specified\nyou must specify {nreq} new variable(s)"

_ALPHA = {"asis": 2, "casewise": 4, "detail": 1, "generate": 1, "item": 1, "label": 1, "min": 3, "reverse": 7,
          "std": 3}


@command("alpha", "alpha")
def cmd_alpha(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, _ALPHA) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    ds = s.data
    from ._util import touse
    mask = touse(s, p)
    cols = np.column_stack([ds.get(n).data for n in names]).astype(float)
    miss = cols >= SYS
    cols = np.where(miss, np.nan, cols)
    casewise = bool(o.get("casewise"))
    X = cols[mask]
    if casewise:
        X = X[~np.isnan(X).any(1)]
    if X.shape[0] == 0:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    k = len(names)
    std = bool(o.get("std"))
    rev = set(s.expand_varlist(str(o["reverse"]))) if isinstance(o.get("reverse"), str) else set()
    if not set(rev) <= set(names):
        raise StataError(198, "reverse() variables must be in varlist")                   # VERIFY
    sign = np.array([-1.0 if n in rev else 1.0 for n in names])
    if not o.get("asis") and not rev:
        # VERIFY: signs from the first principal component of the correlation matrix (Stata 14 default)
        C0, _ = mv.pairwise_cov(X)
        sd0 = np.sqrt(np.diag(C0))
        R0 = C0 / np.outer(sd0, sd0)
        v = mv.sorted_eigh(np.nan_to_num(R0))[1][:, 0]
        if v.sum() < 0:
            v = -v
        sign = np.where(v < 0, -1.0, 1.0)
    X = X * sign
    C, Nm = mv.pairwise_cov(X)
    res = mv.alpha_from_cov(C, std)
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\nTest scale = mean({'standardized' if std else 'unstandardized'} items)\n", "text")
    avg = res["rbar"] if std else res["cbar"]
    if o.get("item"):
        _alpha_items(s, names, X, sign, C, Nm, std, res)
    else:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        for lab, val in (("Average interitem " + ("correlation:" if std else "covariance:"), f"{avg:.4f}" if std else gnum(avg, "%9.0g")),
                         ("Number of items in the scale:", f"{k}"),
                         ("Scale reliability coefficient:", f"{res['alpha']:.4f}")):
            out.write(lab + val.rjust(42 - len(lab)) + "\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    s.r = {"rho" if std else "cov": avg, "k": float(k), "alpha": res["alpha"]}
    if o.get("detail"):
        sd = np.sqrt(np.diag(C))
        M_ = np.nan_to_num(C / np.outer(sd, sd) if std else C)
        lo, hi = int(Nm.min()), int(Nm.max())
        out.write(f"\nInteritem {'correlations' if std else 'covariances'} "
                  f"(obs={lo if lo == hi else f'{lo} to {hi}'}{' in all pairs' if lo == hi else ''})\n\n", "text")
        lower_matrix(out, names, M_)
    if isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
        gname = str(o["generate"]).strip()
        if ds.has(gname):
            raise StataError(110, f"{gname} already defined")
        full = cols * sign
        if std:
            full = (full - np.nanmean(X, 0)) / np.nanstd(X, 0, ddof=1)
        mn = int(float(o["min"])) if o.get("min") else k
        cnt = (~np.isnan(full)).sum(1)
        sc = np.where(mask & (cnt >= mn), np.nansum(full, 1) / np.maximum(cnt, 1), SYS)
        var = Variable(gname, "float", np.full(ds.nobs, SYS))
        var.data = sc
        ds.add(var)
        nm = int((sc >= SYS).sum())
        if nm:
            out.write(f"({nm:,} missing value{'s' if nm != 1 else ''} generated)\n", "text")
        s.notify_state()


def _alpha_items(s, names, X, sign, C, Nm, std, res) -> None:
    out = s.output
    k = len(names)
    ok = ~np.isnan(X).any(1)
    Xc = X[ok]
    tot = Xc.sum(1)
    sd = np.sqrt(np.diag(C))
    R = C / np.outer(sd, sd)
    off = lambda M_: float(M_[~np.eye(len(M_), dtype=bool)].mean())
    rows = []
    for j in range(k):
        it = Xc[:, j]
        rest = tot - it
        itc = float(np.corrcoef(it, tot)[0, 1])
        irc = float(np.corrcoef(it, rest)[0, 1])
        idx = [i for i in range(k) if i != j]
        sub = C[np.ix_(idx, idx)]
        a_j = mv.alpha_from_cov(sub, std)["alpha"] if k > 2 else float("nan")
        inter = off(R[np.ix_(idx, idx)] if std else sub) if k > 2 else float("nan")
        rows.append((names[j], int(Nm[j, j]), "-" if sign[j] < 0 else "+", itc, irc, inter, a_j))
    avg = res["rbar"] if std else res["cbar"]
    lab = "correlation" if std else "covariance"
    val = (lambda v: f"{v:.4f}") if std else gnum
    out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'average':>67}\n{'item-test':>38}{'item-rest':>14}{'interitem':>16}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Item':<13}|{'Obs':>5}{'Sign':>6}{'correlation':>14}{'correlation':>14}{lab:>15}{'alpha':>11}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 65 + "\n", "text")
    for n_, ob, sg, itc, irc, inter, a_j in rows:
        out.write(f"{n_[:12]:<13}|{ob:>5}{sg:>5}{itc:>13.4f}{irc:>14.4f}{val(inter):>16}{a_j:>12.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 65 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Test scale':<13}|{val(avg):>53}{res['alpha']:>12.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")

@command("screeplot", "screeplot")
def cmd_screeplot(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:

                                     "saving": 3, "nodraw": 3, "components": 4, "correlation": 4, "covariance": 3,

def _plot_xy(s, args: str, scores: bool) -> None:
    from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
    from .graphcmd import finish
    est = getattr(s, "_estimates", None)
    d = (getattr(est, "extra", None) or {}).get("mv") if est is not None else None
    if d is None:
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"name": 3, "saving": 3, "nodraw": 3, "title": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    k = d["rot"]["k"] if d["rot"] else d["k"]
    if k < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "at least two components/factors are required")           # VERIFY
    word = "Component" if d["kind"] == "pca" else "Factor"
    if scores:
        nreq, fn, _ = _pred_scores(s, est)
        ds = s.data
        sc = fn(ds.esample)
        ok = (sc[0] < SYS) & (sc[1] < SYS)
        x, y, lab = sc[0][ok].tolist(), sc[1][ok].tolist(), None
        title = f"Score variables ({word.lower()}s)"
    else:
        A = d["rot"]["L"] if d["rot"] else (d["V"][:, :k] * np.sqrt(np.maximum(d["ev"][:k], 0)) if d["kind"] == "pca" else d["L"])
        x, y, lab = A[:, 0].tolist(), A[:, 1].tolist(), list(d["names"])
        title = f"{word} loadings"
    extra = {"mlabel": lab} if lab else {}
    opts = {"_xtitle": f"{word} 1", "_ytitle": f"{word} 2", "title": {"lines": [title]}, "legend": {"off": True}}
    finish(s, Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", [Layer("scatter", x, y, extra, {}, "")])]), o)


@command("loadingplot", "loadingplot")
def cmd_loadingplot(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _plot_xy(s, args, False)


@command("scoreplot", "scoreplot")
def cmd_scoreplot(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _plot_xy(s, args, True)

The statistics are in core/ordination.py. Layouts follow the manuals' examples; what they do not
show carries a VERIFY mark and is settled by the reference log of compat case 1906."""

from __future__ import annotations

def _cat_sample(s: "Session", p, names: list[str]) -> tuple:
    """(codes per variable, labels per variable, weights, weight type, mask) of the observations
    with every categorical variable present."""
    ds = s.data
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for n in names:
        v = ds.get(n)
        mask &= (v.raw != "") if v.is_string else (v.data < SYS)
    w, wtype, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight",))
    if not mask.any():
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")

def _dims(o: dict, available: int, default: int = 2) -> int:

        raise StataError(198, "dimensions() must be positive")                            # VERIFY

def _center(text: str, width: int) -> str:
    left = (width - len(text)) // 2
    return " " * left + text + " " * (width - len(text) - left)


def _point_table(out, title: str, sections: list, labs: list[str], st: dict, C: np.ndarray, f: int) -> None:
    """Mass, quality and inertia share of every category and, for each retained dimension, its
    coordinate, squared correlation and contribution. `sections` lists (variable, first, last + 1)
    of the categories that belong together."""
    out.write(f"\n{title}\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>17}|{_center('overall', 27)}|" + "|".join(_center(f"dimension_{j + 1}", 27) for j in range(f)) + "\n", "text")
    cells = lambda *h: "".join(f"{x:>8} " for x in h)
    out.write(f"{'Categories':>16} |{cells('mass', 'quality', '%inert')}|"
              + "|".join(cells("coord", "sqcorr", "contrib") for _ in range(f)) + "\n", "text")
    rule = f"{_PAD}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * 27}" + ("+" + "-" * 27) * f
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    num = lambda *v: "".join(f"{x:>8.3f} " for x in v)
    for k_, (var, lo, hi) in enumerate(sections):
        if k_:
            out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{var[:12]:<12} |{'':>27}" + f"|{'':>27}" * f + "\n", "text")
        for i in range(lo, hi):
            out.write(f"{labs[i][:15]:>16} |{num(st['mass'][i], st['quality'][i], st['inertia'][i])}|"
                      + "|".join(num(C[i, j], st['sqcorr'][i, j], st['contrib'][i, j]) for j in range(f)) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{_PAD}{'-' * (13 + 1 + 27 * (f + 1) + f)}\n", "text")


def _matlist(out, title: str, corner: str, cols: list[str], rows: list[str], M_, fmt, *, lower: bool = False,
             bottom: bool = True) -> None:
    """Matrix with a stub of 12 characters and cells of 10 followed by a space (estat tables)."""
    out.write(f"\n{title}\n\n{_PAD}{corner:>12} |" + "".join(f"{c:>10} " for c in cols) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{_PAD}{'-' * 13}+{'-' * (11 * len(cols))}\n", "text")
    for i, r_ in enumerate(rows):
        m = i + 1 if lower else len(cols)
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{r_[:12]:>12} |" + "".join(f"{fmt(M_[i, j]):>10} " for j in range(m)) + "\n", "text")
    if bottom:
        out.write(f"{_PAD}{'-' * (13 + 1 + 11 * len(cols))}\n", "text")


def _estat_table(s, est, rest):
    ctx = est.extra["ord"]
    fit, f = ctx["fit"], ctx["f"]
    P = np.outer(fit["r"], fit["c"]) * (1.0 + (fit["A"][:, :f] * fit["sv"][:f]) @ fit["B"][:, :f].T)
    _matlist(s.output, f"Approximation for dim = {f} (normalized to overall sum = 1)", "",
             ctx["labels"][1], ctx["labels"][0], P, lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
    s.output.write("\n", "text")


def _estat_coordinates(s, est, rest):
    ctx = est.extra["ord"]
    out = s.output
    f = ctx["f"]
    cols = [f"dim{j + 1}" for j in range(f)]
    if ctx["cmd"] == "ca":
        for side, var, labs, C in zip(("row", "column"), ctx["vars"], ctx["labels"], ctx["coords"]):
            _matlist(out, f"Coordinates in {side} space in {ctx['norm']} normalization", var, cols, labs, C, lambda x: f"{x:.4f}")
        s.r = {"coord_row": matrix(ctx["coords"][0], ctx["labels"][0], cols), "coord_col": matrix(ctx["coords"][1], ctx["labels"][1], cols)}
    else:
        C = ctx["coords"]
        w = 14
        out.write(f"\nColumn {ctx['norm']} coordinates\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{_PAD}+{'-' * (w + 1 + 11 * f)}+\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{_PAD}|{'Categories':>13} |" + "".join(f"{c:>10} " for c in cols) + "|\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{_PAD}|{'-' * w}+{'-' * (11 * f)}|\n", "text")
        for k_, (var, lo, hi) in enumerate(ctx["sections"]):
            if k_:
                out.write(f"{_PAD}|{'-' * w}+{'-' * (11 * f)}|\n", "text")
            out.write(f"{_PAD}|{var[:w]:<{w}}|{'':>{11 * f}}|\n", "text")
            for i in range(lo, hi):
                out.write(f"{_PAD}|{ctx['labels'][i][:13]:>13} |" + "".join(f"{gnum(C[i, j]):>10} " for j in range(f)) + "|\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{_PAD}+{'-' * (w + 1 + 11 * f)}+\n", "text")
        s.r = {"coord": matrix(C, ctx["labels"], cols)}
    out.write("\n", "text")

@command("ca", "ca")

    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(102 if len(names) < 2 else 103, "too few variables specified" if len(names) < 2 else "too many variables specified")
    codes, labels, w, wtype, mask = _cat_sample(s, p, names)
    R, Cn = len(labels[0]), len(labels[1])
    if min(R, Cn) < 2:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")                               # VERIFY
    N = np.zeros((R, Cn))
    np.add.at(N, (codes[0], codes[1]), 1.0 if w is None else w)
    _ca_run(s, N, labels, names, o, "ca " + args.strip(), mask, "variables")


@command("camat", "camat")
def cmd_camat(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """camat matname: correspondence analysis of a matrix of counts ([MV] ca)."""
    from .matrix import get_matrix
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"dimensions": 3, "normalize": 4, "rowname": 4, "colname": 4}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    mat = get_matrix(s, p.varlist.strip())
    N = np.array(mat.data, dtype=float)
    if np.any(N < 0):
        raise StataError(498, f"matrix {p.varlist.strip()} has negative entries")         # VERIFY

        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")                               # VERIFY
    names = [str(o["rowname"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("rowname"), str) else "rows",       # VERIFY the defaults
             str(o["colname"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("colname"), str) else "columns"]
    _ca_run(s, N, [list(mat.rownames), list(mat.colnames)], names, o, "camat " + args.strip(),
            np.zeros(s.data.nobs, dtype=bool), "matrix")


def _ca_run(s: "Session", N: np.ndarray, labels, names: list[str], o: dict, cmdline: str, mask, data: str) -> None:
    R, Cn = N.shape
    norm = str(o.get("normalize", "symmetric")).strip()
    if norm not in ("symmetric", "standard", "row", "column", "principal"):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid normalize()")                                      # VERIFY
    fit = O.ca_fit(N)
    f = _dims(o, len(fit["sv"]))
    Rc, Cc = O.ca_coordinates(fit, norm)
    rs = O.ca_point_stats(fit["r"], fit["A"], fit["sv"], f)
    cs = O.ca_point_stats(fit["c"], fit["B"], fit["sv"], f)
    n, total = fit["n"], fit["total"]
    df = (R - 1) * (Cn - 1)
    chi2 = n * total
    nd = len(fit["sv"])
    expl = 100.0 * fit["inertia"][:f].sum() / total
    out = s.output
    blk = lambda lab, val: f"{lab:<19}={val:>11}"
    out.write(f"\n{'Correspondence analysis':<46}{blk('Number of obs', gnum(n, '%10.0g'))}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':<46}{blk(f'Pearson chi2({df})', f'{chi2:.2f}')}\n{'':<46}{blk('Prob > chi2', f'{chi2_p(chi2, df):.4f}')}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':<46}{blk('Total inertia', f'{total:.4f}')}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{f'{R} active rows':<46}{blk('Number of dim.', str(f))}\n{f'{Cn} active columns':<46}{blk('Expl. inertia (%)', f'{expl:.2f}')}\n".replace("\n    ", "\n    ").replace(f"\n{R} active", f"\n{R} active"), "text") if False else None
    out.write(f"{f'    {R} active rows':<46}{blk('Number of dim.', str(f))}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{f'    {Cn} active columns':<46}{blk('Expl. inertia (%)', f'{expl:.2f}')}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"\n{'':>16}|   singular    principal                             cumul\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Dimension':>15} |    value       inertia           chi2    percent   percent\n", "text")
    rule = f"{_PAD}{'-' * 12}+{'-' * 60}"
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    cum = 0.0
    for j in range(nd):
        pct = 100.0 * fit["inertia"][j] / total
        cum += pct
        out.write(f"{'dim ' + str(j + 1):>15} |{gnum(fit['sv'][j]):>11}{gnum(fit['inertia'][j]):>12}{n * fit['inertia'][j]:>15.2f}"
                  f"{pct:>11.2f}{cum:>10.2f}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{rule}\n{'total':>15} |{'':>11}{gnum(total):>12}{chi2:>15.2f}{'100':>8}\n", "text")
    labs = [str(x) for x in labels[0]] + [str(x) for x in labels[1]]
    st = {k: np.concatenate([rs[k], cs[k]]) for k in ("mass", "inertia", "quality", "sqcorr", "contrib")}
    C = np.vstack([Rc[:, :f], Cc[:, :f]])
    _point_table(out, f"Statistics for row and column categories in {norm} normalization",
                 [(names[0], 0, R), (names[1], R, R + Cn)], labs, st, C, f)
    out.write("\n", "text")
    ctx = {"cmd": "ca", "fit": fit, "f": f, "norm": norm, "vars": names, "labels": [[str(x) for x in labels[0]], [str(x) for x in labels[1]]],
           "coords": [Rc[:, :f], Cc[:, :f]], "coords_all": [Rc, Cc], "share": fit["inertia"] / total}
    scalars = [("N", n), ("inertia", total), ("f", f), ("pinertia", expl / 100.0), ("X2", chi2), ("X2_df", df), ("X2_p", chi2_p(chi2, df))]
    if data == "matrix":
        # camat: no varlist, no coding matrices and no e(sample) (compat 1917)
        macros = [("cmdline", cmdline), ("cmd", "ca"), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"), ("ca_data", data)]
    else:
        macros = [("cmdline", cmdline), ("ca_data", data), ("varlist", " ".join(names)), ("cmd", "ca"),
                  ("marginsnotok", "_ALL")]
    macros += [("estat_cmd", "ca_estat"), ("predict", "ca_p"), ("title", "correspondence analysis"),
              ("Cname", names[1]), ("Rname", names[0]), ("norm", norm), ("sv_unique", "1"), ("properties", "nob noV eigen")]
    dn = [f"dim{j + 1}" for j in range(nd)]
    gs = lambda stt, Cx: np.column_stack([stt["mass"], stt["quality"], stt["inertia"]]
                                         + [np.column_stack([Cx[:, j], stt["sqcorr"][:, j], stt["contrib"][:, j]]) for j in range(f)])
    gcols = ["mass", "quality", "inertia"] + [f"{k_}{j + 1}" for j in range(f) for k_ in ("coord", "sqcorr", "contrib")]
    P = N / n
    mats = [("Ccoding", matrix(np.arange(1, Cn + 1, dtype=float).reshape(1, -1), ["Ccoding"], [str(x) for x in labels[1]])),
            ("Rcoding", matrix(np.arange(1, R + 1, dtype=float).reshape(1, -1), ["Rcoding"], [str(x) for x in labels[0]])),
            ("GSC", matrix(gs(cs, Cc[:, :f]), [str(x) for x in labels[1]], gcols)),
            ("GSR", matrix(gs(rs, Rc[:, :f]), [str(x) for x in labels[0]], gcols)),
            ("TC", matrix(fit["B"], [str(x) for x in labels[1]], dn)), ("TR", matrix(fit["A"], [str(x) for x in labels[0]], dn)),
            ("C", matrix(Cc, [str(x) for x in labels[1]], dn)), ("R", matrix(Rc, [str(x) for x in labels[0]], dn)),
            ("Sv", matrix(fit["sv"].reshape(1, -1), ["Sv"], dn)),
            ("c", matrix(fit["c"].reshape(-1, 1), [str(x) for x in labels[1]], ["c"])),
            ("r", matrix(fit["r"].reshape(-1, 1), [str(x) for x in labels[0]], ["r"])),
            ("P", matrix(P, [str(x) for x in labels[0]], [str(x) for x in labels[1]]))]       # VERIFY: contents
    if data == "matrix":
        mats = mats[2:]
    post_e(s, "ca", scalars, macros, mats, mask, int(round(n)),
           estat={"table": (3, _estat_table), "coordinates": (5, _estat_coordinates)}, extra={"ord": ctx})
    if data == "matrix":
        s.data.esample = None
