@command("mca", "mca")
def cmd_mca(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"dimensions": 3, "normalize": 4}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    codes, labels, w, wtype, mask = _cat_sample(s, p, names)
    if w is not None:
        raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed")                                      # VERIFY
    norm = str(o.get("normalize", "standard")).strip()
    if norm not in ("standard", "principal"):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid normalize()")                                      # VERIFY
    fit = O.mca_fit(codes, [len(x) for x in labels])
    f = _dims(o, len(fit["sv"]))
    n = len(codes[0])
    pin, total = fit["adjusted"], fit["adj_total"]
    shown = max(int(np.sum(pin > 0)), 1)
    coord = fit["B"] if norm == "standard" else fit["B"] * np.sqrt(pin)          # VERIFY: principal coordinates
    cats = [lb for labs in labels for lb in labs]
    bounds = np.cumsum([0] + [len(x) for x in labels])
    sections = [(nm, int(bounds[i]), int(bounds[i + 1])) for i, nm in enumerate(names)]
    st = O.mca_point_stats(fit, f)
    out = s.output
    blk = lambda lab, val: f"{lab:<18}={val:>11}"
    out.write(f"\n{'Multiple/Joint correspondence analysis':<47}{blk('Number of obs', gnum(n, '%10.0g'))}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':<47}{blk('Total inertia', gnum(total, '%10.0g'))}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'    Method: Burt/adjusted inertias':<47}{blk('Number of axes', str(f))}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"\n{'':>16}|   principal               cumul\n{'Dimension':>15} |    inertia     percent   percent\n", "text")
    rule = f"{_PAD}{'-' * 12}+{'-' * 34}"
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    cum = 0.0
    for j in range(shown):
        cum += 100.0 * pin[j] / total
        out.write(f"{'dim ' + str(j + 1):>15} |{gnum(pin[j]):>12}{100.0 * pin[j] / total:>10.2f}{cum:>11.2f}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{rule}\n{'Total':>15} |{gnum(total):>12}{100.0:>10.2f}\n", "text")
    title = f"Statistics for column categories in {norm} normalization"
    _point_table(out, title, sections, cats, st, coord[:, :f], f)
    out.write("\n", "text")
    ctx = {"cmd": "mca", "f": f, "norm": norm, "labels": cats, "coords": coord[:, :f], "sections": sections,
           "coords_all": coord, "share": pin / total}
    scalars = [("f", f), ("ev_unique", 1), ("inertia", total), ("adjust", 1), ("N", n)]
    macros = [("cmdline", "mca " + args.strip()), ("cmd", "mca"), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"),
              ("title", "Multiple/Joint correspondence analysis"), ("method", "burt"), ("estat_cmd", "mca_estat"),
              ("predict", "mca_p"), ("crossed", "0"), ("defs", " / ".join(names)), ("names", " ".join(names)),
              ("norm", norm), ("properties", "nob noV eigen")]
    dn = [f"dim{j + 1}" for j in range(f)]
    J = len(cats)
    gen = np.column_stack([st["mass"], st["quality"], st["inertia"]]
                          + [np.column_stack([coord[:, j], st["sqcorr"][:, j], st["contrib"][:, j]]) for j in range(f)])
    gcols = ["mass", "quality", "inertia"] + [f"{k_}{j + 1}" for j in range(f) for k_ in ("coord", "sqcorr", "contrib")]
    mats = [(f"Coding{i + 1}", matrix(np.arange(1, len(labels[i]) + 1, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1), labels[i], ["Coding"]))
            for i in reversed(range(len(names)))]
    mats += [("inertia_e", matrix(pin[:shown].reshape(1, -1), ["inertia_e"], [f"dim{j + 1}" for j in range(shown)])),
             ("Ev", matrix(pin[:shown].reshape(1, -1), ["Ev"], [f"dim{j + 1}" for j in range(shown)])),
             ("rSCW", matrix(fit["B"][:, :f] * np.sqrt(fit["c"])[:, None], cats, dn)),
             ("cGS", matrix(gen, cats, gcols)), ("F", matrix(fit["B"][:, :f] * fit["sv"][:f], cats, dn)),
             ("A", matrix(fit["B"][:, :f], cats, dn)),
             ("cInertia", matrix((fit["c"] * (fit["B"] * fit["sv"]) .__pow__(2).sum(1)).reshape(-1, 1), cats, ["cInertia"])),
             ("cDist", matrix(((fit["B"] * fit["sv"]) ** 2).sum(1).reshape(-1, 1), cats, ["cDist"])),
             ("cMass", matrix(fit["c"].reshape(-1, 1), cats, ["cMass"]))]               # VERIFY: contents
    post_e(s, "mca", scalars, macros, mats, mask, n,
           estat={"coordinates": (5, _estat_coordinates)}, extra={"ord": ctx})

def _mds_run(s: "Session", D: np.ndarray, ids: list[str], o: dict, desc: str, cmdline: str, cmd: str, mask: np.ndarray,
             meta: dict | None = None) -> None:
    meta = meta or {}
    n = D.shape[0]
    method = str(o.get("method", "classical")).strip()
    if method not in ("classical", "modern"):
        raise StataError(198, f"method {method} is not available yet in OpenDTA")        # VERIFY
    dims = int(float(o["dimension"])) if isinstance(o.get("dimension"), str) else 2
    cl = O.mds_classical(D, dims)
    dims = cl["dims"]
    out = s.output
    ev = cl["ev"]
    Y = cl["Y"]
    if method == "classical":
        npos = int(np.sum(ev > 1e-12 * ev[0]))                           # VERIFY: tolerance
        m1, m2 = O.mardia(ev, dims)
        a, sq = np.abs(ev).sum(), (ev ** 2).sum()
        out.write(f"\nClassical metric multidimensional scaling\n    {desc}\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':>45}{'Number of obs':<21}={gnum(n, '%10.0g'):>11}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'Eigenvalues > 0':<21}={npos:>10}         {'Mardia fit measure 1':<21}={m1:>11.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'Retained dimensions':<21}={dims:>10}         {'Mardia fit measure 2':<21}={m2:>11.4f}\n", "text")
        rule = "-" * 74
        out.write(f"\n    {rule}\n{'':>17}|{'abs(eigenvalue)':>34}{'(eigenvalue)^2':>24}\n"
                  f"{'Dimension':>15}  |{'Eigenvalue':>12}{'Percent':>13}{'Cumul.':>10}{'Percent':>14}{'Cumul.':>10}\n"
                  f"    {'-' * 13}+{'-' * 60}\n", "text")                               # VERIFY
        c1 = c2 = 0.0
        for j in range(npos):
            if j == dims and j > 0:
                out.write(f"    {'-' * 13}+{'-' * 60}\n", "text")
            c1 += 100 * abs(ev[j]) / a
            c2 += 100 * ev[j] ** 2 / sq
            out.write(f"{j + 1:>15}  |{format(ev[j], '.8g'):>12}{100 * abs(ev[j]) / a:>13.2f}{c1:>10.2f}"
                      f"{100 * ev[j] ** 2 / sq:>14.2f}{c2:>10.2f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {rule}\n", "text")
        scalars = [("mardia2", m2), ("mardia1", m1), ("np", npos), ("p", dims), ("addcons", 0), ("rc", 0), ("N", n)]
        mats = []
    else:
        out.write("(loss(stress) assumed)\n(transform(identity) assumed)\n\n", "text")
        trace: list[float] = []
        Y, iters = O.mds_modern(D, Y, trace=trace)
        U, sv, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Y, full_matrices=False)
        Y = Y @ Vt.T
        st = O.stress1(D, Y)
        for k_, v_ in enumerate(trace, 1):
            out.write(f"Iteration {k_}:   stress = {gnum(v_, '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"\nModern multidimensional scaling\n    {desc}\n\n"
                  f"    Loss criterion: stress = raw_stress/norm(distances)\n"
                  f"    Transformation: identity (no transformation)\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':>49}{'Number of obs':<17}={gnum(n, '%10.0g'):>11}\n{'':>49}{'Dimensions':<17}={dims:>11}\n"
                  f"{'    Normalization: principal':<49}{'Loss criterion':<17}={st:>11.4f}\n", "text")      # VERIFY
        scalars = [("stress", st), ("iter", iters), ("p", dims), ("N", n)]
        mats = []
    cn = [f"dim{j + 1}" for j in range(dims)]
    macros = [("cmdline", f"{cmd} " + cmdline.strip()), ("estat_cmd", "mds_estat"), ("cmd", cmd), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"),
              ("predict", "mds_p"), ("dtype", meta.get("dtype", "dissimilarity")), ("dname", meta.get("dname", "")),
              ("duplicates", "0")]
    if cmd == "mds":
        macros += [("idtype", meta.get("idtype", "int")), ("id", meta.get("idname", "")), ("varlist", meta.get("varlist", ""))]
    elif cmd == "mdslong":
        # mdslong: the object labels and the id variables, no dname (compat 1917; idtype of
        # string ids VERIFY)
        macros = [("cmdline", f"{cmd} " + cmdline.strip()), ("cmd", cmd), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"),
                  ("estat_cmd", "mds_estat"), ("predict", "mds_p"), ("duplicates", "0"),
                  ("idtype", meta.get("idtype", "int")), ("mxlen", str(max(len(x) for x in ids))),
                  ("labels", " ".join(f'`"{x}"\'' for x in ids)), ("dtype", meta.get("dtype", "dissimilarity")),
                  ("id", meta.get("idname", "")), ("depvar", meta.get("dname", ""))]
    macros += [("method", method), ("unique", "1"), ("norm", "principal"),
               ("properties", "nob noV eigen" if method == "classical" else "nob noV")]
    if cmd == "mdslong":
        mats += [("idcoding", matrix(np.arange(1.0, n + 1).reshape(-1, 1), ids, ["idcoding"]))]          # VERIFY: contents
    if cmd == "mds":
        mats += [("idcoding", matrix(np.arange(1.0, n + 1).reshape(-1, 1), ids, ["idcoding"])),
                 ("coding", matrix(np.tile([0.0, 1.0], (len(meta.get("names", [])), 1)), meta.get("names", []), ["shift", "scale"]))]
    mats += [("D", matrix(D, ids, ids)), ("Y", matrix(Y, ids, cn)),
             ("linearf", matrix(np.array([[0.0, 1.0]]), ["linearf"], ["c1", "c2"]))]                  # VERIFY
    if method == "classical":
        mats.append(("Ev", matrix(ev.reshape(1, -1), ["Ev"], [f"c{j + 1}" for j in range(n)])))
    post_e(s, cmd, scalars, macros, mats, mask, n, estat={"config": (3, _estat_config)},
           predict_multi={"": lambda ss, ee: _mds_predict(ss, ee), "config": lambda ss, ee: _mds_predict(ss, ee)},
           predict_opts={"config": 3}, extra={"mds": {"Y": Y, "ids": ids, "mask": mask, "idname": meta.get("idname", ""), "D": D}})


@command("mds", "mds")
def cmd_mds(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"id": 2, "dimension": 3, "measure": 3, "method": 3, "noplot": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    X, _, _, mask = sample(s, p, names, allowed=())
    meas, power = _measure(o.get("measure"), "L2")
    D = K.pairwise(X, None, meas, power)
    if isinstance(o.get("id"), str):
        iv = s.data.get(s.expand_varlist(o["id"])[0])
        ids = [str(x) if iv.is_string else gnum(x) for x in (iv.raw if iv.is_string else iv.data)[mask]]
    else:
        ids = [str(i + 1) for i in np.flatnonzero(mask)]
    desc = f"dissimilarity: {meas}, computed on {len(names)} variable{'s' if len(names) != 1 else ''}"
    meta = {"dname": meas, "varlist": " ".join(names), "names": names, "idname": s.expand_varlist(o["id"])[0] if isinstance(o.get("id"), str) else ""}
    if isinstance(o.get("id"), str) and iv.is_string:
        meta["idtype"] = "str"
    _mds_run(s, D, ids, o, desc, args, "mds", mask, meta)

def _estat_config(s, est, rest):
    d = est.extra["mds"]
    Y = d["Y"]
    k = Y.shape[1]
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\nConfiguration in {k}-dimensional Euclidean space (principal normalization)\n\n"
              f"{d['idname'] or 'obs':>9} |" + "".join(f"{'dim' + str(j + 1):>13} " for j in range(k)) + "\n", "text")     # VERIFY
    out.write(f"    {'-' * 6}+{'-' * (14 * k)}\n", "text")
    for i, idn in enumerate(d["ids"]):
        out.write(f"{idn[:9]:>9} |" + "".join(f"{Y[i, j]:>13.4f} " for j in range(k)) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"    {'-' * (7 + 14 * k)}\n", "text")


def _mds_predict(s, est):
    d = est.extra["mds"]
    Y, mask = d["Y"], d["mask"]
    if len(mask) != s.data.nobs or not mask.any():
        raise StataError(198, "the data have changed since mds")                           # VERIFY

    def fn(m):
        cols = []
        for j in range(Y.shape[1]):
            v = np.full(len(mask), SYS)
            v[mask] = Y[:, j]
            cols.append(v)
        return cols
    return Y.shape[1], fn

def _g7(x: float) -> str:
    """A number of the matrix tables of procrustes, in %9.0g."""
    if not np.isfinite(x):
        return "."
    return gnum(x, "%9.0g")


def _proc_matrix(out, title: str, corner: str, rows: list[str], cols: list[str], M_) -> None:
    w = 13 + 1 + 11 * len(cols)
    out.write(f"{title}\n\n    {'-' * w}\n{corner:>16} |" + "".join(f"{c_:>10} " for c_ in cols) + "\n"
              f"    {'-' * 13}+{'-' * (11 * len(cols))}\n", "text")
    for i, r_ in enumerate(rows):
        out.write(f"{r_:>16} |" + "".join(f"{_g7(M_[i, j]):>10} " for j in range(len(cols))) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"    {'-' * w}\n\n", "text")


@command("procrustes", "procrustes")
def cmd_procrustes(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    m = re.match(r"\s*\(([^)]*)\)\s*\(([^)]*)\)(.*)$", args, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    tgt, src = s.expand_varlist(m.group(1)), s.expand_varlist(m.group(2))
    p = parse_standard(m.group(3))
    o = match_options(p.options, {"transform": 5, "norho": 3, "noscale": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    tr = str(o.get("transform", "orthogonal")).strip().lower()
    tr = next((f_ for f_, m_ in (("orthogonal", 1), ("oblique", 2), ("unrestricted", 1)) if len(tr) >= m_ and f_.startswith(tr)), tr)
    if tr not in ("orthogonal", "unrestricted", "oblique") and tr != "unrestricted":
        raise StataError(198, f"transform({tr}) invalid")                                 # VERIFY
    if tr == "orthogonal" and len(tgt) != len(src):
        raise StataError(198, "the two variable lists must have the same number of variables")   # VERIFY
    for nm in tgt + src:
        if s.data.get(nm).is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    X, _, _, mask = sample(s, p, tgt + src, allowed=())
    k = len(tgt)
    Yt, Xs = X[:, :k], X[:, k:]
    kx = Xs.shape[1]
    if tr == "unrestricted":
        r = O.procrustes_unrestricted(Yt, Xs)
        df_m = kx * k + k
    elif tr == "oblique":
        r = O.procrustes_oblique(Yt, Xs)
        df_m = kx * k + (0 if o.get("norho") else 1)                        # VERIFY norho
    else:
        r = O.procrustes_orthogonal(Yt, Xs, scale=not o.get("norho"))      # VERIFY: noscale is accepted and ignored
        df_m = k * k - k * (k + 1) // 2 + k + (0 if o.get("norho") else 1)
    n = X.shape[0]
    out = s.output
    df_r = n * k - df_m
    P = r["rss"] / r["ss"] if r["ss"] else float("nan")
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(r["rss"] / df_r)) if df_r > 0 else float("nan")
    urmse = float(np.sqrt(r["rss"] / (n * k)))
    lab = " " * 43

    def row(label, val):
        out.write(f"{lab}{label:<23}={val:>11}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{f'Procrustes analysis ({tr})':<43}{'Number of observations':<23}={n:>11}\n", "text")
    row("Model df (df_m)", df_m)
    row("Residual df (df_r)", df_r)
    row("SS(target)", gnum(r["ss"], "%9.0g"))
    row("RSS(target)", gnum(r["rss"], "%9.0g"))
    row("RMSE = root(RSS/df_r)", gnum(rmse, "%9.0g"))
    row("Procrustes = RSS/SS", f"{P:.4f}")
    _proc_matrix(out, "Translation c", "", ["_cons"], tgt, r["trans"].reshape(1, -1))
    _proc_matrix(out, f"Rotation & reflection matrix A ({tr})", "", src, tgt, r["T"])
    if tr != "unrestricted":
        out.write(f"Dilation factor\n\n{'rho =':>18}{r['c']:>10.4f}\n\n", "text")
    ddf = df_r / k if k else float("nan")
    ys = np.vstack([r["ss_i"], r["rss_i"], np.sqrt(r["rss_i"] / ddf), r["rss_i"] / r["ss_i"], r["corr_i"]])
    _proc_matrix(out, "Fit statistics by target variable", "Statistics", ["SS", "RSS", "RMSE", "Procrustes", "Corr_y_yhat"], tgt, ys)
    scalars = [("rho", r["c"]), ("N", n), ("ss", r["ss"]), ("rss", r["rss"]), ("P", P), ("rmse", rmse), ("urmse", urmse),
               ("df_m", df_m), ("df_r", df_r), ("ny", k)]
    macros = [("cmdline", "procrustes " + args.strip()), ("cmd", "procrustes"), ("marginsnotok", "_ALL"),
              ("estat_cmd", "procrustes_estat"), ("predict", "procrustes_p"), ("uniqueA", "1"), ("transform", tr),
              ("xlist", " ".join(src)), ("ylist", " ".join(tgt)), ("properties", "nob noV")]
    mats = [("ystats", matrix(ys, ["SS", "RSS", "RMSE", "Procrustes", "Corr_y_yhat"], tgt)),
            ("c", matrix(r["trans"].reshape(1, -1), ["c"], tgt)), ("A", matrix(r["T"], src, tgt))]

    def pred(ss, ee, resid=False, note=False):
        ds = ss.data
        X2 = np.column_stack([ds.get(n_).data.astype(float) for n_ in src])
        ok = np.all(X2 < SYS, axis=1)
        F = r["c"] * X2 @ r["T"] + r["trans"]
        if resid:
            F = np.column_stack([ds.get(n_).data.astype(float) for n_ in tgt]) - F

        def fn(m):
            if note:
                ss.output.write("(fitted assumed)\n", "text")
            return [np.where(ok, F[:, j], SYS) for j in range(k)]
        return k, fn
    post_e(s, "procrustes", scalars, macros, mats, mask, n, extra={"proc": {"r": r, "src": src, "tgt": tgt}},
           predict_multi={"": lambda ss, ee: pred(ss, ee, note=True), "fitted": lambda ss, ee: pred(ss, ee),
                          "residuals": lambda ss, ee: pred(ss, ee, True)}, predict_opts={"fitted": 3})

@command("biplot", "biplot")
def cmd_biplot(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
    from .graphcmd import finish
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"std": 3, "dim": 3, "rowlabel": 4, "norow": 5, "nocolumn": 5, "name": 3, "saving": 3, "nodraw": 3}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    X, _, _, mask = sample(s, p, names, allowed=())
    pair = [int(float(x)) - 1 for x in str(o["dim"]).replace(",", " ").split()] if isinstance(o.get("dim"), str) else [0, 1]
    if len(pair) != 2 or min(pair) < 0 or max(pair) >= len(names):
        raise StataError(198, "invalid dim()")                                            # VERIFY
    b = O.biplot_coords(X, std=bool(o.get("std")))
    a, c = b["rows"][:, pair], b["cols"][:, pair]
    layers = []
    if not o.get("norow"):
        lab = None
        if isinstance(o.get("rowlabel"), str):
            lv = s.data.get(s.expand_varlist(o["rowlabel"])[0])
            lab = [str(x) for x in (lv.raw if lv.is_string else lv.data)[mask]]
        layers.append(Layer("scatter", a[:, 0].tolist(), a[:, 1].tolist(), {"mlabel": lab} if lab else {}, {}, ""))
    if not o.get("nocolumn"):
        xs, ys = [], []
        for x_, y_ in c:
            xs += [0.0, float(x_), float("nan")]
            ys += [0.0, float(y_), float("nan")]
        layers.append(Layer("line", xs, ys, {}, {}, ""))
        layers.append(Layer("scatter", c[:, 0].tolist(), c[:, 1].tolist(), {"mlabel": list(names)}, {}, ""))
    tot = (b["sv"] ** 2).sum()
    e1, e2 = (b["sv"][pair[0]] ** 2) / tot, (b["sv"][pair[1]] ** 2) / tot
    s.output.write(f"\nBiplot of {X.shape[0]} observations and {len(names)} variables\n\n"
                   f"    Explained variance by component {pair[0] + 1}  {e1:.4f}\n"
                   f"    Explained variance by component {pair[1] + 1}  {e2:.4f}\n"
                   f"{'Total explained variance':>37}  {e1 + e2:.4f}\n", "text")             # VERIFY
    opts = {"_xtitle": f"Dimension {pair[0] + 1} ({100 * b['sv'][pair[0]] ** 2 / tot:.1f}%)",
            "_ytitle": f"Dimension {pair[1] + 1} ({100 * b['sv'][pair[1]] ** 2 / tot:.1f}%)",
            "title": {"lines": ["Biplot"]}, "legend": {"off": True}}
    finish(s, Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), o)

_GOPTS = {"name": 3, "saving": 3, "nodraw": 3, "title": 1, "dim": 3, "norow": 5, "nocolumn": 5,
          "xnegate": 4, "ynegate": 4, "origin": 3, "maxlength": 4, "variables": 3, "combine": 4,
          "autoaspect": 4, "normalize": 4, "nolabel": 5}


def _graph_opts(text: str) -> dict:
    return match_options(text, _GOPTS) if text.strip() else {}


def _last(s: "Session", cmds: tuple[str, ...]):
    est = getattr(s, "_estimates", None)
    if est is None or est.cmd not in cmds:
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    return est


def _pair(o: dict, avail: int) -> list[int]:
    pr = [int(float(x)) - 1 for x in str(o["dim"]).replace(",", " ").split()] if isinstance(o.get("dim"), str) else [0, 1]
    if len(pr) != 2 or min(pr) < 0 or max(pr) >= avail:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid dim()")                                            # VERIFY
    return pr


def _signs(o: dict) -> tuple[float, float]:
    return (-1.0 if o.get("xnegate") else 1.0), (-1.0 if o.get("ynegate") else 1.0)


def _axis_title(share, j: int) -> str:
    return f"Dimension {j + 1} ({100 * float(share[j]):.1f}%)"                              # VERIFY


def _draw(s, o, opts, panels) -> None:
    from ..graphics.model import Graph
    from .graphcmd import finish
    if isinstance(o.get("title"), str):
        opts["title"] = {"lines": [o["title"].strip().strip('"')]}
    finish(s, Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=panels), o)


def _scatter(x, y, labels, style=None):
    from ..graphics.model import Layer
    return Layer("scatter", [float(v) for v in x], [float(v) for v in y], {"mlabel": list(labels)}, style or {}, "")


def _origin_lines(xs, ys):
    from ..graphics.model import Layer
    lo_x, hi_x = min(xs + [0.0]), max(xs + [0.0])
    lo_y, hi_y = min(ys + [0.0]), max(ys + [0.0])
    return Layer("line", [lo_x, hi_x, float("nan"), 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, float("nan"), lo_y, hi_y],
                 {}, {"lpattern": "dash"}, "")


@command("cabiplot", "cabiplot")
def cmd_cabiplot(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """Biplot of the row and column coordinates after ca ([MV] ca postestimation plots)."""
    from ..graphics.model import Panel
    o = _graph_opts(args.lstrip(", ").strip() if args.strip().startswith(",") else args)

    Rc, Cc = ctx["coords_all"]
    pr = _pair(o, Rc.shape[1])
    sx, sy = _signs(o)
    layers = []
    xs, ys = [], []
    if not o.get("norow"):
        layers.append(_scatter(sx * Rc[:, pr[0]], sy * Rc[:, pr[1]], ctx["labels"][0], {"msymbol": "O"}))
        xs += (sx * Rc[:, pr[0]]).tolist()
        ys += (sy * Rc[:, pr[1]]).tolist()
    if not o.get("nocolumn"):
        layers.append(_scatter(sx * Cc[:, pr[0]], sy * Cc[:, pr[1]], ctx["labels"][1], {"msymbol": "T"}))
        xs += (sx * Cc[:, pr[0]]).tolist()
        ys += (sy * Cc[:, pr[1]]).tolist()
    if o.get("origin"):
        layers.insert(0, _origin_lines(xs, ys))
    opts = {"_xtitle": _axis_title(ctx["share"], pr[0]), "_ytitle": _axis_title(ctx["share"], pr[1]),
            "title": {"lines": ["Correspondence analysis biplot"]},
            "note": {"lines": [f"coordinates in {ctx['norm']} normalization"]}}             # VERIFY
    if not o.get("norow") and not o.get("nocolumn"):
        layers[-2].label, layers[-1].label = ctx["vars"][0], ctx["vars"][1]
    else:
        opts["legend"] = {"off": True}
    _draw(s, o, opts, [Panel("", layers)])


def _projection(s, o, sections, title: str, f: int) -> None:
    """One panel per section: the categories at their coordinates on a vertical axis per
    dimension (x = dimension, y = coordinate), labeled by category."""
    from ..graphics.model import Layer, Panel
    panels = []
    for lab, names, C in sections:
        layers = []
        for j in range(f):
            y = C[:, j]
            layers.append(Layer("line", [j + 1.0, j + 1.0], [float(y.min()), float(y.max())], {}, {"lcolor": "gs8"}, ""))
            layers.append(_scatter(np.full(len(y), j + 1.0), y, names, {"msymbol": "d", "mcolor": "navy"}))
        panels.append(Panel(lab, layers))
    opts = {"_xtitle": "", "_ytitle": "score", "title": {"lines": [title]}, "legend": {"off": True},
            "xlabel": {"ticks": [[float(j + 1), f"dimension {j + 1}"] for j in range(f)]},
            "xscale": {"range": [0.5, f + 0.5]}}                                           # VERIFY
    _draw(s, o, opts, panels)

def _mca_sections(ctx, o):
    C = ctx["coords_all"]

    out = []
    for var, lo, hi in ctx["sections"]:
        if want is None or var in want:
            out.append((var, ctx["labels"][lo:hi], C[lo:hi]))
    return out

@command("mdsshepard", "mdsshepard")
def cmd_mdsshepard(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """Shepard diagram after mds: the fitted Euclidean distances against the dissimilarities of
    every pair of objects."""
    from ..graphics.model import Layer, Panel
    o = _graph_opts(args.strip().lstrip(","))
    est = _last(s, ("mds", "mdsmat", "mdslong"))
    d = est.extra["mds"]
    Y = d["Y"]
    D = d.get("D")
    if D is None:
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    iu = np.triu_indices(Y.shape[0], 1)
    fit = np.sqrt(((Y[:, None, :] - Y[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1))[iu]
    dis = D[iu]
    hi = float(max(dis.max(), fit.max()))
    layers = [Layer("scatter", dis.tolist(), fit.tolist(), {}, {}, ""),
              Layer("line", [0.0, hi], [0.0, hi], {}, {}, "")]
    opts = {"_xtitle": "Dissimilarities", "_ytitle": "Distances", "title": {"lines": ["Shepard diagram"]},
            "legend": {"off": True}}                                                       # VERIFY
    _draw(s, o, opts, [Panel("", layers)])


@command("mdslong", "mdslong")
def cmd_mdslong(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """mdslong depvar, id(var1 var2): multidimensional scaling of dissimilarities given in long
    format, one observation per pair of objects ([MV] mdslong)."""
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"id": 2, "dimension": 3, "method": 3, "noplot": 3, "force": 5, "s2d": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    if not isinstance(o.get("id"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option id() required")
    idv = s.expand_varlist(o["id"])
    if len(idv) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "id() requires two variables")                               # VERIFY
    ds = s.data
    X, _, _, mask = sample(s, p, names, allowed=(), extra=[v for v in idv if not ds.get(v).is_string])
    v1, v2 = (ds.get(v) for v in idv)
    a = [(str(x) if v1.is_string else gnum(x)) for x in (v1.raw if v1.is_string else v1.data)[mask]]

"""rotate after pca and factor, and rotatemat ([MV] rotate, [MV] rotatemat).

The rotation criteria and the gradient projection algorithm are in core/rotation.py; varimax and
promax keep the dedicated routines of core/multivariate.py, which the manual says ignore the
optimize options."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats as st

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import multivariate as mv
from ..core import rng
from ..core import rotation as R
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..lang.syntax import match_options
from .mvcommon import chi2_p, fill_e, g as gnum, matrix
from .mvfactor import _eig_table, _f4, _factor_head, _header, _lr_line, _right, _table, _uniq_extra, _unexpl_extra
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# options shared by rotate and rotatemat
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_METHODS = ("varimax", "vgpf", "quartimax", "equamax", "parsimax", "entropy", "tandem1", "tandem2", "promax",
            "oblimin", "cf", "bentler", "oblimax", "quartimin", "target", "partial")
_COMMON = {"varimax": 3, "vgpf": 4, "quartimax": 6, "equamax": 3, "parsimax": 3, "entropy": 7, "tandem1": 7,
           "tandem2": 7, "promax": 3, "oblimin": 3, "cf": 2, "bentler": 7, "oblimax": 7, "quartimin": 6,
           "target": 6, "partial": 7, "orthogonal": 4, "oblique": 3, "normalize": 4, "blanks": 5, "format": 3,
           "noloading": 5, "norotation": 6, "iterate": 4, "log": 3, "trace": 3, "tolerance": 3,
           "gtolerance": 4, "ltolerance": 4, "protect": 4, "maxstep": 4, "init": 4, "random": 4}
_ROT = dict(_COMMON, factors=6, components=4, norotated=5, detail=3)
_ROTMAT = dict(_COMMON, nodisplay=5, matname=7, colnames=8)


def _spec(s, o: dict, p: int, k: int) -> dict:
    """The rotation requested by the options: method, its argument, class and optimize options."""
    from .matrix import get_matrix
    methods = [m for m in _METHODS if o.get(m)]
    if len(methods) > 1:
        raise StataError(198, "only one rotation method may be specified")                   # VERIFY
    method = methods[0] if methods else "varimax"
    if o.get("orthogonal") and o.get("oblique"):
        raise StataError(198, "options orthogonal and oblique may not be combined")          # VERIFY
    oblique = bool(o.get("oblique")) or method == "promax"
    if method == "promax" and o.get("orthogonal"):
        raise StataError(198, "promax rotation is oblique; option orthogonal not allowed")   # VERIFY
    if oblique and method in ("varimax",) + R.ORTHOGONAL_ONLY:
        # VERIFY: seen for entropy only
        raise StataError(198, f"the {method} criterion is not suitable for oblique rotations")
    arg, carg = None, ""
    val = o.get(method)
    if method == "promax":
        arg = float(val) if isinstance(val, str) else 3.0
        if arg <= 1:
            raise StataError(198, "promax() power must be greater than 1")                  # VERIFY
        carg = f"{arg:g}"
    elif method == "oblimin":
        arg = float(val) if isinstance(val, str) else 0.0
        carg = f"{arg:g}"
    elif method == "cf":
        if not isinstance(val, str):
            raise StataError(198, "option cf() requires an argument")                       # VERIFY
        arg = float(val)
        if not 0 <= arg <= 1:
            raise StataError(198, "cf() must be between 0 and 1")
        carg = f"{arg:g}"
    elif method in ("target", "partial"):
        names = str(val).split() if isinstance(val, str) else []
        if len(names) != (1 if method == "target" else 2):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {method}() incorrectly specified")                # VERIFY
        mats = [get_matrix(s, n_).data for n_ in names]
        if any(m_.shape != (p, k) for m_ in mats):
            raise StataError(503, "conformability error")
        arg = mats[0] if method == "target" else (mats[0], mats[1])
        carg = " ".join(names)
    if o.get("init") and o.get("random"):
        raise StataError(198, "options init() and random may not be combined")              # VERIFY
    T0 = get_matrix(s, str(o["init"])).data if isinstance(o.get("init"), str) else None
    if T0 is not None and T0.shape != (k, k):
        raise StataError(503, "conformability error")

    def num(name, default):
        return float(o[name]) if isinstance(o.get(name), str) else default
    return {"method": method, "arg": arg, "carg": carg, "oblique": oblique, "norm": bool(o.get("normalize")),
            "iterate": int(num("iterate", 1000)), "tol": num("tolerance", 1e-6), "gtol": num("gtolerance", 1e-6),
            "ltol": num("ltolerance", 1e-6), "maxstep": int(num("maxstep", 20)),
            "protect": int(num("protect", 0)), "random": bool(o.get("random")), "T0": T0}


def _ctitle(spec: dict) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(criterion, ctitle) as rotatemat stores them in r(criterion) and r(ctitle)."""
    m = spec["method"]
    if m in ("promax", "oblimin"):
        return m, f"{m}({spec['carg']})"
    if m == "cf":
        return m, f"Crawford-Ferguson({spec['carg']})"
    if m == "vgpf":
        return "varimax", "varimax"                                                          # VERIFY
    return m, _TITLES.get(m, m)


_TITLES = {"entropy": "minimum entropy", "tandem1": "Comrey's principle 1", "tandem2": "Comrey's principle 2",
           "bentler": "Bentler's invariant pattern simplicity"}


def _random_T(k: int, oblique: bool) -> np.ndarray:
    """A random start for random/protect(): normal deviates from Stata's uniform stream (VERIFY:
    Stata's draw of the random orthogonal or normal matrix is not documented)."""
    u = np.clip(rng.RNG.uniform(k * k), 1e-16, 1 - 1e-16)
    return R.random_start(k, oblique, st.norm.ppf(u).reshape(k, k))


def rotate_matrix(s, A: np.ndarray, spec: dict) -> dict:
    """Rotate A as the spec says. Returns {"L", "T" (manual's T: L = A T, or A inv(T') when
    oblique), "f", "iter", "trials"}. Kaiser normalization is applied around the rotation; the
    columns get positive sums and decreasing sums of squares (core/rotation.orient)."""
    m, obl = spec["method"], spec["oblique"]
    B, h = R.kaiser(A) if spec["norm"] else (A, np.ones(A.shape[0]))
    trials = []
    if m == "varimax":
        L, T, _ = mv.orthomax(B, 1.0)
        f, it, conv = SYS, SYS, True
    elif m == "promax":
        L, Tp, _ = mv.promax(B, spec["arg"])
        T = np.linalg.inv(Tp).T
        f, it, conv = SYS, SYS, True
    else:
        opts = dict(oblique=obl, maxiter=spec["iterate"], tol=spec["tol"], gtol=spec["gtol"], ltol=spec["ltol"],
                    maxstep=spec["maxstep"])
        name = "oblimin" if m == "oblimin" else m
        k = A.shape[1]
        if spec["protect"] > 0:
            best = None
            for _ in range(spec["protect"]):
                r_ = R.gpf(B, name, spec["arg"], T0=_random_T(k, obl), **opts)
                trials.append(r_)
                if best is None or r_["f"] < best["f"]:
                    best = r_
            r_ = best
        else:
            T0 = spec["T0"] if spec["T0"] is not None else (_random_T(k, obl) if spec["random"] else None)
            r_ = R.gpf(B, name, spec["arg"], T0=T0, **opts)
        L, T, f, it, conv = r_["L"], r_["T"], r_["f"], r_["iter"], r_["converged"]
    L, T = R.orient(L, T)
    return {"L": L * h[:, None], "T": T, "f": f, "iter": it, "converged": conv, "trials": trials}


def _trials(out, trials) -> None:
    """protect(): one line per trial."""
    for i, r_ in enumerate(trials, start=1):
        out.write(f"Trial {i:>3} : min criterion {gnum(r_['f']).strip():>10}\n", "text")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rotate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("rotate", "rot")
def cmd_rotate(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    est = getattr(s, "_estimates", None)
    d = (getattr(est, "extra", None) or {}).get("mv") if est is not None else None
    if d is None or d["kind"] not in ("pca", "factor"):
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    o = match_options(args.strip().lstrip(","), _ROT) if args.strip().lstrip(",").strip() else {}
    kind = d["kind"]
    k = d["k"]
    kk = int(float(o.get("factors") or o.get("components") or k))
    if kk < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "rotation requires at least 2 factors/components")             # VERIFY
    kk = min(kk, k)
    # pca rotates the eigenvectors (unit length); the variances are those of the scaled eigenvectors
    A = d["V"][:, :kk] if kind == "pca" else d["L"][:, :kk]
    As = A * np.sqrt(np.maximum(d["ev"][:kk], 0)) if kind == "pca" else A
    pdim = A.shape[0]
    spec = _spec(s, o, pdim, kk)
    method, norm = spec["method"], spec["norm"]
    Phi = np.eye(kk)
    fmin = SYS
    if method in ("varimax", "quartimax", "equamax", "parsimax") and not spec["protect"]:
        gamma = {"varimax": 1.0, "quartimax": 0.0, "equamax": kk / 2.0, "parsimax": pdim * (kk - 1) / (pdim + kk - 2.0)}[method]
        Lr, T, _ = mv.orthomax(A, gamma, normalize=norm)
        desc = f"orthogonal {method}"
    elif method == "promax":
        Lr, T, Phi = mv.promax(A, spec["arg"], normalize=norm)
        desc = "oblique promax"
    elif method in ("oblimin", "quartimin") and spec["oblique"] and not spec["protect"] and spec["T0"] is None \
            and not spec["random"]:
        gamma = spec["arg"] if method == "oblimin" else 0.0
        Lr, T, Phi, _ = mv.oblimin(A, gamma, normalize=norm)
        T = np.linalg.inv(T).T                      # the rotation matrix shown is the one with Lr = A T
        desc = f"oblique {method}"
        fmin = mv._oblimin_crit(Lr, gamma)[0]
    else:
        r_ = rotate_matrix(s, A, spec)
        _trials(s.output, r_["trials"])
        Lr, Tm = r_["L"], r_["T"]
        if spec["oblique"]:
            T, Phi = np.linalg.inv(Tm).T, Tm.T @ Tm
        else:
            T = Tm
        # rotate sorts the columns by decreasing explained variance ([MV] rotate, technical note)
        ev_ = ((Lr @ Phi) ** 2).sum(0) if kind == "factor" and spec["oblique"] else ((As @ T) ** 2).sum(0)
        order = np.argsort(-ev_, kind="stable")
        Lr, T, Phi = Lr[:, order], T[:, order], Phi[np.ix_(order, order)]
        fmin = r_["f"]
        desc = f"{'oblique' if spec['oblique'] else 'orthogonal'} {_ctitle(spec)[0]}"
    crit, ctitle = _ctitle(spec)
    oblique = spec["oblique"]
    desc += f" (Kaiser {'on' if norm else 'off'})"
    blanks = float(o["blanks"]) if o.get("blanks") else 0.0
    out = s.output
    names = d["names"]
    N = d["N"]
    var = ((As @ T) ** 2).sum(0)
    if kind == "factor" and oblique:
        var = ((Lr @ Phi) ** 2).sum(0)                  # variance of the structure (compat 1929)
    if kind == "pca":
        unexpl = mv.pca_unexplained(d["C"], d["ev"], d["V"], kk)
        rho = float(d["ev"][:kk].sum() / d["trace"])
        _header(out, f"Principal components/{'covariance' if d['cov'] else 'correlation'}", [
            ("", _right("Number of obs", f"{N}")), ("", _right("Number of comp.", f"{kk}")),
            ("", _right("Trace", gnum(d["trace"]))),
            (f"    Rotation: {desc}", _right("Rho", f"{rho:.4f}"))])
        if oblique:
            _eig_table(out, "Component", var, d["trace"], head="Variance", oblique="Rotated comp. are correlated")
        else:
            _eig_table(out, "Component", var, d["trace"], head="Variance")
        _table(out, "Rotated components", names, [f"Comp{j + 1}" for j in range(kk)], Lr, _f4,
               extra=_unexpl_extra(unexpl), blanks=blanks)
        resid = unexpl
    else:
        _factor_head(out, d, desc, kk)
        if oblique:
            _eig_table(out, "Factor", var, d["evsum"], head="Variance", fixed=True, oblique="Rotated factors are correlated")
        else:
            _eig_table(out, "Factor", var, d["evsum"], head="Variance", fixed=True)
        _lr_line(out, "independent", d["chi_i"], d["df_i"], chi2_p(d["chi_i"], d["df_i"]))
        if d["ml"] is not None:
            chi_k, df_k, pk = d["ml"][:3]
            if df_k > 0:
                _lr_line(out, f"{kk} factor{'s' if kk != 1 else ''}", chi_k, df_k, pk)
        _table(out, "Rotated factor loadings (pattern matrix) and unique variances", names, [f"Factor{j + 1}" for j in range(kk)],
               Lr, _f4, extra=_uniq_extra(d["psi"]), blanks=blanks)
        resid = d["psi"]
    cn = ("Comp" if kind == "pca" else "Factor")
    cols = [f"{cn}{j + 1}" for j in range(kk)]
    # pca shows the matrix with rotated = unrotated T; factor shows its inverse transpose (compat 1929)
    Tshow = np.linalg.inv(T).T if kind == "factor" and oblique else T
    _table(out, ("Component" if kind == "pca" else "Factor") + " rotation matrix", cols, cols, Tshow, _f4, stub="",
           cw=9 if kind == "pca" else 8)
    d2 = dict(d)
    d2["rot"] = {"L": Lr, "T": T, "Phi": Phi, "method": method, "desc": desc, "k": kk, "oblique": oblique,
                 "ctitle": ctitle, "crit": crit, "norm": norm}
    est.extra["mv"] = d2
    base_s, base_m, base_t = est.extra["elist"]
    # the r_ results as Stata 14 lists them (compat 1906, 1929); r_fmin (the value of the rotation
    # criterion) is stored only for the criteria that have one
    rs = ([("r_fmin", fmin)] if fmin != SYS else []) + [("r_f", kk)]
    rm = [("r_normalization", "kaiser" if norm else "none"), ("r_ctitle", ctitle), ("r_criterion", crit),
          ("r_class", "oblique" if oblique else "orthogonal")]
    if kind == "factor":
        rm = [rm[0], rm[3], rm[2], rm[1]]
    rt = [("r_Ev", matrix(var.reshape(1, -1), ["r_Ev"], cols))]
    if kind == "factor":
        rt.append(("r_Phi", matrix(Phi, cols, cols)))
    rt += [("r_T", matrix(Tshow, cols, cols)), ("r_L", matrix(Lr, names, cols))]
    base_m = [x for x in base_m if not x[0].startswith("r_")]
    fill_e(s, [x for x in base_s if not x[0].startswith("r_")] + rs, rm + base_m, rt + [x for x in base_t if not x[0].startswith("r_")])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _fmt_cell(fmt: str):
    return lambda x: format_value(x, fmt, pad=False)


@command("rotatemat", "rotatemat")
def cmd_rotatemat(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """rotatemat matname [, options] ([MV] rotatemat): rotation of a Stata matrix. The layout
    follows Stata 14's output (compat/do/1929_multivariate2.do)."""
    from .matrix import get_matrix
    body, _, opt = args.partition(",")
    name = body.strip()
    if not name or len(name.split()) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    M_ = get_matrix(s, name)
    A = M_.data
    if (np.abs(A) >= SYS).any():
        raise StataError(504, f"matrix {name} has missing values")
    p, k = A.shape
    o = match_options(opt, _ROTMAT) if opt.strip() else {}
    spec = _spec(s, o, p, k)
    r_ = rotate_matrix(s, A, spec)
    crit, ctitle = _ctitle(spec)
    cls = "oblique" if spec["oblique"] else "orthogonal"
    fmt = str(o["format"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("format"), str) else "%9.5f"
    blanks = float(o["blanks"]) if isinstance(o.get("blanks"), str) else 0.0
    rows = M_.rownames
    cols = M_.colnames
    out = s.output
    if not o.get("nodisplay"):
        _trials(out, r_["trials"])
        label = str(o["matname"]) if isinstance(o.get("matname"), str) else f"{name}[{p},{k}]"
        out.write(f"\nRotation of {label}\n\n", "text")
        lines = [("Criterion", ctitle), ("Rotation class", cls), ("Kaiser normalization", "on" if spec["norm"] else "off")]
        if r_["f"] != SYS:
            lines += [("Criterion value", gnum(r_["f"]).strip()), ("Number of iterations", str(r_["iter"]))]
        for lab, val in lines:
            out.write(f"    {lab:<24}{val}\n", "text")
        if not r_["converged"]:
            out.write("    Warning: convergence not achieved\n", "text")
        cw = len(format_value(0.0, fmt)) + 1
        cname = str(o["colnames"]) if isinstance(o.get("colnames"), str) else "factors"
        if not o.get("noloading"):
            title = f"Rotated {cname}" + (f" (blanks represent abs()<{gnum(blanks).strip()})" if blanks else "")
            _table(out, title, rows, cols, r_["L"], _fmt_cell(fmt), stub="", blanks=blanks, cw=cw)
        if not o.get("norotation"):
            _table(out, f"{'Oblique' if spec['oblique'] else 'Orthogonal'} rotation", cols, cols, r_["T"],
                   _fmt_cell(fmt), stub="", cw=cw)
    # return list shows the results in reverse order of creation
    res = {"T": matrix(r_["T"], cols, cols), "AT": matrix(r_["L"], rows, cols)}
    if r_["trials"]:
        res["fmin"] = matrix(np.array([[t_["f"] for t_ in r_["trials"]]]))
    res.update({"ctitle": ctitle, "ctitle12": ctitle[:12], "criterion": crit, "class": cls,
                "normalization": "kaiser" if spec["norm"] else "none"})
    if spec["carg"]:
        res["carg"] = spec["carg"]
    res["cmd"] = "rotatemat"
    if r_["trials"]:
        res["nnconv"] = float(sum(not t_["converged"] for t_ in r_["trials"]))
    res.update({"rc": 0.0, "iter": float(r_["iter"]) if r_["iter"] != SYS else SYS, "f": float(r_["f"])})
    s.r = res

"""mvtest: tests of means, covariances, correlations and normality ([MV] mvtest).

The statistics are in core/mvtests.py."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import multivariate as mv
from ..core import mvtests as T
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from .mvcommon import g as gnum, matrix, numeric_names, sample
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# mvtest
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("mvtest", "mvtest", byable=True)
def cmd_mvtest(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    words = args.strip().split(None, 1)
    if not words:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub = words[0].rstrip(",")
    rest = args.strip()[len(words[0]):] if len(words) > 1 else ""
    for name, mn, fn in (("means", 1, _mvtest_means), ("covariances", 3, _mvtest_cov), ("correlations", 4, _mvtest_corr),
                         ("normality", 1, _mvtest_norm)):
        if len(sub) >= mn and name.startswith(sub):
            from .data import _by_header
            from .summarize import by_groups
            for group, first in by_groups(s):
                if first is not None:
                    _by_header(s, first)
                s._by_group_mask = group if first is not None else None
                try:
                    fn(s, rest)
                finally:
                    s._by_group_mask = None
            return
    raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")


def _groups(s, p, names, o, allowed=("fweight", "aweight")):
    """The sample and, with by(groupvars), the group of each observation (one code per distinct
    combination of values). Observations with missing groupvars are dropped unless `missing`."""
    by = str(o["by"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else None
    if by is None:
        X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names, allowed)
        return X, w, None, mask, None
    byvars = s.expand_varlist(by)
    X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names, allowed, extra=[] if o.get("missing") else byvars)
    cols = np.column_stack([s.data.get(v).data[mask].astype(float) for v in byvars])
    _, g = np.unique(cols, axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    return X, w, g.ravel(), mask, by


def _chi_lines(out, title: str, label: str, chi2: float, df: float, p: float) -> None:
    out.write(f"\n{title}\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{label + '(' + gnum(df) + ') =':>24}{chi2:>10.2f}\n{'Prob > chi2 =':>24}{p:>10.4f}\n", "text")


def _mvtest_means(s, rest: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "zero": 4, "equals": 3, "homogeneous": 4, "heterogeneous": 6}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    X, w, g, mask, by = _groups(s, p, names, o)
    out = s.output
    k = len(names)
    if g is None:
        mean, S, R, n = mv.weighted_moments(X, w)
        if o.get("zero") or isinstance(o.get("equals"), str):
            mu0 = np.zeros(k)
            if isinstance(o.get("equals"), str):
                from .matrix import get_matrix
                mu0 = get_matrix(s, str(o["equals"]).strip()).data.ravel()
            r = T.hotelling_one(mean, S, n, mu0)
            what = "Test that all means are equal to the hypothesized values" if not o.get("zero") else "Test that all means are equal to 0"
            df1 = k
        else:
            if k < 2:
                raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
            Cm = np.hstack([np.eye(k - 1), -np.ones((k - 1, 1))])
            r = T.hotelling_one(Cm @ mean, Cm @ S @ Cm.T, n)
            what = "Test that all means are the same"
            df1 = k - 1
        out.write(f"\n{what}\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Hotelling T2 =':>24}{r['T2']:>10.2f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Hotelling F(' + str(df1) + ',' + gnum(r['df2']) + ') =':>24}{r['F']:>10.2f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Prob > F =':>24}{r['p']:>10.4f}\n", "text")
        s.r = {"T2": r["T2"], "F": r["F"], "df_m": float(df1), "df_r": r["df2"], "p_F": r["p"]}
        return
    levels = sorted(set(g.tolist()))
    if len(levels) < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "by() must define at least 2 groups")                         # VERIFY
    E = np.zeros((k, k))
    gm = np.average(X, axis=0, weights=w)
    H = np.zeros((k, k))
    N = float(X.shape[0] if w is None else w.sum())
    for lv in levels:
        sel = g == lv
        ww = np.ones(int(sel.sum())) if w is None else w[sel]
        xm = (ww[:, None] * X[sel]).sum(0) / ww.sum()
        Xc = X[sel] - xm
        E += (Xc * ww[:, None]).T @ Xc
        d = xm - gm
        H += ww.sum() * np.outer(d, d)
    dfh, dfe = len(levels) - 1, N - len(levels)
    stats = T.mv_statistics(T.eig_ratio(E, H), k, dfh, dfe)
    out.write(f"\nTest for equality of {len(levels)} group means, assuming homogeneity\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>28}| Statistic   F(df1,     df2)   =  F      Prob>F\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>5}{'-' * 23}+{'-' * 47}\n", "text")
    nm = {"W": "Wilks' lambda", "P": "Pillai's trace", "L": "Lawley-Hotelling trace", "R": "Roy's largest root"}
    for r_ in stats:
        out.write(f"{nm[r_['name']]:>27} |{r_['stat']:>10.4f}{r_['df1']:>8.1f}{r_['df2']:>10.1f}{r_['F']:>10.2f}"
                  f"{r_['p']:>9.4f} {r_['flag']}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>5}{'-' * 71}\n{'':>28}e = exact, a = approximate, u = upper bound on F\n", "text")
    s.r = {"p_F": stats[0]["p"], "F": stats[0]["F"], "df_r": stats[0]["df2"], "df_m": stats[0]["df1"]}


def _mvtest_cov(s, rest: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "missing": 4, "equals": 3, "diagonal": 4, "spherical": 4, "compound": 4,
                                  "block": 4}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    hyp = [h for h in ("diagonal", "spherical", "compound", "equals", "block") if o.get(h)]
    if len(hyp) > 1:
        raise StataError(198, "only one hypothesis may be specified")
    if o.get("by") and hyp:
        raise StataError(198, f"option {hyp[0]} not allowed with by()")                   # VERIFY
    X, w, g, mask, by = _groups(s, p, names, o)
    out = s.output
    if g is not None:
        levels = sorted(set(g.tolist()))
        Ss, ns = [], []
        for lv in levels:
            sel = g == lv
            _, S_, _, sw = mv.weighted_moments(X[sel], None if w is None else w[sel])
            Ss.append(S_)
            ns.append(sw)
        r = T.box_m(Ss, ns)
        out.write(f"\nTest of equality of covariance matrices across {len(levels)} samples\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Modified LR chi2 =':>24}{gnum(r['M']):>10}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Box F(' + gnum(r['df']) + ',' + gnum(r['df2']) + ') =':>24}{r['F']:>10.2f}"
                  f"{'Prob > F =':>16}{r['p_F']:>8.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Box chi2(' + gnum(r['df']) + ') =':>24}{r['chi2']:>10.2f}{'Prob > chi2 =':>16}{r['p']:>8.4f}\n", "text")
        # return list shows them in reverse order
        s.r = {"chi2type": "Box", "F_Box": r["F"], "df_m_Box": r["df"], "df_r_Box": r["df2"], "p_F_Box": r["p_F"],
               "chi2": r["chi2"], "df": r["df"], "p_chi2": r["p"]}
        return
    mean, S, R, n = mv.weighted_moments(X, w)
    SN = S * (n - 1.0) / n
    if o.get("spherical"):
        r = T.lr_spherical(S, n)
        title = "Test that covariance matrix is spherical"
    elif o.get("compound"):
        r = T.lr_compound_cov(SN, n)
        title = "Test that covariance matrix is compound symmetric"
    elif isinstance(o.get("equals"), str):
        from .matrix import get_matrix
        mname = str(o["equals"]).strip()
        S0 = get_matrix(s, mname).data
        if S0.shape != S.shape:
            raise StataError(503, "conformability error")
        r = T.lr_equals_cov(SN, S0, n)
        title = f"Test that covariance matrix equals matrix {mname}"
    elif isinstance(o.get("block"), str):
        blocks = [[names.index(v) for v in s.expand_varlist(part)] for part in str(o["block"]).split("||")]
        used = [i for b_ in blocks for i in b_]
        if len(set(used)) != len(used):
            raise StataError(198, "variables may appear in only one block")                    # VERIFY
        rest_ = [i for i in range(len(names)) if i not in used]
        if rest_:
            blocks.append(rest_)            # VERIFY: the variables not listed form the last block
        r = T.lr_block_cov(SN, blocks, n)
        title = "Test that covariance matrix is block diagonal"
    else:
        r = T.lr_diagonal(R, n)
        title = "Test that covariance matrix is diagonal"
    _chi_lines(out, title, "Adjusted LR chi2", r["chi2"], r["df"], r["p"])
    s.r = {"chi2type": "Adjusted LR", "chi2": r["chi2"], "df": r["df"], "p_chi2": r["p"]}   # VERIFY: seen for compound


def _mvtest_corr(s, rest: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "missing": 4, "compound": 4, "equals": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    if o.get("by") and (o.get("compound") or o.get("equals")):
        raise StataError(198, "options compound and equals() not allowed with by()")      # VERIFY
    if o.get("compound") and o.get("equals"):
        raise StataError(198, "options compound and equals() may not be combined")        # VERIFY
    X, w, g, mask, by = _groups(s, p, names, o)
    out = s.output
    if g is not None:
        levels = sorted(set(g.tolist()))
        Rs, ns = [], []
        for lv in levels:
            sel = g == lv
            _, _, R_, sw = mv.weighted_moments(X[sel], None if w is None else w[sel])
            Rs.append(R_)
            ns.append(sw)
        r = T.jennrich_equal(Rs, ns)
        _chi_lines(out, "Test of equality of correlation matrices across samples", "Jennrich chi2", r["chi2"], r["df"], r["p"])
        typ = "Jennrich"
    else:
        mean, S, R, n = mv.weighted_moments(X, w)
        if isinstance(o.get("equals"), str):
            from .matrix import get_matrix
            mname = str(o["equals"]).strip()
            C = get_matrix(s, mname).data
            if C.shape != R.shape:
                raise StataError(503, "conformability error")
            sd = np.sqrt(np.diag(C))
            r = T.jennrich_one(R, C / np.outer(sd, sd), n)
            _chi_lines(out, f"Test that correlation matrix equals specified pattern {mname}", "Jennrich chi2",
                       r["chi2"], r["df"], r["p"])
            typ = "Jennrich"
        else:
            r = T.lawley(R, n)
            _chi_lines(out, "Test that correlation matrix is compound symmetric (all correlations equal)",
                       "Lawley chi2", r["chi2"], r["df"], r["p"])
            typ = "Lawley"                                                                     # VERIFY
    s.r = {"chi2type": typ, "chi2": r["chi2"], "df": r["df"], "p_chi2": r["p"]}


_NORM_STATS = ("dhansen", "hzirkler", "kurtosis", "skewness")


def _mv_line(label: str, value, chi: str, chi2: float, p: float) -> str:
    """One line of the multivariate normality tests."""
    head = f"{label:<16} = {gnum(value):>9}" if value is not None else f"{label:<28}"
    return f"    {head}{chi:>12} = {chi2:8.3f}   Prob>chi2 = {p:7.4f}\n"


def _mvtest_norm(s, rest: str) -> None:
    from .nptests import _royston_adjust, _sk_z
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"stats": 2, "univariate": 3, "bivariate": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    req = str(o["stats"]).split() if isinstance(o.get("stats"), str) else ["dhansen"]
    want = set()
    for w_ in req:
        if w_ == "all":
            want.update(_NORM_STATS)
            continue
        full = next((n_ for n_ in _NORM_STATS if len(w_) >= 2 and n_.startswith(w_)), None)
        if full is None:
            raise StataError(198, f"stats({w_}) invalid")
        want.add(full)
    X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names, ("fweight",))
    if w is not None:
        X = np.repeat(X, w.astype(int), axis=0)                        # fweights: replicate the observations
    out = s.output
    res: dict = {}
    if o.get("univariate"):
        out.write("\nTest for univariate normality\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'-' * 69}\n{'':>17}|{'':>35}------- joint ------\n", "text")
        out.write("        Variable |  Pr(Skewness)   Pr(Kurtosis)  adj chi2(2)    Prob>chi2\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'-' * 13}+{'-' * 55}\n", "text")
        U = []
        for j, nm in enumerate(names):
            z1, z2 = _sk_z(X[:, j])
            ps, pk = 2 * float(T.st.norm.sf(abs(z1))), 2 * float(T.st.norm.sf(abs(z2)))
            K2, pj = _royston_adjust(z1 * z1 + z2 * z2, X.shape[0])
            U.append([ps, pk, K2, pj])
            out.write(f"    {nm[:12]:>12} |{ps:>11.4f}{pk:>15.4f}{K2:>15.2f}{pj:>13.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'-' * 69}\n", "text")
        res["Utest"] = matrix(np.array(U), names, ["P_skew", "P_kurt", "chi2", "P_chi2"])
    if o.get("bivariate"):
        out.write("\nDoornik-Hansen test for bivariate normality\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'-' * 56}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'Pair of variables':<27}|      chi2    df   Prob>chi2\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    {'-' * 27}+{'-' * 28}\n", "text")
        B, bnames = [], []
        for i in range(len(names)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(names)):
                d = T.doornik_hansen(X[:, [i, j]])
                B.append([d["chi2"], d["df"], d["p"]])
                bnames.append((names[i], names[j]))
                left = names[i][:12] if j == i + 1 else ""
                out.write(f"    {left:<14}{names[j][:12]:<13}|{d['chi2']:>10.2f}{gnum(d['df']):>6}{d['p']:>11.4f}\n",
                          "text")
        out.write(f"    {'-' * 56}\n", "text")
        Bm = matrix(np.array(B), [b_ for _, b_ in bnames], ["chi2", "df", "p"])
        Bm.roweq = [a_ for a_, _ in bnames]
        res["Btest"] = Bm
    out.write("\nTest for multivariate normality\n\n", "text")
    rank = float(np.linalg.matrix_rank(np.cov(X, rowvar=False)))
    if "skewness" in want or "kurtosis" in want:
        m = T.mardia(X)
    if "skewness" in want:
        out.write(_mv_line("Mardia mSkewness", m["b1"], f"chi2({gnum(m['df_skew'])})", m["chi2_skew"], m["p_skew"]),
                  "text")
        res.update({"mskew": m["b1"], "chi2_mskew": m["chi2_skew"], "df_mskew": m["df_skew"], "p_mskew": m["p_skew"],
                    "rank_mskew": rank})
    if "kurtosis" in want:
        out.write(_mv_line("Mardia mKurtosis", m["b2"], "chi2(1)", m["z_kurt"] ** 2, m["p_kurt"]), "text")
        res.update({"mkurt": m["b2"], "chi2_mkurt": m["z_kurt"] ** 2, "z_mkurt": m["z_kurt"], "p_mkurt": m["p_kurt"],
                    "rank_mkurt": rank})
    if "hzirkler" in want:
        h = T.henze_zirkler(X)
        out.write(_mv_line("Henze-Zirkler", h["hz"], "chi2(1)", h["z"] ** 2, h["p"]), "text")
        res.update({k_: h[v_] for k_, v_ in (("hz", "hz"), ("E_hz", "E"), ("V_hz", "V"), ("z_hz", "z"), ("p_hz", "p"))
                    if v_ in h})
        res["rank_hz"] = rank
    if "dhansen" in want:
        d = T.doornik_hansen(X)
        out.write(_mv_line("Doornik-Hansen", None, f"chi2({gnum(d['df'])})", d["chi2"], d["p"]), "text")
        res.update({"chi2_dh": d["chi2"], "df_dh": d["df"], "p_dh": d["p"]})
        res["U_dh"] = matrix(d["U"], names, ["b1", "b2", "z1", "z2"])
    # return list shows them in this order (compat 1906, 1929); the dictionary is filled in reverse
    order = ["p_dh", "df_dh", "chi2_dh", "rank_hz", "p_hz", "z_hz", "V_hz", "E_hz", "hz", "rank_mkurt", "p_mkurt",
             "chi2_mkurt", "z_mkurt", "mkurt", "rank_mskew", "p_mskew", "df_mskew", "chi2_mskew", "mskew",
             "U_dh", "Btest", "Utest"]
    s.r = {k_: res[k_] for k_ in reversed(order) if k_ in res}

"""Hotelling's test, multivariate regression, MANOVA, canonical correlations and mvtest
([MV] hotelling, [MV] mvreg, [MV] manova, [MV] canon, [MV] mvtest).

The statistics are in core/mvtests.py. Layouts follow the manuals' examples; what they do not
show carries a VERIFY mark and is settled by the reference log of compat case 1906."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import multivariate as mv
from ..core import mvtests as T
from ..core.errors import StataError

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _fp(p: float) -> str:
    return f"{p:.4f}" if np.isfinite(p) else "."


def _summary_table(out, ds, names, X, w=None, wtype="") -> None:
    """The table of `summarize`: observations, mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum."""
    from ..core import stats as S
    from .summarize import g9
    out.write("\n    Variable |        Obs        Mean    Std. Dev.       Min        Max\n", "text")
    out.write("-------------+" + "-" * 57 + "\n", "text")
    for j, n_ in enumerate(names):
        m = S.moments(X[:, j], w, wtype)
        # the mean is accumulated in extended precision, so that a mean that is exactly -.86921875 shows as Stata does
        xj = X[:, j].astype(np.longdouble)
        wj = np.ones(len(xj), dtype=np.longdouble) if w is None else np.asarray(w, dtype=np.longdouble)
        mean = float((wj * xj).sum() / wj.sum())
        out.write(f"{n_[:12]:>12} | {m.N:>10,.0f}   {g9(mean):>9}   {g9(m.sd):>9}  {g9(m.min):>9}  {g9(m.max):>9}\n", "text")

@command("hotelling", "hot")
def cmd_hotelling(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "notable": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    by = str(o["by"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else None
    X, w, wtype, mask = sample(s, p, names, extra=[by] if by else [])
    out = s.output
    k = len(names)
    ds = s.data
    if by is None:
        mean, S, R, sw = mv.weighted_moments(X, w)
        n = sw
        if not o.get("notable"):
            _summary_table(out, ds, names, X, w, wtype)
        r = T.hotelling_one(mean, S, n)
        t2, f_ = gnum(r["T2"], "%10.0g"), gnum(r["F"], "%10.0g")
        out.write(f"\n1-group Hotelling's T-squared = {t2}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"F test statistic: (({int(n)}-{k})/({int(n)}-1)({k})) x {t2} = {f_}\n", "text")
        out.write("\nH0: Vector of means is equal to a vector of zeros\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'F(' + str(k) + ',' + gnum(r['df2']) + ') =':>24}{r['F']:>10.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Prob > F(' + str(k) + ',' + gnum(r['df2']) + ') =':>24}{r['p']:>10.4f}\n", "text")
        s.r = {"N": float(n), "k": float(k), "df": r["df2"], "T2": r["T2"]}
        return
    g = s.data.get(by).data[mask]
    levels = sorted(set(g.tolist()))
    if len(levels) != 2:
        raise StataError(420, f"{by} has {len(levels)} groups; must be 2")                 # VERIFY
    parts = []
    for lv in levels:
        sel = g == lv
        ww = None if w is None else w[sel]
        mean, S, R, sw = mv.weighted_moments(X[sel], ww)
        parts.append((mean, S, sw, sel))
        if not o.get("notable"):
            from .inspect import cell_text
            lab = cell_text(ds, ds.get(by), int(np.flatnonzero(mask)[np.flatnonzero(sel)[0]]))
            out.write("\n" + "-" * int(s.settings.get("linesize", 80)) + "\n", "text")
            out.write(f"-> {by} = {lab}\n", "text")
            _summary_table(out, ds, names, X[sel], ww, wtype)
    (m1, S1, n1, _), (m2, S2, n2, _) = parts
    r = T.hotelling_two(m1, S1, n1, m2, S2, n2)
    t2, f_ = gnum(r["T2"], "%10.0g"), gnum(r["F"], "%10.0g")
    out.write(f"\n2-group Hotelling's T-squared = {t2}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"F test statistic: (({int(n1 + n2)}-{k}-1)/({int(n1 + n2)}-2)({k})) x {t2} = {f_}\n", "text")
    out.write("\nH0: Vectors of means are equal for the two groups\n", "text")
    d2 = gnum(r["df2"])
    out.write(f"{'F(' + str(k) + ',' + d2 + ') =':>24}{r['F']:>10.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Prob > F(' + str(k) + ',' + d2 + ') =':>24}{r['p']:>10.4f}\n", "text")
    s.r = {"N": float(n1 + n2), "k": float(k), "df": r["df2"], "T2": r["T2"]}

@command("mvreg", "mvreg")
def cmd_mvreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        from ..estimation.postest import replay
        replay(s, "mvreg", args)
        return
    from ..estimation import fvars
    from ..estimation.results import CoefRow, Estimates, post, rows_from_columns
    from ._util import touse
    from .summarize import weights
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"noconstant": 3, "corr": 4, "level": 1}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    if p.exp is None:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    deps = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 1)
    constant = not o.get("noconstant")
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    with fvars.caching():
        terms = fvars.expand_fv(ds, p.exp)
        mask = touse(s, p)
        for d_ in deps:
            mask &= ds.get(d_).data < SYS
        mask &= ~fvars.term_missing(ds, terms)
        w, wtype, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight",))
        if not mask.any():
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        cols = fvars.build_design(ds, terms, mask, constant=constant)
    n = int(mask.sum())
    wv = np.ones(n) if w is None else w[mask].astype(float)
    N = float(wv.sum())
    for nm in fvars.drop_collinear(cols, constant, wv):
        s.output.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    est_cols = [c for c in cols if c.values is not None]
    X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols] + ([np.ones(n)] if constant else []))
    Y = np.column_stack([ds.get(d_).data[mask] for d_ in deps]).astype(float)
    k = X.shape[1]
    XtWXi = np.linalg.inv((X * wv[:, None]).T @ X)
    B = XtWXi @ (X * wv[:, None]).T @ Y
    E = Y - X @ B
    df_r = N - k
    if df_r <= 0:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    SSCP = (E * wv[:, None]).T @ E
    Sigma = SSCP / df_r
    q = len(deps)
    df_m = k - (1 if constant else 0)
    out = s.output
    names_one = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in cols] + (["_cons"] if constant else [])
    kk = len(names_one)
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if constant else [])
    eq_stats = []
    b_all, V_all, names_all, eq_all, rows = [], np.zeros((kk * q, kk * q)), [], [], []
    for e_i, d_ in enumerate(deps):
        bfull = np.zeros(kk)
        bfull[pos] = B[:, e_i]
        bmap = {c.name: bfull[i] for i, c in enumerate(cols)}
        semap = {}
        for i, c in enumerate(cols):
            semap[c.name] = math.sqrt(Sigma[e_i, e_i] * XtWXi[pos.index(i), pos.index(i)]) if i in pos else 0.0
        if constant:
            bmap["_cons"] = bfull[-1]
            semap["_cons"] = math.sqrt(Sigma[e_i, e_i] * XtWXi[-1, -1])
        if e_i:
            rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("header", d_, left=True))
        rows += rows_from_columns(cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=constant)
        b_all.append(bfull)
        names_all += names_one
        eq_all += [d_] * kk
        y = Y[:, e_i]
        ybar = float(np.average(y, weights=wv)) if constant else 0.0
        tss = float((wv * (y - ybar) ** 2).sum())
        rss = float(SSCP[e_i, e_i])
        r2 = 1 - rss / tss if tss > 0 else float("nan")
        F = ((tss - rss) / df_m) / (rss / df_r) if df_m > 0 else float("nan")
        pF = float(T.st.f.sf(F, df_m, df_r)) if df_m > 0 and np.isfinite(F) else float("nan")
        eq_stats.append((d_, N, k, math.sqrt(Sigma[e_i, e_i]), r2, F, pF))
    for a in range(q):
        for b_ in range(q):
            blk = Sigma[a, b_] * XtWXi
            full = np.zeros((kk, kk))
            full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = blk
            V_all[a * kk:(a + 1) * kk, b_ * kk:(b_ + 1) * kk] = full
    b_vec = np.concatenate(b_all)
    est = Estimates("mvreg", deps[0], names_all, b_vec, V_all, int(round(N)), "t", df_r)
    est.eqnames = eq_all
    est.rows = rows
    est.cols = cols
    est.constant = constant
    est.terms = terms
    est.level = level
    est.vcetype = ""
    est.wtype = wtype
    est.resid_df = df_r
    est.extra = {"N": N, "df_m": df_m, "df_r": df_r, "Sigma": Sigma, "B": B, "deps": deps,
                 "rank": k}
    est.predict = _mvreg_predict
    est.predict_opts = {}
    scalars = [("k", kk), ("df_r", df_r), ("k_eq", q), ("N", N), ("rank", kk * q)]
    if o.get("corr") and q > 1:
        Rr = Sigma / np.sqrt(np.outer(np.diag(Sigma), np.diag(Sigma)))
        scalars += [("df_chi2", q * (q - 1) / 2.0), ("chi2", float(N * sum(Rr[i, j] ** 2 for i in range(q) for j in range(i))))]
    strs = lambda vals, fmt: "".join(" " + fmt(v) for v in vals)
    g7 = lambda v: gnum(v, "%9.0g")
    macros = [("cmd", "mvreg"), ("cmdline", "mvreg " + args.strip()), ("estat_cmd", "mvreg_estat"),
              ("marginsdefault", " ".join(f"predict(xb equation({d_}))" for d_ in deps)), ("marginsok", "XB default"),
              ("marginsnotok", "stdp Residuals stddp"), ("predict", "reg3_p"), ("depvar", " ".join(deps)),
              ("eqnames", " ".join(deps)), ("F", strs([x[5] for x in eq_stats], g7)),
              ("rmse", strs([x[3] for x in eq_stats], g7)), ("p_F", strs([x[6] for x in eq_stats], lambda v: f"{v:.4f}")),
              ("r2", strs([x[4] for x in eq_stats], lambda v: f"{v:.4f}")), ("properties", "b V"), ("wtype", wtype)]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, mask, extra_mats=[("Sigma", matrix(Sigma, deps, deps))])
    est.no_b = False
    _display_mvreg(s, est, eq_stats, o, deps, N)


def _display_mvreg(s, est, eq_stats, o, deps, N) -> None:
    from ..estimation.results import coef_table
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Equation':<21}{'Obs':>3}{'Parms':>8}{'RMSE':>12}{'\"R-sq\"':>10}{'F':>11}{'P':>9}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 74 + "\n", "text")
    for d_, ob, parms, rmse, r2, F, pF in eq_stats:
        out.write(f"{d_[:21]:<21}{int(ob):>3}{parms:>8}{gnum(rmse, '%9.0g'):>12}{r2:>10.4f}{gnum(F, '%9.0g'):>11}{pF:>9.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    coef_table(s, "", est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=est.level)
    if o.get("corr") and len(deps) > 1:
        q = len(deps)
        Sg = est.extra["Sigma"]
        R = Sg / np.sqrt(np.outer(np.diag(Sg), np.diag(Sg)))
        chi2 = float(N * sum(R[i, j] ** 2 for i in range(q) for j in range(i)))
        df = q * (q - 1) / 2.0
        out.write("\nCorrelation matrix of residuals:\n\n", "text")
        lower_matrix(out, deps, R)
        out.write(f"\nBreusch-Pagan test of independence: chi2({int(df)}) = {chi2:9.3f}, Pr = {T.st.chi2.sf(chi2, df):.4f}\n", "text")


def _mvreg_predict(s, est, stat, mask):
    from ..estimation import fvars
    from ..estimation.postest import _columns
    o = getattr(est, "_pred_opts", {}) or {}
    deps = est.extra["deps"]
    eq = str(o["equation"]).strip().lstrip("#") if isinstance(o.get("equation"), str) else deps[0]
    if eq.isdigit():
        eq = deps[int(eq) - 1]
    if eq not in deps:
        raise StataError(111, f"equation {eq} not found")                                  # VERIFY
    i = deps.index(eq)
    kk = len(est.names) // len(deps)
    b = est.b[i * kk:(i + 1) * kk]
    with fvars.caching():
        ok = ~fvars.term_missing(s.data, est.terms)
        xb = np.zeros(s.data.nobs)
        for j, col in _columns(s, est):
            xb += b[j] * col
    xb = np.where(ok, xb, SYS)
    note = ""
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        if not stat:
            note = "(option xb assumed; fitted values)"
        return xb, note
    if stat == "residuals":
        y = s.data.get(eq).data
        return np.where(ok & (y < SYS), y - xb, SYS), ""
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")
