def _resid_sscp(X: np.ndarray, Y: np.ndarray, w: np.ndarray):
    sw = np.sqrt(w)
    Xw, Yw = X * sw[:, None], Y * sw[:, None]
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xw, Yw, rcond=None)
    R = Yw - Xw @ beta
    return R.T @ R, int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(Xw))


def _test_mats(lam, stats, q: int, dfh: float, dfe: float) -> tuple:
    """(eigvals, aux, stat) of one test: the s = min(q, df) nonzero eigenvalues, (s, m, n) and the
    4 x 6 table of the statistics (type 1 = exact, 2 = approximate, 3 = upper bound)."""
    sdim = int(min(q, dfh))
    mpar, npar = (abs(q - dfh) - 1.0) / 2.0, (dfe - q - 1.0) / 2.0
    code = {"e": 1.0, "a": 2.0, "u": 3.0}
    stat = None
    if stats:
        stat = matrix(np.array([[r_["stat"], r_["df1"], r_["df2"], r_["F"], r_["p"], code[r_["flag"]]]
                                for r_ in stats]), ["W", "P", "L", "R"], ["statistic", "df1", "df2", "F", "p", "type"])
    aux = matrix(np.array([[sdim], [mpar], [npar]], dtype=float), ["s", "m", "n"], ["aux"])
    return matrix(np.asarray(lam[:sdim], dtype=float).reshape(1, -1)), aux, stat


def _stat_rows(out, label: str, stats: list[dict], df_h: float) -> None:
    pieces = _wrap_label(label)
    for i, r in enumerate(stats):
        src = pieces[i] if i < len(pieces) else ""
        dfc = f"{int(df_h):>10}" if i == 0 else f"{'':>10}"
        out.write(f"{src:>20} |{r['name']}{r['stat']:>9.4f}{dfc}{r['df1']:>9.1f}{r['df2']:>9.1f}"
                  f"{r['F']:>9.2f} {r['p']:.4f} {r['flag']}\n", "text")


@command("manova", "manova")
def cmd_manova(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..estimation import anova as A
    from ._util import touse
    from .summarize import weights
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"sequential": 3, "continuous": 4, "noconstant": 4, "partial": 4,
                                  "dropemptycells": 4}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    if p.exp is None:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    deps = numeric_names(s, p.varlist, 2)
    continuous = set(s.expand_varlist(o["continuous"])) if isinstance(o.get("continuous"), str) else set()
    segments = A._parse_terms(s, p.exp, continuous)
    terms = [t_ for seg in segments for t_ in seg]
    if not terms:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    allvars = sorted({n for t_ in terms for n in t_.variables})
    ds = s.data
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for n_ in deps + allvars:
        if ds.get(n_).is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
        mask &= ds.get(n_).data < SYS
    w, wtype, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("aweight", "fweight"))
    if not mask.any():
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    Y = np.column_stack([ds.get(d_).data[mask] for d_ in deps]).astype(float)
    ww = np.ones(Y.shape[0]) if w is None else w[mask].astype(float)
    if wtype == "aweight":
        ww = ww * len(ww) / ww.sum()
    data = {}
    for n_ in allvars:
        x = ds.get(n_).data[mask].astype(float)
        data[n_] = (x, sorted(set(x.tolist())))
    blocks = [A._term_matrix(t_, data) for t_ in terms]
    sequential = bool(o.get("sequential"))
    one = np.ones((Y.shape[0], 1))
    Xfull = np.column_stack([one] + blocks)
    E, rank = _resid_sscp(Xfull, Y, ww)
    N = float(ww.sum())
    ybar = (ww[:, None] * Y).sum(0) / N
    Yc = Y - ybar
    Ttot = (Yc * ww[:, None]).T @ Yc
    Hm = Ttot - E
    q = len(deps)
    df_m, df_r = rank - 1, N - rank
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\n{'':>23}Number of obs = {int(N):>10}\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>23}W = Wilks' lambda      L = Lawley-Hotelling trace\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>23}P = Pillai's trace     R = Roy's largest root\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Source':>20} | Statistic        df    F(df1,     df2) =   F   Prob>F\n", "text")
    rule = f"{'':>10}{'-' * 11}+{'-' * 55}"
    sep = f"{'':>21}|{'-' * 55}"
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    res = {}
    lam_m = T.eig_ratio(E, Hm)
    res["model"] = (T.mv_statistics(lam_m, q, df_m, df_r), df_m, Hm)
    rows = [("Model", res["model"])]
    prev_E, prev_rank = _resid_sscp(one, Y, ww)
    for k_, t_ in enumerate(terms):
        if sequential:
            Ek, rk = _resid_sscp(np.column_stack([one] + blocks[:k_ + 1]), Y, ww)
            H, dfh = prev_E - Ek, rk - prev_rank
            prev_E, prev_rank = Ek, rk
        else:
            Er, rk = _resid_sscp(np.column_stack([one] + [b for j, b in enumerate(blocks) if j != k_]), Y, ww)
            H, dfh = Er - E, rank - rk
        lam = T.eig_ratio(E, H) if dfh > 0 else np.zeros(0)
        rows.append((t_.name, (T.mv_statistics(lam, q, dfh, df_r) if dfh > 0 else [], dfh, H)))
    index = {id(t_): k_ for k_, t_ in enumerate(terms)}
    groups = _error_groups(segments, index)
    resid = f"{'Residual':>20} |{int(df_r):>20}\n"
    if len(terms) > 1:
        _stat_rows(out, "Model", rows[0][1][0], rows[0][1][1])
        out.write(sep + "\n" + resid + rule + "\n", "text")
    tested = {}
    for members, err in groups:
        for k_ in members:
            label, (_, dfh, H) = rows[k_ + 1]
            if err is None:
                stats = rows[k_ + 1][1][0]
            else:
                He, dfe = rows[err + 1][1][2], rows[err + 1][1][1]
                stats = T.mv_statistics(T.eig_ratio(He, H), q, dfh, dfe) if dfh > 0 and dfe > 0 else []
            tested[k_] = (stats, err)
            _stat_rows(out, label, stats, dfh)
            out.write(sep + "\n", "text")
        if err is None:
            out.write(resid + rule + "\n", "text")
        else:
            _label_df_row(out, terms[err].name, rows[err + 1][1][1])
            out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Total':>20} |{int(N - 1):>20}\n{'':>10}{'-' * 67}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>23}e = exact, a = approximate, u = upper bound on F\n", "text")
    # e() in the order of Stata 14's ereturn list (compat 1929)
    Xo = np.column_stack([_overparam_block(t_, data) for t_ in terms] + [one])
    Xw = Xo * ww[:, None]
    G = np.linalg.pinv(Xo.T @ Xw)
    B = G @ Xw.T @ Y
    fv = _design_fvnames(terms, data)
    bm = matrix(B.T.reshape(1, -1), ["y1"], fv * q)
    bm.coleq = [d_ for d_ in deps for _ in fv]
    Vm = matrix(np.kron(E / df_r, G), fv * q, fv * q)
    Vm.roweq = Vm.coleq = bm.coleq
    mats = [("b", bm), ("V", Vm)]
    for j in range(len(terms), 0, -1):
        stats, err = tested.get(j - 1, (rows[j][1][0], None))
        dfh, H = rows[j][1][1], rows[j][1][2]
        He, dfe = (E, df_r) if err is None else (rows[err + 1][1][2], rows[err + 1][1][1])
        lam = T.eig_ratio(He, H) if dfh > 0 and dfe > 0 else np.zeros(0)
        eig, aux, stat = _test_mats(lam, stats, q, dfh, dfe)
        mats += [(f"eigvals_{j}", eig), (f"aux_{j}", aux), (f"stat_{j}", stat), (f"H_{j}", matrix(H, deps, deps))]
    eig, aux, stat = _test_mats(lam_m, res["model"][0], q, df_m, df_r)
    mats += [("eigvals_m", eig), ("aux_m", aux), ("stat_m", stat), ("H_m", matrix(Hm, deps, deps)),
             ("E", matrix(E, deps, deps)), ("B", matrix(B, fv, deps)), ("xpxinv", matrix(G, fv, fv))]
    mats = [(k_, v_) for k_, v_ in mats if v_ is not None]
    scalars = [("N", N), ("k", float(rank)), ("rank", float(rank * q)), ("df_m", df_m), ("df_r", df_r),
               ("k_eq", float(q))] + [(f"df_{j}", float(rows[j][1][1])) for j in range(1, len(terms) + 1)]
    # the univariate regression of each dependent variable (VERIFY: the number formats)
    rss, tss = np.diag(E), np.diag(Ttot)
    F_ = (tss - rss) / df_m / (rss / df_r)
    pF = [float(T.st.f.sf(f_, df_m, df_r)) for f_ in F_]
    indep = list(dict.fromkeys(n_ for t_ in terms for n_ in t_.variables))
    macros = [("cmdline", "manova " + args.strip()), ("marginsnotok", "stdp Residuals STDDp"),
              ("marginsdefault", " ".join(f"predict(xb equation({d_}))" for d_ in deps)),
              ("p_F", " ".join(f"{x:.4f}" for x in pF)), ("F", " ".join(gnum(x).strip() for x in F_)),
              ("r2", " ".join(f"{1 - r_ / t_:.4f}" for r_, t_ in zip(rss, tss))),
              ("rmse", " ".join(gnum(math.sqrt(r_ / df_r)).strip() for r_ in rss)),
              ("cmd", "manova"), ("predict", "manova_p"), ("estat_cmd", "manova_estat"), ("properties", "b V"),
              ("depvar", " ".join(deps)), ("indepvars", " ".join(indep)), ("wtype", wtype)]
    tm = []
    for j, t_ in enumerate(terms, start=1):
        tm.append((f"term_{j}", t_.name))
        err = tested.get(j - 1, (None, None))[1]
        if err is not None:
            tm.append((f"errorterm_{j}", terms[err].name))
    macros += tm[::-1]
    post_e(s, "manova", scalars, macros, mats, mask, int(N),
           extra={"manova": {"Y": Y, "w": ww, "blocks": blocks, "terms": [t_.name for t_ in terms],
                             "order": _design_order(terms, data),
                             "fvnames": _design_fvnames(terms, data),
                             "Xo": Xo,
                             "ref_blocks": [_reference_block(t_, data) for t_ in terms],
                             "nested": [bool(t_.nest) for t_ in terms],
                             "E": E, "rank": rank, "df_r": df_r, "deps": deps}})


def _error_groups(segments, index) -> list[tuple[list[int], int | None]]:
    """Which terms are tested against which error term ([MV] manova, nested designs): the terms
    of a segment are tested against the first term of the next segment (the residual when the
    next segment is empty, a trailing slash). A term that follows a slash is an error term and is
    tested only when it is itself followed by a slash, that is, when it is alone in its segment
    (VERIFY beyond the manual's two examples). Returns [(term indices, error index or None)]."""
    groups = []
    last = len(segments) - 1
    for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
        ids = [index[id(t_)] for t_ in seg]
        if i == last:
            members = ids if i == 0 else ids[1:]
            err = None
        else:
            members = ids if i == 0 or len(ids) == 1 else ids[1:]
            nxt = segments[i + 1]
            err = index[id(nxt[0])] if nxt else None
        if members:
            groups.append((members, err))
    return groups


def _wrap_label(label: str, width: int = 20) -> list[str]:
    """The lines of a source label: terms joined by spaces while they fit in the column ("a b",
    compat 1917), a term longer than the column broken after a | or # (the manual's
    "associate|store|" + "video"; VERIFY for other shapes)."""
    pieces = []
    for term in label.split() or [""]:
        while len(term) > width:
            cut = max(term.rfind("|", 0, width), term.rfind("#", 0, width))
            if cut <= 0:
                cut = width - 1
            pieces.append((term[:cut + 1], True))
            term = term[cut + 1:]
        pieces.append((term, False))
    lines: list[str] = []
    joinable = False
    for piece, broken in pieces:
        if lines and joinable and len(lines[-1]) + 1 + len(piece) <= width:
            lines[-1] += " " + piece
        else:
            lines.append(piece)
        joinable = not broken
    return lines


def _label_df_row(out, label: str, df: float) -> None:
    pieces = _wrap_label(label)
    out.write(f"{pieces[0]:>20} |{int(df):>20}\n", "text")
    for piece in pieces[1:]:
        out.write(f"{piece:>20} |\n", "text")


def _overparam_block(t_, data: dict) -> np.ndarray:
    """The columns of a term in the overparameterized design (an indicator for every level,
    continuous variables as they are, crossed for interactions), in manovatest, showorder's
    order."""
    mats = []
    for name, cont in list(t_.comps) + [(v, False) for v in t_.nest]:
        x, levels = data[name]
        mats.append(x[:, None] if cont else np.column_stack([(x == lev).astype(float) for lev in levels]))
    out = mats[0]
    for m_ in mats[1:]:
        out = np.einsum("ij,ik->ijk", out, m_).reshape(len(out), -1)
    return out


def _design_fvnames(terms, data: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Factor-variable names of the overparameterized columns, as the test() constraints are
    written: 1.group, 1.a#2.b, x, _cons ([MV] manova postestimation, example 2)."""
    out = []
    for t_ in terms:
        labs = [""]
        for name, cont in list(t_.comps) + [(v, False) for v in t_.nest]:
            parts = [name] if cont else [f"{lev:g}.{name}" for lev in data[name][1]]
            labs = [f"{a}#{b}" if a else b for a in labs for b in parts]
        out += labs
    return out + ["_cons"]


def _design_order(terms, data: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Labels of the columns of the overparameterized design matrix, as manovatest, showorder
    lists them: (a==0), ..., (a==0)*(b==0), ..., _cons (compat 1917; nested terms VERIFY)."""
    out = []
    for t_ in terms:
        labs = [""]
        for name, cont in list(t_.comps) + [(v, False) for v in t_.nest]:
            parts = [name] if cont else [f"({name}=={lev:g})" for lev in data[name][1]]
            labs = [f"{a}*{b}" if a else b for a in labs for b in parts]
        out += labs
    return out + ["_cons"]


def _reference_block(t_, data: dict) -> np.ndarray:
    """The columns of a term in the base-level coding (indicators of every level but the
    first; continuous variables as they are), crossed for interactions."""
    mats = []
    for name, cont in list(t_.comps) + [(v, False) for v in t_.nest]:
        x, levels = data[name]
        mats.append(x[:, None] if cont else np.column_stack([(x == lev).astype(float) for lev in levels[1:]]))
    out = mats[0]
    for m_ in mats[1:]:
        out = np.einsum("ij,ik->ijk", out, m_).reshape(len(out), -1)
    return out


def _manova_terms(text: str, names: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    """Indices of the terms of the last manova named in text (as written in e(term_#))."""
    out = []
    norm = {n_.replace(" ", ""): i for i, n_ in enumerate(names)}
    for w_ in text.split():
        key = w_.replace(" ", "")
        if key not in norm:
            raise StataError(111, f"manova variable {w_} not found")
        out.append(norm[key])
    return out


def _joint_hypothesis(Y, ww, m, idx):
    """SSCP matrix and degrees of freedom of the test of the terms idx: one term is the partial
    test (the model without the term, sum-to-zero coding); several terms drop their columns
    together from the model in the base-level coding, which is what Stata's joint test
    reproduces (compat 1917; VERIFY beyond two main effects next to their interaction)."""
    # nested terms keep their within-cell coding: the base-level coding crosses the nesting
    # variables as if they were factors (the pooled error of [MV] manova postestimation, example 4)
    blocks = m["blocks"] if len(idx) == 1 else [b if nested else r for b, r, nested in
                                                 zip(m["blocks"], m["ref_blocks"], m["nested"])]
    one = np.ones((Y.shape[0], 1))
    E, rank = _resid_sscp(np.column_stack([one] + blocks), Y, ww)
    Er, rk = _resid_sscp(np.column_stack([one] + [b for k, b in enumerate(blocks) if k not in idx]), Y, ww)
    return Er - E, rank - rk


def _test_hypothesis(Y, ww, Xo, C):
    """SSCP matrix and degrees of freedom of the hypothesis C beta = 0 on the overparameterized
    design ([MV] manova, Methods and formulas): H = (CB)'{C (X'X)^- C'}^-1 (CB), B = (X'X)^- X'Y."""
    if C.shape[1] != Xo.shape[1]:
        raise StataError(503, "conformability error")
    Xw = Xo * ww[:, None]
    G = np.linalg.pinv(Xo.T @ Xw)
    B = G @ Xw.T @ Y
    CB = C @ B
    M_ = C @ G @ C.T
    return CB.T @ np.linalg.pinv(M_) @ CB, int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(M_))


def _ytransform_lines(Mt, deps) -> list[str]:
    """The rows of ytransform() written as combinations of the dependent variables (VERIFY for
    coefficients other than 1 and -1)."""
    lines = []
    for row in Mt:
        text = ""
        for c, d in zip(row, deps):
            if c == 0:
                continue
            mag = "" if abs(c) == 1 else f"{abs(c):g}*"
            if not text:
                text = ("-" if c < 0 else "") + mag + d
            else:
                text += (" - " if c < 0 else " + ") + mag + d
        lines.append(text)
    return lines


@command("manovatest", "manovatest")
def cmd_manovatest(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """manovatest term [term ...] [/ term [term ...]] [, ytransform(matname) showorder] after
    manova ([MV] manova postestimation): the multivariate tests of the terms, with the residual
    or the terms after the slash as the error. test() is not available yet."""
    from .matrix import get_matrix
    est = getattr(s, "_estimates", None)
    if est is None or est.cmd != "manova":
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    c = _find_comma(args)
    body, opt = (args, "") if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
    o = match_options(opt, {"ytransform": 2, "test": 4, "showorder": 5}) if opt.strip() else {}
    m = est.extra["manova"]
    out = s.output
    if o.get("showorder"):
        out.write("\n Order of columns in the design matrix\n", "text")
        for i, lab in enumerate(m["order"], start=1):
            out.write(f"{i:>7}: {lab}\n", "text")
        if not body.strip():
            return
    num, _, den = body.partition("/")
    Y, ww = m["Y"], m["w"]
    q = len(m["deps"])
    Cm = None
    if isinstance(o.get("test"), str):
        if body.strip():
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        Cm = get_matrix(s, o["test"].strip()).data
        H, dfh = _test_hypothesis(Y, ww, m["Xo"], Cm)
        num, den = "manovatest", ""
    elif not num.strip():
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    else:
        H, dfh = _joint_hypothesis(Y, ww, m, _manova_terms(num, m["terms"]))
    if den.strip():
        Eh, dfe = _joint_hypothesis(Y, ww, m, _manova_terms(den, m["terms"]))
        elab = " ".join(den.split())
    else:
        Eh, dfe = m["E"], m["df_r"]
        elab = "Residual"
    Mt = None
    if isinstance(o.get("ytransform"), str):
        Mt = get_matrix(s, o["ytransform"].strip()).data
        if Mt.shape[1] != q:
            raise StataError(503, "conformability error")
        H, Eh = Mt @ H @ Mt.T, Mt @ Eh @ Mt.T
        q = Mt.shape[0]
    if dfe < q:
        # an error term with fewer degrees of freedom than dependent variables (compat 1917)
        out.write("matrix not positive definite\n", "text")
        raise StataError(459, "insufficient denominator degrees of freedom")               # VERIFY rc
    if np.linalg.matrix_rank(Eh) < Eh.shape[0]:
        raise StataError(506, "error matrix is singular")                                   # VERIFY
    lam = T.eig_ratio(Eh, H) if dfh > 0 else np.zeros(0)
    stats = T.mv_statistics(lam, q, dfh, dfe) if dfh > 0 else []
    if Mt is not None:
        lines = _ytransform_lines(Mt, m["deps"])
        out.write(f"\n Transformation{'s' if len(lines) > 1 else ''} of the dependent variables\n", "text")
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
            out.write(f" ({i})    {line}\n", "text")
    if Cm is not None:
        lines = _ytransform_lines(Cm, m["fvnames"])
        out.write(f"\n Test constraint{'s' if len(lines) > 1 else ''}\n", "text")
        for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
            out.write(f" ({i})    {line} = 0\n", "text")
    out.write(f"\n{'':>23}W = Wilks' lambda      L = Lawley-Hotelling trace\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>23}P = Pillai's trace     R = Roy's largest root\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Source':>20} | Statistic        df    F(df1,     df2) =   F   Prob>F\n", "text")
    rule = f"{'':>10}{'-' * 11}+{'-' * 55}"
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    _stat_rows(out, " ".join(num.split()), stats, dfh)
    out.write(f"{'':>21}|{'-' * 55}\n", "text")
    _label_df_row(out, elab, dfe)
    out.write(f"{'':>10}{'-' * 67}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>23}e = exact, a = approximate, u = upper bound on F\n", "text")
    # r() as Stata lists it (return list shows the last stored first): df, df_r, then eigvals,
    # aux, stat, E, H; with an error term after the slash aux, stat, H, E, eigvals (compat 1917, 1929)
    eig, aux, stat = _test_mats(lam, stats, q, dfh, dfe)
    if den.strip():
        s.r = {"eigvals": eig, "E": matrix(Eh), "H": matrix(H), "stat": stat, "aux": aux}
    else:
        s.r = {"H": matrix(H), "E": matrix(Eh), "stat": stat, "aux": aux, "eigvals": eig}
    s.r.update({"df_r": float(dfe), "df": float(dfh)})
    s.r = {k_: v_ for k_, v_ in s.r.items() if v_ is not None}


def _find_comma(text: str) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(text):
        if ch == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")":
            depth -= 1
        elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
            return i
    return -1

"""Nonparametric and normality tests: ranksum, signrank, kwallis,
spearman, swilk, sktest and sdtest ([R] ranksum, signrank, kwallis,
spearman, swilk, sktest, sdtest).

Formulas from the manuals (Methods and formulas section). The layouts
were checked against the Stata 14 logs in compat/do/0801_testes.do;
what could not be checked has the VERIFY mark."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import stats as S
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from ._util import touse
from .registry import command
from .summarize import _corr_table, _level, g9, name12, numeric_vars
from .ttest import _ttest_table

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session


def _groups(s: "Session", gname: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    """Distinct values of by() in the sample, with the text (label) of each."""
    from .inspect import cell_text
    g = s.data.get(s.expand_varlist(gname)[0])
    if g.is_string:
        col = np.asarray(g.raw, dtype=object)
        ok = np.array([x != "" for x in col])
    else:
        col = g.data
        ok = col < M.SYSMISS
    mask = mask & ok
    vals = sorted(set(col[mask].tolist()))
    out = []
    for v in vals:
        sel = mask & (col == v)
        out.append((v, cell_text(s.data, g, int(np.flatnonzero(sel)[0])), sel))
    return g, out


def _tie_sum(x: np.ndarray) -> float:
    _, counts = np.unique(x, return_counts=True)
    return float(((counts ** 3) - counts).sum())


def _rank_table(s: "Session", head: str, cols: tuple[str, str, str], rows, total) -> None:
    """ranksum/signrank table: group | obs, rank sum, expected."""
    out = s.output
    # VERIFY: larguras (obs %9.0g, somas %12.0g)
    out.write(f"{name12(head):>12} |{cols[0]:>9}{cols[1]:>12}{cols[2]:>12}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 33 + "\n", "text")
    for name, n, sobs, sexp in rows:
        out.write(f"{name12(str(name)):>12} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{n:>9.0f}{g9(sobs, '%12.0g'):>12}{g9(sexp, '%12.0g'):>12}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 33 + "\n", "text")
    name, n, sobs, sexp = total
    out.write(f"{name:>12} |", "text")
    out.write(f"{n:>9.0f}{g9(sobs, '%12.0g'):>12}{g9(sexp, '%12.0g'):>12}\n", "result")


def _variance_lines(s: "Session", lines: list[tuple[str, float]], total: float) -> None:
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n", "text")
    for label, v in lines:
        if abs(v) < 0.005:
            v = 0.0     # evita "-0.00" (compat 0801)
        out.write(f"{label:<21}", "text")
        out.write(f"{v:>10.2f}\n", "result")
    out.write(" " * 21 + "-" * 10 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'adjusted variance':<21}", "text")
    out.write(f"{total:>10.2f}\n", "result")


def _z_lines(s: "Session", ho: str, z: float, p: float) -> None:
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\n{ho}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'z':>14} = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{z:>7.3f}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'Prob > |z|':>14} = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{p:>8.4f}\n", "result")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ranksum
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("ranksum", "ranksum")
def cmd_ranksum(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "porder": 2, "exact": 2})
    if not isinstance(o.get("by"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option by() required")
    v = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)
    if len(v) != 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    v = v[0]
    mask = touse(s, p) & S.valid(v.data)
    g, groups = _groups(s, o["by"], mask)
    if len(groups) != 2:
        raise StataError(420, f"{len(groups)} groups found, 2 required")   # VERIFY
    sel = groups[0][2] | groups[1][2]
    x = v.data[sel]
    r = st.rankdata(x)
    in1 = groups[0][2][sel]
    n1, n2 = int(in1.sum()), int((~in1).sum())
    N = n1 + n2
    r1, r2 = float(r[in1].sum()), float(r[~in1].sum())
    e1, e2 = n1 * (N + 1) / 2, n2 * (N + 1) / 2
    var_u = n1 * n2 * (N + 1) / 12
    adj = -n1 * n2 * _tie_sum(x) / (12 * N * (N - 1)) if N > 1 else 0.0
    var_a = var_u + adj
    z = (r1 - e1) / math.sqrt(var_a) if var_a > 0 else M.SYSMISS
    pv = 2 * float(st.norm.sf(abs(z))) if z < M.SYSMISS else M.SYSMISS
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nTwo-sample Wilcoxon rank-sum (Mann-Whitney) test\n\n", "text")
    _rank_table(s, g.name, ("obs", "rank sum", "expected"),
                [(groups[0][1], n1, r1, e1), (groups[1][1], n2, r2, e2)],
                ("combined", N, r1 + r2, e1 + e2))
    _variance_lines(s, [("unadjusted variance", var_u), ("adjustment for ties", adj)], var_a)
    ho = f"Ho: {v.name}({g.name}=={groups[0][1]}) = {v.name}({g.name}=={groups[1][1]})"
    _z_lines(s, ho, z, pv)
    porder = (r1 - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n2)
    if o.get("porder"):
        out.write(f"\nP{{{v.name}({g.name}=={groups[0][1]}) > {v.name}({g.name}=={groups[1][1]})}} = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{porder:.3f}\n", "result")
    g1 = float(groups[0][0]) if not isinstance(groups[0][0], str) else groups[0][0]
    # return list order of Stata 14 (compat 0801); porder only with the option
    _set_r(s, ([("porder", porder)] if o.get("porder") else [])
           + [("N_2", float(n2)), ("N_1", float(n1)), ("Var_a", var_a), ("z", z), ("sum_exp", e1),
              ("sum_obs", r1), ("group1", g1)])

@command("signrank", "signrank")
def cmd_signrank(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.exp is None and "==" in p.varlist:
        a, _, b = p.varlist.partition("==")
        p.varlist, p.exp = a.strip(), b.strip()
    if p.exp is None:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    v = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)[0]
    rhs = p.exp.strip()
    mask = touse(s, p) & S.valid(v.data)
    try:
        other = s.data.get(s.expand_varlist(rhs)[0]) if not _is_num(rhs) else None
    except StataError:
        other = None
    if other is not None:
        mask &= S.valid(other.data)
        d = v.data[mask] - other.data[mask]
        rhs_name = other.name
    else:
        val = float(s.eval(rhs))
        d = v.data[mask] - val
        rhs_name = rhs
    n = len(d)
    if n == 0:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    ad = np.abs(d)
    r = st.rankdata(ad)
    pos, neg, zer = d > 0, d < 0, d == 0
    sp, sn, sz = float(r[pos].sum()), float(r[neg].sum()), float(r[zer].sum())
    tot = n * (n + 1) / 2
    e = (tot - sz) / 2
    n0 = int(zer.sum())
    var_u = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) / 24
    ties = -_tie_sum(ad[~zer]) / 48 if (~zer).any() else 0.0
    zeros = -n0 * (n0 + 1) * (2 * n0 + 1) / 24
    var_a = var_u + ties + zeros
    z = (sp - e) / math.sqrt(var_a) if var_a > 0 else M.SYSMISS
    pv = 2 * float(st.norm.sf(abs(z))) if z < M.SYSMISS else M.SYSMISS
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nWilcoxon signed-rank test\n\n", "text")
    _rank_table(s, "sign", ("obs", "sum ranks", "expected"),
                [("positive", int(pos.sum()), sp, e), ("negative", int(neg.sum()), sn, e),
                 ("zero", n0, sz, sz)], ("all", n, tot, tot))
    # VERIFY: order of the adjustment lines (ties, zeros)
    _variance_lines(s, [("unadjusted variance", var_u), ("adjustment for ties", ties),
                        ("adjustment for zeros", zeros)], var_a)
    _z_lines(s, f"Ho: {v.name} = {rhs_name}", z, pv)
    _set_r(s, [("N_tie", float(n0)), ("N_neg", float(neg.sum())), ("N_pos", float(pos.sum())),
               ("Var_a", var_a), ("z", z), ("sum_neg", sn), ("sum_pos", sp)])


def _is_num(t: str) -> bool:
    try:
        float(t)
        return True
    except ValueError:
        return False

@command("kwallis", "kwallis")
def cmd_kwallis(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2})
    if not isinstance(o.get("by"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option by() required")
    v = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)[0]
    mask = touse(s, p) & S.valid(v.data)
    g, groups = _groups(s, o["by"], mask)
    sel = np.zeros_like(mask)
    for _, _, m in groups:
        sel |= m
    x = v.data[sel]
    N = len(x)
    r = st.rankdata(x)
    rows = []
    H = 0.0
    for val, lab, m in groups:
        rk = r[m[sel]]
        rows.append((lab, int(m.sum()), float(rk.sum())))
        H += rk.sum() ** 2 / len(rk)
    H = 12 / (N * (N + 1)) * H - 3 * (N + 1)
    df = len(groups) - 1
    corr = 1 - _tie_sum(x) / (N ** 3 - N)
    Ht = H / corr if corr > 0 else M.SYSMISS
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nKruskal-Wallis equality-of-populations rank test\n\n", "text")
    w0 = max(len(g.name), max(len(str(lab)) for lab, _, _ in rows))
    w1 = max(3, max(len(str(n)) for _, n, _ in rows))
    w2 = max(8, max(len(f"{rs:.2f}") for _, _, rs in rows))
    border = "  +" + "-" * (w0 + w1 + w2 + 8) + "+\n"
    out.write(border, "text")
    out.write(f"  | {g.name:>{w0}} | {'Obs':>{w1}} | {'Rank Sum':>{w2}} |\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  |{'-' * (w0 + 2)}+{'-' * (w1 + 2)}+{'-' * (w2 + 2)}|\n", "text")
    for lab, n, rs in rows:
        out.write(f"  | {str(lab):>{w0}} | {n:>{w1}} | {rs:>{w2}.2f} |\n", "text")
    out.write(border, "text")
    out.write(f"\nchi-squared = {H:>9.3f} with {df} d.f.\n", "text")
    out.write(f"probability = {st.chi2.sf(H, df):>10.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"\nchi-squared with ties = {Ht:>9.3f} with {df} d.f.\n", "text")
    out.write(f"probability = {st.chi2.sf(Ht, df):>10.4f}\n", "text")
    _set_r(s, [("chi2_adj", Ht), ("df", float(df)), ("chi2", H)])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# spearman
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@command("spearman", "spearman")
def cmd_spearman(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"stats": 2, "print": 2, "star": 2, "bonferroni": 1, "sidak": 2,
                                  "pw": 2, "matrix": 3})
    vars_ = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)
    if len(vars_) < 2:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for v in vars_:
        mask &= S.valid(v.data)
    n = int(mask.sum())
    if n < 2:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    R = np.column_stack([st.rankdata(v.data[mask]) for v in vars_])
    rho = np.corrcoef(R, rowvar=False)
    out = s.output

    def pval(r: float) -> float:
        if abs(r) >= 1:
            return 0.0
        t = r * math.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r * r))
        return float(2 * st.t.sf(abs(t), n - 2))

    if len(vars_) == 2 and not o.get("matrix"):
        r = float(rho[0, 1])
        pv = pval(r)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        # compat 0801: labels in 14 columns, values in %8.0f and %12.4f
        out.write(f"{'Number of obs':>14} = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{n:>7}\n", "result")
        out.write("Spearman's rho = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{r:>12.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"\nTest of Ho: {vars_[0].name} and {vars_[1].name} are independent\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Prob > |t|':>14} = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{pv:>12.4f}\n", "result")
        _set_r(s, [("N", float(n)), ("rho", r), ("p", pv)])
        return
    out.write(f"(obs={n:,})\n", "text")
    names = [v.name for v in vars_]
    k = len(names)
    cells = [[f"{rho[i, j]:.4f}" for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)]
    extra = None
    if o.get("stats") or o.get("print"):
        extra = [[[f"{pval(rho[i, j]):.4f}" if i != j else "" for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)]]
    _corr_table(s, names, cells, extra=extra)
    from .matrix import Matrix
    s.r = {"N": float(n), "Rho": Matrix(rho.copy(), names, names)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# swilk e sktest
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _swilk_stats(x: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
    """W (algorithm AS R94, the same as Stata's), V, z and Prob>z (Royston 1992)."""
    return _royston(float(st.shapiro(x).statistic), len(x))


def _royston(W: float, n: int) -> tuple[float, float, float, float]:
    ln = math.log(n)
    if n >= 12:
        mu = 0.0038915 * ln ** 3 - 0.083751 * ln ** 2 - 0.31082 * ln - 1.5861
        sigma = math.exp(0.0030302 * ln ** 2 - 0.082676 * ln - 0.4803)
        y = math.log(1 - W) if W < 1 else -math.inf
        V = (1 - W) / math.exp(mu)
    else:
        gamma = 0.459 * n - 2.273
        mu = 0.544 - 0.39978 * n + 0.025054 * n ** 2 - 0.0006714 * n ** 3
        sigma = math.exp(1.3822 - 0.77857 * n + 0.062767 * n ** 2 - 0.0020322 * n ** 3)
        y = -math.log(gamma - math.log(1 - W)) if W < 1 else -math.inf
        V = (1 - W) / math.exp(mu)   # VERIFY: V for n < 12
    z = (y - mu) / sigma
    return W, V, z, float(st.norm.sf(z))


@command("swilk", "swilk")
def cmd_swilk(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    match_options(p.options, {"generate": 1, "lnnormal": 2, "noties": 5})
    vars_ = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)
    base = touse(s, p)
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n" + " " * 19 + "Shapiro-Wilk W test for normal data\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"    Variable |{'Obs':>11}{'W':>8}{'V':>12}{'z':>10}{'Prob>z':>13}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 54 + "\n", "text")
    for v in vars_:
        x = v.data[base & S.valid(v.data)]
        n = len(x)
        if n < 4:
            raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
        W, V, z, pz = _swilk_stats(x)
        out.write(f"{name12(v.name):>12} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{n:>11}{W:>11.5f}{V:>11.3f}{z:>10.3f}{pz:>11.5f}\n", "result")
        _set_r(s, [("p", pz), ("z", z), ("V", V), ("W", W), ("N", float(n))])


def _sk_z(x: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """z statistics for skewness (D'Agostino 1970) and kurtosis (Anscombe and
    Glynn 1983), as in [R] sktest."""
    n = len(x)
    d = x - x.mean()
    m2, m3, m4 = (d ** 2).mean(), (d ** 3).mean(), (d ** 4).mean()
    b1 = m3 / m2 ** 1.5
    b2 = m4 / m2 ** 2
    Y = b1 * math.sqrt((n + 1) * (n + 3) / (6 * (n - 2)))
    beta2 = 3 * (n * n + 27 * n - 70) * (n + 1) * (n + 3) / ((n - 2) * (n + 5) * (n + 7) * (n + 9))
    W2 = -1 + math.sqrt(2 * (beta2 - 1))
    delta = 1 / math.sqrt(math.log(math.sqrt(W2)))
    alpha = math.sqrt(2 / (W2 - 1))
    z1 = delta * math.log(Y / alpha + math.sqrt((Y / alpha) ** 2 + 1))
    E = 3 * (n - 1) / (n + 1)
    var = 24 * n * (n - 2) * (n - 3) / ((n + 1) ** 2 * (n + 3) * (n + 5))
    xk = (b2 - E) / math.sqrt(var)
    sb1 = 6 * (n * n - 5 * n + 2) / ((n + 7) * (n + 9)) * math.sqrt(6 * (n + 3) * (n + 5) / (n * (n - 2) * (n - 3)))
    A = 6 + 8 / sb1 * (2 / sb1 + math.sqrt(1 + 4 / sb1 ** 2))
    t = (1 - 2 / A) / (1 + xk * math.sqrt(2 / (A - 4)))
    z2 = ((1 - 2 / (9 * A)) - math.copysign(abs(t) ** (1 / 3), t)) / math.sqrt(2 / (9 * A))
    return z1, z2


@command("sktest", "sktest")
def cmd_sktest(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"noadjust": 5})
    vars_ = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)
    base = touse(s, p)
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n" + " " * 20 + "Skewness/Kurtosis tests for Normality\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 58 + "------ joint ------\n", "text")
    lab = "chi2(2)" if o.get("noadjust") else "adj chi2(2)"
    out.write(f"    Variable |{'Obs':>11}  Pr(Skewness)  Pr(Kurtosis){lab:>12}   Prob>chi2\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 63 + "\n", "text")
    for v in vars_:
        x = v.data[base & S.valid(v.data)]
        n = len(x)
        if n < 8:
            raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
        z1, z2 = _sk_z(x)
        ps, pk = 2 * float(st.norm.sf(abs(z1))), 2 * float(st.norm.sf(abs(z2)))
        K2 = z1 * z1 + z2 * z2
        if o.get("noadjust"):
            pj = float(st.chi2.sf(K2, 2))
        else:
            K2, pj = _royston_adjust(K2, n)
        out.write(f"{name12(v.name):>12} |", "text")
        k2t = "." if not math.isfinite(K2) else f"{K2:.2f}"
        out.write(f"{n:>11}{ps:>11.4f}{pk:>14.4f}{k2t:>12}{pj:>15.4f}\n", "result")
        s.r = {"P_chi2": pj, "chi2": K2, "P_kurt": pk, "P_skew": ps, "N": float(n)}

def _set_r(s: "Session", pairs: list) -> None:
    """r() in the order Stata lists it (return list shows the reverse
    of the order in which results were stored)."""
    s.r = dict(reversed(pairs))


def _royston_adjust(K2: float, n: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Royston (1991c) correction of D'Agostino's K² ([R] sktest, Methods
    and formulas). Returns (adj chi2, P)."""
    e = math.exp(-0.5 * K2)
    if e < 1e-100:      # VERIFY: Stata shows both the statistic and P as missing for huge K2 (limit unknown)
        return math.nan, math.nan
    Zc = -float(st.norm.ppf(e))
    ln = math.log(n)
    Zt = 0.55 * n ** 0.2 - 0.21
    a1 = (-5 + 3.46 * ln) * math.exp(-1.37 * ln)
    b1 = 1 + (0.854 - 0.148 * ln) * math.exp(-0.55 * ln)
    a2 = a1 - (2.13 / (1 - 2.37 * ln)) * Zt
    b2 = 2.13 / (1 - 2.37 * ln) + b1
    Z = Zc if Zc < -1 else (a1 + b1 * Zc if Zc < Zt else a2 + b2 * Zc)
    P = float(1.0 - st.norm.cdf(Z))    # VERIFY: 1-normal(Z) loses the tail below 1e-16, as in Stata
    return (-2 * math.log(P) if P > 0 else math.inf), P


def _ha3(s: "Session", has: list[str], probs: list[str]) -> None:
    """Ha/Pr lines of sdtest (compat 0801): Pr in columns 2, 29 and 60; each
    Ha centered at 10.5, 39.5 and 69.5 (rounded down)."""
    starts = [2, 29, 60]
    centers = [10.5, 39.5, 69.5]
    line_p = [" "] * 90
    line_h = [" "] * 90
    for st_, c, pr, ha in zip(starts, centers, probs, has):
        for k, ch in enumerate(pr):
            line_p[st_ + k] = ch
        hs = int(math.floor(c - len(ha) / 2))
        for k, ch in enumerate(ha):
            line_h[hs + k] = ch
    s.output.write("\n" + "".join(line_h).rstrip() + "\n", "text")
    s.output.write("".join(line_p).rstrip() + "\n", "result")


def _row(name, x):
    n = len(x)
    m = S.moments(x)
    se = m.sd / math.sqrt(n) if n > 1 else M.SYSMISS
    lo, hi = S.t_ci(m.mean, se, n - 1, 95.0) if n > 1 else (M.SYSMISS, M.SYSMISS)
    return [name, n, m.mean, se, m.sd, lo, hi]


@command("sdtest", "sdtest")
def cmd_sdtest(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "level": 1})
    level = _level(s, o)
    if p.exp is None and "==" in p.varlist:
        a, _, b = p.varlist.partition("==")
        p.varlist, p.exp = a.strip(), b.strip()
    v = numeric_vars(s, p.varlist, allow_string=False)[0]
    mask = touse(s, p) & S.valid(v.data)

    def row(name, x):
        r = _row(name, x)
        if r[1] > 1:
            r[5], r[6] = S.t_ci(r[2], r[3], r[1] - 1, level)
        return tuple(r)

    out = s.output
    if isinstance(o.get("by"), str):
        g, groups = _groups(s, o["by"], mask)
        if len(groups) != 2:
            raise StataError(420, f"{len(groups)} groups found, 2 required")   # VERIFY
        x1, x2 = v.data[groups[0][2]], v.data[groups[1][2]]
        allx = np.concatenate([x1, x2])
        _ttest_table(s, [row(groups[0][1], x1), row(groups[1][1], x2)], level, title="Variance ratio test",
                     foot_rows=[row("combined", allx)], head="Group")
        sd1, sd2 = S.moments(x1).sd, S.moments(x2).sd
        f = sd1 ** 2 / sd2 ** 2
        df1, df2 = len(x1) - 1, len(x2) - 1
        out.write(f"    ratio = sd({groups[0][1]}) / sd({groups[1][1]})".ljust(66) + f"f = {f:>8.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write("Ho: ratio = 1".ljust(49) + "degrees of freedom = " + f"{df1}, {df2}".rjust(8) + "\n", "text")
        lo = float(st.f.cdf(f, df1, df2))
        up = float(st.f.sf(f, df1, df2))
        two = 2 * min(lo, up)
        mid = f"2*Pr(F < f) = {two:.4f}" if lo < up else f"2*Pr(F > f) = {two:.4f}"
        _ha3(s, ["Ha: ratio < 1", "Ha: ratio != 1", "Ha: ratio > 1"],
             [f"Pr(F < f) = {lo:.4f}", mid, f"Pr(F > f) = {up:.4f}"])
        _set_r(s, [("sd", S.moments(allx).sd), ("p", two), ("p_l", lo), ("p_u", up), ("sd_2", sd2),
                   ("sd_1", sd1), ("F", f), ("df_2", float(df2)), ("df_1", float(df1)),
                   ("N", float(len(allx)))])
        return
    if p.exp is None:
        raise StataError(198, "option by() required")   # VERIFY
    rhs = p.exp.strip()
    x = v.data[mask]
    if not _is_num(rhs):
        other = s.data.get(s.expand_varlist(rhs)[0])
        m2 = mask & S.valid(other.data)
        x1, x2 = v.data[m2], other.data[m2]
        allx = np.concatenate([x1, x2])
        _ttest_table(s, [row(v.name, x1), row(other.name, x2)], level, title="Variance ratio test",
                     foot_rows=[row("combined", allx)])
        sd1, sd2 = S.moments(x1).sd, S.moments(x2).sd
        f = sd1 ** 2 / sd2 ** 2
        df1 = df2 = len(x1) - 1
        out.write(f"    ratio = sd({v.name}) / sd({other.name})".ljust(66) + f"f = {f:>8.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write("Ho: ratio = 1".ljust(49) + "degrees of freedom = " + f"{df1}, {df2}".rjust(8) + "\n", "text")
        lo, up = float(st.f.cdf(f, df1, df2)), float(st.f.sf(f, df1, df2))
        two = 2 * min(lo, up)
        mid = f"2*Pr(F < f) = {two:.4f}" if lo < up else f"2*Pr(F > f) = {two:.4f}"
        _ha3(s, ["Ha: ratio < 1", "Ha: ratio != 1", "Ha: ratio > 1"],
             [f"Pr(F < f) = {lo:.4f}", mid, f"Pr(F > f) = {up:.4f}"])
        s.r = {"p": two, "p_u": up, "p_l": lo, "F": f, "df_2": float(df2), "df_1": float(df1),
               "sd_2": sd2, "sd_1": sd1, "N_2": float(len(x2)), "N_1": float(len(x1))}
        return
    sd0 = float(s.eval(rhs))
    n = len(x)
    _ttest_table(s, [row(v.name, x)], level, title="One-sample test of variance")
    sd = S.moments(x).sd
    c = (n - 1) * sd ** 2 / sd0 ** 2
    num = format(sd0, "g")
    out.write(f"    sd = sd({v.name})".ljust(59) + f"c = chi2 = {c:>8.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"Ho: sd = {num}".ljust(49) + f"degrees of freedom = {n - 1:>8}\n", "text")
    lo, up = float(st.chi2.cdf(c, n - 1)), float(st.chi2.sf(c, n - 1))
    two = 2 * min(lo, up)
    mid = f"2*Pr(C < c) = {two:.4f}" if lo < up else f"2*Pr(C > c) = {two:.4f}"
    _ha3(s, [f"Ha: sd < {num}", f"Ha: sd != {num}", f"Ha: sd > {num}"],
         [f"Pr(C < c) = {lo:.4f}", mid, f"Pr(C > c) = {up:.4f}"])
    s.r = {"p": two, "p_u": up, "p_l": lo, "chi2": c, "df": float(n - 1), "sd": sd, "N": float(n)}

def _combos(base: dict, parallel: bool):
    keys = list(base)
    lists = [base[k] for k in keys]
    if parallel:
        lens = {len(v) for v in lists if len(v) > 1}
        if len(lens) > 1:
            _fail("parallel requires lists of the same length")        # VERIFY
        L = max(lens) if lens else 1
        rows = zip(*[v * L if len(v) == 1 else v for v in lists])
    else:
        rows = itertools.product(*lists)
    return [dict(zip(keys, r)) for r in rows], any(len(v) > 1 for v in lists)

def _parse(s: "Session", args: str):
    text = args.strip()

    parts = head.split(None, 1)

    opts = {n.lower(): a for n, a in parse_options(opts_text)} if opts_text.strip() else {}
    for k in opts:
        if k not in ("i", "j", "string", "atwl"):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {k} not allowed")

def _advanced(s: "Session", sub: str, args: str) -> None:

    elif full == "j":
        if not body:
            raise StataError(100, "varname required")
        for k in opts:
            if k != "string":
                raise StataError(198, f"option {k} not allowed")
        state["j"] = body
        state["string"] = "string" in opts
    elif full == "xij":
        if not body:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        state["stubs"] = split_words(body)
    else:                                        # xi: documentation only
        state["xi"] = body
    s._reshape = state


def _query(s: "Session") -> None:
    """reshape and reshape query: the current definitions in Stata's box (compat 0805; VERIFY
    the rows when j has a range or xi is defined)."""
    st_ = getattr(s, "_reshape", None) or {}
    w = s.output.write
    ds = s.data
    stubs = st_.get("stubs") or []
    if stubs and all(ds.has(x) for x in stubs):
        form = "long"
    elif stubs and any(v.name.startswith(x) and v.name != x for x in stubs for v in ds.vars):
        form = "wide"
    else:
        form = ""
    if form:
        w(f" (data are {form})\n", "text")
    j = st_.get("j") or ""
    if j and st_.get("string"):
        j += ", string"

    def cmd(name, val, empty):
        return f"reshape {name} {val}" if val else f"reshape {name}  {empty}"   # VERIFY undefined rows
    rows = [("Xij", "Command/contents"), None, ("Subscript i,j definitions:", ""),
            (" group id variable(s)", cmd("i", st_.get("i") or "", "<varlist>")),
            (" within-group variable", cmd("j", j, "<varname>")),
            ("  and its range", ""), ("", ""), ("Variable X definitions:", ""),
            (" varying within group", cmd("xij", " ".join(stubs), "<stubnames>")),
            (" constant within group (opt)", cmd("xi", st_.get("xi") or "", "<varlist>"))]
    w("\n+" + "-" * 77 + "+\n", "text")
    for r in rows:
        if r is None:
            w("|" + "-" * 30 + "+" + "-" * 46 + "|\n", "text")
        else:
            w(f"| {r[0]:<29}| {r[1]:<45}|\n", "text")
    w("+" + "-" * 77 + "+\n", "text")
    if not st_.get("xi"):
        w("Optionally type reshape xi to define variables that are constant within i.\n", "text")
    if form:
        to = "long" if form == "wide" else "wide"
        w(f"Type reshape {to} to convert the data to {to} form.\n", "text")


def _error_report(s: "Session") -> None:
    """reshape error: lists the observations that made the last reshape fail (VERIFY: the
    wording of the summary lines)."""
    f = getattr(s, "_reshape_failed", None)
    w = s.output.write
    if not f:
        w("(no reshape error to report)\n", "text")
        return
    ds = s.data
    ivars, jname = f["ivars"], f["jname"]
    ilist = " ".join(ivars)
    if f["to"] == "long":
        sorting.sort(ds, ivars)
        ids, k = group_ids(ds, ivars)
        bad = np.bincount(ids, minlength=k)[ids] > 1
        w(f"(data now sorted by {ilist})\n", "text")
        _list(s, bad, ivars)
        w(f"\n{int(bad.sum())} of {ds.nobs} observations have duplicate {ilist} values\n", "text")
        return
    keys = ivars + [jname]
    sorting.sort(ds, keys)
    ids, k = group_ids(ds, keys)
    counts = np.bincount(ids, minlength=k)
    bad = counts[ids] > 1
    if bad.any():
        # Stata's explanation, the list, then the sort note (compat 0805)
        jcol = ds.get(jname)
        jv = sorted(set(jcol.raw)) if jcol.is_string else sorted(set(jcol.data.tolist()))
        w(f"(note: j = {' '.join(_jtext(x) for x in jv)})\n\n", "text")
        w(f"i ({ilist}) indicates the top-level grouping such as subject id.\n", "text")
        w(f"j ({jname}) indicates the subgrouping such as time.\n", "text")
        w("The data are in the long form;  j should be unique within i.\n\n", "text")
        w(f"There are multiple observations on the same {jname} within {ilist}.\n\n", "text")
        w(f"The following {int(bad.sum())} of {ds.nobs} observations have repeated {jname} values:\n", "text")
        _list(s, bad, keys)
        w(f"\n(data now sorted by {' '.join(keys)})\n", "text")
        return
    w(f"(data now sorted by {' '.join(keys)})\n", "text")
    longs = [_long_name(st_) for st_ in f["stubs"]]
    gid, _g = group_ids(ds, ivars)
    from ..core.grouping import first_index
    first = first_index(gid, _g)
    for v in ds.vars:
        if v.name in keys or v.name in longs:
            continue
        col = v.raw
        same = np.array([col[i] == col[first[gid[i]]] for i in range(ds.nobs)], dtype=bool)
        groups_bad = np.zeros(_g, dtype=bool)
        groups_bad[gid[~same]] = True
        if groups_bad.any():
            sel = groups_bad[gid]
            _list(s, sel, keys + [v.name])
            w(f"\n{int(sel.sum())} of {ds.nobs} observations have {v.name} not constant within "
              f"{ilist}\n", "text")
            return
    w(f"\n{ilist} and {jname} uniquely identify the observations\n", "text")


def _list(s: "Session", sel: np.ndarray, names: list[str]) -> None:
    if not sel.any():
        return
    ds = s.data
    tmp = "__000rse"
    ds.add(Variable(tmp, "byte", sel.astype(np.float64)))
    try:
        s.interp._execute_expanded(f"list {' '.join(names)} if {tmp}, sepby({names[0]})")
    finally:
        ds.drop_vars([tmp])


def _to_long(s: "Session", stubs: list[str], ivars: list[str], jname: str,
             jvals_spec: str, string: bool) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    if ds.has(jname):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {jname} already defined")
    check_name(jname)
    # values of j and variables of each stub
    found: dict[str, dict] = {}
    all_j: set = set()
    for stub in stubs:
        rx = _stub_regex(stub, string)
        found[stub] = {}
        for name in ds.names:
            m = rx.match(name)
            if m and name not in ivars:
                key = m.group(1) if string else int(m.group(1))
                found[stub][key] = name
        all_j.update(found[stub])
    if jvals_spec:
        jvals = split_words(jvals_spec) if string else [int(x) for x in parse_numlist(jvals_spec)]
    else:
        jvals = sorted(all_j)
    if not jvals:
        raise StataError(111, "no xij variables found")    # VERIFY
    if not string:
        bad = [x for x in jvals if x != int(x)]
        if bad:
            raise StataError(198, "j values must be integers")   # VERIFY
    # i must identify the observations
    s.output.write(f"(note: j = {' '.join(_jtext(x) for x in jvals)})\n", "text")
    for stub in stubs:
        for x in jvals:
            if x not in found[stub]:
                s.output.write(f"(note: {_wide_name(stub, _jtext(x))} not found)\n", "text")
    # i must identify the observations (text observed in Stata 14)
    ids, k = group_ids(ds, ivars)
    if k != ds.nobs:
        il = " ".join(ivars)
        word = "variable" if len(ivars) == 1 else "variables"
        verb = "does" if len(ivars) == 1 else "do"
        raise StataError(9, _explain(s, f"{word} {il} {verb} not uniquely identify the observations", [
            f"Your data are currently wide.  You are performing a reshape long.  You specified i({il}) "
            f"and j({jname}).  In the current wide form, {word} {il} should uniquely identify the "
            "observations.  Remember this picture:",
            "@" + _PICTURE,
            "Type reshape error for a list of the problem observations."]))
    xij_names = {nm for st in stubs for x, nm in found[st].items() if x in set(jvals)}
    for stub in stubs:
        ln = _long_name(stub)
        if ds.has(ln) and ln not in xij_names:
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {ln} already defined")   # VERIFY
    n0, k0 = ds.nobs, ds.nvars
    nj = len(jvals)
    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(n0), nj)
    jidx = np.tile(np.arange(nj), n0)
    new = Dataset()
    new.label, new.notes, new.value_labels = ds.label, list(ds.notes), ds.value_labels
    new.nobs = n0 * nj
    for nm in ivars:
        v = ds.get(nm)
        nv = Variable(nm, v.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=v.fmt, label=v.label, value_label=v.value_label)
        nv.raw = v.raw[rows]
        new.vars.append(nv)
    if string:
        jtype = str_type_for(max((str_len(x) for x in jvals), default=1) or 1)
        jv = Variable(jname, jtype, np.array([jvals[t] for t in jidx], dtype=object))
    else:
        jarr = np.array(jvals, dtype=np.float64)[jidx]
        # smallest type, but %9.0g format (byte %9.0g; observed in Stata 14)
        jv = Variable(jname, smallest_type_for(np.array(jvals, dtype=np.float64)), jarr, fmt="%9.0g")
    long_vars: dict[str, Variable] = {}
    last_of: dict[str, str] = {}             # rightmost wide variable of each stub
    table_rows = []
    for stub in stubs:
        names = [found[stub].get(x) for x in jvals]
        present = [ds.get(nm) for nm in names if nm]
        if not present:
            raise StataError(111, f"no xij variables found for {stub}")   # VERIFY
        if len({v.is_string for v in present}) > 1:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")   # VERIFY
        vtype = present[0].vtype
        for v in present[1:]:
            vtype = common_type(vtype, v.vtype)
        is_str = present[0].is_string
        cols = []
        for nm in names:
            src = ds.get(nm) if nm else None
            if is_str:
                cols.append(np.array(src.raw if src else [""] * n0, dtype=object))
            elif src is not None and src.vtype == vtype:
                cols.append(src.raw)
            else:
                cols.append(Variable("_t", vtype, src.data if src else np.full(n0, M.SYSMISS)).raw)
        nv = Variable(_long_name(stub), vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=present[0].fmt,
                      value_label=present[0].value_label)
        # linha a linha: (obs 1, j1), (obs 1, j2), ..., (obs 2, j1), ...
        nv.raw = np.stack(cols, axis=1).reshape(-1).copy()
        long_vars[stub] = nv
        last_of[max((nm for nm in names if nm), key=ds.index)] = stub
        table_rows.append((" ".join(nm for nm in names if nm), _long_name(stub)))
    new.vars.append(jv)
    # each long variable takes the place of the last wide variable of its stub; the others keep
    # their order (observed in Stata 14)
    for v in ds.vars:
        if v.name in ivars:
            continue
        if v.name in xij_names:
            if v.name in last_of:
                new.vars.append(long_vars[last_of[v.name]])
            continue
        nv = Variable(v.name, v.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=v.fmt, label=v.label, value_label=v.value_label)
        nv.raw = v.raw[rows]
        new.vars.append(nv)
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    sorting.sort(new, ivars + [jname])
    _table(s, "wide", "long", n0, new.nobs, k0, new.nvars, jname, nj, table_rows)


def _to_wide(s: "Session", stubs: list[str], ivars: list[str], jname: str,
             jvals_spec: str, string: bool) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    jvar = ds.get(jname)
    if jvar.is_string != string:
        if jvar.is_string:
            raise StataError(109, f"variable {jname} is string; specify string option")   # VERIFY
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    for stub in stubs:
        ds.get(_long_name(stub))
    longs = [_long_name(st) for st in stubs]
    n0, k0 = ds.nobs, ds.nvars
    if string:
        jcol = np.array(jvar.raw, dtype=object)
        jvals = split_words(jvals_spec) if jvals_spec else sorted(set(jcol))
    else:
        jcol = np.asarray(jvar.data, dtype=np.float64)
        if (jcol >= M.SYSMISS).any():
            raise StataError(498, f"variable {jname} contains missing values")   # VERIFY
        jvals = [float(x) for x in parse_numlist(jvals_spec)] if jvals_spec else sorted(set(jcol.tolist()))
    jtexts = [_jtext(x) for x in jvals]
    s.output.write(f"(note: j = {' '.join(jtexts)})\n", "text")
    ids, k = group_ids(ds, ivars)
    # (i, j) unique
    pair_ids, kp = group_ids(ds, ivars + [jname])
    ilist = " ".join(ivars)
    if kp != n0:
        raise StataError(9, _explain(s, f"values of variable {jname} not unique within {ilist}", [
            f"Your data are currently long.  You are performing a reshape wide.  You specified "
            f"i({ilist}) and j({jname}).  There are observations within i({ilist}) with the same "
            f"value of j({jname}).  In the long data, variables i() and j() together must uniquely "
            "identify the observations.",
            "@" + _PICTURE,
            "Type reshape error for a list of the problem variables."]))   # compat 0805
    others = [v for v in ds.vars if v.name not in ivars and v.name != jname and v.name not in longs]
    from ..core.grouping import first_index
    first = first_index(ids, k)
    for v in others:
        col = v.raw
        if v.is_string:
            same = all(col[i] == col[first[ids[i]]] for i in range(n0))
        else:
            same = bool(np.all(col == col[first[ids]]))
        if not same:
            raise StataError(9, _explain(s, f"variable {v.name} not constant within {ilist}", [
                "Your data are currently long.  You are performing a reshape wide.  You typed "
                "something like",
                "",
                f"@        . reshape wide a b, i({ilist}) j({jname})",
                "",
                f"There are variables other than a, b, {ilist}, {jname} in your data.  They must be "
                f"constant within {ilist} because that is the only way they can fit into wide data "
                "without loss of information.",
                "",
                f"The variable or variables listed above are not constant within {ilist}.  Perhaps "
                "the values are in error.  Type reshape error for a list of the problem "
                "observations.",
                "",
                "Either that, or the values vary because they should vary, in which case you must "
                "either add the variables to the list of xij variables to be reshaped, or drop "
                "them."]))
    pos = {x: t for t, x in enumerate(jvals)}
    jpos = np.array([pos.get(x, -1) for x in (jcol.tolist())], dtype=np.int64)
    if (jpos < 0).any():
        keep = jpos >= 0   # values of j outside the given list are discarded (VERIFY)
    else:
        keep = np.ones(n0, dtype=bool)
    new = Dataset()
    new.label, new.notes, new.value_labels = ds.label, list(ds.notes), ds.value_labels
    new.nobs = k
    for nm in ivars:
        v = ds.get(nm)
        nv = Variable(nm, v.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=v.fmt, label=v.label, value_label=v.value_label)
        nv.raw = v.raw[first].copy()
        new.vars.append(nv)
    table_rows = []
    wide_vars: dict[tuple[int, str], Variable] = {}
    for stub, ln in zip(stubs, longs):
        src = ds.get(ln)
        names = []
        for t, jt in enumerate(jtexts):
            wn = _wide_name(stub, jt)
            check_name(wn)
            if wn in ivars or any(v.name == wn for v in others):
                raise StataError(110, f"variable {wn} already defined")
            if src.is_string:
                vals = np.array([""] * k, dtype=object)
            else:
                vals = Variable("_t", src.vtype, np.full(k, M.SYSMISS)).raw.copy()
            sel = keep & (jpos == t)
            vals[ids[sel]] = src.raw[sel]
            # label "80 inc" (value of j and name of the long variable; Stata 14)
            nv = Variable(wn, src.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=src.fmt, value_label=src.value_label,
                          label=f"{jt} {src.label or ln}")
            nv.raw = vals
            wide_vars[(t, stub)] = nv
            names.append(wn)
        table_rows.append((ln, " ".join(names)))
    # VERIFY: ordem intercalada por j (inc80 ue80 inc81 ue81 ...)
    for t in range(len(jtexts)):
        for stub in stubs:
            new.vars.append(wide_vars[(t, stub)])
    for v in others:
        nv = Variable(v.name, v.vtype, np.empty(0), fmt=v.fmt, label=v.label, value_label=v.value_label)
        nv.raw = v.raw[first].copy()
        new.vars.append(nv)
    new.changed = True
    s.data = new
    new.sortlist = list(ivars)
    _table(s, "long", "wide", n0, k, k0, new.nvars, jname, len(jvals), table_rows)

"""Receiver operating characteristic analysis ([R] roc, [R] rocfit, [R] lroc,
[R] lsens): roctab (nonparametric ROC curve of one classifier), roccomp
(comparison of the areas of several classifiers), rocfit (binormal model fit by
maximum likelihood), and lroc/lsens after logit, logistic or probit.

The area is the Mann-Whitney statistic; its standard error is DeLong, DeLong and
Clarke-Pearson's (1988) by default, or Hanley and McNeil's (1982). roccomp tests
the equality of areas with DeLong's covariance (correlated classifiers) or with
independent variances (by()). Layout details are marked VERIFY and checked in
compat/do/1402_kappa_roc.do."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import roc as R
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from ._util import touse
from .epitab import _set_r, _strata
from .registry import command
from .summarize import _level, name12, weights

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

NAN = float("nan")
SYS = M.SYSMISS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# area and its variance
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def placements(pos: np.ndarray, neg: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """V10 (one per positive) and V01 (one per negative): the share of the other group a
    score beats, ties counting one half."""
    ns = np.sort(neg)
    ps = np.sort(pos)
    v10 = (np.searchsorted(ns, pos, "left") + np.searchsorted(ns, pos, "right")) / (2 * len(neg))
    v01 = 1 - (np.searchsorted(ps, neg, "left") + np.searchsorted(ps, neg, "right")) / (2 * len(pos))
    return v10, v01


def auc_delong(pos: np.ndarray, neg: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    v10, v01 = placements(pos, neg)
    a = float(v10.mean())
    m, n = len(pos), len(neg)
    var = (v10.var(ddof=1) if m > 1 else 0.0) / m + (v01.var(ddof=1) if n > 1 else 0.0) / n
    return a, math.sqrt(var)


def se_hanley(a: float, m: int, n: int) -> float:
    q1, q2 = a / (2 - a), 2 * a * a / (1 + a)
    var = (a * (1 - a) + (m - 1) * (q1 - a * a) + (n - 1) * (q2 - a * a)) / (m * n)
    return math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))


def delong_cov(pos_list, neg_list) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Areas and DeLong covariance matrix of classifiers scored on the same subjects."""
    V10 = []
    V01 = []
    for pos, neg in zip(pos_list, neg_list):
        v10, v01 = placements(pos, neg)
        V10.append(v10)
        V01.append(v01)
    V10, V01 = np.array(V10), np.array(V01)
    m, n = V10.shape[1], V01.shape[1]
    areas = V10.mean(1)
    S = np.cov(V10) / m + np.cov(V01) / n
    return areas, np.atleast_2d(S)


def roc_points(pos: np.ndarray, neg: np.ndarray):
    """Cutpoints (each distinct score, classified + if score >= cutpoint) with sensitivity
    and specificity, plus the final 'greater than the maximum' row."""
    cuts = np.unique(np.concatenate([pos, neg]))
    rows = []
    for c in cuts:
        rows.append((c, float((pos >= c).mean()), float((neg < c).mean()), ">="))
    rows.append((cuts[-1], 0.0, 1.0, ">"))
    return rows


def _expand(x: np.ndarray, w: np.ndarray | None) -> np.ndarray:
    return x if w is None else np.repeat(x, w.astype(int))


def _ci(a: float, se: float, level: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
    z = float(st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - level / 100) / 2))
    return a - z * se, a + z * se


def _f(x, spec) -> str:
    return "." if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and math.isnan(x)) else format(x, spec)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# roctab
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _pos_neg(s: "Session", p, ref: str, cls: list[str], extra_mask=None):
    ds = s.data
    rv = ds.get(s.expand_varlist(ref)[0])
    cv = [ds.get(s.expand_varlist(c)[0]) for c in cls]
    mask = touse(s, p) & (rv.data < SYS)
    for c in cv:
        if c.is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
        mask &= c.data < SYS
    if extra_mask is not None:
        mask &= extra_mask
    w, _, mask = weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight",))
    vals = set(rv.data[mask].tolist())
    if not vals <= {0.0, 1.0}:
        # Stata: the reference variable must be 0/1 (VERIFY: rc and message)
        raise StataError(450, f"{rv.name} not a 0/1 variable")
    return rv, cv, mask, w


@command("roctab", "roctab")
def cmd_roctab(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"detail": 1, "lorenz": 3, "binomial": 3, "nolabel": 5, "table": 3,
                                  "bamber": 3, "hanley": 3, "graph": 2, "norefline": 5, "summary": 3,
                                  "specificity": 4, "level": 1})
    level = _level(s, o)
    rv, (cv,), mask, w = _pos_neg(s, p, names[0], [names[1]])
    wm = None if w is None else w[mask]
    y = _expand(rv.data[mask], wm)
    x = _expand(cv.data[mask], wm)
    pos, neg = x[y == 1], x[y == 0]
    if not len(pos) or not len(neg):
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")   # VERIFY
    _a, se = auc_delong(pos, neg)
    a = R.area_trapezoid(pos, neg)
    if o.get("hanley") and o.get("bamber"):
        raise StataError(198, "options hanley and bamber may not be combined")   # VERIFY
    if o.get("hanley"):
        se = se_hanley(a, len(pos), len(neg))
    elif o.get("bamber"):
        se = R.se_bamber(pos, neg, a)
    N = len(pos) + len(neg)
    lo, hi = R.binomial_ci(a, N, level) if o.get("binomial") else _ci(a, se, level)
    out = s.output
    rows = roc_points(pos, neg)
    if o.get("table"):
        # the two-way table of tabulate (compat 1402)
        from .tabulate import _twoway
        _twoway(s, rv, cv, mask, w, "fweight" if w is not None else "", {})
    if o.get("detail"):
        out.write("\nDetailed report of sensitivity and specificity\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(" " * 43 + "Correctly\n", "text")
        out.write("Cutpoint      Sensitivity   Specificity   Classified          LR+          LR-\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")

def _roc_graph(s: "Session", curves, refline: bool, title: str = "", legend: bool = False) -> None:

@command("roccomp", "roccomp")
def cmd_roccomp(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"by": 2, "test": 1, "graph": 2, "norefline": 5, "separate": 3,
                                  "summary": 3, "binormal": 3, "line": 4, "level": 1})
    level = _level(s, o)
    binorm = bool(o.get("binormal"))
    out = s.output
    if isinstance(o.get("by"), str):
        if len(names) != 2:
            raise StataError(198, "only one classifier allowed with by()")   # VERIFY
        rv, (cv,), mask, w = _pos_neg(s, p, names[0], [names[1]])
        byname, groups = _strata(s, str(o["by"]), mask)
        items = []
        for lab, sel in groups:
            if binorm:
                out.write(f"Fitting binormal model for: {byname}=={lab}\n", "text")
            ws = None if w is None else w[sel]
            y, x = _expand(rv.data[sel], ws), _expand(cv.data[sel], ws)
            pos, neg = x[y == 1], x[y == 0]
            a, se = _binormal_area(pos, neg) if binorm else auc_delong(pos, neg)
            if not binorm:
                a = R.area_trapezoid(pos, neg)
            items.append((lab, len(pos) + len(neg), a, se, roc_points(pos, neg)))
        areas = np.array([i[2] for i in items])
        S = np.diag([i[3] ** 2 for i in items])
    else:
        rv, cvs, mask, w = _pos_neg(s, p, names[0], names[1:])
        wm = None if w is None else w[mask]
        y = _expand(rv.data[mask], wm)
        xs = [_expand(c.data[mask], wm) for c in cvs]
        pos_l = [x[y == 1] for x in xs]
        neg_l = [x[y == 0] for x in xs]
        areas, S = delong_cov(pos_l, neg_l)
        areas = np.array([R.area_trapezoid(pp, nn) for pp, nn in zip(pos_l, neg_l)])
        ses = np.sqrt(np.diag(S))
        if binorm:
            # binormal areas and standard errors; the test uses DeLong's covariance of the
            # correlated classifiers (VERIFY)
            fits = []
            for c, pp, nn in zip(cvs, pos_l, neg_l):
                out.write(f"Fitting binormal model for: {c.name}\n", "text")
                fits.append(_binormal_area(pp, nn))
            areas = np.array([f[0] for f in fits])
            ses = np.array([f[1] for f in fits])
        items = [(c.name, len(y), areas[k], ses[k], roc_points(pos_l[k], neg_l[k]))
                 for k, c in enumerate(cvs)]
    # binormal fits show no interval title (compat 1601)
    out.write("\n" + " " * 30 + "ROC" + ("" if binorm else " " * 20 + "-Asymptotic Normal--") + "\n", "text")
    byname = name12(str(o["by"]).split()[0]) if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else ""
    out.write(f"{byname:<17}{'Obs':>5}{'Area':>11}     Std. Err.      [{level:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 73 + "\n", "text")
    for lab, n, a, se, _ in items:
        lo, hi = _ci(a, se, level)
        out.write(f"{name12(str(lab)):<17}", "text")
        out.write(f"{n:>5}{a:>11.4f}{se:>13.4f}{lo:>15.5f}{hi:>12.5f}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 73 + "\n", "text")
    k = len(items)
    L = np.zeros((k - 1, k))
    for i in range(k - 1):
        L[i, i], L[i, i + 1] = 1, -1
    if isinstance(o.get("test"), str):
        m = getattr(s, "matrices", {}).get(str(o["test"]))
        if m is None:
            raise StataError(111, f"matrix {o['test']} not found")
        L = np.asarray(m.data, float)
    d = L @ areas
    try:
        chi2 = float(d @ np.linalg.solve(L @ S @ L.T, d))
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        chi2 = NAN
    df = L.shape[0]
    pv = float(st.chi2.sf(chi2, df)) if not math.isnan(chi2) else NAN
    labs = [str(i[0]) for i in items]
    ho = " = ".join(f"area({lab})" for lab in labs) if not isinstance(o.get("test"), str) else "Comparison as defined by contrast matrix: " + str(o["test"])
    out.write(f"Ho: {ho}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"    chi2({df}) = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{_f(chi2, '>8.2f')}", "result")
    out.write("       Prob>chi2 = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{_f(pv, '>8.4f')}\n", "result")
    if o.get("graph"):
        _roc_graph(s, [(str(i[0]), i[4], i[2]) for i in items], refline=not o.get("norefline"), legend=True)
    from .matrix import Matrix
    # return list order of Stata 14 (compat 1402)
    s.r = {"p": pv if not math.isnan(pv) else SYS, "df": float(df), "chi2": chi2 if not math.isnan(chi2) else SYS,
           "N_g": float(k), "V": Matrix(S, labs, labs)}


def _binormal_area(pos: np.ndarray, neg: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Area under the binormal ROC curve fit to the categories of the scores, and its standard
    error ([R] rocfit)."""
    from ..estimation import binormal
    cats = np.unique(np.concatenate([pos, neg]))
    if len(cats) < 3:
        raise StataError(459, "classvar must have at least 3 categories for the binormal fit")   # VERIFY
    n0 = np.bincount(np.searchsorted(cats, neg), minlength=len(cats)).astype(float)
    n1 = np.bincount(np.searchsorted(cats, pos), minlength=len(cats)).astype(float)
    bf = binormal.fit(n0, n1)
    est, se = binormal.indices(bf.b[0], bf.b[1], bf.V[:2, :2])
    return float(est[0]), float(se[0])

@command("lsens", "lsens")
def cmd_lsens(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"all": 3, "genprob": 4, "gensens": 4, "genspec": 4, "replace": 3,
                                  "nograph": 3})
    if o.get("all"):
        raise StataError(198, "option all of lsens is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    est, y, pr, mask = _fitted(s, p.varlist)
    pos, neg = pr[y], pr[~y]
    cuts = np.unique(pr)
    sens = np.array([(pos >= c).mean() for c in cuts])
    spec = np.array([(neg < c).mean() for c in cuts])
    ds = s.data
    # the variables hold one row per observed cutoff; the graph adds the ends 0 and 1
    new = [(o.get("genprob"), cuts), (o.get("gensens"), sens), (o.get("genspec"), spec)]
    cuts = np.concatenate([[0.0], cuts, [1.0]])
    sens = np.concatenate([[1.0], sens, [0.0]])
    spec = np.concatenate([[0.0], spec, [1.0]])
    for name, vals in new:
        if isinstance(name, str):
            # one row per cutoff, in the first observations (VERIFY: Stata's layout)
            if ds.has(name):
                if not o.get("replace"):
                    raise StataError(110, f"{name} already defined")
                ds.drop_vars([name])
            if len(vals) > ds.nobs:
                raise StataError(198, "too few observations to store the cutoffs")   # VERIFY
            col = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
            col[:len(vals)] = vals
            from ..core.dataset import Variable
            ds.add(Variable(name, "float", col))
    if any(isinstance(n, str) for n, _ in new):
        s.notify_state()
    if not o.get("nograph"):
        from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
        from .graphcmd import finish
        layers = [Layer("connected", cuts.tolist(), sens.tolist(), {}, {}, "Sensitivity"),
                  Layer("connected", cuts.tolist(), spec.tolist(), {}, {}, "Specificity")]
        opts = {"_xtitle": "Probability cutoff", "_ytitle": "Sensitivity/Specificity"}
        finish(s, Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), {})
