@command("rocfit", "rocfit")
def cmd_rocfit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..estimation import binormal, ml
    from ..estimation.results import Estimates, post
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"continuous": 4, "generate": 3, "level": 1, "iterate": 4,
                                  "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4, "nolog": 3, "log": 3})
    level = _level(s, o)
    rv, (cv,), mask, w = _pos_neg(s, p, names[0], [names[1]])
    x = cv.data[mask]
    if isinstance(o.get("continuous"), str):
        G = int(o["continuous"])
        qs = np.quantile(x, np.linspace(0, 1, G + 1)[1:-1])
        x = np.searchsorted(qs, x, side="right").astype(float)
    cats = np.unique(x)
    K = len(cats)
    if K < 3:
        raise StataError(459, "classvar must have at least 3 categories for the binormal fit")   # VERIFY
    wv = np.ones(mask.sum()) if w is None else w[mask]
    k_idx = np.searchsorted(cats, x)
    y = rv.data[mask] == 1
    n0 = np.bincount(k_idx[~y], weights=wv[~y], minlength=K)
    n1 = np.bincount(k_idx[y], weights=wv[y], minlength=K)
    out = s.output
    bf = binormal.fit(n0, n1, maxiter=int(o["iterate"]) if isinstance(o.get("iterate"), str) else 16000)
    res = bf.res
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting binormal model:\n\n", "text")
        ml.print_log(out, res)
    b, V, p0, p1 = bf.b, bf.V, bf.p0, bf.p1
    # Pearson goodness of fit over the 2 x K table (df = K - 3; VERIFY)
    e0, e1 = n0.sum() * p0, n1.sum() * p1
    gof = float(((n0 - e0) ** 2 / e0).sum() + ((n1 - e1) ** 2 / e1).sum())
    df_gof = K - 3
    p_gof = float(st.chi2.sf(gof, df_gof)) if df_gof > 0 else NAN
    N = int(n0.sum() + n1.sum())
    est_i, se_i = binormal.indices(b[0], b[1], V[:2, :2])
    names_b = ["intercept", "slope"] + [f"cut{i + 1}" for i in range(K - 1)]
    est = Estimates("rocfit", rv.name, ["_cons"] * len(names_b), b.copy(), V, N, stat="z", eqnames=names_b)
    est.level = level
    est.extra = {"title": f"Binormal model of {rv.name} on {cv.name}", "gof": gof, "df_gof": df_gof,
                 "p_gof": p_gof, "ll": res.ll, "idx": (est_i, se_i)}
    est.display = _rocfit_display
    # e() in Stata 14's ereturn list order (compat 1402)
    scalars = [("rank", float(len(b))), ("N", N), ("ic", float(res.iterations)), ("k", float(len(b))),
               ("k_eq", float(len(b))), ("k_dv", 2.0), ("converged", 1.0 if res.converged else 0.0),
               ("rc", 0.0), ("ll", res.ll), ("k_eq_model", 1.0), ("df_m", 0.0), ("chi2_gf", gof),
               ("df_gf", df_gof), ("p_gf", p_gof), ("area", est_i[0]), ("se_area", se_i[0]),
               ("deltam", est_i[1]), ("se_delm", se_i[1]), ("de", est_i[2]), ("se_da", se_i[3]),
               ("da", est_i[3]), ("se_de", se_i[2])]
    wt = [("wexp", f"= {p.weight[1]}")] if p.weight else []
    wtt = [("wtype", "fweight")] if p.weight else []
    macros = ([("cmd", "rocfit"), ("cmdline", f"rocfit {args.strip()}"), ("depvar", f"{rv.name} {cv.name}"),
               ("title", est.extra["title"])] + wt + [("chi2type", "GOF")] + wtt
              + [("opt", "moptimize"), ("vce", "oim"), ("user", "rocf_lf"), ("ml_method", "lf"),
                 ("technique", "nr"), ("which", "max"), ("properties", "b V")])
    from .matrix import Matrix
    grad = Matrix(res.g.reshape(1, -1), ["r1"], ["_cons"] * len(b))
    grad.coleq = names_b
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, mask, extra_mats=[("ilog", Matrix(ml.ilog(res), ["r1"],
                                                                     [f"c{i}" for i in range(1, 21)])),
                                                   ("gradient", grad)])
    _rocfit_display(s, est)


def _rocfit_display(s: "Session", est, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    """rocfit's report: intercept and slope (with the z test that the slope is 1), the
    cutpoints, then the indices of the fitted curve; numbers as %9.6f (compat 1402)."""
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    lv = level or est.level
    z = float(st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - lv / 100) / 2))
    if header:
        out.write(f"\n{x['title']:<50}Number of obs   = {est.N:>10}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"Goodness-of-fit chi2({x['df_gof']}) = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{x['gof']:>11.2f}\n", "result")
        out.write("Prob > chi2             = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f(x['p_gof'], '>11.4f')}\n", "result")
        out.write("Log likelihood          = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_g10(x['ll']):>11}\n", "result")
    if not table:
        return
    from ..estimation.results import pvalue
    b, V = est.b, est.V
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(V))

    def row(label, bb, ss, zz):
        out.write(f"{label:>12} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{bb:>11.6f}{ss:>11.6f}{zz:>9.2f}{pvalue('z', zz, None):>8.3f}{bb - z * ss:>13.6f}"
                  f"{bb + z * ss:>12.6f}\n", "result")
    out.write("\n" + "-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>12} |      Coef.   Std. Err.      z    P>|z|     [{lv:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    row("intercept", b[0], se[0], b[0] / se[0])
    row("slope (*)", b[1], se[1], (b[1] - 1) / se[1])
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    for i in range(2, len(b)):
        row(f"/cut{i - 1}", b[i], se[i], b[i] / se[i])
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    est_i, se_i = x["idx"]
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>12} |                    Indices from binormal fit\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Index':>12} |   Estimate   Std. Err.                     [{lv:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    for lab, e_, s_ in zip(("ROC area", "delta(m)", "d(e)", "d(a)"), est_i, se_i):
        out.write(f"{lab:>12} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{e_:>11.6f}{s_:>11.6f}{'':>17}{e_ - z * s_:>13.6f}{e_ + z * s_:>12.6f}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write("(*) z test for slope==1\n", "text")


def _g10(x: float) -> str:
    from ..core.formats import format_value
    return format_value(float(x), "%10.0g", pad=False).strip()

    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, _OPTS)
    level = _level(s, o)
    probit = bool(o.get("probit"))
    refname, classes = names[0], names[1:]
    ctrlcov = s.expand_varlist(str(o["ctrlcov"])) if isinstance(o.get("ctrlcov"), str) else []
    roccov = s.expand_varlist(str(o["roccov"])) if isinstance(o.get("roccov"), str) else []
    if roccov and not probit:
        raise StataError(198, "option roccov() requires probit")   # VERIFY
    if probit and len(classes) > 1 and not o.get("ml"):
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")   # VERIFY: one classifier per model
    if probit and any(o.get(k) for k in ("auc", "roc", "invroc", "pauc")):
        raise StataError(198, "summary options auc, roc(), invroc() and pauc() are not allowed with probit")   # VERIFY
    if o.get("ml") and not probit:
        raise StataError(198, "probit must be specified if ml is specified")
    model = str(o.get("ctrlmodel") or "strata").strip()
    if model not in ("strata", "linear"):
        raise StataError(198, "ctrlmodel() must be strata or linear")
    pvc = str(o.get("pvc") or "empirical").strip()
    if pvc not in ("empirical", "normal"):
        raise StataError(198, "pvc() must be empirical or normal")
    ds = s.data
    clustvar = s.expand_varlist(str(o["cluster"]))[0] if isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str) else ""
    cols = {n: ds.get(n) for n in [refname] + classes + ctrlcov + roccov + ([clustvar] if clustvar else [])}
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for n, v in cols.items():
        if v.is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
        mask &= v.data < SYS
    ref = cols[refname].data[mask] != 0
    if ref.all() or not ref.any():
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")   # VERIFY: needs cases and controls
    clust = cols[clustvar].data[mask] if clustvar else None
    if o.get("ml"):
        _rocreg_ml(s, o, args, refname, classes, ctrlcov, roccov, cols, mask, ref, clust, clustvar, level)
        return
    spec = _summary_spec(o) if not probit else []

    def statistic(idx: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """The estimates for the observations idx (positions within the sample)."""
        d = ref[idx]
        out = []
        for c in classes:
            y = cols[c].data[mask][idx]
            pv = _pv(y[d], y[~d], [cols[v].data[mask][idx] for v in ctrlcov], d, model, pvc,
                     bool(o.get("tiecorrected")))
            ok = ~np.isnan(pv)
            if probit:
                Z = np.column_stack([cols[v].data[mask][idx][d][ok] for v in roccov]) if roccov \
                    else np.zeros((int(ok.sum()), 0))
                t = np.unique(1 - pv[ok]) if o.get("ctrlfprall") else RR.fpr_points(_fprpts(o))
                t = t[(t > 0) & (t < 1)]
                g = RR.probit_glm(pv[ok], Z, t)
                # i_cons, the ROC covariates, s_cons; and the AUC without covariates
                kz = Z.shape[1]
                b = np.concatenate([[g[kz]], g[:kz], [g[kz + 1]]])
                if not kz:
                    b = np.append(b, st.norm.cdf(b[0] / math.sqrt(1 + b[-1] ** 2)))
                out.append(b)
            else:
                out.append(RR.summaries(pv[ok], spec))
        return np.concatenate(out)

    n = int(mask.sum())
    observed = statistic(np.arange(n))
    colnames, eqs = [], []
    for c in classes:
        if probit:
            # VERIFY: names of e(b) after probit
            colnames += ["_cons"] + roccov + ["_cons"] + ([] if roccov else ["auc"])
            eqs += [c] * (1 + len(roccov)) + ["probit"] + ([] if roccov else [c])
        else:
            labels = [_colname(k, j, spec) for j, (k, _) in enumerate(spec)]
            colnames += labels
            eqs += [c] * len(labels)
    k = len(observed)
    boot = None
    if not o.get("nobootstrap"):
        boot = _bootstrap(s, o, statistic, ref, observed, level, clust)
        V = np.cov(boot["reps"], rowvar=False, ddof=1).reshape(k, k)
    else:
        V = np.zeros((k, k))
    _display(s, o, refname, classes, spec, colnames, observed, boot, level, n, probit, ctrlcov, roccov,
             model, pvc, mask)
    _post(s, o, args, refname, classes, ctrlcov, roccov, colnames, eqs, observed, V, boot, n, mask, probit,
          model, pvc, spec)


def _fprpts(o) -> int:
    k = int(o["fprpts"]) if isinstance(o.get("fprpts"), str) else 10
    if k < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "fprpts() must be at least 2")   # VERIFY
    return k


def _summary_spec(o) -> list[tuple[str, float | None]]:
    """The summaries in Stata's order: ROC(t), inverse ROC, partial AUC, then the AUC
    (compat 1601)."""
    spec: list[tuple[str, float | None]] = []
    for kind in ("roc", "invroc", "pauc"):
        if isinstance(o.get(kind), str):
            for x in parse_numlist(str(o[kind])):
                if not 0 < x < 1 and not (kind == "pauc" and x == 1):
                    raise StataError(125, f"{kind}() values must be between 0 and 1")   # VERIFY
                spec.append((kind, float(x)))
    if o.get("auc") or not spec:
        spec.append(("auc", None))
    return spec


def _colname(kind: str, j: int, spec) -> str:
    if kind == "auc":
        return "auc"
    k = sum(1 for q, _ in spec[:j + 1] if q == kind)
    return f"{kind}_{k}"


def _pv(case_y, ctrl_y, ctrl_cov, d, model, pvc, tiecorrected) -> np.ndarray:
    """Percentile values of the cases, adjusted for the control covariates."""
    if not ctrl_cov:
        return RR.pv_normal(case_y, ctrl_y) if pvc == "normal" else RR.pv_empirical(case_y, ctrl_y, tiecorrected)
    if model == "linear":
        X = np.column_stack(ctrl_cov)
        return RR.pv_linear(case_y, X[d], ctrl_y, X[~d], pvc, tiecorrected)
    # strata of the control covariates: each case against the controls of its stratum;
    # cases without controls in their stratum are left out (VERIFY)
    key = np.column_stack(ctrl_cov)
    kc, kd = key[~d], key[d]
    pv = np.full(len(case_y), np.nan)
    for row in np.unique(kd, axis=0):
        sd, sc = (kd == row).all(1), (kc == row).all(1)
        if sc.any():
            pv[sd] = RR.pv_normal(case_y[sd], ctrl_y[sc]) if pvc == "normal" else \
                RR.pv_empirical(case_y[sd], ctrl_y[sc], tiecorrected)
    return pv


def _bootstrap(s: "Session", o, statistic, ref, observed, level, clust=None) -> dict:
    from ..estimation.bootstrap import _draw
    reps = int(o["breps"]) if isinstance(o.get("breps"), str) else 1000
    if reps < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "breps() must be an integer greater than 1")   # VERIFY
    if isinstance(o.get("bseed"), str):
        s.interp._execute_expanded(f"set seed {str(o['bseed']).strip()}")
    from ..core import rng
    rngstate = rng.RNG.state()          # e(rngstate): the state when the draws start
    out = s.output
    groups = [np.arange(len(ref))] if o.get("nobstrata") else [np.flatnonzero(~ref), np.flatnonzero(ref)]
    if clust is not None:
        # cluster(): whole clusters are drawn, within the case/control strata when no cluster has
        # both (VERIFY: Stata's rule for mixed clusters)
        ids = np.unique(clust)
        members = {c: np.flatnonzero(clust == c) for c in ids}
        mixed = any(ref[m].any() and not ref[m].all() for m in members.values())
        if o.get("nobstrata") or mixed:
            cgroups = [ids]
        else:
            cgroups = [np.array([c for c in ids if not ref[members[c]].any()]),
                       np.array([c for c in ids if ref[members[c]].all()])]
    dots = not o.get("nodots")
    if dots:
        out.write(f"\nBootstrap replications ({reps})\n", "text")
        out.write("----+--- 1 ---+--- 2 ---+--- 3 ---+--- 4 ---+--- 5 \n", "text")
    R = np.full((reps, len(observed)), np.nan)
    for r in range(reps):
        if clust is None:
            idx = np.concatenate([g[_draw(len(g))] for g in groups])
        else:
            idx = np.concatenate([members[c] for g in cgroups for c in g[_draw(len(g))]])
        ok = True
        try:
            if ref[idx].all() or not ref[idx].any():
                raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
            R[r] = statistic(idx)
        except (StataError, np.linalg.LinAlgError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
            ok = False
        if np.isnan(R[r]).any():
            ok = False
        if dots:
            out.write("." if ok else "x", "text")
            if (r + 1) % 50 == 0:
                out.write(f"{r + 1:>6}\n", "text")
    if dots and reps % 50:
        out.write("\n", "text")
    good = R[~np.isnan(R).any(axis=1)]
    if len(good) < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "insufficient observations to compute bootstrap standard errors")   # VERIFY
    se = good.std(axis=0, ddof=1)
    z = float(st.norm.ppf(0.5 + level / 200))
    a = (100 - level) / 2
    prop = np.clip((good < observed).mean(axis=0), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    z0 = st.norm.ppf(prop)
    bc = [(np.percentile(good[:, j], st.norm.cdf(2 * z0[j] - z) * 100),
           np.percentile(good[:, j], st.norm.cdf(2 * z0[j] + z) * 100)) for j in range(len(observed))]
    return {"rngstate": rngstate, "reps": good, "n": len(good), "se": se, "bias": good.mean(axis=0) - observed, "z0": z0,
            "b_bs": good.mean(axis=0),
            "normal": (observed - z * se, observed + z * se),
            "percentile": (np.percentile(good, a, axis=0), np.percentile(good, 100 - a, axis=0)),
            "bc": (np.array([x[0] for x in bc]), np.array([x[1] for x in bc]))}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# display and e() (layout and names from compat 1601)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TITLES = {"auc": "Area under the ROC curve", "roc": "ROC curve", "invroc": "False-positive rate",
           "pauc": "Partial area under the ROC curve"}
_HEAD = {"auc": "AUC", "roc": "ROC", "invroc": "invROC", "pauc": "pAUC"}


def _f(x) -> str:
    return "." if x is None or not math.isfinite(x) else _g9(x)


def _g9(x: float) -> str:
    from .summarize import g9
    return g9(float(x)).strip()


def _display(s: "Session", o, refname, classes, spec, colnames, observed, boot, level, n, probit,
             ctrlcov, roccov, model, pvc, mask) -> None:
    out = s.output
    title = "Parametric ROC estimation" if probit else "Nonparametric ROC estimation"
    out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{(title if boot is None else 'Bootstrap results'):<48}Number of obs     = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{n:>10,}\n", "result")
    if boot is not None:
        out.write(f"{'':<48}Replications      = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{boot['n']:>10,}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"\n{title}\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if ctrlcov:
        out.write(f"Covariate control      : {'stratification' if model == 'strata' else 'linear regression'}\n",
                  "text")
        out.write(f"Control variables      : {' '.join(ctrlcov)}\n", "text")
    tie = ", corrected for ties" if o.get("tiecorrected") else ""
    out.write(f"Control standardization: {pvc}{tie}\n", "text")
    if probit:
        out.write(f"ROC method             : {'parametric':<23}Link: probit\n", "text")
    else:
        out.write("ROC method             : empirical\n", "text")
    if ctrlcov and model == "linear":
        # the regression of each classifier on the control covariates among the controls
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        ds = s.data
        tmp = "__rocreg_ctrl"
        flag = np.zeros(ds.nobs)
        flag[mask & (ds.get(refname).data == 0)] = 1
        ds.add(Variable(tmp, "byte", flag))
        try:
            for c in classes:
                out.write(f"\nStatus    : {refname}\nClassifier: {c}\nCovariate control adjustment model:\n",
                          "text")
                s.interp._execute_expanded(f"regress {c} {' '.join(ctrlcov)} if {tmp}")
        finally:
            ds.drop_vars([tmp])
    per = len(colnames) // len(classes)
    note = ""
    if boot is not None and isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str):
        cv = str(o["cluster"]).strip()
        G = len(np.unique(s.data.get(cv).data[mask]))
        note = f"{f'(Replications based on {G:,} clusters in {cv})':>78}\n"      # compat 1912
    if probit:
        for ci, c in enumerate(classes):
            base = ci * per
            out.write(f"\n   Status    : {refname}\n   Classifier: {c}\n   ROC Model : \n", "text")
            _table_head(out, c, level, note)
            rows = [("_cons", base)] + [(v, base + 1 + j) for j, v in enumerate(roccov)]
            for lab, j in rows:
                _row(out, lab, observed[j], boot, j, level, tags=boot is not None)
            out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
            out.write(f"{'probit':>12} |\n", "text")
            out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
            j = base + 1 + len(roccov)
            _row(out, "_cons", observed[j], boot, j, level, tags=boot is not None)
            out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
            if not roccov:
                out.write("\n", "text")
                _table_head(out, "AUC", level, note)
                _row(out, "", observed[j + 1], boot, j + 1, level)
                out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        return
    kinds = list(dict.fromkeys(k for k, _ in spec))
    for kind in kinds:
        out.write(f"\n{_TITLES[kind]}\n", "text")
        for ci, c in enumerate(classes):
            out.write(f"\n   Status    : {refname}\n   Classifier: {c}\n", "text")
            _table_head(out, _HEAD[kind], level, note)
            for j, (k, x) in enumerate(spec):
                if k == kind:
                    _row(out, "" if kind == "auc" else _g9(x), observed[ci * per + j], boot, ci * per + j, level)
            out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")


def _table_head(out, head: str, level: float, note: str = "") -> None:
    out.write(note, "text")
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>12} |    Observed               Bootstrap\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{head[:12]:>12} |       Coef.       Bias    Std. Err.     [{level:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")


def _row(out, label, obs, boot, j, level, tags: bool = True) -> None:
    """Observed value, bootstrap bias and standard error, and the normal (N), percentile (P)
    and bias-corrected (BC) intervals; missing without the bootstrap."""
    if boot is None:
        bias = se = None
        cis = [(None, None)] * 3
    else:
        bias, se = boot["bias"][j], boot["se"][j]
        cis = [(boot[k][0][j], boot[k][1][j]) for k in ("normal", "percentile", "bc")]
    out.write(f"{label:>12} |", "text")
    out.write(f"{_f(obs):>12}{_f(bias):>11}{_f(se):>12}{_f(cis[0][0]):>13}{_f(cis[0][1]):>11}", "result")
    if not tags:
        # the probit rows without the bootstrap: one line (compat 1601); with it, the three
        # intervals (compat 1912)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        return
    out.write("  (N)\n", "text")
    for tag, (lo, hi) in zip(("  (P)", " (BC)"), cis[1:]):
        out.write(f"{'':>12} |{'':>35}", "text")
        out.write(f"{_f(lo):>13}{_f(hi):>11}", "result")
        out.write(tag + "\n", "text")


def _post(s: "Session", o, args, refname, classes, ctrlcov, roccov, colnames, eqs, observed, V, boot, n, mask,
          probit, model, pvc, spec) -> None:
    """e() in Stata 14's ereturn list order (compat 1601; VERIFY the names with ctrlcov(),
    roc(), invroc() and pauc())."""
    from ..estimation.results import Estimates, post
    from .matrix import Matrix
    est = Estimates("rocreg", refname, colnames, np.asarray(observed, float), V, n, stat="z", eqnames=eqs)
    est.title = "Parametric ROC estimation" if probit else "Nonparametric ROC estimation"
    level = _level(s, o)

    def mat(row, rown="y1"):
        m = Matrix(np.asarray(row, float).reshape(1, -1), [rown], list(colnames))
        m.coleq = list(eqs)
        return m

    def ci(pair):
        m = Matrix(np.vstack(pair), ["ll", "ul"], list(colnames))
        m.coleq = list(eqs)
        return m
    stats = {"auc": "auc" if any(k == "auc" for k, _ in spec) else ""}
    for kind in ("roc", "invroc", "pauc"):
        vals = [x for k, x in spec if k == kind]
        stats[kind] = " ".join(_g9(x) for x in vals)
    common = [("pvc", pvc), ("ctrlcov", " ".join(ctrlcov)), ("ctrlmodel", model if ctrlcov else "")]
    if boot is None:
        scalars = [("N", float(n))] if probit else [("level", level), ("N", float(n))]
        macros = [("title", est.title), ("nobootstrap", "nobootstrap"), ("cmdline", f"rocreg {args.strip()}"),
                  ("refvar", refname), ("classvars", " ".join(classes)), ("cmd", "rocreg")] + common
        if probit:
            macros += [("fprpts", str(_fprpts(o))), ("predict", "rocreg_p"), ("probit", "probit"),
                       ("roccov", " ".join(roccov))]
        else:
            macros += [(k, stats[k]) for k in ("auc", "roc", "invroc", "pauc")]
        macros += [("np", str(len(colnames))), ("properties", "b")]
        post(s, est, scalars, macros, mask)
        s.e.pop("V", None)
        return
    scalars = [("N", float(n)), ("rank", float(np.linalg.matrix_rank(V))), ("level", level)]
    clustvar = str(o["cluster"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str) else ""
    if clustvar:
        scalars.insert(0, ("N_clust", float(len(np.unique(s.data.get(clustvar).data[mask])))))
    exps = " ".join(f"[{e}]_b[{c}]" for e, c in zip(eqs, colnames))
    # e(rngstate) and e(clustvar) come before e(vce) (compat 1912)
    macros = [("properties", "b V"), ("exp1", exps), ("rngstate", boot["rngstate"]), ("clustvar", clustvar),
              ("vce", "bootstrap")]
    macros += [(k, stats[k]) for k in ("auc", "roc", "invroc", "pauc")] if not probit else \
        [("probit", "probit"), ("roccov", " ".join(roccov))]
    macros += [("pvc", pvc), ("ctrlcov", " ".join(ctrlcov)), ("ctrlmodel", model if ctrlcov else ""),
               ("cmdline", f"rocreg {args.strip()}"), ("classvars", " ".join(classes)), ("refvar", refname),
               ("breps", str(boot["n"])), ("cmd", "rocreg"), ("title", est.title)]
    extra = [("ci_bc", ci(boot["bc"])), ("ci_percentile", ci(boot["percentile"])),
             ("ci_normal", ci(boot["normal"])), ("se", mat(boot["se"])), ("z0", mat(boot["z0"])),
             ("bias", mat(boot["bias"])), ("reps", mat(np.full(len(colnames), float(boot["n"])))),
             ("b_bs", mat(boot["b_bs"]))]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, mask, extra_mats=extra)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# probit ml (compat 1912): for each classifier, the covariate control adjustment model by maximum
# likelihood (cases and controls normal; casecov, casesd, ctrlcov, ctrlsd), then the ROC model's
# parameters as functions of it, with delta-method standard errors
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _rocreg_ml(s: "Session", o, args, refname, classes, ctrlcov, roccov, cols, mask, ref, clust, clustvar,
               level) -> None:
    from ..estimation import ml
    from ..estimation.results import CoefRow, Estimates, coef_table, post
    if str(o.get("ctrlmodel") or "linear").strip() != "linear":
        raise StataError(198, "ctrlmodel(strata) not allowed with ml;\nspecify ctrlmodel(linear) instead")
    out = s.output
    # the title and the number of observations of the header are those of the estimation results
    # in memory before this command (compat 1912: its first rocreg shows the N of an earlier one;
    # VERIFY)
    prev_title = str(s.e.get("title", "")) if isinstance(s.e.get("title"), str) else ""
    prev_n = s.e.get("N")
    n = int(mask.sum())
    X = np.column_stack([cols[v].data[mask] for v in roccov]) if roccov else np.zeros((n, 0))
    Z = np.column_stack([cols[v].data[mask] for v in ctrlcov]) if ctrlcov else np.zeros((n, 0))
    kx, kz = X.shape[1], Z.shape[1]
    G = len(np.unique(clust)) if clust is not None else 0
    note = f"{f'(Std. Err. adjusted for {G:,} clusters in {clustvar})':>78}\n" if clust is not None else ""
    out.write("\n" + f"{prev_title:<48}Number of obs     = ", "text")
    out.write((f"{int(prev_n):>10,}" if isinstance(prev_n, float) and prev_n < SYS else f"{'.':>10}") + "\n",
              "result")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if ctrlcov:
        out.write(f"Covariate control      : linear regression\nControl variables      : {' '.join(ctrlcov)}\n",
                  "text")
    out.write("Control standardization: normal\n", "text")
    out.write(f"ROC method             : {'parametric':<25}Link: probit\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  Status     : {refname}\n  Classifiers: {' '.join(classes)}\n", "text")
    label = "log pseudolikelihood" if clust is not None else "log likelihood"
    fits = []
    for c in classes:
        y = cols[c].data[mask].astype(float)
        out.write(f"\n  Classifier : {c}\n  Covariate control adjustment model:\n\n", "text")
        res = RR.adjust_ml(y, ref, X, Z)
        ml.print_log(out, res, label)
        if not res.converged:
            raise StataError(430, "convergence not achieved")
        _, S, H = RR.adjust_derivatives(res.b, y, ref, X, Z)
        A = np.linalg.inv(-H)
        A = (A + A.T) / 2
        V1 = A if clust is None else _sandwich(A, S, A, clust)
        fits.append((res.b, S, A, V1))
        se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V1), 0))
        rows = []
        k = 0
        for eq, labels in (("casecov", roccov + ["_cons"]), ("casesd", ["_cons"]),
                           ("ctrlcov", ctrlcov + ["_cons"]), ("ctrlsd", ["_cons"])):
            if rows:
                rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
            rows.append(CoefRow("eq", eq))
            for lab in labels:
                rows.append(CoefRow("coef", lab, res.b[k], se[k]))
                k += 1
        out.write(note, "text")
        coef_table(s, "", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=level,
                   vcetype="Robust" if clust is not None else "")
    # the ROC parameters of every classifier; with several classifiers (or clusters) their joint
    # variance is the sandwich of the stacked scores (Robust in Stata's table)
    from scipy.linalg import block_diag
    A = block_diag(*[f[2] for f in fits])
    if len(classes) > 1 or clust is not None:
        Vt = _sandwich(A, np.hstack([f[1] for f in fits]), A, clust)
    else:
        Vt = A
    J = block_diag(*[RR.roc_jacobian(f[0], kx, kz) for f in fits])
    b = np.concatenate([RR.roc_params(f[0], kx, kz) for f in fits])
    V = J @ Vt @ J.T
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    names = (["i_cons"] + roccov + ["s_cons"] + ([] if roccov else ["auc"])) * len(classes)
    per = len(names) // len(classes)
    eqs = [c for c in classes for _ in range(per)]
    out.write(f"\n   Status    : {refname}\n   ROC Model : \n", "text")
    out.write(note, "text")
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
    rows = []
    for ci, c in enumerate(classes):
        if rows:
            rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("eq", c))
        rows += [CoefRow("coef", names[ci * per + j], b[ci * per + j], se[ci * per + j]) for j in range(per)]
    coef_table(s, "", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=level,
               vcetype="Robust" if len(classes) > 1 or clust is not None else "")
    if len(classes) > 1 and not roccov:
        # Wald test that the AUCs are equal (VERIFY: the test statistic Stata uses)
        pos = [ci * per + per - 1 for ci in range(len(classes))]
        R = np.zeros((len(classes) - 1, len(b)))
        for r in range(len(classes) - 1):
            R[r, pos[r]], R[r, pos[r + 1]] = 1.0, -1.0
        rb = R @ b
        chi2 = float(rb @ np.linalg.solve(R @ V @ R.T, rb))

              ("ctrlcov", " ".join(ctrlcov)), ("ctrlmodel", "linear"), ("refvar", refname),
              ("classvars", " ".join(classes)), ("cmd", "rocreg"), ("pvc", "normal")]
    if clust is not None:
        macros += [("vce", "cluster"), ("vcetype", "Robust"), ("clustvar", clustvar)]
    macros += [("fprpts", str(_fprpts(o))), ("predict", "rocreg_p"), ("roccov", " ".join(roccov)),
               ("probit", "probit"), ("ml", "ml"), ("properties", "b V")]

def _sandwich(A: np.ndarray, S: np.ndarray, B: np.ndarray, clust) -> np.ndarray:
    """A (U'U) B * G/(G-1), with U the scores summed within each cluster (each observation without
    clusters)."""
    if clust is None:
        U = S
    else:
        U = np.vstack([S[clust == g].sum(axis=0) for g in np.unique(clust)])
    G = len(U)
    return A @ (U.T @ U) @ B * G / (G - 1)

"""import sas, import spss, import sasxport and export sasxport ([D] import sas, [D] import spss,
[D] import sasxport); the readers are in io/statpkg.py.

Messages and undocumented rules are marked VERIFY, with the sasxport cases in

from __future__ import annotations

import struct

import numpy as np

from ..core.dataset import Dataset

from ..lang.syntax import Parsed, match_options, parse_standard

def _file(text: str, ext: str, *, must_exist: bool = True) -> Path:
    t = strip_outer_quotes(text.strip())
    if not t:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid file specification")
    p = Path(t).expanduser()
    if p.suffix == "":
        p = p.with_suffix(ext)
    if must_exist and not p.exists():
        raise StataError(601, f"file {p} not found")
    return p


def _install(s: "Session", new: Dataset, p: Parsed, namelist: list[str], quiet: bool = False) -> None:
    if namelist:
        statpkg.select(new, namelist)
    old = s.data
    s.data = new
    try:
        if p.if_ or p.in_:
            new.keep_obs(touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_)))
    except Exception:
        s.data = old
        raise
    s.r = {"N": float(new.nobs), "k": float(new.nvars)}
    if not quiet:
        s.output.write(f"({new.nvars} vars, {new.nobs} obs)\n", "text")    # import sasxport is silent (compat 1701)
    s.notify_state()


def _check_replace(s: "Session", clear: bool) -> None:
    if s.data.changed and s.data.nvars and not clear:
        raise StataError(4, "no; data in memory would be lost")


def _namelist(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return text.split()


def import_sas(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"bcat": 4, "case": 4, "clear": 5, "encoding": 8})
    names = _namelist(p.varlist) if p.using is not None else []
    path = _file(p.using if p.using is not None else p.varlist, ".sas7bdat")
    case = str(o.get("case", "preserve")).strip()
    if case not in ("lower", "upper", "preserve"):
        raise StataError(198, "option case() invalid")
    _check_replace(s, bool(o.get("clear")))
    bcat = _file(str(o["bcat"]), ".sas7bcat") if o.get("bcat") else None
    cols, meta = statpkg.read_sas(path, bcat=bcat, encoding=_enc(o))
    _install(s, statpkg.dataset_from_columns(cols, meta, case=case), p, names)


def import_spss(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"case": 4, "clear": 5, "zsav": 4, "encoding": 8})
    names = _namelist(p.varlist) if p.using is not None else []
    zsav = bool(o.get("zsav"))
    path = _file(p.using if p.using is not None else p.varlist, ".zsav" if zsav else ".sav")
    case = str(o.get("case", "preserve")).strip()
    if case not in ("lower", "upper", "preserve"):
        raise StataError(198, "option case() invalid")
    _check_replace(s, bool(o.get("clear")))
    cols, meta = statpkg.read_spss(path, zsav=zsav, encoding=_enc(o))
    # the label of a variable has up to 256 characters in the SPSS format
    _install(s, statpkg.dataset_from_columns(cols, meta, case=case, label_max=256), p, names)


def _enc(o: dict) -> str | None:
    return strip_outer_quotes(str(o["encoding"]).strip()) if o.get("encoding") else None


def _formats_file(folder: Path) -> Path | None:
    for f in ("formats.xpf", "FORMATS.xpf", "FORMATS.XPF"):
        if (folder / f).exists():
            return folder / f
    return None


def _xport_describe(s: "Session", path: Path, member: str) -> None:
    """import sasxport, describe: each member (or the one in member()) with its variables, in the
    layout of compat 1911. VERIFY: files with several members, string variables."""
    from ..io import xport
    members = xport.read(path)
    total = len(members)
    if member:
        members = [_pick(members, member)]
    out = s.output
    rule = "-" * 76 + "\n"
    for m in members:
        n, k = len(m.rows), len(m.variables)
        # size: the observations as stored in the file plus 4 bytes each (compat 1911)
        size = n * (sum(v.length for v in m.variables) + 4)
        out.write(f"\ndata from {path.name}, member({m.name.lower()})\n", "text")
        out.write(f"  obs:{n:>17,}             {m.created.lower()}\n", "text")
        out.write(f" vars:{k:>17,}             (date shown exactly as recorded in file)\n", "text")
        out.write(f" size:{size:>17,}\n" + rule, "text")
        out.write("variable    variable     value\n  name        type       label      variable label\n"
                  + rule, "text")
        for v in m.variables:
            kind = "numeric" if v.numeric else f"char({v.length})"           # VERIFY: strings
            out.write(f"{v.name.lower():<12}{kind:<12}{v.format.lower():<12}{v.label}".rstrip() + "\n",
                      "text")
        out.write(rule, "text")
    # return list shows the results in the reverse order of this dictionary
    s.r = {"members": " ".join(m.name.lower() for m in members), "n_members": float(total),
           "size": float(size), "k": float(k), "N": float(n)}


def _pick(members: list, name: str):
    for m in members:
        if m.name.lower() == name.lower():
            return m
    raise StataError(198, f"member {name} not found")              # VERIFY: return code


def import_sasxport(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"clear": 5, "novallabels": 5, "member": 6, "describe": 8})
    path = _file(p.varlist, ".xpt")
    member = str(o["member"]).strip() if o.get("member") not in (None, True) else ""
    if o.get("describe"):
        _xport_describe(s, path, member)
        return
    _check_replace(s, bool(o.get("clear")))
    fmt_file = _formats_file(path.parent)
    if not member and fmt_file is None:
        cols, meta = statpkg.read_xport(path)
        _install(s, statpkg.dataset_from_columns(cols, meta, case="lower", xport=True), Parsed(), [], quiet=True)
        return
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    from ..io import xport
    try:
        members = xport.read(path)
    except (IndexError, ValueError, struct.error):
        raise StataError(610, f"file {path} not SAS XPORT format")
    m = _pick(members, member) if member else members[0]
    cols = {v.name: [(float("nan") if x is None else x) if v.numeric else x for x in
                     (row[k] for row in m.rows)] for k, v in enumerate(m.variables)}
    meta = SimpleNamespace(column_names=[v.name for v in m.variables],
                           column_labels=[v.label or None for v in m.variables], file_label=m.label,
                           variable_storage_width={v.name: v.length for v in m.variables if not v.numeric})
    ds = statpkg.dataset_from_columns(cols, meta, case="lower", xport=True)
    if fmt_file is not None:
        # the value labels of formats.xpf go to the variables whose SAS format has their name;
        # with novallabels the variables keep the names but the labels are not defined (compat
        # 1911; VERIFY)
        labels = xport.value_labels(fmt_file)
        for var, xv in zip(ds.vars, m.variables):
            fname = xv.format.lower()
            if fname in labels and not var.is_string:
                if not o.get("novallabels"):
                    ds.value_labels[fname] = labels[fname]
                var.value_label = fname
    _install(s, ds, Parsed(), [], quiet=True)


def _sas_names(names: list[str], rename: bool, what: str, out=None) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Names that SAS XPORT accepts: up to 8 characters, the same in upper and lower case. With
    rename, a longer or clashing name is cut, upper-cased and given a number (VERIFY: Stata's rule
    for clashes). out: where the list of renamed variables goes (compat 1911)."""
    if out is not None:
        new = _sas_names(names, True, what)
        changed = [(n, v.upper()) for n, v in new.items() if v != n]
        if changed:
            items = "".join(f"                {n} -> {v}\n" for n, v in changed)
            if not rename:
                out.write("the following variable(s) have names that must be changed to fit into "
                          ".xpt format:  (suggested renamings shown):\n\n" + items + "\n", "text")
                raise StataError(198, "specify option rename to save .xpt file with suggested names")
            out.write("the following variable(s) were renamed in the output file:\n\n" + items + "\n",
                      "text")
        return {n: v.upper() if v != n else v for n, v in new.items()}
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    taken: set[str] = set()
    for n in names:
        new = n
        if len(n) > 8 or n.upper() in taken:
            if not rename:
                raise StataError(198, f"{what} {n} has more than 8 characters or clashes with another; "
                                      "use option rename")               # VERIFY: Stata's message
            new, k = n[:8], 1
            while new.upper() in taken:
                tail = str(k)
                new, k = n[:8 - len(tail)] + tail, k + 1
        taken.add(new.upper())
        out[n] = new
    return out


def export_sasxport(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """export sasxport [varlist using] filename [if] [in] [, rename replace vallabfile()]"""
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"rename": 6, "replace": 7, "vallabfile": 6})
    ds = s.data
    if ds.nvars == 0:
        raise StataError(102, "no variables defined")   # VERIFY
    if p.using is not None:
        names, file = unique(expand(ds, p.varlist)), p.using
    else:
        names, file = list(ds.names), p.varlist
    vallab = str(o.get("vallabfile", "xpf")).strip() if o.get("vallabfile") not in (None, True) else "xpf"
    if vallab not in ("xpf", "sascode", "both", "none"):
        raise StataError(198, "option vallabfile() incorrectly specified")      # VERIFY
    rename = bool(o.get("rename"))
    newnames = _sas_names(names, rename, "variable", s.output)
    # the value labels in the order of the variables that use them (compat 1911)
    used = list(dict.fromkeys(ds.get(n).value_label for n in names if ds.get(n).value_label
                              and ds.get(n).value_label in ds.value_labels)) if vallab != "none" else []
    labnames = _sas_names(used, rename, "value label")
    path = _file(file, ".xpt", must_exist=False)
    if path.exists() and not o.get("replace"):
        raise StataError(602, f"file {path} already exists")
    rows = np.flatnonzero(touse(s, Parsed(if_=p.if_, in_=p.in_)))
    formats = {newnames[n]: labnames[ds.get(n).value_label].upper() for n in names
               if ds.get(n).value_label in labnames}
    statpkg.write_xport(ds, path, names, rows, rename=newnames, formats=formats)
    s.output.write(f"file {path} saved\n", "text")
    sas = path.with_suffix(".sas")
    if vallab in ("xpf", "none") and sas.exists():
        sas.unlink()        # Stata leaves no .sas file of an earlier export (compat 1911; VERIFY)
    if used:
        sets = {labnames[n]: ds.value_labels[n] for n in used}
        if vallab in ("sascode", "both"):
            _write_sascode(sas, sets)
            s.output.write(f"file {sas} saved\n", "text")
        if vallab in ("xpf", "both"):
            statpkg.write_formats_xpf(path.parent / "formats.xpf", sets)
            s.output.write("file formats.xpf saved\n", "text")


def _write_sascode(path: Path, sets: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
    """The value labels as a SAS program with PROC FORMAT (VERIFY: Stata's file)."""
    lines = ["proc format;"]
    for name, lab in sets.items():
        lines.append(f"value {name}")
        for k in sorted(lab):
            text = str(lab[k]).replace('"', '""')
            lines.append(f'  {k} = "{text}"')
        lines.append(";")
    lines.append("run;")
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

"""statsby ([D] statsby): runs a command on each group of the data and collects the results it
returns as a dataset."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.dataset import Dataset, Variable
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options
from ..lang.words import strip_outer_quotes
from .datacmds import _need_clear
from .registry import command

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


@command("statsby", "statsby")
def cmd_statsby(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    colon = find_top(args, ":")
    if colon == -1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    head, cmd = args[:colon], args[colon + 1:].strip()
    c = find_top(head, ",")
    explist, opt = (head, "") if c == -1 else (head[:c], head[c + 1:])
    o = match_options(opt, {"by": 2, "clear": 5, "saving": 3, "total": 2, "subsets": 3, "nodots": 5,
                            "noisily": 1, "basepop": 4, "nolegend": 5, "verbose": 1, "force": 5})
    if not cmd:
        raise StataError(198, "command required")
    ds0 = s.data
    if not isinstance(o.get("saving"), str):
        _need_clear(s, o)
    byvars = s.expand_varlist(str(o["by"]).split(",")[0]) if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else []
    keep_missing = isinstance(o.get("by"), str) and "missing" in str(o["by"]).split(",", 1)[-1]
    exps = _parse_explist(explist)
    full = ds0.copy()
    groups: list[tuple[tuple, np.ndarray]] = []
    if byvars:
        cols = [full.get(b) for b in byvars]
        keys: dict[tuple, list[int]] = {}
        for i in range(full.nobs):
            key = tuple((c.raw[i] if c.is_string else float(c.data[i])) for c in cols)
            if not keep_missing and any((k == "" if c.is_string else k >= SYS) for k, c in zip(key, cols)):
                continue
            keys.setdefault(key, []).append(i)
        for key in sorted(keys, key=lambda t: tuple((isinstance(x, str), x) for x in t)):
            m = np.zeros(full.nobs, dtype=bool)
            m[keys[key]] = True
            groups.append((key, m))
    if o.get("total") or not byvars:
        groups.append((None, np.ones(full.nobs, dtype=bool)))
    out = s.output
    results = []
    for gi, (key, m) in enumerate(groups):
        sub = full.copy()
        sub.keep_obs(m)
        s.data = sub
        s.r, s.e = {}, {}
        ok = True
        # the command inside is silent even under `capture noisily statsby` (compat 1501)
        noisy_saved = out.noisy_depth
        if not o.get("noisily"):
            out.quiet_depth += 1
            out.noisy_depth = 0
        try:
            s.interp._execute_expanded(cmd)
        except StataError:
            ok = False
        finally:
            if not o.get("noisily"):
                out.quiet_depth -= 1
                out.noisy_depth = noisy_saved
        if gi == 0:
            if not exps:
                exps = _default_explist(s)
            elif any(e in ("_b", "_se") for _, e in exps):
                exps = [x for name, e in exps
                        for x in ([(nm.replace("_b_", e + "_", 1), ex.replace("_b[", e + "[", 1))
                                   for nm, ex in _default_explist(s, coefs=True)] if e in ("_b", "_se")
                                  else [(name, e)])]
        row = []
        for name, e in exps:
            try:
                val = float(s.eval(e)) if ok else SYS
            except (StataError, TypeError, ValueError):
                val = SYS
            row.append(val)
        results.append((key, row))
    s.data = ds0
    # legend (VERIFY: layout)
    if not o.get("nolegend"):
        out.write(f"\n{'command:':>14}  {cmd}\n", "text")
        for name, e in exps:
            out.write(f"{name + ':':>14}  {e}\n", "text")
        if byvars:
            out.write(f"{'by:':>14}  {' '.join(byvars)}\n", "text")
    if not o.get("nodots"):
        out.write("\nStatsby groups\n", "text")
        out.write("----+--- 1 ---+--- 2 ---+--- 3 ---+--- 4 ---+--- 5 \n", "text")
        out.write("." * len(groups) + "\n", "text")
    new = Dataset()
    new.set_obs(len(results))
    for j, b in enumerate(byvars):
        c = full.get(b)
        vals = [(k[j] if k is not None else ("" if c.is_string else SYS)) for k, _ in results]
        new.add(Variable(b, c.vtype, np.array(vals, dtype=object if c.is_string else float), fmt=c.fmt,
                         label=c.label, value_label=c.value_label))
    for j, (name, e) in enumerate(exps):
        new.add(Variable(name, "float", np.array([r[j] for _, r in results], float), label=e))
    new.value_labels = dict(full.value_labels)
    new.changed = True
    if isinstance(o.get("saving"), str):
        from pathlib import Path
        import os
        from ..io.dta import write_dta
        sv = str(o["saving"])
        cc = find_top(sv, ",")
        fname, rep = (sv, "") if cc == -1 else (sv[:cc], sv[cc + 1:])
        path = Path(os.path.expanduser(strip_outer_quotes(fname.strip())))
        if path.suffix == "":
            path = path.with_suffix(".dta")
        if path.exists() and "replace" not in rep:
            raise StataError(602, f"file {path} already exists")
        write_dta(new, path)
        return
    s.data = new
    s.notify_state()


def _parse_explist(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = []
    k = 0
    for m in re.finditer(r"(\w+)\s*=\s*(\([^()]*(?:\([^()]*\)[^()]*)*\)|\S+)|(\S+)", text.strip()):
        if m.group(1):
            out.append((m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()))
        else:
            k += 1
            e = m.group(3)
            if e in ("_b", "_se"):
                out.append((e, e))      # expanded later from e(b)
                continue
            out.append((f"_stat_{k}", e))
    return out


def _default_explist(s: "Session", coefs: bool = False) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """No exp_list: _b after an estimation command, otherwise the r() scalars."""
    b = s.e.get("b") if isinstance(s.e, dict) else None
    if b is not None or coefs:
        if b is None:
            return []
        names = list(getattr(b, "colnames", []))
        return [(f"_b_{n.strip('_') or 'cons'}" if n != "_cons" else "_b_cons", f"_b[{n}]") for n in names]
    return [(k, f"r({k})") for k, v in (s.r or {}).items() if isinstance(v, float)]

    ("stcrreg", "stcrreg", "cmd_stcrreg"), ("stcurve", "stcurve", "cmd_stcurve"),
):

files.opendta/commands/stdata.py:
"""Survival-time data manipulation: stsplit, stjoin, stfill, stgen, stvary, stbase and snapspan
([ST] stsplit, [ST] stjoin, [ST] stfill, [ST] stgen, [ST] stvary, [ST] stbase, [ST] snapspan).

The array work is in core/survival.py. Details that the manuals do not show carry the VERIFY mark
(compat/do/1901_survival.do)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import survival as SV
from ..core.dataset import Variable
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.grouping import group_ids
from ..estimation.st import STInfo, header, require_st
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lang.words import parse_numlist
from ._util import eval_vector, touse

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..core.dataset import Dataset
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
_ST_VARS = ("_st", "_d", "_t", "_t0")


def _need_id(info: STInfo, cmd: str) -> None:
    if not info.idvar:
        raise StataError(459, f"{cmd} requires that the data be stset with id()")   # VERIFY


def _take(ds: "Dataset", src: np.ndarray) -> None:
    """Rebuilds the observations as ds[src] (repeating or reordering rows)."""
    for v in ds.vars:
        v.raw = v.raw[src]
    ds.nobs = len(src)
    ds.esample = None
    ds.sortlist = []
    ds._touch()


def _put(ds: "Dataset", name: str, values: np.ndarray, rows: np.ndarray) -> None:
    var = ds.get(name)
    full = np.array(var.data, dtype=np.float64)
    full[rows] = values
    ds.set_numeric(var, full)


def _origin(s: "Session", info: STInfo, n: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """The origin of analysis time of each observation, in the units of the time variable."""
    if info.origin and info.origin != "min":
        return np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, info.origin), dtype=np.float64), (n,)).copy()
    return np.zeros(n)


def _st_arrays(s: "Session"):
    ds = s.data
    return (ds.get("_st").data == 1, ds.get("_t0").data.astype(np.float64),
            ds.get("_t").data.astype(np.float64), ds.get("_d").data.astype(np.float64))


def _subjects(s: "Session", info: STInfo, rows: np.ndarray):
    """Rows (sorted by subject, entry and exit time), their subject numbers and the bounds of
    each subject's run."""
    ds = s.data
    ok = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
    ok[rows] = True
    if info.idvar:
        gid_all = group_ids(ds, [info.idvar], ok)[0]
    else:
        gid_all = np.where(ok, np.arange(ds.nobs), -1)
    t0 = ds.get("_t0").data.astype(np.float64)
    t = ds.get("_t").data.astype(np.float64)
    gid = gid_all[rows]
    o = SV.time_order(gid, t0[rows], t[rows])
    rows_s = rows[o]
    gid_s = gid[o]
    return rows_s, gid_s, SV.group_bounds(gid_s)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stsplit
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _after_ref(s: "Session", info: STInfo, spec: str, rows: np.ndarray, t: np.ndarray, org: np.ndarray):
    """Reference point of each record for after(): at() values are measured from it, in analysis
    time units."""
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(time|t)\s*=\s*(.*)$", spec)
    unit, text = (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else ("time", spec)
    kind = "exp"
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(min|asis)\s*\((.*)\)\s*$", text)
    if m:
        kind, text = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    n = s.data.nobs
    v = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, text), dtype=np.float64), (n,)).copy()
    if kind == "min":
        gid = group_ids(s.data, [info.idvar], None)[0]
        for g in np.unique(gid[rows]):
            sel = rows[gid[rows] == g]
            good = v[sel][v[sel] < SYS]
            v[sel] = good.min() if len(good) else SYS
    if unit == "time":
        v = (v - org) / info.scale
    return v


def cmd_stsplit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    _need_id(info, "stsplit")
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) > 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"at": 2, "every": 2, "after": 2, "trim": 4, "strata": 3,
                                  "riskset": 3, "nopreserve": 3})
    newvar = names[0] if names else ""
    at_txt = str(o["at"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("at"), str) else ""
    failures = at_txt == "failures"
    if failures:
        if newvar:
            raise StataError(101, "varlist not allowed")
        if o.get("every") or o.get("after") or o.get("trim"):
            raise StataError(198, "at(failures) may not be combined with every(), after() or "
                             "trim")   # VERIFY
    else:
        if o.get("strata") or o.get("riskset"):
            raise StataError(198, "options strata() and riskset() require at(failures)")   # VERIFY
        if o.get("every") and not newvar:
            raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
        if bool(at_txt) == bool(o.get("every")):
            raise StataError(198, "must specify either at() or every()")   # VERIFY
    n = ds.nobs
    sel = (ds.get("_st").data == 1) & touse(s, p)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(sel)
    _st, t0_all, t_all, d_all = _st_arrays(s)
    org = _origin(s, info, n)
    # -- cut points of each selected record
    at = np.array([])
    rs_info = None
    if failures:
        svars = s.expand_varlist(str(o["strata"])) if isinstance(o.get("strata"), str) else []
        sg = group_ids(ds, svars, sel)[0] if svars else np.where(sel, 0, -1)
        ft = {int(h): np.unique(t_all[sel & (sg == h) & (d_all == 1)]) for h in np.unique(sg[sel])}
        ordered = sorted(ft)
        offs, tot = {}, 0
        for h in ordered:
            offs[h] = tot
            tot += len(ft[h])
        s.output.write(f"({tot} failure times)\n", "text")
        cuts = [ft[int(sg[i])] for i in rows]
        rs_info = (sg, ft, offs)
    else:
        if o.get("every"):
            step = float(s.eval(str(o["every"])))
            if not step > 0:
                raise StataError(198, "every() must be positive")   # VERIFY
            hi = float(t_all[rows].max()) if len(rows) else 0.0
            lo = float((_after_ref(s, info, str(o["after"]), rows, t_all, org)[rows]).min()) \
                if o.get("after") and len(rows) else 0.0
            at = np.arange(1, int(np.ceil((hi - lo) / step)) + 2) * step
        else:
            big = float(t_all[rows].max()) * 2 + 1e6 if len(rows) else 1e6
            at = np.array(parse_numlist(re.sub(r"\bmax\b", repr(big), at_txt)), dtype=np.float64)
            at = np.unique(at)
        ref = np.zeros(n)
        if o.get("after"):
            ref = _after_ref(s, info, str(o["after"]), rows, t_all, org)
        cuts = [ref[i] + at for i in rows]
    parent, a, b, last = SV.split_pieces(t0_all[rows], t_all[rows], cuts)
    parent_row = rows[parent]
    reps = np.ones(n, dtype=np.int64)
    reps[rows] = np.bincount(parent, minlength=len(rows))
    created = int(len(parent) - len(rows))
    # -- the new values of the pieces
    lab = None if failures or not newvar else SV.category_labels(b, cuts, parent, at)
    excl = np.zeros(len(parent), dtype=bool)
    if o.get("trim") and not failures:
        lo_c = np.array([c.min() for c in cuts])[parent]
        hi_c = np.array([c.max() for c in cuts])[parent]
        excl = (b <= lo_c) | (a >= hi_c)
    rsid = None
    if failures and o.get("riskset"):
        sg, ft, offs = rs_info
        rsid = np.full(len(parent), SYS)
        for j in range(len(parent)):
            h = int(sg[parent_row[j]])
            f = ft[h]
            k = np.searchsorted(f, b[j])
            if k < len(f) and f[k] == b[j]:
                rsid[j] = offs[h] + k + 1
    tv = ds.get(info.timevar).data.astype(np.float64)
    org_rec = tv - t_all * info.scale       # origin of each record, from the stored times
    src = np.repeat(np.arange(n), reps)
    pos = np.flatnonzero(np.repeat(sel, reps))
    fail_new = np.where(last, d_all[parent_row], 0.0)
    _take(ds, src)
    _put(ds, "_t", b, pos)
    _put(ds, "_t0", a, pos)
    _put(ds, "_d", fail_new, pos)
    nonlast = pos[~last]
    ot = org_rec[parent_row]
    _put(ds, info.timevar, (ot + b * info.scale)[~last], nonlast)
    if info.time0:
        first = a == t0_all[parent_row]
        _put(ds, info.time0, (ot + a * info.scale)[~first], pos[~first])
    if info.failvar and ds.has(info.failvar) and not last.all():
        _put(ds, info.failvar, np.zeros(int((~last).sum())), nonlast)   # VERIFY: censored value 0
    if excl.any():
        for nm, val in (("_st", 0.0), ("_d", SYS), ("_t", SYS), ("_t0", SYS)):
            _put(ds, nm, np.full(int(excl.sum()), val), pos[excl])
    if newvar:
        full = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        full[pos] = lab
        ds.add(Variable(newvar, "float", full.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64)))
    if rsid is not None:
        full = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        full[pos] = rsid
        ds.add(Variable(str(o["riskset"]).strip(), "float", full))
    s.output.write(f"({created} observations (episodes) created)\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stjoin
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _same_as_previous(ds: "Dataset", rows: np.ndarray, skip: set[str]) -> np.ndarray:
    """For rows in order: do all the variables not in `skip` have the values of the previous row?"""
    same = np.ones(max(len(rows) - 1, 0), dtype=bool)
    for v in ds.vars:
        if v.name in skip:
            continue
        x = v.raw[rows]
        same &= (x[1:] == x[:-1]) if not v.is_string else np.array([a == b for a, b in zip(x[1:], x[:-1])],
                                                                    dtype=bool)
    return same


def cmd_stjoin(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    _need_id(info, "stjoin")
    o = match_options(args.strip().lstrip(","), {"censored": 4}) if args.strip() else {}
    cens = None
    if isinstance(o.get("censored"), str):
        cens = np.array(parse_numlist(str(o["censored"])), dtype=np.float64)
    elif info.failvals is not None and info.failvar:
        cens = np.array([0.0])
    st_, t0, t, d = _st_arrays(s)
    rows, gid, _bounds = _subjects(s, info, np.flatnonzero(st_))
    censored = d == 0
    if cens is not None and info.failvar and ds.has(info.failvar):
        censored = censored & np.isin(ds.get(info.failvar).data.astype(np.float64), cens)
    skip = set(_ST_VARS) | {info.timevar, info.time0, info.failvar}
    skip.discard("")
    gid_all = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=np.int64)
    gid_all[rows] = gid
    same = _same_as_previous(ds, rows, skip)
    join = SV.join_chains(rows, gid_all, t0, t, censored, same)
    drop = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
    if join.any():
        # each chain keeps its first record, which takes the end of the last one
        head = np.arange(len(rows))
        for k in range(1, len(rows)):
            if join[k]:
                head[k] = head[k - 1]
        for k in np.flatnonzero(join):
            drop[rows[k]] = True
        for k in range(len(rows)):
            h = head[k]
            if h != k and (k + 1 == len(rows) or head[k + 1] != h):
                dst, srcr = rows[h], rows[k]
                for nm in ("_t", "_d", info.timevar, info.failvar):
                    if nm and ds.has(nm):
                        ds.get(nm).raw[dst] = ds.get(nm).raw[srcr]
    removed = ds.keep_obs(~drop)
    s.output.write(f"({removed} obs. eliminated)\n", "text")
    if not removed and not isinstance(o.get("censored"), str):
        s.output.write("(perhaps you need to specify stjoin's censored() option)\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stfill and stvary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _value_vectors(ds: "Dataset", name: str):
    v = ds.get(name)
    if v.is_string:
        x = np.array(v.raw, dtype=object)
        return x, np.array([a == "" for a in x], dtype=bool), True
    x = v.data.astype(np.float64)
    return x, x >= SYS, False


def cmd_stfill(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"baseline": 1, "forward": 1, "noshow": 6})
    if bool(o.get("baseline")) == bool(o.get("forward")):
        raise StataError(198, "must specify either baseline or forward")   # VERIFY
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    allowed = touse(s, p)
    rows, _gid, bounds = _subjects(s, info, np.flatnonzero(ds.get("_st").data == 1))
    if not o.get("noshow"):
        header(s, info)
    out = s.output
    out.write("replace all values with value at earliest observed:\n" if o.get("baseline")
              else "replace missing values with previously observed values:\n", "text")
    for nm in names:
        x, miss, is_str = _value_vectors(ds, nm)
        xs, ms = x[rows], miss[rows]
        new = xs.copy()
        if o.get("baseline"):
            for a, b in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                new[a:b] = xs[a]
        else:
            src = SV.fill_forward(xs, ms, bounds)
            fill = ms & (src >= 0)
            new[fill] = xs[src[fill]]
        full = x.copy()
        ok = allowed[rows]
        full[rows[ok]] = new[ok]
        changed = int(np.sum([a != b for a, b in zip(full, x)])) if is_str else int(np.sum(full != x))
        if changed:
            (ds.set_string if is_str else ds.set_numeric)(ds.get(nm), full)
        out.write(f"{nm:>16}:  {changed:,} real changes made\n", "text")   # VERIFY: layout
    s.notify_state()


def cmd_stvary(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"noshow": 6})
    mask = touse(s, p)
    if p.varlist.strip():
        names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    else:
        skip = set(_ST_VARS) | {info.idvar, info.failvar}   # VERIFY: variables left out without a varlist
        names = [v.name for v in ds.vars if v.name not in skip]
    rows, _gid, bounds = _subjects(s, info, np.flatnonzero((ds.get("_st").data == 1) & mask))
    if not o.get("noshow"):
        header(s, info)
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"{'':15}subjects for whom the variable is\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':49}never    always   sometimes\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'variable':>12} |  constant    varying{'':13}missing   missing   missing\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 62 + "\n", "text")
    last = (0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    for nm in names:
        x, miss, _ = _value_vectors(ds, nm)
        last = SV.subject_summary(x[rows], miss[rows], bounds)
        out.write(f"{nm[:12]:>12} |", "text")
        out.write("".join(f"{v:>{w}}" for v, w in zip(last, (10, 11, 20, 10, 10))) + "\n", "result")
    s.r = dict(zip(("cons", "varies", "never", "always", "miss"), (float(v) for v in last)))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stgen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TYPES = ("byte", "int", "long", "float", "double")
_NOARG = ("nfailures", "ngaps", "gaplen", "hasgap")
_FUNCS = ("ever", "never", "always", "min", "max", "when", "when0", "count", "count0", "minage", "maxage",
          "avgage") + _NOARG


def _time_bounds(s: "Session", info: STInfo, rows: np.ndarray):
    """Start and end of each record, in the units of the time variable."""
    ds = s.data
    t = ds.get("_t").data.astype(np.float64)
    t0 = ds.get("_t0").data.astype(np.float64)
    end = ds.get(info.timevar).data.astype(np.float64)
    org = end - t * info.scale
    start = ds.get(info.time0).data.astype(np.float64) if info.time0 else org + t0 * info.scale
    return start[rows], end[rows]


def cmd_stgen(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    left, eq, right = args.partition("=")
    toks = left.split()
    if not eq or not toks:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    vtype = "float"
    if toks[0] in _TYPES:
        vtype = toks.pop(0)
    if len(toks) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    newvar = toks[0]
    m = re.match(r"^\s*([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\((.*)\)\s*$", right.strip(), re.S)
    if not m or m.group(1) not in _FUNCS:
        raise StataError(198, f"{right.strip()} invalid function")   # VERIFY
    fn, arg = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()
    if fn in _NOARG and arg:
        raise StataError(198, f"{fn}() takes no arguments")   # VERIFY
    if fn not in _NOARG and not arg:
        raise StataError(198, f"{fn}() requires an expression")   # VERIFY
    if ds.has(newvar):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {newvar} already defined")
    rows, _gid, bounds = _subjects(s, info, np.flatnonzero(ds.get("_st").data == 1))
    _st, t0_all, t_all, d_all = _st_arrays(s)
    n = ds.nobs
    res_s = np.full(len(rows), SYS)
    if fn not in _NOARG:
        v = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, arg), dtype=np.float64), (n,))[rows]
        true = (v != 0) & (v < SYS)
    ng, gl = SV.gaps(t0_all[rows], t_all[rows], bounds)
    start, end = _time_bounds(s, info, rows)
    for a, b in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
        sl = slice(a, b)
        if fn == "ever":
            res_s[sl] = float(true[sl].any())
        elif fn == "never":
            res_s[sl] = float(not true[sl].any())
        elif fn == "always":
            res_s[sl] = float(true[sl].all())
        elif fn in ("min", "max"):
            good = v[sl][v[sl] < SYS]
            res_s[sl] = (good.min() if fn == "min" else good.max()) if len(good) else SYS
        elif fn in ("when", "when0"):
            hit = np.flatnonzero(true[sl])
            res_s[sl] = (end if fn == "when" else start)[sl][hit[0]] if len(hit) else SYS
        elif fn in ("count", "count0"):
            res_s[sl] = SV.cumulative_before(true[sl], np.array([0, b - a]), fn == "count0")
        elif fn in ("minage", "maxage", "avgage"):
            ref = {"minage": start, "maxage": end, "avgage": (start + end) / 2}[fn][sl]
            res_s[sl] = np.where(v[sl] < SYS, ref - v[sl], SYS)
        elif fn == "nfailures":
            f = (d_all[rows][sl] == 1).astype(float)
            res_s[sl] = np.cumsum(f) - f
        elif fn == "ngaps":
            res_s[sl] = ng[sl]
        elif fn == "gaplen":
            res_s[sl] = gl[sl]
        else:   # hasgap
            res_s[sl] = float(ng[b - 1] > 0)
    full = np.full(n, SYS)
    full[rows] = res_s
    ds.add(Variable(newvar, vtype, full))
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# snapspan
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_snapspan(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    p = parse_standard(args)
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) < 3:
        raise StataError(100 if not names else 102, "varlist required" if not names
                         else "too few variables specified")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"generate": 1, "replace": 1})
    if not isinstance(o.get("generate"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option generate() required")
    idv, tv = names[0], names[1]
    idv, tv = s.expand_varlist(idv)[0], s.expand_varlist(tv)[0]
    events = s.expand_varlist(" ".join(names[2:]))
    if ds.get(tv).is_string:
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    if ds.changed and not o.get("replace"):
        raise StataError(4, "no; data in memory would be lost")
    new0 = str(o["generate"]).strip()
    if ds.has(new0):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {new0} already defined")
    gid = group_ids(ds, [idv], None)[0]
    single = np.bincount(gid)[gid] == 1
    if single.any():
        s.output.write(f"note:  {int(single.sum())} obs. ({100 * single.mean():.1f}%) have only a single "
                       "record; they will be ignored\n", "text")
        if single.all():
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        ds.keep_obs(~single)
        gid = group_ids(ds, [idv], None)[0]
    tt = ds.get(tv).data.astype(np.float64)
    order = np.lexsort((tt, gid))
    _take(ds, order)
    gid, tt = gid[order], tt[order]
    prev = np.zeros(len(order), dtype=bool)
    prev[1:] = gid[1:] == gid[:-1]
    shift_src = np.where(prev, np.arange(len(order)) - 1, -1)
    keep = {idv, tv, *events}
    for v in ds.vars:
        if v.name in keep:
            continue
        old = v.raw.copy()
        if v.is_string:
            v.raw = np.array([old[j] if j >= 0 else "" for j in shift_src], dtype=object)
        else:
            from ..core import storage
            v.raw = np.where(shift_src >= 0, old[np.maximum(shift_src, 0)], storage.missing_raw(v.vtype)) \
                .astype(old.dtype)
    t0 = np.where(prev, tt[np.maximum(shift_src, 0)], SYS)
    tvar = ds.get(tv)
    ds.add(Variable(new0, tvar.vtype, t0, fmt=tvar.fmt), position=ds.index(tv))
    ds.sortlist = [idv, tv]
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stbase
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_stbase(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"at": 2, "gap": 3, "replace": 1, "noshow": 6, "nopreserve": 3})
    if ds.changed and not o.get("replace"):
        raise StataError(4, "no; data in memory would be lost")
    if o.get("gap") and not isinstance(o.get("at"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option gap() requires at()")   # VERIFY
    mask = touse(s, p)
    rows, gid, bounds = _subjects(s, info, np.flatnonzero((ds.get("_st").data == 1) & mask))
    if not o.get("noshow"):
        header(s, info)
    st_, t0_all, t_all, d_all = _st_arrays(s)
    if isinstance(o.get("at"), str):
        _stbase_at(s, info, o, rows, bounds, float(s.eval(str(o["at"]))))
        return
    if np.all(np.diff(bounds) == 1):
        s.output.write(f"nothing to do; data has one record per id({info.idvar}) and so is already "
                       "baseline\n", "text")
        return
    # -- baseline values, then the records that can be joined
    skip = set(_ST_VARS) | {info.timevar, info.time0, info.failvar, info.idvar}
    skip.discard("")
    for v in ds.vars:
        if v.name in skip:
            continue
        x = v.raw[rows].copy()
        for a, b in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
            x[a:b] = x[a]
        v.raw[rows] = x
    ng, _gl = SV.gaps(t0_all[rows], t_all[rows], bounds)
    after_fail = False
    for a, b in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
        d = d_all[rows][a:b]
        after_fail |= bool(d[:-1].any()) if b - a > 1 else False
    gid_all = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=np.int64)
    gid_all[rows] = gid
    same = np.ones(max(len(rows) - 1, 0), dtype=bool)
    join = SV.join_chains(rows, gid_all, t0_all, t_all, d_all == 0, same)
    drop = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
    head = np.arange(len(rows))
    for k in range(1, len(rows)):
        if join[k]:
            head[k] = head[k - 1]
            drop[rows[k]] = True
    for k in range(len(rows)):
        h = head[k]
        if h != k and (k + 1 == len(rows) or head[k + 1] != h):
            for nm in ("_t", "_d", info.timevar, info.failvar):
                if nm and ds.has(nm):
                    ds.get(nm).raw[rows[h]] = ds.get(nm).raw[rows[k]]
    ds.keep_obs(~drop)
    left = SV.group_bounds(gid[~drop[rows]])
    multi = bool(np.any(np.diff(left) > 1))
    out = s.output
    out.write("notes:\n", "text")
    k = 1
    out.write(f"{k}. {'there were gaps' if ng.any() else 'no gaps'}\n", "text")
    if after_fail:
        k += 1
        out.write(f"{k}. there were multiple failures or reentries after failures\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    if multi:
        k += 1
        out.write(f"{k}. baseline data has multiple records per id({info.idvar})\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    k += 1
    out.write(f"{k}. all records have covariate values at baseline\n", "text")
    s.notify_state()


def _stbase_at(s: "Session", info: STInfo, o: dict, rows: np.ndarray, bounds: np.ndarray, at: float) -> None:
    """stbase, at(#): one record per subject, as a cross-section at analysis time #."""
    ds = s.data
    _st, t0_all, t_all, d_all = _st_arrays(s)
    keep_rows, time0, gapv, tend, nfail = [], [], [], [], []
    ng, gl = SV.gaps(t0_all[rows], t_all[rows], bounds)
    for a, b in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
        entry = t0_all[rows][a:b].min()
        exits = t_all[rows][a:b]
        d = d_all[rows][a:b]
        fails = exits[(d == 1) & (exits <= at)]
        if entry >= at:
            continue
        if not len(fails) and exits.max() < at:
            continue
        keep_rows.append(rows[a])
        time0.append(entry)
        tend.append(min(exits.max(), at))
        nfail.append(float(len(fails)))
        gl_at = 0.0
        for k in range(a + 1, b):
            if t0_all[rows][k] > t_all[rows][k - 1] and t0_all[rows][k] < at:
                gl_at += min(t0_all[rows][k], at) - t_all[rows][k - 1]
        gapv.append(gl_at)
    keep = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
    keep[np.array(keep_rows, dtype=int)] = True
    # names of the new variables
    t0name = info.time0 or next(nm for nm in ("t0", "time0") if not ds.has(nm) or nm == info.time0)
    gapname = str(o["gap"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("gap"), str) else \
        next(nm for nm in ("gap", "gaptime") if not ds.has(nm))
    failname = info.failvar or next(nm for nm in ("failure", "d") if not ds.has(nm))
    tname = info.timevar
    vals = {t0name: np.array(time0), gapname: np.array(gapv), tname: np.array(tend), failname: np.array(nfail)}
    order = np.array(keep_rows, dtype=int)
    drop_names = [v.name for v in ds.vars if v.name in _ST_VARS]
    _take(ds, order)
    ds.drop_vars(drop_names)
    for nm, arr in vals.items():
        if ds.has(nm):
            ds.drop_vars([nm])
        ds.add(Variable(nm, "double" if nm == tname else "float", arr))
    ch = ds.chars.setdefault("_dta", {})
    for k in [k for k in ch if k.startswith("st_")] + ["_dta"]:
        ch.pop(k, None)
    s.output.write(f"data now cross-section at time {at:g}\n", "text")
    s.run_command(f"summarize {t0name} {gapname} {tname} {failname}")
    s.notify_state()
