"""tabulate (one- and two-way), tab1, tab2 and table ([R] tabulate, [R] table).

Layouts reproduced from Stata 14; undocumented details have the
VERIFY mark and cases in compat/do/0302_tabulate.do.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import itertools
import math
import re
import textwrap
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import stats as S
from ..core.dataset import Variable
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ._util import touse
from .data import _by_header
from .registry import command
from .summarize import by_groups, g9, weights

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# categorias
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _categories(s: "Session", v: Variable, mask: np.ndarray, *, missing: bool, nolabel: bool):
    """Distinct values (sorted, missing last) and the labels shown."""
    if v.is_string:
        vals = v.raw
        ok = mask if missing else mask & np.array([x != "" for x in vals], dtype=bool)
        cats = sorted(set(vals[ok].tolist()))
        if "" in cats:
            cats.remove("")
            cats.append("")
        labels = [c for c in cats]
        return cats, labels, ok
    x = v.data
    ok = mask if missing else mask & S.valid(x)
    cats = sorted(set(x[ok].tolist()))
    lab = s.data.value_labels.get(v.value_label, {}) if v.value_label and not nolabel else {}
    labels = []
    for c in cats:
        if c >= M.SYSMISS:
            labels.append(M.missing_name(c))
        elif c == int(c) and int(c) in lab:
            labels.append(lab[int(c)])
        else:
            labels.append(format_value(c, v.fmt, pad=False).strip())
    return cats, labels, ok


def _codes(v: Variable, cats: list) -> np.ndarray:
    """Category index of each observation (-1 outside)."""
    lookup = {c: k for k, c in enumerate(cats)}
    src = v.raw.tolist() if v.is_string else v.data.tolist()
    return np.array([lookup.get(x, -1) for x in src], dtype=np.int64)


def _header_lines(text: str, width: int) -> list[str]:
    """Variable label wrapped in lines as wide as the 1st column."""
    lines = textwrap.wrap(text, width) or [""]
    return lines[-2:] if len(lines) > 2 else lines   # VERIFY: at most two lines


def _fmt_freq(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else g9(x).strip()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# one-way
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _oneway(s: "Session", v: Variable, mask, w, wtype, o: dict) -> None:
    out = s.output
    cats, labels, ok = _categories(s, v, mask, missing=bool(o.get("missing")),
                                   nolabel=bool(o.get("nolabel")))
    codes = _codes(v, cats)
    ww = w if w is not None else np.ones(s.data.nobs)
    freq = np.zeros(len(cats))
    sel = ok & (codes >= 0)
    np.add.at(freq, codes[sel], ww[sel])
    total = float(freq.sum())
    if total == 0:
        out.write("no observations\n", "text")
        s.r = {"N": 0.0, "r": 0.0}
        return
    order = list(range(len(cats)))
    if o.get("sort"):
        order.sort(key=lambda k: -freq[k])
    title = v.label or v.name
    # the column fits all labels of the value label, even those absent from the data (_merge: 23
    # columns; observed in Stata 14)
    all_labels = []
    if v.value_label and not o.get("nolabel"):
        all_labels = list(s.data.value_labels.get(v.value_label, {}).values())
    W = max([11] + [len(lb) for lb in labels] + [len(lb) for lb in all_labels])
    W = min(W, 30)
    out.write("\n", "text")
    head = _header_lines(title, W)
    for k, line in enumerate(head):
        last = k == len(head) - 1
        out.write(f"{line:>{W}} |" + ("      Freq.     Percent        Cum." if last else "") + "\n", "text")
    sep = "-" * (W + 1) + "+" + "-" * 35 + "\n"
    out.write(sep, "text")
    cum = 0.0
    for k in order:
        cum += freq[k]
        out.write(f"{labels[k][:W]:>{W}} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{_fmt_freq(freq[k]):>11}{100 * freq[k] / total:>12.2f}{100 * cum / total:>12.2f}\n",
                  "result")
    out.write(sep, "text")
    out.write(f"{'Total':>{W}} |", "text")
    out.write(f"{_fmt_freq(total):>11}{100.0:>12.2f}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"N": total, "r": float(len(cats))}
    _store_mats(s, o, cell=freq[:, None], rows=cats, v=v)
    if o.get("generate"):
        stub = str(o["generate"]).strip()
        for k, c in enumerate(cats, start=1):
            col = np.where(codes == k - 1, 1.0, 0.0)
            col[~(mask & (S.valid(v.data) if not v.is_string else True))] = M.SYSMISS
            nv = Variable(f"{stub}{k}", "byte", col)
            nv.label = f"{v.name}=={labels[k - 1]}"
            s.data.add(nv)
        s.notify_state()


def _store_mats(s: "Session", o: dict, *, cell, rows, v, cols=None) -> None:
    from .matrix import Matrix, _store
    if o.get("matcell"):
        _store(s)[str(o["matcell"]).strip()] = Matrix(np.asarray(cell, dtype=np.float64))
    if o.get("matrow") and not v.is_string:
        _store(s)[str(o["matrow"]).strip()] = Matrix(np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)[:, None])
    if o.get("matcol") and cols is not None:
        _store(s)[str(o["matcol"]).strip()] = Matrix(np.asarray(cols, dtype=np.float64)[None, :])

# duas vias

def _twoway(s: "Session", rv: Variable, cv: Variable, mask, w, wtype, o: dict) -> None:
    out = s.output
    miss, nolab = bool(o.get("missing")), bool(o.get("nolabel"))
    rcats, rlabels, rok = _categories(s, rv, mask, missing=miss, nolabel=nolab)
    ccats, clabels, cok = _categories(s, cv, mask, missing=miss, nolabel=nolab)
    ok = rok & cok
    rc, cc = _codes(rv, rcats), _codes(cv, ccats)
    sel = ok & (rc >= 0) & (cc >= 0)
    ww = w if w is not None else np.ones(s.data.nobs)
    T = np.zeros((len(rcats), len(ccats)))
    np.add.at(T, (rc[sel], cc[sel]), ww[sel])
    N = float(T.sum())
    if N == 0:
        out.write("no observations\n", "text")
        s.r = {"N": 0.0}
        return
    rowt, colt = T.sum(1), T.sum(0)
    E = np.outer(rowt, colt) / N
    shows = []
    if not o.get("nofreq"):
        shows.append("frequency")
    if o.get("expected"):
        shows.append("expected frequency")
    if o.get("row"):
        shows.append("row percentage")
    if o.get("column"):
        shows.append("column percentage")
    if o.get("cell"):
        shows.append("cell percentage")
    if len(shows) > 1 and not o.get("nokey"):
        wkey = max(len(x) for x in shows)
        out.write("\n+" + "-" * (wkey + 2) + "+\n", "text")
        out.write("| " + "Key".ljust(wkey) + " |\n", "text")
        out.write("|" + "-" * (wkey + 2) + "|\n", "text")
        for x in shows:
            pad = wkey - len(x)          # odd leftover goes to the right (Stata 14)
            out.write("| " + " " * (pad // 2) + x + " " * (pad - pad // 2) + " |\n", "text")
        out.write("+" + "-" * (wkey + 2) + "+\n", "text")

    def values(i: int | None, j: int | None) -> list[str]:
        f = (T[i, j] if i is not None and j is not None else
             rowt[i] if i is not None else colt[j] if j is not None else N)
        rtot = rowt[i] if i is not None else N
        ctot = colt[j] if j is not None else N
        res = []
        for x in shows:
            if x == "frequency":
                res.append(_fmt_freq(f))
            elif x == "expected frequency":
                e = E[i, j] if i is not None and j is not None else f
                res.append(f"{e:.1f}")
            elif x == "row percentage":
                res.append(f"{100 * f / rtot:.2f}" if rtot else ".")
            elif x == "column percentage":
                res.append(f"{100 * f / ctot:.2f}" if ctot else ".")
            else:
                res.append(f"{100 * f / N:.2f}")
        return res

    W = min(30, max([10] + [len(x) for x in rlabels]))
    rtitle = rv.label or rv.name
    ctitle = cv.label or cv.name
    per_panel = max(1, (79 - (W + 2) - 11) // 11)   # VERIFY: splitting into panels
    ncol = len(ccats)
    for start in range(0, ncol, per_panel):
        cols = list(range(start, min(ncol, start + per_panel)))
        last_panel = cols[-1] == ncol - 1
        block = 11 * len(cols)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        rhead = _header_lines(rtitle, W)
        above = rhead[:-1] if len(rhead) > 1 else [""]
        for k, left in enumerate(above):
            # centered, an odd leftover space on the left (compat 1402)
            mid = " " * ((block - len(ctitle) + 1) // 2) + ctitle if k == len(above) - 1 else ""
            out.write(f"{left:>{W}} |{mid}\n", "text")
        lab = "".join(f"{clabels[j][:10]:>10} " for j in cols)
        tot = "|     Total" if last_panel else ""
        out.write(f"{rhead[-1]:>{W}} |" + lab + tot + "\n", "text")
        sep = "-" * (W + 1) + "+" + "-" * block + ("+" + "-" * 10 if last_panel else "") + "\n"
        out.write(sep, "text")
        for i in range(len(rcats)):
            cells = [values(i, j) for j in cols]
            tot = values(i, None)
            for line in range(len(shows)):
                label = rlabels[i][:W] if line == 0 else ""
                out.write(f"{label:>{W}} |", "text")
                out.write("".join(f"{c[line]:>10} " for c in cells), "result")
                if last_panel:
                    out.write("|", "text")
                    out.write(f"{tot[line]:>10} ", "result")
                out.write("\n", "text")
            if len(shows) > 1 and i < len(rcats) - 1:
                out.write(sep, "text")      # groups of rows separated by dashes
        out.write(sep, "text")
        cells = [values(None, j) for j in cols]
        tot = values(None, None)
        for line in range(len(shows)):
            label = "Total" if line == 0 else ""
            out.write(f"{label:>{W}} |", "text")
            out.write("".join(f"{c[line]:>10} " for c in cells), "result")
            if last_panel:
                out.write("|", "text")
                out.write(f"{tot[line]:>10} ", "result")
            out.write("\n", "text")
    s.r = {"N": N, "r": float(len(rcats)), "c": float(len(ccats))}
    _tests(s, T, E, N, o)
    _store_mats(s, o, cell=T, rows=rcats, v=rv, cols=ccats if not cv.is_string else None)


def _twoway_summarize(s: "Session", rv: Variable, cv: Variable, yname: str, mask, w, o: dict) -> None:
    """tabulate var1 var2, summarize(var3): mean, standard deviation and frequency of var3 in
    each cell ([R] tabulate, summarize(); layout VERIFY, case compat 0805)."""
    from ..estimation.anova import _g
    out = s.output
    yv = s.data.get(yname)
    if yv.is_string:
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    mask = mask & (yv.data < M.SYSMISS)
    miss, nolab = bool(o.get("missing")), bool(o.get("nolabel"))
    rcats, rlabels, rok = _categories(s, rv, mask, missing=miss, nolabel=nolab)
    ccats, clabels, cok = _categories(s, cv, mask, missing=miss, nolabel=nolab)
    rc, cc = _codes(rv, rcats), _codes(cv, ccats)
    sel = mask & rok & cok & (rc >= 0) & (cc >= 0)
    if not sel.any():
        out.write("no observations\n", "text")
        return
    y = yv.data.astype(float)
    ww = w if w is not None else np.ones(s.data.nobs)
    show = [k for k in ("means", "standard", "freq", "obs") if o.get(k)] or ["means", "standard", "freq"]
    for k in ("means", "standard", "freq", "obs"):
        if o.get("no" + k) and k in show:
            show.remove(k)
    names = {"means": "Means", "standard": "Standard Deviations", "freq": "Frequencies",
             "obs": "Number of Observations"}
    parts = [names[k] for k in show]
    what = parts[0] if len(parts) == 1 else ", ".join(parts[:-1]) + " and " + parts[-1]
    title = f"{what} of {yv.label or yv.name}"

    def values(rmask, cmask) -> list[str]:
        m_ = sel & rmask & cmask
        x, wx = y[m_], ww[m_]
        n = float(wx.sum())
        mean = float((wx * x).sum() / n) if n else M.SYSMISS
        sd = math.sqrt(float((wx * (x - mean) ** 2).sum()) / (n - 1)) if n > 1 else M.SYSMISS
        v = {"means": _g(mean), "standard": _g(sd), "freq": _fmt_freq(n), "obs": f"{int(m_.sum()):,}"}
        return [v[k] for k in show]

    every = np.ones(s.data.nobs, dtype=bool)
    W = min(30, max([10] + [len(x) for x in rlabels]))
    rtitle, ctitle = rv.label or rv.name, cv.label or cv.name
    per_panel = max(1, (79 - (W + 2) - 11) // 11)   # VERIFY: splitting into panels
    ncol = len(ccats)
    out.write("\n", "text")
    total_w = W + 2 + 11 * min(ncol, per_panel) + 11
    # centered over the table width plus 8 (compat 0805, 4 columns; VERIFY other widths)
    for line in _header_lines(title, 60):
        out.write(" " * max(0, (total_w + 8 - len(line)) // 2) + line + "\n", "text")
    for start in range(0, ncol, per_panel):
        cols = list(range(start, min(ncol, start + per_panel)))
        last_panel = cols[-1] == ncol - 1
        block = 11 * len(cols)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        rhead = _header_lines(rtitle, W)
        above = rhead[:-1] if len(rhead) > 1 else [""]
        for k, left in enumerate(above):
            # (block - 4) wide: 18 spaces before a 4-letter name over 4 columns (compat 0805)
            mid = " " * max(0, (block - 4 - len(ctitle)) // 2) + ctitle if k == len(above) - 1 else ""
            out.write(f"{left:>{W}} |{mid}\n", "text")
        lab = "".join(f"{clabels[j][:10]:>10} " for j in cols)
        out.write(f"{rhead[-1]:>{W}} |" + lab + ("|     Total" if last_panel else "") + "\n", "text")
        sep = "-" * (W + 1) + "+" + "-" * block + ("+" + "-" * 10 if last_panel else "") + "\n"
        out.write(sep, "text")
        groups = [(rlabels[i], rc == i) for i in range(len(rcats))] + [("Total", every)]
        for gi, (rlab, rmask) in enumerate(groups):
            if gi == len(groups) - 1:
                out.write(sep, "text")
            cells = [values(rmask, cc == j) for j in cols]
            tot = values(rmask, every)
            for line in range(len(show)):
                out.write(f"{(rlab[:W] if line == 0 else ''):>{W}} |", "text")
                out.write("".join(f"{c[line]:>10} " for c in cells), "result")
                if last_panel:
                    out.write("|", "text")
                    out.write(f"{tot[line]:>10} ", "result")
                out.write("\n", "text")
            if len(show) > 1 and gi < len(groups) - 2:
                out.write(sep, "text")


def _tests(s: "Session", T: np.ndarray, E: np.ndarray, N: float, o: dict) -> None:
    from scipy import stats as st
    out = s.output
    r, c = T.shape
    df = (r - 1) * (c - 1)
    lines = []
    if o.get("chi2") or o.get("all"):
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            chi2 = float(np.nansum((T - E) ** 2 / E))
        p = float(st.chi2.sf(chi2, df)) if df > 0 else M.SYSMISS
        lines.append((f"Pearson chi2({df})", f"{chi2:8.4f}", f"Pr = {p:5.3f}"))
        s.r.update({"chi2": chi2, "p": p})
    if o.get("lrchi2") or o.get("all"):
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            lr = float(2 * np.nansum(np.where(T > 0, T * np.log(T / E), 0.0)))
        p = float(st.chi2.sf(lr, df)) if df > 0 else M.SYSMISS
        lines.append((f"likelihood-ratio chi2({df})", f"{lr:8.4f}", f"Pr = {p:5.3f}"))
        s.r.update({"chi2_lr": lr, "p_lr": p})
    if o.get("v") or o.get("all"):
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            chi2 = float(np.nansum((T - E) ** 2 / E))
        V = math.sqrt(chi2 / (N * (min(r, c) - 1))) if min(r, c) > 1 else M.SYSMISS
        if r == 2 and c == 2:
            V = float((T[0, 0] * T[1, 1] - T[0, 1] * T[1, 0])
                      / math.sqrt(np.prod(T.sum(0)) * np.prod(T.sum(1))))
        lines.append(("Cramér's V", f"{V:8.4f}", ""))
        s.r["CramersV"] = V
    if o.get("gamma") or o.get("all"):
        g, ase = _gamma(T)
        lines.append(("gamma", f"{g:8.4f}", f"ASE = {ase:.3f}"))
        s.r.update({"gamma": g, "ase_gam": ase})
    if o.get("taub") or o.get("all"):
        tb, ase = _taub(T)
        lines.append(("Kendall's tau-b", f"{tb:8.4f}", f"ASE = {ase:.3f}"))
        s.r.update({"taub": tb, "ase_taub": ase})
    if lines:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        for name, value, extra in lines:
            out.write(f"{name:>25} = ", "text")
            gap = "  " if extra.startswith("ASE") else "   "
            out.write(value + (gap + extra if extra else "") + "\n", "result")
    if o.get("exact"):
        if np.any(T != np.trunc(T)):
            raise StataError(198, "exact requires frequency counts")   # VERIFY
        if not lines:
            out.write("\n", "text")
        if (r, c) == (2, 2):
            _, p2 = st.fisher_exact(T.astype(int))
            # 1-sided: in the observed direction (VERIFY)
            _, pl = st.fisher_exact(T.astype(int), alternative="less")
            _, pg = st.fisher_exact(T.astype(int), alternative="greater")
            p1 = min(pl, pg)
            out.write(f"{'Fisher' + chr(39) + 's exact':>25} = ", "text")
            out.write(f"{p2:>21.3f}\n", "result")
            out.write(f"{'1-sided Fisher' + chr(39) + 's exact':>25} = ", "text")
            out.write(f"{p1:>21.3f}\n", "result")
            s.r.update({"p_exact": float(p2), "p1_exact": float(p1)})
        else:
            p2 = fisher_rxc(T.astype(int))
            # VERIFY: Stata first prints the progress of the network algorithm ("Enumerating
            # sample-space combinations:", "stage k: enumerations = #"), which OpenDTA does not
            # reproduce
            out.write(f"{'Fisher' + chr(39) + 's exact':>25} = ", "text")
            out.write(f"{p2:>21.3f}\n", "result")
            s.r["p_exact"] = float(p2)


def fisher_rxc(T: np.ndarray, limit: int = 5_000_000) -> float:
    """Fisher's exact test for r x c tables: adds the probabilities
    (multivariate hypergeometric) of the tables with the same margins and
    probability less than or equal to the observed one, enumerating them one by one."""
    from math import lgamma
    rows = [int(x) for x in T.sum(1)]
    cols = [int(x) for x in T.sum(0)]
    n = sum(rows)
    const = sum(lgamma(x + 1) for x in rows) + sum(lgamma(x + 1) for x in cols) - lgamma(n + 1)

    def logp(table_cells) -> float:
        return const - sum(lgamma(x + 1) for x in table_cells)

    obs = logp(T.ravel().tolist())
    tol = 1e-7
    total = 0.0
    count = [0]
    r, c = len(rows), len(cols)

    def fill_row(i: int, colrem: list[int], acc: float) -> None:
        nonlocal total
        if i == r - 1:
            cells = colrem
            if sum(cells) != rows[i]:
                return
            lp = acc - sum(lgamma(x + 1) for x in cells)
            count[0] += 1
            if count[0] > limit:
                raise StataError(908, "table too large for the exact test; "
                                      "OpenDTA enumerates every table with the same margins")
            if lp <= obs + tol:
                total += math.exp(lp)
            return

        def place(j: int, left: int, cur: list[int], colrem: list[int]) -> None:
            if j == c - 1:
                if left <= colrem[j]:
                    row_cells = cur + [left]
                    rest = [colrem[k] - row_cells[k] for k in range(c)]
                    fill_row(i + 1, rest, acc - sum(lgamma(x + 1) for x in row_cells))
                return
            hi = min(left, colrem[j])
            for x in range(hi + 1):
                place(j + 1, left - x, cur + [x], colrem)
        place(0, rows[i], [], colrem)

    fill_row(0, cols, const)
    return min(1.0, total)


def _concordance(T: np.ndarray):
    r, c = T.shape
    P = Q = 0.0
    A = np.zeros_like(T)    # concordant pairs for each cell
    D = np.zeros_like(T)
    for i in range(r):
        for j in range(c):
            A[i, j] = T[:i, :j].sum() + T[i + 1:, j + 1:].sum()
            D[i, j] = T[:i, j + 1:].sum() + T[i + 1:, :j].sum()
    P = float((T * A).sum())
    Q = float((T * D).sum())
    return P, Q, A, D


def _gamma(T: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    P, Q, A, D = _concordance(T)
    if P + Q == 0:
        return M.SYSMISS, M.SYSMISS
    g = (P - Q) / (P + Q)
    ase = 4 / (P + Q) ** 2 * math.sqrt(float((T * (Q * A - P * D) ** 2).sum()))
    return g, ase


def _taub(T: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    P, Q, A, D = _concordance(T)
    n = T.sum()
    wr = n ** 2 - float((T.sum(1) ** 2).sum())
    wc = n ** 2 - float((T.sum(0) ** 2).sum())
    if wr <= 0 or wc <= 0:
        return M.SYSMISS, M.SYSMISS
    w = math.sqrt(wr * wc)
    tb = (P - Q) / w
    # ASE (Agresti); VERIFY contra o Stata
    rows, cols = T.sum(1), T.sum(0)
    vij = np.zeros_like(T)
    for i in range(T.shape[0]):
        for j in range(T.shape[1]):
            vij[i, j] = 2 * w * (A[i, j] - D[i, j]) + tb * (rows[i] * wc + cols[j] * wr)
    ase = math.sqrt(max(0.0, float((T * vij ** 2).sum()) - n ** 3 * tb ** 2 * (wr + wc) ** 2)) / w ** 2
    return tb, ase

def _opts(text: str) -> dict:
    # Cramér's option is capital V
    return match_options(re.sub(r"\bV\b", "v", text), _OPTS) if text.strip() else {}


_OPTS = {"missing": 1, "nolabel": 5, "sort": 4, "generate": 3, "matcell": 7, "matrow": 6,
         "matcol": 7, "chi2": 2, "lrchi2": 3, "v": 1, "gamma": 1, "taub": 2, "exact": 2,
         "row": 1, "column": 3, "cell": 4, "expected": 5, "nofreq": 5, "nokey": 5, "all": 3,
         "plot": 4, "subpop": 3, "wrap": 4, "nolog": 5, "firstonly": 5,
         "summarize": 2, "means": 2, "standard": 2, "freq": 2, "obs": 2, "nomeans": 3,
         "nostandard": 4, "noobs": 4}


@command("tabulate", "ta", byable=True)
def cmd_tabulate(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = _opts(p.options)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not 1 <= len(names) <= 2:
        raise StataError(103 if len(names) > 2 else 100,
                         "too many variables specified" if len(names) > 2 else "varlist required")
    base = touse(s, p)
    w, wtype, base = weights(s, p, base, ("fweight", "aweight", "iweight"))
    vs = [s.data.get(n) for n in names]
    for group, first in by_groups(s):
        if first is not None:
            _by_header(s, first)
        mask = base & group
        if isinstance(o.get("summarize"), str):
            yname = s.expand_varlist(o["summarize"])[0]
            if len(vs) == 2:
                _twoway_summarize(s, vs[0], vs[1], yname, mask, w, o)
            else:
                from ..estimation.anova import tab_summarize
                tab_summarize(s, vs[0], yname, mask, w, o)
        elif len(vs) == 1:
            _oneway(s, vs[0], mask, w, wtype, o)
        else:
            _twoway(s, vs[0], vs[1], mask, w, wtype, o)


@command("tab1")
def cmd_tab1(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = _opts(p.options)
    base = touse(s, p)
    w, wtype, base = weights(s, p, base, ("fweight", "aweight", "iweight"))
    for n in s.expand_varlist(p.varlist):
        s.output.write(f"\n-> tabulation of {n}  \n", "text")
        _oneway(s, s.data.get(n), base, w, wtype, o)


@command("tab2")
def cmd_tab2(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = _opts(p.options)
    base = touse(s, p)

    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    for i in range(len(names)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(names)):
            s.output.write(f"\n-> tabulation of {names[i]} by {names[j]}  \n", "text")
            _twoway(s, s.data.get(names[i]), s.data.get(names[j]), base, w, wtype, o)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# table (Stata 14 syntax)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_STATS = {"freq", "mean", "sd", "sum", "rawsum", "count", "n", "max", "min", "median", "iqr",
          "p1", "p2", "p5", "p10", "p25", "p50", "p75", "p90", "p95", "p98", "p99"}


def _stat_value(stat: str, x: np.ndarray, w: np.ndarray | None) -> float:
    if stat in ("count", "n"):
        return float(len(x))
    if len(x) == 0:
        return M.SYSMISS
    m = S.moments(x, w, "fweight" if w is not None else "")
    if stat == "mean":
        return m.mean
    if stat == "sd":
        return m.sd
    if stat in ("sum", "rawsum"):
        return float(m.sum)
    if stat == "max":
        return m.max
    if stat == "min":
        return m.min
    xs = np.sort(x)
    if stat == "median":
        return S.percentile(xs, 50)
    if stat == "iqr":
        return S.percentile(xs, 75) - S.percentile(xs, 25)
    if stat.startswith("p"):
        return S.percentile(xs, float(stat[1:]))
    return M.SYSMISS


@command("table", byable=True)
def cmd_table(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """table rowvar [colvar [supercolvar]] [, contents() by(superrowvars) row col scol ...].
    The layout of supercolumns and by() groups is VERIFY (compat 1911)."""
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"contents": 1, "format": 1, "row": 3, "col": 3, "scol": 4,
                                  "missing": 1, "by": 2, "center": 3, "left": 4, "cellwidth": 5,
                                  "stubwidth": 5}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not 1 <= len(names) <= 3:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    bynames = s.expand_varlist(str(o["by"])) if o.get("by") not in (None, True) else []
    if len(bynames) > 4:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")             # VERIFY
    contents = str(o.get("contents", "freq")).split()
    specs: list[tuple[str, str | None]] = []
    k = 0
    while k < len(contents):
        st = contents[k]
        if st not in _STATS:
            raise StataError(198, f"{st} invalid statistic")   # VERIFY
        if st == "freq":
            specs.append(("freq", None))
            k += 1
        else:
            specs.append((st, s.expand_varlist(contents[k + 1])[0]))
            k += 2
    if len(specs) > 5:
        raise StataError(198, "too many statistics")
    fmt = str(o.get("format", "%9.0g")).strip()
    base = touse(s, p)
    w, wtype, base = weights(s, p, base, ("fweight", "aweight", "iweight", "pweight"))
    out = s.output
    miss = bool(o.get("missing"))

    def cats_of(name: str):
        v = s.data.get(name)
        cats, labels, ok = _categories(s, v, base, missing=miss, nolabel=False)
        return v, labels, _codes(v, cats), ok

    rv, rlabels, rc, ok = cats_of(names[0])
    if len(names) >= 2:
        cv, clabels, cc, cok = cats_of(names[1])
        ok = ok & cok
    else:
        cv, clabels, cc = None, [""], np.zeros(s.data.nobs, dtype=np.int64)
    if len(names) == 3:
        sv, slabels, sc, sok = cats_of(names[2])
        ok = ok & sok
    else:
        sv, slabels, sc = None, [""], np.zeros(s.data.nobs, dtype=np.int64)
    byinfo = []
    for n in bynames:
        bv, blabels, bc, bok = cats_of(n)
        ok = ok & bok
        byinfo.append((bv, blabels, bc))
    # by() groups: every combination of the values of the by() variables, empty ones included
    # (compat 1911)
    keys = list(itertools.product(*[range(len(bl)) for _, bl, _ in byinfo]))

    def cell(sel: np.ndarray) -> list[str]:
        if not sel.any():
            return [""] * len(specs)          # a cell without observations is blank (compat 1911)
        res = []
        for st, var in specs:
            if st == "freq":
                n = float((w[sel] if w is not None else np.ones(int(sel.sum()))).sum())
                # format() applies to the frequencies too (compat 1911)
                res.append(format_value(n, fmt, pad=False).strip() if "format" in o else _fmt_freq(n))
            else:
                x = s.data.get(var).data
                ss = sel & S.valid(x)
                val = _stat_value(st, x[ss], w[ss] if w is not None else None)
                res.append("" if val >= M.SYSMISS else format_value(val, fmt, pad=False).strip())
        return res

    # columns: (supercolumn, column) pairs; "T" is a total
    sgroups = list(range(len(slabels))) + (["T"] if o.get("scol") and sv is not None else [])
    cols_in = list(range(len(clabels))) + (["T"] if o.get("col") and cv is not None else [])
    cols = [(g, c) for g in sgroups for c in cols_in]

    def colsel(g, c) -> np.ndarray:
        m = ok
        if g != "T" and sv is not None:
            m = m & (sc == g)
        if c != "T" and cv is not None:
            m = m & (cc == c)
        return m

    rows = list(range(len(rlabels))) + (["T"] if o.get("row") else [])
    grids = []
    for key in keys:
        gsel = ok.copy()
        for (_, _, bc), code in zip(byinfo, key):
            gsel &= bc == code
        present = rows                   # every row, empty ones included (compat 1911)
        grid = {}
        for r in present:
            rsel = gsel & (rc == r) if r != "T" else gsel
            if cv is None:
                grid[r] = [cell(rsel)]            # one line, the statistics side by side
                continue
            vals = [cell(rsel & colsel(g, c)) for g, c in cols]
            grid[r] = [[v[line] for v in vals] for line in range(len(specs))]
        grids.append((key, present, grid))

    if cv is None:
        heads = ["Freq." if st == "freq" else f"{st}({var})" for st, var in specs]
    else:
        heads = [clabels[c] if c != "T" else "Total" for _, c in cols]
    every = heads + [x for _, pr, gr in grids for r in pr for line in gr[r] for x in line]
    # one-way tables have cells at least 10 wide (compat 0302, 1911; VERIFY)
    CW = max([4 if cv is not None else 10] + [len(x) for x in every])
    parts = [b.label or b.name for b, _, _ in byinfo] + [rv.label or rv.name]
    stub_title = parts[0] if len(parts) == 1 else ", ".join(parts[:-1]) + " and " + parts[-1]
    W = max([9] + [len(x) for x in rlabels] + [len(rv.name)] + [len(x) for _, bl, _ in byinfo for x in bl])   # VERIFY minimum width 9
    title_lines = textwrap.wrap(stub_title, W) or [rv.name]
    per = len(cols_in) if sv is not None else 0

    def gap(k: int) -> str:
        # supercolumns are 4 blanks apart (compat 1911)
        return " " if k == 0 else "    " if per and k % per == 0 else "  "

    def row_text(values: list[str]) -> str:
        from ..core.layout import center_text
        if o.get("center"):
            return "".join(gap(k) + center_text(v, CW) for k, v in enumerate(values))
        return "".join(gap(k) + f"{v:>{CW}}" for k, v in enumerate(values))

    block = len(row_text([""] * len(heads if cv is None else cols)))
    width = W + 2 + block
    rule = "-" * (W + 1) + "+" + "-" * block + "\n"
    out.write("\n" + "-" * width + "\n", "text")
    if cv is None:
        head_lines = [row_text(heads)]
    else:
        ctitle = cv.label or cv.name
        if sv is not None:
            ctitle = f"{sv.label or sv.name} and {ctitle}"
        left = -(-(block - len(ctitle)) // 2)
        head_lines = [" " * max(0, left) + ctitle]
        if sv is not None:
            # each supercolumn: its label centered in a dashed line over its columns
            n = len(cols_in)
            gw = n * CW + 2 * (n - 1)
            parts = []
            for g in sgroups:
                lab = f" {slabels[g] if g != 'T' else 'Total'} "
                dl = max(0, gw - len(lab))
                # the extra dash goes on the left (compat 1911)
                parts.append("-" * (dl - dl // 2) + lab + "-" * (dl // 2))
            head_lines.append(" " + "    ".join(parts))
        head_lines.append(row_text(heads))
    # the stub title sits at the bottom of the header lines, right-aligned on one line and
    # left-aligned when it wraps (compat 1911)
    n = max(len(title_lines), len(head_lines))
    for t, h in zip([""] * (n - len(title_lines)) + title_lines, [""] * (n - len(head_lines)) + head_lines):
        out.write((f"{t:<{W}}" if len(title_lines) > 1 else f"{t:>{W}}") + " |" + h + "\n", "text")
    out.write(rule, "text")
    for gk, (key, present, grid) in enumerate(grids):
        if gk:
            out.write(rule, "text")
        for code, (_, lab, _) in zip(key, byinfo):
            out.write(f"{lab[code]:<{W}} |\n", "text")         # one line per by() variable
        for ri, r in enumerate(present):
            # a blank line before the total and between rows of several lines (compat 1911)
            if ri and (r == "T" or len(grid[r]) > 1):
                out.write(" " * W + " |\n", "text")
            for line in range(len(grid[r])):
                label = (rlabels[r] if r != "T" else "Total") if line == 0 else ""
                out.write(f"{label:>{W}} |", "text")
                out.write(row_text(grid[r][line]) + "\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * width + "\n", "text")

"""Time-series data tools: tsappend, tsfill, tsreport and the rolling prefix ([TS] tsappend,
[TS] tsfill, [TS] tsreport, [TS] rolling).

The layouts of tsreport and rolling follow the manual's examples; the alignment of the lines the
manual shows only as text is marked VERIFY (compat/do/1904_timeseries.do)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..estimation.tsops import _fmt_time, require_ts
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options
from .registry import command
from .tshelp import append_periods, kv, panels, to_nan

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# tsappend, tsfill
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_MONTHS = ["jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "may", "jun", "jul", "aug", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dec"]


def date_literal(text: str, fmt: str) -> float:
    """The integer of a date literal of the given %t function (td, tw, tm, tq, th, ty)."""
    import datetime as dt
    t = text.strip().lower()
    f = fmt.strip().lower().lstrip("%")
    try:
        if f == "td":
            m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})([a-z]{3})(\d{4})", t)
            d = dt.date(int(m.group(3)), _MONTHS.index(m.group(2)) + 1, int(m.group(1)))
            return float((d - dt.date(1960, 1, 1)).days)
        if f in ("tw", "tm", "tq", "th"):
            letter = f[1]
            y, n = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})" + letter + r"(\d+)", t).groups()
            per = {"w": 52, "m": 12, "q": 4, "h": 2}[letter]
            return float((int(y) - 1960) * per + int(n) - 1)
        if f == "ty":
            return float(int(t) - 1960)
    except (AttributeError, ValueError):
        raise StataError(198, f"{text} invalid date for {fmt}")
    raise StataError(198, f"tsfmt({fmt}) is not available in OpenDTA")


@command("tsappend", "tsa")
def cmd_tsappend(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    opts = args[c + 1:] if c != -1 else ""
    o = match_options(opts, {"add": 3, "last": 4, "tsfmt": 3, "panel": 5}) if opts.strip() else {}
    if isinstance(o.get("add"), str) == isinstance(o.get("last"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option add() or last() required")
    delta = info.delta
    only = None
    if isinstance(o.get("panel"), str):
        only = float(s.eval(o["panel"]))
    entries: list[tuple[float | None, float]] = []
    for pv, rows, t in panels(s):
        if only is not None and pv != only:
            continue
        if not len(t):
            continue
        tl = float(t.max())
        if isinstance(o.get("add"), str):
            k = int(float(s.eval(o["add"])))
            if k < 1:
                raise StataError(198, "add() must be positive")
            entries += [(pv, tl + delta * i) for i in range(1, k + 1)]
        else:
            if not isinstance(o.get("tsfmt"), str):
                raise StataError(198, "option tsfmt() required with last()")
            last = date_literal(str(o["last"]), o["tsfmt"])
            entries += [(pv, x) for x in np.arange(tl + delta, last + delta / 2, delta)]
    append_periods(s, entries)
    kv(s, [("add", float(len(entries)))])
    s.notify_state()


@command("tsfill", "tsf")
def cmd_tsfill(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    o = match_options(args.lstrip(", "), {"full": 1}) if args.strip() else {}
    delta = info.delta
    groups = panels(s)
    if o.get("full") and info.panel:
        gmin = min(float(t.min()) for _p, _r, t in groups if len(t))
        gmax = max(float(t.max()) for _p, _r, t in groups if len(t))
    entries = []
    for pv, rows, t in groups:
        if not len(t):
            continue
        lo, hi = (gmin, gmax) if (o.get("full") and info.panel) else (float(t.min()), float(t.max()))
        have = set(np.round(t / delta).astype(np.int64).tolist())
        for x in np.arange(lo, hi + delta / 2, delta):
            if int(round(x / delta)) not in have:
                entries.append((pv, float(x)))
    append_periods(s, entries)
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# tsreport
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _gaps(ds, info, rows_by_panel, include_panel_changes: bool):
    """[(row_before, row_after, panel, start, end, nobs)] for consecutive rows that are more
    than one period apart; a panel change counts as a gap (with the period after the end of the
    panel and no end)."""
    t = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    out = []
    prev = None
    for pv, rows in rows_by_panel:
        if prev is not None and include_panel_changes and len(rows):
            out.append((prev[1], int(rows[0]), prev[0], prev[2] + info.delta, None, None))
        for a, b in zip(rows[:-1], rows[1:]):
            if t[b] - t[a] > info.delta + 1e-9:
                n = int(round((t[b] - t[a]) / info.delta)) - 1
                out.append((int(a), int(b), pv, t[a] + info.delta, t[b] - info.delta, n))
        if len(rows):
            prev = (pv, int(rows[-1]), float(t[rows[-1]]))
    return out


def _block(s: "Session", lines: list[tuple[str, str]], width: int = 15) -> None:
    for lab, val in lines:
        s.output.write(f"{lab:>{width}}{val}\n", "text")


def _report_block(s, info, head, lo, hi, n, ng, fmt):
    """Stata's layout of one tsreport block (no panel variable)."""
    w = max(7, len(fmt(lo)), len(fmt(hi)), len(str(n)), len(str(ng)))
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if head:
        out.write(f"{head[0]:<18}{head[1]}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Time variable:':<18}{info.tvar}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * (18 + w) + "\n", "text")
    for lab, val in (("Starting period", fmt(lo)), ("Ending period", fmt(hi)),
                     ("Observations", str(n)), ("Number of gaps", str(ng))):
        out.write(f"{lab:<15} = {val:>{w}}\n", "text")


def _report_gaps(s, gl, fmt):
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nGap report\n" + "-" * 50 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Obs.':<13}|{'Start':>11}{'End':>12}{'N. Obs.':>13}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 36 + "\n", "text")
    for a, b, _pv, st_, en, n in gl:
        out.write(f"{f'{a + 1}--{b + 1}':>13}|{fmt(st_):>11}{(fmt(en) if en is not None else '.'):>12}"
                  f"{(str(n) if n is not None else '.'):>13}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 50 + "\n", "text")


@command("tsreport", "tsrep")
def cmd_tsreport(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ._util import touse
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    ds = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds)
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"detail": 1, "casewise": 1, "panel": 5}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = []
    for tok in p.varlist.split():
        names += s.expand_varlist(tok) if ("*" in tok or "?" in tok or ds.has(tok)) else [tok]
    sample = touse(s, p)
    detail, casewise, nopanel = bool(o.get("detail")), bool(o.get("casewise")), bool(o.get("panel"))
    fmt = lambda x: _fmt_time(ds, info.tvar, x)
    t = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    out = s.output

    def groups_for(mask):
        return [(pv, rows) for pv, rows, _t in panels(s, mask)]

    def head(mask, label_lines):
        rows_all = np.flatnonzero(mask & (t < SYS))
        tt = t[rows_all]
        gl = _gaps(ds, info, groups_for(mask), info.panel != "" and not nopanel)
        lines = list(label_lines) + [
            ("Time variable: ", info.tvar) if not info.panel else (" Time variable: ", info.tvar),
            ("Starting period = ", fmt(tt.min())), ("  Ending period = ", fmt(tt.max())),
            ("   Observations = ", f"{len(rows_all)}"), (" Number of gaps = ", f"{len(gl)}")]
        return gl, lines, rows_all, tt

    def gap_table(gl):
        out.write("Gap report\n", "text")
        cols = ["Obs.", info.panel, "Start", "End", "N. Obs."] if info.panel else \
            ["Obs.", "Start", "End", "N. Obs."]
        head_ = f"{'Obs.':>12}" + (f"{info.panel[:12]:>13}" if info.panel else "") + \
            f"{'Start':>22}{'End':>22}{'N. Obs.':>9}"
        del cols
        out.write(head_ + "\n", "text")
        for a, b, pv, st_, en, n in gl:
            line = f"{a + 1:>6}{b + 1:>6}"
            if info.panel:
                line += f"{pv:>13g}"
            line += f"{fmt(st_):>22}{(fmt(en) if en is not None else '.'):>22}{(str(n) if n is not None else '.'):>9}"
            out.write(line + "\n", "result")

    if not names or casewise:
        mask = sample.copy()
        for nm in names:
            mask &= ~np.isnan(to_nan(ds.get(nm).data))
        if names:
            lab = "Variables: " + (" and ".join(names) if len(names) <= 2 else ", ".join(names))
        pre = []
        if info.panel:
            pre.append(("Panel variable: ", info.panel))
        if names:
            out.write(lab + "\n", "text")
        gl, lines, rows_all, tt = head(mask, pre)
        if info.panel:
            _block(s, lines)
        else:
            _report_block(s, info, None, tt.min(), tt.max(), len(rows_all), len(gl), fmt)
        if info.panel and not nopanel:
            out.write("(Gap count includes panel changes)\n", "text")
        if detail and gl:
            gap_table(gl) if info.panel else _report_gaps(s, gl, fmt)
        from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
        pairs = [("N_gaps", float(len(gl))), ("N_obs", float(len(rows_all))),
                 ("start", float(tt.min())), ("end", float(tt.max())),
                 ("tsfmt", ds.get(info.tvar).fmt)]
        if detail and gl:
            tab = np.array([[g[3], g[4] if g[4] is not None else np.nan] for g in gl])
            pairs.append(("table", Matrix(np.where(np.isnan(tab), SYS, tab), [str(i + 1) for i in range(len(gl))],
                                          ["start", "end"])))
        kv(s, pairs)
        return
    # one report per variable
    pairs = []
    summary = []
    for k, nm in enumerate(names, start=1):
        v = to_nan(ds.get(nm).data)
        mask = sample & ~np.isnan(v)
        gl = _gaps(ds, info, groups_for(mask), info.panel != "" and not nopanel)
        rows_all = np.flatnonzero(mask & (t < SYS))
        tt = t[rows_all]
        if not len(tt):
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        summary.append((nm, tt.min(), tt.max(), len(rows_all), len(gl), gl))
        pairs += [(f"N_gaps{k}", float(len(gl))), (f"N_obs{k}", float(len(rows_all))),
                  (f"start{k}", float(tt.min())), (f"end{k}", float(tt.max())), (f"var{k}", nm)]
    if detail:
        for nm, lo, hi, n, ng, gl in summary:
            if not info.panel:
                _report_block(s, info, ("Variable:", nm), lo, hi, n, ng, fmt)
                if gl:
                    _report_gaps(s, gl, fmt)
                continue
            out.write(f"Variable: {nm}\n", "text")
            lines = ([("Panel variable: ", info.panel)] if info.panel else []) + \
                [(" Time variable: ", info.tvar), ("Starting period = ", fmt(lo)),
                 ("  Ending period = ", fmt(hi)), ("   Observations = ", f"{n}"),
                 (" Number of gaps = ", f"{ng}")]
            _block(s, lines)
            if gl:
                gap_table(gl)
    else:
        out.write("Gap summary report\n", "text")
        w = max(8, max(len(x[0]) for x in summary) + 1)
        out.write(f"{'':<{w}}{'':>22}{'':>22}{'Number of':>11}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Variable':<{w}}{'Start':>22}{'End':>22}{'Obs.':>7}{'Gaps':>6}\n", "text")
        for nm, lo, hi, n, ng, gl in summary:
            out.write(f"{nm:<{w}}{fmt(lo):>22}{fmt(hi):>22}{n:>7}{ng:>6}\n", "result")
    pairs.append(("tsfmt", ds.get(info.tvar).fmt))
    kv(s, pairs)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rolling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_ROLL = {"window": 1, "recursive": 3, "rrecursive": 2, "stepsize": 4, "start": 5, "end": 3,
         "keep": 4, "clear": 5, "saving": 6, "nodots": 5, "dots": 4, "noisily": 3, "trace": 5,
         "reject": 3, "force": 5, "double": 6}


def cmd_rolling(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..estimation.bootstrap import _evaluate, _subset, parse_exp_list
    from ..estimation.resample import _dot, _dots, _named, _quiet, _run0, _split
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    from ._util import touse
    ds0 = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds0)
    head, opt_text, command_ = _split(args)
    ifin = ""
    for kw in (" if ", " in "):
        c = find_top(head, kw)
        if c != -1:
            ifin = head[c:]
            head = head[:c]
            break
    o = match_options(opt_text, _ROLL) if opt_text.strip() else {}
    if not isinstance(o.get("window"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option window() required")
    window = int(float(s.eval(o["window"])))
    if window < 1:
        raise StataError(198, "window() must be positive")
    step = int(float(s.eval(o["stepsize"]))) if isinstance(o.get("stepsize"), str) else 1
    if o.get("recursive") and o.get("rrecursive"):
        raise StataError(198, "options recursive and rrecursive may not be combined")
    items = _named(parse_exp_list(head), "_stat_")
    out = s.output
    noisy = bool(o.get("noisily")) or bool(o.get("trace"))
    cmdname, eclass, e0, est0 = _run0(s, command_, noisy)
    if not items:
        if eclass:
            items = [("", "_b")]
        else:
            items = [(k, f"r({k})") for k, v in s.r.items() if isinstance(v, (int, float))]
            if not items:
                raise StataError(198, "expression list required")
    names, _obs = _evaluate(s, items)
    ds = s.data
    delta = info.delta
    p = parse_standard("x" + ifin)
    base_mask = touse(s, p)
    t = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    tt = t[base_mask & (t < SYS)]
    if not len(tt):
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    first = float(s.eval(o["start"])) if isinstance(o.get("start"), str) else float(tt.min())
    last = float(s.eval(o["end"])) if isinstance(o.get("end"), str) else float(tt.max())
    wins = []
    if o.get("recursive"):
        e = first + (window - 1) * delta
        while e <= last + 1e-9:
            wins.append((first, e))
            e += step * delta
    elif o.get("rrecursive"):
        b = last - (window - 1) * delta
        while b >= first - 1e-9:
            wins.append((b, last))
            b -= step * delta
        wins.reverse()
    else:
        b = first
        while b + (window - 1) * delta <= last + 1e-9:
            wins.append((b, b + (window - 1) * delta))
            b += step * delta
    if not wins:
        raise StataError(198, "window() too large for the sample")      # VERIFY
    keepvar, keep_start = None, False
    if isinstance(o.get("keep"), str):
        kv_, _, kopt = o["keep"].partition(",")
        keepvar, keep_start = kv_.strip(), kopt.strip().startswith("start")
        if not ds.has(keepvar):
            raise StataError(111, f"variable {keepvar} not found")
    out.write(f"(running {cmdname} on estimation sample)\n", "text")
    r0 = dict(s.r)
    nwin = len(wins)
    R = np.full((nwin, len(names)), np.nan)
    kcol = np.full(nwin, np.nan)
    dots = _dots(s, "Rolling replications", nwin, {"nodots": o.get("nodots") or noisy})
    reject = str(o["reject"]) if isinstance(o.get("reject"), str) else None
    try:
        for r, (wb, we) in enumerate(wins):
            sel = np.flatnonzero(base_mask & (t >= wb - 1e-9) & (t <= we + 1e-9))
            s.data = _subset(ds, sel)
            ok = True
            try:
                _quiet(s, command_, noisy)
                _, vals = _evaluate(s, items)
                if len(vals) != len(names):
                    ok = False
                else:
                    R[r] = vals
                    if reject is not None and float(s.eval(reject)) != 0:
                        R[r] = np.nan
            except StataError:
                ok = False
            if keepvar:
                kt = we if not keep_start else wb
                rows = np.flatnonzero(t == kt)
                if len(rows):
                    kcol[r] = to_nan(ds.get(keepvar).data)[rows[0]]
            if dots:
                _dot(s, ok and not np.isnan(R[r]).any(), r, nwin)
    finally:
        s.data = ds
    s.r = r0
    from ..core.dataset import Dataset, Variable

    res = Dataset()
    res.set_obs(nwin)
    tv = ds.get(info.tvar)
    for nm, vals in (("start", np.array([w[0] for w in wins])), ("end", np.array([w[1] for w in wins]))):
        res.add(Variable(nm, tv.vtype if tv.vtype in ("double", "long", "float") else "long", vals, fmt=tv.fmt))
    # _b and _se expand to one variable per coefficient (_b_x, _se_x); the others keep their names
    final = []
    idx = 0
    for nm0, ex in items:
        if ex in ("_b", "_se"):
            pref = "_b_" if ex == "_b" else "_se_"
            n_ex = len(est0.names) if est0 is not None else 0
            n_ex = len(s.e["b"].colnames) if "b" in s.e else n_ex
            for nm in names[idx:idx + n_ex]:
                col = nm.split(":")[-1]
                final.append(pref + (col[1:] if col == "_cons" else col))
            idx += n_ex
        else:
            final.append(nm0 or names[idx])
            idx += 1
    for j, nm in enumerate(final):
        col = np.where(np.isnan(R[:, j]), SYS, R[:, j])
        res.add(Variable(nm[:32], "double" if o.get("double") else "float",
                         col.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64) if not o.get("double") else col))
    if keepvar:
        res.add(Variable(keepvar, "double", np.where(np.isnan(kcol), SYS, kcol)))
    if isinstance(o.get("saving"), str):
        base = s.data
        s.data = res
        try:
            file, _, opt = o["saving"].partition(",")
            s.interp._execute_expanded(f'save "{file.strip()}"' + (", replace" if "replace" in opt else ""))
        finally:
            s.data = base
    else:
        s.data = res
        s.notify_state()


@command("rolling", "rolling", prefix=True)
def _rolling(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    cmd_rolling(s, args)

"""Helpers shared by the time-series commands of phase 18 (tsfilter, tssmooth, tsappend, tsfill,
tsreport, rolling, pergram, xcorr, the unit-root tests...): the time grid of each panel, time
units, creating variables and adding observations."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.dataset import Variable
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..estimation.tsops import require_ts

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

# periods in a year for the %t formats (Ravn-Uhlig scaling and the defaults of the filters)
PERIODS_PER_YEAR = {"d": 365.0, "w": 52.0, "m": 12.0, "q": 4.0, "h": 2.0, "y": 1.0}
UNIT_NAME = {"d": "daily", "w": "weekly", "m": "monthly", "q": "quarterly", "h": "halfyearly",
             "y": "yearly"}
TYPES = ("byte", "int", "long", "float", "double")


def unit_code(s: "Session") -> str:
    """Letter of the %t format of the time variable ('' when it has none)."""
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    fmt = s.data.get(info.tvar).fmt
    c = fmt[2:3] if fmt.startswith("%t") else ""
    return c if c in PERIODS_PER_YEAR else ""


def unit_name(s: "Session") -> str:
    return UNIT_NAME.get(unit_code(s), ".")


def to_nan(x) -> np.ndarray:
    """Float vector with NaN in place of Stata's missing values."""
    v = np.array(x, dtype=np.float64)
    v[v >= SYS] = np.nan
    return v


def from_nan(x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    v = np.array(x, dtype=np.float64)
    v[np.isnan(v)] = SYS
    return v


def panels(s: "Session", mask: np.ndarray | None = None):
    """[(panel value or None, rows ordered by time, times)] for the observations of `mask` that
    have a time value (and a panel value)."""
    ds = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds)
    t = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(np.float64)
    ok = t < SYS
    if mask is not None:
        ok &= mask
    if info.panel:
        pv = ds.get(info.panel).data.astype(np.float64)
        ok &= pv < SYS
        keys = np.unique(pv[ok])
    else:
        pv, keys = None, [None]
    out = []
    for k in keys:
        sel = ok & (pv == k) if pv is not None else ok
        rows = np.flatnonzero(sel)
        order = np.argsort(t[rows], kind="stable")
        rows = rows[order]
        out.append((k, rows, t[rows]))
    return out


def new_variable(s: "Session", name: str, values: np.ndarray, *, vtype: str | None = None,
                 replace: bool = False, label: str = "") -> None:
    ds = s.data
    if ds.has(name):
        if not replace:
            raise StataError(110, f"{name} already defined")
        ds.drop_vars([name])
    ds.add(Variable(name, vtype or s.settings.get("type", "float"), from_nan(values), label=label))


def split_type(words: list[str]) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    if words and words[0] in TYPES:
        return words[0], words[1:]
    return None, words


def append_periods(s: "Session", entries: list[tuple[float | None, float]]) -> np.ndarray:
    """Adds one observation for each (panel value, time) and re-sorts by panel and time. Returns
    the positions of the new observations before the sort as a boolean mask over the new data
    (so callers can refer to them)."""
    ds = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds)
    n0 = ds.nobs
    k = len(entries)
    if k == 0:
        return np.zeros(n0, dtype=bool)
    ds.set_obs(n0 + k)
    rows = np.arange(n0, n0 + k)
    ds.set_numeric(ds.get(info.tvar), np.array([e[1] for e in entries], dtype=float), rows)
    if info.panel:
        ds.set_numeric(ds.get(info.panel), np.array([e[0] for e in entries], dtype=float), rows)
    flag = np.zeros(n0 + k, dtype=bool)
    flag[rows] = True
    keys = [x for x in (info.panel, info.tvar) if x]
    from ..core.sorting import sort_order
    order = sort_order(ds, keys)
    ds.reorder_obs(order)
    ds.sortlist = list(keys)
    return flag[order]


def kv(s: "Session", pairs: list) -> None:
    """r() from (name, value) pairs in the order of storage."""
    s.r = dict(reversed(pairs))

"""Periodogram, spectral and white-noise tools: pergram, cumsp, xcorr, wntestb, wntestq and
psdensity ([TS] pergram, [TS] cumsp, [TS] xcorr, [TS] wntestb, [TS] wntestq, [TS] psdensity).

The spectral formulas are in the manual: omega_k = (k-1)/n, C_k^2 = |sum x(t) e^(2 pi i (t-1)
omega_k)|^2 / n^2 and the sample spectral density f(omega_k) = n C_k^2. The layouts the manual
does not show are marked VERIFY (compat/do/1904_timeseries.do)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..estimation.tsops import require_ts
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from ._util import touse
from .registry import command
from .tshelp import kv, new_variable, panels

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _one_series(s: "Session", p, *, dense: bool = True):
    """The single variable of the command over the sample, in time order, with its times."""
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if names else 102,
                         "too many variables specified" if names else "too few variables specified")
    return names[0]


def _values(s: "Session", tok: str) -> np.ndarray:
    from .tsfilters import _series
    return _series(s, tok)


def _sample_series(s: "Session", p, tok: str, *, what: str = "") -> np.ndarray:
    """Values of tok over the sample in time order; the sample must be dense."""
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    x = _values(s, tok)
    mask = touse(s, p)
    groups = panels(s, mask)
    if info.panel and len(groups) > 1:
        raise StataError(498, "panel data not allowed; use a single time series")      # VERIFY
    _pv, rows, t = groups[0]
    if not len(rows):
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    if np.isnan(x[rows]).any() or np.any(np.abs(np.diff(t) - info.delta) > 1e-9):
        raise StataError(498, "sample may not contain gaps" if not np.isnan(x[rows]).any()
                         else "sample may not contain missing values")      # VERIFY
    return x[rows], rows

# periodogram

def periodogram(x: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, float]:
    """(frequencies, n C_k^2, sample variance) at the natural frequencies k = 1..n/2 + 1; the
    series is demeaned."""
    n = len(x)
    xc = x - x.mean()
    f = np.fft.rfft(xc)
    c2 = (np.abs(f) ** 2) / n ** 2
    om = np.arange(len(f)) / n
    return om, n * c2, float((xc @ xc) / n)


def _tsplot_graph(s: "Session", p, graw: dict, layers, xtitle: str, ytitle: str, title: str,
                  note: str | None = None):
    from ..graphics.baseplots import _graph
    return _graph(s, graw, layers, xtitle, ytitle, True, title, note)


@command("pergram", "pergram")
def cmd_pergram(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..graphics.baseplots import _own, _split

    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, args, {"generate": 1, "nograph": 4})

        new_variable(s, lopts["generate"], col, vtype="double")

def cmd_cumsp(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:

                      "Sample spectral distribution function", "Points evaluated at the natural frequencies")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# xcorr
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def crosscorr(x1: np.ndarray, x2: np.ndarray, Q: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """rho_12(k) = Cov[x1(t), x2(t+k)] / sqrt(R11(0) R22(0)), k = -Q..Q."""
    n = len(x1)
    a, b = x1 - x1.mean(), x2 - x2.mean()
    den = math.sqrt(float(a @ a) * float(b @ b))
    out = []
    for k in range(-Q, Q + 1):
        if k >= 0:
            out.append(float(a[:n - k] @ b[k:]) / den)
        else:
            out.append(float(a[-k:] @ b[:n + k]) / den)
    return np.array(out)


def _bar(v: float) -> str:
    k = min(int(math.floor(abs(v) * 8 + 1e-12)), 8)
    return " " * 8 + "|" + "-" * k if v >= 0 else " " * (8 - k) + "-" * k + "|"


@command("xcorr", "xc")
def cmd_xcorr(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..graphics.baseplots import _own, _split
    from ..graphics.model import Layer
    from .graphcmd import finish
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, args, {"generate": 1, "lags": 1, "table": 1, "noplot": 3, "base": 4})
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(102 if len(names) < 2 else 103,
                         "too few variables specified" if len(names) < 2 else "too many variables specified")
    x1, rows = _sample_series(s, p, names[0])
    x2, _r = _sample_series(s, p, names[1])
    n = len(x1)
    Q = int(float(s.eval(str(lopts["lags"])))) if isinstance(lopts.get("lags"), str) else min(n // 2 - 2, 20)
    if Q < 1 or Q >= n:
        raise StataError(198, "lags() out of range")      # VERIFY
    r = crosscorr(x1, x2, Q)
    if isinstance(lopts.get("generate"), str):
        col = np.full(s.data.nobs, np.nan)
        col[:len(r)] = r
        new_variable(s, lopts["generate"], col, vtype="double")
    lags = np.arange(-Q, Q + 1)
    if lopts.get("table"):
        out = s.output
        noplot = bool(lopts.get("noplot"))
        out.write("\n", "text")
        if not noplot:
            out.write(f"{'':28}-1       0       1\n", "text")
            out.write(" LAG       CORR     [Cross-correlation]\n", "text")
        else:
            out.write(" LAG      CORR\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * (47 if not noplot else 15) + "\n", "text")
        for k, v in zip(lags, r):
            if noplot:
                out.write(f"{k:<8}{v:>7.4f}   \n", "result")      # VERIFY: Stata 14 layout
                continue
            line = f"{k:<5}{v:>10.4f}"
            line += f"  {_bar(v)}"
            out.write(line.rstrip() + "\n", "result")
        return
    layers = [Layer("spike", lags.tolist(), r.tolist(), {}, _own(lopts, {"generate", "lags", "table", "noplot", "base"}), "")]
    g = _tsplot_graph(s, p, graw, layers, "Lag", "Cross-correlogram", "")
    finish(s, g, graw)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# wntestb, wntestq
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def kolmogorov_sf(a: float) -> float:
    """1 - G(a), G(a) = sum_{j=-inf}^{inf} (-1)^j exp(-2 a^2 j^2)."""
    if a <= 0:
        return 1.0
    j = np.arange(1, 200)
    v = 2 * float(np.sum((-1.0) ** (j - 1) * np.exp(-2 * a * a * j * j)))
    return min(max(v, 0.0), 1.0)


def bartlett_b(x: np.ndarray):
    """Bartlett's B statistic, its p-value and the cumulative periodogram."""
    n = len(x)
    om, pg, _v = periodogram(x)
    q = n // 2 + 1
    F = np.cumsum(pg[:q]) / pg[:q].sum()
    k = np.arange(1, q + 1)
    # VERIFY: B = sqrt(q) max|F_k - (k-1)/(q-1)| reproduces the reference log (n even)
    dev = np.abs(F - (k - 1) / (q - 1))
    B = math.sqrt(q) * float(dev.max())
    return B, kolmogorov_sf(B), om[:q], F, q


@command("wntestb", "wntestb")
def cmd_wntestb(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..graphics.baseplots import _own, _split
    from ..graphics.model import Layer
    from .graphcmd import finish
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, args, {"table": 1, "level": 1, "noplot": 3})
    tok = _one_series(s, p)
    x, _rows = _sample_series(s, p, tok)
    B, pv, om, F, q = bartlett_b(x)
    kv(s, [("stat", B), ("p", pv)])
    out = s.output
    if lopts.get("table"):
        out.write("\nCumulative periodogram white-noise test\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 39 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f" Bartlett's (B) statistic  = {B:>10.4f}\n", "text")
        out.write(f" Prob > B".ljust(27) + f"= {pv:>10.4f}\n", "text")
        return
    if lopts.get("noplot"):
        return
    n = len(x)
    level = float(s.eval(str(lopts["level"]))) if isinstance(lopts.get("level"), str) else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    lo_, hi_ = 0.0, 5.0
    target = 1 - level / 100
    for _ in range(80):
        mid = (lo_ + hi_) / 2
        if kolmogorov_sf(mid) > target:
            lo_ = mid
        else:
            hi_ = mid
    a = (lo_ + hi_) / 2 / math.sqrt(q)
    k = np.arange(q) / (q - 1)
    layers = [Layer("connected", om.tolist(), F.tolist(), {}, _own(lopts, {"table", "level", "noplot"}), ""),
              Layer("line", om.tolist(), k.tolist(), {}, {"lcolor": "gs8"}, ""),
              Layer("line", om.tolist(), (k + a).tolist(), {}, {"lcolor": "gs8", "lpattern": "dash"}, ""),
              Layer("line", om.tolist(), (k - a).tolist(), {}, {"lcolor": "gs8", "lpattern": "dash"}, "")]
    g = _tsplot_graph(s, p, graw, layers, "Frequency", "Cumulative periodogram",
                      f"Cumulative periodogram for {tok}",
                      f"Bartlett's (B) statistic = {B:.2f}  Prob > B = {pv:.4f}")
    finish(s, g, graw)


@command("wntestq", "wntestq")
def cmd_wntestq(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"lags": 1}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    tok = _one_series(s, p)
    x, _rows = _sample_series(s, p, tok)
    n = len(x)
    m = int(float(s.eval(str(o["lags"])))) if isinstance(o.get("lags"), str) else min(n // 2 - 2, 40)
    if m < 1 or m >= n:
        raise StataError(198, "lags() out of range")      # VERIFY
    xc = x - x.mean()
    c0 = float(xc @ xc)
    ac = np.array([float(xc[k:] @ xc[:-k]) / c0 for k in range(1, m + 1)])
    Q = n * (n + 2) * float(np.sum(ac ** 2 / (n - np.arange(1, m + 1))))
    pv = float(chi2_tail(Q, m))
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nPortmanteau test for white noise\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 39 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f" Portmanteau (Q) statistic = {Q:>10.4f}\n", "text")
    out.write(f" Prob > chi2({m})".ljust(27) + f"= {pv:>10.4f}\n", "text")
    kv(s, [("stat", Q), ("df", float(m)), ("p", pv)])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# psdensity
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def arma_density(ar: dict, ma: dict, sigma2: float, omega: np.ndarray, d: float = 0.0):
    """sigma^2 / (2 pi) |theta(e^-iw)|^2 / |phi(e^-iw)|^2 |1 - e^iw|^(-2d); ar and ma map the lag
    to its coefficient."""
    z = np.exp(-1j * omega)
    phi = 1 - sum(c * z ** k for k, c in ar.items()) if ar else np.ones_like(z)
    theta = 1 + sum(c * z ** k for k, c in ma.items()) if ma else np.ones_like(z)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        f = sigma2 / (2 * math.pi) * np.abs(theta) ** 2 / np.abs(phi) ** 2
        if d:
            f = f * np.abs(1 - np.exp(1j * omega)) ** (-2 * d)
    return f


def arma_variance(ar: dict, ma: dict, sigma2: float, d: float = 0.0) -> float:
    """Variance of the ARMA process (psi weights summed until they vanish)."""
    from scipy import signal
    P = max(ar) if ar else 0
    Q = max(ma) if ma else 0
    a = np.zeros(P + 1)
    a[0] = 1
    for k, c in ar.items():
        a[k] = -c
    b = np.zeros(Q + 1)
    b[0] = 1
    for k, c in ma.items():
        b[k] = c
    imp = np.zeros(20000)
    imp[0] = 1
    psi = signal.lfilter(b, a, imp)
    return float(sigma2 * np.sum(psi ** 2))


@command("psdensity", "psdensity")
def cmd_psdensity(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..estimation.results import current
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"pspectrum": 2, "range": 3, "cycle": 3, "smemory": 2}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = p.varlist.split()
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(102 if len(names) < 2 else 103,
                         "too few variables specified" if len(names) < 2 else "too many variables specified")
    est = current(s)
    sample = touse(s, p)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(sample)
    N = len(rows)
    if est.cmd == "arima":
        A = est.arima
        b = est.b
        k = A["k"]
        na, nm = len(A["ar"]), len(A["ma"])
        ar = {lag: float(b[k + i]) for i, lag in enumerate(A["ar"])}
        ma = {lag: float(b[k + na + i]) for i, lag in enumerate(A["ma"])}
        sigma2 = float(b[-1]) ** 2
        d = 0.0
    elif est.cmd == "arfima":
        A = est.arfima
        ar, ma, sigma2, d = A["ar"], A["ma"], A["sigma2"], (0.0 if o.get("smemory") else A["d"])
    elif est.cmd == "ucm":
        from ..estimation.ucm import cycle_density
        which = int(o["cycle"]) if isinstance(o.get("cycle"), str) else 1
        ar = ma = None
    else:
        raise StataError(321, "psdensity only works after arima, arfima and ucm")      # VERIFY
    lo, hi = 0.0, math.pi
    if isinstance(o.get("range"), str):
        v = [float(w) for w in o["range"].split()]
        if len(v) != 2 or not 0 <= v[0] < v[1] < math.pi:
            raise StataError(198, "range() invalid")
        lo, hi = v
    omega = math.pi * np.arange(N) / (N - 1) if N > 1 else np.array([0.0])
    omega = omega[(omega >= lo) & (omega < hi)] if isinstance(o.get("range"), str) else omega
    if est.cmd == "ucm":
        f = cycle_density(est, which, omega, normalized=not o.get("pspectrum"))
    else:
        f = arma_density(ar, ma, sigma2, omega, d)
        if not o.get("pspectrum"):
            f = f / arma_variance(ar, ma, sigma2, d) if d == 0 else f / A["gamma0"]
    for nm in names:
        if s.data.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
    for nm, vals in ((names[0], f), (names[1], omega)):
        col = np.full(s.data.nobs, np.nan)
        col[rows[:len(vals)]] = vals
        new_variable(s, nm, col)
