def cmd_bootstrap(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    colon = find_top(args, ":")
    if colon == -1:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    head, command = args[:colon].strip(), args[colon + 1:].strip()
    if not command:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    c = find_top(head, ",")
    exp_text, opt_text = (head, "") if c == -1 else (head[:c], head[c + 1:])
    o = match_options(opt_text, _OPTS) if opt_text.strip() else {}
    run(s, command, parse_exp_list(exp_text), o)


def run(s: "Session", command: str, items: list[tuple[str, str]], o: dict) -> None:
    from ..commands.registry import lookup
    out = s.output
    reps = int(o["reps"]) if isinstance(o.get("reps"), str) else 50
    if reps < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "reps() must be an integer greater than 1")   # VERIFY
    level = float(o["level"]) if isinstance(o.get("level"), str) else float(s.settings.get("level", 95))
    if isinstance(o.get("seed"), str):
        s.interp._execute_expanded(f"set seed {o['seed'].strip()}")
    word = command.split(None, 1)[0]
    spec = lookup(word)
    cmdname = spec.name if spec else word
    noisy = bool(o.get("noisily"))

    # 1) run with the original data
    _quiet(s, command, noisy)
    eclass = "b" in s.e and getattr(s, "_estimates", None) is not None and \
        getattr(s._estimates, "cmd", "") == cmdname
    if not items:
        if not eclass:
            raise StataError(198, "expression list required")   # VERIFY
        items = [("", "_b")]
    eclass_b = eclass and items == [("", "_b")]
    names, observed = _evaluate(s, items)
    base = s.data
    sample = np.ones(base.nobs, dtype=bool)
    if eclass and base.esample is not None and len(base.esample) == base.nobs:
        sample = base.esample.copy()
        if not o.get("_from_vce"):
            # with vce(bootstrap) Stata does not show this line (compat 0803)
            out.write(f"(running {cmdname} on estimation sample)\n", "text")
    if not eclass:
        _warn_rclass(s, cmdname)
    est0 = getattr(s, "_estimates", None) if eclass else None
    e0 = dict(s.e)
    r0 = dict(s.r)
    work = _subset(base, np.flatnonzero(sample))
    strata = clusters = None
    if isinstance(o.get("strata"), str):
        sv = work.get(s.expand_varlist(o["strata"])[0])
        strata = np.asarray(sv.raw if sv.is_string else sv.data)
    if isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str):
        cv = work.get(s.expand_varlist(o["cluster"])[0])
        clusters = np.asarray(cv.raw if cv.is_string else cv.data)
    size = int(o["size"]) if isinstance(o.get("size"), str) else None

    # 2) replicates
    dots = not o.get("nodots")
    if dots:
        out.write(f"\nBootstrap replications ({reps})\n", "text")
        out.write("----+--- 1 ---+--- 2 ---+--- 3 ---+--- 4 ---+--- 5 \n", "text")
    R = np.full((reps, len(names)), np.nan)
    mis = 0
    try:
        for r in range(reps):
            idx = _sample_index(work, strata, clusters, size)
            s.data = _subset(work, idx)
            ok = True
            try:
                _quiet(s, command, noisy)
                nm, vals = _evaluate(s, items)
                if len(vals) != len(names):
                    ok = False
                elif o.get("double"):
                    R[r] = vals
                else:
                    # replicates stored as float, as Stata does without the double option
                    R[r] = np.asarray(vals, dtype=np.float32)
            except StataError:
                ok = False
            if not ok:
                mis += 1
            if dots:
                out.write("." if ok else "x", "text")
                if (r + 1) % 50 == 0:
                    out.write(f"{r + 1:>6}\n", "text")
        if dots and reps % 50:
            out.write("\n", "text")
    finally:
        s.data = base
    s.r = r0

    good = R[~np.isnan(R).any(axis=1)]
    nrep = len(good)
    if nrep < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "insufficient observations to compute bootstrap standard errors")   # VERIFY
    V = np.cov(good, rowvar=False, ddof=1).reshape(len(names), len(names))
    info = BootInfo(reps=R, names=names, observed=observed, command=command, exps=[e for _, e in items],
                    n_reps=nrep, n_mis=mis, level=level, eclass_b=eclass_b, N=int(sample.sum()),
                    strata=o.get("strata", "") if isinstance(o.get("strata"), str) else "",
                    cluster=o.get("cluster", "") if isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str) else "")
    _post(s, info, V, est0, e0, cmdname, sample)
    display(s, s._estimates, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _wrap(text: str, width: int, first: str, rest: str) -> list[str]:
    """Wraps keeping the two spaces after a period, with indentation."""
    parts = re.split(r"( +)", text)
    lines, cur = [], first
    started = False
    for k in range(0, len(parts), 2):
        word = parts[k]
        sep = parts[k - 1] if k > 0 else ""
        if started and len(cur) + len(sep) + len(word) > width:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = rest + word
        else:
            cur = cur + (sep if started else "") + word
        started = True
    lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def _warn_rclass(s: "Session", cmdname: str, prefix: str = "bootstrap") -> None:
    """bootstrap warning for a command that does not store e(sample) (compat 0803)."""
    width = int(s.settings.get("linesize", 80)) - 2          # VERIFY: 253 at linesize 255 (compat 1903)
    out = s.output
    p1 = (f"Because {cmdname} is not an estimation command or does not set e(sample), {prefix} has no "
          "way to determine which observations are used in calculating the statistics and so assumes "
          "that all observations are used.  This means that no observations will be excluded from the "
          "resampling because of missing values or other reasons.")
    p2 = ("If the assumption is not true, press Break, save the data, and drop the observations that "
          "are to be excluded.  Be sure that the dataset in memory contains only the relevant data.")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    for ln in _wrap(p1, width, "Warning:  ", " " * 10):
        out.write(ln + "\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    for ln in _wrap(p2, width, " " * 10, " " * 10):
        out.write(ln + "\n", "text")


def _quiet(s: "Session", command: str, noisy: bool) -> None:
    if noisy:
        s.interp._execute_expanded(command)
    else:
        with s.output.quietly():
            s.interp._execute_expanded(command)

def _post(s: "Session", info: BootInfo, V: np.ndarray, est0, e0: dict, cmdname: str,
          sample: np.ndarray) -> None:
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    from .results import post
    good = info.reps[~np.isnan(info.reps).any(axis=1)]
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
    b_bs = good.mean(axis=0)
    z = st.norm.ppf(0.5 + info.level / 200)
    a = (100 - info.level) / 2
    pct_lo = np.percentile(good, a, axis=0, method="linear")   # VERIFY definition of the percentile
    pct_hi = np.percentile(good, 100 - a, axis=0, method="linear")
    # bias-corrected: z0 = Φ⁻¹(proportion of replicates below the observed value)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        prop = np.clip((good < info.observed).mean(axis=0), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    z0 = st.norm.ppf(prop)
    p1 = st.norm.cdf(2 * z0 - z) * 100
    p2 = st.norm.cdf(2 * z0 + z) * 100
    bc_lo = np.array([np.percentile(good[:, j], p1[j]) for j in range(len(info.names))])
    bc_hi = np.array([np.percentile(good[:, j], p2[j]) for j in range(len(info.names))])
    info.extra = {"se": se, "b_bs": b_bs, "bias": b_bs - info.observed,
                  "normal": (info.observed - z * se, info.observed + z * se),
                  "percentile": (pct_lo, pct_hi), "bc": (bc_lo, bc_hi)}
    names = info.names
    cols = [n.split(":")[-1] for n in names]
    eqs = [n.split(":")[0] if ":" in n else "_" for n in names]

    def mat(row: np.ndarray, rown: str = "y1") -> Matrix:
        m = Matrix(np.asarray(row, dtype=float).reshape(1, -1), [rown], cols)
        m.coleq = eqs
        return m

    def ci(pair) -> Matrix:
        m = Matrix(np.vstack(pair), ["ll", "ul"], cols)
        m.coleq = eqs
        return m

    extra_mats = [("b_bs", mat(b_bs)), ("reps", mat(np.full(len(names), info.n_reps, dtype=float))),
                  ("bias", mat(b_bs - info.observed)), ("se", mat(se)),
                  ("z0", mat(z0)), ("ci_normal", ci(info.extra["normal"])),
                  ("ci_percentile", ci(info.extra["percentile"])), ("ci_bc", ci(info.extra["bc"]))]
    if info.eclass_b and est0 is not None:
        est = est0
        est.V = V
        est.vcetype = "Bootstrap"
        est.stat = "z"
        est.boot = info
        est.title = getattr(est0, "title", "") or e0.get("title", "")
        scalars = [(k, v) for k, v in e0.items() if isinstance(v, float) and k not in ("N_reps", "N_misreps")]
        scalars += [("N_reps", float(info.n_reps)), ("N_misreps", float(info.n_mis)), ("level", info.level)]
        k = int(np.count_nonzero(np.abs(np.diag(V)) > 0))
        _wald(info, V)
        scalars.append(("chi2", info.extra.get("chi2", SYS)))
        macros = [(k_, v) for k_, v in e0.items() if isinstance(v, str)
                  and k_ not in ("vce", "vcetype", "prefix")]
        macros += [("prefix", "bootstrap"), ("vce", "bootstrap"), ("vcetype", "Bootstrap"),
                   ("command", info.command)]
        # Stata lists in the reverse order of storage; here the lists already come in that order
        post(s, est, list(reversed(scalars)), list(reversed(macros)), sample, extra_mats=extra_mats)
        return
    est = Estimates(cmd="bootstrap", depvar="", names=cols, b=np.asarray(info.observed, dtype=float),
                    V=V, N=info.N, stat="z")
    est.eqnames = eqs
    est.rows = [CoefRow("coef", label=n.split(":")[-1], b=float(b), se=float(v), name=n)
                for n, b, v in zip(names, info.observed, se)]
    est.vcetype = "Bootstrap"
    est.boot = info
    est.title = "Bootstrap results"
    est.level = info.level
    scalars = [("N", float(info.N)), ("N_reps", float(info.n_reps)), ("N_misreps", float(info.n_mis)),
               ("k_eq", 1.0), ("k_exp", float(len(names))), ("level", info.level)]
    macros = [("cmd", "bootstrap"), ("command", info.command), ("prefix", "bootstrap"),
              ("vce", "bootstrap"), ("vcetype", "Bootstrap"), ("title", "Bootstrap results"),
              ("properties", "b V")]
    for j, ex in enumerate(info.exps, start=1):
        macros.append((f"exp{j}", ex))
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, sample, extra_mats=extra_mats)


def _wald(info: BootInfo, V: np.ndarray) -> None:
    keep = [j for j, n in enumerate(info.names) if not n.endswith("_cons") and V[j, j] > 0]
    if not keep:
        return
    b = info.observed[keep]
    Vk = V[np.ix_(keep, keep)]
    try:
        info.extra["chi2"] = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(Vk, b))
        info.extra["df"] = len(keep)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        pass


def _hdr(s: "Session", left: str, items: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
    out = s.output
    for k, (lab, val) in enumerate(items):
        lft = left if k == 0 else ""
        out.write(f"{lft:<48}{lab:<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{val:>10}\n", "result")


def display(s: "Session", est, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True, level: float | None = None,
            **_) -> None:
    info: BootInfo = est.boot
    out = s.output
    lev = level if level is not None else info.level
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        items = [("Number of obs", f"{info.N:,}"), ("Replications", f"{info.n_reps:,}")]
        if info.eclass_b:
            if "chi2" in info.extra:
                df = info.extra["df"]
                items.append((f"Wald chi2({df})", f"{info.extra['chi2']:.2f}"))
                items.append(("Prob > chi2", f"{_chi2_tail(info.extra['chi2'], df):.4f}"))
            for key, lab, fmt in (("r2", "R-squared", "%9.4f"), ("r2_a", "Adj R-squared", "%9.4f"),
                                  ("r2_p", "Pseudo R2", "%9.4f"), ("rmse", "Root MSE", "%9.4f")):
                v = s.e.get(key)
                if isinstance(v, float) and v < SYS:
                    items.append((lab, g9(v, fmt)))
        _hdr(s, est.title if info.eclass_b else "Bootstrap results", items)
        if info.cluster:
            out.write(f"{'':>48}(Replications based on clusters in {info.cluster})\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        if not info.eclass_b:
            out.write("\n", "text")
            out.write(f"{'command':>13}:  {info.command}\n", "text")
            k = 0
            for n, ex in zip(info.names, info.exps):
                out.write(f"{abbrev(n, 12):>13}:  {ex}\n", "text")
                k += 1
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if not table:
        return
    se = info.extra["se"]
    rows = []
    if info.eclass_b:
        se_by = dict(zip(info.names, se))
        se_short = {n.split(":")[-1]: v for n, v in se_by.items()}
        for r in est.rows:
            if r.kind in ("coef", "aux"):
                key = r.name or r.label
                v = se_by.get(key, se_short.get(key.split(":")[-1], r.se))
                rows.append(CoefRow(r.kind, r.label, r.b, float(v), r.eq, r.name))
            else:
                rows.append(r)
    else:
        rows = [CoefRow("coef", label=n.split(":")[-1], b=float(b), se=float(v), name=n)
                for n, b, v in zip(info.names, info.observed, se)]
    dep = est.depvar if info.eclass_b else ""
    coef_table(s, dep, rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev,
               vcetype="", top_line=f"{'':>12} |   Observed   Bootstrap                         Normal-based")

def estat_bootstrap(s: "Session", est, rest: str) -> None:
    info: BootInfo | None = getattr(est, "boot", None)
    if info is None:
        raise StataError(321, "estat bootstrap requires bootstrap results")   # VERIFY
    c = find_top(rest, ",")
    opt = "" if c == -1 else rest[c + 1:]
    o = match_options(opt, {"bc": 2, "bca": 3, "normal": 1, "percentile": 1, "all": 3, "noheader": 5,
                            "nolegend": 5, "verbose": 1}) if opt.strip() else {}
    kinds = [k for k in ("normal", "percentile", "bc") if o.get(k) or o.get("all")]
    if not kinds:
        kinds = ["percentile", "bc"] if not o.get("bc") else ["bc"]
        if o.get("percentile"):
            kinds = ["percentile"]
    out = s.output
    lv = f"{info.level:g}"
    out.write("\n", "text")
    _hdr(s, est.title if info.eclass_b else "Bootstrap results",
         [("Number of obs", f"{info.N:,}"), ("Replications", f"{info.n_reps:,}")])
    out.write("\n" + LINE + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>12} |    Observed               Bootstrap\n", "text")
    dep = est.depvar if info.eclass_b else ""
    out.write(f"{abbrev(dep):>12} |       Coef.       Bias    Std. Err.  [{lv}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    tags = {"normal": "(N)", "percentile": "(P)", "bc": "(BC)"}
    ex = info.extra
    for j, n in enumerate(info.names):
        first = True
        for k in kinds:
            lo, hi = ex[k][0][j], ex[k][1][j]
            # columns (compat 0803): 12, 11, 12, 12, 11 and the label in 6
            if first:
                out.write(f"{abbrev(n.split(':')[-1]):>12} |", "text")
                out.write(f"{g9(info.observed[j], '%10.0g'):>12}{g9(ex['bias'][j]):>11}"
                          f"{g9(ex['se'][j], '%10.0g'):>12}{g9(lo):>12}{g9(hi):>11}{tags[k]:>6}\n", "result")
                first = False
            else:
                out.write(f"{'':>12} |" + " " * 35, "text")
                out.write(f"{g9(lo):>12}{g9(hi):>11}{tags[k]:>6}\n", "result")
    out.write(LINE + "\n", "text")
    legend = {"normal": "(N)    normal confidence interval",
              "percentile": "(P)    percentile confidence interval",
              "bc": "(BC)   bias-corrected confidence interval"}
    for k in kinds:
        out.write(legend[k] + "\n", "text")

_VCE = re.compile(r"\bvce\s*\(\s*(boot(?:s|st|str|stra|strap)?)\b", re.I)


def split_vce_bootstrap(args: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """If the options have vce(bootstrap [, options]), returns (args without the option,
    bootstrap options)."""
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    if c == -1:
        return None
    opts = args[c + 1:]
    m = _VCE.search(opts)
    if not m:
        return None
    start = m.start()
    depth, j = 0, opts.index("(", start)
    k = j
    while k < len(opts):
        if opts[k] == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif opts[k] == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                break
        k += 1
    inner = opts[j + 1:k]
    bopts = inner.partition(",")[2].strip()
    rest = (opts[:start] + opts[k + 1:]).strip()
    new_args = args[:c] + ((", " + rest) if rest else "")
    return new_args, bopts


def wrap_vce_bootstrap(name: str) -> None:
    """Replaces the registered command with one that understands vce(bootstrap)."""
    from ..commands.registry import REGISTRY, CommandSpec
    spec = REGISTRY[name]
    inner = spec.fn

    def fn(s: "Session", args: str, _inner=inner, _name=name) -> None:
        sp = split_vce_bootstrap(args)
        if sp is None:
            _inner(s, args)
            return
        new_args, bopts = sp
        o = match_options(bopts, _OPTS) if bopts else {}
        o["_from_vce"] = True
        run(s, f"{_name} {new_args}", [], o)

    REGISTRY[name] = CommandSpec(spec.name, spec.min_abbrev, fn, spec.prefix, spec.byable)

"""Interval, truncated and selection models: intreg, truncreg, heckman, heckprobit,
heckoprobit and biprobit ([R] intreg, [R] truncreg, [R] heckman, [R] heckprobit,

from __future__ import annotations

def _replay(s, cmd, args) -> bool:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return True
    return False


def _chi2p(x: float, df: int) -> float:
    return float(chi2_tail(x, df)) if df > 0 else SYS


def _split_vars(args: str, k: int) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    """The first k plain variable names of a command line and the rest of the line."""
    text = args.strip()
    names = []
    for _ in range(k):
        parts = text.split(None, 1)
        if not parts or parts[0].startswith(",") or "(" in parts[0]:
            raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
        names.append(parts[0])
        text = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    return names, text


def _values(ds, name: str, mask) -> np.ndarray:
    """Variable values on the sample with missing as nan."""
    v = ds.get(name).data[mask].astype(float)
    return np.where(v >= SYS, np.nan, v)


def _weighted_probit(y, X, w, off=None):
    if off is None:
        fun, _ = _probit(y, X, w)
        return maximize(fun, np.zeros(X.shape[1]), maxiter=300)
    q = 2 * y - 1

    def fun(b, todo):
        z = q * (X @ b + off)
        lc = st.norm.logcdf(z)
        ll = float(w @ lc)
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        lam = q * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(z) - lc)
        d2 = -lam * (lam + X @ b + off)
        return ll, X.T @ (w * lam), (X * (w * d2)[:, None]).T @ X
    return maximize(fun, np.zeros(X.shape[1]), maxiter=300)

def cmd_intreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "intreg", args):
        return
    (d1, d2), rest = _split_vars(args, 2)
    ds = s.data
    spec = {"offset": 3, "het": 3}
    o = peek(rest, spec)
    het_vars = str(o["het"]) if o.get("het") not in (None, True) else None
    both_missing = (ds.get(d1).data >= SYS) & (ds.get(d2).data >= SYS)
    pr = _Prep(s, rest, spec, need_dep=False, restrict=~both_missing, extra_vars=names_in(het_vars, o.get("offset")))
    pr.smp.depname = d1
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    lo = _values(ds, d1, pr.smp.mask)
    hi = _values(ds, d2, pr.smp.mask)
    if np.any(lo > hi):
        raise StataError(498, f"{d1} > {d2} in {int(np.sum(lo > hi))} observations")   # VERIFY
    main = block_from_pr(pr, "model" if het_vars else d1)
    main.offset, main.off_name = offset_values(pr, o.get("offset"), None)
    hetb = block_from_text(pr, "lnsigma", het_vars, constant=True) if het_vars else None
    w = pr.w
    exact = lo == hi
    left = np.isnan(lo)
    right = np.isnan(hi)
    inter = ~exact & ~left & ~right

    if hetb is None:
        def lik(etas, th):
            ll, d1_, d2_ = L.intreg(lo, hi, etas[0], th[0])
            return ll, [d1_], d2_.reshape(-1, 1)
        eng = Engine(lik, [main], w, 1)
    else:
        def lik(etas, th):
            ll, d1_, d2_ = L.intreg(lo, hi, etas[0], etas[1])
            return ll, [d1_, d2_], None
        eng = Engine(lik, [main, hetb], w, 0)
    # start: OLS on the exact value, the interval midpoint or the censoring point
    yy = np.where(exact, lo, np.where(inter, (lo + hi) / 2, np.where(left, hi, lo)))
    off0 = main.offset if main.offset is not None else 0.0
    sw = np.sqrt(w)
    beta = np.linalg.lstsq(main.X * sw[:, None], (yy - off0) * sw, rcond=None)[0]
    sig = float(np.sqrt(np.sum(w * (yy - off0 - main.X @ beta) ** 2) / np.sum(w)))
    if hetb is None:
        b0 = np.concatenate([beta, [np.log(max(sig, 1e-6))]])
    else:
        h0 = np.zeros(hetb.k)
        h0[-1] = np.log(max(sig, 1e-6))
        b0 = np.concatenate([beta, h0])
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, b0)
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    null = None
    if main.constant and hetb is None:
        e0 = Engine(lik, [constant_only(main)], w, 1)
        mu0 = float(np.sum(w * (yy - off0)) / np.sum(w))
        null = maximize(e0.fun, np.array([mu0, np.log(max(float(np.std(yy)), 1e-6))]), maxiter=300)
        fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting constant-only model:", null)
    fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting full model:", res)
    # observation counts: weighted only with fweights (case 1909: svy: intreg)
    counts = [float(w[m].sum()) if pr.smp.wtype == "fweight" else float(np.sum(m)) for m in (left, exact, right, inter)]
    if hetb is None:
        lns, se_lns = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))

        def aux_rows(level):
            return [CoefRow("sep"), aux_row("/lnsigma", lns, se_lns, level), CoefRow("sep"),
                    transformed_row("sigma", np.exp, np.exp, lns, se_lns, level)]
    else:
        def aux_rows(level):
            return []

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        left_ = [est.title, "", f"{lab(est)} = {g(x['ll'], '%10.0g'):>10}"]
        return left_, std_right({**x, "r2_p": None})

    def footer(s_, est):
        out = s_.output
        for n_, lbl in zip(counts, ("left-censored", "uncensored", "right-censored", "interval")):
            out.write(f"{int(n_):>14}{lbl:>15} observations\n", "text")

    est = finish_model(s, pr, "intreg", args, title="Interval regression", blocks=[main] + ([hetb] if hetb else []),
                       eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=null.ll if null else SYS,
                       aux_names=[] if hetb else [("lnsigma", "_cons")],
                       aux_rows_fn=aux_rows, hdr_fn=hdr, depvar_cell="", footer=footer,
                       wald=pr.robust or hetb is not None, k_eq=2, r2p=None,
                       extra_scalars=([] if hetb else [("sigma", float(np.exp(lns)))])
                       + [("N_lc", counts[0]), ("N_unc", counts[1]), ("N_rc", counts[2]), ("N_int", counts[3])],
                       extra_macros=[("depvar", f"{d1} {d2}")])
    est.depvar = d1
    est.predict = make_predict(lambda what, etas, th, e: etas[0] if what == "xb" else None, "xb")
    est.pred_label = "fitted values"
    display_eq(s, est)

# truncreg

def _limit(s, text) -> float:
    if text in (None, False, True):
        return None
    return float(s.eval(str(text)))


def cmd_truncreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "truncreg", args):
        return
    spec = {"ll": 2, "ul": 2, "offset": 3}
    o = peek(args, spec)
    lower = _limit(s, o.get("ll"))
    upper = _limit(s, o.get("ul"))
    if lower is None and upper is None:
        raise StataError(198, "must specify at least one of ll() and ul()")   # VERIFY
    lo_ = -np.inf if lower is None else lower
    hi_ = np.inf if upper is None else upper
    pr = _Prep(s, args, spec, extra_vars=names_in(o.get("offset")))
    out_ = (pr.y <= lo_) | (pr.y >= hi_)
    n_trunc = int(out_.sum())
    if n_trunc:        # observations outside the limits are dropped
        yfull = s.data.get(args.split()[0]).data
        pr = _Prep(s, args, spec, extra_vars=names_in(o.get("offset")),
                   restrict=~((yfull < SYS) & ((yfull <= lo_) | (yfull >= hi_))))
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    s.output.write(f"(note: {n_trunc} obs. truncated)\n", "text")
    y = pr.y
    main = block_from_pr(pr, pr.smp.depname)
    main.offset, main.off_name = offset_values(pr, o.get("offset"), None)
    off0 = main.offset if main.offset is not None else 0.0
    w = pr.w

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d1, d2 = L.truncreg(y, etas[0], th[0], lo_, hi_)
        return ll, [d1], d2.reshape(-1, 1)

    eng = Engine(lik, [main], w, 1)
    sw = np.sqrt(w)
    beta = np.linalg.lstsq(main.X * sw[:, None], (y - off0) * sw, rcond=None)[0]
    sig = float(np.sqrt(np.sum(w * (y - off0 - main.X @ beta) ** 2) / np.sum(w)))
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, np.concatenate([beta, [np.log(max(sig, 1e-6))]]))
    fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting full model:", res)
    Vl, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    # Stata's e(b) holds sigma, not ln sigma: delta method
    sg = float(np.exp(res.b[-1]))
    J = np.eye(len(res.b))
    J[-1, -1] = sg
    V = J @ Vl @ J.T
    b_rep = np.concatenate([res.b[:-1], [sg]])
    res2 = dataclasses.replace(res, b=b_rep)
    null = None
    if main.constant:
        e0 = Engine(lik, [constant_only(main)], w, 1)
        null = maximize(e0.fun, np.array([float(np.average(y - off0, weights=w)), np.log(max(float(np.std(y)), 1e-6))]),
                        maxiter=300)
    se_sg = float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))

    def aux_rows(level):
        return [CoefRow("sep"), aux_row("/sigma", sg, se_sg, level)]

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        lo_t = "-inf" if lower is None else f"{lower:g}"
        hi_t = "+inf" if upper is None else f"{upper:g}"
        left_ = [est.title, f"Limit:   lower = {lo_t:>10}", f"         upper = {hi_t:>10}",
                 f"{lab(est)} = {g(x['ll'], '%10.0g'):>10}"]
        right = [("", ""), ("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
                 (f"Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g(x["chi2"], "%10.2f")), ("Prob > chi2", g(x["p"], "%10.4f"))]
        return left_, right   # VERIFY layout

    est = finish_model(s, pr, "truncreg", args, title="Truncated regression", blocks=[main], eng=eng,
                       res=res2, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=null.ll if null else SYS,
                       aux_names=[("sigma", "_cons")], aux_rows_fn=aux_rows, hdr_fn=hdr, wald=True, k_eq=2,
                       heads=False,
                       extra_scalars=[("sigma", sg)] + ([("llopt", lower)] if lower is not None else [])
                       + ([("ulopt", upper)] if upper is not None else []))
    est.predict = make_predict(lambda what, etas, th, e: etas[0] if what == "xb" else None, "xb")
    est.pred_label = "fitted values"
    display_eq(s, est)

# selection models: heckman, heckprobit, heckoprobit
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _selection_setup(s, args: str, spec: dict, outcome_constant: bool | None = None):
    """(dep name, selection variable name or None, selection varlist, rest of the options,
    _Prep) of a selection command."""
    (dep,), rest = _split_vars(args, 1)
    o = peek(rest, {**spec, "select": 3})
    if o.get("select") in (None, True):
        raise StataError(198, "option select() required")
    sel_text = str(o["select"])
    if "=" in sel_text:
        sel_name, sel_vars = (t.strip() for t in sel_text.split("=", 1))
    else:
        sel_name, sel_vars = None, sel_text.strip()
    ds = s.data
    yv = ds.get(dep).data
    n = ds.nobs
    if sel_name:
        sv = ds.get(sel_name).data
        sel_miss = sv >= SYS
        selected = (sv != 0) & ~sel_miss
        restrict = ~sel_miss & (~selected | (yv < SYS))
    else:
        selected = yv < SYS
        restrict = np.ones(n, bool)
    pr = _Prep(s, rest, spec_with_select(spec), need_dep=False, extra_vars=names_in(sel_vars, sel_name, o.get("offset")),
               restrict=restrict, constant=outcome_constant)
    pr.smp.depname = dep
    return dep, sel_name, sel_vars, pr, selected[pr.smp.mask], o


def spec_with_select(spec: dict) -> dict:
    return {**spec, "select": 3}


def _selection_common(s, pr, dep, sel_vars, selected, ncat=None, sel_name=None):
    ds = s.data
    yfull = ds.get(dep).data[pr.smp.mask].astype(float)
    y = np.where(selected & (yfull < SYS), yfull, 0.0)
    main = block_from_pr(pr, dep)
    # offset() belongs to the outcome equation (the selection equation takes its own in select())
    main.offset, main.off_name = offset_values(pr, pr.o.get("offset"), None)
    sel_blk = block_from_text(pr, sel_name or "select", sel_vars, constant=True)
    for nm in sel_blk.notes:
        s.output.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    return y, main, sel_blk


def _selected_subset(blk: Block, m) -> Block:
    return Block(blk.name, blk.cols, blk.terms, blk.constant, blk.X[m])


def _lambda_row(level, ath, lns, V2):
    """lambda = rho sigma with the delta-method standard error."""
    rho, sg = np.tanh(ath), np.exp(lns)
    gr = np.array([(1 - rho ** 2) * sg, rho * sg])
    se = float(np.sqrt(gr @ V2 @ gr))
    c = crit("z", level, None)
    val = float(rho * sg)
    return aux_row("lambda", val, se, level, ci=(val - c * se, val + c * se))


def cmd_heckman(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "heckman", args):
        return
    spec = {"twostep": 3, "offset": 3, "mills": 3}
    dep, sel_name, sel_vars, pr, selected, o = _selection_setup(s, args, spec)
    if o.get("twostep"):
        return _heckman_twostep(s, args, dep, sel_vars, pr, selected, o, sel_name)
    mills = o["mills"].strip() if isinstance(o.get("mills"), str) else None
    if mills and s.data.has(mills):
        raise StataError(110, f"{mills} already defined")
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    y, main, sel_blk = _selection_common(s, pr, dep, sel_vars, selected, sel_name=sel_name)
    sel = selected.astype(float)
    w = pr.w
    n = len(y)
    sw_ = selected
    yo = y - main.offset if main.offset is not None else y      # for the OLS start and comparison

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_ls = L.heckman(sel, y, etas[0], etas[1], th[0], th[1])
        return ll, [d_eta, d_zeta], np.column_stack([d_ath, d_ls])

    eng = Engine(lik, [main, sel_blk], w, 2)
    b0 = _heckman_start(yo, main, sel_blk, sel, w)
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, b0)
    _log(s, pr, res)
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    ath, lns = float(res.b[-2]), float(res.b[-1])
    V2 = V[-2:, -2:]
    # independent equations: probit on the selection + OLS on the selected observations
    rp = _weighted_probit(sel, sel_blk.X, w)
    Xs, ys, ws = main.X[sw_], yo[sw_], w[sw_]
    swr = np.sqrt(ws)
    bo = np.linalg.lstsq(Xs * swr[:, None], ys * swr, rcond=None)[0]
    rss = float(np.sum(ws * (ys - Xs @ bo) ** 2))
    n1 = float(ws.sum())
    ll_ols = -0.5 * n1 * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + 1 + np.log(rss / n1))
    lr = max(2 * (res.ll - (rp.ll + ll_ols)), 0.0)
    p_lr = _chi2p(lr, 1)
    n_cens, n_unc = float(w[~sw_].sum()), float(w[sw_].sum())

    def aux_rows(level):
        return [CoefRow("sep"), aux_row("/athrho", ath, float(np.sqrt(V[-2, -2])), level, name="_cons"),
                aux_row("/lnsigma", lns, float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1])), level, name="_cons"), CoefRow("sep"),
                transformed_row("rho", np.tanh, lambda x: 1 - np.tanh(x) ** 2, ath, float(np.sqrt(V[-2, -2])), level),
                transformed_row("sigma", np.exp, np.exp, lns, float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1])), level),
                _lambda_row(level, ath, lns, V2)]

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        left_ = [est.title, "(regression model with sample selection)", "", "", "",
                 f"{lab(est)} = {g(x['ll'], '%9.0g'):>9}"]
        right = [("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])), ("Censored obs", comma(n_cens)),
                 ("Uncensored obs", comma(n_unc)), ("", ""),
                 (f"{x['chi2type']} chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g(x["chi2"], "%10.2f")),
                 ("Prob > chi2", g(x["p"], "%10.4f"))]
        return left_, right

    w_rho = (ath / float(np.sqrt(V[-2, -2]))) ** 2
    p_w = _chi2p(w_rho, 1)

    def footer(s_, est):
        if pr.robust:    # with robust or cluster, the LR test is not valid: Wald test of /athrho (compat 1907)
            s_.output.write(f"Wald test of indep. eqns. (rho = 0): chi2(1) = {w_rho:8.2f}   Prob > chi2 = {p_w:6.4f}\n",
                            "text")
        else:
            s_.output.write(f"LR test of indep. eqns. (rho = 0):   chi2(1) = {lr:8.2f}   Prob > chi2 = {p_lr:6.4f}\n",
                            "text")   # VERIFY

    rho, sg = float(np.tanh(ath)), float(np.exp(lns))
    est = finish_model(s, pr, "heckman", args, title="Heckman selection model", blocks=[main, sel_blk],
                       eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=SYS,
                       aux_names=[("athrho", "_cons"), ("lnsigma", "_cons")], aux_rows_fn=aux_rows, hdr_fn=hdr,
                       depvar_cell="", footer=footer, wald=True, k_eq=4, test_idx=list(range(main.nslopes)),
                       extra_scalars=[("N_selected", n_unc), ("N_nonselected", n_cens), ("rho", rho),
                                      ("sigma", sg), ("lambda", rho * sg), ("chi2_c", lr), ("p_c", p_lr)],
                       predict_opts={"xbsel": 4, "ycond": 2, "yexpected": 2, "psel": 4})
    est.predict = make_predict(_predict_heckman, "xb")
    est.pred_label = "fitted values"
    if mills:
        # the inverse Mills ratio from the selection equation of the ML fit (compat 1918; values
        # VERIFY)
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        zg = sel_blk.X @ res.b[main.k:main.k + sel_blk.k] + (sel_blk.offset if sel_blk.offset is not None else 0.0)
        vals = np.full(s.data.nobs, SYS)
        vals[np.flatnonzero(pr.smp.mask)] = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zg) - st.norm.logcdf(zg))
        var = Variable(mills, "double", np.full(s.data.nobs, SYS))
        var.data = vals
        s.data.add(var)
    display_eq(s, est)


def _predict_heckman(what, etas, th, est):
    ath, lns = th[0], th[1]
    rho, sg = np.tanh(ath), np.exp(lns)
    if what == "xb":
        return etas[0]
    if what == "xbsel":
        return etas[1]
    if what == "pr":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[1])
    if what == "ycond":
        return etas[0] + rho * sg * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(etas[1]) - st.norm.logcdf(etas[1]))
    if what == "yexpected":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[1]) * (etas[0] + rho * sg * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(etas[1]) - st.norm.logcdf(etas[1])))
    return None


def _heckman_start(y, main, sel_blk, sel, w):
    """Two-step estimates as starting values."""
    rp = _weighted_probit(sel, sel_blk.X, w)
    zg = sel_blk.X @ rp.b
    m = sel > 0
    lam = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zg) - st.norm.logcdf(zg))
    Xs = np.column_stack([main.X[m], lam[m]])
    sw = np.sqrt(w[m])
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(Xs * sw[:, None], y[m] * sw, rcond=None)[0]
    beta, theta = coef[:-1], coef[-1]
    resid = y[m] - main.X[m] @ beta
    sig2 = float(np.sum(w[m] * resid ** 2) / np.sum(w[m]))
    sig = np.sqrt(max(sig2, 1e-8))
    rho = float(np.clip(theta / sig, -0.9, 0.9))
    return np.concatenate([beta, rp.b, [np.arctanh(rho), np.log(sig)]])


def _heckman_twostep(s, args, dep, sel_vars, pr, selected, o, sel_name=None):
    """Heckman's two-step estimates: probit for the selection, then OLS of the outcome on the
    covariates and the inverse Mills ratio, with the variance corrected for the estimated
    lambda (Heckman 1979; Greene, Econometric Analysis)."""
    from .ml import MLResult
    from .models2 import _finish  # noqa: F401  (finish_model posts through it)
    if pr.smp.wtype:
        raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed")   # VERIFY ([R] heckman: no weights with twostep)
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    y, main, sel_blk = _selection_common(s, pr, dep, sel_vars, selected, sel_name=sel_name)
    if main.offset is not None:
        y = y - main.offset
    sel = selected.astype(float)
    n = len(y)
    w = np.ones(n)
    ps = _weighted_probit(sel, sel_blk.X, w)
    Vg = np.linalg.inv(-ps.H)
    zg = sel_blk.X @ ps.b
    lam = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zg) - st.norm.logcdf(zg))
    delta = lam * (lam + zg)
    if isinstance(o.get("mills"), str):
        # the inverse Mills ratio of every observation of the estimation sample (VERIFY)
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        nm = o["mills"].strip()
        if s.data.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
        vals = np.full(s.data.nobs, SYS)
        vals[np.flatnonzero(pr.smp.mask)] = lam
        var = Variable(nm, "double", np.full(s.data.nobs, SYS))
        var.data = vals
        s.data.add(var)
    m = selected
    n1 = int(m.sum())
    Xs = np.column_stack([main.X[m], lam[m]])
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(Xs, y[m], rcond=None)[0]
    beta, theta = coef[:-1], coef[-1]
    e = y[m] - Xs @ coef
    sig2 = float(e @ e / n1 + theta ** 2 * delta[m].mean())
    sig = float(np.sqrt(sig2))
    rho = float(np.clip(theta / sig, -1.0, 1.0))
    XtXi = np.linalg.inv(Xs.T @ Xs)
    D = delta[m]
    Fm = Xs.T @ (sel_blk.X[m] * D[:, None])
    mid = Xs.T @ (Xs * (1 - rho ** 2 * D)[:, None]) + rho ** 2 * Fm @ Vg @ Fm.T
    Vs = sig2 * XtXi @ mid @ XtXi
    k1, k2 = main.k, sel_blk.k
    b_all = np.concatenate([beta, ps.b, [theta]])
    V_all = np.zeros((k1 + k2 + 1, k1 + k2 + 1))
    pos_a = list(range(k1)) + [k1 + k2]
    V_all[np.ix_(pos_a, pos_a)] = Vs
    V_all[k1:k1 + k2, k1:k1 + k2] = Vg
    res = MLResult(b_all, SYS, np.zeros(len(b_all)), np.zeros((len(b_all), len(b_all))), 0, True, [])
    n_cens, n_unc = float((~m).sum()), float(n1)
    se_l = float(np.sqrt(Vs[-1, -1]))

    def aux_rows(level):
        return [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("eq", "mills"), CoefRow("coef", "lambda", theta, se_l, name="lambda"),
                CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("value", "rho", rho, eq=f"{rho:.5f}"),
                CoefRow("value", "sigma", sig, eq=g(sig, "%10.8g"))]

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        left_ = ["Heckman selection model -- two-step estimates", "(regression model with sample selection)",
                 "", "", ""]
        right = [("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])), ("Censored obs", comma(n_cens)),
                 ("Uncensored obs", comma(n_unc)), ("", ""),
                 (f"Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g(x["chi2"], "%10.2f")), ("Prob > chi2", g(x["p"], "%10.4f"))]
        return left_, right   # VERIFY layout

    eng = Engine(lambda e_, th: (np.zeros(n), [np.zeros(n)], None), [main], w, 0)
    order = (["N", "N_selected", "N_nonselected", "df_m", "chi2", "p", "rho", "sigma", "lambda"],
             ["cmdline", "cmd", "title", "chi2type", "vce", "depvar", "properties"], [])
    idx = list(range(main.nslopes))
    est = finish_model(s, pr, "heckman", args, title="Heckman selection model -- two-step estimates",
                       blocks=[main, sel_blk], eng=eng, res=res, V=V_all, n_clust=None, ll0=SYS,
                       aux_names=[("mills", "lambda")], aux_rows_fn=aux_rows, hdr_fn=hdr, depvar_cell="",
                       wald=True, k_eq=3, test_idx=idx, order=order,
                       extra_scalars=[("N_selected", n_unc), ("N_nonselected", n_cens), ("rho", rho),
                                      ("sigma", sig), ("lambda", theta)],
                       predict_opts={"xbsel": 4, "psel": 4})
    est.predict = make_predict(_predict_heckman_two, "xb")
    est.pred_label = "fitted values"
    display_eq(s, est)


def _predict_heckman_two(what, etas, th, est):
    if what == "xb":
        return etas[0]
    if what == "xbsel":
        return etas[1]
    if what == "pr":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[1])
    return None


def _sel_header(title, n_cens, n_unc, line2=""):
    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        left_ = [title] + ([line2] if line2 else [""]) + ["", "", "", f"{lab(est)} = {g(x['ll'], '%9.0g'):>9}"]
        right = [("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])), ("Censored obs", comma(n_cens)),
                 ("Uncensored obs", comma(n_unc)), ("", ""),
                 (f"{x['chi2type']} chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g(x["chi2"], "%10.2f")),
                 ("Prob > chi2", g(x["p"], "%10.4f"))]
        return left_, right   # VERIFY layout
    return hdr


def _rho_rows(ath, se_ath, level):
    return [aux_row("/athrho", ath, se_ath, level, name="_cons"), CoefRow("sep"),
            transformed_row("rho", np.tanh, lambda x: 1 - np.tanh(x) ** 2, ath, se_ath, level)]


def _lr_footer_rho(lr, p_lr, label="LR test of indep. eqns. (rho = 0):  "):
    def footer(s_, est):
        s_.output.write(f"{label} chi2(1) = {lr:8.2f}   Prob > chi2 = {p_lr:6.4f}\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    return footer

def cmd_heckprobit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "heckprobit", args):
        return
    dep, sel_name, sel_vars, pr, selected, o = _selection_setup(s, args, {"offset": 3})
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    y, main, sel_blk = _selection_common(s, pr, dep, sel_vars, selected, sel_name=sel_name)
    yb = np.where(selected, (y != 0).astype(float), 0.0)
    if np.all(yb[selected] == yb[selected][0]):
        raise StataError(2000, "outcome does not vary; remember:\n"
                         "                                  0 = negative outcome,\n"
                         "        all other nonmissing values = positive outcome")
    sel = selected.astype(float)
    w = pr.w

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath = L.heckprobit(sel, yb, etas[0], etas[1], th[0])
        return ll, [d_eta, d_zeta], d_ath.reshape(-1, 1)

    eng = Engine(lik, [main, sel_blk], w, 1)
    ps = _weighted_probit(sel, sel_blk.X, w)
    po = _weighted_probit(yb[selected], main.X[selected], w[selected])
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, np.concatenate([po.b, ps.b, [0.0]]))
    fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting probit model:", po)
    fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting selection model:", ps)
    s.output.write(f"\nComparison:    log likelihood = {g(ps.ll + po.ll, '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
    # starting values: the outcome probit with the inverse Mills ratio of the selection equation
    zg = sel_blk.X @ ps.b
    lam_ = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zg) - st.norm.logcdf(zg))
    ysel_ = yb[selected]
    pf_, _ = _probit(ysel_, np.column_stack([main.X[selected], lam_[selected]]), w[selected])
    pst = maximize(pf_, np.concatenate([po.b, [0.0]]), maxiter=300)
    fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting starting values:", pst)
    fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting full model:", res)
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    ath, se_ath = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    lr = max(2 * (res.ll - (ps.ll + po.ll)), 0.0)
    p_lr = _chi2p(lr, 1)
    n_cens, n_unc = float(w[~selected].sum()), float(w[selected].sum())
    est = finish_model(s, pr, "heckprobit", args, title="Probit model with sample selection",
                       blocks=[main, sel_blk], eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=SYS,
                       aux_names=[("athrho", "_cons")], aux_rows_fn=lambda lv: [CoefRow("sep")] + _rho_rows(ath, se_ath, lv),
                       hdr_fn=_sel_header("Probit model with sample selection", n_cens, n_unc), depvar_cell="",
                       footer=_lr_footer_rho(lr, p_lr), wald=True, k_eq=3,
                       test_idx=list(range(main.nslopes)),
                       extra_scalars=[("N_selected", n_unc), ("N_nonselected", n_cens), ("rho", float(np.tanh(ath))),
                                      ("chi2_c", lr), ("p_c", p_lr)],
                       predict_opts={"pmargin": 4, "psel": 4, "xbsel": 4})
    est.predict = make_predict(_predict_heckprobit, "pmargin")
    est.pred_label = f"Pr({est.depvar})"
    display_eq(s, est)


def _predict_heckprobit(what, etas, th, est):
    if what == "xb":
        return etas[0]
    if what == "xbsel":
        return etas[1]
    if what == "pmargin":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[0])
    if what == "psel":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[1])
    return None

def cmd_heckoprobit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "heckoprobit", args):
        return
    dep, sel_name, sel_vars, pr, selected, o = _selection_setup(s, args, {"offset": 3}, outcome_constant=False)
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    y, main, sel_blk = _selection_common(s, pr, dep, sel_vars, selected, sel_name=sel_name)
    levels = sorted(set(y[selected].tolist()))
    J = len(levels)
    if J < 3:
        raise StataError(198, "dependent variable must have at least 3 categories")   # VERIFY
    yi = np.where(selected, np.searchsorted(levels, y), 0)
    sel = selected.astype(float)
    w = pr.w
    n = len(y)

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_cut = L.heckoprobit(sel, yi, J, etas[0], etas[1], th[:J - 1], th[J - 1])
        return ll, [d_eta, d_zeta], np.column_stack([d_cut, d_ath])

    class _Nan(Exception):
        pass

    eng = Engine(lik, [main, sel_blk], w, J)
    ps = _weighted_probit(sel, sel_blk.X, w)
    cum = np.array([np.sum(w[selected & (yi <= j)]) for j in range(J - 1)]) / np.sum(w[selected])
    cuts0 = st.norm.ppf(np.clip(cum, 1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
    # ordered probit among the selected: the model of the LR test (the selection index at +inf)
    big = np.full(n, 1e10)
    sub = selected

    def lik_o(etas, th):
        ll, d_eta, _, _, d_cut = L.heckoprobit(np.ones(sub.sum()), yi[sub], J, etas[0], big[sub], th[:J - 1], 0.0)
        return ll, [d_eta], d_cut

    mo = Block(main.name, main.cols, main.terms, main.constant, main.X[sub])
    eo = Engine(lik_o, [mo], w[sub], J - 1)
    ro = maximize(eo.fun, np.concatenate([np.zeros(main.k), cuts0]), maxiter=300)
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, np.concatenate([ro.b[:main.k], ps.b, ro.b[main.k:], [0.0]]))
    _log(s, pr, res)
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    ath, se_ath = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    lr = max(2 * (res.ll - (ps.ll + ro.ll)), 0.0)
    p_lr = _chi2p(lr, 1)
    n_cens, n_unc = float(w[~selected].sum()), float(w[selected].sum())
    cut_names = [(f"cut{j + 1}", "_cons") for j in range(J - 1)]

    def aux_rows(level):
        rows = [CoefRow("sep")]
        for j in range(J - 1):
            rows.append(aux_row(f"/cut{j + 1}", float(res.b[-J + j]), float(np.sqrt(V[-J + j, -J + j])), level,
                                name="_cons"))
        return rows + _rho_rows(ath, se_ath, level)

    est = finish_model(s, pr, "heckoprobit", args, title="Ordered probit model with sample selection",
                       blocks=[main, sel_blk], eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=SYS,
                       aux_names=cut_names + [("athrho", "_cons")], aux_rows_fn=aux_rows,
                       hdr_fn=_sel_header("Ordered probit model with sample selection", n_cens, n_unc),
                       depvar_cell="", footer=_lr_footer_rho(lr, p_lr), wald=True, k_eq=3 + J - 1,
                       test_idx=list(range(main.nslopes)),
                       extra_scalars=[("N_selected", n_unc), ("N_nonselected", n_cens), ("k_cat", float(J)),
                                      ("rho", float(np.tanh(ath))), ("chi2_c", lr), ("p_c", p_lr)])
    est.predict = make_predict(lambda what, etas, th, e: etas[0] if what == "xb" else
                               (etas[1] if what == "xbsel" else None), "xb")
    est.pred_label = "linear prediction"
    display_eq(s, est)

def _biprobit_equations(args: str):
    """((y1, x1), (y2, x2), rest of the line) for `biprobit (y1 = x1) (y2 = x2) ...`, or None."""
    t = args.strip()
    if not t.startswith("("):
        return None
    eqs = []
    for _ in range(2):
        if not t.startswith("("):
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        depth, i = 0, 0
        for i, ch in enumerate(t):
            depth += ch == "("
            depth -= ch == ")"
            if depth == 0:
                break
        body, t = t[1:i], t[i + 1:].lstrip()
        if "=" not in body:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        yv, xv = body.split("=", 1)
        eqs.append((yv.strip(), xv.strip()))
    return eqs[0], eqs[1], t


def cmd_biprobit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "biprobit", args):
        return
    eqs = _biprobit_equations(args)
    ds = s.data
    if eqs is None:
        (d1, d2), rest = _split_vars(args, 2)
        x1 = x2 = None
        first_vars = None
        rest_args = rest
        # shared regressors: the varlist after the two dependent variables
        from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
        shared = parse_standard(rest).varlist
        x1 = x2 = shared
        pr_args = rest
    else:
        (d1, x1), (d2, x2), rest = eqs
        pr_args = f"{x1} {rest}" if not rest.startswith(",") else f"{x1} {rest}"
    bad = (ds.get(d1).data >= SYS) | (ds.get(d2).data >= SYS)
    spec = {"partial": 4, "offset1": 7, "offset2": 7, "constraints": 3}
    ob = peek(pr_args, spec)
    partial = bool(ob.get("partial"))
    pr = _Prep(s, pr_args, spec, need_dep=False, restrict=~bad,
               extra_vars=names_in(x2, ob.get("offset1"), ob.get("offset2")))
    pr.smp.depname = d1
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    mask = pr.smp.mask
    y1 = (ds.get(d1).data[mask] != 0).astype(float)
    y2 = (ds.get(d2).data[mask] != 0).astype(float)
    for yy in ((y1 * y2,) if partial else (y1, y2)):
        if np.all(yy == yy[0]):
            raise StataError(2000, "outcome does not vary; remember:\n"
                             "                                  0 = negative outcome,\n"
                             "        all other nonmissing values = positive outcome")
    b1 = block_from_pr(pr, d1)
    b2 = block_from_text(pr, d2, x2, constant=pr.constant) if eqs is not None or x2 != x1 else None
    if b2 is None:
        b2 = Block(d2, b1.cols, b1.terms, b1.constant, b1.X.copy())
        # an independent copy of the columns: omitted terms are marked per equation
    for nm in b2.notes:
        s.output.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    b1.offset, b1.off_name = offset_values(pr, ob.get("offset1"), None)
    b2.offset, b2.off_name = offset_values(pr, ob.get("offset2"), None)
    w = pr.w

    if partial:
        # partial observability: only z = y1 y2 is seen, P(z = 1) = Phi2(eta1, eta2; rho)
        # ([R] biprobit, Methods and formulas)
        z = y1 * y2

        def lik(etas, th):
            return L.biprobit_partial(z, etas[0], etas[1], th[0])
    else:
        def lik(etas, th):
            ll, d1_, d2_, d_ath = L.biprobit(y1, y2, etas[0], etas[1], th[0])
            return ll, [d1_, d2_], d_ath.reshape(-1, 1)

    eng = Engine(lik, [b1, b2], w, 1)
    read_constraints(s, pr, [b1, b2], [("athrho", "_cons")])
    p1 = _weighted_probit(y1, b1.X, w, b1.offset)
    p2 = _weighted_probit(y2, b2.X, w, b2.offset)
    b0 = np.concatenate([p1.b, p2.b, [0.0]])
    if partial:
        # comparison: the partial-observability model with rho = 0, fitted from the two probits
        # (VERIFY: Stata's comparison model and log for partial)
        k12 = b1.k + b2.k
        saved = getattr(pr, "cns", None)
        pr.cns = None
        e0 = Engine(lambda et, th: (lambda r_: (r_[0], r_[1], None))(L.biprobit_partial(z, et[0], et[1], 0.0)),
                    [b1, b2], w, 0)
        c0 = pr.maximize(e0.fun, b0[:k12])
        pr.cns = saved
        b0 = np.concatenate([c0.b, [0.0]])
        res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, b0)
        fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting comparison model:", c0)
        fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting full model:", res)
        ll_c = c0.ll
    else:
        res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, b0)
        for j, (pj, dj) in enumerate(((p1, d1), (p2, d2)), 1):
            if pr.o.get("nolog"):
                break
            s.output.write(f"\nFitting comparison equation {j}:\n\n", "text")
            # Stata passes constraints() to each comparison probit, where a constraint on another
            # equation fails (compat 1922)
            for num in _foreign_constraints(s, pr.o.get("constraints"), dj):
                s.output.write(f"(note: constraint number {num} caused error r(303))\n", "text")
            from .ml import print_log
            print_log(s.output, pj, "log pseudolikelihood" if pr.robust else "log likelihood")
        s.output.write(f"\nComparison:    log likelihood = {g(p1.ll + p2.ll, '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
        fit_log(s, pr, "Fitting full model:", res)
        ll_c = p1.ll + p2.ll
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    ath, se_ath = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    lr = max(2 * (res.ll - ll_c), 0.0)
    p_lr = _chi2p(lr, 1)
    title_bp = ("Partial observability bivariate probit" if partial      # VERIFY title
                else "Seemingly unrelated bivariate probit" if eqs is not None else "Bivariate probit regression")

    constrained = pr.o.get("constraints") not in (None, True, False)
    w_rho = (ath / se_ath) ** 2 if se_ath > 0 else SYS
    if constrained:
        # with constraints Stata reports the Wald test of rho = 0 (compat 1922)
        p_w = _chi2p(w_rho, 1) if w_rho < SYS else SYS

        def bp_footer(s_, est):
            val = g(w_rho, '%8.0g') if w_rho < SYS else "."
            pv = f"{p_w:6.4f}" if p_w < SYS else "."
            s_.output.write(f"Wald test of rho=0:{'':17}chi2(1) ={val:>9}    Prob > chi2 = {pv:>6}\n", "text")
    else:
        def bp_footer(s_, est):
            s_.output.write(f"Likelihood-ratio test of rho=0:     chi2(1) ={g(lr, '%8.0g'):>9}    Prob > chi2 = {p_lr:6.4f}\n",
                            "text")
    slopes = list(range(b1.nslopes)) + [b1.k + i for i in range(b2.nslopes)]

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        left_ = [est.title, "", f"{lab(est)} = {g(x['ll'], '%10.0g'):>10}"]
        right = [("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])), (f"{x['chi2type']} chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g(x["chi2"], "%10.2f")),
                 ("Prob > chi2", g(x["p"], "%10.4f"))]
        return left_, right   # VERIFY layout

    est = finish_model(s, pr, "biprobit", args, title=title_bp, blocks=[b1, b2],
                       eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=SYS, aux_names=[("athrho", "_cons")],
                       aux_rows_fn=lambda lv: [CoefRow("sep")] + _rho_rows(ath, se_ath, lv), hdr_fn=hdr,
                       depvar_cell="", wald=True, k_eq=3, test_idx=slopes,
                       footer=bp_footer,
                       extra_scalars=[("rho", float(np.tanh(ath)))] + ([("ll_c", ll_c)] if partial else []) +
                                     [("chi2_c", w_rho if constrained else lr), ("k_dv", 2.0), ("k_eq_model", 2.0)],
                       extra_macros=[("depvar", f"{d1} {d2}"), ("predict", "bipr_p"),
                                     ("chi2_ct", "Wald" if constrained else "LR"),
                                     ("user", "bipp_lf" if partial else "bipr_lf"), ("ml_method", "e2")],
                       # e() as Stata lists it (compat 1922; without constraints, VERIFY)
                       order=(["rank", "N", "ic", "k", "k_eq", "k_dv", "converged", "rc", "ll", "N_clust", "df_m",
                               "chi2", "p", "rho", "ll_c", "chi2_c", "k_aux", "k_eq_model"],
                              ["cmdline", "cmd", "predict", "chi2_ct", "chi2type", "opt", "vce", "vcetype", "clustvar",
                               "title", "user", "ml_method", "technique", "which", "wtype", "wexp", "depvar",
                               "properties"],
                              ["Cns", "ilog", "gradient"]),
                       predict_opts={"xb1": 3, "xb2": 3, "pmarg1": 6, "pmarg2": 6, "p11": 3, "p10": 3, "p01": 3, "p00": 3})
    est.depvar = d1
    est.predict = make_predict(_predict_biprobit, "pmarg1")
    est.pred_label = f"Pr({d1})"
    display_eq(s, est)


def _foreign_constraints(s, numlist, eqname):
    """The constraints in numlist that name an equation other than eqname ([athrho]_cons, [y2]x1),
    which a single-equation probit cannot apply."""
    if numlist in (None, True, False):
        return []
    import re
    from .sysmodels import _constraints, _numlist
    defined = _constraints(s)
    out = []
    for num in _numlist(str(numlist)):
        eqs = re.findall(r"\[\s*([^\]]+?)\s*\]", defined.get(num, ""))
        if any(e != eqname for e in eqs):
            out.append(num)
    return out


def _predict_biprobit(what, etas, th, est):
    from ..core.bvnorm import bvn_cdf
    rho = np.tanh(th[0])
    if what == "xb1":
        return etas[0]
    if what == "xb2":
        return etas[1]
    if what == "pmarg1":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[0])
    if what == "pmarg2":
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[1])
    if what == "p11":
        return bvn_cdf(etas[0], etas[1], rho)
    if what == "p10":
        return bvn_cdf(etas[0], -etas[1], -rho)
    if what == "p01":
        return bvn_cdf(-etas[0], etas[1], -rho)
    if what == "p00":
        return bvn_cdf(-etas[0], -etas[1], rho)
    return None

([R] clogit, [R] rologit, [R] asclogit, [R] slogit, [R] mprobit, [R] asmprobit, [R] asroprobit).
The likelihoods are in core/choice.py; the layout of the equations in mleq.py.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
from .mleq import (Block, Engine, add_base_row, aux_row, display_eq, finish_model, lab, names_in, peek, std_right)
from .models2 import _Prep, _header, g
from .regress import comma

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _replay(s, cmd, args) -> bool:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return True
    return False


def _group_values(pr, name: str) -> np.ndarray:
    ds = pr.s.data
    var = ds.get(name)
    vals = var.data[pr.smp.mask]
    if var.is_string:
        codes = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(sorted(set(vals)))}
        return np.array([codes[v] for v in vals], dtype=float)
    return vals.astype(float)


def _restrict(pr, keep: np.ndarray) -> None:
    """Drops observations from the sample of a prepared command (groups that carry no information)."""
    if keep.all():
        return
    smp = pr.smp
    full = np.flatnonzero(smp.mask)
    smp.mask = smp.mask.copy()
    smp.mask[full[~keep]] = False
    smp.n = int(smp.mask.sum())
    pr.w = pr.w[keep]
    pr.y = pr.y[keep]
    pr.X = pr.X[keep]
    pr.N = float(pr.w.sum()) if smp.wtype in ("fweight", "iweight") else float(smp.n)
    if getattr(smp, "cluster", None) is not None and len(np.atleast_1d(smp.cluster)) == len(keep):
        smp.cluster = smp.cluster[keep]
    for c in smp.cols:
        if c.values is not None:
            c.values = c.values[keep]


def _notes_dropped(s, name: str, ngroups: int, nobs: int, why: str) -> None:
    if ngroups:
        s.output.write(f"note: {ngroups} group{'s' if ngroups != 1 else ''} ({nobs} obs) dropped because of "
                       f"{why}\n", "text")


def _group_setup(s, args: str, spec: dict, cmd: str):
    o = peek(args, spec)
    if o.get("group") in (None, True):
        raise StataError(100, "option group() required")
    gname = resolve_name(s.data, str(o["group"]).strip())
    pr = _Prep(s, args, spec, constant=False, extra_vars=names_in(gname, o.get("offset")))
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    gid = _group_values(pr, gname)
    return pr, o, gname, gid


def _cluster_by_group(pr, gname: str, gid: np.ndarray) -> None:
    """vce(robust) in these commands clusters on the group variable."""
    smp = pr.smp
    if pr.robust and smp.vce == "robust":
        smp.vce, smp.clustvar = "cluster", gname
        smp.cluster = gid.copy()


def _block(pr, name: str, X: np.ndarray) -> Block:
    return Block(name, pr.smp.cols, pr.smp.terms, False, X)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_clogit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "clogit", args):
        return
    spec = {"group": 1, "or": 2, "offset": 3, "strata": 4}
    pr, o, gname, gid = _group_setup(s, args, spec, "clogit")
    y = (pr.y != 0).astype(float)
    groups = C.group_index(gid)
    # groups with only positive or only negative outcomes carry no information
    drop_g = [idx for idx in groups if y[idx].min() == y[idx].max()]
    if drop_g:
        keep = np.ones(len(y), dtype=bool)
        for idx in drop_g:
            keep[idx] = False
        _notes_dropped(s, "clogit", len(drop_g), int(sum(len(i) for i in drop_g)),
                       "all positive or all negative outcomes.")
        if not keep.any():
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        _restrict(pr, keep)
        y, gid = y[keep], gid[keep]
        groups = C.group_index(gid)
    if any(y[idx].sum() > 1 for idx in groups):
        s.output.write("note: multiple positive outcomes within groups encountered.\n", "text")
    _cluster_by_group(pr, gname, gid)
    main = _block(pr, pr.smp.depname, pr.X)
    w = pr.w

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d = C.clogit(etas[0], y, groups)
        return ll, [d], None

    eng = Engine(lik, [main], w, 0)
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, np.zeros(main.k))
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, _group_scores(eng, res.b, groups) if pr.robust else None)
    ll0 = C.clogit_null(y, groups)
    ngroups = len(groups)
    nalt = np.array([len(i) for i in groups])

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        ll4 = g(x["ll"], "%10.0g").strip()
        left = [est.title, "", "", "", "", f"{lab(est)} = {ll4:>9}"]
        right = [("", ""), ("", "")] + std_right(x)
        if est.robust:
            right = [r for r in right if r[0] != "Pseudo R2"] + [("Pseudo R2", g(1 - x["ll"] / ll0, "%10.4f"))]
        return left, right

    est = finish_model(s, pr, "clogit", args, title="Conditional (fixed-effects) logistic regression",
                       blocks=[main], eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=ll0, aux_names=[],
                       aux_rows_fn=lambda lev: [], hdr_fn=hdr, k_eq=1, r2p=1 - res.ll / ll0 if ll0 else None,
                       extra_scalars=[("N_g", float(ngroups)), ("g_min", float(nalt.min())),
                                      ("g_avg", float(nalt.mean())), ("g_max", float(nalt.max())),
                                      ("k_out", float(sum(1 for idx in groups if y[idx].sum() > 0)))],
                       extra_macros=[("group", gname)])
    est.group_cluster = True
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = ("Odds Ratio", True) if o.get("or") else ("Coef.", False)
    display_eq(s, est)
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "Coef.", False


def _group_scores(eng, b, groups) -> np.ndarray:
    """Scores of the groups (one row each), the ones the sandwich needs when the groups are the
    clusters; the observation scores summed within the group."""
    S = eng.scores(b)
    return S

def cmd_rologit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "rologit", args):
        return
    spec = {"group": 1, "ties": 2, "reverse": 3, "or": 2, "offset": 3, "incomplete": 3, "notestrg": 6}
    pr, o, gname, gid = _group_setup(s, args, spec, "rologit")
    ties = str(o.get("ties", "exactm")).strip().lower()
    for full in ("none", "exactm", "breslow", "efron"):
        if full.startswith(ties) and ties:
            ties = full
            break
    else:
        raise StataError(198, "option ties() invalid")   # VERIFY
    rank = pr.y.astype(float)
    if o.get("reverse"):
        rank = -rank
    groups = C.group_index(gid)
    drop_g = [idx for idx in groups if len(idx) < 2 or rank[idx].min() == rank[idx].max()]
    if drop_g:
        keep = np.ones(len(rank), dtype=bool)
        for idx in drop_g:
            keep[idx] = False
        _notes_dropped(s, "rologit", len(drop_g), int(sum(len(i) for i in drop_g)),
                       "all alternatives tied or a single alternative")   # VERIFY
        if not keep.any():
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        _restrict(pr, keep)
        rank, gid = rank[keep], gid[keep]
        groups = C.group_index(gid)
    if ties == "none" and any(len(np.unique(rank[i])) < len(i) for i in groups):
        raise StataError(459, "ties found in the rankings; specify ties()")   # VERIFY
    _cluster_by_group(pr, gname, gid)
    main = _block(pr, pr.smp.depname, pr.X)
    w = pr.w

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d = C.rologit(etas[0], rank, groups, ties)
        return ll, [d], None

    eng = Engine(lik, [main], w, 0)
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, np.zeros(main.k))
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    ll0 = float(sum(C.rologit_group(np.zeros(len(i)), rank[i], ties)[0] for i in groups))
    nalt = np.array([len(i) for i in groups])
    ngroups = len(groups)

    no_ties = all(len(np.unique(rank[i])) == len(i) for i in groups)
    ties_txt = "No ties in data" if no_ties else f"Ties handled via the {ties} method"   # VERIFY wording

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        ll4 = g(x["ll"], "%9.0g")
        left = [est.title, f"Group variable: {gname}", "", ties_txt, "", "", "", "", "",
                f"{lab(est)} = {ll4:>9}"]
        right = [("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])), ("Number of groups", comma(ngroups)), ("", ""),
                 ("Obs per group:", None), (f"{'min':>17} ", comma(nalt.min())),
                 (f"{'avg':>17} ", g(nalt.mean(), "%10.2f")), (f"{'max':>17} ", comma(nalt.max())),
                 ("", "")] + [r for r in std_right(x)[1:] if r[0] != "Pseudo R2"]
        return left, right

    est = finish_model(s, pr, "rologit", args, title="Rank-ordered logistic regression", blocks=[main],
                       eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=ll0, aux_names=[], aux_rows_fn=lambda lev: [],
                       hdr_fn=hdr, k_eq=1, r2p=None, extra_scalars=[("N_g", float(ngroups)),
                       ("g_min", float(nalt.min())), ("g_avg", float(nalt.mean())), ("g_max", float(nalt.max()))],
                       extra_macros=[("group", gname), ("ties", ties)])
    est.group_cluster = True
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = ("Odds Ratio", True) if o.get("or") else ("Coef.", False)
    display_eq(s, est)
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "Coef.", False

def _alt_names(ds, altvar: str, levels: np.ndarray) -> list[str]:
    var = ds.get(altvar)
    labels = ds.value_labels.get(var.value_label, {}) if var.value_label else {}
    out = []
    for v in levels:
        if var.is_string:
            out.append(str(v))
        else:
            iv = int(v)
            out.append(labels.get(iv, str(iv)))
    return out


def _alt_setup(s, args: str, spec: dict, cmd: str):
    o = peek(args, spec)
    for key in ("case", "alternatives"):
        if o.get(key) in (None, True):
            raise StataError(100, f"option {key}() required")
    ds = s.data
    case = resolve_name(ds, str(o["case"]).strip())
    alt = resolve_name(ds, str(o["alternatives"]).strip())
    casevars = str(o.get("casevars", "")).strip()
    pr = _Prep(s, args, spec, constant=False, extra_vars=names_in(case, alt, casevars))
    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    cid = _group_values(pr, case)
    mask = pr.smp.mask
    avar = ds.get(alt)
    araw = avar.data[mask]
    if avar.is_string:
        levels = np.array(sorted(set(araw)))
        acode = np.array([int(np.searchsorted(levels, v)) for v in araw])
        lev_names = [str(v) for v in levels]
    else:
        levels = np.unique(araw.astype(float))
        acode = np.searchsorted(levels, araw.astype(float))
        lev_names = _alt_names(ds, alt, levels)
    return pr, o, case, alt, casevars, cid, acode, levels, lev_names


class _Alt:
    """Design of the commands on case/alternative data (long form)."""


def _asc_design(s, args: str, spec: dict, cmd: str, *, ranking: bool = False) -> _Alt:
    from .mleq import block_from_text
    pr, o, case, alt, casevars, cid, acode, levels, lev_names = _alt_setup(s, args, spec, cmd)
    d = _Alt()
    d.pr, d.o, d.case, d.alt, d.cid, d.acode, d.levels, d.lev_names = pr, o, case, alt, cid, acode, levels, lev_names
    y = (pr.y != 0).astype(float) if not ranking else pr.y.astype(float)
    cases = C.group_index(cid)
    if ranking:
        bad = [idx for idx in cases if len(np.unique(y[idx])) < len(idx)]
        why = "ties in the rankings"
    else:
        bad = [idx for idx in cases if y[idx].sum() != 1]
        why = ""
    if bad:
        keep = np.ones(len(y), dtype=bool)
        for idx in bad:
            keep[idx] = False
        if ranking:
            s.output.write(f"note: {len(bad)} case{'s' if len(bad) != 1 else ''} ({int(sum(len(i) for i in bad))} obs) "
                           "dropped because of ties or missing rankings\n", "text")   # VERIFY text
        else:
            n_no = sum(1 for idx in bad if y[idx].sum() == 0)
            if n_no:
                s.output.write(f"note: {n_no} case{'s' if n_no != 1 else ''} "
                               f"({int(sum(len(i) for i in bad if y[i].sum() == 0))} obs) "
                               "dropped because of no positive outcome\n", "text")   # VERIFY text
            n_mu = len(bad) - n_no
            if n_mu:
                s.output.write(f"note: {n_mu} case{'s' if n_mu != 1 else ''} "
                               f"({int(sum(len(i) for i in bad if y[i].sum() > 1))} obs) "
                               "dropped because of multiple positive outcomes\n", "text")   # VERIFY text
        if not keep.any():
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        _restrict(pr, keep)
        y, cid, acode = y[keep], cid[keep], acode[keep]
        d.cid, d.acode = cid, acode
        cases = C.group_index(cid)
    d.y, d.cases = y, cases
    counts = np.bincount(acode, minlength=len(levels))
    base_opt = o.get("basealternative")
    if base_opt in (None, True):
        base = int(np.argmax(counts))
    else:
        b_txt = str(base_opt).strip()
        names_l = [n.lower() for n in lev_names]
        if b_txt.lower() in names_l:
            base = names_l.index(b_txt.lower())
        else:
            try:
                base = int(np.flatnonzero(levels.astype(float) == float(b_txt))[0])
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                raise StataError(198, f"alternative {b_txt} not found")   # VERIFY
    d.base = base
    _cluster_by_group(pr, case, cid)
    smp = pr.smp
    d.n = smp.n
    d.main = Block(alt, smp.cols, smp.terms, False, pr.X)
    d.blocks = [d.main]
    casevars = str(o.get("casevars", "")).strip()
    for j in range(len(levels)):
        if j == base:
            continue
        ind = (acode == j).astype(float)
        blk = block_from_text(pr, lev_names[j], casevars, constant=not o.get("noconstant"))
        blk.X = blk.X * ind[:, None]
        d.blocks.append(blk)
    d.ncase = len(cases)
    d.nalt = np.array([len(i) for i in cases])
    return d


def _asc_header(d: _Alt, title: str):
    def hdr(est):
        def write(s_):
            out, x = s_.output, est.extra
            ll = g(x["ll"], "%10.0g").strip()
            llab = getattr(est, "ll_label", None) or lab(est)
            out.write("\n", "text")
            for lft, lb, val in ((est.title, "Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
                                 (f"Case variable: {d.case}", "Number of cases", comma(d.ncase))):
                out.write(f"{lft:<47}{lb:<19}= ", "text")
                out.write(f"{val:>10}\n", "result")
            out.write("\n", "text")
            for lft, lb, val in ((f"Alternative variable: {d.alt}", "Alts per case: min", comma(d.nalt.min())),
                                 ("", f"{'avg':>18}", g(d.nalt.mean(), "%10.1f")),
                                 ("", f"{'max':>18}", comma(d.nalt.max()))):
                out.write(f"{lft:<47}{lb:<19}= ", "text")
                out.write(f"{val:>10}\n", "result")
            ints = getattr(est, "int_lines", None)
            if ints:
                out.write(f"{'Integration sequence:':<21}{ints[0]:>16}\n", "text")
                out.write(f"{'Integration points:':<19}{ints[1]:>18}".ljust(50), "text")
            else:
                out.write("\n", "text")
                out.write("".ljust(50), "text")
            out.write(f"{f'Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})':<16}= ", "text")
            out.write(f"{g(x['chi2'], '%10.2f'):>10}\n", "result")
            out.write(f"{llab} = {ll}".ljust(50), "text")
            out.write(f"{'Prob > chi2':<16}= ", "text")
            out.write(f"{g(x['p'], '%10.4f'):>10}\n\n", "result")
        return write
    return hdr


def _asc_finish(s, args, cmd, title, d: _Alt, eng, res, V, n_clust, ll0, *, aux_names=(), aux_rows_fn=None,
                extra_scalars=(), extra_macros=()):
    idx = []
    for j, blk in enumerate(d.blocks):
        idx += list(range(eng.offs[j], eng.offs[j] + blk.nslopes))

    est = finish_model(s, d.pr, cmd, args, title=title, blocks=d.blocks, eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust,
                       ll0=ll0, aux_names=list(aux_names), aux_rows_fn=aux_rows_fn or (lambda lev: []),
                       hdr_fn=_asc_header(d, title), wald=True, test_idx=idx, df_m=len(idx),
                       k_eq=len(d.blocks), heads=True, noeform_after_first=False,
                       extra_scalars=[("N_case", float(d.ncase)), ("k_alt", float(len(d.levels))),
                                      ("alt_min", float(d.nalt.min())), ("alt_avg", float(d.nalt.mean())),
                                      ("alt_max", float(d.nalt.max())), ("i_base", float(d.base + 1))]
                       + list(extra_scalars),
                       extra_macros=[("case", d.case), ("altvar", d.alt), ("base", d.lev_names[d.base])]
                       + list(extra_macros))
    nxt = next((d.lev_names[j] for j in range(d.base + 1, len(d.levels))), None)
    add_base_row(est, d.lev_names[d.base], "(base alternative)", nxt)
    return est


def cmd_asclogit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "asclogit", args):
        return
    spec = {"case": 4, "alternatives": 3, "casevars": 5, "basealternative": 3, "altwise": 3, "or": 2,
            "offset": 3, "noconstant": 4}
    d = _asc_design(s, args, spec, "asclogit")
    pr, o = d.pr, d.o

    def lik(etas, th):
        eta = np.zeros(d.n)
        for e in etas:
            eta = eta + e
        ll, dd = C.clogit(eta, d.y, d.cases)
        return ll, [dd] * len(etas), None

    eng = Engine(lik, d.blocks, pr.w, 0)
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, np.zeros(eng.K))
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    est = _asc_finish(s, args, "asclogit", "Alternative-specific conditional logit", d, eng, res, V, n_clust,
                      C.clogit_null(d.y, d.cases))
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = ("Odds Ratio", True) if o.get("or") else ("Coef.", False)
    display_eq(s, est)
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "Coef.", False
