"""Kaplan-Meier and Nelson-Aalen estimates: sts list, sts generate,
sts test and sts graph ([ST] sts, [ST] sts list, [ST] sts generate,
[ST] sts test, [ST] sts graph).

Formulas from [ST] sts, Methods and formulas: product-limit estimate with
delayed entry, Greenwood standard error and the confidence interval on
the ln(-ln S) scale; the log-rank and Wilcoxon (Breslow) tests use the
hypergeometric variance. Layout details carry the VERIFY mark
(compat/do/0901_st.do).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options
from ..lazy import lazy
from .st import STData, _level_label, _qualifiers, header, require_st, st_data
from .results import g9

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


@dataclass
class KM:
    times: np.ndarray       # times where something happens (exit or entry)
    n: np.ndarray           # number at risk just before the time
    d: np.ndarray           # failures at the time
    c: np.ndarray           # censored at the time
    e: np.ndarray           # entries at the time (they join the risk set after it)
    S: np.ndarray           # survivor function just after the time
    gw: np.ndarray          # Greenwood sum of d/(n(n-d))
    H: np.ndarray           # Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard
    hv: np.ndarray          # sum of d/n^2 (variance of H)


def km(t: np.ndarray, t0: np.ndarray, d: np.ndarray, w: np.ndarray) -> KM:
    ent = t0[t0 > 0]
    times = np.unique(np.concatenate([t, ent]))
    ts, t0s = np.sort(t), np.sort(t0)
    # at risk at time x: t0 < x <= t  ->  #(t >= x) - #(t0 >= x)
    o_t, o_t0 = np.argsort(t, kind="stable"), np.argsort(t0, kind="stable")
    cw_t = np.concatenate([np.cumsum(w[o_t][::-1])[::-1], [0.0]])
    cw_t0 = np.concatenate([np.cumsum(w[o_t0][::-1])[::-1], [0.0]])
    n = cw_t[np.searchsorted(ts, times, "left")] - cw_t0[np.searchsorted(t0s, times, "left")]
    idx = np.searchsorted(times, t)
    dd = np.bincount(idx, weights=w * d, minlength=len(times))
    cc = np.bincount(idx, weights=w * (1 - d), minlength=len(times))
    ee = np.zeros(len(times))
    if ent.size:
        np.add.at(ee, np.searchsorted(times, t0[t0 > 0]), w[t0 > 0])
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        q = np.where(n > 0, 1 - dd / np.where(n > 0, n, 1), 1.0)
        S = np.cumprod(q)
        term = np.where((dd > 0) & (n > dd), dd / (n * (n - dd)), 0.0)
        gw = np.cumsum(term)
        gw = np.where(np.cumsum((dd > 0) & (n <= dd)) > 0, np.inf, gw)
        H = np.cumsum(np.where(n > 0, dd / np.where(n > 0, n, 1), 0.0))
        hv = np.cumsum(np.where(n > 0, dd / np.where(n > 0, n, 1) ** 2, 0.0))
    return KM(times, n, dd, cc, ee, S, gw, H, hv)


def at_times(k: KM, x: np.ndarray, what: str) -> np.ndarray:
    """Step function evaluated at x (value just after x)."""
    j = np.searchsorted(k.times, x, "right") - 1
    arr = getattr(k, what)
    base = {"S": 1.0, "gw": 0.0, "H": 0.0, "hv": 0.0}[what]
    return np.where(j >= 0, arr[np.maximum(j, 0)], base)


def km_ci(S: np.ndarray, gw: np.ndarray, level: float) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Greenwood standard error and interval on the ln(-ln S) scale ([ST] sts)."""
    z = st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - level / 100) / 2)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        se = S * np.sqrt(gw)
        lns = np.log(S)
        sig = np.sqrt(gw) / np.abs(lns)
        lo = S ** np.exp(z * sig)
        hi = S ** np.exp(-z * sig)
    ok = (S > 0) & (S < 1) & np.isfinite(gw)
    # before the first failure (S = 1) the standard error is shown as missing (compat 0901)
    return (np.where(np.isfinite(se) & (S > 0) & (S < 1), se, SYS), np.where(ok, lo, SYS), np.where(ok, hi, SYS))


def quantile_time(k: KM, p: float) -> float:
    """Smallest failure time with S(t) <= 1 - p (VERIFY: <= or <)."""
    target = 1 - p
    hit = np.nonzero((k.d > 0) & (k.S <= target + 1e-12))[0]
    return float(k.times[hit[0]]) if hit.size else SYS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sts dispatcher
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_sts(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    text = args.strip()
    word = text.split(None, 1)[0] if text and not text.startswith(",") else ""
    w = word.split(",", 1)[0]
    rest = text[len(w):] if w else text
    if w and len(w) >= 1 and "list".startswith(w):
        sts_list(s, rest)
    elif w and len(w) >= 1 and "generate".startswith(w):
        sts_generate(s, rest)
    elif w and len(w) >= 1 and "test".startswith(w):
        sts_test(s, rest)
    elif w and len(w) >= 1 and "graph".startswith(w):
        sts_graph(s, rest)
    elif not w:
        sts_graph(s, rest)
    else:
        raise StataError(198, f"{word} invalid subcommand")   # VERIFY


def _by_groups(s: "Session", mask: np.ndarray, byvars: list[str]):
    """[(label, STData)] for each combination of by() (a single group without by())."""
    if not byvars:
        return [("", st_data(s, mask))]
    from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
    ds = s.data
    names = [resolve_name(ds, v) for v in byvars]
    base = st_data(s, mask)
    cols = [ds.get(v).data for v in names]
    valid = base.mask.copy()
    for v, c in zip(names, cols):
        if not ds.get(v).is_string:
            valid &= c < SYS
    keys = sorted({tuple(c[i] for c in cols) for i in np.nonzero(valid)[0]})
    out = []
    for key in keys:
        m = valid.copy()
        for c, kv in zip(cols, key):
            m &= c == kv
        lab = ", ".join(f"{v} = {_level_label(s, v, kv)}" for v, kv in zip(names, key))
        out.append((lab, st_data(s, m), names, key))
    return [(g[0], g[1]) for g in out]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sts list
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def sts_list(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _vl, mask, o = _qualifiers(s, args, {"by": 2, "failure": 1, "at": 2, "level": 1, "noshow": 6,
                                         "enter": 5, "compare": 3, "survival": 3})
    info = require_st(s)
    if not o.get("noshow"):
        header(s, info)
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    byv = str(o["by"]).split() if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else []
    fail = bool(o.get("failure"))
    out = s.output
    lv = f"{level:g}"
    func = "Failure" if fail else "Survivor"
    at = None
    if o.get("at"):
        from ..lang.words import parse_numlist
        at = np.array(parse_numlist(str(o["at"])), dtype=float)
    if at is None:
        out.write(f"{'':11}Beg.          Net{'':12}{func:>8}      Std.\n", "text")
        out.write(f"  Time    Total   Fail   Lost{'':11}Function     Error     [{lv}% Conf. Int.]\n", "text")
    else:
        out.write(f"{'':14}Beg.{'':22}{func:<8}      Std.\n", "text")
        out.write(f"    Time     Total     Fail{'':13}Function     Error     [{lv}% Conf. Int.]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
    groups = _by_groups(s, mask, byv)
    for lab, sd in groups:
        if lab:
            out.write(f"{lab.replace(' = ', '=')} \n", "text")    # VERIFY
        k = km(sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d, sd.w)
        se, lo, hi = km_ci(k.S, k.gw, level)
        if at is None:
            for i in range(len(k.times)):
                if sd.ids is not None and k.d[i] == 0 and k.c[i] == k.e[i]:
                    continue        # a subject's record boundary: nothing happens (VERIFY)
                S, a, b = k.S[i], lo[i], hi[i]
                if fail:
                    S, a, b = 1 - S, (1 - b if b < SYS else SYS), (1 - a if a < SYS else SYS)
                _list_row(out, k.times[i], k.n[i], k.d[i], k.c[i] - k.e[i], S, se[i], a, b)
        else:
            prev = -np.inf
            for x in at:
                sel = (k.times > prev) & (k.times <= x)
                # Beg. Total is the number at risk at the last listed time on or before x
                # (compat 0901)
                j = np.searchsorted(k.times, x, "right") - 1
                nb = float(k.n[j]) if j >= 0 else at_risk(sd, x)
                S = float(k.S[j]) if j >= 0 else 1.0
                sev = float(se[j]) if j >= 0 else SYS
                a, b = (float(lo[j]), float(hi[j])) if j >= 0 else (SYS, SYS)
                if fail:
                    S, a, b = 1 - S, (1 - b if b < SYS else SYS), (1 - a if a < SYS else SYS)
                _at_row(out, x, nb, float(k.d[sel].sum()), S, sev, a, b)
                prev = x
    out.write("-" * 79 + "\n", "text")
    if at is not None:
        out.write(f"Note: {func} function is calculated over full data and evaluated at indicated times; "
                  "it is not calculated from aggregates shown at left.\n", "text")


def _fmt4(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{v:.4f}" if v < SYS else "."


def _at_row(out, t, n, d, S, se, lo, hi) -> None:
    out.write(f"{g9(t, '%8.0g'):>8}{g9(n, '%9.0g'):>10}{g9(d, '%8.0g'):>9}", "result")
    out.write(f"{_fmt4(S):>20}{_fmt4(se):>10}{_fmt4(lo):>11}{_fmt4(hi):>10}\n", "result")


def at_risk(sd: STData, x: float) -> float:
    return float(np.sum(sd.w[(sd.t0 < x) & (sd.t >= x)]))


def _list_row(out, t, n, d, lost, S, se, lo, hi) -> None:
    out.write(f"{g9(t, '%6.0g'):>6} {g9(n, '%8.0g'):>8} {g9(d, '%6.0g'):>6} {g9(lost, '%6.0g'):>6}", "result")
    out.write(f"{_fmt4(S):>19} {_fmt4(se):>9} {_fmt4(lo):>10} {_fmt4(hi):>9}\n", "result")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sts generate
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_GEN_FUNCS = ("s", "se(s)", "lb(s)", "ub(s)", "na", "se(na)", "lb(na)", "ub(na)", "n", "d", "h")


def sts_generate(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    text = args.strip()
    c = find_top(text, ",")
    body, opts = (text, "") if c == -1 else (text[:c], text[c + 1:])
    o = match_options(opts, {"by": 2, "level": 1, "adjustfor": 3}) if opts.strip() else {}
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    pairs = []
    toks = body.replace("=", " = ").split()
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        if i + 2 >= len(toks) or toks[i + 1] != "=":
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        name, fn = toks[i], toks[i + 2].replace(" ", "").lower()
        if fn not in _GEN_FUNCS:
            raise StataError(198, f"{toks[i + 2]} invalid")   # VERIFY
        pairs.append((name, fn))
        i += 3
    if not pairs:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    ds = s.data
    for name, _ in pairs:
        if ds.has(name):
            raise StataError(110, f"{name} already defined")
    require_st(s)
    byv = str(o["by"]).split() if isinstance(o.get("by"), str) else []
    vals = {name: np.full(ds.nobs, SYS) for name, _ in pairs}
    z = st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - level / 100) / 2)
    for _lab, sd in _by_groups(s, np.ones(ds.nobs, dtype=bool), byv):
        k = km(sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d, sd.w)
        x = sd.t
        S = at_times(k, x, "S")
        gw = at_times(k, x, "gw")
        # the Greenwood sum goes through a float temporary, as Stata's ado-file appears to do:
        # with a double sum lb(s) differs in the last displayed digit (VERIFY, compat 0901)
        gw = np.where(np.isfinite(gw), gw.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64), gw)
        H = at_times(k, x, "H")
        hv = at_times(k, x, "hv")
        se, lo, hi = km_ci(S, gw, level)
        j = np.searchsorted(k.times, x)
        for name, fn in pairs:
            if fn == "s":
                v = S
            elif fn == "se(s)":
                v = se
            elif fn == "lb(s)":
                v = lo
            elif fn == "ub(s)":
                v = hi
            elif fn == "na":
                v = H
            elif fn == "se(na)":
                v = np.sqrt(hv)
            elif fn in ("lb(na)", "ub(na)"):
                with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
                    f = np.exp((-1 if fn == "lb(na)" else 1) * z * np.sqrt(hv) / H)
                v = np.where(H > 0, H * f, SYS)   # VERIFY: transformation used by Stata
            elif fn == "n":
                v = k.n[j]
            elif fn == "d":
                v = k.d[j]
            else:   # h: hazard contribution d/n at the time
                v = np.where(k.n[j] > 0, k.d[j] / np.where(k.n[j] > 0, k.n[j], 1), SYS)
            arr = vals[name]
            arr[sd.mask] = np.where(np.isfinite(v), v, SYS)
    for name, _ in pairs:
        v = vals[name]
        ok = v < SYS
        out_v = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        out_v[ok] = v[ok].astype(np.float32)
        ds.add(Variable(name, "float", out_v))
    s.notify_state()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sts test
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def sts_test(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
    from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
    vl, mask, o = _qualifiers(s, args, {"logrank": 1, "wilcoxon": 1, "tware": 2, "peto": 2,
                                        "strata": 3, "detail": 3, "noshow": 6, "trend": 3})
    info = require_st(s)
    names = [resolve_name(s.data, v) for v in s.expand_varlist(vl)] if vl else []
    if not names:
        raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
    test = "wilcoxon" if o.get("wilcoxon") else "tware" if o.get("tware") else \
        "peto" if o.get("peto") else "logrank"
    if not o.get("noshow"):
        header(s, info)
    ds = s.data
    sd = st_data(s, mask)
    cols = [ds.get(v).data[sd.mask] for v in names]
    ok = np.ones(len(sd.t), dtype=bool)
    for v, c in zip(names, cols):
        if not ds.get(v).is_string:
            ok &= c < SYS
    keys = [tuple(c[i] for c in cols) for i in range(len(sd.t))]
    levels = sorted({kk for kk, good in zip(keys, ok) if good})
    G = len(levels)
    grp = np.array([levels.index(kk) if good else -1 for kk, good in zip(keys, ok)])
    strat = np.zeros(len(sd.t), dtype=int)
    svars: list[str] = []
    if isinstance(o.get("strata"), str):
        svars = [resolve_name(ds, v) for v in s.expand_varlist(o["strata"])]
        sk = [tuple(ds.get(v).data[sd.mask][i] for v in svars) for i in range(len(sd.t))]
        su = sorted(set(sk))
        strat = np.array([su.index(x) for x in sk])
    O = np.zeros(G)
    E = np.zeros(G)
    V = np.zeros((G, G))
    R = np.zeros(G)
    for h in np.unique(strat):
        m = (strat == h) & (grp >= 0)
        t, t0, d, w, g = sd.t[m], sd.t0[m], sd.d[m], sd.w[m], grp[m]
        ft = np.unique(t[d > 0])
        km_all = km(t, t0, d, w) if test in ("peto",) else None
        for x in ft:
            risk = (t0 < x) & (t >= x)
            nt = float(w[risk].sum())
            dt = float(w[(t == x) & (d > 0)].sum())
            ng = np.bincount(g[risk], weights=w[risk], minlength=G)
            dg = np.bincount(g[(t == x) & (d > 0)], weights=w[(t == x) & (d > 0)], minlength=G)
            if test == "logrank":
                wt = 1.0
            elif test == "wilcoxon":
                wt = nt
            elif test == "tware":
                wt = np.sqrt(nt)
            else:
                j = np.searchsorted(km_all.times, x) - 1
                wt = float(km_all.S[j]) if j >= 0 else 1.0
                wt = wt * nt / (nt + 1)   # VERIFY: Peto-Peto-Prentice weight
            eg = dt * ng / nt
            O += wt * dg if test != "logrank" else dg
            E += wt * eg if test != "logrank" else eg
            R += wt * (dg - eg)
            if nt > 1:
                fac = dt * (nt - dt) / (nt - 1) / nt
                V += wt * wt * fac * (np.diag(ng) - np.outer(ng, ng) / nt)
    if test == "logrank":
        O_disp, E_disp = O, E
    else:
        # the table shows the unweighted counts; the statistic uses the weighted sums
        O_disp, E_disp = _unweighted_oe(sd, grp, strat, G)
    diff = R if test != "logrank" else O - E
    k = G - 1
    try:
        chi2 = float(diff[:k] @ np.linalg.solve(V[:k, :k], diff[:k])) if k > 0 else SYS
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        chi2 = float(diff[:k] @ np.linalg.pinv(V[:k, :k]) @ diff[:k])
    p = float(chi2_tail(chi2, k)) if k > 0 else SYS
    out = s.output
    title = {"logrank": "Log-rank test for equality of survivor functions",
             "wilcoxon": "Wilcoxon (Breslow) test for equality of survivor functions",
             "tware": "Tarone-Ware test for equality of survivor functions",
             "peto": "Peto-Peto test for equality of survivor functions"}[test]
    nstrata = len(np.unique(strat))
    if nstrata > 1 or isinstance(o.get("strata"), str):
        title = "Stratified " + title[0].lower() + title[1:]
    out.write(f"\n{title}\n", "text")
    if isinstance(o.get("strata"), str):
        nofail = sum(1 for h in np.unique(strat) if not np.any(sd.d[(strat == h) & (grp >= 0)] > 0))
        if nofail:
            out.write(f"Note: {nofail} strat{'um' if nofail == 1 else 'a'} omitted because of no failures\n",
                      "text")   # VERIFY: singular form
    out.write("\n", "text")
    stratified = isinstance(o.get("strata"), str)
    labs = [", ".join(_level_label(s, v, kv) for v, kv in zip(names, kk)) for kk in levels]
    head = " ".join(names)
    L = max(len(head), len("Total"), *(len(x) for x in labs)) + 1
    extra = test != "logrank"
    out.write(f"{'':<{L}}|   Events         Events" + ("        Sum of" if extra else "") + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{head:<{L}}|  observed    expected(*)" if stratified else f"{head:<{L}}|  observed       expected",
              "text")
    out.write(("        ranks" if extra else "") + "\n", "text")
    width = 25 + (13 if extra else 0)
    out.write("-" * L + "+" + "-" * width + "\n", "text")
    for i, lab in enumerate(labs):
        out.write(f"{lab:<{L}}|", "text")
        out.write(f"{g9(O_disp[i], '%9.0g'):>10}{E_disp[i]:>15.2f}" +
                  (f"{g9(R[i], '%12.0g'):>13}" if extra else "") + "\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * L + "+" + "-" * width + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Total':<{L}}|", "text")
    out.write(f"{g9(O_disp.sum(), '%9.0g'):>10}{E_disp.sum():>15.2f}" +
              (f"{g9(R.sum() if abs(R.sum()) > 1e-9 else 0.0, '%12.0g'):>13}" if extra else "") + "\n", "result")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if stratified:
        svl = " ".join(svars)
        out.write(f"(*) sum over calculations within {svl}\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'chi2(' + str(k) + ') =':>21}", "text")
    out.write(f"{chi2:>11.2f}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'Pr>chi2 =':>21}", "text")
    out.write(f"{p:>11.4f}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"df": float(k), "chi2": chi2}


def _unweighted_oe(sd: STData, grp, strat, G):
    O = np.zeros(G)
    E = np.zeros(G)
    for h in np.unique(strat):
        m = (strat == h) & (grp >= 0)
        t, t0, d, w, g = sd.t[m], sd.t0[m], sd.d[m], sd.w[m], grp[m]
        for x in np.unique(t[d > 0]):
            risk = (t0 < x) & (t >= x)
            nt = float(w[risk].sum())
            dsel = (t == x) & (d > 0)
            ng = np.bincount(g[risk], weights=w[risk], minlength=G)
            O += np.bincount(g[dsel], weights=w[dsel], minlength=G)
            E += float(w[dsel].sum()) * ng / nt
    return O, E


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# sts graph
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _steps(x0: float, times: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, y0: float, tmax: float):
    xs, ys = [x0], [y0]
    cur = y0
    for t, v in zip(times, y):
        if t < x0:
            cur = v
            continue
        xs += [float(t), float(t)]
        ys += [cur, float(v)]
        cur = float(v)
    if xs[-1] < tmax:
        xs.append(float(tmax))
        ys.append(cur)
    return xs, ys


def sts_graph(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from ..commands.graphcmd import finish
    from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
    from ..graphics.opts import axis_label, graph_options, split_layer_graph
    from ..graphics.twoway import layer_spec
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    p = parse_standard(args)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, {**layer_spec(), "by": 2, "failure": 1, "na": 2,
                                                "cumhaz": 4, "ci": 2, "noshow": 6, "level": 1,
                                                "separate": 3, "censored": 4})
    info = require_st(s)
    if not lopts.get("noshow"):
        header(s, info)
    mask = touse(s, p)
    byv = str(lopts["by"]).split() if isinstance(lopts.get("by"), str) else []
    na = bool(lopts.get("na") or lopts.get("cumhaz"))
    fail = bool(lopts.get("failure"))
    level = float(lopts["level"]) if lopts.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    layers = []
    for lab, sd in _by_groups(s, mask, byv):
        k = km(sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d, sd.w)
        if na:
            y, y0 = k.H, 0.0
        elif fail:
            y, y0 = 1 - k.S, 0.0
        else:
            y, y0 = k.S, 1.0
        x0 = float(min(0.0, sd.t0.min())) if len(sd.t0) else 0.0
        tmax = float(sd.t.max()) if len(sd.t) else 0.0
        xs, ys = _steps(x0, k.times, y, y0, tmax)
        if lopts.get("ci") and not na:
            _se, lo, hi = km_ci(k.S, k.gw, level)
            # before the first failure the band is undefined; it starts at the first value
            lo = np.where(lo < SYS, lo, np.nan)
            hi = np.where(hi < SYS, hi, np.nan)
            if fail:
                lo, hi = 1 - hi, 1 - lo
            bx, blo = _steps(x0, k.times, lo, np.nan, tmax)
            _, bhi = _steps(x0, k.times, hi, np.nan, tmax)
            layers.append(Layer("rarea", bx, blo, {"y2": bhi}, {"_pal": len(layers) // 2},
                                f"{level:g}% CI"))
        layers.append(Layer("line", xs, ys, {}, {"_pal": len(layers) // 2} if lopts.get("ci") else {},
                            lab or ("Nelson-Aalen" if na else "Kaplan-Meier")))
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    if na:
        title = "Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard estimate" + ("s" if byv else "")
    else:
        title = f"Kaplan-Meier {'failure' if fail else 'survival'} estimate" + ("s" if byv else "")
    opts.setdefault("title", {"lines": [title]})
    opts["_xtitle"] = "analysis time"
    opts["_ytitle"] = ""
    if not na and "ylabel" not in graw:
        try:
            opts["ylabel"] = axis_label("0(.25)1, format(%4.2f)")
        except Exception:   # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    if not byv:
        opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    g = Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)])
    finish(s, g, graw)

"""Log likelihoods of the binary, count, censored and selection models, per observation.

Every function takes arrays (the outcome and the linear indexes of the equations, plus the
ancillary parameters on the scale where they are estimated) and returns the log likelihood of
each observation and its derivatives with respect to those indexes and parameters, in the order
of the arguments. No Session, no variables, no printing: the commands build the indexes and the
engine in `mleq.py` assembles scores and Hessians.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from ..core.bvnorm import bvn_grad
from ..lazy import lazy

special = lazy("scipy.special")
st = lazy("scipy.stats")


def _lam(x):
    """phi(x) / Phi(x), stable in the lower tail."""
    return np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(x) - st.norm.logcdf(x))


def _lam_up(x):
    """phi(x) / (1 - Phi(x))."""
    return np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(x) - st.norm.logsf(x))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# binary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cloglog(y, eta):
    """P(y = 1) = 1 - exp(-exp(eta))."""
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        u = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
        pos = y > 0
        ll = np.where(pos, np.log(-np.expm1(-u)), -u)
        d = np.where(pos, u / np.expm1(u), -u)
    d = np.where(np.isfinite(d), d, 0.0)
    return ll, d


def scobit(y, eta, lnalpha):
    """P(y = 1) = 1 - (1 + exp(eta))^-alpha, alpha = exp(lnalpha) (skewed logistic)."""
    alpha = np.exp(lnalpha)
    sp = np.logaddexp(0, eta)
    u = alpha * sp
    sig = special.expit(eta)
    pos = y > 0
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        em = np.expm1(u)
        ll = np.where(pos, np.log(-np.expm1(-u)), -u)
        d_eta = np.where(pos, alpha * sig / em, -alpha * sig)
        d_la = np.where(pos, u / em, -u)
    d_eta = np.where(np.isfinite(d_eta), d_eta, 0.0)
    d_la = np.where(np.isfinite(d_la), d_la, 0.0)
    return ll, d_eta, d_la


def hetprobit(y, eta, zeta):
    """P(y = 1) = Phi(eta / exp(zeta))."""
    t = eta * np.exp(-zeta)
    q = np.where(y > 0, 1.0, -1.0)
    ll = st.norm.logcdf(q * t)
    d = q * _lam(q * t)
    return ll, d * np.exp(-zeta), -d * t


def fractional(y, eta, link):
    """Bernoulli quasi-log-likelihood for y in [0, 1]: y ln F + (1 - y) ln (1 - F)."""
    if link == "logit":
        ll = -y * np.logaddexp(0, -eta) - (1 - y) * np.logaddexp(0, eta)
        return ll, y - special.expit(eta)
    if link == "probit":
        lp, lq = st.norm.logcdf(eta), st.norm.logcdf(-eta)
        ll = y * lp + (1 - y) * lq
        return ll, y * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(eta) - lp) - (1 - y) * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(eta) - lq)
    # cloglog: ln(1 - F) = -u
    with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        u = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
        ll = np.where(y > 0, y * np.log(-np.expm1(-u)), 0.0) - (1 - y) * u
        d = np.where(y > 0, y * u / np.expm1(u), 0.0) - (1 - y) * u
    return ll, np.where(np.isfinite(d), d, 0.0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# count
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _gamma_ratio(y, r):
    """(ln Gamma(y + r) - ln Gamma(r), digamma(y + r) - digamma(r)) for counts y. With a large r
    (the dispersion going to zero) the differences cancel, so they are summed term by term:
    sum over j < y of ln(r + j) and 1 / (r + j)."""
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float) * np.ones_like(r)
    lgd = special.gammaln(y + r) - special.gammaln(r)
    dgd = special.digamma(y + r) - special.digamma(r)
    big = (r > 1e4) & (y == np.floor(y))
    if np.any(big):
        yb, rb = y[big], r[big]
        a, b = np.zeros_like(rb), np.zeros_like(rb)
        for j in range(int(yb.max())):
            inc = j < yb
            a += np.where(inc, np.log(rb + j), 0.0)
            b += np.where(inc, 1.0 / (rb + j), 0.0)
        lgd[big], dgd[big] = a, b
    return lgd, dgd


def _nb_terms(y, mu, m):
    """ln NB2(y; mu, alpha = 1/m) and the derivatives of it with respect to eta = ln mu and
    to ln alpha."""
    lgd, dgd = _gamma_ratio(y, m * np.ones_like(mu))
    ll = lgd - special.gammaln(y + 1) - m * np.log1p(mu / m) + y * np.log(mu / (m + mu))
    d_eta = (y - mu) / (1 + mu / m)
    dm = dgd - np.log1p(mu / m) + 1 - (m + y) / (m + mu)
    return ll, d_eta, -m * dm


def _infl_prob(zeta, link):
    """(pi, ln pi, ln(1 - pi), dpi/dzeta) of the inflation equation."""
    if link == "probit":
        return (st.norm.cdf(zeta), st.norm.logcdf(zeta), st.norm.logcdf(-zeta), st.norm.pdf(zeta))
    pi = special.expit(zeta)
    return pi, -np.logaddexp(0, -zeta), -np.logaddexp(0, zeta), pi * (1 - pi)


def zip_(y, eta, zeta, link="logit"):
    """Zero-inflated Poisson: mean exp(eta), inflation probability F(zeta)."""
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
    pi, lpi, lq, dpi = _infl_prob(zeta, link)
    zero = y == 0
    lp0 = np.logaddexp(lpi, lq - mu)
    ll = np.where(zero, lp0, lq - mu + y * np.log(mu) - special.gammaln(y + 1))
    p0 = np.exp(lp0)
    d_eta = np.where(zero, (1 - pi) * np.exp(-mu) * (-mu) / p0, y - mu)
    d_zeta = np.where(zero, dpi * (1 - np.exp(-mu)) / p0, -dpi / (1 - pi))
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta


def zinb(y, eta, zeta, lnalpha, link="logit"):
    """Zero-inflated negative binomial (NB2)."""
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
    m = np.exp(-lnalpha)
    pi, lpi, lq, dpi = _infl_prob(zeta, link)
    zero = y == 0
    lnb, dnb_eta, dnb_la = _nb_terms(y, mu, m)
    lnb0, dnb0_eta, dnb0_la = _nb_terms(np.zeros_like(y), mu, m)
    lp0 = np.logaddexp(lpi, lq + lnb0)
    ll = np.where(zero, lp0, lq + lnb)
    p0 = np.exp(lp0)
    w0 = (1 - pi) * np.exp(lnb0) / p0
    d_eta = np.where(zero, w0 * dnb0_eta, dnb_eta)
    d_la = np.where(zero, w0 * dnb0_la, dnb_la)
    d_zeta = np.where(zero, dpi * (1 - np.exp(lnb0)) / p0, -dpi / (1 - pi))
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_la


def tpoisson(y, eta, lower):
    """Poisson truncated below: only y > lower is observed."""
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
    lsf = st.poisson.logsf(lower, mu)
    ll = -mu + y * np.log(mu) - special.gammaln(y + 1) - lsf
    d_eta = (y - mu) - mu * np.exp(st.poisson.logpmf(lower, mu) - lsf)
    return ll, d_eta


def tnbreg(y, eta, lnalpha, lower):
    """Negative binomial (NB2) truncated below: only y > lower is observed. `lnalpha` may be a
    scalar or an array."""
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
    m = np.exp(-lnalpha) * np.ones_like(mu)
    lnb, d_eta, d_la = _nb_terms(y, mu, m)
    cdf = np.zeros_like(mu)
    dc_eta = np.zeros_like(mu)
    dc_la = np.zeros_like(mu)
    for j in range(int(np.floor(lower)) + 1):
        lj, de, dl = _nb_terms(np.full_like(mu, j), mu, m)
        pj = np.exp(lj)
        cdf += pj
        dc_eta += pj * de
        dc_la += pj * dl
    sf = np.maximum(1 - cdf, 1e-300)
    return lnb - np.log(sf), d_eta + dc_eta / sf, d_la + dc_la / sf


def _nb1_terms(y, mu, lndelta):
    """ln NB1(y; mu, delta) (variance mu (1 + delta)) and its derivatives with respect to
    eta = ln mu and ln delta: size r = mu/delta and probability 1/(1 + delta)."""
    dl = np.exp(lndelta) * np.ones_like(mu)
    r = mu / dl
    l1d = np.log1p(dl)
    lgd, psi = _gamma_ratio(y, r)
    ll = lgd - special.gammaln(y + 1) - r * l1d + y * (np.log(dl) - l1d)
    d_eta = r * (psi - l1d)
    d_ld = -r * psi + r * l1d - r * dl / (1 + dl) + y / (1 + dl)
    return ll, d_eta, d_ld


def trunc_count(y, eta, lnpar, lower, upper, kind):
    """Count distribution truncated to lower < y < upper (arrays; upper may be inf): ln f(y) -
    ln P(lower < Y < upper) and its derivatives with respect to eta and the dispersion
    parameter. kind: "poisson", "nb2" (lnpar = ln alpha) or "nb1" (lnpar = ln delta)."""
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))

    def terms(j):
        jj = np.full_like(mu, j) if np.ndim(j) == 0 else j
        if kind == "poisson":
            return -mu + jj * np.log(mu) - special.gammaln(jj + 1), jj - mu, np.zeros_like(mu)
        if kind == "nb2":
            return _nb_terms(jj, mu, np.exp(-lnpar) * np.ones_like(mu))
        return _nb1_terms(jj, mu, lnpar)
    ll, d_eta, d_par = terms(y)
    fin = np.isfinite(upper)
    top = int(max(np.max(lower), np.max(np.where(fin, upper - 1, 0)))) if len(y) else 0
    Fl, Fl_e, Fl_p = (np.zeros_like(mu) for _ in range(3))
    Fm, Fm_e, Fm_p = (np.zeros_like(mu) for _ in range(3))
    for j in range(top + 1):
        lj, ej, pj_ = terms(j)
        pj = np.exp(lj)
        lo = j <= lower
        # with an upper limit the probability of the window is summed term by term: the
        # difference of two cumulative probabilities cancels when they are both near 1 or 0
        mid = fin & (j > lower) & (j <= upper - 1)
        Fl += np.where(lo, pj, 0)
        Fl_e += np.where(lo, pj * ej, 0)
        Fl_p += np.where(lo, pj * pj_, 0)
        Fm += np.where(mid, pj, 0)
        Fm_e += np.where(mid, pj * ej, 0)
        Fm_p += np.where(mid, pj * pj_, 0)
    P = np.where(fin, Fm, 1.0 - Fl)
    P_e = np.where(fin, Fm_e, -Fl_e)
    P_p = np.where(fin, Fm_p, -Fl_p)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        lnP = np.where(P > 0, np.log(np.where(P > 0, P, 1.0)), -np.inf)
        return ll - lnP, d_eta - P_e / P, d_par - P_p / P


def gnbreg(y, eta, zeta):
    """Negative binomial with ln alpha = zeta, an index of its own."""
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
    m = np.exp(-zeta)
    return _nb_terms(y, mu, m)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# censored, truncated, interval
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def intreg(lo, hi, eta, lnsigma):
    """Interval regression: lo or hi missing (nan) means left or right censoring; lo == hi an
    exact observation."""
    n = len(eta)
    lns = lnsigma * np.ones(n)
    sg = np.exp(lns)
    ll = np.zeros(n)
    d_eta = np.zeros(n)
    d_ls = np.zeros(n)
    exact = (lo == hi)
    left = np.isnan(lo) & ~np.isnan(hi)
    right = np.isnan(hi) & ~np.isnan(lo)
    inter = ~exact & ~np.isnan(lo) & ~np.isnan(hi)
    e = (lo[exact] - eta[exact]) / sg[exact]
    ll[exact] = st.norm.logpdf(e) - lns[exact]
    d_eta[exact] = e / sg[exact]
    d_ls[exact] = e * e - 1
    z = (hi[left] - eta[left]) / sg[left]
    lam = _lam(z)
    ll[left] = st.norm.logcdf(z)
    d_eta[left] = -lam / sg[left]
    d_ls[left] = -lam * z
    z = (lo[right] - eta[right]) / sg[right]
    lam = _lam(-z)
    ll[right] = st.norm.logcdf(-z)
    d_eta[right] = lam / sg[right]
    d_ls[right] = lam * z
    zl = (lo[inter] - eta[inter]) / sg[inter]
    zu = (hi[inter] - eta[inter]) / sg[inter]
    # Phi(zu) - Phi(zl) in the tail where it is smaller
    flip = (zl + zu) > 0
    a = np.where(flip, -zu, zl)
    b = np.where(flip, -zl, zu)
    p = np.maximum(st.norm.cdf(b) - st.norm.cdf(a), 1e-300)
    ll[inter] = np.log(p)
    fa, fb = st.norm.pdf(zl), st.norm.pdf(zu)
    d_eta[inter] = (fa - fb) / sg[inter] / p
    d_ls[inter] = (zl * fa - zu * fb) / p
    return ll, d_eta, d_ls


def truncreg(y, eta, lnsigma, lower, upper):
    """Normal regression truncated to (lower, upper); infinite limits are +-inf."""
    lns = lnsigma * np.ones(len(eta))
    sg = np.exp(lns)
    e = (y - eta) / sg
    zl = (lower - eta) / sg
    zu = (upper - eta) / sg
    flip = (zl + zu) > 0
    a = np.where(flip, -zu, zl)
    b = np.where(flip, -zl, zu)
    p = np.maximum(st.norm.cdf(b) - st.norm.cdf(a), 1e-300)
    fl = np.where(np.isfinite(zl), st.norm.pdf(np.where(np.isfinite(zl), zl, 0)), 0.0)
    fu = np.where(np.isfinite(zu), st.norm.pdf(np.where(np.isfinite(zu), zu, 0)), 0.0)
    zlf = np.where(np.isfinite(zl), zl, 0.0)
    zuf = np.where(np.isfinite(zu), zu, 0.0)
    ll = st.norm.logpdf(e) - lns - np.log(p)
    d_eta = e / sg - (fl - fu) / sg / p
    d_ls = e * e - 1 - (zlf * fl - zuf * fu) / p
    return ll, d_eta, d_ls


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# selection and bivariate probit
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def heckman(sel, y, eta, zeta, athrho, lnsigma):
    """Normal regression observed when sel = 1; selection probit with index zeta."""
    rho = np.tanh(athrho) * np.ones(len(eta))
    lns = lnsigma * np.ones(len(eta))
    sg = np.exp(lns)
    r = np.sqrt(1 - rho * rho)
    obs = sel > 0
    e = np.where(obs, (np.where(obs, y, 0.0) - eta) / sg, 0.0)
    a = (zeta + rho * e) / r
    lam = _lam(a)
    ll = np.where(obs, st.norm.logpdf(e) - lns + st.norm.logcdf(a), st.norm.logcdf(-zeta))
    lam0 = _lam(-zeta)
    d_eta = np.where(obs, e / sg - lam * rho / (sg * r), 0.0)
    d_zeta = np.where(obs, lam / r, -lam0)
    d_ls = np.where(obs, e * e - 1 - lam * rho * e / r, 0.0)
    d_ath = np.where(obs, lam * (e + rho * zeta) / r, 0.0)
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_ls


def etreg(t, y, eta, zeta, athrho, lnsigma):
    """Normal outcome with an endogenous binary treatment: y = eta + e, t = 1(zeta + u > 0),
    e ~ N(0, sigma^2), corr(e, u) = rho. Returns ll and the derivatives with respect to eta,
    zeta, athrho and lnsigma."""
    n = len(y)
    rho = np.tanh(athrho) * np.ones(n)
    lns = lnsigma * np.ones(n)
    sg = np.exp(lns)
    c = np.sqrt(1 - rho * rho)
    q = np.where(t > 0, 1.0, -1.0)
    u = (y - eta) / sg
    a = q * (zeta + rho * u) / c
    lam = _lam(a)
    ll = st.norm.logpdf(u) - lns + st.norm.logcdf(a)
    d_eta = (u - lam * q * rho / c) / sg
    d_zeta = lam * q / c
    d_ls = u * u - 1 - u * lam * q * rho / c
    da_drho = q * (u / c + (zeta + rho * u) * rho / c ** 3)
    d_ath = lam * da_drho * c * c
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_ls


def etpois(t, y, eta, zeta, athrho, lnsigma, nodes=32):
    """Poisson outcome with an endogenous binary treatment: y ~ Poisson(exp(eta + e)), e ~ N(0, sigma^2),
    t = 1(zeta + u > 0), corr(e, u) = rho. The integral over e is a Gauss-Hermite quadrature.
    Returns ll and the derivatives with respect to eta, zeta, athrho and lnsigma."""
    from scipy.special import gammaln, logsumexp
    x, wq = np.polynomial.hermite.hermgauss(nodes)
    sk = np.sqrt(2.0) * x
    lw = np.log(wq / np.sqrt(np.pi))
    rho = np.tanh(athrho)
    c = np.sqrt(1 - rho * rho)
    sg = np.exp(lnsigma)
    q = np.where(t > 0, 1.0, -1.0)[:, None]
    mu = np.exp(np.clip(eta[:, None] + sg * sk[None, :], -50, 50))
    a = q * (zeta[:, None] + rho * sk[None, :]) / c
    lf = y[:, None] * np.log(mu) - mu - gammaln(y + 1)[:, None] + st.norm.logcdf(a) + lw[None, :]
    ll = logsumexp(lf, axis=1)
    pi = np.exp(lf - ll[:, None])
    lam = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(a) - st.norm.logcdf(a))
    r = y[:, None] - mu
    d_eta = (pi * r).sum(axis=1)
    d_zeta = (pi * lam * q / c).sum(axis=1)
    d_ls = (pi * r * sg * sk[None, :]).sum(axis=1)
    da = q * (sk[None, :] / c + (zeta[:, None] + rho * sk[None, :]) * rho / c ** 3)
    d_ath = (pi * lam * da).sum(axis=1) * c * c
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_ls


def biprobit(y1, y2, eta1, eta2, athrho):
    """Bivariate probit: P(y1, y2) = Phi2(q1 eta1, q2 eta2; q1 q2 rho)."""
    rho = np.tanh(athrho)
    q1 = np.where(y1 > 0, 1.0, -1.0)
    q2 = np.where(y2 > 0, 1.0, -1.0)
    F, Fa, Fb, Fr = bvn_grad(q1 * eta1, q2 * eta2, q1 * q2 * rho)
    F = np.maximum(F, 1e-300)
    return (np.log(F), q1 * Fa / F, q2 * Fb / F, q1 * q2 * Fr * (1 - rho * rho) / F)


def biprobit_partial(z, eta1, eta2, athrho):
    """Partial-observability bivariate probit: only z = y1 y2 is seen, P(z = 1) = Phi2(eta1,
    eta2; rho). Returns the log likelihood, [d/d eta1, d/d eta2] and d/d athrho (n x 1)."""
    rho = np.tanh(athrho)
    F, Fa, Fb, Fr = bvn_grad(eta1, eta2, rho * np.ones_like(eta1))
    F = np.clip(F, 1e-300, 1 - 1e-16)
    one = z > 0
    k = np.where(one, 1 / F, -1 / (1 - F))
    ll = np.where(one, np.log(F), np.log1p(-F))
    return ll, [k * Fa, k * Fb], (k * Fr * (1 - rho * rho)).reshape(-1, 1)


def heckprobit(sel, y, eta, zeta, athrho):
    """Probit for y observed when sel = 1 (selection probit with index zeta)."""
    rho = np.tanh(athrho)
    obs = sel > 0
    q = np.where(y > 0, 1.0, -1.0)
    # selected: P = Phi2(zeta, q eta; q rho)
    F, Fa, Fb, Fr = bvn_grad(zeta, q * eta, q * rho)
    F = np.maximum(F, 1e-300)
    ll = np.where(obs, np.log(F), st.norm.logcdf(-zeta))
    d_eta = np.where(obs, q * Fb / F, 0.0)
    d_zeta = np.where(obs, Fa / F, -_lam(-zeta))
    d_ath = np.where(obs, q * Fr * (1 - rho * rho) / F, 0.0)
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath


def heckoprobit(sel, yi, ncat, eta, zeta, cuts, athrho):
    """Ordered probit for y (categories 0..ncat-1) observed when sel = 1. Returns the log
    likelihood and the derivatives with respect to eta, zeta, athrho and the cutpoints (n x
    (ncat - 1))."""
    rho = np.tanh(athrho)
    obs = sel > 0
    n = len(eta)
    k = ncat - 1
    big = 1e10
    cu = np.concatenate([[-big], cuts, [big]])
    hi = cu[np.where(obs, yi, 0) + 1]
    lo = cu[np.where(obs, yi, 0)]
    # P(s = 1, y = j) = Phi2(zeta, hi - eta; -rho) - Phi2(zeta, lo - eta; -rho)
    Fh, Fha, Fhb, Fhr = bvn_grad(zeta, hi - eta, -rho)
    Fl, Fla, Flb, Flr = bvn_grad(zeta, lo - eta, -rho)
    P = np.maximum(Fh - Fl, 1e-300)
    ll = np.where(obs, np.log(P), st.norm.logcdf(-zeta))
    d_zeta = np.where(obs, (Fha - Fla) / P, -_lam(-zeta))
    d_eta = np.where(obs, -(Fhb - Flb) / P, 0.0)
    d_ath = np.where(obs, -(Fhr - Flr) * (1 - rho * rho) / P, 0.0)
    d_cut = np.zeros((n, k))
    for j in range(k):
        up = obs & (yi == j)
        dn = obs & (yi == j + 1)
        d_cut[:, j] = np.where(up, Fhb / P, 0.0) - np.where(dn, Flb / P, 0.0)
    return ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_cut


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# endogenous regressor: ivprobit, ivtobit (y2 = eta2 + v, v ~ N(0, sigma_v^2), corr(u, v) = rho)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def ivprobit(y, y2, eta1, eta2, athrho, lnsigma):
    """ll_obs and derivatives wrt eta1, eta2, athrho and lnsigma (sigma = sd of y2's error);
    the probit error has variance one."""
    n = len(y)
    r = np.tanh(athrho) * np.ones(n)
    c = np.sqrt(1 - r * r)
    sv = np.exp(lnsigma) * np.ones(n)
    v = y2 - eta2
    u = v / sv
    q = 2 * y - 1
    t = (eta1 + r * u) / c
    z = q * t
    lcdf = np.where(z > -30, special.log_ndtr(z), -0.5 * z * z - np.log(-z) - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi))
    ll = -0.5 * u * u - lnsigma - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) + lcdf
    lam = q * np.exp(-0.5 * z * z - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - lcdf)
    d1 = lam / c
    d2 = u / sv - lam * r / (sv * c)
    da = lam * (c * u + t * r)
    dls = u * u - 1 - lam * r * u / c
    return ll, d1, d2, da, dls


def ivtobit(y, y2, eta1, eta2, alpha, lns, lnv, lower, upper):
    """Tobit with an endogenous regressor, in Stata's parameters: y* = eta1 + alpha*v + e with
    v = y2 - eta2 ~ N(0, exp(lnv)^2) and e ~ N(0, exp(lns)^2). Derivatives wrt eta1, eta2, alpha,
    lns and lnv; lower/upper are the censoring limits (+-inf when absent)."""
    n = len(y)
    s_ = np.exp(lns) * np.ones(n)
    sv = np.exp(lnv) * np.ones(n)
    v = y2 - eta2
    u = v / sv
    m = eta1 + alpha * v
    left = y <= lower
    right = y >= upper
    unc = ~(left | right)
    zz = np.where(left, (lower - m) / s_, np.where(right, (m - upper) / s_, (y - m) / s_))
    lcdf = np.where(zz > -30, special.log_ndtr(zz), -0.5 * zz * zz - np.log(np.abs(zz) + 1e-300) - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi))
    h = np.exp(-0.5 * zz * zz - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - lcdf)
    llc = np.where(unc, -0.5 * zz * zz - np.log(s_) - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi), lcdf)
    Dm = np.where(unc, zz / s_, np.where(left, -h / s_, h / s_))
    DS = np.where(unc, (zz * zz - 1) / s_, -h * zz / s_)
    ll = llc - 0.5 * u * u - lnv - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi)
    d1 = Dm
    d2 = -alpha * Dm + u / sv
    da = Dm * v
    dls = DS * s_
    dlv = u * u - 1
    return ll, d1, d2, da, dls, dlv

"""Mixed-effects generalized linear models: meglm and its special cases melogit, meprobit,
mecloglog, mepoisson, menbreg, meologit and meoprobit ([ME] meglm and the others).

Two-level models with random intercepts and slopes. This module parses the syntax, reads the
data, runs the maximization and stores e(); the likelihood is in glmm.py and the output and
predict in meglm_out.py. The likelihood of each group is integrated by mean-variance adaptive
Gauss-Hermite quadrature (intmethod(mvaghermite), intpoints(7) by default; with q random
effects, the product rule with 7^q points); intmethod(ghermite) gives the non-adaptive rule and
intmethod(laplace) a single point. The adaptive parameters (posterior means and Cholesky
factors) are updated at each iteration and held fixed within it; the gradient is analytic and
the Hessian is the numerical derivative of the gradient.

Stata's starting values ("Refining starting values" with a grid search)
are not documented, so the iteration logs may differ; the final
estimates should agree to the precision of the quadrature (VERIFY:
compat/do/1002_melogit.do).

def _word(text: str, choices, what: str) -> str:
    t = text.strip().lower()
    hit = [c for c in choices if c.startswith(t)] if t else []
    if len(hit) != 1 and t in choices:
        hit = [t]
    if len(hit) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, f"{what}({text.strip()}) invalid")   # VERIFY
    return hit[0]


def _resolve(cmdname: str, o: dict) -> dict:
    """Family, link and titles of the command, from its name and the family()/link() options of
    meglm."""
    fam, link, title, model, vs = _CMDS[cmdname]
    disp = ""
    nb = ""
    if cmdname == "meglm":
        words = str(o.get("family") or "gaussian").split()
        fam = _word(words[0], _FAMILIES, "family")
        rest = words[1:]
        if fam == "nbinomial":
            disp = _word(rest[0], ("mean", "constant"), "family") if rest else "mean"
        elif fam == "binomial":
            nb = rest[0] if rest else "1"
        elif rest:
            raise StataError(198, f"family({' '.join(words)}) invalid")   # VERIFY
        link = _word(str(o["link"]), ("identity", "log", "logit", "probit", "cloglog"), "link") \
            if o.get("link") else _DEFAULT_LINK[fam]
        if link not in _LINKS_OK[fam]:
            raise StataError(198, f"link({link}) with family({fam}) is not available yet in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
        vs = _VS_GLM[(fam, link)]
        model = vs[:-6] if vs.endswith(" model") else ""
    elif cmdname == "menbreg":
        disp = _word(str(o["dispersion"]), ("mean", "constant"), "dispersion") if o.get("dispersion") else "mean"
    elif o.get("dispersion"):
        raise StataError(198, "option dispersion() not allowed")
    if o.get("binomial") is not None and o.get("binomial") is not False:
        if cmdname not in ("melogit", "meprobit", "mecloglog"):
            raise StataError(198, "option binomial() not allowed")
        fam, nb = "binomial", str(o["binomial"]).strip()
    if fam == "binomial" and not nb:
        nb = "1"
    return {"cmd": cmdname, "fam": fam, "link": link, "title": title, "model": model, "vs": vs,
            "disp": disp, "nbin": nb}


def _fixed_start(sp, y, off, p, constant, n_nb):
    """Starting values (beta, auxiliary) of the fixed-effects model."""
    fam, link = sp["fam"], sp["link"]
    b0 = np.zeros(p)
    ybar = float(y.mean())
    if fam == "gaussian":
        c = ybar - float(off.mean())
        a0 = [math.log(max(float(y.var()), 1e-8))]
    elif fam == "gamma":
        c = math.log(max(ybar, 1e-10)) - float(off.mean())
        a0 = [0.5 * math.log(max(float(y.var()) / max(ybar * ybar, 1e-10), 1e-2))]
    elif fam == "nbinomial":
        c = math.log(max(ybar, 1e-10)) - float(off.mean())
        over = max(float(y.var()) / max(ybar, 1e-10) - 1.0, 0.05)
        a0 = [math.log(over / max(ybar, 1e-10)) if sp["disp"] == "mean" else math.log(over)]
    elif fam == "poisson":
        c = math.log(max(ybar, 1e-10)) - float(off.mean())
        a0 = []
    else:           # bernoulli, binomial
        pr = min(max(float((y / n_nb).mean()), 1e-4), 1 - 1e-4)
        c = {"logit": math.log(pr / (1 - pr)), "probit": float(st.norm.ppf(pr)),
             "cloglog": math.log(-math.log(1 - pr))}[link]
        a0 = []
    if constant:
        b0[-1] = c
    return b0, np.array(a0, dtype=float)


def _num_gh(gfun, b):
    """Hessian by central differences of the gradient."""
    k = b.size
    H = np.zeros((k, k))
    for i in range(k):
        hi = 1e-5 * (abs(b[i]) + 1)
        e = np.zeros(k)
        e[i] = hi
        H[:, i] = (gfun(b + e) - gfun(b - e)) / (2 * hi)
    return (H + H.T) / 2


@dataclass
class Fit:
    """What a command hands to fit_me once it has read its data: design, offset, level, the
    conditional distribution of the outcome with its auxiliary parameters, and the details that
    differ from one command to the next."""

    npts: int

    aux_eq: list
    off_name: str = ""
    ordered: bool = False
    analytic: bool = False            # analytic Hessian of the fixed-effects model
    aux_in_table: bool = False

    resid: object = None              # latent residual variance of the outcome (float or f(aux))

    eform: str = ""
    predict: object = None
    predict_multi: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    macro_edit: object = None
    cmdline: str = ""                 # e(cmdline) when Stata rebuilds it (meglm, mestreg)
    late_error: str = ""              # an error that Stata only raises after the fit
    predict_opts: dict | None = None
    cats: list = field(default_factory=list)      # outcome values of the ordinal models
    lvs: list = field(default_factory=list)       # all the levels, the highest first (default [lv])
    wobs: object = None               # observation weights ([fweight], [pweight], [iweight])
    wgrp: object = None               # group weights of each level (fweight(), pweight()) or None
    level_opts: list = field(default_factory=list)   # the options of each random-effects equation


def cmd_me(s: "Session", args: str, cmdname: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    from .regress import Sample
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmdname, args)
        return
    fixed, levels_spec, glob = split_levels(args)
    import re
    m_ = re.search(r"\b(exposure|offset)\s*\(\s*\w+\s*\)", glob)
    if m_ and not cmdname.startswith("meqr"):      # compat 1902: these belong to the fixed-effects equation (before the ||)
        raise StataError(198, f"option {re.sub(chr(32), '', m_.group(0))} allowed only in the fixed-effects equation")
    if not levels_spec:
        raise StataError(198, "random-effects equation required")   # VERIFY
    qr_ = cmdname.startswith("meqr")
    c = find_top(fixed, ",")
    fixed_body, fe_opts = (fixed, "") if c == -1 else (fixed[:c], fixed[c + 1:])
    opts_text = " ".join(x for x in (fe_opts.strip(), glob.strip()) if x)
    extra = " ".join([lv for lv, _r, _o in levels_spec] + [r for _l, r, _o in levels_spec if r])
    for _l, _r, _o in levels_spec:
        for _wk in ("fweight", "pweight"):
            if isinstance(_o.get(_wk), str):
                extra += " " + _o[_wk].strip()
    try:
        smp = Sample(s, fixed_body + (f", {opts_text}" if opts_text else ""), opts_spec=_GLOBAL,
                     weights=() if qr_ else ("fweight", "iweight", "pweight"), extra_vars=extra)
    except StataError as e_:
        if e_.message == "aweights not allowed":
            raise StataError(e_.rc, "aweight not allowed") from None     # compat 1916
        raise
    o = smp.o
    sp = _resolve(cmdname, o)
    fam, link = sp["fam"], sp["link"]
    qr = cmdname.startswith("meqr")          # the older commands: same model, layout of mixed
    for _opt in ("stddeviations", "variance"):
        if o.get(_opt) and not qr:      # compat 1902: only the meqr commands accept them
            raise StataError(198, f"option {_opt} not allowed")
    if fam == "ordinal":
        smp.constant = False
    out = s.output
    ds = s.data
    y = smp.y.astype(np.float64)
    n = smp.n
    nbin = np.ones(n)
    if fam == "bernoulli":
        y = (y != 0).astype(float)
    elif fam == "binomial":
        t = sp["nbin"]
        try:
            nbin = np.full(n, float(t))
        except ValueError:
            nbin = ds.get(t).data[smp.mask].astype(float)
        if np.any(y < 0) or np.any(y > nbin):
            raise StataError(459, f"{smp.depname} must be between 0 and the number of trials")   # VERIFY
    elif fam == "gamma":
        if np.any(y <= 0):
            raise StataError(459, f"{smp.depname} must be greater than zero")   # VERIFY
    elif fam in ("poisson", "nbinomial"):
        if np.any(y < 0):
            raise StataError(459, f"{smp.depname} must be greater than or equal to zero")   # VERIFY
    yi = None
    if fam == "ordinal":
        cats = sorted(set(y.tolist()))
        if len(cats) < 2:
            raise StataError(2000, "outcome does not vary")   # VERIFY
        if len(cats) > 50:
            raise StataError(149, f"{smp.depname}:  too many outcomes")   # VERIFY
        yi = np.searchsorted(cats, y)
    fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant)
    est_cols = [col for col in smp.cols if col.values is not None]
    X = np.column_stack([col.values for col in est_cols] + ([np.ones(n)] if smp.constant else [])) \
        if (est_cols or smp.constant) else np.zeros((n, 0))
    off = np.zeros(n)
    off_name = ""
    if o.get("offset") or o.get("exposure"):
        if o.get("exposure") and cmdname in ("melogit", "meprobit", "mecloglog", "meologit", "meoprobit"):
            raise StataError(198, "option exposure() not allowed")
        nm = str(o.get("offset") or o.get("exposure")).strip()
        v = ds.get(nm).data[smp.mask].astype(float)
        off = np.log(v) if o.get("exposure") else v
        off_name = f"ln({nm})" if o.get("exposure") else nm
    lvspec = levels_spec[-1]
    if lvspec[2].get("covariance") is None and o.get("covariance"):
        lvspec[2]["covariance"] = o["covariance"]
    if any(lv_ == "_all" for lv_, _r, _o in levels_spec):
        raise StataError(198, "crossed random effects (_all:) are not available for this command")   # OpenDTA
    levels = build_levels(s, smp.mask, levels_spec, n)
    for lv_, (_l, _r, ro_) in zip(levels, levels_spec):
        if lv_.cov == "identity" and lv_.q > 1 and not ro_.get("covariance"):
            lv_.cov = "independent"
    lv = levels[0]
    wobs, wgrp = level_weights(s, smp, levels, levels_spec)
    npts = int(o["intpoints"]) if o.get("intpoints") else 7
    method = str(o.get("intmethod") or "mvaghermite").strip().lower()
    method = {"mv": "mvaghermite", "mvaghermite": "mvaghermite", "mc": "mcaghermite",
              "mcaghermite": "mcaghermite", "gh": "ghermite", "ghermite": "ghermite",
              "laplace": "laplace"}.get(method, method)
    if qr and o.get("laplace"):
        method = "laplace"
    # the conditional distribution of the outcome
    if fam == "bernoulli" and link in ("logit", "probit"):
        fam_f, naux = basic_family(link, y), 0
    elif fam == "poisson":
        fam_f, naux = basic_family("poisson", y), 0
    elif fam == "ordinal":
        fam_f, naux = ordinal_family(link, yi)
    else:
        fam_f, naux = family_of("binomial" if fam == "bernoulli" else fam, link, y, nbin=nbin,
                                disp=sp["disp"])
    p = X.shape[1]
    analytic = naux == 0 and fam != "binomial" and not (fam == "bernoulli" and link == "cloglog")
    if analytic:
        b0 = _fixed_start(sp, y, off, p, smp.constant, nbin)[0]
    elif fam == "ordinal":
        cum = np.array([np.mean(yi <= j) for j in range(len(cats) - 1)])
        b0 = np.concatenate([np.zeros(p), (special.logit if link == "logit" else st.norm.ppf)(cum)])
    else:
        b0b, a0 = _fixed_start(sp, y, off, p, smp.constant, nbin)
        if fam == "gaussian" and link == "log":
            b0b = np.zeros(p)
            if smp.constant:
                b0b[p - 1] = math.log(max(float(y.mean()), 0.1))
            a0 = np.array([math.log(max(float(np.var(y)), 1e-8))])
        elif fam == "gaussian" and p:
            b0b = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y - off, rcond=None)[0]
            a0 = np.array([math.log(max(float(np.mean((y - off - X @ b0b) ** 2)), 1e-8))])
        b0 = np.concatenate([b0b, a0])
    if fam == "ordinal":
        aux_eq = [f"/cut{j + 1}" for j in range(naux)]
    elif fam == "nbinomial":
        aux_eq = ["/lnalpha" if sp["disp"] == "mean" else "/lndelta"]
    elif fam == "gamma":
        aux_eq = ["/logs"]                                      # compat 1902
    elif fam == "gaussian":
        aux_eq = [f"/var(e.{smp.depname})"]
    else:
        aux_eq = []
    resid = {("bernoulli", "logit"): math.pi ** 2 / 3, ("bernoulli", "probit"): 1.0,
             ("bernoulli", "cloglog"): math.pi ** 2 / 6, ("binomial", "logit"): math.pi ** 2 / 3,
             ("binomial", "probit"): 1.0, ("binomial", "cloglog"): math.pi ** 2 / 6,
             ("ordinal", "logit"): math.pi ** 2 / 3, ("ordinal", "probit"): 1.0}.get((fam, link))
    if fam == "gaussian":
        resid = lambda a: float(math.exp(a[0]))                 # noqa: E731
    eform = "Odds Ratio" if (link == "logit" and o.get("or")) else \
        ("IRR" if (fam in ("poisson", "nbinomial") and o.get("irr")) else "")
    F = Fit(smp=smp, o=o, sp=sp, X=X, off=off, off_name=off_name, lv=lv, lvs=levels, wobs=wobs, wgrp=wgrp,
            level_opts=[ro_ for _l, _r, ro_ in levels_spec],
            fam_f=fam_f, naux=naux,
            ordered=fam == "ordinal", b0=b0, analytic=analytic, aux_eq=aux_eq,
            aux_in_table=fam in ("ordinal", "nbinomial", "gamma"), resid=resid, nbin=nbin,
            nlev=(len(cats) if fam == "ordinal" else 0), qr=qr, eform=eform, npts=npts, method=method,
            family=fam, link=link)
    if fam == "ordinal":
        F.predict_multi = {"": pr_multi, "pr": pr_multi}
        F.cats = [float(c) for c in cats]
    if cmdname == "meglm":      # Stata rebuilds the command line (compat 1902; VERIFY for other forms)
        F.cmdline = (f"meglm {fixed_body.strip()}   ,  "
                     + "".join(f"|| {lvn}: {rev_.strip()}{' ' if rev_.strip() else ''}" for lvn, rev_, _ro in levels_spec)
                     + ", " + "    ".join(_split_opts(glob)))
    fit_me(s, args, cmdname, F)


def level_weights(s: "Session", smp, levels, levels_spec):
    """Observation weights (from [fweight], [pweight] or [iweight]) and the group weights of
    each level (its fweight() or pweight() option, which must be constant within a group)."""
    wobs = None
    if smp.wtype:
        wobs = np.asarray(smp.w, dtype=float)[smp.mask]
    wgrp = []
    kinds = {smp.wtype} if smp.wtype else set()
    for lv, (_l, _r, ro) in zip(levels, levels_spec):
        nm = next(((k, ro[k]) for k in ("fweight", "pweight") if isinstance(ro.get(k), str)), None)
        if nm is None:
            wgrp.append(None)
            continue
        kinds.add(nm[0])
        from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
        v = s.data.get(resolve_name(s.data, nm[1].strip())).data[smp.mask].astype(float)
        G = int(lv.gid.max()) + 1
        first = np.full(G, np.nan)
        first[lv.gid[::-1]] = v[::-1]
        if np.any(v != first[lv.gid]):
            raise StataError(198, f"weights in variable {nm[1].strip()} not constant within groups defined by: {lv.var}")   # compat 1916
        if np.any(first < 0):
            raise StataError(402, "negative weights encountered")   # VERIFY
        wgrp.append(first)
    if len(kinds - {"iweight"}) > 1:
        raise StataError(198, "frequency weights and sampling weights may not be combined")   # VERIFY
    if all(w is None for w in wgrp):
        wgrp = None
    return wobs, wgrp


def _split_opts(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """The options of a command line as separate words (parentheses kept together)."""
    out, depth, cur = [], 0, ""
    for ch in text:
        if ch == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")":
            depth -= 1
        if ch.isspace() and depth == 0:
            if cur:
                out.append(cur)
            cur = ""
        else:
            cur += ch
    if cur:
        out.append(cur)
    return out


def _me_vce(F: "Fit"):
    """vce(oim), vce(robust) or vce(cluster clustvar); sampling weights imply vce(robust)."""
    smp = F.smp
    vce = getattr(smp, "vce", "ols")
    clustvar = getattr(smp, "clustvar", "") or ""
    if vce not in ("ols", "oim", "robust", "cluster"):
        raise StataError(198, f"vcetype '{vce}' not allowed")   # VERIFY
    pw = getattr(smp, "wtype", "") == "pweight" or any(
        isinstance(ro.get("pweight"), str) for ro in (F.level_opts or []))
    if vce in ("ols", "oim"):
        vce = "robust" if pw else "oim"
    if vce != "oim" and F.qr:
        raise StataError(198, f"option vce({vce}) not allowed")   # VERIFY
    if clustvar:
        gtop = (F.lvs or [F.lv])[0].gid
        cl = np.asarray(smp.cluster)
        first = np.zeros(int(gtop.max()) + 1, dtype=cl.dtype)
        first[gtop[::-1]] = cl[::-1]
        if np.any(first[gtop] != cl):
            raise StataError(198, f"highest-level groups are not nested within {clustvar}")   # VERIFY
    return vce, clustvar


def _robust_v(model, b, V, F: "Fit", clustvar: str):
    """Sandwich variance with the scores of the highest-level groups summed within the clusters
    (each highest-level group is a cluster under vce(robust)); multiplier G/(G-1) (VERIFY)."""
    Sc = model.scores(b)
    gtop = model.gtop
    if clustvar:
        cl = np.asarray(F.smp.cluster)
        G = Sc.shape[0]
        first = np.zeros(G, dtype=cl.dtype)
        first[gtop[::-1]] = cl[::-1]
        _, cid = np.unique(first, return_inverse=True)
        Sc = np.array([Sc[cid == c].sum(axis=0) for c in range(cid.max() + 1)])
    g = Sc.shape[0]
    M_ = Sc.T @ Sc * (g / (g - 1) if g > 1 else 1.0)
    Vr = V @ M_ @ V
    return (Vr + Vr.T) / 2, g


def _obs_weight(F: "Fit"):
    """The weight of each observation in the model without random effects: its own weight times
    the weights of its groups."""
    w = None if F.wobs is None else np.asarray(F.wobs, dtype=float).copy()
    for lv, wg in zip(F.lvs or [F.lv], F.wgrp or []):
        if wg is not None:
            w = (np.ones(F.X.shape[0]) if w is None else w) * wg[lv.gid]
    return w


def fit_fixed(F: "Fit", kw: dict):
    """The model without random effects: its log likelihood is the reference of the LR test and
    its estimates start the full model."""
    X, off, naux, b0 = F.X, F.off, F.naux, F.b0
    p = X.shape[1]
    wt = _obs_weight(F)
    if wt is None:
        fam_f = F.fam_f
    else:
        def fam_f(eta, a=None):
            r = F.fam_f(eta, a) if a is not None else F.fam_f(eta)
            return tuple(x * wt[:, None] for x in r)
    if F.analytic:
        def fe_fun(b, todo):
            eta = (X @ b + off)[:, None]
            lf, s1, s2 = fam_f(eta)
            ll = float(lf.sum())
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            return ll, X.T @ s1[:, 0], (X * s2[:, 0][:, None]).T @ X
    else:
        def fe_grad(b):
            eta = (X @ b[:p] + off)[:, None]
            lf, s1, s2 = fam_f(eta, b[p:])
            g = np.zeros(b.size)
            g[:p] = X.T @ s1[:, 0]
            for m in range(naux):
                h = 1e-5 * (abs(b[p + m]) + 1)
                e = np.zeros(naux)
                e[m] = h
                g[p + m] = float(np.sum(fam_f(eta, b[p:] + e)[0] - fam_f(eta, b[p:] - e)[0])) / (2 * h)
            return g

        def fe_fun(b, todo):
            if F.ordered and np.any(np.diff(b[p:]) <= 0):
                return -np.inf, None, None
            eta = (X @ b[:p] + off)[:, None]
            ll = float(fam_f(eta, b[p:])[0].sum())
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            return ll, fe_grad(b), _num_gh(fe_grad, b)
    return maximize(fe_fun, b0, **kw)


def fit_me(s: "Session", args: str, cmdname: str, F: "Fit") -> None:
    """Fits the mixed-effects model with the conditional distribution F.fam_f and posts and
    shows the results (the part that meglm and mestreg have in common)."""
    from .regress import cmdline
    smp, o, sp, X, off, lv = F.smp, F.o, F.sp, F.X, F.off, F.lv
    fam, link, qr, naux = F.family, F.link, F.qr, F.naux
    off_name, aux_eq, npts, method = F.off_name, F.aux_eq, F.npts, F.method
    out = s.output
    ds = s.data
    n = smp.n
    lvs = F.lvs or [lv]
    if len(lvs) == 1:
        model = GLMM(fam, np.zeros(n), X, off, lv, npts, method, fam=F.fam_f, naux=naux, ordered=F.ordered,
                     wobs=F.wobs, wgrp=(F.wgrp[0] if F.wgrp else None))
    else:
        if method == "laplace":
            raise StataError(198, "intmethod(laplace) with more than one level is not available yet in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
        model = MGLMM(X, off, lvs, npts, method, F.fam_f, naux=naux, ordered=F.ordered, wobs=F.wobs,
                      wgrp=F.wgrp)
    vce, clustvar = _me_vce(F)
    robust = vce in ("robust", "cluster")
    kw = ml_options(o)
    p = X.shape[1]
    est_cols = [col for col in smp.cols if col.values is not None]
    rfe = fit_fixed(F, kw)
    # starting values for the variance components: best of a small grid (VERIFY)
    best = None
    for ls in (math.log(0.5), 0.0, math.log(0.25), math.log(1.5)):
        ths = []
        for lv_ in lvs:
            th_ = np.zeros(lv_.npar())
            th_[:min(lv_.q, th_.size) if lv_.cov != "exchangeable" else 1] = ls
            ths.append(th_)
        model.reset()
        bb = np.concatenate([rfe.b] + ths)
        model.adapt(bb)
        ll = model.loglik(bb)
        if best is None or ll > best[0]:
            best = (ll, bb, model.mu.copy(), model.C.copy())
    model.mu, model.C = best[2], best[3]
    lab = "log pseudolikelihood" if robust else "log likelihood"
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        if qr:
            # no fixed-effects fit is shown; the first stage refines the starting values (VERIFY)
            import re as _re
            if not _re.search(r"iterate\(\s*0\s*\)", str(o.get("refineopts") or "")):   # compat 1902
                out.write("\nRefining starting values:\n\n", "text")
                out.write(f"{'Iteration 0:':<14} {lab} = {g9(best[0], '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
            out.write("\nPerforming gradient-based optimization:\n\n", "text")
        else:
            # the fixed-effects fit and the grid show "log likelihood" even with vce(robust) or
            # sampling weights (compat 1916)
            out.write("\nFitting fixed-effects model:\n\n", "text")
            print_log(out, rfe)
            out.write("\nRefining starting values:\n\n", "text")
            out.write(f"{'Grid node 0:':<14} log likelihood = {g9(best[0], '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
            out.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
    r = maximize(model.fun, best[1], **kw)
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        print_log(out, r, lab)
    b = r.b
    try:
        V = np.linalg.inv(-r.H)
        V = (V + V.T) / 2
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        V = np.full((b.size, b.size), np.nan)
    n_clust = 0
    V_model = V
    if robust:
        V, n_clust = _robust_v(model, b, V, F, clustvar)
        # the note and e(N_clust) count the highest-level groups also with vce(cluster) (compat
        # 1916: "30 clusters in cl" for 6 clusters of 5 groups; VERIFY)
        n_clust = int(lvs[0].gid.max()) + 1
    beta, th = model.split(b)
    aux = model.aux(b)
    Vb = V[:p, :p]
    Va = V[p:p + naux, p:p + naux]
    Vth = V[p + naux:, p + naux:]
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    try:
        wchi2 = float(beta[slopes] @ np.linalg.solve(Vb[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)], beta[slopes])) if slopes else SYS
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        wchi2 = SYS
    wp = float(chi2_tail(wchi2, len(slopes))) if slopes and wchi2 < SYS else SYS
    chi2_c = max(2 * (r.ll - rfe.ll), 0.0)
    names = [col.name if not col.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(col.name) for col in smp.cols]
    if smp.constant:
        names.append("_cons")
    kk = len(names)
    pos = [i for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols) if col.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    bf = np.zeros(kk)
    Vf = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    bf[pos] = beta
    Vf[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = Vb
    bmap = {col.name: bf[i] for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {col.name: float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[i, i], 0))) for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = bf[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[-1, -1], 0)))
    if len(lvs) == 1:
        th_names = [f"{t}:_cons" for t in lv.labels()]
    else:       # VERIFY the names of e(b) with several levels
        th_names = [f"{t.replace('_', str(li + 1) + '_', 1)}:_cons" for li, lv_ in enumerate(lvs) for t in lv_.labels()]
    # auxiliary parameters: names in e(b) and the rows of the table are in F.aux_eq
    ball = np.concatenate([bf, aux, th])
    Vall = np.zeros((ball.size, ball.size))
    Vall[:kk, :kk] = Vf
    Vall[kk:kk + naux, kk:kk + naux] = Va
    Vall[kk:kk + naux, kk + naux:] = V[p:p + naux, p + naux:]
    Vall[kk + naux:, kk:kk + naux] = V[p + naux:, p:p + naux]
    Vall[kk + naux:, kk + naux:] = Vth
    bidx = pos + list(range(kk, ball.size))
    V_model_all = np.zeros_like(Vall)
    V_model_all[np.ix_(bidx, bidx)] = V_model
    est = Estimates(cmdname, smp.depname, names + ["_cons"] * (naux + th.size), ball, Vall, n, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = [smp.depname] * kk + aux_eq + [f"/{t.split(':')[0]}" for t in th_names]
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    if off_name:
        est.rows.append(CoefRow("fixed", off_name, eq="(exposure)" if o.get("exposure") else "(offset)"))
    if F.aux_in_table:
        est.rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        if F.aux_rows is not None:
            est.rows += F.aux_rows(aux, Va, st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - smp.level / 100) / 2))
        else:
            for j, nm_ in enumerate(aux_eq):
                se_a = float(np.sqrt(max(Va[j, j], 0)))
                est.rows.append(CoefRow("coef", nm_, float(aux[j]), se_a, name="_cons", noeform=True))
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = "Robust" if robust else ""
    est.robust = robust
    if robust:
        est.n_clust = n_clust
        est.clustvar = clustvar or lvs[0].var
    est.offset_name = off_name
    resid = F.resid(aux) if callable(F.resid) else F.resid
    est.glmm = {"model": model, "theta": th, "Vth": Vth, "beta": beta, "levels": lvs, "aux": aux,
                "Va": Va, "aux_eq": aux_eq, "resid_var": resid, "mask": smp.mask.copy(), "nbin": F.nbin,
                "nlev": F.nlev}
    # frequency weights: the observations of a group are counted with their [fweight] and the
    # groups (and the observations) with the fweight() of their level and of the levels above
    # (compat 1916)
    fwo = np.asarray(F.wobs, dtype=float) if (F.wobs is not None and getattr(smp, "wtype", "") == "fweight") \
        else np.ones(n)
    fwg = np.ones(n)
    groups = []
    for li_, lv_ in enumerate(lvs):
        wg_ = F.wgrp[li_] if (F.wgrp and isinstance(F.level_opts[li_].get("fweight"), str)) else None
        if wg_ is not None:
            fwg = fwg * wg_[lv_.gid]
        cnt = np.bincount(lv_.gid, weights=fwo)
        ng = np.bincount(lv_.gid, weights=fwg) / np.bincount(lv_.gid)    # the group's weight
        groups.append((lv_.var, int(round(ng.sum())), int(round(cnt.min())), float(np.sum(cnt * ng) / ng.sum()),
                       int(round(cnt.max()))))
    nvc = sum(lv_.npar() for lv_ in lvs)
    N_ = float(np.sum(fwo * fwg))
    est.extra = {"N": N_, "ll": r.ll, "chi2": wchi2, "p": wp, "df_m": len(slopes), "ll_c": rfe.ll,
                 "chi2_c": chi2_c, "nvc": nvc, "spec": sp, "method": method, "qr": qr,
                 "sd": bool(o.get("stddeviations")), "robust": robust, "n_clust": n_clust,
                 "clustvar": clustvar or lvs[0].var, "groups": groups}
    est.extra["npts"] = 1 if method == "laplace" else npts
    est.display = display_qr if qr else display_me
    est.predict = F.predict or predict_me
    est.predict_opts = F.predict_opts if F.predict_opts is not None else \
        {"mu": 2, "eta": 3, "reffects": 4, "fixedonly": 5, "pr": 2, "outcome": 3, "conditional": 4}
    est.predict_multi = {"reffects": reffects_me, **F.predict_multi}
    est.estat = {"icc": (3, estat_icc), "group": (3, estat_group)}
    if qr:
        est.estat["recovariance"] = (5, estat_recov)       # compat 1902: unrecognized after the others
    est.icc_ok = cmdname in ("melogit", "meprobit", "meqrlogit", "meqrpoisson") or \
        (cmdname == "meglm" and fam in ("bernoulli", "gaussian"))   # VERIFY for meglm
    est.eform_default = F.eform
    # e() in the order Stata lists it (compat 1002 and 1902)
    nvar_p = sum({"identity": 1, "exchangeable": 1}.get(lv_.cov, lv_.q) for lv_ in lvs)
    ncov_p = nvc - nvar_p
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    from .fvars import base_vars
    from .ml import ilog
    from .results import datasignature
    covs = [c.name for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    family = fam
    names_all = list(est.names)
    grad = np.zeros((1, len(names_all)))
    if r.g is not None and len(r.g) == len(names_all):
        grad[0] = r.g
    ivars = " ".join(lv_.var for lv_ in lvs)
    gmats = [(nm, Matrix(np.array([[g_[j] for g_ in groups]], dtype=float), ["r1"], [lv_.var for lv_ in lvs]))
             for nm, j in (("g_max", 4), ("g_avg", 3), ("g_min", 2), ("N_g", 1))]
    cmdline_ = F.cmdline or cmdline(cmdname, args)
    if qr:
        # meqrlogit and meqrpoisson: the e() of the xtmelogit family. The plain fit lists it in the
        # order below and a fit with refineopts() in the reverse order (compat 1902; VERIFY)
        sigvars = [smp.depname] + [v for v in base_vars(smp.terms) if v != smp.depname] + [lv.var] \
            + [nm for nm in lv.names if nm != "_cons"]
        scalars = [("converged", 1.0 if r.converged else 0.0), ("rc", 0.0), ("p", wp), ("chi2", wchi2),
                   ("df_m", float(len(slopes))), ("N", float(n)), ("p_c", _p_chibar(chi2_c, nvc)),
                   ("chi2_c", chi2_c), ("df_c", float(nvc)), ("ll_c", rfe.ll), ("ll", r.ll),
                   ("k_rc", float(ncov_p)), ("k_rs", float(nvar_p)), ("k_r", float(th.size)),
                   ("k_f", float(len(slopes) + int(smp.constant))), ("k", float(ball.size)),
                   ("reparm_rc", 0.0), ("rank", float(ball.size))]
        macros = [("cmdline", cmdline_), ("datasignaturevars", " ".join(sigvars)),
                  ("datasignature", datasignature(s, sigvars, smp.mask)), ("chi2type", "Wald"),
                  ("n_quad", str(int(est.extra["npts"]))), ("redim", " ".join(str(l_.q) for l_ in lvs)),
                  ("ivars", " ".join(l_.var for l_ in lvs)),   # nested levels: VERIFY
                  ("vartypes", " ".join(COV_TITLE[l_.cov] for l_ in lvs)),
                  ("revars", " ".join(" ".join(l_.names) for l_ in lvs)), ("title", sp["title"]),
                  ("technique", "nr"), ("ml_method", "d0"), ("opt", "moptimize"), ("model", sp["model"]),
                  ("estat_cmd", f"{cmdname}_estat"), ("predict", f"{cmdname}_p"), ("cmd", cmdname),
                  ("marginsdefault", "predict(xb)"),
                  ("marginsnotok", "stdp Pearson Deviance Anscombe REFfects RESEs"), ("method", "ML"),
                  ("depvar", smp.depname), ("properties", "b V")]
        extra_mats = list(gmats)
        if o.get("refineopts"):
            scalars.reverse()
            macros.reverse()
            extra_mats.reverse()
        if method == "laplace":
            macros.append(("laplace", "laplace"))
    else:
        # the level variables from the lowest level up (compat 1916)
        sigvars = [lv_.var for lv_ in reversed(lvs)] + [v for v in base_vars(smp.terms) if v != smp.depname] + [smp.depname]
        ordinal = fam == "ordinal"
        scalars = [("rank", float(ball.size)), ("N", N_), ("ic", float(r.iterations)),
                   ("converged", 1.0 if r.converged else 0.0), ("rc", 0.0), ("ll", r.ll),
                   ("k", float(ball.size)), ("k_eq", float(1 + naux + nvc))]
        if ordinal:
            scalars.append(("k_cat", float(F.nlev)))
        scalars += [("k_eq_model", 1.0), ("ll_c", rfe.ll), ("k_rs", float(nvar_p)), ("k_rc", float(ncov_p)),
                    ("k_dv", 1.0)]
        if len(lvs) > 1:        # compat 1916: with nested levels this part comes in reverse order
            scalars.reverse()
        scalars += [("k_r", float(sum(lv_.q for lv_ in lvs))),
                    ("k_f", float(len(slopes)))]   # VERIFY: k_f without _cons
        scalars += [("p_c", _p_chibar(chi2_c, nvc)), ("df_c", float(nvc)), ("chi2_c", chi2_c)]
        scalars += [("p", wp), ("chi2", wchi2), ("df_m", float(len(slopes)))]
        if robust:
            scalars += [("N_clust", float(n_clust))]
        common = [("n_quad", str(int(est.extra["npts"]))), ("ivars", ivars), ("chi2type", "Wald"),
                  ("datasignaturevars", " ".join(sigvars)),
                  ("datasignature", datasignature(s, sigvars, smp.mask)), ("intmethod", method),
                  ("depvar", smp.depname)] + \
            ([("clustvar", clustvar or lvs[0].var)] if robust else []) + \
            [("marginsnotok", "LATent1(passthru) LATent se(passthru)"), ("covariates", " ".join(covs))]
        tail = [("opt", "moptimize")] + ([("vcetype", "Robust")] if robust else []) + [("vce", vce)] + \
            [("user", "_gsem_eval_chol()"), ("ml_method", "gf2"),
             ("technique", "nr"), ("which", "max"), ("properties", "b V")]   # VERIFY vcetype/clustvar
        if getattr(smp, "wtype", ""):
            from .regress import wexp_macros
            tail[1:1] = wexp_macros(smp)   # VERIFY the place
        if ordinal:
            tail.insert(0, ("marginsdefault", " ".join(f"predict(pr outcome({c:g}))" for c in F.cats)))
        if sp["cmd"] == "meglm":
            macros = [("cmdline", cmdline_), ("cmd2", "meglm"), ("cmd", "gsem"), ("title", sp["title"]),
                      ("family", family), ("model", sp["model"]), ("predict", "meglm_p"),
                      ("estat_cmd", "meglm_estat")] + common + [("link", link)] + tail
        else:
            macros = [("cmd", "meglm"), ("estat_cmd", f"{cmdname}_estat"), ("predict", f"{cmdname}_p"),
                      ("cmdline", cmdline_), ("cmd2", cmdname), ("model", sp["model"]), ("title", sp["title"]),
                      ("dispersion", sp["disp"]), ("link", link), ("family", family)] + common + tail
            if cmdname == "meoprobit":      # compat 1902
                d_ = dict(macros)
                macros = [(k_, d_[k_]) for k_ in ("cmd", "cmdline", "cmd2", "estat_cmd", "predict", "model",
                                                  "title", "link", "family")] + \
                         [m for m in macros if m[0] not in ("cmd", "cmdline", "cmd2", "estat_cmd", "predict",
                                                            "model", "title", "link", "family")]
        extra_mats = list(gmats)
        if ordinal:
            extra_mats.append(("cat", Matrix(np.array([F.cats], dtype=float), ["r1"],
                                             [f"c{i + 1}" for i in range(len(F.cats))])))
        if robust:
            extra_mats.append(("V_modelbased", Matrix(V_model_all, names_all, names_all)))
        extra_mats += [("gradient", Matrix(grad, ["r1"], names_all)),
                       ("ilog", Matrix(ilog(r), ["r1"], [f"c{i + 1}" for i in range(20)]))]
    if F.macro_edit is not None:
        macros = F.macro_edit(macros)
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask, extra_mats=extra_mats)
    if F.late_error:
        raise StataError(198, F.late_error)
    if qr:
        display_qr(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), group=not o.get("nogroup"),
                    lrtest=not o.get("nolrtest"), table=not o.get("nofetable"),
                    retable=not o.get("noretable"))
    else:
