_RE_OPTS = {"covariance": 3, "noconstant": 4, "collinear": 4, "fweight": 2, "pweight": 2}


def split_levels(args: str) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str, dict]], str]:
    """Returns (fixed part, [(level var, re varlist, re options)], global options)."""
    parts = []
    depth, start, i = 0, 0, 0
    quote = False
    while i < len(args):
        c = args[i]
        if c == '"':
            quote = not quote
        elif not quote and c in "([":
            depth += 1
        elif not quote and c in ")]":
            depth -= 1
        elif not quote and depth == 0 and args.startswith("||", i):
            parts.append(args[start:i])
            start = i + 2
            i += 2
            continue
        i += 1
    parts.append(args[start:])
    fixed = parts[0]
    levels = []
    glob = ""
    for k, part in enumerate(parts[1:]):
        c = find_top(part, ",")
        body, opts = (part, "") if c == -1 else (part[:c], part[c + 1:])
        if ":" not in body:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid random-effects specification")   # VERIFY
        lv, revars = body.split(":", 1)
        lv = lv.strip()
        reo: dict = {}
        if opts.strip():
            from ..lang.syntax import parse_options
            rest = []
            for name, arg in parse_options(opts):
                full = next((f for f, m in _RE_OPTS.items() if len(name) >= m and f.startswith(name)), None)
                if full is not None:
                    reo[full] = arg if arg is not None else True
                else:
                    rest.append(name + (f"({arg})" if arg is not None else ""))
            if rest:
                if k != len(parts) - 2:
                    raise StataError(198, f"option {rest[0]} not allowed")
                glob = " ".join(rest)
        levels.append((lv, revars.strip(), reo))
    # global options may also follow the fixed part when there are no levels
    return fixed, levels, glob


def _cov_kind(text: str | bool | None, q: int) -> str:
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return "identity" if q == 1 else "independent"
    t = text.strip().lower()
    for full, k in (("independent", 3), ("exchangeable", 2), ("identity", 2), ("unstructured", 2)):
        if len(t) >= k and full.startswith(t):
            return full
    raise StataError(198, f"covariance({text}) invalid")   # VERIFY


@dataclass
class Level:
    var: str
    names: list[str]          # random-effect names (variables, then _cons)
    cov: str
    Z: np.ndarray             # n x q over the estimation sample
    gid: np.ndarray           # group index over the sample (nested in the upper levels)
    rep: int = 1              # R.factor equations: Z has `rep` indicator columns sharing one variance
    fac: str = ""             # the factor variable of an R. equation
    fcode: np.ndarray | None = None   # its level (0..rep-1) of each observation

    @property
    def q(self) -> int:
        return len(self.names)

    def npar(self) -> int:
        q = self.q
        return {"identity": 1, "independent": q, "exchangeable": 2,
                "unstructured": q + q * (q - 1) // 2}[self.cov]

    def sigma(self, th: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        q = self.q
        if self.cov == "identity":
            return np.exp(2 * th[0]) * np.eye(q)
        if self.cov == "independent":
            return np.diag(np.exp(2 * th[:q]))
        if self.cov == "exchangeable":
            s2 = np.exp(2 * th[0])
            r = np.tanh(th[1])
            S = np.full((q, q), r * s2)
            np.fill_diagonal(S, s2)
            return S
        sd = np.exp(th[:q])
        R = np.eye(q)
        k = q
        for i in range(q):
            for j in range(i + 1, q):
                R[i, j] = R[j, i] = np.tanh(th[k])
                k += 1
        return R * np.outer(sd, sd)

    def labels(self) -> list[str]:
        """Names of the parameters in the estimation metric (for e(b))."""
        q = self.q
        if self.cov == "identity":
            return ["lns_1"]
        if self.cov == "independent":
            return [f"lns_{i + 1}" for i in range(q)]
        if self.cov == "exchangeable":
            return ["lns_1", "atr_1_1"]
        return [f"lns_{i + 1}" for i in range(q)] + [f"atr_{i + 1}_{j + 1}" for i in range(q) for j in range(i + 1, q)]


class _Cluster:
    """Precomputed cross products of a top-level group."""

    def __init__(self, rows, X, y, levels: list[Level]):
        self.rows = rows
        self.reps = [lv.rep for lv in levels]
        Zs = []
        self.blocks = []        # (level index, number of copies)
        for li, lv in enumerate(levels):
            g = lv.gid[rows]
            ug = np.unique(g)
            for u in ug:
                Zb = np.zeros((len(rows), lv.Z.shape[1]))
                m = g == u
                Zb[m] = lv.Z[rows][m]
                Zs.append(Zb)
            self.blocks.append((li, len(ug)))
        self.Z = np.column_stack(Zs) if Zs else np.zeros((len(rows), 0))
        Xr, yr = X[rows], y[rows]
        self.n = len(rows)
        self.A = self.Z.T @ self.Z
        self.ZX = self.Z.T @ Xr
        self.Zy = self.Z.T @ yr
        self.XX = Xr.T @ Xr
        self.Xy = Xr.T @ yr
        self.yy = float(yr @ yr)


def _G(cl: _Cluster, sigmas: list[np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
    Q = cl.Z.shape[1]
    G = np.zeros((Q, Q))
    k = 0
    for li, copies in cl.blocks:
        S = sigmas[li]
        if cl.reps[li] > 1:
            S = np.kron(S, np.eye(cl.reps[li]))
        q = S.shape[0]
        for _ in range(copies):
            G[k:k + q, k:k + q] = S
            k += q
    return G


class LMM:
    def __init__(self, X, y, levels: list[Level], reml: bool):
        self.X, self.y, self.levels, self.reml = X, y, levels, reml
        self.n, self.p = X.shape
        top = levels[0].gid
        order = np.argsort(top, kind="stable")
        bounds = np.nonzero(np.diff(top[order]))[0] + 1
        self.clusters = [_Cluster(rows, X, y, levels) for rows in np.split(order, bounds)]
        self.sizes = [lv.npar() for lv in levels]

    def split(self, th):
        out, k = [], 0
        for s in self.sizes:
            out.append(th[k:k + s])
            k += s
        return out, th[k]

    def parts(self, th):
        """Aggregates for the profiled likelihood at theta."""
        pieces, lnse = self.split(th)
        sigmas = [lv.sigma(t) for lv, t in zip(self.levels, pieces)]
        s2 = math.exp(2 * lnse)
        p = self.p
        XVX = np.zeros((p, p))
        XVy = np.zeros(p)
        yVy = 0.0
        logdet = 0.0
        cache = []
        for cl in self.clusters:
            G = _G(cl, sigmas)
            Q = G.shape[0]
            K = s2 * np.eye(Q) + G @ cl.A
            sign, ld = np.linalg.slogdet(K)
            if sign <= 0:
                return None
            # V^-1 = (I - Z K^-1 G Z') / s2
            KG = np.linalg.solve(K, G)
            XVX += (cl.XX - cl.ZX.T @ KG @ cl.ZX) / s2
            XVy += (cl.Xy - cl.ZX.T @ KG @ cl.Zy) / s2
            yVy += (cl.yy - cl.Zy @ KG @ cl.Zy) / s2
            logdet += cl.n * math.log(s2) + ld - Q * math.log(s2)
            cache.append((G, KG))
        return XVX, XVy, yVy, logdet, cache, sigmas, s2

    def loglik(self, th) -> float:
        r = self.parts(th)
        if r is None:
            return -np.inf
        XVX, XVy, yVy, logdet, *_ = r
        try:
            b = np.linalg.solve(XVX, XVy)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return -np.inf
        q = yVy - 2 * b @ XVy + b @ XVX @ b
        if self.reml:
            s, ldx = np.linalg.slogdet(XVX)
            return -0.5 * ((self.n - self.p) * math.log(2 * math.pi) + logdet + ldx + q)
        return -0.5 * (self.n * math.log(2 * math.pi) + logdet + q)

    def beta(self, th):
        XVX, XVy, *_ = self.parts(th)
        b = np.linalg.solve(XVX, XVy)
        return b, np.linalg.inv(XVX)

    def blups(self, th, b) -> list[np.ndarray]:
        """Empirical Bayes predictions of the random effects of each cluster (stacked
        as in Z) : u = G Z' V^-1 r."""
        _, _, _, _, cache, sigmas, s2 = self.parts(th)
        out = []
        for cl, (G, KG) in zip(self.clusters, cache):
            Zr = cl.Zy - cl.ZX @ b
            out.append((G @ Zr - G @ cl.A @ KG @ Zr) / s2)
        return out


def _numderiv(f, x):
    """Gradient and Hessian by central differences (steps scaled to x)."""
    k = x.size
    h = 1e-4 * (np.abs(x) + 1)
    f0 = f(x)
    g = np.zeros(k)
    H = np.zeros((k, k))
    fp = np.zeros(k)
    fm = np.zeros(k)
    for i in range(k):
        e = np.zeros(k)
        e[i] = h[i]
        fp[i], fm[i] = f(x + e), f(x - e)
        g[i] = (fp[i] - fm[i]) / (2 * h[i])
        H[i, i] = (fp[i] - 2 * f0 + fm[i]) / h[i] ** 2
    for i in range(k):
        for j in range(i + 1, k):
            ei = np.zeros(k)
            ej = np.zeros(k)
            ei[i], ej[j] = h[i], h[j]
            v = (f(x + ei + ej) - f(x + ei - ej) - f(x - ei + ej) + f(x - ei - ej)) / (4 * h[i] * h[j])
            H[i, j] = H[j, i] = v
    return f0, g, H

            continue
        var = resolve_name(ds, lv)
        names = s.expand_varlist(revars) if revars else []
        cols = [ds.get(v).data[mask].astype(np.float64) for v in names]
        cons = not reo.get("noconstant")
        if cons:
            cols.append(np.ones(nm_))
        if not cols:
            raise StataError(198, "random-effects equation has no variables")   # VERIFY
        Z = np.column_stack(cols)
        codes = codes_of(var)
        # nested in the levels above: the group is the combination with the upper key
        key = prev_key * (codes.max() + 1) + codes
        _, gid = np.unique(key, return_inverse=True)
        prev_key = gid.astype(np.int64)
        q = len(names) + (1 if cons else 0)
        out.append(Level(var, names + (["_cons"] if cons else []), _cov_kind(reo.get("covariance"), q), Z, gid))
    return out


def cmd_mixed(s: "Session", args: str, cmdname: str = "mixed") -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    from .regress import Sample, cmdline
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "mixed", args)
        return
    fixed, levels_spec, glob = split_levels(args)
    if not levels_spec:
        raise StataError(198, "random-effects equation required")   # VERIFY
    c = find_top(fixed, ",")
    fixed_body, fe_opts = (fixed, "") if c == -1 else (fixed[:c], fixed[c + 1:])
    opts_text = " ".join(x for x in (fe_opts.strip(), glob.strip()) if x)
    for lv_, r_, _o in levels_spec:      # compat 1902: checked before the variables are looked up
        if lv_ == "_all" and len(r_.split()) != 1:
            raise StataError(198, f"{r_} invalid level specification")
    extra = " ".join([lv for lv, _r, _o in levels_spec if lv != "_all"] +
                     [(r[2:] if lv == "_all" and r.startswith("R.") else r)
                      for lv, r, _o in levels_spec if r])
    smp = Sample(s, fixed_body + (f", {opts_text}" if opts_text else ""), opts_spec=_GLOBAL,
                 weights=(), extra_vars=extra)
    o = smp.o
    reml = bool(o.get("reml"))
    out = s.output
    ds = s.data
    fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant)
    est_cols = [col for col in smp.cols if col.values is not None]
    n = smp.n
    X = np.column_stack([col.values for col in est_cols] + ([np.ones(n)] if smp.constant else [])) \
        if (est_cols or smp.constant) else np.zeros((n, 0))
    y = smp.y.astype(np.float64)
    levels = build_levels(s, smp.mask, levels_spec, n, crossed=True)
    model = LMM(X, y, levels, reml)
    # starting values from OLS
    b_ols, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    res = y - X @ b_ols
    s2 = float(res @ res / max(n - X.shape[1], 1))
    th0 = []
    for lv in levels:
        sd0 = []
        for j, nm in enumerate(lv.names):
            zsd = float(np.std(lv.Z[:, j])) if nm != "_cons" and lv.rep == 1 else 1.0
            sd0.append(0.5 * math.log(s2 / 4) - (math.log(zsd) if zsd > 0 and nm != "_cons" and lv.rep == 1 else 0.0))
        if lv.cov == "identity":
            th0.append(sd0[0])
        elif lv.cov == "independent":
            th0 += sd0
        elif lv.cov == "exchangeable":
            th0 += [sd0[0], 0.0]
        else:
            th0 += sd0 + [0.0] * (lv.q * (lv.q - 1) // 2)
    th0.append(0.5 * math.log(s2 / 2))
    th0 = np.array(th0)

    def fun(th, todo):
        if todo == 0:
            return model.loglik(th), None, None
        return _numderiv(model.loglik, th)

    # silent rough maximization (in place of Stata's EM iterations)
    pre = maximize(fun, th0, maxiter=50, tol=1e-2, ltol=1e-3, nrtol=1e2)
    r = maximize(fun, pre.b, **ml_options(o))
    lab = "log restricted-likelihood" if reml else "log likelihood"
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nPerforming EM optimization: \n\nPerforming gradient-based optimization: \n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, r, lab)
        out.write("\nComputing standard errors:\n", "text")
    th = r.b
    b, Vb = model.beta(th)
    try:
        Vth = np.linalg.inv(-r.H)
        Vth = (Vth + Vth.T) / 2
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        Vth = np.full((th.size, th.size), np.nan)
    # linear model for the LR test (same criterion: ML or REML)
    rss = float(res @ res)
    p = X.shape[1]
    if reml:
        s2r = rss / (n - p)
        _sgn, ldx = np.linalg.slogdet(X.T @ X / s2r)
        ll_lin = -0.5 * ((n - p) * math.log(2 * math.pi) + n * math.log(s2r) + ldx + (n - p))
    else:
        ll_lin = -0.5 * n * (math.log(2 * math.pi) + math.log(rss / n) + 1)
    chi2_c = max(2 * (r.ll - ll_lin), 0.0)
    nvc = sum(lv.npar() for lv in levels)
    # Wald test of the slopes
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    try:
        wchi2 = float(b[slopes] @ np.linalg.solve(Vb[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)], b[slopes])) if slopes else SYS
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        wchi2 = SYS
    wp = float(chi2_tail(wchi2, len(slopes))) if slopes and wchi2 < SYS else SYS
    # e(b): fixed part with the full names, then the variance parameters
    names = [col.name if not col.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(col.name) for col in smp.cols]
    if smp.constant:
        names.append("_cons")
    kk = len(names)
    pos = [i for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols) if col.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    bf = np.zeros(kk)
    Vf = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    bf[pos] = b
    Vf[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = Vb
    th_names, th_eqs = [], []
    for li, lv in enumerate(levels):
        for lab_ in lv.labels():
            th_eqs.append(f"{lab_.split('_')[0]}{li + 1}_{lab_.split('_', 1)[1]}")
            th_names.append("_cons")
    th_eqs.append("lnsig_e")
    th_names.append("_cons")
    ball = np.concatenate([bf, th])
    Vall = np.zeros((kk + th.size, kk + th.size))
    Vall[:kk, :kk] = Vf
    Vall[kk:, kk:] = Vth
    bmap = {col.name: bf[i] for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {col.name: float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[i, i], 0))) for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = bf[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates("mixed", smp.depname, names + th_names, ball, Vall, n, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = [smp.depname] * kk + th_eqs
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = ""
    est.robust = False
    est.lmm = {"model": model, "theta": th, "Vth": Vth, "beta": b, "levels": levels, "reml": reml,
               "kfixed": kk, "mask": smp.mask.copy()}
    est.extra = {"N": float(n), "ll": r.ll, "chi2": wchi2, "p": wp, "df_m": len(slopes), "ll_c": ll_lin,
                 "chi2_c": chi2_c, "nvc": nvc, "reml": reml, "sd": bool(o.get("stddeviations"))}
    est.display = display_mixed
    est.predict = _predict_mixed
    est.predict_opts = {"fitted": 3, "reffects": 4, "residuals": 3, "rstandard": 4}
    est.predict_multi = {"reffects": _reffects}
    est.estat = {"icc": (3, estat_icc), "group": (3, estat_group), "recovariance": (5, estat_recov)}
    est.ml_cmd = "mixed"
    # groups per level
    ginfo = []
    for lv in levels:
        if lv.var == "_all" and ginfo and ginfo[-1][0] == "_all":
            continue                # one line for all the _all: equations   # VERIFY
        cnt = np.bincount(lv.gid)
        ginfo.append((lv.var, len(cnt), int(cnt.min()), float(cnt.mean()), int(cnt.max())))
    est.extra["groups"] = ginfo
    # e() in the order Stata lists it (compat 1001)
    nvar_p = sum({"identity": 1, "exchangeable": 1}.get(lv.cov, lv.q) for lv in levels)
    ncov_p = nvc - nvar_p
    # e(nrgroups) does not count the _all level (compat 1902; VERIFY with only _all levels)
    scalars = [("rank", float(ball.size)), ("k_f", float(kk)), ("k_r", float(th.size)),
               ("k", float(ball.size)), ("k_rs", float(nvar_p + 1)), ("k_rc", float(ncov_p)),
               ("k_res", 0.0), ("converged", 1.0 if r.converged else 0.0), ("ll", r.ll),
               ("ll_c", ll_lin), ("df_c", float(nvc)), ("chi2_c", chi2_c),
               ("p_c", _p_chibar(chi2_c, nvc)), ("N", float(n)), ("nrgroups", float(max(1, sum(lv.var != "_all" for lv in levels)))),
               ("rc", 0.0), ("df_m", float(len(slopes))), ("chi2", wchi2), ("p", wp), ("small", 0.0)]
    if any(lv.var == "_all" for lv in levels):      # compat 1902: crossed effects list the scalars reversed
        scalars = scalars[-2::-1] + scalars[-1:]
    from .results import datasignature
    sigvars = [smp.depname] + fvars.base_vars(smp.terms)
    for lv in levels:
        for nm in lv.names + [lv.var, lv.fac]:
            if nm != "_cons" and nm not in sigvars and ds.has(nm):
                sigvars.append(nm)
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline(cmdname, args)), ("datasignaturevars", " ".join(sigvars)),
              ("datasignature", datasignature(s, sigvars, smp.mask)), ("chi2type", "Wald"),
              ("rstructlab", "Independent"), ("rstructure", "independent"),
              ("estat_cmd", "mixed_estat"), ("predict", "mixed_p"),
              ("redim", " ".join(str(lv.q) for lv in levels)),
              ("ivars", " ".join(lv.var for lv in levels)),
              ("vartypes", " ".join({"identity": "Identity", "independent": "Independent",
                                    "exchangeable": "Exchangeable", "unstructured": "Unstructured"}[lv.cov]
                                   for lv in levels)),
              ("revars", " ".join(" ".join(lv.names) for lv in levels)), ("cmd", "mixed"),
              ("title", "Mixed-effects REML regression" if reml else "Mixed-effects ML regression"),
              ("technique", "nr"), ("ml_method", "d0"), ("opt", "moptimize"),
              ("method", "REML" if reml else "ML"), ("optmetric", "matsqrt"), ("depvar", smp.depname),
              ("properties", "b V")]
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    gcols = [lv.var for lv in levels]
    extra_mats = [(nm, Matrix(np.array([[fn(g) for g in ginfo]], dtype=float), ["r1"], gcols))
                  for nm, fn in (("g_max", lambda g: g[4]), ("g_avg", lambda g: g[3]),
                                 ("g_min", lambda g: g[2]), ("N_g", lambda g: g[1]))]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask, extra_mats=extra_mats)
    display_mixed(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("nofetable"),
                  retable=not o.get("noretable"), group=not o.get("nogroup"),
                  lrtest=not o.get("nolrtest"))


def _p_chibar(chi2: float, k: int) -> float:
    if k == 1:
        return 0.5 * float(st.chi2.sf(chi2, 1)) if chi2 > 0 else 1.0
    return float(chi2_tail(chi2, k))

def _right(out, left: str, lab: str, val: str) -> None:

def group_header(out, title: str, ginfo, N: float, extra_right=(), *, gv_right: bool = False,
                 mid=()) -> None:
    """gv_right: the me commands right-align the group variable ("Group variable:   g",
    compat 1002); mixed writes it after one space."""
    out.write("\n", "text")
    _right(out, title, "Number of obs", f"{int(N):,}")
    for line in mid:                  # Family:/Link: of meglm, Overdispersion: of menbreg
        out.write(line + "\n", "text")
    if len(ginfo) == 1:
        var, ng, mn, av, mx = ginfo[0]
        gv = f"Group variable:{var:>16}" if gv_right else f"Group variable: {var}"
        _right(out, gv, "Number of groups", f"{ng:,}")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':48}Obs per group:\n", "text")
        for lab, val in (("min", f"{mn:,}"), ("avg", f"{av:.1f}"), ("max", f"{mx:,}")):
            out.write(f"{'':48}{lab:>17} = ", "text")
            out.write(f"{val:>10}\n", "result")
    else:
        out.write("\n" + "-" * 61 + "\n", "text")
        out.write("                |     No. of       Observations per Group\n", "text")
        out.write(" Group Variable |     Groups    Minimum    Average    Maximum\n", "text")
        out.write("----------------+--------------------------------------------\n", "text")
        for var, ng, mn, av, mx in ginfo:
            out.write(f"{var[:14]:>15} |", "text")
            out.write(f" {ng:>10,} {mn:>10,} {av:>10.1f} {mx:>10,}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 61 + "\n", "text")
    for left, lab, val in extra_right:
        if lab:
            _right(out, left, lab, val)
        else:
            out.write(left + "\n", "text")

                  level: float | None = None, retable: bool = True, group: bool = True,

def lr_line(out, against: str, chi2: float, k: int) -> None:
    if k == 1:
        left = f"LR test vs. {against}: chibar2(01) = {chi2:.2f}"
        right = f"Prob >= chibar2 = {_p_chibar(chi2, 1):.4f}"
    else:
        left = f"LR test vs. {against}: chi2({k}) = {chi2:.2f}"
        right = f"Prob > chi2 = {chi2_tail(chi2, k):.4f}"
    out.write(left + right.rjust(max(78 - len(left), len(right) + 1)) + "\n", "text")
    if k > 1:
        out.write("\nNote: LR test is conservative and provided only for reference.\n", "text")


def _vc_rows(lv: Level, th: np.ndarray, V: np.ndarray, sd: bool, z: float):
    """(label, estimate, se, lo, hi) for the variance components of a level, by the delta method."""
    rows = []
    q = lv.q
    S = lv.sigma(th)

    def num_jac(fn):
        h = 1e-6
        f0 = fn(th)
        J = np.zeros(th.size)
        for i in range(th.size):
            e = np.zeros(th.size)
            e[i] = h
            J[i] = (fn(th + e) - fn(th - e)) / (2 * h)
        return f0, J

    def add(label, fn, kind):
        f0, J = num_jac(fn)
        se = float(np.sqrt(max(J @ V @ J, 0)))
        if kind == "pos":           # variances and sds: interval on the log scale
            lse = se / f0 if f0 > 0 else np.nan
            try:
                lo, hi = f0 * math.exp(-z * lse), f0 * math.exp(z * lse)
            except OverflowError:   # a variance at the boundary (compat 1916)
                lo = hi = np.nan
        elif kind == "corr":
            a = math.atanh(f0) if abs(f0) < 1 else np.nan
            ase = se / (1 - f0 * f0) if abs(f0) < 1 else np.nan
            lo, hi = math.tanh(a - z * ase), math.tanh(a + z * ase)
        else:                       # covariance: VERIFY Stata's interval for cov()
            lo, hi = f0 - z * se, f0 + z * se
        rows.append((label, f0, se, lo, hi))

    pre = "sd" if sd else "var"
    if lv.cov == "identity":
        nm = lv.names[0] if q == 1 else "_cons"
        lab = f"{pre}({nm})" if q == 1 else f"{pre}({lv.names[0]}..{lv.names[-1]})"   # VERIFY
        add(lab, (lambda t: math.exp(t[0])) if sd else (lambda t: math.exp(2 * t[0])), "pos")
        return rows
    if lv.cov == "exchangeable":
        add(f"{pre}({lv.names[0]}..{lv.names[-1]})" if q > 1 else f"{pre}({lv.names[0]})",
            (lambda t: math.exp(t[0])) if sd else (lambda t: math.exp(2 * t[0])), "pos")
        if sd:
            add(f"corr({lv.names[0]}..{lv.names[-1]})", lambda t: math.tanh(t[1]), "corr")
        else:
            add(f"cov({lv.names[0]}..{lv.names[-1]})", lambda t: math.tanh(t[1]) * math.exp(2 * t[0]), "cov")
        return rows
    for i, nm in enumerate(lv.names):
        add(f"{pre}({nm})", (lambda t, i=i: math.exp(t[i])) if sd else (lambda t, i=i: math.exp(2 * t[i])), "pos")
    if lv.cov == "unstructured":
        k = q
        for i in range(q):
            for j in range(i + 1, q):
                if sd:
                    add(f"corr({lv.names[i]},{lv.names[j]})", lambda t, k=k: math.tanh(t[k]), "corr")
                else:
                    add(f"cov({lv.names[i]},{lv.names[j]})",
                        lambda t, i=i, j=j, k=k: math.tanh(t[k]) * math.exp(t[i] + t[j]), "cov")
                k += 1
    del S
    return rows


def _re_row(out, lab, est_, se, lo, hi) -> None:
    out.write(f"{lab[:28]:>28} |", "text")
    out.write(f"{g9(est_):>11}{g9(se):>11}{g9(lo):>14}{g9(hi):>12}\n", "result")


def re_table(s: "Session", est: Estimates, lev: float) -> None:
    out = s.output
    L = est.lmm
    model, th, Vth = L["model"], L["theta"], L["Vth"]
    z = st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - lev / 100) / 2)
    sd = est.extra["sd"]
    out.write("\n" + "-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  Random-effects Parameters  |   Estimate   Std. Err.     [{lev:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 29 + "+" + "-" * 48 + "\n", "text")
    pieces, lnse = model.split(th)
    k = 0
    for lv, t in zip(L["levels"], pieces):
        npar = lv.npar()
        Vl = Vth[k:k + npar, k:k + npar]
        k += npar
        kind = {"identity": "Identity", "independent": "Independent", "exchangeable": "Exchangeable",
                "unstructured": "Unstructured"}[lv.cov]
        out.write(f"{lv.var + ': ' + kind:<29}|\n", "text")
        for row in _vc_rows(lv, t, Vl, sd, z):
            _re_row(out, *row)
        out.write("-" * 29 + "+" + "-" * 48 + "\n", "text")
    se_l = float(np.sqrt(max(Vth[-1, -1], 0)))
    if sd:
        v = math.exp(lnse)
        se = v * se_l
        _re_row(out, "sd(Residual)", v, se, v * math.exp(-z * se_l), v * math.exp(z * se_l))
    else:
        v = math.exp(2 * lnse)
        se = 2 * v * se_l
        _re_row(out, "var(Residual)", v, se, v * math.exp(-2 * z * se_l), v * math.exp(2 * z * se_l))
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")

def _predict_mixed(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    from .postest import xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ("" if stat else "(option xb assumed)")   # VERIFY
    L = est.lmm
    model, th = L["model"], L["theta"]
    b = L["beta"]
    ds = s.data
    rows = np.nonzero(L["mask"])[0]
    u = model.blups(th, b)
    fitted = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
    for cl, uc in zip(model.clusters, u):
        zu = cl.Z @ uc
        fitted[rows[cl.rows]] = model.X[cl.rows] @ b + zu
    if stat == "fitted":
        return fitted, ""
    yv = ds.get(est.depvar).data.astype(float)
    if stat in ("residuals", "rstandard"):
        r = np.where(fitted < SYS, yv - fitted, SYS)
        if stat == "rstandard":
            _, lnse = model.split(th)
            r = np.where(r < SYS, r / math.exp(lnse), SYS)
        return r, ""
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")


def _reffects(s: "Session", est: Estimates):
    """predict newvarlist, reffects: one variable per random effect, from the highest level
    down and, within a level, in the order of e(revars) ([ME] mixed postestimation)."""
    L = est.lmm
    model, th, b = L["model"], L["theta"], L["beta"]
    nreq = sum(lv.q for lv in model.levels)

    def fn(mask):
        ds = s.data
        rows = np.nonzero(L["mask"])[0]
        u = model.blups(th, b)
        out = [np.full(ds.nobs, SYS) for _ in range(nreq)]
        offs = np.cumsum([0] + [lv.q for lv in model.levels])
        for cl, uc in zip(model.clusters, u):
            k = 0
            for li, copies in cl.blocks:
                lv = model.levels[li]
                q = lv.q
                gids = np.unique(lv.gid[cl.rows])
                for c in range(copies):
                    m = lv.gid[cl.rows] == gids[c]
                    if lv.rep > 1:      # R.factor: the effect of the level of each observation
                        out[offs[li]][rows[cl.rows[m]]] = uc[k + lv.fcode[cl.rows[m]]]
                        k += lv.rep
                        continue
                    for j in range(q):
                        out[offs[li] + j][rows[cl.rows[m]]] = uc[k + j]
                    k += q
        return out
    return nreq, fn


def estat_icc(s: "Session", est: Estimates, rest: str) -> None:
    """Intraclass correlations: for level l, the share of the total variance of the random
    intercepts at l and above ([ME] estat icc). Only random-intercept models."""
    out = s.output
    L = getattr(est, "lmm", None)
    lev = est.level
    z = st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - lev / 100) / 2)
    if L is not None:
        model, th, Vth = L["model"], L["theta"], L["Vth"]
        levels = L["levels"]
        resid = lambda t: math.exp(2 * t[-1])   # noqa: E731
    else:
        model = None
        levels = est.glmm["levels"]
        th, Vth = est.glmm["theta"], est.glmm["Vth"]
        resid = lambda t: est.glmm["resid_var"]   # noqa: E731
    # with covariates in the fixed part the correlation is conditional on them (compat 1001)
    has_cov = any(c.values is not None for c in (est.cols or []))
    title = "Residual intraclass correlation" if has_cov else "Intraclass correlation"
    if L is None and (est.glmm["resid_var"] is None or not getattr(est, "icc_ok", True)):
        raise StataError(321, "requested action not valid after most recent estimation command")   # compat 1902
    if L is not None and any(lv.var == "_all" for lv in levels):
        raise StataError(321, "estat icc not allowed after crossed-effects models")   # compat 1902
    if any(lv.q != 1 or lv.names[0] != "_cons" for lv in levels):
        raise StataError(498, "estat icc is available only for random-intercept models")   # VERIFY
    out.write(f"\n{title}\n\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Level':>28} |        ICC   Std. Err.     [{lev:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 29 + "+" + "-" * 48 + "\n", "text")
    nl = len(levels)
    res = {}
    for k in range(nl):
        def icc(t, k=k):
            v = [math.exp(2 * t[i]) for i in range(nl)]
            return sum(v[:k + 1]) / (sum(v) + resid(t))
        f0 = icc(th)
        J = np.zeros(th.size)
        for i in range(th.size):
            e = np.zeros(th.size)
            e[i] = 1e-6
            J[i] = (icc(th + e) - icc(th - e)) / 2e-6
        se = float(np.sqrt(max(J @ Vth @ J, 0)))
        lg = math.log(f0 / (1 - f0))
        lse = se / (f0 * (1 - f0))
        lo, hi = 1 / (1 + math.exp(-(lg - z * lse))), 1 / (1 + math.exp(-(lg + z * lse)))
        # the innermost level first: class|school (compat 1001)
        lab = "|".join(lv.var for lv in reversed(levels[:k + 1]))
        _re_row(out, lab, f0, se, lo, hi)
        res[k] = (f0, se)
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    s.r = {"icc2": res[0][0]} if nl == 1 else {f"icc{k + 2}": v[0] for k, v in res.items()}
    del model

"""Likelihood maximization in Stata's style ([R] maximize, [R] ml).

Newton-Raphson with the step observed in Mata's optimize() (compat 0406):
if the full step improves, it advances in increments of 1/8, 1/4, 1/2...
while it improves; if it gets worse, it halves ("backed up"). Convergence:
(mreldif(b) < tolerance or reldif(ll) < ltolerance) and g H⁻¹ g' < nrtolerance.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable

import numpy as np

from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value


@dataclass
class MLResult:
    b: np.ndarray
    ll: float
    g: np.ndarray
    H: np.ndarray
    iterations: int
    converged: bool
    log: list[tuple[int, float, str]] = field(default_factory=list)


def _g10(x: float) -> str:
    return format_value(x, "%10.0g", pad=False).strip()


def maximize(fun: Callable[[np.ndarray, int], tuple], b0: np.ndarray, *, maxiter: int = 16000,
             tol: float = 1e-6, ltol: float = 1e-7, nrtol: float = 1e-5, start_iter: int = 0,
             first_ll: float | None = None, stop_at_zero: bool = False,
             nr_stop: float | None = None) -> MLResult:
    """fun(b, todo) -> (ll, g, H) with todo 0 (ll only) or 2 (ll, g and H).
    Returns the iterations for the log ("Iteration k:   log likelihood = ...")."""
    b = np.asarray(b0, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    ll, g, H = fun(b, 2)
    if not np.isfinite(ll):
        raise StataError(430, "initial values not feasible")   # VERIFY
    log: list[tuple[int, float, str]] = []
    it = start_iter
    converged = False
    k = b.size
    # already at the maximum (e.g. gaussian glm from IRLS): Stata stops at iteration 0 (compat
    # 0509)
    if stop_at_zero and k and np.all(np.abs(g) <= 1e-9 * (1 + abs(ll))):
        log.append((it, ll, ""))
        return MLResult(b, ll, g, H, it, True, log)
    while True:
        concave = True
        try:
            np.linalg.cholesky(-H)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            concave = False
        Hm = H
        if not concave:
            # non-concave Hessian: adds a multiple of the identity (VERIFY: Stata uses a
            # combination of gradient and modified Hessian)
            lam = max(1e-8, float(np.max(np.linalg.eigvalsh(H))) * 1.1 + 1e-6)
            Hm = H - lam * np.eye(k)
        log.append((it, ll, "  (not concave)" if not concave else ""))
        if it - start_iter >= maxiter:
            break
        step = -np.linalg.solve(Hm, g) if k else np.zeros(0)
        t = 1.0
        backed = False
        for _ in range(60):
            bn = b + t * step
            fn = fun(bn, 0)[0]
            if np.isfinite(fn) and fn >= ll - 1e-12 * max(1.0, abs(ll)):
                break
            t /= 2
            backed = True
        else:
            break
        if t == 1.0 and fn > ll:
            inc = 0.125
            for _ in range(60):
                bt = b + (t + inc) * step
                ft = fun(bt, 0)[0]
                if not (np.isfinite(ft) and ft > fn):
                    break
                t, bn, fn = t + inc, bt, ft
                inc *= 2
        # one halving of the step is not flagged (compat 1912: Stata's iteration 1 is the half
        # step, without "(backed up)"; VERIFY: Stata's exact rule)
        if backed and t < 0.5:
            log[-1] = (log[-1][0], log[-1][1], log[-1][2] + "  (backed up)")
        dp = float(np.max(np.abs(bn - b) / (np.abs(b) + 1))) if k else 0.0
        dv = abs(fn - ll) / (abs(ll) + 1)
        b = bn
        ll, g, H = fun(b, 2)
        it += 1
        try:
            nr = float(abs(g @ np.linalg.solve(H, g))) if k else 0.0
            np.linalg.cholesky(-H)
            concave_now = True
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            nr, concave_now = np.inf, False
        # nr_stop: the iteration is final when g H^-1 g' falls below it, whatever the change since
        # the previous iteration (stcox; compat 0902)
        if ((dp < tol or dv < ltol) and nr < nrtol or nr_stop is not None and nr < nr_stop) \
                and concave_now:
            converged = True
            log.append((it, ll, ""))
            break
    res = MLResult(b, ll, g, H, it, converged, log)
    if converged and k:
        from .numerics import precise
        if precise():
            refine(fun, res)      # set numerics precise
    return res


def refine(fun, res: MLResult, steps: int = 5) -> None:
    """Newton steps outside the iteration log, while the log likelihood does not fall and the
    gradient keeps shrinking: they take b to the exact maximum (set numerics precise; stcox's
    "Refining estimates")."""
    for _ in range(steps):
        try:
            bn = res.b - np.linalg.solve(res.H, res.g)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return
        lln, gn, Hn = fun(bn, 2)
        if not np.isfinite(lln) or lln < res.ll - 1e-12 * max(1.0, abs(res.ll)) or \
                np.linalg.norm(gn) >= np.linalg.norm(res.g):
            return
        res.b, res.ll, res.g, res.H = bn, lln, gn, Hn


def options(o: dict, maxiter: int = 16000) -> dict:
    """maximize() keywords from the iterate(), tolerance(), ltolerance() and nrtolerance()
    options ([R] maximize), with Stata's defaults."""
    return dict(maxiter=int(o["iterate"]) if o.get("iterate") else maxiter,
                tol=float(o["tolerance"]) if o.get("tolerance") else 1e-6,
                ltol=float(o["ltolerance"]) if o.get("ltolerance") else 1e-7,
                nrtol=float(o["nrtolerance"]) if o.get("nrtolerance") else 1e-5)


def maximize_switching(llf: Callable[[np.ndarray], float], scores: Callable[[np.ndarray], np.ndarray],
                       b0: np.ndarray, *, plan=(("bhhh", 5), ("bfgs", 10)), maxiter: int = 16000,
                       tol: float = 1e-6, ltol: float = 1e-7, nrtol: float = 1e-5) -> MLResult:
    """technique(bhhh 5 bfgs 10), the default of arima ([R] maximize): BHHH steps with the outer
    product of the scores, then BFGS updates, alternating until convergence. The log carries the
    "(setting optimization to ...)" and "(switching optimization to ...)" lines as notes with
    iteration number -1. VERIFY: Stata's step-size rules are undocumented; the maximum is the same
    but the iteration values may differ."""
    b = np.asarray(b0, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    k = b.size
    ll = llf(b)
    if not np.isfinite(ll):
        raise StataError(430, "initial values not feasible")   # VERIFY

    def grad(x):
        S_ = scores(x)
        return S_.sum(axis=0), S_

    g, S = grad(b)
    log: list[tuple[int, float, str]] = []
    it = 0
    converged = False
    stage = 0
    tech, left = plan[0]
    log.append((-1, 0.0, f"(setting optimization to {tech.upper()})"))
    W = None            # BFGS approximation of the inverse of -H
    stalled = 0
    while True:
        log.append((it, ll, ""))
        if it >= maxiter:
            break
        if tech == "bhhh" or W is None:
            B = S.T @ S
            try:
                W = np.linalg.inv(B)
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                W = np.linalg.pinv(B)
        step = W @ g
        t = 1.0
        backed = False
        for _ in range(60):
            bn = b + t * step
            fn = llf(bn)
            if np.isfinite(fn) and fn >= ll - 1e-12 * max(1.0, abs(ll)):
                break
            t /= 2
            backed = True
        else:
            break
        if backed:
            log[-1] = (log[-1][0], log[-1][1], "  (backed up)")
        gn, Sn = grad(bn)
        dp = float(np.max(np.abs(bn - b) / (np.abs(b) + 1))) if k else 0.0
        dv = abs(fn - ll) / (abs(ll) + 1)
        if tech == "bfgs":
            sv, yv = bn - b, -(gn - g)          # y: change of the gradient of -ll
            sy = float(sv @ yv)
            if sy > 1e-12:
                rho = 1.0 / sy
                I = np.eye(k)
                W = (I - rho * np.outer(sv, yv)) @ W @ (I - rho * np.outer(yv, sv)) + rho * np.outer(sv, sv)
        b, ll, g, S = bn, fn, gn, Sn
        it += 1
        left -= 1
        stalled = stalled + 1 if dv < 1e-13 else 0
        if stalled >= 25:
            break               # no progress at all (an optimum on the boundary of the parameter space)
        if left == 0:
            # the switch is announced before the next iteration, even when that iteration is the
            # last one (compat 1101)
            stage = (stage + 1) % len(plan)
            tech, left = plan[stage]
            log.append((-1, 0.0, f"(switching optimization to {tech.upper()})"))
        if tech == "bhhh":
            B = S.T @ S
            try:
                nr = float(g @ np.linalg.solve(B, g))
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                nr = np.inf
        else:
            nr = float(g @ W @ g)
        if (dp < tol or dv < ltol) and abs(nr) < nrtol:
            converged = True
            log.append((it, ll, ""))
            break
    return MLResult(b, ll, g, np.zeros((k, k)), it, converged, log)


def print_log(out, res: MLResult, label: str = "log likelihood") -> None:
    for it, ll, note in res.log:
        if it < 0:
            out.write(note + "\n", "text")
            continue
        lead = f"Iteration {it}:"
        out.write(f"{lead:<14} {label} = {_g10(ll):>10}{note}  \n", "text")
    if not res.converged and res.log:
        out.write("convergence not achieved\n", "error")


def ilog(res: MLResult) -> np.ndarray:
    """e(ilog): log likelihood of the first 20 iterations (zeros afterward)."""
    v = np.zeros((1, 20))
    vals = [ll for it, ll, _ in res.log if it >= 0][:20]
    v[0, :len(vals)] = vals
    return v

"""Engine for maximum-likelihood models with several linear indexes (equations) and ancillary
parameters: zip, hetprobit, heckman, biprobit... ([R] ml).

A model gives `lik(etas, theta) -> (ll_obs, [d ll / d eta_j], d ll / d theta (n x a) or None)`
(see likelihoods.py). `Engine` builds the weighted log likelihood, its score and Hessian over the
stacked parameters [beta_1, ..., beta_m, theta]; `Block` is one equation (its columns, which
include factor variables, and its constant); `assemble` lays out e(b), e(V) and the table rows
the way Stata shows several equations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from . import fvars
from .models2 import _header, g, num_hess
from .results import CoefRow, crit, coef_table, rows_from_columns

SYS = M.SYSMISS


@dataclass
class Block:
    """One equation: columns of its varlist (free ones form X), constant and offset."""
    name: str
    cols: list
    terms: list
    constant: bool
    X: np.ndarray
    offset: np.ndarray | None = None
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)
    off_name: str = ""

    @property
    def k(self) -> int:
        return self.X.shape[1]

    @property
    def nslopes(self) -> int:
        return self.k - (1 if self.constant else 0)


def block_from_pr(pr, name: str) -> Block:
    """The main equation of a `_Prep`: its columns plus the constant."""
    n = pr.smp.n
    X = np.column_stack([pr.X, np.ones(n)]) if pr.constant else pr.X
    return Block(name, pr.smp.cols, pr.smp.terms, pr.constant, X)


def block_from_text(pr, name: str, text: str, constant: bool = True) -> Block:
    """An extra equation from a varlist (factor variables allowed), on the sample of `pr`."""
    ds = pr.s.data
    mask = pr.smp.mask
    with fvars.caching():
        terms = fvars.expand_fv(ds, text) if text.strip() else []
        cols = fvars.build_design(ds, terms, mask, constant=constant)
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear(cols, constant, pr.w)
    free = [c.values for c in cols if c.values is not None]
    n = pr.smp.n
    parts = free + ([np.ones(n)] if constant else [])
    X = np.column_stack(parts) if parts else np.zeros((n, 0))
    return Block(name, cols, terms, constant, X, notes=notes)


def constant_only(blk: Block) -> Block:
    n = blk.X.shape[0]
    return Block(blk.name, [], [], True, np.ones((n, 1)), blk.offset)


class Engine:
    """Weighted log likelihood over [beta_1 ... beta_m, theta]."""

    def __init__(self, lik: Callable, blocks: list[Block], w: np.ndarray, n_theta: int = 0):
        self.lik = lik
        self.blocks = blocks
        self.w = w
        self.n_theta = n_theta
        self.ks = [b.k for b in blocks]
        self.offs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(self.ks)]).astype(int)
        self.K = int(self.offs[-1]) + n_theta

    def split(self, b: np.ndarray):
        etas = []
        for j, blk in enumerate(self.blocks):
            e = blk.X @ b[self.offs[j]:self.offs[j + 1]]
            if blk.offset is not None:
                e = e + blk.offset
            etas.append(e)
        return etas, b[self.offs[-1]:]

    def ll_obs(self, b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        etas, th = self.split(b)
        return self.lik(etas, th)[0]

    def scores(self, b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        etas, th = self.split(b)
        _, d_eta, d_th = self.lik(etas, th)
        cols = [blk.X * d[:, None] for blk, d in zip(self.blocks, d_eta)]
        if self.n_theta:
            cols.append(np.asarray(d_th).reshape(len(d_eta[0]), self.n_theta))
        return np.column_stack(cols)

    def grad(self, b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.scores(b).T @ self.w

    def fun(self, b: np.ndarray, todo: int):
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            ll = float(self.w @ self.ll_obs(b))
            if not np.isfinite(ll):
                return -np.inf, None, None
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            gr = self.grad(b)
            if not np.all(np.isfinite(gr)):
                return -np.inf, None, None
            return ll, gr, num_hess(self.grad, b)


def add_base_row(est, label: str, text: str, before: str | None = None) -> None:
    """The row `label |  text` of the base alternative/outcome, between two equation blocks: ahead
    of the block named `before`, or after the last coefficient block when there is none."""
    old = est.rows_fn

    def with_base(level: float):
        rows = list(old(level))
        i = len(rows)
        for k, r in enumerate(rows):
            if before is not None and r.kind == "eq" and r.label == before:
                i = k - 1
                break
        rows[i:i] = [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("eq", label, eq=text)]
        return rows

    est.rows_fn = with_base
    est.rows = with_base(est.level)


def aux_row(label: str, value: float, se: float, level: float, *, ci=None, name: str = "_cons"):
    """Row of an ancillary parameter (/athrho, rho...). An estimated parameter (`ci` None) has z and
    P>|z|; one derived by a transformation (`ci` = (lo, hi), from the estimate's own interval)
    has neither."""
    if ci is None:
        return CoefRow("coef", label, value, se, name=name, noeform=True)
    r = CoefRow("aux", label, value, se, name=name)
    r.eq = f"{float(ci[0])!r} {float(ci[1])!r}"
    return r


def transformed_row(label: str, f: Callable, df_: Callable, b: float, se: float, level: float):
    """Row for f(b) with delta-method standard error and the interval of b transformed."""
    c = crit("z", level, None)
    return aux_row(label, float(f(b)), float(abs(df_(b)) * se), level,
                   ci=(float(f(b - c * se)), float(f(b + c * se))))


def assemble(pr, blocks: list[Block], b: np.ndarray, V: np.ndarray, aux_names: list[tuple[str, str]],
             *, heads: bool | None = None):
    """Names, equation names, e(b), e(V) and the table rows of the coefficient blocks. `aux_names`
    = [(equation, name)] for the ancillary parameters at the end of b (in e(b) they come after
    the blocks). `heads`: write an equation header before each block (default: when there is more
    than one). The rows of the ancillary parameters are left to the caller."""
    ds = pr.s.data
    names, eqs, layout, rows = [], [], [], []
    start = 0
    pos_all: list[int] = []
    heads = len(blocks) > 1 if heads is None else heads
    for j, blk in enumerate(blocks):
        bmap, semap = {}, {}
        slot = start
        for c in blk.cols:
            nm = c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name)
            names.append(nm)
            eqs.append(blk.name)
            if c.values is not None:
                layout.append((nm, True))
                pos_all.append(slot)
                bmap[c.name] = float(b[slot])
                semap[c.name] = float(np.sqrt(max(V[slot, slot], 0)))
                slot += 1
            else:
                layout.append((nm, False))
                bmap[c.name], semap[c.name] = 0.0, 0.0
        if blk.constant:
            names.append("_cons")
            eqs.append(blk.name)
            layout.append(("_cons", True))
            pos_all.append(slot)
            bmap["_cons"] = float(b[slot])
            semap["_cons"] = float(np.sqrt(max(V[slot, slot], 0)))
            slot += 1
        if heads:
            if j:
                rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
            rows.append(CoefRow("eq", blk.name))
        rows.extend(rows_from_columns(blk.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=blk.constant))
        if getattr(blk, "off_name", ""):
            kind = "exposure" if blk.off_name.startswith("ln(") else "offset"
            rows.append(CoefRow("fixed", blk.off_name, eq=f"({kind})"))
        start += blk.k
    for eq, nm in aux_names:
        names.append(nm)
        eqs.append(eq)
        layout.append((nm, True))
        pos_all.append(start)
        start += 1
    kk = len(names)
    b_full = np.zeros(kk)
    V_full = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    sel = [i for i, (_, free) in enumerate(layout) if free]
    b_full[sel] = b[pos_all]
    V_full[np.ix_(sel, sel)] = V[np.ix_(pos_all, pos_all)]
    return names, eqs, b_full, V_full, rows


def read_constraints(s, pr, blocks: list[Block], aux_names: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
    """constraints(numlist): the constraints read against the names of e(b) and turned into the
    transformation b = T bc + a of the free parameters, kept on `pr` (pr.cns) for its maximize
    and vce; pr.cns_C is e(Cns) and pr.cns_names the names it is read against."""
    numlist = pr.o.get("constraints")
    if numlist in (None, True, False):
        return
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    from ..core.constraints import constraint_transform
    from ..core.errors import StataError
    from .postest import _constraint
    from .sysmodels import _constraints, _numlist
    K = sum(blk.k for blk in blocks) + len(aux_names)
    names, eqs, *_ = assemble(pr, blocks, np.zeros(K), np.zeros((K, K)), aux_names)
    free = []
    pos = 0
    for blk in blocks:
        for c in blk.cols:
            if c.values is not None:
                free.append(pos)
            pos += 1
        if blk.constant:
            free.append(pos)
            pos += 1
    free += list(range(pos, pos + len(aux_names)))
    defined = _constraints(s)
    fake = SimpleNamespace(names=names, eqnames=eqs)
    rows = []
    for n in _numlist(str(numlist)):
        if n not in defined:
            raise StataError(111, f"constraint {n} not found")
        coef, rhs = _constraint(s, fake, defined[n])
        row = np.zeros(len(names) + 1)
        for j, v in coef.items():
            row[j] += v
        row[-1] = rhs
        rows.append(row)
    C = np.array(rows).reshape(-1, len(names) + 1)
    T, a = constraint_transform(np.column_stack([C[:, free], C[:, -1]]))
    pr.cns = (T, a.ravel())
    pr.cns_C = C
    pr.cns_names = (names, eqs)


def constraint_lines(est) -> list[str]:
    """' ( 1)  [y1]x1 - [y2]x1 = 0', one per row of e(Cns), as the table header lists them."""
    C = getattr(est, "cns_C", None)
    if C is None:
        return []
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    from .postest import _ctext
    names, eqs = est.cns_names
    fake = SimpleNamespace(names=names, eqnames=eqs)
    return [f" ({i:>2})  {_ctext(fake, {j: float(v) for j, v in enumerate(row[:-1]) if v != 0}, float(row[-1]))}"
            for i, row in enumerate(C, 1)]

    """Header (left lines, right pairs), table and footer of a model made with `Engine`."""
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        hd = est.hdr_fn(est)
        if callable(hd):
            hd(s)
        else:
            _header(s, *hd)
    if table:
        if est.vcetype and est.clustvar and getattr(est, "group_cluster", False):

        elif est.vcetype and est.clustvar:
            s.output.write(f"{'(Std. Err. adjusted for ' + format(int(est.n_clust), ',') + ' clusters in ' + est.clustvar + ')':>78}\n",

        lines = constraint_lines(est)

                 n_clust, ll0: float, aux_names: list[tuple[str, str]], aux_rows_fn: Callable,

_COMMON_OPTS = {"noconstant": 4, "level": 1, "vce": 3, "robust": 1, "cluster": 2, "nolog": 4, "log": 3,
                "iterate": 4, "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4, "nrtolerance": 4, "difficult": 4,

    head, tail = text.split(",", 1)

    return " ".join(t for t in texts if t and t.strip())

    """(offset array on the sample, label for e()/the table) from offset() or exposure()."""
    ds = pr.s.data
    if exp_opt:
        nm = str(exp_opt).strip()
        v = ds.get(nm).data[pr.smp.mask].astype(float)
        if np.any(v <= 0):
            from ..core.errors import StataError
            raise StataError(459, f"{nm} <= 0 in sample")   # VERIFY
        return np.log(v), f"ln({nm})"
    if off_opt:
        nm = str(off_opt).strip()
        return ds.get(nm).data[pr.smp.mask].astype(float), nm

def _block_columns(s, blk):
    """Yields (position in the block's free coefficients, column for all observations)."""
    ds = s.data
    n = ds.nobs
    for c in blk.cols:
        if c.values is None:
            continue
        t = blk.terms[c.term]
        col = np.ones(n)
        kk = 0
        for comp in t.comps:
            x = fvars.comp_values(ds, comp)
            if comp.factor:
                col = col * (x == c.cell[kk])
                kk += 1
            else:
                col = col * np.where(x < SYS, x, 0.0)
        yield c, col


def block_index(s, est, j: int):
    """Linear index of equation j for all observations (offset included) and the mask of
    observations where its variables are not missing."""
    ds = s.data
    blk = est.blocks[j]
    pos = sum(len(b.cols) + (1 if b.constant else 0) for b in est.blocks[:j])
    eta = np.zeros(ds.nobs)
    with fvars.caching():
        ok = ~fvars.term_missing(ds, blk.terms) if blk.terms else np.ones(ds.nobs, bool)
        idx = {id(c): i for i, c in enumerate(blk.cols)}
        for c, col in _block_columns(s, blk):
            bj = est.b[pos + idx[id(c)]]
            if bj != 0:
                eta += bj * col
        if blk.constant:
            eta += est.b[pos + len(blk.cols)]
    if getattr(blk, "off_name", ""):
        nm = blk.off_name
        if nm.startswith("ln("):
            v = ds.get(nm[3:-1]).data
            eta += np.where(v < SYS, np.log(np.where(v > 0, v, 1)), 0.0)
        else:
            v = ds.get(nm).data
            eta += np.where(v < SYS, v, 0.0)
    return eta, ok


def make_predict(fn: Callable, default: str = ""):
    """predict for a model made with Engine. fn(stat, etas, theta, est) returns the values for
    `stat` or None when the statistic is not available; stat "" is replaced by `default` with
    Stata's note."""
    from ..core.errors import StataError

    def predict(s, est, stat, mask):
        idxs = [block_index(s, est, j) for j in range(len(est.blocks))]
        ok = np.all([o for _, o in idxs], axis=0)
        etas = [e for e, _ in idxs]
        th = est.b[est.n_coef:] if hasattr(est, "n_coef") else np.zeros(0)
        what = stat or default
        if what == "xb":
            vals, note = etas[0], ""
        else:
            vals = fn(what, etas, th, est)
            note = f"(option {what} assumed; predicted {est.pred_label})" if not stat and getattr(est, "pred_label", "") else ""
            if vals is None:
                raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")
        return np.where(ok, vals, SYS), note
    return predict

"""The tools of ml evaluators ([R] ml, [P] mleval, [P] mlsum): mleval, mlsum, mlvecsum and
mlmatsum, which programs of method d0, d1 and d2 call to build the likelihood and its
derivatives."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options
from .mlmodel import Eq, Model, _full, _mats

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _tool_split(args: str, opts: dict):
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    body, opt = (args, "") if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
    return body, (match_options(opt, opts) if opt.strip() else {})


def _eq_index(m: Model, v) -> int:
    k = int(v) if isinstance(v, str) else 1
    if not 1 <= k <= m.K:
        raise StataError(198, f"equation {k} not found")
    return k - 1


def cmd_mleval(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    body, o = _tool_split(args, {"eq": 2, "scalar": 6})
    m = getattr(s, "_ml_active", None)
    if m is None:
        raise StataError(198, "mleval can only be used within an ml evaluator")
    mm = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\S+?)\s*=\s*(\S+)\s*", body)
    if not mm:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    new, bname = mm.groups()
    e = m.eqs[_eq_index(m, o.get("eq"))]
    bvec = np.asarray(_mats(s)[bname].data, dtype=float).ravel()
    coef = bvec[e.start:e.start + e.k]
    if o.get("scalar"):
        s.scalars[new] = float(coef[-1] if e.cons else 0.0)
        return
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    xb = e.X @ coef + e.off
    full = _full(m, xb, s.data.nobs)
    if s.data.has(new):
        s.data.get(new).data = full
    else:
        s.data.add(Variable(new, "double", full))


def _expr(s: "Session", m: Model, text: str):
    mm = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(.+?)\s*", text)
    body, _, ifp = mm.group(1).partition(" if ")
    from ..commands._util import eval_vector
    v = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, body), dtype=float), (s.data.nobs,))
    sel = m.touse.copy()
    if ifp.strip():
        from ..lang.vexpr import truth
        t = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(truth(eval_vector(s, ifp)), dtype=bool), (s.data.nobs,))
        sel &= t
    return v, sel


def cmd_mlsum(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    body, o = _tool_split(args, {"noweight": 3})
    m = getattr(s, "_ml_active", None)
    if m is None:
        raise StataError(198, "mlsum can only be used within an ml evaluator")
    name, eq_sign, expr = body.partition("=")
    if not eq_sign:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    v, sel = _expr(s, m, expr)
    x = v[sel]
    if np.any(x >= SYS):
        s.scalars[name.strip()] = SYS
        return
    wfull = np.ones(s.data.nobs)
    if m.w is not None and not o.get("noweight"):
        wfull = np.zeros(s.data.nobs)
        wfull[m.touse] = m.w
    s.scalars[name.strip()] = float((x * wfull[sel]).sum())


def _x_full(m: Model, e: Eq, nobs: int) -> np.ndarray:
    X = np.zeros((nobs, e.k))
    X[m.touse] = e.X
    return X


def cmd_mlvecsum(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    body, o = _tool_split(args, {"eq": 2})
    m = getattr(s, "_ml_active", None)
    if m is None:
        raise StataError(198, "mlvecsum can only be used within an ml evaluator")
    left, eq_sign, expr = body.partition("=")
    names = left.split()
    if len(names) != 2 or not eq_sign:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    lnf, vec = names
    e = m.eqs[_eq_index(m, o.get("eq"))]
    v, sel = _expr(s, m, expr)
    x = v[sel]
    if np.any(x >= SYS):
        s.scalars[lnf] = SYS
        return
    wfull = np.ones(s.data.nobs)
    if m.w is not None:
        wfull = np.zeros(s.data.nobs)
        wfull[m.touse] = m.w
    X = _x_full(m, e, s.data.nobs)[sel]
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    row = (x * wfull[sel]) @ X
    _mats(s)[vec] = Matrix(row.reshape(1, -1), ["r1"],
                           [c for q, c in m.names if q == e.name])


def cmd_mlmatsum(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    body, o = _tool_split(args, {"eq": 2})
    m = getattr(s, "_ml_active", None)
    if m is None:
        raise StataError(198, "mlmatsum can only be used within an ml evaluator")
    left, eq_sign, expr = body.partition("=")
    names = left.split()
    if len(names) != 2 or not eq_sign:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    lnf, mat = names
    ev = o.get("eq")
    if isinstance(ev, str) and "," in ev:
        i1, i2 = (int(x) for x in ev.split(","))
    else:
        i1 = int(ev) if isinstance(ev, str) else 1
        i2 = i1
    e1, e2 = m.eqs[i1 - 1], m.eqs[i2 - 1]
    v, sel = _expr(s, m, expr)
    x = v[sel]
    if np.any(x >= SYS):
        s.scalars[lnf] = SYS
        return
    wfull = np.ones(s.data.nobs)
    if m.w is not None:
        wfull = np.zeros(s.data.nobs)
        wfull[m.touse] = m.w
    X1 = _x_full(m, e1, s.data.nobs)[sel]
    X2 = _x_full(m, e2, s.data.nobs)[sel]
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    _mats(s)[mat] = Matrix(X1.T @ (X2 * (x * wfull[sel])[:, None]),
                           [c for q, c in m.names if q == e1.name], [c for q, c in m.names if q == e2.name])

"""Maximum-likelihood models: logit, logistic, probit, poisson
([R] logit, [R] logistic, [R] probit, [R] poisson)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail as _chi2_tail
from ..lazy import lazy
from . import fvars
from . import likelihoods as L
from .vce import bread, sandwich
from .ml import maximize, print_log
from .ml import options as ml_options
from .regress import Sample, cmdline, comma, wexp_macros
from .results import CoefRow, Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
special = lazy("scipy.special")
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def g(x: float, fmt: str) -> str:
    if x is None or not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    return format_value(float(x), fmt, pad=False).strip()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# likelihoods: (ll, gradient, Hessian) and scores per observation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _logit(y, X, w):
    def fun(b, todo):
        xb = X @ b
        # stable ln F(xb) and ln(1 - F(xb))
        lp = -np.logaddexp(0, -xb)
        lq = -np.logaddexp(0, xb)
        ll = float(np.sum(w * np.where(y > 0, lp, lq)))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        p = special.expit(xb)
        r = (y > 0) - p
        gr = X.T @ (w * r)
        H = -(X * (w * p * (1 - p))[:, None]).T @ X
        return ll, gr, H

    def scores(b):
        p = special.expit(X @ b)
        return (y > 0) - p
    return fun, scores


def _probit(y, X, w):
    q = np.where(y > 0, 1.0, -1.0)

    def fun(b, todo):
        xb = X @ b
        ll = float(np.sum(w * st.norm.logcdf(q * xb)))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        lam = q * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(q * xb) - st.norm.logcdf(q * xb))
        gr = X.T @ (w * lam)
        H = -(X * (w * lam * (lam + xb))[:, None]).T @ X
        return ll, gr, H

    def scores(b):
        xb = X @ b
        return q * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(q * xb) - st.norm.logcdf(q * xb))
    return fun, scores


def _cloglog(y, X, w, offset):
    def fun(b, todo):
        xb = X @ b + offset
        ll_i, d = L.cloglog(y, xb)
        ll = float(np.sum(w * ll_i))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        gr = X.T @ (w * d)
        # d2/deta2 of ln P and ln (1 - P) with u = exp(eta): by differencing the analytic score
        h = 1e-5
        d2 = (L.cloglog(y, xb + h)[1] - L.cloglog(y, xb - h)[1]) / (2 * h)
        return ll, gr, (X * (w * d2)[:, None]).T @ X

    def scores(b):
        return L.cloglog(y, X @ b + offset)[1]
    return fun, scores


def _poisson(y, X, w, offset):
    lgy = special.gammaln(y + 1)

    def fun(b, todo):
        xb = X @ b + offset
        mu = np.exp(np.clip(xb, -700, 700))
        ll = float(np.sum(w * (-mu + y * xb - lgy)))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        gr = X.T @ (w * (y - mu))
        H = -(X * (w * mu)[:, None]).T @ X
        return ll, gr, H

    def scores(b):
        return y - np.exp(X @ b + offset)
    return fun, scores

_TITLES = {"logit": "Logistic regression", "logistic": "Logistic regression",

def _fit(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str) -> None:

    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):

               table: bool = True, level: float | None = None, **_kw) -> None:

        out.write("\n", "text")

def predict_ml(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    from .postest import design_all, xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    X = None
    if est.offset_name and stat not in ("xb_nooffset",):
        ds = s.data
        name = est.offset_name
        if name.startswith("ln("):
            v = ds.get(name[3:-1]).data
            off = np.where(v < SYS, np.log(np.where(v > 0, v, 1)), 0)
        else:
            v = ds.get(name).data
            off = np.where(v < SYS, v, 0)
        xb = xb + off
    note = ""
    cmd = est.ml_cmd
    if stat == "xb":
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ""
    if stat == "stdp":
        X, _ = design_all(s, est)
        sp = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", X, est.V, X), 0))
        return np.where(ok, sp, SYS), ""
    if cmd in ("logit", "logistic", "probit", "cloglog"):
        if stat in ("", "pr", "p"):
            if not stat:
                note = f"(option pr assumed; Pr({est.depvar}))"
            p = {"probit": st.norm.cdf, "cloglog": lambda z: 1 - np.exp(-np.exp(z))}.get(cmd, special.expit)(xb)
            return np.where(ok, p, SYS), note
    if cmd == "poisson":
        if stat in ("", "n"):
            if not stat:
                note = "(option n assumed; predicted number of events)"
            return np.where(ok, np.exp(xb), SYS), note
        if stat == "ir":
            xb0, _ = xb_all(s, est)
            return np.where(ok, np.exp(xb0), SYS), ""
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Callable

import numpy as np

from ..core.stats import chi2_tail as _chi2_tail

special = lazy("scipy.special")
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def g(x: float, fmt: str) -> str:
    if x is None or not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    return format_value(float(x), fmt, pad=False).strip()


def num_hess(grad: Callable[[np.ndarray], np.ndarray], b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Hessian by central differences of the analytic gradient, with Richardson
    extrapolation (truncation error O(h⁴))."""
    k = b.size
    H = np.zeros((k, k))
    for i in range(k):
        h = 1e-4 * (abs(b[i]) + 1)

        def D(hh, i=i):
            a, c = b.copy(), b.copy()
            a[i] += hh
            c[i] -= hh
            return (grad(a) - grad(c)) / (2 * hh)
        H[:, i] = (4 * D(h / 2) - D(h)) / 3
    return (H + H.T) / 2


class _Prep:
    """Sample, weights and columns of the independent variables (without a constant)."""

    def __init__(self, s: "Session", args: str, spec: dict[str, int], weights=("fweight", "iweight",
                 "pweight"), constant: bool | None = None, need_dep: bool = True,
                 extra_vars: str = "", restrict: np.ndarray | None = None):
        full = dict(spec)
        full.update({"nolog": 4, "log": 3, "iterate": 4, "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4,
                     "nrtolerance": 4, "difficult": 4, "technique": 4, "noheader": 6})
        smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec=full, weights=weights, need_dep=need_dep,
                     extra_vars=extra_vars, restrict=restrict)
        self.s = s
        self.smp = smp
        self.o = smp.o
        w = smp.w[smp.mask].astype(np.float64) if smp.w is not None else np.ones(smp.n)
        self.w = w
        self.N = float(w.sum()) if smp.wtype in ("fweight", "iweight") else float(smp.n)
        self.y = smp.y.astype(np.float64) if smp.y is not None else None
        self.constant = smp.constant if constant is None else constant
        self.notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, self.constant, w)
        self.est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
        self.X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in self.est_cols]) if self.est_cols \
            else np.zeros((smp.n, 0))
        self.robust = smp.vce in ("robust", "cluster")

    def write_notes(self, out) -> None:
        for nm in self.notes:
            out.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")

    def maximize(self, fun, b0):
        o = self.o
        cns = getattr(self, "cns", None)
        if cns is None:
            return maximize(fun, b0, **ml_options(o, maxiter=300))
        # constraints(): b = T bc + a, maximized over bc; res.H stays T' H T (see vce)
        T, a = cns

        def cfun(bc, todo):
            ll, g_, H = fun(T @ bc + a, todo)
            if g_ is None:
                return ll, g_, H
            return ll, T.T @ g_, (T.T @ H @ T if H is not None else None)
        r = maximize(cfun, T.T @ (np.asarray(b0, dtype=float) - a), **ml_options(o, maxiter=300))
        r.b = T @ r.b + a
        r.g = fun(r.b, 1)[1]
        return r

    def vce(self, H: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray | None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int | None]:
        """Model V (OIM) or the sandwich with the scores per observation (n x k)."""
        cns = getattr(self, "cns", None)
        if cns is not None and H.shape[0] == cns[0].shape[1]:
            V = cns[0] @ bread(H) @ cns[0].T
        else:
            V = bread(H)
        ctx = getattr(self.s, "_svy_ctx", None)
        if ctx is not None and scores is not None:
            # svy: linearized scores u = w s V carried to the design observations (zero outside the
            # sample/subpop), V = design variance
            sc = scores * self.w[:, None]
            Z = sc @ V
            dd = ctx["dd"]
            pos = ctx["pos"][np.flatnonzero(self.smp.mask)]
            Zf = np.zeros((dd.n, Z.shape[1]))
            Zf[pos] = Z
            ctx["Z"] = Zf
            Vs = dd.variance(Zf)
            return (Vs + Vs.T) / 2, None
        if not self.robust or scores is None:
            return V, None
        smp = self.smp
        return sandwich(V, scores, self.w, fweight=smp.wtype == "fweight", n=self.N,
                        clusters=smp.cluster if smp.vce == "cluster" else None)


def _header(s: "Session", left: list[str], right: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n", "text")
    n = max(len(left), len(right))
    left = left + [""] * (n - len(left))
    right = right + [("", "")] * (n - len(right))
    for lft, (rl, rv) in zip(left, right):
        if rl and rv is None:
            out.write(f"{lft:<48}{rl}\n", "text")
        elif rl:
            out.write(f"{lft:<48}{rl:<18}= ", "text")
            out.write(f"{rv:>10}\n", "result")
        else:
            out.write(lft + "\n", "text")

def _std_right(N: float, chi2type: str, df: int, chi2: float, p: float, r2p: float | None):

             ("Prob > chi2", g(p, "%10.4f"))]

def _model_test(pr: _Prep, b: np.ndarray, V: np.ndarray, idx: list[int], ll: float, ll0: float):
    if pr.robust:
        try:
            chi2 = float(b[idx] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(idx, idx)], b[idx])) if idx else 0.0

            j += 1
        else:
            bmap[c.name], semap[c.name] = 0.0, 0.0
        names.append(c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name))
    rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s_data(pr), constant=False)
    return names, rows


def s_data(pr: _Prep):
    return pr.smp.s.data


def _expand(pr: _Prep, b_est: np.ndarray, V_est: np.ndarray, layout: list[tuple[str, bool]]):
    """Places the estimated b/V (free columns only) at the positions of e(b), which includes
    bases and omitted terms with zero. `layout` = [(name, free?)]."""
    kk = len(layout)
    pos = [i for i, (_, free) in enumerate(layout) if free]
    b = np.zeros(kk)
    V = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    b[pos] = b_est
    V[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V_est
    return b, V

def _finish(s: "Session", pr: _Prep, cmd: str, args: str, *, title: str, names: list[str], eqnames,
            b: np.ndarray, V: np.ndarray, rows: list[CoefRow], res, ll0: float, df_m: int, chi2kind,
            chi2, p, r2p, display, n_clust, extra_scalars=(), extra_macros=(), k_eq=1, k_aux=0,
            depvar_name: str | None = None, constant: bool = False, mats=(), k_free=None,
            order: tuple | None = None) -> Estimates:
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    from .ml import ilog
    smp = pr.smp
    est = Estimates(cmd, depvar_name or smp.depname, names, b, V, smp.n, "z", None)
    est.rows = rows
    est.eqnames = list(eqnames)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, constant, smp.terms, getattr(smp, "depcomp", None)
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = "Robust" if pr.robust else ""
    est.clustvar = smp.clustvar
    est.n_clust = n_clust
    est.title = title
    est.robust = pr.robust
    est.extra = {"N": pr.N, "ll": res.ll, "ll_0": ll0, "chi2": chi2, "p": p, "df_m": df_m,
                 "r2_p": r2p, "chi2type": chi2kind}
    est.display = display
    est.ml_cmd = cmd
    sv = {"rank": float(np.linalg.matrix_rank(V)) if V.size else 0.0, "N": pr.N, "ic": float(res.iterations),
          "k": float(k_free if k_free is not None else len(names)), "k_eq": float(k_eq), "k_dv": 1.0,
          "converged": 1.0 if res.converged else 0.0, "rc": 0.0, "ll": res.ll, "k_eq_model": 1.0,
          "ll_0": ll0, "df_m": float(df_m), "chi2": chi2, "p": p}
    if n_clust is not None:
        sv["N_clust"] = float(n_clust)
    if r2p is not None:
        sv["r2_p"] = r2p
    if k_aux:
        sv["k_aux"] = float(k_aux)
    sv.update(dict(extra_scalars))
    mv = {"cmdline": cmdline(cmd, args), "cmd": cmd, "title": title, "chi2type": chi2kind,
          "vce": smp.vce if pr.robust else "oim", "depvar": smp.depname, "opt": "moptimize", "which": "max",
          "ml_method": "d2", "technique": "nr", "properties": "b V", "predict": f"{cmd}_p",
          "user": f"mopt__{cmd}_d2()"}
    if pr.robust:
        mv["vcetype"] = "Robust"
    if smp.clustvar:
        mv["clustvar"] = smp.clustvar
    mv.update(dict(wexp_macros(smp)))
    mv.update(dict(extra_macros))
    md = {"ilog": Matrix(ilog(res)), "gradient": Matrix(res.g.reshape(1, -1))}
    md.update(dict(mats))
    so, mo, xo = order or _E_ORDER.get(cmd, (list(sv), list(mv), list(md)))
    scalars = [(k_, sv[k_]) for k_ in so if k_ in sv]
    macros = [(k_, mv[k_]) for k_ in mo if k_ in mv]
    if order is None:
        # without an explicit order, what is not in the list goes to the end
        scalars += [(k_, v) for k_, v in sv.items() if k_ not in so]
        macros += [(k_, v) for k_, v in mv.items() if k_ not in mo]
    mlist = [(k_, md[k_]) for k_ in xo if k_ in md]
    if "Cns" in md and "Cns" not in xo:
        mlist.insert(0, ("Cns", md["Cns"]))   # constraints(): e(Cns) after e(V) (VERIFY)
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask, extra_mats=mlist)
    return est


def _log(s: "Session", pr: _Prep, res, label: str | None = None) -> None:
    if pr.o.get("nolog"):
        return
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n", "text")
    print_log(out, res, label or ("log pseudolikelihood" if pr.robust else "log likelihood"))


def _cluster_note(s, est) -> None:
    if est.vcetype and est.clustvar:
        s.output.write(f"{'(Std. Err. adjusted for ' + format(int(est.n_clust), ',') + ' clusters in ' + est.clustvar + ')':>78}\n",
                       "text")
