def _ordered(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return
    pr = _Prep(s, args, {"offset": 3}, constant=False)
    out = s.output
    pr.write_notes(out)
    y = pr.y
    levels = sorted(set(y.tolist()))
    if len(levels) < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "outcome does not vary")   # VERIFY
    if len(levels) > 50:
        raise StataError(149, f"{smp_name(pr)}:  too many outcomes")   # VERIFY
    J = len(levels)
    yi = np.searchsorted(levels, y)
    X, w = pr.X, pr.w
    k = X.shape[1]
    if cmd == "ologit":
        F = special.expit
        f = lambda z: special.expit(z) * (1 - special.expit(z))   # noqa: E731
        Finv = special.logit
    else:
        F = st.norm.cdf
        f = st.norm.pdf
        Finv = st.norm.ppf

    def probs(b):
        xb = X @ b[:k]
        cuts = b[k:]
        up = np.where(yi < J - 1, cuts[np.minimum(yi, J - 2)] - xb, np.inf)
        lo = np.where(yi > 0, cuts[np.maximum(yi - 1, 0)] - xb, -np.inf)
        return up, lo

    def ll_obs(b):
        up, lo = probs(b)
        p = F(up) - F(lo)
        return np.log(np.maximum(p, 1e-300))

    def scores(b):
        up, lo = probs(b)
        p = np.maximum(F(up) - F(lo), 1e-300)
        fu = np.where(np.isfinite(up), f(np.where(np.isfinite(up), up, 0)), 0.0)
        fl = np.where(np.isfinite(lo), f(np.where(np.isfinite(lo), lo, 0)), 0.0)
        S = np.zeros((len(y), k + J - 1))
        S[:, :k] = -((fu - fl) / p)[:, None] * X
        for j in range(J - 1):
            S[:, k + j] = np.where(yi == j, fu / p, 0.0) - np.where(yi == j + 1, fl / p, 0.0)
        return S

    def grad(b):
        return scores(b).T @ w

    def fun(b, todo):
        cuts = b[k:]
        if np.any(np.diff(cuts) <= 0):
            return -np.inf, None, None
        ll = float(w @ ll_obs(b))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        return ll, grad(b), num_hess(grad, b)

    cum = np.array([np.sum(w[yi <= j]) for j in range(J - 1)]) / w.sum()
    b0 = np.concatenate([np.zeros(k), Finv(cum)])
    ll0 = float(fun(b0, 0)[0])
    res = pr.maximize(fun, b0)
    _log(s, pr, res)
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    idx = list(range(k))
    kind, chi2, pv = _model_test(pr, res.b, V, idx, res.ll, ll0)
    r2p = 1 - res.ll / ll0 if ll0 else SYS
    names, rows = _slope_rows(pr, res.b, V)
    layout = [(nm, c.values is not None) for nm, c in zip(names, pr.smp.cols)]
    cutnames = [f"cut{j + 1}" for j in range(J - 1)]
    layout += [("_cons", True)] * (J - 1)
    b_full, V_full = _expand(pr, res.b, V, layout)
    eqs = [pr.smp.depname] * len(names) + cutnames
    rows = list(rows)
    rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    for j in range(J - 1):
        se = np.sqrt(V[k + j, k + j])
        rows.append(CoefRow("aux", f"/{cutnames[j]}", float(res.b[k + j]), float(se), name=f"cut{j + 1}"))
    title = "Ordered logistic regression" if cmd == "ologit" else "Ordered probit regression"
    est = _finish(s, pr, cmd, args, title=title, names=names + ["_cons"] * (J - 1), eqnames=eqs,
                  b=b_full, V=V_full, rows=rows, res=res, ll0=ll0, df_m=k, chi2kind=kind, chi2=chi2, p=pv,
                  r2p=r2p, display=_display_std, n_clust=n_clust, k_eq=J, k_aux=J - 1,
                  extra_scalars=[("k_cat", float(J)), ("N_cd", 0.0)],
                  extra_macros=[("marginsdefault", " ".join(f"predict(pr outcome({_lv(v)}))" for v in levels))],
                  mats=[("cat", _mat_row(levels))])
    est.cat = levels
    est.predict = _predict_ordered
    est.kslopes = k
    est.Fcdf = F
    _display_std(s, est)


def _lv(v: float) -> str:
    return f"{int(v)}" if v == int(v) else f"{v:g}"


def _mat_row(vals):
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    return Matrix(np.array(vals, dtype=float).reshape(1, -1))


def smp_name(pr):
    return pr.smp.depname


def _display_std(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
                 level: float | None = None, **_kw) -> None:
    x = est.extra
    if header:
        lab = "Log pseudolikelihood" if est.robust else "Log likelihood"
        left = [est.title, "", "", f"{lab} = {g(x['ll'], '%10.0g'):>10}"]
        if getattr(est, "dispersion", ""):
            # the label follows the width of "Log (pseudo)likelihood" (compat 0512)
            left[2] = f"{'Dispersion':<{len(lab) + 1}}= {est.dispersion}"
        r2p = x.get("r2_p")
        _header(s, left, _std_right(x["N"], x["chi2type"], int(x["df_m"]), x["chi2"], x["p"],
                                    r2p if r2p is not None else None))
    if table:
        _cluster_note(s, est)
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat=est.stat, df=est.df_r, level=level or est.level,
                   vcetype=est.vcetype, coef_title=getattr(est, "coef_title", "Coef."),
                   eform=getattr(est, "eform_on", False))
        foot = getattr(est, "footer", None)
        if foot:
            foot(s, est)


def _predict_ordered(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    from .postest import xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    if stat == "xb":
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ""
    if stat in ("", "pr", "p"):
        # without outcome(): the first category (VERIFY: Stata asks for one variable per category)
        k = est.kslopes
        cut1 = est.b[est.names.index("_cons", k)] if "_cons" in est.names else 0.0
        p = est.Fcdf(cut1 - xb)
        return np.where(ok, p, SYS), f"(option pr assumed; predicted probability)"   # VERIFY
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")

def cmd_mlogit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "mlogit", args)
        return
    pr = _Prep(s, args, {"baseoutcome": 2, "rrr": 3})
    out = s.output
    pr.write_notes(out)
    y = pr.y
    levels = sorted(set(y.tolist()))
    J = len(levels)
    if J < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "outcome does not vary")   # VERIFY
    w = pr.w
    yi = np.searchsorted(levels, y)
    freq = np.array([w[yi == j].sum() for j in range(J)])
    if pr.o.get("baseoutcome"):
        bv = float(str(pr.o["baseoutcome"]).strip().lstrip("#"))
        if str(pr.o["baseoutcome"]).strip().startswith("#"):
            base = int(bv) - 1
        else:
            if bv not in levels:
                raise StataError(198, "outcome not found")   # VERIFY
            base = levels.index(bv)
    else:
        base = int(np.argmax(freq))      # the most frequent category (the first one in case of a tie)
    X = np.column_stack([pr.X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else pr.X
    kx = X.shape[1]
    others = [j for j in range(J) if j != base]
    Y = np.zeros((len(y), J))
    Y[np.arange(len(y)), yi] = 1

    def P(b):
        B = b.reshape(len(others), kx)
        eta = np.zeros((len(y), J))
        for m, j in enumerate(others):
            eta[:, j] = X @ B[m]
        eta -= eta.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        e = np.exp(eta)
        return e / e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    def fun(b, todo):
        Pm = P(b)
        ll = float(w @ np.log(np.maximum(Pm[np.arange(len(y)), yi], 1e-300)))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        gr = np.concatenate([X.T @ (w * (Y[:, j] - Pm[:, j])) for j in others])
        H = np.zeros((b.size, b.size))
        for a, ja in enumerate(others):
            for c, jc in enumerate(others):
                wt = w * Pm[:, ja] * ((1.0 if ja == jc else 0.0) - Pm[:, jc])
                H[a * kx:(a + 1) * kx, c * kx:(c + 1) * kx] = -(X * wt[:, None]).T @ X
        return ll, gr, H

    def scores(b):
        Pm = P(b)
        return np.column_stack([X * (Y[:, j] - Pm[:, j])[:, None] for j in others])

    b0 = np.zeros(len(others) * kx)
    if pr.constant:
        for m, j in enumerate(others):
            b0[m * kx + kx - 1] = np.log(freq[j] / freq[base])
    ll0 = float(fun(b0, 0)[0]) if pr.constant else SYS
    res = pr.maximize(fun, b0)
    _log(s, pr, res)
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    slope_idx = [m * kx + i for m in range(len(others)) for i in range(kx - (1 if pr.constant else 0))]
    kind, chi2, pv = _model_test(pr, res.b, V, slope_idx, res.ll, ll0)
    r2p = 1 - res.ll / ll0 if ll0 < SYS and ll0 else None
    ds = s.data
    depv = ds.get(pr.smp.depcomp.var)
    vlab = ds.value_labels.get(depv.value_label, {}) if depv.value_label else {}

    def eqname(j):
        # labels with spaces become equation names with _ (compat 0508)
        lv = levels[j]
        return vlab.get(int(lv), f"{int(lv)}" if lv == int(lv) else f"{lv:g}").replace(" ", "_")
    # e(b) with all equations, including the base (zeros); table rows
    names_all, eqs_all, free = [], [], []
    rows: list[CoefRow] = []
    bvals, Vidx = [], []
    for j in range(J):
        if rows:
            rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        if j == base:
            rows.append(CoefRow("eq", eqname(j), eq="(base outcome)"))
        else:
            rows.append(CoefRow("eq", eqname(j)))
        m = others.index(j) if j != base else None
        slot = 0
        bmap, semap = {}, {}
        for c in pr.smp.cols:
            nm = c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name)
            if m is None and not c.omitted and not c.base:
                nm = fvars.omitted_name(c.name)       # base equation: o.x1
            names_all.append(nm)
            eqs_all.append(eqname(j))
            if c.values is not None and m is not None:
                Vidx.append(m * kx + slot)
                free.append(True)
                bmap[c.name] = res.b[m * kx + slot]
                semap[c.name] = np.sqrt(max(V[m * kx + slot, m * kx + slot], 0))
                slot += 1
            else:
                free.append(False)
                bmap[c.name], semap[c.name] = 0.0, 0.0
        if pr.constant:
            names_all.append("_cons" if m is not None else "o._cons")
            eqs_all.append(eqname(j))
            if m is not None:
                Vidx.append(m * kx + kx - 1)
                free.append(True)
                bmap["_cons"] = res.b[m * kx + kx - 1]
                semap["_cons"] = np.sqrt(max(V[m * kx + kx - 1, m * kx + kx - 1], 0))
            else:
                free.append(False)
        if m is not None:
            sub = rows_from_columns(pr.smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=pr.constant)
            for r in sub:
                r.eq = ""
            rows.extend(sub)
    kk = len(names_all)
    b_full = np.zeros(kk)
    V_full = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    pos = [i for i, f_ in enumerate(free) if f_]
    order = Vidx
    b_full[pos] = res.b[order]
    V_full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V[np.ix_(order, order)]
    est = _finish(s, pr, "mlogit", args, title="Multinomial logistic regression", names=names_all,
                  eqnames=eqs_all, b=b_full, V=V_full, rows=rows, res=res, ll0=ll0,
                  df_m=len(slope_idx), chi2kind=kind, chi2=chi2, p=pv, r2p=r2p, display=_display_std,
                  n_clust=n_clust, k_eq=J, k_free=len(res.b),
                  extra_scalars=[("k_out", float(J)), ("ibaseout", float(base + 1)),
                                 ("baseout", float(levels[base])), ("N_cd", 0.0), ("k_eq_model", float(J)),
                                 ("k_eq_base", float(base + 1))],
                  extra_macros=[("marginsdefault", " ".join(f"predict(pr outcome({_lv(v)}))" for v in levels)),
                                ("marginsnotok", "stdp stddp SCores"),
                                ("eqnames", " ".join(eqname(j) for j in range(J))),
                                ("baselab", eqname(base))],
                  mats=[("out", _mat_row(levels))])
    est.rows = rows
    if pr.o.get("rrr"):
        est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "RRR", True
    _display_std(s, est)
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "Coef.", False

def cmd_nbreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "nbreg", args)
        return
    pr = _Prep(s, args, {"dispersion": 4, "irr": 3, "exposure": 3, "offset": 3})
    disp = str(pr.o.get("dispersion") or "mean").strip().lower()
    if not ("mean".startswith(disp) or "constant".startswith(disp)):
        raise StataError(198, f"dispersion({disp}) invalid")   # VERIFY
    nb1 = "constant".startswith(disp)     # variance mu (1 + delta), ln delta in the last place
    out = s.output
    pr.write_notes(out)
    y = pr.y
    if np.any(y < 0) or np.any(y != np.trunc(y)):
        raise StataError(459, f"{pr.smp.depname} must be nonnegative integers")   # VERIFY
    ds = s.data
    off = np.zeros(len(y))
    if pr.o.get("exposure"):
        off = np.log(ds.get(str(pr.o["exposure"]).strip()).data[pr.smp.mask].astype(float))
    elif pr.o.get("offset"):
        off = ds.get(str(pr.o["offset"]).strip()).data[pr.smp.mask].astype(float)
    X = np.column_stack([pr.X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else pr.X
    kx = X.shape[1]
    w = pr.w
    lgy = special.gammaln(y + 1)

    def make(Xm):
        k = Xm.shape[1]

        def ll_obs(b):
            mu = np.exp(np.clip(Xm @ b[:k] + off, -700, 700))
            if nb1:
                return L._nb1_terms(y, mu, b[k])[0]
            m = np.exp(-b[k])
            return (special.gammaln(y + m) - special.gammaln(m) - lgy + m * np.log(m / (m + mu))
                    + y * np.log(mu / (m + mu)))

        def scores(b):
            mu = np.exp(np.clip(Xm @ b[:k] + off, -700, 700))
            if nb1:
                _ll, de, dd = L._nb1_terms(y, mu, b[k])
                return np.column_stack([Xm * de[:, None], dd])
            a = np.exp(b[k])
            m = 1 / a
            sx = (y - mu) / (1 + a * mu)
            dm = special.digamma(y + m) - special.digamma(m) + np.log(m / (m + mu)) + 1 - (m + y) / (m + mu)
            return np.column_stack([Xm * sx[:, None], -m * dm])

        def grad(b):
            return scores(b).T @ w

        def fun(b, todo):
            ll = float(w @ ll_obs(b))
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            return ll, grad(b), num_hess(grad, b)
        return fun, scores

    # 1) Poisson, 2) constant only, 3) full model (as Stata does)
    from .models import _poisson
    pfun, _ = _poisson(y, X, w, off)
    ybar = float(np.sum(w * y) / np.sum(w))
    # Poisson start: three IRLS steps from μ0 = (y + ȳ)/2, without a log. Gets close to what Stata
    # shows (compat 0512: iteration 0 = -245.31049, here -245.3105); the exact rule is undocumented
    # (VERIFY)
    mu0 = (y + ybar) / 2
    b0p = np.zeros(kx)
    for _ in range(3):
        eta0 = np.log(mu0)
        z = eta0 + (y - mu0) / mu0 - off
        sw = w * mu0
        b0p = np.linalg.lstsq(X * np.sqrt(sw)[:, None], z * np.sqrt(sw), rcond=None)[0]
        mu0 = np.exp(np.clip(X @ b0p + off, -700, 700))
    resp = pr.maximize(pfun, b0p)
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting Poisson model:\n", "text")
    _log(s, pr, resp)
    ll_pois = resp.ll
    fun0, _ = make(np.ones((len(y), 1)))
    b00 = np.array([np.log(np.sum(w * y) / np.sum(w * np.exp(off))), 0.0])
    res0 = pr.maximize(fun0, b00)
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting constant-only model:\n", "text")
    _log(s, pr, res0)
    fun, scores = make(X)
    b0 = np.concatenate([resp.b, [res0.b[1]]])
    if nb1:
        # dispersion(constant) starts from the constant-only fit (Stata's iteration 0 is ll_0;
        # compat 1918)
        b0 = np.concatenate([np.zeros(kx - 1), res0.b]) if pr.constant else b0
    res = pr.maximize(fun, b0)
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n", "text")
    _log(s, pr, res)
    # alpha at the boundary (very negative ln alpha): the likelihood is flat in ln alpha and Stata
    # ends with the Poisson coefficients and missing standard errors for /lnalpha and alpha (compat
    # 0602, svy: nbreg). Threshold VERIFY
    boundary = float(res.b[-1]) < -20
    if boundary:
        res.b[:kx] = resp.b
        H = np.array(fun(res.b, 2)[2], dtype=float)     # Hessian at the new point
        H[-1, :] = 0
        H[:, -1] = 0
        H[-1, -1] = -1.0
        res.H = H
    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    if boundary:
        V[-1, :] = 0
        V[:, -1] = 0
    slope = list(range(kx - (1 if pr.constant else 0)))
    kind, chi2, pv = _model_test(pr, res.b, V, slope, res.ll, res0.ll)
    r2p = 1 - res.ll / res0.ll
    names, rows = _slope_rows(pr, res.b, V)
    ds = s.data
    bmap = {}
    rows = rows_from_columns(pr.smp.cols, _bmap(pr, res.b, kx), _semap(pr, V, kx), ds,
                             constant=pr.constant)
    rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    lna, se_lna = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    c = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    alpha = np.exp(lna)
    an = "delta" if nb1 else "alpha"
    if boundary:
        rows.append(CoefRow("aux", f"/ln{an}", lna, SYS, name="_cons"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("aux", an, alpha, SYS))
    else:
        rows.append(CoefRow("aux", f"/ln{an}", lna, se_lna, name="_cons"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("aux", an, alpha, alpha * se_lna,
                            eq=f"{float(np.exp(lna - c * se_lna))!r} {float(np.exp(lna + c * se_lna))!r}"))
    layout = [(nm, cc.values is not None) for nm, cc in zip(names, pr.smp.cols)]
    if pr.constant:
        layout.append(("_cons", True))
        names = names + ["_cons"]
    layout.append(("_cons", True))
    b_full, V_full = _expand(pr, res.b, V, layout)
    eqs = [pr.smp.depname] * len(names) + [f"ln{an}"]
    chibar = max(2 * (res.ll - ll_pois), 0.0)
    p_chibar = 0.5 * float(_chi2_tail(chibar, 1)) if chibar > 0 else 0.5
    est = _finish(s, pr, "nbreg", args, title="Negative binomial regression", names=names + ["_cons"],
                  eqnames=eqs, b=b_full, V=V_full, rows=rows, res=res, ll0=res0.ll, df_m=len(slope),
                  chi2kind=kind, chi2=chi2, p=pv, r2p=r2p, display=_display_std, n_clust=n_clust, k_eq=2,
                  k_aux=1, extra_scalars=[(an, alpha), ("rank0", 2.0)]
                  + ([] if pr.robust else [("chi2_c", chibar), ("ll_c", ll_pois)]),
                  extra_macros=[("dispers", "constant" if nb1 else "mean"), ("chi2_ct", "LR"),
                                ("user", "nbreg_al" if nb1 else "nbreg_lf"),      # compat 1918
                                ("ml_method", "e2")], constant=pr.constant,
                  order=_E_ORDER["nbreg"])
    est.dispersion = "constant" if nb1 else "mean"
    est.chibar = (chibar, p_chibar)
    if not pr.robust:
        # with vce(robust) Stata does not show the LR test of alpha (compat 0512)
        est.footer = _nbreg_footer
    if pr.o.get("irr"):
        est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "IRR", True
    _display_std(s, est)
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = "Coef.", False


def chibar_text(chibar: float) -> str:
    """The chibar2 of the LR test of alpha (delta) = 0: %7.2f, and 0.0e+00 when the test is zero
    (the model at the boundary; compat 1907, 1918; VERIFY for small positive values)."""
    return f"{chibar:7.1e}" if chibar < 0.005 else f"{chibar:7.2f}"


def _bmap(pr, b, kx):
    bmap = {}
    j = 0
    for c in pr.smp.cols:
        if c.values is not None:
            bmap[c.name] = float(b[j])
            j += 1
        else:
            bmap[c.name] = 0.0
    if pr.constant:
        bmap["_cons"] = float(b[kx - 1])
    return bmap


def _semap(pr, V, kx):
    semap = {}
    j = 0
    for c in pr.smp.cols:
        if c.values is not None:
            semap[c.name] = float(np.sqrt(max(V[j, j], 0)))
            j += 1
        else:
            semap[c.name] = 0.0
    if pr.constant:
        semap["_cons"] = float(np.sqrt(max(V[kx - 1, kx - 1], 0)))
    return semap


def _nbreg_footer(s: "Session", est: Estimates) -> None:
    chibar, p = est.chibar
    an = "delta" if getattr(est, "dispersion", "mean") == "constant" else "alpha"
    s.output.write(f"Likelihood-ratio test of {an}=0:  chibar2(01) = {chibar_text(chibar)} Prob>=chibar2 = {p:5.3f}\n",
                   "text")

def cmd_tobit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "tobit", args)
        return
    pr = _Prep(s, args, {"ll": 2, "ul": 2}, weights=("aweight", "fweight", "iweight", "pweight"))
    out = s.output
    pr.write_notes(out)
    y = pr.y
    o = pr.o
    lo = hi = None
    if o.get("ll") is not None and o.get("ll") is not False:
        lo = float(y.min()) if o["ll"] is True or str(o["ll"]).strip() == "" else float(s.eval(str(o["ll"])))
    if o.get("ul") is not None and o.get("ul") is not False:
        hi = float(y.max()) if o["ul"] is True or str(o["ul"]).strip() == "" else float(s.eval(str(o["ul"])))
    if lo is None and hi is None:
        raise StataError(198, "must specify censoring point")   # VERIFY
    left = (y <= lo) if lo is not None else np.zeros(len(y), bool)
    right = (y >= hi) if hi is not None else np.zeros(len(y), bool)
    unc = ~(left | right)
    X = np.column_stack([pr.X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else pr.X
    kx = X.shape[1]
    w = pr.w

    def make(Xm):
        k = Xm.shape[1]

        def ll_obs(b):
            xb = Xm @ b[:k]
            sg = np.exp(b[k])
            out_ = np.zeros(len(y))
            out_[unc] = st.norm.logpdf((y[unc] - xb[unc]) / sg) - np.log(sg)
            if lo is not None:
                out_[left] = st.norm.logcdf((lo - xb[left]) / sg)
            if hi is not None:
                out_[right] = st.norm.logsf((hi - xb[right]) / sg)
            return out_

        def scores(b):
            xb = Xm @ b[:k]
            sg = np.exp(b[k])
            sx = np.zeros(len(y))
            ss = np.zeros(len(y))
            z = (y - xb) / sg
            sx[unc] = z[unc] / sg
            ss[unc] = z[unc] ** 2 - 1
            if lo is not None:
                zl = (lo - xb[left]) / sg
                lam = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zl) - st.norm.logcdf(zl))
                sx[left] = -lam / sg
                ss[left] = -lam * zl
            if hi is not None:
                zh = (hi - xb[right]) / sg
                lam = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zh) - st.norm.logsf(zh))
                sx[right] = lam / sg
                ss[right] = lam * zh
            return np.column_stack([Xm * sx[:, None], ss])

        def grad(b):
            return scores(b).T @ w

        def fun(b, todo):
            ll = float(w @ ll_obs(b))
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            return ll, grad(b), num_hess(grad, b)
        return fun, scores

    # start: OLS (VERIFY: Stata's starting values)
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X * np.sqrt(w)[:, None], y * np.sqrt(w), rcond=None)
    resid = y - X @ beta
    sig0 = np.sqrt(np.sum(w * resid ** 2) / w.sum())
    fun0, _ = make(np.ones((len(y), 1)))
    res0 = pr.maximize(fun0, np.array([np.average(y, weights=w), np.log(np.std(y) or 1.0)]))
    fun, scores = make(X)
    res = pr.maximize(fun, np.concatenate([beta, [np.log(sig0)]]))
    # Stata 14's tobit does not show the iteration log (compat 0510)
    Vl, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    # Stata 14's e(b) stores sigma (not ln sigma): delta method
    sg = float(np.exp(res.b[-1]))
    Jm = np.eye(kx + 1)
    Jm[-1, -1] = sg
    V = Jm @ Vl @ Jm.T
    b_rep = np.concatenate([res.b[:kx], [sg]])
    slope = list(range(kx - (1 if pr.constant else 0)))
    kind, chi2, pv = _model_test(pr, b_rep, V, slope, res.ll, res0.ll)
    r2p = 1 - res.ll / res0.ll
    names, _ = _slope_rows(pr, b_rep, V)
    ds = s.data
    rows = rows_from_columns(pr.smp.cols, _bmap(pr, b_rep, kx), _semap(pr, V, kx), ds,
                             constant=pr.constant)
    rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    c = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    se_s = float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    rows.append(CoefRow("aux", "/sigma", sg, se_s, name="_cons"))
    layout = [(nm, cc.values is not None) for nm, cc in zip(names, pr.smp.cols)]
    if pr.constant:
        layout.append(("_cons", True))
        names = names + ["_cons"]
    layout.append(("_cons", True))
    b_full, V_full = _expand(pr, b_rep, V, layout)
    eqs = ["model"] * len(names) + ["sigma"]
    est = _finish(s, pr, "tobit", args, title="Tobit regression", names=names + ["_cons"], eqnames=eqs,
                  b=b_full, V=V_full, rows=rows, res=res, ll0=res0.ll, df_m=len(slope), chi2kind=kind,
                  chi2=chi2, p=pv, r2p=r2p, display=_display_std, n_clust=n_clust, k_eq=2, k_aux=1,
                  extra_scalars=[("N_unc", float(w[unc].sum())), ("N_lc", float(w[left].sum())),
                                 ("N_rc", float(w[right].sum())), ("sigma", sg)]
                  + ([("llopt", lo)] if lo is not None else []) + ([("ulopt", hi)] if hi is not None else [])
                  + [("df_r", float(pr.N - len(slope)))],
                  extra_macros=[("footnote", 'censobs_table e(N_unc) e(N_lc) e(N_rc) "" e(llopt) e(ulopt)'),
                                ("marginsok", "default XB Pr(passthru) E(passthru) YStar(passthru)")],
                  constant=pr.constant,
                  # Stata 14's tobit does not use moptimize: its own e(), without ilog and gradient
                  # (compat 0513)
                  order=(["N", "N_clust", "ll_0", "ll", "r2_p", "llopt", "ulopt", "k_aux", "N_lc", "N_rc",
                          "N_unc", "chi2", "converged", "rank", "df_m", "df_r"],
                         ["cmdline", "chi2type", "footnote", "title", "vce", "vcetype", "clustvar",
                          "marginsok", "wtype", "wexp", "depvar", "cmd", "predict", "properties"], []))
    est.cens = (float(w[left].sum()), float(w[unc].sum()), float(w[right].sum()), lo, hi)
    # degrees of freedom N - df_m (compat 0513: 60 obs, 2 slopes -> 58)
    est.stat, est.df_r = "t", pr.N - len(slope)
    est.footer = _tobit_footer
    _display_std(s, est)


def _tobit_footer(s: "Session", est: Estimates) -> None:
    nl, nu, nr, lo, hi = est.cens
    out = s.output
    dep = est.depvar
    out.write(f"{int(nl):>14}  left-censored observations"
              + (f" at {dep} <= {g(lo, '%9.0g')}" if lo is not None and nl else "") + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{int(nu):>14}     uncensored observations\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{int(nr):>14} right-censored observations"
              + (f" at {dep} >= {g(hi, '%9.0g')}" if hi is not None and nr else "") + "\n", "text")

"""Nonlinear estimation with substitutable expressions: nl, nlsur and gmm ([R] nl, [R] nlsur,
[R] gmm). A parameter is written {name}, {name=init} or {lc: varlist [, noconstant]} inside an
expression; the expression is evaluated with Stata's own evaluator at the current parameter
values and the derivatives are numerical.

Layouts come from the manuals; the lines marked VERIFY wait for the Stata 14 log of case 1908."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from .mleq import aux_row
from .models2 import g
from .regress import cmdline, comma
from .results import Estimates, coef_table, post

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

_BRACE = re.compile(r"\{([^{}]*)\}")


def _lit(v) -> str:
    """A number as text the expression parser reads back exactly."""
    return format(float(v), ".17g")


class SubExpr:
    """An expression with parameters. `names` are the parameters in order of appearance (a linear
    combination {xb: x1 x2} contributes xb_x1, xb_x2 and xb__cons)."""

    def __init__(self, s: "Session", text: str):
        self.s = s
        self.text = text
        self.names: list[str] = []
        self.init: dict[str, float | None] = {}
        self.lcs: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]] = {}     # label -> [(param, variable or "")]
        for m in _BRACE.finditer(text):
            self._add(m.group(1))

    def _add(self, body: str) -> None:
        body = body.strip()
        if ":" in body:
            label, rest = body.split(":", 1)
            label = label.strip() or "xb"
            noconstant = False
            if "," in rest:
                rest, opt = rest.split(",", 1)
                noconstant = opt.strip().startswith("nocons")
            if label in self.lcs:
                return
            parts = []
            for v in rest.split():
                v = resolve_name(self.s.data, v)
                parts.append((f"{label}_{v}", v))
            if not noconstant:
                parts.append((f"{label}__cons", ""))
            self.lcs[label] = parts
            for nm, _ in parts:
                self._register(nm, None)
            return
        init = None
        if "=" in body:
            name, val = body.split("=", 1)
            name = name.strip()
            try:
                init = float(val.strip())
            except ValueError:
                raise StataError(198, f"invalid initial value for {name}")   # VERIFY
        else:
            name = body
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", name):
            raise StataError(198, f"invalid parameter name {{{body}}}")   # VERIFY
        self._register(name, init)

    def _register(self, name: str, init: float | None) -> None:
        if name not in self.names:
            self.names.append(name)
            self.init[name] = init
        elif init is not None:
            self.init[name] = init

    def variables(self) -> list[str]:
        return [v for parts in self.lcs.values() for _, v in parts if v]

    def render(self, theta: dict) -> str:
        def sub(m):
            body = m.group(1).strip()
            if ":" in body:
                label = body.split(":", 1)[0].strip() or "xb"
                terms = []
                for nm, v in self.lcs[label]:
                    terms.append(f"{_lit(theta[nm])}*{v}" if v else f"{_lit(theta[nm])}")
                return "(" + " + ".join(terms) + ")"
            name = body.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
            return f"({_lit(theta[name])})"
        return _BRACE.sub(sub, self.text)

    def evaluate(self, theta: dict) -> np.ndarray:
        from ..commands._util import eval_vector
        v = eval_vector(self.s, self.render(theta))
        v = np.asarray(v, dtype=float)
        n = self.s.data.nobs
        if v.ndim == 0:
            v = np.full(n, float(v))
        return v


def _split_equations(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    """'(a) (b) if x, opts' -> ['a', 'b'], 'if x, opts'."""
    t = text.strip()
    eqs, depth, start, end = [], 0, None, 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(t):
        if ch == "(":
            if depth == 0:
                start = i
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0 and start is not None:
                eqs.append(t[start + 1:i])
                end = i + 1
        elif depth == 0 and ch not in " \t":
            break
    return eqs, t[end:].strip()


def _lhs_rhs(body: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    depth = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(body):
        if ch in "({[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch in ")}]":
            depth -= 1
        elif ch == "=" and depth == 0 and body[i - 1:i + 1] != "==" and body[i:i + 2] != "==":
            return body[:i].strip(), body[i + 1:].strip()
    raise StataError(198, "equation must be specified as (depvar = expression)")   # VERIFY


def _num_jac(fun, theta: np.ndarray, h: float = 1e-6) -> np.ndarray:
    """Jacobian of fun(theta) (n values) by central differences."""
    cols = []
    for j in range(len(theta)):
        step = h * max(abs(theta[j]), 1e-2)
        up, dn = theta.copy(), theta.copy()
        up[j] += step
        dn[j] -= step
        cols.append((fun(up) - fun(dn)) / (2 * step))
    return np.column_stack(cols)


def gauss_newton(resid, theta0: np.ndarray, W: np.ndarray, *, eps: float = 1e-5, maxit: int = 100, log=None):
    """Minimizes r' W r with r = resid(theta) (W a vector of weights or a matrix) by Gauss-Newton with
    step halving. `log(it, value)` is called at every iteration. Returns (theta, J, r, iterations)."""
    def quad(r):
        return float(r @ (W * r)) if W.ndim == 1 else float(r @ W @ r)

    def wmul(A):
        return A * W[:, None] if W.ndim == 1 else W @ A

    theta = theta0.copy()
    f = lambda t: -resid(t)                         # the model: r = y - f
    r = resid(theta)
    q = quad(r)
    it = 0
    while True:
        J = _num_jac(f, theta)
        if log:
            log(it, q)
        WJ = wmul(J)
        A = J.T @ WJ
        d = np.linalg.solve(A + 1e-12 * np.trace(A) / max(len(theta), 1) * np.eye(len(theta)), WJ.T @ r)
        crit = float(r @ WJ @ np.linalg.solve(A + 1e-14 * np.eye(len(theta)), WJ.T @ r)) / max(q, 1e-300)
        if crit < eps * eps or it >= maxit:
            break
        lam = 1.0
        while lam > 1e-10:
            tn = theta + lam * d
            rn = resid(tn)
            qn = quad(rn)
            if np.isfinite(qn) and qn <= q:
                break
            lam /= 2
        else:
            break
        converged_rel = abs(q - qn) <= 1e-12 * max(q, 1e-300)
        theta, r, q = tn, rn, qn
        it += 1
        if converged_rel:
            if log:
                log(it, q)
            J = _num_jac(f, theta)
            break
    return theta, J, r, it

class ProgFunc:
    """The function evaluator program of nl, nlsur and gmm ([R] nl, [R] nlsur, [R] gmm), called
    as `prog newvars varlist if touse, at(matrix)`: it fills the m new variables (the fitted
    values of nl and nlsur, the residuals of gmm). The program runs on every observation and the
    caller keeps those of its sample. `names` are the parameters (parameters(), or b1, b2, ...
    with nparameters(#)); `eq(q)` is equation q with the interface of SubExpr."""

    def __init__(self, s: "Session", prog: str, m: int, names: list[str], varlist: list[str],
                 noisy_first: bool = False):
        self.s = s
        self.noisy_first = noisy_first      # gmm shows the output of the first call (compat 1923)
        self.prog = prog
        self.m = m
        self.names = names
        self.init: dict[str, float | None] = {nm: None for nm in names}
        self.vars = varlist
        self._key = None
        self._val = None

    def evaluate_all(self, theta: dict) -> np.ndarray:
        key = tuple(float(theta[nm]) for nm in self.names)
        if key == self._key:
            return self._val
        from ..commands.matrix import Matrix, _store
        from ..commands.syntaxcmd import _temp_name
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        s, ds = self.s, self.s.data
        tmp = []
        for i in range(self.m + 1):
            nm = _temp_name(s)
            ds.add(Variable(nm, "double", np.ones(ds.nobs) if i == 0 else np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)))
            tmp.append(nm)
        mats = _store(s)
        mats["__nlat"] = Matrix(np.array([key]), ["r1"], list(self.names))
        try:
            call = f"{self.prog} {' '.join(tmp[1:] + self.vars)} if {tmp[0]}, at(__nlat)"
            if self.noisy_first:
                self.noisy_first = False
                s.interp._execute_expanded(call)
            else:
                with s.output.quietly():
                    s.interp._execute_expanded(call)
            val = np.column_stack([ds.get(nm).data.astype(float) for nm in tmp[1:]])
        finally:
            ds.drop_vars([nm for nm in tmp if ds.has(nm)])
            mats.pop("__nlat", None)
        self._key, self._val = key, val
        return val

    def eq(self, q: int) -> "_ProgEq":
        return _ProgEq(self, q)


class _ProgEq:
    def __init__(self, pf: ProgFunc, q: int):
        self.pf, self.q = pf, q
        self.names = pf.names
        self.init = pf.init
        self.lcs: dict = {}
        self.text = ""

    def variables(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self.pf.vars)

    def evaluate(self, theta: dict) -> np.ndarray:
        return self.pf.evaluate_all(theta)[:, self.q]


_PROG_FORM = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*([@:])(.*)$", re.S)


def _program(s: "Session", name: str) -> str:
    if name not in s.programs:
        raise StataError(199, f"unrecognized command:  {name}")
    return name


def _split_varlist(s: "Session", text: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    """'y x1 x2 if z, opts' -> (['y', 'x1', 'x2'], 'if z, opts')."""
    text = text.strip()
    cut = len(text)
    for mm in re.finditer(r",|\[|(?<!\S)(?:if|in)(?!\S)", text):
        cut = mm.start()
        break
    head = text[:cut].split()
    tail = text[cut:].strip()
    from ..core.varlist import expand
    return (expand(s.data, " ".join(head)) if head else []), tail


def _param_names(opts_text: str) -> list[str]:
    """parameters(namelist) or nparameters(#) (b1, b2, ...) of a function evaluator program."""
    m = re.search(r"\bparam\w*\s*\(([^)]*)\)", opts_text)
    if m and not re.search(r"\bnparam\w*\s*\(", opts_text[:m.start() + 1]):
        return [nm.split(":")[-1] for nm in m.group(1).split()]
    m = re.search(r"\bnparam\w*\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)", opts_text)
    if m:
        return [f"b{i}" for i in range(1, int(m.group(1)) + 1)]
    raise StataError(198, "you must specify parameters() or nparameters()")   # VERIFY


def _int_option(opts_text: str, stem: str) -> int | None:
    m = re.search(rf"\b{stem}\w*\s*\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)", opts_text)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def _sexp_program(s: "Session", prog: str, varlist: list[str], tail: str) -> None:
    """Runs a substitutable expression program (`nl name : varlist`), whose r() holds the
    equations."""
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard as _ps
    p = _ps(tail)
    cond = ""
    if p.if_:
        cond += f" if {p.if_}"
    if p.in_:
        cond += f" in {p.in_}"
    with s.output.quietly():
        s.interp._execute_expanded(f"{prog} {' '.join(varlist)}{cond}")


def _options_tail(tail: str) -> str:
    i = tail.find(",")
    return tail[i + 1:] if i >= 0 else ""


def cmd_nl(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from ..commands.summarize import weights as get_weights
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "nl", args)
        return
    ds = s.data
    orig_args = args
    pm = _PROG_FORM.match(args)
    funcprog = ""
    nl_type = "3" if pm and pm.group(2) == "@" else ("2" if pm else "1")
    if pm and pm.group(2) == ":":
        # substitutable expression program: nl<name> leaves the equation in r(eq) and a title in
        # r(title)
        prog = _program(s, "nl" + pm.group(1))
        varlist, tail = _split_varlist(s, pm.group(3))
        _sexp_program(s, prog, varlist, tail)
        eq = str(s.r.get("eq", ""))
        if not eq:
            raise StataError(198, f"{prog} did not return r(eq)")   # VERIFY
        if "=" not in eq.split("{")[0]:
            eq = f"{varlist[0]} = {eq}"
        title = str(s.r.get("title", ""))
        if title and not re.search(r"\btitle\s*\(", tail):
            tail = (tail + ("" if "," in tail else ",") + f' title("{title}")')
        args = f"({eq}) {tail}"
    if pm and pm.group(2) == "@":
        # function evaluator program: nl<name> fills the dependent variable (a temporary one)
        funcprog = _program(s, "nl" + pm.group(1))
        varlist, tail = _split_varlist(s, pm.group(3))
        if not varlist:
            raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
        depname, rhs = varlist[0], ""
        se = ProgFunc(s, funcprog, 1, _param_names(_options_tail(tail)), varlist[1:]).eq(0)
    else:
        eqs, tail = _split_equations(args)
        if len(eqs) != 1:
            raise StataError(198, "nl requires one equation: (depvar = expression)")   # VERIFY
        dep, rhs = _lhs_rhs(eqs[0])
        depname = resolve_name(ds, dep)
        se = SubExpr(s, rhs)
        if not se.names:
            raise StataError(198, "no parameters in the expression")   # VERIFY
    p = parse_standard(tail)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"initial": 4, "nolog": 4, "log": 3, "eps": 3, "iterate": 4, "level": 1,
                                  "variables": 3, "lnlsq": 3, "title": 5, "robust": 1, "vce": 3, "cluster": 2,
                                  "noconstant": 4, "hasconstant": 3, "nocnsreport": 5, "noheader": 6,
                                  "notable": 5, "delta": 3, "parameters": 5, "nparameters": 6}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    mask = touse(s, p)
    y_all = ds.get(depname).data.astype(float)
    mask &= y_all < SYS
    for v in se.variables():
        mask &= ds.get(v).data < SYS
    w, wtype, mask = get_weights(s, p, mask, ("aweight", "fweight", "iweight", "pweight"))
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    init = dict(se.init)
    if o.get("initial"):
        for m in re.finditer(r"(\w+)\s+([-+0-9.eE]+)", str(o["initial"])):
            init[m.group(1)] = float(m.group(2))
    theta0 = np.array([0.0 if init.get(nm) is None else init[nm] for nm in se.names])
    for label, parts in se.lcs.items():
        if all(init.get(nm) is None for nm, _ in parts):
            # linear combinations start at the regression of the dependent variable on the variables
            X = np.column_stack([ds.get(v).data[mask] if v else np.ones(int(mask.sum())) for _, v in parts])
            bb = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y_all[mask], rcond=None)[0]
            for (nm, _), v in zip(parts, bb):
                theta0[se.names.index(nm)] = float(v)
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        f0 = se.evaluate(dict(zip(se.names, theta0)))
    mask &= f0 < SYS
    mask &= np.isfinite(f0)
    n = int(mask.sum())
    if n == 0:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    wv = w[mask].astype(float) if w is not None else np.ones(n)
    if wtype in ("aweight", "pweight"):
        wv = wv * n / wv.sum()
    N = float(wv.sum()) if wtype in ("fweight", "iweight") else float(n)
    y = y_all[mask]
    out = s.output
    k = len(se.names)
    out.write(f"(obs = {comma(N)})\n", "text")

    def f_theta(t):
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            return se.evaluate(dict(zip(se.names, t)))[mask]

    def resid(t):
        return y - f_theta(t)

    def log(it, q):
        if not o.get("nolog"):
            if it == 0:
                out.write("\n", "text")
            out.write(f"Iteration {it}:  residual SS = {g(q, '%9.0g'):>9}\n", "text")

    theta, J, r, iters = gauss_newton(resid, theta0, wv, eps=float(o["eps"]) if o.get("eps") else 1e-5,
                                      maxit=int(o["iterate"]) if o.get("iterate") else 100, log=log)
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\n", "text")
    rss = float(r @ (wv * r))
    df_r = N - k
    s2 = rss / df_r
    A = J.T @ (J * wv[:, None])
    Ainv = np.linalg.inv(A)
    V = s2 * Ainv
    vcetype = ""
    if o.get("robust") or str(o.get("vce", "")).startswith("rob") or wtype == "pweight":
        sc = J * (wv * r)[:, None]
        V = (N / (N - k)) * Ainv @ (sc.T @ sc) @ Ainv
        vcetype = "Robust"
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    # a parameter that enters additively is the constant term of the model
    const_idx = None
    for j in range(k):
        if np.allclose(J[:, j], 1.0, atol=1e-6):
            const_idx = j
            break
    if o.get("noconstant"):
        const_idx = None
    if const_idx is not None or o.get("hasconstant"):
        ybar = float(np.sum(wv * y) / wv.sum())
        tss = float(np.sum(wv * (y - ybar) ** 2))
        df_m = k - 1
        df_tot = N - 1
    else:
        tss = float(np.sum(wv * y ** 2))
        df_m = k
        df_tot = N
    mss = tss - rss
    r2 = mss / tss if tss > 0 else SYS
    r2_a = 1 - (1 - r2) * df_tot / df_r if tss > 0 else SYS
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(s2))
    dev = N * (1 + np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(rss / N))
    est = Estimates("nl", depname, list(se.names), theta, V, int(N), "t", df_r)
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = level, vcetype, "", None
    est.eqnames = ["/"] * k
    est.rows = [aux_row("/" + nm, float(theta[i]), float(np.sqrt(max(V[i, i], 0))), level) for i, nm in enumerate(se.names)]
    for r_ in est.rows:
        r_.noeform = True
    est.extra = {"N": N, "mss": mss, "rss": rss, "tss": tss, "df_m": df_m, "df_r": df_r, "df_t": df_tot,
                 "r2": r2, "r2_a": r2_a, "rmse": rmse, "dev": dev, "const": se.names[const_idx] if const_idx is not None else ""}
    est.sexp = se
    est.title = str(o.get("title") or "").strip().strip('"')
    est.display = _display_nl

    def predict(s_, e, stat, mask_):
        t = dict(zip(e.sexp.names, e.b))
        v = e.sexp.evaluate(t)
        if stat in ("", "yhat"):
            return v, ("(option yhat assumed; fitted values)" if not stat else "")   # compat 1923
        if stat == "residuals":
            return ds.get(e.depvar).data.astype(float) - v, ""
        raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")   # VERIFY
    est.predict = predict
    est.predict_opts = {"yhat": 1, "residuals": 3}
    # e() as Stata lists it (compat 1923)
    scalars = [("df_m", df_m), ("df_r", df_r), ("mss", mss), ("mms", mss / df_m if df_m else SYS),
               ("msr", rss / df_r), ("rmse", rmse), ("ll", -dev / 2), ("r2", r2), ("r2_a", r2_a), ("dev", dev),
               ("converge", 1.0), ("N", N), ("rss", rss), ("df_t", df_tot), ("tss", tss),
               ("cj", float(const_idx + 1) if const_idx is not None else 0.0), ("gm_2", 1.0),   # VERIFY gm_2
               ("delta", float(o["delta"]) if o.get("delta") else 4e-7), ("k", float(k)), ("k_eq_model", 0.0),
               ("rank", float(np.linalg.matrix_rank(V))), ("log_t", 1.0 if o.get("lnlsq") else 0.0), ("ic", iters)]
    covs = " ".join(se.variables()) if nl_type == "3" else " ".join(dict.fromkeys(
        w for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", _BRACE.sub(" ", rhs)) if ds.has(w)))
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("nl", orig_args)), ("cmd", "nl"), ("predict", "nl_p"),
              ("marginsnotok", "SCores Residuals"), ("marginsok", "default Yhat"), ("vce", "gnr")]
    if funcprog:
        macros.append(("funcprog", funcprog))
    macros += [("covariates", covs), ("rhs", covs), ("type", nl_type)]
    if est.title:
        macros.append(("title", est.title))
    if nl_type != "3":
        # the expression as Stata stores it: "{a} *xp^ {b}" (compat 1923; VERIFY the general rule)
        def _sx(mm_):
            return "{" + mm_.group(1).split("=")[0].strip() + "}" + (" " if mm_.start() == 0 else "")
        sx = re.sub(r"\s+", "", rhs)
        sx = re.sub(r"\{([^}]*)\}", lambda mm_: _sx(mm_) if mm_.start() == 0 else " " + _sx(mm_), sx)
        macros.append(("sexp", sx))
    macros += [("params", " ".join(se.names)), ("depvar", depname), ("properties", "b V")]
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, mask, extra_mats=[("init", Matrix(theta0.reshape(1, -1), ["y1"], list(se.names)))])
    _display_nl(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _display_nl(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        msm = x["mss"] / x["df_m"] if x["df_m"] > 0 else SYS

        def ss_row(nm, ss, df, ms):
            return f"{nm:>12} |{g(ss, '%10.0g'):>11}{int(df):>11}{g(ms, '%11.0g'):>12}"

        left = [f"{'Source':>12} |      SS            df       MS",
                "-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 34,
                ss_row("Model", x["mss"], x["df_m"], msm),
                ss_row("Residual", x["rss"], x["df_r"], x["rss"] / x["df_r"]),
                "-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 34,
                ss_row("Total", x["tss"], x["df_t"], x["tss"] / x["df_t"])]
        rights = {1: ("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])), 2: ("R-squared", g(x["r2"], "%9.4f")),
                  3: ("Adj R-squared", g(x["r2_a"], "%9.4f")), 4: ("Root MSE", g(x["rmse"], "%9.0g")),
                  5: ("Res. dev.", g(x["dev"], "%9.0g"))}
        for i, lft in enumerate(left):
            out.write(lft, "text")
            if i in rights:
                lab, val = rights[i]
                out.write(f"{'':<{48 - len(lft)}}    {lab:<14}=", "text")
                out.write(f"{val:>11}", "result")
            out.write("\n", "text")
        if est.title:
            out.write(f"{est.title}\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=lev, vcetype=est.vcetype)
        if x["const"]:
            out.write(f"  Parameter {x['const']} taken as constant term in model & ANOVA table\n", "text")

def cmd_nlsur(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "nlsur", args)
        return
    ds = s.data
    orig_args = args
    pm = _PROG_FORM.match(args)
    funcprog = ""
    if pm and pm.group(2) == ":":
        # substitutable expression program: nlsur<name> returns r(n_eq) and the equations in
        # r(eq_1), r(eq_2), ... (VERIFY)
        prog = _program(s, "nlsur" + pm.group(1))
        varlist, tail = _split_varlist(s, pm.group(3))
        _sexp_program(s, prog, varlist, tail)
        try:
            neq = int(float(s.r.get("n_eq", 0)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            neq = 0
        if neq < 1:
            raise StataError(198, f"{prog} did not return r(n_eq)")   # VERIFY
        args = " ".join(f"({s.r.get(f'eq_{q}', '')})" for q in range(1, neq + 1)) + " " + tail
    deps, ses = [], []
    if pm and pm.group(2) == "@":
        # function evaluator program: nlsur<name> fills the dependent variables (temporary ones)
        funcprog = _program(s, "nlsur" + pm.group(1))
        varlist, tail = _split_varlist(s, pm.group(3))
        neq = _int_option(_options_tail(tail), "neq")
        if not neq:
            raise StataError(198, "option nequations() required")   # VERIFY
        if len(varlist) < neq:
            raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
        deps = varlist[:neq]
        pf = ProgFunc(s, funcprog, neq, _param_names(_options_tail(tail)), varlist[neq:])
        ses = [pf.eq(q) for q in range(neq)]
        eqs = ["" for _ in range(neq)]
    else:
        eqs, tail = _split_equations(args)
        if not eqs:
            raise StataError(198, "equation required")   # VERIFY
        for body in eqs:
            dep, rhs = _lhs_rhs(body)
            deps.append(resolve_name(ds, dep))
            ses.append(SubExpr(s, rhs))
    names: list[str] = []
    init: dict = {}
    for se in ses:
        for nm in se.names:
            if nm not in names:
                names.append(nm)
            if se.init.get(nm) is not None:
                init[nm] = se.init[nm]
    p = parse_standard(tail)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"fgnls": 2, "nls": 3, "initial": 4, "nolog": 4, "log": 3, "eps": 3,
                                  "iterate": 4, "level": 1, "variables": 3, "noconstant": 4, "title": 5,
                                  "noheader": 6, "notable": 5, "delta": 3, "robust": 1, "nequations": 3,
                                  "parameters": 5, "nparameters": 6, "lnlsq": 3, "ifgnls": 3}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for dn in deps:
        mask &= ds.get(dn).data < SYS
    for se in ses:
        for v in se.variables():
            mask &= ds.get(v).data < SYS
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    theta0 = np.array([init.get(nm, 0.0) for nm in names])
    for se in ses:
        for label, parts in se.lcs.items():
            if all(nm not in init for nm, _ in parts):
                X = np.column_stack([ds.get(v).data[mask] if v else np.ones(int(mask.sum())) for _, v in parts])
                bb = np.linalg.lstsq(X, ds.get(deps[ses.index(se)]).data[mask], rcond=None)[0]
                for (nm, _), v in zip(parts, bb):
                    theta0[names.index(nm)] = float(v)
    for se in ses:
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            f0 = se.evaluate({nm: theta0[names.index(nm)] for nm in se.names})
        mask &= (f0 < SYS) & np.isfinite(f0)
    n = int(mask.sum())
    m = len(eqs)
    Y = np.column_stack([ds.get(dn).data[mask].astype(float) for dn in deps])
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"(obs = {comma(n)})\n\n", "text")

    def fit_vals(t):
        cols = []
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            for se in ses:
                cols.append(se.evaluate({nm: t[names.index(nm)] for nm in se.names})[mask])
        return np.column_stack(cols)

    def resid_vec(t):
        return (Y - fit_vals(t)).T.reshape(-1)            # equation by equation

    def logger(label):
        def log(it, q):
            if not o.get("nolog"):
                lab = "Residual SS" if label == "nls" else "Scaled RSS"
                out.write(f"Iteration {it}:  {lab} = {g(q, '%9.0g'):>9}\n", "text")
        return log

    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("Calculating NLS estimates...\n", "text")     # VERIFY
    I = np.ones(n * m)
    theta, J, r, it = gauss_newton(resid_vec, theta0, I, log=logger("nls"))
    method = "nls" if o.get("nls") else ("ifgnls" if o.get("ifgnls") else "fgnls")
    sigma = None
    if method != "nls":
        for rounds in range(1 if method == "fgnls" else 50):
            E = (Y - fit_vals(theta))
            sigma = E.T @ E / n
            Wm = np.kron(np.linalg.inv(sigma), np.eye(n))
            if not o.get("nolog"):
                out.write("Calculating FGNLS estimates...\n" if rounds == 0 else "", "text")   # VERIFY
            tnew, J, r, it = gauss_newton(resid_vec, theta, Wm, log=logger("fgnls"))
            done = np.max(np.abs(tnew - theta)) < 1e-8
            theta = tnew
            if done:
                break
        E = (Y - fit_vals(theta))
        if method == "ifgnls":
            sigma = E.T @ E / n
        Wm = np.kron(np.linalg.inv(sigma), np.eye(n))
        J = _num_jac(lambda t: -resid_vec(t), theta)
        A = J.T @ Wm @ J
        V = np.linalg.inv(A)
    else:
        # Stata's nls: the equations weighted by the inverse of their residual variances from the
        # unweighted fit (no covariances), one more Gauss-Newton fit, V = (J' W J)^-1 (compat 1923)
        E = (Y - fit_vals(theta))
        sigma = np.diag(np.diag(E.T @ E / n))
        Wm = np.kron(np.linalg.inv(sigma), np.eye(n))

def _display_nlsur(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        title = {"fgnls": "FGNLS regression", "ifgnls": "Iterated FGNLS regression",
                 "nls": "Nonlinear least-squares regression"}[x["method"]]   # compat 1923
        out.write(f"\n{title} \n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 71 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Equation':>15} |{'Obs':>11}{'Parms':>8}{'RMSE':>11}{'R-sq':>10}{'Constant':>13}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 16 + "+" + "-" * 54 + "\n", "text")
        for i, (dn, e) in enumerate(zip(x["deps"], x["info"]), 1):
            # R-sq is written from column 4 of its field, so a negative value shifts the rest
            r2 = g(e['r2'], '%9.4f').strip() + ("*" if e.get("uncentered") else "")
            out.write(f"{i:>2}{dn:>13} |{e['obs']:>11}{e['parms']:>8}{g(e['rmse'], '%9.0g'):>11}"
                      f"    {r2:<7}{e['const'] or '.':>12}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 71 + "\n", "text")
        if any(e.get("uncentered") for e in x["info"]):
            out.write("* Uncentered R-sq\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, "", est.rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev)

"""Panel and absorbed effects: xtreg (fe, re, be), areg ([XT] xtreg, [R] areg),
and instrumental variables: ivregress 2sls ([R] ivregress)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail as _chi2_tail
from ..lazy import lazy
from . import fvars
from .regress import Sample, cmdline, comma
from .results import Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns
from .tsops import panel_info

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def g(x: float, fmt: str) -> str:
    if x is None or not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    return format_value(float(x), fmt, pad=False).strip()


def _demean(v: np.ndarray, ids: np.ndarray, inv: np.ndarray, counts: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    sums = np.bincount(inv, weights=v, minlength=len(counts))
    return v - (sums / counts)[inv]


def _group_means(v, inv, counts):
    return np.bincount(inv, weights=v, minlength=len(counts)) / counts


def _maps(cols, b, V, constant: bool):
    bmap, semap = {}, {}
    j = 0
    for c in cols:
        if c.values is not None:
            bmap[c.name] = float(b[j])
            semap[c.name] = float(np.sqrt(max(V[j, j], 0)))
            j += 1
        else:
            bmap[c.name], semap[c.name] = 0.0, 0.0
    if constant:
        bmap["_cons"] = float(b[-1])
        semap["_cons"] = float(np.sqrt(max(V[-1, -1], 0)))
    return bmap, semap


def _names(cols, constant):
    out = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in cols]
    return out + (["_cons"] if constant else [])


def _full(cols, constant, b, V):
    names = _names(cols, constant)
    kk = len(names)
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if constant else [])
    bf = np.zeros(kk)
    Vf = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    bf[pos] = b
    Vf[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    return names, bf, Vf


def _cluster_vce(Xs, e, ids, A, N, k, g_count_adjust=True):
    uniq = np.unique(ids)
    G = len(uniq)
    sc = Xs * e[:, None]
    meat = np.zeros((Xs.shape[1], Xs.shape[1]))
    for u in uniq:
        sg = sc[ids == u].sum(axis=0)
        meat += np.outer(sg, sg)
    q = (G / (G - 1)) * ((N - 1) / (N - k)) if g_count_adjust else G / (G - 1)
    return q * A @ meat @ A, G

# xtreg
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_xtreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "xtreg", args)
        return
    from .xtgee import run_pa
    if run_pa(s, "xtreg", args):
        return
    from .xtgee import has_option
    if has_option(args, "mle"):
        from .panel2 import cmd_xtreg_mle
        cmd_xtreg_mle(s, args)
        return
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"fe": 2, "re": 2, "be": 2, "mle": 3, "i": 1, "sa": 2, "wls": 3},
                 weights=("aweight", "fweight", "pweight"))
    o = smp.o
    ds = s.data
    pvar = str(o.get("i")).strip() if o.get("i") else panel_info(ds)
    if not pvar:
        raise StataError(459, "panel variable not set; use xtset varname ...")   # VERIFY
    ids_all = ds.get(pvar).data
    mask = smp.mask & (ids_all < SYS)
    if not np.array_equal(mask, smp.mask):
        raise StataError(459, f"{pvar} missing in sample")   # VERIFY
    ids = ids_all[smp.mask]
    uniq, inv, counts = np.unique(ids, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    G = len(uniq)
    y = smp.y.astype(float)
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, True)
    out = s.output
    for nm in notes:
        out.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    Xs = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols]) if est_cols else np.zeros((len(y), 0))
    N = len(y)
    k = Xs.shape[1]
    model = "re" if not (o.get("fe") or o.get("be")) else ("fe" if o.get("fe") else "be")
    if model == "fe":
        _xtreg_fe(s, smp, args, y, Xs, est_cols, ids, inv, counts, G, N, k, pvar)
    elif model == "re":
        _xtreg_re(s, smp, args, y, Xs, est_cols, ids, inv, counts, G, N, k, pvar)
    else:
        _xtreg_be(s, smp, args, y, Xs, est_cols, ids, inv, counts, G, N, k, pvar)


def _xtreg_be(s, smp, args, y, Xs, est_cols, ids, inv, counts, G, N, k, pvar):
    """Between estimator: OLS of the panel means of y on the panel means of x ([XT] xtreg;
    wls weights each panel by its number of observations)."""
    if smp.vce in ("robust", "cluster"):
        raise StataError(198, "option vce() not allowed")   # VERIFY
    yb = _group_means(y, inv, counts)
    Xb = np.column_stack([_group_means(Xs[:, j], inv, counts) for j in range(k)] + [np.ones(G)])
    wg = counts.astype(float) if smp.o.get("wls") else np.ones(G)
    sw = np.sqrt(wg)
    A = np.linalg.pinv((Xb * wg[:, None]).T @ Xb)
    b = A @ ((Xb * wg[:, None]).T @ yb)
    e = (yb - Xb @ b) * sw
    df_r = G - (k + 1)
    if df_r <= 0:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    rss = float(e @ e)
    s2 = rss / df_r
    if smp.o.get("wls"):
        s2 = s2 * G / wg.sum()        # VERIFY: scale of the wls variance
    V = s2 * A
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    F = float(b[:k] @ np.linalg.solve(V[:k, :k], b[:k])) / k if k else SYS
    pF = float(st.f.sf(F, k, df_r)) if F < SYS else SYS
    xb_all = Xs @ b[:k]
    yw = _demean(y, ids, inv, counts)
    r2_w = float(np.corrcoef(_demean(xb_all, ids, inv, counts), yw)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    r2_b = float(np.corrcoef(_group_means(xb_all, inv, counts), yb)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    r2_o = float(np.corrcoef(xb_all, y)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    names, bf, Vf = _full(smp.cols, True, b, V)
    bmap, semap = _maps(smp.cols, b, V, True)
    rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=True)
    est = Estimates("xtreg", smp.depname, names, bf, Vf, N, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, True, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = "", "", None
    est.model = "be"
    sd = math.sqrt(s2)
    est.extra = dict(N=N, G=G, tmin=int(counts.min()), tmax=int(counts.max()), tbar=N / G, r2_w=r2_w,
                     r2_b=r2_b, r2_o=r2_o, F=F, pF=pF, df_m=k, df_r=df_r, pvar=pvar, sd_ue=sd)
    est.display = display_xtreg
    est.predict = _predict_xt
    est.predict_opts = {"u": 1, "e": 1, "ue": 2, "xbu": 3}
    est.panel = (pvar, ids)
    scalars = [("N", float(N)), ("N_g", float(G)), ("mss", float(((Xb @ b - yb.mean()) ** 2 * wg).sum())),
               ("df_m", float(k)), ("rss", rss), ("df_r", float(df_r)), ("r2", r2_b), ("r2_a", SYS),
               ("F", F), ("rmse", sd), ("r2_w", r2_w), ("r2_o", r2_o), ("r2_b", r2_b),
               ("g_min", float(counts.min())), ("g_avg", N / G), ("g_max", float(counts.max())),
               ("Tbar", N / G), ("rank", float(k + 1))]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("xtreg", args)), ("cmd", "xtreg"), ("depvar", smp.depname),
              ("ivar", pvar), ("model", "be"), ("title", "Between regression"),
              ("predict", "xtrefe_p"), ("properties", "b V")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    display_xtreg(s, est)


def _drop_within_collinear(smp, Xw, est_cols, out):
    """Variables constant within groups drop out in fe (collinearity note)."""
    keep = []
    for j, c in enumerate(est_cols):
        if np.allclose(Xw[:, j], 0, atol=1e-12 * (np.abs(c.values).max() + 1)):
            c.omitted = True
            c.values = None
            out.write(f"note: {c.name} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
        else:
            keep.append(j)
    return keep


def _xtreg_fe(s, smp, args, y, Xs, est_cols, ids, inv, counts, G, N, k, pvar):
    out = s.output
    yw = _demean(y, ids, inv, counts)
    Xw = np.column_stack([_demean(Xs[:, j], ids, inv, counts) for j in range(k)]) if k else Xs
    keep = _drop_within_collinear(smp, Xw, est_cols, out)
    Xw, Xs = Xw[:, keep], Xs[:, keep]
    est_cols = [est_cols[j] for j in keep]
    k = Xs.shape[1]
    A = np.linalg.inv(Xw.T @ Xw) if k else np.zeros((0, 0))
    b = A @ (Xw.T @ yw) if k else np.zeros(0)
    e = yw - Xw @ b
    rss = float(e @ e)
    df_r = N - G - k
    s2 = rss / df_r
    xbar, ybar = Xs.mean(axis=0), y.mean()
    cons = ybar - float(xbar @ b)
    # V with the constant: regression of (y - ȳi + ȳ) on (x - x̄i + x̄) and 1
    Xa = np.column_stack([Xw + xbar, np.ones(N)])
    Aa = np.linalg.inv(Xa.T @ Xa)
    V = s2 * Aa
    bb = np.append(b, cons)
    vcetype = ""
    n_clust = None
    if smp.vce in ("robust", "cluster"):
        # xtreg, vce(robust) = cluster on the panel (Stata)
        cl = smp.cluster if smp.vce == "cluster" else ids
        ea = yw - Xw @ b
        uniq = np.unique(cl)
        n_clust = len(uniq)
        sc = Xa * ea[:, None]
        meat = np.zeros((k + 1, k + 1))
        for u in uniq:
            sg = sc[cl == u].sum(axis=0)
            meat += np.outer(sg, sg)
        q = (n_clust / (n_clust - 1)) * ((N - 1) / (N - k - 1))
        V = q * Aa @ meat @ Aa
        vcetype = "Robust"
        df_r = n_clust - 1
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    # medidas
    xb_all = Xs @ b
    u_i = _group_means(y, inv, counts) - _group_means(xb_all, inv, counts) - cons
    sigma_u = float(np.std(u_i, ddof=1)) if G > 1 else 0.0
    sigma_e = float(np.sqrt(s2 if smp.vce == "ols" else rss / (N - G - k)))
    rho = sigma_u ** 2 / (sigma_u ** 2 + sigma_e ** 2)
    r2_w = float(np.corrcoef(Xw @ b, yw)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    r2_b = float(np.corrcoef(_group_means(xb_all, inv, counts), _group_means(y, inv, counts))[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    r2_o = float(np.corrcoef(xb_all, y)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    corr = float(np.corrcoef(u_i[inv], xb_all)[0, 1]) if k else 0.0
    if smp.vce == "ols":
        F = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(V[:k, :k], b)) / k if k else SYS
    else:
        F = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(V[:k, :k], b)) / k if k else SYS
    pF = float(st.f.sf(F, k, df_r)) if F < SYS else SYS
    # F test that all u_i = 0: pooled OLS vs fe
    Xp = np.column_stack([Xs, np.ones(N)])
    bp = np.linalg.lstsq(Xp, y, rcond=None)[0]
    rss_p = float(np.sum((y - Xp @ bp) ** 2))
    F_f = ((rss_p - rss) / (G - 1)) / (rss / (N - G - k))
    p_f = float(st.f.sf(F_f, G - 1, N - G - k))
    names, bf, Vf = _full(smp.cols, True, bb, V)
    bmap, semap = _maps(smp.cols, bb, V, True)
    rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=True)
    est = Estimates("xtreg", smp.depname, names, bf, Vf, N, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, True, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = vcetype, (smp.clustvar or pvar) if vcetype else "", n_clust
    est.model = "fe"
    est.extra = dict(N=N, G=G, tmin=int(counts.min()), tmax=int(counts.max()), tbar=N / G, r2_w=r2_w,
                     r2_b=r2_b, r2_o=r2_o, F=F, pF=pF, df_m=k, df_r=df_r, corr=corr, sigma_u=sigma_u,
                     sigma_e=sigma_e, rho=rho, F_f=F_f, p_f=p_f, pvar=pvar)
    est.display = display_xtreg
    est.predict = _predict_xt
    est.predict_opts = {"u": 1, "e": 1, "ue": 2, "xbu": 3}
    # e(): names and order observed in Stata 14 (compat 0510)
    tss_w = float(yw @ yw)
    ll = -0.5 * N * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(rss / N) + 1)
    ll_0 = -0.5 * N * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(tss_w / N) + 1)
    tss = float(np.sum((y - ybar) ** 2))
    r2_a = 1 - (1 - r2_w) * (N - 1) / (N - G - k)
    scalars = [("r2_w", r2_w), ("F_f", F_f), ("rank", float(k + 1)), ("Tbar", N / G),
               ("Tcon", 1.0 if counts.min() == counts.max() else 0.0), ("g_min", float(counts.min())),
               ("g_avg", N / G), ("g_max", float(counts.max())), ("N_g", float(G)), ("sigma_u", sigma_u),
               ("corr", corr), ("r2_o", r2_o), ("r2_b", r2_b), ("sigma_e", sigma_e),
               ("sigma", float(np.sqrt(sigma_u ** 2 + sigma_e ** 2))), ("rho", rho), ("df_m", float(k + G - 1)),
               ("df_b", float(k)), ("ll_0", ll_0), ("ll", ll), ("tss", tss), ("df_a", float(G - 1)),
               ("r2_a", r2_a), ("rss", rss), ("mss", tss_w - rss), ("rmse", sigma_e), ("r2", r2_w), ("F", F),
               ("df_r", float(df_r)), ("N", float(N))]
    if n_clust is not None:
        scalars.insert(scalars.index(("N", float(N))), ("N_clust", float(n_clust)))   # VERIFY position
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("xtreg", args)), ("cmd", "xtreg"), ("marginsnotok", "E U UE SCore STDP XBU"),
              ("predict", "xtrefe_p"), ("model", "fe"), ("vce", smp.vce if vcetype else "conventional")]
    if vcetype:
        macros += [("vcetype", vcetype), ("clustvar", est.clustvar)]
    macros += [("ivar", pvar), ("depvar", smp.depname), ("properties", "b V"), ("absvar", pvar)]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    display_xtreg(s, est)


def _xtreg_re(s, smp, args, y, Xs, est_cols, ids, inv, counts, G, N, k, pvar):
    # Swamy-Arora: σe² from within, σu² from between (harmonic T̄)
    yw = _demean(y, ids, inv, counts)
    Xw = np.column_stack([_demean(Xs[:, j], ids, inv, counts) for j in range(k)]) if k else Xs
    keepw = [j for j in range(k) if not np.allclose(Xw[:, j], 0)]
    Aw = np.linalg.inv(Xw[:, keepw].T @ Xw[:, keepw]) if keepw else np.zeros((0, 0))
    bw = Aw @ (Xw[:, keepw].T @ yw) if keepw else np.zeros(0)
    ew = yw - Xw[:, keepw] @ bw
    sig_e2 = float(ew @ ew) / (N - G - len(keepw))
    yb = _group_means(y, inv, counts)
    Xb = np.column_stack([_group_means(Xs[:, j], inv, counts) for j in range(k)] + [np.ones(G)])
    bb_, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xb, yb, rcond=None)
    eb = yb - Xb @ bb_
    Tbar = G / np.sum(1.0 / counts)
    sig_u2 = max(float(eb @ eb) / (G - (k + 1)) - sig_e2 / Tbar, 0.0)
    theta_i = 1 - np.sqrt(sig_e2 / (counts * sig_u2 + sig_e2))
    th = theta_i[inv]
    ys = y - th * yb[inv]
    Xstar = np.column_stack([Xs - th[:, None] * Xb[inv, :k], 1 - th])
    A = np.linalg.inv(Xstar.T @ Xstar)
    b = A @ (Xstar.T @ ys)
    e = ys - Xstar @ b
    V = (float(e @ e) / (N - (k + 1))) * A   # VERIFY: s² of the transformed regression
    vcetype = ""
    n_clust = None
    if smp.vce in ("robust", "cluster"):
        cl = smp.cluster if smp.vce == "cluster" else ids
        V, n_clust = _cluster_vce(Xstar, e, cl, A, N, k + 1, g_count_adjust=False)
        vcetype = "Robust"
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    chi2 = float(b[:k] @ np.linalg.solve(V[:k, :k], b[:k])) if k else 0.0
    p = float(_chi2_tail(chi2, k)) if k else SYS
    xb_all = Xs @ b[:k]
    r2_w = float(np.corrcoef(_demean(xb_all, ids, inv, counts), yw)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    r2_b = float(np.corrcoef(_group_means(xb_all, inv, counts), yb)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    r2_o = float(np.corrcoef(xb_all, y)[0, 1] ** 2) if k else 0.0
    sigma_u, sigma_e = np.sqrt(sig_u2), np.sqrt(sig_e2)
    rho = sig_u2 / (sig_u2 + sig_e2)
    names, bf, Vf = _full(smp.cols, True, b, V)
    bmap, semap = _maps(smp.cols, b, V, True)
    rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=True)
    est = Estimates("xtreg", smp.depname, names, bf, Vf, N, "z", None)
    est.rows = rows
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, True, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = vcetype, (smp.clustvar or pvar) if vcetype else "", n_clust
    est.model = "re"
    est.extra = dict(N=N, G=G, tmin=int(counts.min()), tmax=int(counts.max()), tbar=N / G, r2_w=r2_w,
                     r2_b=r2_b, r2_o=r2_o, chi2=chi2, p=p, df_m=k, sigma_u=sigma_u, sigma_e=sigma_e, rho=rho,
                     pvar=pvar, theta=float(theta_i[0]) if counts.min() == counts.max() else None)
    est.display = display_xtreg
    est.predict = _predict_xt
    est.predict_opts = {"u": 1, "e": 1, "ue": 2, "xbu": 3}
    scalars = [("N", float(N)), ("N_g", float(G)), ("df_m", float(k)), ("sigma_u", sigma_u), ("sigma_e", sigma_e),
               ("r2_w", r2_w), ("r2_o", r2_o), ("r2_b", r2_b), ("chi2", chi2), ("rho", rho),
               ("Tbar", Tbar), ("g_min", float(counts.min())), ("g_avg", N / G), ("g_max", float(counts.max())),
               ("rank", float(k + 1))]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("xtreg", args)), ("cmd", "xtreg"), ("depvar", smp.depname), ("ivar", pvar),
              ("model", "re"), ("title", "Random-effects GLS regression"), ("chi2type", "Wald"),
              ("vce", smp.vce if vcetype else "conventional"), ("properties", "b V"), ("predict", "xtrefe_p")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    display_xtreg(s, est)

def _predict_xt(s, est, stat, mask):
    """predict after xtreg: xb, stdp, ue (u_i + e_it), u, e and xbu ([XT] xtreg postestimation).
    u_i: mean residual of the panel (fe and be) or its shrunken estimate T s_u^2 / (T s_u^2 + s_e^2)
    times the mean residual (re; VERIFY)."""
    from .postest import design_all, xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        note = "(option xb assumed; fitted values)" if not stat else ""
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), note
    if stat == "stdp":
        X, _ = design_all(s, est)
        return np.where(ok, np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", X, est.V, X), 0)), SYS), ""
    if stat not in ("ue", "u", "e", "xbu"):
        raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")
    ds = s.data
    yv = fvars.comp_values(ds, est.depcomp)
    pvar = est.extra["pvar"]
    ids = ds.get(pvar).data
    smp = ds.esample if getattr(ds, "esample", None) is not None and len(ds.esample) == ds.nobs \
        else np.ones(ds.nobs, bool)
    good = ok & (yv < SYS) & (ids < SYS)
    res = np.where(good, yv - xb, 0.0)
    use = good & smp
    uniq, inv = np.unique(np.where(ids < SYS, ids, -1e300), return_inverse=True)
    tot = np.bincount(inv, weights=np.where(use, res, 0.0), minlength=len(uniq))
    cnt = np.bincount(inv, weights=use.astype(float), minlength=len(uniq))
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
        u = np.where(cnt > 0, tot / cnt, 0.0)
    if est.model == "re":
        su2, se2 = est.extra["sigma_u"] ** 2, est.extra["sigma_e"] ** 2
        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
            u = u * (cnt * su2 / (cnt * su2 + se2))
    ui = u[inv]
    if stat == "ue":
        return np.where(good, yv - xb, SYS), ""
    if stat == "u":
        return np.where(ok & (ids < SYS) & (cnt[inv] > 0), ui, SYS), ""
    if stat == "e":
        return np.where(good & (cnt[inv] > 0), yv - xb - ui, SYS), ""
    return np.where(ok & (ids < SYS) & (cnt[inv] > 0), xb + ui, SYS), ""

def cmd_areg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "areg", args)
        return
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"absorb": 1}, weights=("aweight", "fweight", "pweight"))
    o = smp.o
    if not o.get("absorb"):
        raise StataError(198, "option absorb() required")
    from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
    ds = s.data
    avar = resolve_name(ds, str(o["absorb"]).strip())
    av = ds.get(avar).data
    if np.any(av[smp.mask] >= SYS):
        smp.mask &= av < SYS   # VERIFY
    ids = av[smp.mask]
    uniq, inv, counts = np.unique(ids, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    G = len(uniq)
    y = smp.y.astype(float)
    out = s.output
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, True)
    for nm in notes:
        out.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    Xs = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols]) if est_cols else np.zeros((len(y), 0))
    N, k = len(y), Xs.shape[1]
    yw = _demean(y, ids, inv, counts)
    Xw = np.column_stack([_demean(Xs[:, j], ids, inv, counts) for j in range(k)]) if k else Xs
    A = np.linalg.inv(Xw.T @ Xw) if k else np.zeros((0, 0))
    b = A @ (Xw.T @ yw) if k else np.zeros(0)
    e = yw - Xw @ b
    rss = float(e @ e)
    df_r = N - G - k
    s2 = rss / df_r
    xbar, ybar = Xs.mean(axis=0), y.mean()
    cons = ybar - float(xbar @ b)
    Xa = np.column_stack([Xw + xbar, np.ones(N)])
    Aa = np.linalg.inv(Xa.T @ Xa)
    V = s2 * Aa
    vcetype, n_clust = "", None
    if smp.vce in ("robust", "cluster"):
        if smp.vce == "cluster":
            V, n_clust = _cluster_vce(Xa, e, smp.cluster, Aa, N, k + G)
            df_r = n_clust - 1
        else:
            sc = Xa * e[:, None]
            V = (N / df_r) * Aa @ (sc.T @ sc) @ Aa
        vcetype = "Robust"
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    bb = np.append(b, cons)
    tss = float(np.sum((y - ybar) ** 2))
    r2 = 1 - rss / tss
    r2_a = 1 - (1 - r2) * (N - 1) / df_r
    F = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(V[:k, :k], b)) / k if k else SYS
    pF = float(st.f.sf(F, k, df_r)) if k else SYS
    Xp = np.column_stack([Xs, np.ones(N)])
    bp = np.linalg.lstsq(Xp, y, rcond=None)[0]
    rss_p = float(np.sum((y - Xp @ bp) ** 2))
    F_abs = ((rss_p - rss) / (G - 1)) / (rss / (N - G - k))
    p_abs = float(st.f.sf(F_abs, G - 1, N - G - k))
    names, bf, Vf = _full(smp.cols, True, bb, V)
    bmap, semap = _maps(smp.cols, bb, V, True)
    rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=True)
    est = Estimates("areg", smp.depname, names, bf, Vf, N, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, True, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = vcetype, smp.clustvar, n_clust
    est.extra = dict(N=N, G=G, F=F, pF=pF, df_m=k, df_r=df_r, r2=r2, r2_a=r2_a, rmse=np.sqrt(s2),
                     F_abs=F_abs, p_abs=p_abs, avar=avar)
    est.display = display_areg
    est.predict = _predict_xt
    est.predict_opts = {"u": 1, "e": 1, "ue": 2, "xbu": 3}
    scalars = [("N", float(N)), ("tss", tss), ("df_m", float(k)), ("rss", rss), ("df_r", float(df_r)),
               ("r2", r2), ("r2_a", r2_a), ("F", F), ("rmse", np.sqrt(s2)), ("df_a", float(G - 1)),
               ("F_absorb", F_abs), ("rank", float(k + 1))]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("areg", args)), ("cmd", "areg"), ("depvar", smp.depname), ("absvar", avar),
              ("title", "Linear regression, absorbing indicators"),
              ("vce", smp.vce), ("properties", "b V"), ("predict", "areg_p")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    display_areg(s, est)

"""xtpoisson (fe, re) and xtlogit (fe, re) ([XT] xtpoisson, [XT] xtlogit).

- xtpoisson, fe: conditional likelihood (multinomial within the group);
- xtpoisson, re: gamma effect, closed-form likelihood;
- xtlogit, fe: conditional logit (sum over the subsets with the same
  total, by dynamic programming);
- xtlogit, re: normal effect integrated by adaptive Gauss-Hermite with 12
  points (Stata's default is mvaghermite with 12 points; details of the
  adaptation VERIFY).

Layouts checked against case 0804."""

from __future__ import annotations

from ..lazy import lazy
