def _g(x, fmt="%10.0g"):
    return g9(x, fmt)


def _num_grad(f, b, h=1e-5):
    g = np.zeros_like(b)
    for i in range(len(b)):
        e = np.zeros_like(b)
        hh = h * (abs(b[i]) + 1)
        e[i] = hh
        g[i] = (f(b + e) - f(b - e)) / (2 * hh)
    return g


class _Panel:
    def __init__(self, s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str, extra_opts: dict | None = None,
                 constant: bool | None = None, need_dep: bool = True):
        from .tsops import panel_info
        self.s = s
        spec = {"fe": 2, "re": 2, "pa": 2, "i": 1, "or": 2, "irr": 3, "exposure": 3,
                "offset": 3, "normal": 4, "intpoints": 4, "intmethod": 4, "mle": 3}
        spec.update(extra_opts or {})
        self.pr = _Prep(s, args, spec, constant=constant, need_dep=need_dep)
        o = self.pr.o
        ds = s.data
        pvar = str(o["i"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("i"), str) else panel_info(ds)
        if not pvar:
            raise StataError(459, "panel variable not set; use xtset varname ...")
        self.pvar = pvar
        ids = ds.get(pvar).data[self.pr.smp.mask]
        self.uniq, self.inv = np.unique(ids, return_inverse=True)
        self.fe = bool(o.get("fe"))
        self.y = self.pr.y.astype(float) if self.pr.y is not None else None


def _obs_per_group(inv: np.ndarray):
    cnt = np.bincount(inv)

def _finish(s, P: _Panel, cmd: str, args: str, b, V, res, names_extra, title, sub, keep_groups, ll0=None,
            chibar=None, aux_rows=(), eform="", lr0=None, intpoints=None, intmethod="mvaghermite",
            robust=None, extra_scalars=(), extra_macros=(), footer=None, chi2_V=None):
    pr = P.pr
    smp = pr.smp
    fe = P.fe and not getattr(P, "fe_cons", False)      # xtnbreg, fe reports _cons (compat 1905)
    k = pr.X.shape[1] + (0 if fe else (1 if pr.constant else 0))

def cmd_xtreg_mle(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """Random-effects linear model by maximum likelihood ([XT] xtreg, mle): y_it = x_it b + u_i +
    e_it, u_i ~ N(0, s_u^2), e_it ~ N(0, s_e^2); parameters b, ln s_u and ln s_e."""
    P = _Panel(s, "xtreg", args)
    pr = P.pr
    y, X, inv = P.y, pr.X, P.inv
    Xc = np.column_stack([X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else X
    k = Xc.shape[1]
    G = int(inv.max()) + 1
    T = np.bincount(inv, minlength=G).astype(float)

    def ll_of(Z):
        kz = Z.shape[1]

        def ll(par):
            b, lsu, lse = par[:kz], par[kz], par[kz + 1]
            su2, se2 = math.exp(2 * lsu), math.exp(2 * lse)
            e = y - Z @ b
            s1 = np.bincount(inv, weights=e, minlength=G)
            s2 = np.bincount(inv, weights=e * e, minlength=G)
            a = su2 / (se2 * (se2 + T * su2))
            return float(-0.5 * (s2 / se2 - a * s1 * s1 + np.log1p(T * su2 / se2)
                                 + T * math.log(2 * math.pi * se2)).sum())

        def fun(par, todo):
            v = ll(par)
            if todo == 0:
                return v, None, None
            g = _num_grad(ll, par)
            return v, g, num_hess(lambda q: _num_grad(ll, q), par)
        return fun

    def start(Z):
        b0, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, y, rcond=None)
        e = y - Z @ b0
        sd = float(np.std(e)) or 1.0
        return np.concatenate([b0, [math.log(sd / 2), math.log(sd)]])

    out = s.output
    from .ml import print_log
    one = np.ones((len(y), 1))
    r0 = pr.maximize(ll_of(one), start(one)) if pr.constant else None
    res = pr.maximize(ll_of(Xc), start(Xc))
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        if r0 is not None:
            out.write("\nFitting constant-only model:\n", "text")
            print_log(out, r0, "log likelihood")
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    V = np.linalg.inv(-res.H)
    from .results import crit
    c = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    lsu, lse = float(res.b[k]), float(res.b[k + 1])
    se_su, se_se = float(np.sqrt(V[k, k])), float(np.sqrt(V[k + 1, k + 1]))
    su, se_ = math.exp(lsu), math.exp(lse)
    rho = su ** 2 / (su ** 2 + se_ ** 2)
    # rho: delta method from (ln s_u, ln s_e); interval on the logit scale (VERIFY)
    grad = np.array([2 * rho * (1 - rho), -2 * rho * (1 - rho)])
    se_rho = float(math.sqrt(grad @ V[k:k + 2, k:k + 2] @ grad))
    lr = math.log(rho / (1 - rho)) if 0 < rho < 1 else 0.0
    se_lr = se_rho / (rho * (1 - rho)) if 0 < rho < 1 else 0.0
    aux = [CoefRow("sep"),
           CoefRow("aux", "/sigma_u", su, su * se_su, eq=f"{math.exp(lsu - c * se_su)} {math.exp(lsu + c * se_su)}"),
           CoefRow("aux", "/sigma_e", se_, se_ * se_se, eq=f"{math.exp(lse - c * se_se)} {math.exp(lse + c * se_se)}"),
           CoefRow("aux", "rho", rho, se_rho,
                   eq=f"{1 / (1 + math.exp(-(lr - c * se_lr)))} {1 / (1 + math.exp(-(lr + c * se_lr)))}")]
    # LR test of sigma_u = 0 against the pooled regression
    b_ols, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xc, y, rcond=None)
    rss = float(((y - Xc @ b_ols) ** 2).sum())
    n = len(y)
    ll_ols = -0.5 * n * (math.log(2 * math.pi * rss / n) + 1)
    chib = max(2 * (res.ll - ll_ols), 0.0)
    pchib = 0.5 * chi2_tail(chib, 1) if chib > 0 else 0.5
    lr0 = r0.ll if r0 is not None else None
    _finish(s, P, "xtreg", args, res.b, V, res, ["/sigma_u", "/sigma_e"], "Random-effects ML regression",
            "Random effects u_i ~ Gaussian", np.ones(len(y), bool),
            chibar=("LR test of sigma_u=0", chib, pchib), aux_rows=aux, lr0=lr0)
    s.e["model"] = "ml"
    s.e["sigma_u"], s.e["sigma_e"], s.e["rho"] = su, se_, rho

def cmd_xtpoisson(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "xtpoisson", args)
        return
    from .xtgee import run_pa
    if run_pa(s, "xtpoisson", args):
        return
    P = _Panel(s, "xtpoisson", args)
    pr = P.pr
    y, X, inv = P.y, pr.X, P.inv
    if np.any(y < 0) or np.any(y != np.trunc(y)):
        raise StataError(459, f"{pr.smp.depname} must be nonnegative integers")   # VERIFY
    out = s.output
    eform = "IRR" if pr.o.get("irr") else ""
    if P.fe:
        tot = np.bincount(inv, weights=y)
        keep = tot[inv] > 0
        drop_g = int((tot == 0).sum())
        if drop_g:
            out.write(f"note: {drop_g} group{'s' if drop_g > 1 else ''} ({int((~keep).sum())} obs) dropped because "
                      "of all zero outcomes\n", "text")
        yk, Xk = y[keep], X[keep]
        _, invk = np.unique(inv[keep], return_inverse=True)
        G = invk.max() + 1
        nk = np.bincount(invk, weights=yk)
        const = float(special.gammaln(nk + 1).sum() - special.gammaln(yk + 1).sum())

        def fun(b, todo):
            eta = Xk @ b
            mx = np.full(G, -np.inf)
            np.maximum.at(mx, invk, eta)
            e = np.exp(eta - mx[invk])
            den = np.bincount(invk, weights=e, minlength=G)
            lse = np.log(den) + mx
            ll = float(yk @ eta - nk @ lse) + const
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            pi = e / den[invk]
            xbar = np.zeros((G, Xk.shape[1]))
            np.add.at(xbar, invk, Xk * pi[:, None])
            g = Xk.T @ yk - nk @ xbar
            Xc = Xk - xbar[invk]
            H = -(Xc * (pi * nk[invk])[:, None]).T @ Xc
            return ll, g, H
        res = pr.maximize(fun, np.zeros(X.shape[1]))
        if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
            from .ml import print_log
            out.write("\n", "text")
            print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
        V = np.linalg.inv(-res.H)
        _finish(s, P, "xtpoisson", args, res.b, V, res, [], "Conditional fixed-effects Poisson regression", "",
                keep, eform=eform)
        return
    # gamma random effects
    Xc = np.column_stack([X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else X
    k = Xc.shape[1]
    lgy = special.gammaln(y + 1)
    G = inv.max() + 1
    n_i = np.bincount(inv, weights=y, minlength=G)

    def ll_re(par):
        b, lna = par[:k], par[k]
        eta = Xc @ b
        u = np.exp(np.clip(eta, -700, 700))
        th = math.exp(-lna)
        U = np.bincount(inv, weights=u, minlength=G)
        return float((y * eta - lgy).sum() + (special.gammaln(th + n_i) - special.gammaln(th)
                                               + th * math.log(th) - (th + n_i) * np.log(th + U)).sum())

    def fun(par, todo):
        ll = ll_re(par)
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        g = _num_grad(ll_re, par)
        H = num_hess(lambda q: _num_grad(ll_re, q), par)
        return ll, g, H
    # start: pooled Poisson and ln(alpha) = 0
    from .models import _poisson
    pf, _ = _poisson(y, Xc, np.ones(len(y)), np.zeros(len(y)))
    from .ml import maximize, print_log
    b0 = np.zeros(k)
    if pr.constant:
        b0[-1] = math.log(max(y.mean(), 1e-8))
    rp = maximize(pf, b0)
    # Stata shows the Poisson starting already at the optimum (iterations 0 and 1 equal; compat
    # 0804): the exact fit stays out of the log
    rp = maximize(pf, rp.b)
    res = pr.maximize(fun, np.concatenate([rp.b, [0.0]]))
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting Poisson model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, rp, "log likelihood")
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    V = np.linalg.inv(-res.H)
    lna, se_lna = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    alpha = math.exp(lna)
    from .results import crit
    c = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    aux = [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("aux", "/lnalpha", lna, se_lna, name="_cons"), CoefRow("sep"),
           CoefRow("aux", "alpha", alpha, alpha * se_lna,
                   eq=f"{math.exp(lna - c * se_lna)} {math.exp(lna + c * se_lna)}")]
    chib = max(2 * (res.ll - rp.ll), 0.0)
    pchib = 0.5 * chi2_tail(chib, 1) if chib > 0 else 0.5
    _finish(s, P, "xtpoisson", args, res.b, V, res, ["/lnalpha"], "Random-effects Poisson regression",
            "Random effects u_i ~ Gamma", np.ones(len(y), bool), chibar=("LR test of alpha=0", chib, pchib),
            aux_rows=aux, eform=eform)

def _clogit_ll(eta: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """log P(y | Σy) of the conditional logit for one group."""
    k = int(y.sum())
    T = len(eta)
    # f[j] = log Σ_{|S|=j} exp(Σ_S eta), over the observations seen so far
    f = np.full(k + 1, -np.inf)
    f[0] = 0.0
    for t in range(T):
        upto = min(t + 1, k)
        for j in range(upto, 0, -1):
            f[j] = np.logaddexp(f[j], f[j - 1] + eta[t])
    return float(eta @ y - f[k])


def cmd_xtlogit(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "xtlogit", args)
        return
    from .xtgee import run_pa
    if run_pa(s, "xtlogit", args):
        return
    P = _Panel(s, "xtlogit", args)
    pr = P.pr
    y = (P.y != 0).astype(float)
    X, inv = pr.X, P.inv
    out = s.output
    eform = "OR" if pr.o.get("or") else ""
    from .ml import print_log
    if P.fe:
        tot = np.bincount(inv, weights=y)
        cnt = np.bincount(inv)
        good = (tot > 0) & (tot < cnt)
        keep = good[inv]
        dg = int((~good).sum())
        if np.any(tot[good] > 1):
            # this note comes before the one about dropped groups (compat 0804)
            out.write("note: multiple positive outcomes within groups encountered.\n", "text")
        if dg:
            out.write(f"note: {dg} group{'s' if dg > 1 else ''} ({int((~keep).sum())} obs) dropped because of "
                      "all positive or\n      all negative outcomes.\n", "text")
        groups = [np.flatnonzero((inv == g)) for g in np.flatnonzero(good)]

        def ll_fe(b):
            eta = X @ b
            return sum(_clogit_ll(eta[ix], y[ix]) for ix in groups)

        def fun(b, todo):
            ll = ll_fe(b)
            if todo == 0:
                return ll, None, None
            g = _num_grad(ll_fe, b)
            return ll, g, num_hess(lambda q: _num_grad(ll_fe, q), b)
        # start: pooled logit (with a constant) on the groups kept (compat 0804)
        from .ml import maximize
        from .models import _logit
        Xk = np.column_stack([X[keep], np.ones(int(keep.sum()))])
        lk, _ = _logit(y[keep], Xk, np.ones(int(keep.sum())))
        b_start = maximize(lk, np.zeros(Xk.shape[1])).b[:-1]
        res = pr.maximize(fun, b_start)
        if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
            out.write("\n", "text")
            print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
        V = np.linalg.inv(-res.H)
        _finish(s, P, "xtlogit", args, res.b, V, res, [], "Conditional fixed-effects logistic regression", "",
                keep, eform="Odds Ratio" if eform else "", lr0=ll_fe(np.zeros(X.shape[1])))
        return
    Xc = np.column_stack([X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else X
    k = Xc.shape[1]
    from ..core import panelquad as pq
    from .xtre import _quad_options
    nq, adaptive, meth = _quad_options(P)
    grp = pq.Groups(inv)
    sign = 2 * y - 1

    def f(u):
        return pq.ll_logit(u, sign)

    def ll_re(par):
        return pq.re_loglik(f, Xc @ par[:k], grp, math.exp(0.5 * par[k]), nq, adaptive)

    def fun(par, todo):
        ll = ll_re(par)
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        g = _num_grad(ll_re, par)
        return ll, g, num_hess(lambda q: _num_grad(ll_re, q), par)
    from .ml import maximize
    from .models import _logit
    lf, _ = _logit(y, Xc, np.ones(len(y)))
    b0 = np.zeros(k)
    if pr.constant:
        p0 = y.mean()
        b0[-1] = math.log(p0 / (1 - p0))
    rl = maximize(lf, b0)
    # search over tau = sigma2/(1 + sigma2) with the pooled logit coefficients and plain
    # Gauss-Hermite quadrature, until the likelihood falls; the full model starts from the best tau
    # (compat 0804)

    grid = pq.tau_grid(f, Xc @ rl.b, grp, rl.ll, nq)
    best_t = max(grid, key=lambda tv: tv[1])[0]
    start_l2 = math.log(best_t / (1 - best_t)) if best_t > 0 else 0.0
    res = pr.maximize(fun, np.concatenate([rl.b, [start_l2]]))
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting comparison model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, rl, "log likelihood")
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
        for tv, lv in grid:
            out.write(f"tau = {tv:4.1f}     log likelihood = {_g(lv).strip():>10}\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    V = np.linalg.inv(-res.H)
    l2, se2 = float(res.b[-1]), float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    sig = math.exp(0.5 * l2)
    rho = sig ** 2 / (sig ** 2 + math.pi ** 2 / 3)
    from .results import crit
    c = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    lo2, hi2 = l2 - c * se2, l2 + c * se2

    def rho_of(v):
        s2 = math.exp(v)
        return s2 / (s2 + math.pi ** 2 / 3)
    aux = [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("aux", "/lnsig2u", l2, se2, name="_cons"), CoefRow("sep"),
           CoefRow("aux", "sigma_u", sig, 0.5 * sig * se2,
                   eq=f"{math.exp(0.5 * lo2)} {math.exp(0.5 * hi2)}"),
           CoefRow("aux", "rho", rho, rho * (1 - rho) * se2, eq=f"{rho_of(lo2)} {rho_of(hi2)}")]
    chib = max(2 * (res.ll - rl.ll), 0.0)
    pchib = 0.5 * chi2_tail(chib, 1) if chib > 0 else 0.5
    _finish(s, P, "xtlogit", args, res.b, V, res, ["/lnsig2u"], "Random-effects logistic regression",
            "Random effects u_i ~ Gaussian", np.ones(len(y), bool), chibar=("LR test of rho=0", chib, pchib),
            aux_rows=aux, eform="Odds Ratio" if eform else "", intpoints=nq, intmethod=meth)
    s._quadchk = {"cmd": "xtlogit", "args": args, "nq": nq, "adaptive": adaptive, "ll": res.ll}

    base_se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(est.V), 0))

    def fn(bb):
        def rep(m):
            kind, name = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            idx = _coef_index(est, s, name)
            if kind == "_se":
                return repr(float(base_se[idx]))
            return f"({float(bb[idx])!r})"
        t = re.sub(r"(_b|_coef|_se)\[([^\]]+)\]", rep, expr)
        return float(s.eval(t))
    return fn


def _jac(f, b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    from .margins import _jacobian
    return _jacobian(f, b)

def cmd_testnl(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    est = current(s)
    head, comma, opts = args.partition(",")
    if comma and opts.strip():
        match_options(opts, {"iterate": 4, "df": 2})
        raise StataError(198, "options of testnl are not available yet in OpenDTA")
    text = head.strip()
    if text.startswith("("):
        from .postest import _split_parens
        hyps = _split_parens(text)
    else:
        hyps = [text]
    fns, shown = [], []
    for h in hyps:
        lhs, eq_sign, rhs = h.partition("=") if "==" not in h else h.partition("==")
        if eq_sign:
            rhs = rhs.lstrip("=")
            e = f"({lhs}) - ({rhs})"
        else:
            e = f"({lhs})"
        fns.append(_coef_fn(s, est, e))
        shown.append(h.strip())
    b0 = np.asarray(est.b, dtype=float)
    g = np.array([f(b0) for f in fns])
    J = np.vstack([_jac(f, b0) for f in fns])
    GVG = J @ est.V @ J.T
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n", "text")
    for i, h in enumerate(shown, start=1):
        out.write(f"  ({i})  {h}\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    q = len(fns)
    W = float(g @ np.linalg.solve(GVG, g))
    # chi2 also after regress (reference log 1903); the F version is not used
    p = float(chi2_tail(W, q))
    out.write(f"{'chi2(' + str(q) + ') =':>24}", "text")
    out.write(f"{W:>12.2f}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'Prob > chi2 =':>24}", "text")
    out.write(f"{p:>14.4f}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"p": p, "df": float(q), "chi2": W}

_PNL = {"se": 2, "variance": 3, "ci": 2, "force": 5, "g": 1, "wald": 4, "p": 1, "level": 1, "iterate": 4}


def cmd_predictnl(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    est = current(s)
    from ..commands._util import eval_vector, touse
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    from .margins import _transform, _xb
    from .postest import esample
    p = parse_standard(args)
    m = re.match(r"\s*(?:(byte|int|long|float|double)\s+)?(\w+)\s*=\s*(.+)$", p.varlist + (" = " + p.exp if p.exp else "")
                 if "=" not in p.varlist else p.varlist, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    vtype, newvar, expr = m.group(1) or "float", m.group(2), m.group(3).strip()
    o = match_options(p.options, _PNL) if p.options.strip() else {}
    ds = s.data
    if ds.has(newvar):
        raise StataError(110, f"variable {newvar} already defined")
    sample = esample(s) & touse(s, p)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(sample)
    if not len(rows):
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    f_default, _ = _transform(est, "")
    names = {"__pnl_xb": "xb", "__pnl_pr": "pr"}

    def prep(text: str) -> str:
        text = re.sub(r"predict\(\s*xb\s*\)|\bxb\(\s*\)", "__pnl_xb", text)
        text = re.sub(r"predict\(\s*\)", "__pnl_pr", text)
        return text
    expr_t = prep(expr)

    def evaluate(bb: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        xb = _xb(s, est, bb, rows, {})
        for nm, vals in (("__pnl_xb", xb), ("__pnl_pr", f_default(xb, bb))):
            full = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
            full[rows] = vals
            if ds.has(nm):
                ds.get(nm).data = full
            else:
                ds.add(Variable(nm, "double", full))

        def rep(mt):
            return f"({float(bb[_cidx(s, est, mt.group(2))])!r})"
        t = re.sub(r"(_b|_coef)\[([^\]]+)\]", rep, expr_t)
        v = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(eval_vector(s, t), dtype=float), (ds.nobs,))
        return v[rows]
    b0 = np.asarray(est.b, dtype=float)
    try:
        val = evaluate(b0)
        need_se = any(o.get(k) for k in ("se", "variance", "ci", "wald", "p"))
        J = None
        if need_se:
            J = np.zeros((len(rows), b0.size))
            for j in range(b0.size):
                h = 1e-4 * (abs(b0[j]) + 1e-3)

                def D(hh, j=j):
                    a, c = b0.copy(), b0.copy()
                    a[j] += hh
                    c[j] -= hh
                    return (evaluate(a) - evaluate(c)) / (2 * hh)
                J[:, j] = (4 * D(h / 2) - D(h)) / 3
    finally:
        for nm in names:
            if ds.has(nm):
                ds.drop_vars([nm])

    def put(name: str, vals: np.ndarray, vt: str = vtype) -> None:
        full = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        full[rows] = vals
        ds.add(Variable(name, vt, full))
    put(newvar, val)
    if need_se:
        var = np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", J, np.asarray(est.V, dtype=float), J)
        lev = float(o["level"]) if isinstance(o.get("level"), str) else getattr(est, "level", 95.0)
        if isinstance(o.get("se"), str):
            put(o["se"], np.sqrt(np.maximum(var, 0)))
        if isinstance(o.get("variance"), str):
            put(o["variance"], var)
        if isinstance(o.get("ci"), str):
            lo, hi = o["ci"].split()
            z = crit("z", lev, None)
            se_ = np.sqrt(np.maximum(var, 0))
            put(lo, val - z * se_)
            put(hi, val + z * se_)
        if isinstance(o.get("wald"), str):
            put(o["wald"], val ** 2 / var)
        if isinstance(o.get("p"), str):
            put(o["p"], 2 * st.norm.sf(np.abs(val) / np.sqrt(var)))
    n_missing = 0
    if isinstance(val, np.ndarray):
        n_missing = int(np.sum(~np.isfinite(val)))
    if n_missing:
        s.output.write(f"({n_missing} missing value{'s' if n_missing != 1 else ''} generated)\n", "text")


def _cidx(s: "Session", est, name: str) -> int:
    from .postest import _coef_index
    return _coef_index(est, s, name)

def cmd_linktest(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    est = current(s)
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    from .postest import _restore, _snapshot, xb_all
    cmdline = s.e.get("cmdline")
    cmdname = s.e.get("cmd")
    dep = s.e.get("depvar") or est.depvar
    if not isinstance(cmdline, str) or not cmdname or not dep:
        raise StataError(321, "linktest requires a single-equation estimation command")    # VERIFY
    c = find_top(cmdline, ",")
    opts = "" if c == -1 else cmdline[c + 1:].strip()
    body = cmdline if c == -1 else cmdline[:c]
    word, _, rest = body.strip().partition(" ")
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    ds = s.data
    for nm in ("_hat", "_hatsq"):
        if ds.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"variable {nm} already defined")      # VERIFY
    snap = _snapshot(s)
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    smp = np.asarray(ds.esample, dtype=bool) & ok
    xb32 = xb.astype(np.float32).astype(float)       # predict stores _hat as float, as Stata does
    ds.add(Variable("_hat", "float", np.where(smp, xb32, SYS)))
    ds.add(Variable("_hatsq", "float", np.where(smp, (xb32 * xb32).astype(np.float32).astype(float), SYS)))
    parts = [word, dep, "_hat", "_hatsq"]
    if p.weight is not None:
        parts.append(f"[{p.weight[0]}={p.weight[1]}]")
    if p.if_:
        parts.append(f"if {p.if_}")
    if p.in_:
        parts.append(f"in {p.in_}")
    text = " ".join(parts) + (f", {opts}" if opts else "")
    try:
        s.interp._execute_expanded(text)
    finally:
        changed = ds.changed
        ds.drop_vars([n for n in ("_hat", "_hatsq") if ds.has(n)])
        ds.changed = changed
        _restore(s, snap)

# margins of factor terms for contrast and pwcompare
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _term_cells(s: "Session", est, tokens: list[str], asbalanced: bool, rows: np.ndarray):
    """For a factor term (a list of variables): the cell levels, the matrix A (cells × k) with
    margin = A b, and the number of levels of each factor."""
    from .margins import _jacobian, _xb
    ds = s.data
    factor_vars = {c.var for t in est.terms for c in t.comps if c.factor}
    for v in tokens:
        if v not in factor_vars:
            raise StataError(198, f"{v} is not a factor variable in the model")      # VERIFY
    levels = [sorted(set(ds.get(v).data[rows].tolist())) for v in tokens]
    base = {}
    if asbalanced:
        for t in est.terms:
            for comp in t.comps:
                if comp.var in tokens or comp.var in base:
                    continue
                vals = fvars.comp_values(ds, comp)[rows]
                if comp.factor:
                    lv = sorted(set(vals.tolist()))
                    base[comp.var] = {v: 1.0 / len(lv) for v in lv}
                else:
                    base[comp.var] = np.full(len(rows), float(np.mean(vals)))
    b = np.asarray(est.b, dtype=float)
    cells = list(itertools.product(*levels))

    def margin_all(bb):
        out = []
        for cell in cells:
            ov = {k: (dict(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v) for k, v in base.items()}
            for v, lv in zip(tokens, cell):
                ov[v] = np.full(len(rows), lv)
            out.append(float(np.mean(_xb(s, est, bb, rows, ov))))
        return np.array(out)
    A = _jacobian(margin_all, b)
    return cells, A, [len(lv) for lv in levels]


def _label_level(s: "Session", var: str, lv: float) -> str:
    return f"{int(lv)}" if float(lv).is_integer() else f"{lv:g}"


_OPS = ("ar", "r", "a", "g", "h", "j")


def _op_matrix(op: str, n: int):
    """Contrast matrix and labels for n levels (labels use the level positions 1..n)."""
    rows, labs = [], []
    if op in ("", "r"):
        for j in range(1, n):
            v = np.zeros(n)
            v[j], v[0] = 1, -1
            rows.append(v)
            labs.append((j, 0, "vs"))
    elif op == "a":
        for j in range(1, n):
            v = np.zeros(n)
            v[j], v[j - 1] = 1, -1
            rows.append(v)
            labs.append((j, j - 1, "vs"))
    elif op == "ar":
        for j in range(n - 1):
            v = np.zeros(n)
            v[j], v[j + 1] = 1, -1
            rows.append(v)
            labs.append((j, j + 1, "vs"))
    elif op == "g":
        for j in range(n):
            v = np.full(n, -1.0 / n)
            v[j] += 1
            rows.append(v)
            labs.append((j, None, "mean"))
        rows, labs = rows[:-1], labs[:-1]
    elif op == "h":
        for j in range(n - 1):
            v = np.zeros(n)
            v[j] = 1
            v[j + 1:] = -1.0 / (n - 1 - j)
            rows.append(v)
            labs.append((j, None, "next"))
    elif op == "j":
        for j in range(1, n):
            v = np.zeros(n)
            v[j] = 1
            v[:j] = -1.0 / j
            rows.append(v)
            labs.append((j, None, "prev"))
    else:
        raise StataError(198, f"operator {op}. is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    return np.array(rows), labs


def _split_terms(text: str):
    """`r.g a.h g#h` -> [(operator, [vars])]."""
    out = []
    for tok in text.split():
        m = re.match(r"^(?:(" + "|".join(_OPS) + r")\.)?(\w+(?:#\w+)*)$", tok)
        if not m:
            raise StataError(198, f"{tok} is not allowed here")
        op = m.group(1) or ""
        vars_ = [v.split(".")[-1] for v in m.group(2).split("#")]
        out.append((op, vars_, tok))
    return out


def _wald_L(L: np.ndarray, m: np.ndarray, Vm: np.ndarray):
    d = L @ m
    LVL = L @ Vm @ L.T
    rank = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(LVL))
    return float(d @ np.linalg.pinv(LVL) @ d), rank


def cmd_contrast(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    est = current(s)
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"asbalanced": 3, "asobserved": 3, "effects": 2, "level": 1, "nowald": 3,
                                  "noeffects": 3, "pveffects": 2, "cieffects": 2, "mcompare": 2}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    if o.get("mcompare"):
        raise StataError(198, "option mcompare() is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    from .postest import esample
    rows = np.flatnonzero(esample(s))
    asbal = not o.get("asobserved")
    terms = _split_terms(p.varlist)
    if not terms:
        raise StataError(198, "no terms")
    out = s.output
    df_r = est.df_r if est.stat == "t" and est.df_r else None
    stat_name = "F" if df_r else "chi2"
    lev = float(o["level"]) if isinstance(o.get("level"), str) else getattr(est, "level", 95.0)
    results = []
    eff_rows = []
    for op, vars_, tok in terms:
        cells, A, nl = _term_cells(s, est, vars_, asbal, rows)
        Vm = A @ np.asarray(est.V, dtype=float) @ A.T
        m = A @ np.asarray(est.b, dtype=float)
        mats = [_op_matrix(op, n) for n in nl]
        if len(vars_) == 1:
            L, labs = mats[0]
            labels = []
            levs = sorted(set(c[0] for c in cells))
            for (a_, b_, kind) in labs:
                la = _label_level(s, vars_[0], levs[a_])
                if kind == "vs":
                    labels.append(f"({la} vs {_label_level(s, vars_[0], levs[b_])})")
                elif kind == "mean":
                    labels.append(f"({la} vs mean)")
                elif kind == "next":
                    labels.append(f"({la} vs next)")      # VERIFY
                else:
                    labels.append(f"({la} vs previous)")  # VERIFY
        else:
            L = np.array([np.kron(*[mm[0][i] for mm in mats[:1]], mats[1][0][j])
                          for i in range(len(mats[0][0])) for j in range(len(mats[1][0]))]) \
                if len(vars_) == 2 else None
            if L is None:
                raise StataError(198, "interactions of more than two factors are not available yet")
            labels = []
        joint, rank = _wald_L(L, m, Vm)
        results.append((tok, labels, L, m, Vm, joint, rank))
    out.write("\nContrasts of marginal linear predictions\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"Margins      : {'asbalanced' if asbal else 'asobserved'}\n\n", "text")
    hdr = f"{'df':>11}{stat_name:>12}{'P>' + stat_name:>11}"
    width = 13 + 1 + 34
    out.write("-" * width + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>13}|{hdr}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 34 + "\n", "text")

    def line(label: str, df: int, w: float) -> None:
        if df_r:
            f_ = w / df
            pv = float(st.f.sf(f_, df, df_r))
            val = f_
        else:
            pv = float(chi2_tail(w, df))
            val = w
        out.write(f"{label + ' ' if label.startswith('(') or label == 'Joint' else label:>12} |", "text")
        out.write(f"{df:>11}{val:>12.2f}{pv:>11.4f}\n", "result")
    for tok, labels, L, m, Vm, joint, rank in results:
        op_given = "." in tok
        if not op_given or not labels:
            line(tok.split(".")[-1], rank, joint)
            continue
        out.write(f"{tok.split('.')[-1]:>12} |\n", "text")
        for lab, row in zip(labels, L):
            w, rk = _wald_L(row.reshape(1, -1), m, Vm)
            line(lab, rk, w)
            eff_rows.append((lab, float(row @ m), float(np.sqrt(max(row @ Vm @ row, 0)))))
        line("Joint", rank, joint)
    out.write(f"{'':>13}|\n", "text")
    if df_r:
        out.write(f"{'Denominator':>12} |{int(df_r):>11}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * width + "\n", "text")
    if o.get("effects") and eff_rows:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        rws = [CoefRow("coef", lab, b_, se_) for lab, b_, se_ in eff_rows]
        coef_table(s, "", rws, stat="t" if df_r else "z", df=df_r, level=lev, coef_title="Contrast")
    elif eff_rows:
        # with a contrast operator the table of contrasts with intervals follows (VERIFY: when the
        # operator is not given, or with several terms, the reference log has no such table)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        tcrit = float(st.t.ppf(1 - (1 - lev / 100) / 2, df_r)) if df_r else float(st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - lev / 100) / 2))
        out.write("-" * 62 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':>13}|   Contrast   Std. Err.     [{lev:g}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 48 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{results[0][0].split('.')[-1]:>12} |\n", "text")
        for lab, b_, se_ in eff_rows:
            out.write(f"{lab + ' ':>12} |", "text")
            out.write(f" {g9(b_):>10} {g9(se_):>10}     {g9(b_ - tcrit * se_):>9}   {g9(b_ + tcrit * se_):>9}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 62 + "\n", "text")
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    names = [tok.split(".")[-1] for tok, *_ in results]
    stat_v = [(j / rk if df_r else j) for *_, j, rk in results]
    dfs = [float(rk) for *_, rk in results]
    pvs = [float(st.f.sf(v, d, df_r)) if df_r else float(chi2_tail(v, d)) for v, d in zip(stat_v, dfs)]
    row = lambda v: Matrix(np.array([v], dtype=float), ["r1"], names)    # noqa: E731
    # VERIFY: the names and order of what contrast leaves in r()
    s.r = {"p": row(pvs), "df": row(dfs), stat_name: row(stat_v), "level": lev,
           "k_terms": float(len(results))}
    if df_r:
        s.r["df_r"] = float(df_r)

def _adjust(method: str, tval: float, df, m: int, k: int, level: float):
    """(adjusted p, critical value) for a comparison under the multiple-comparison method."""
    a = 1 - level / 100
    p = 2 * (st.t.sf(abs(tval), df) if df else st.norm.sf(abs(tval)))
    if method in ("", "noadjust"):
        return p, (st.t.ppf(1 - a / 2, df) if df else st.norm.ppf(1 - a / 2))
    if method == "bonferroni":
        return min(1.0, p * m), (st.t.ppf(1 - a / (2 * m), df) if df else st.norm.ppf(1 - a / (2 * m)))
    if method == "sidak":
        a2 = 1 - (1 - a) ** (1.0 / m)
        return 1 - (1 - p) ** m, (st.t.ppf(1 - a2 / 2, df) if df else st.norm.ppf(1 - a2 / 2))
    if method == "scheffe":
        f_ = tval ** 2 / (k - 1)
        crit_ = np.sqrt((k - 1) * st.f.ppf(1 - a, k - 1, df))
        return float(st.f.sf(f_, k - 1, df)), float(crit_)
    if method == "tukey":
        q = abs(tval) * np.sqrt(2)
        return float(st.studentized_range.sf(q, k, df)), float(st.studentized_range.ppf(1 - a, k, df) / np.sqrt(2))
    raise StataError(198, f"mcompare({method}) is not available yet in OpenDTA")


def _pairwise_table(s: "Session", term: str, labels: list[str], means: np.ndarray, Vm: np.ndarray,
                    df, o: dict, lev: float, title_lines: list[str], lhs: str = "") -> None:
    out = s.output
    method = str(o.get("mcompare") or "noadjust").lower()
    k = len(labels)
    pairs = [(j, i) for i in range(k) for j in range(i + 1, k)]
    m = len(pairs)
    eff = o.get("effects")
    pv_eff = o.get("pveffects")
    adj = method not in ("noadjust", "")
    rows, tvals = [], []
    for (j, i) in pairs:
        d = means[j] - means[i]
        se = float(np.sqrt(max(Vm[j, j] + Vm[i, i] - 2 * Vm[i, j], 0)))
        tv = d / se if se > 0 else np.nan
        p, c = _adjust(method, tv, df, m, k, lev) if se > 0 else (np.nan, np.nan)
        rows.append((f"{labels[j]} vs {labels[i]}", d, se, tv, p, c))
    for ln in title_lines:
        out.write(ln, "text")
    lv = f"{lev:g}"
    tag = {"noadjust": "Unadjusted", "bonferroni": "Bonferroni", "sidak": "Sidak", "scheffe": "Scheffe",
           "tukey": "Tukey"}.get(method, method.title())
    effects = bool(eff or pv_eff)
    cw = 13 + 1 + (64 if effects else 48)
    if adj:
        out.write("-" * 27 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':>13}|    Number of\n{'':>13}|  Comparisons\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 13 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{term:>12} |{m:>13}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 27 + "\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * cw + "\n", "text")
    if effects:
        if adj:
            # VERIFY: the position of the method name over the P>|t| and the interval columns
            p1 = 33 - (len(tag) + 1) // 2
            p2 = 54 - (len(tag) + 1) // 2
            out.write(f"{'':>13}|{' ' * p1}{tag}{' ' * (p2 - p1 - len(tag))}{tag}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{lhs:>12} |   Contrast   Std. Err.      {'t' if df else 'z'}    P>|{'t' if df else 'z'}|     "
                  f"[{lv}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    else:
        if adj:
            out.write(f"{'':>13}|{' ' * (38 - (len(tag) + 1) // 2)}{tag}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{lhs:>12} |   Contrast   Std. Err.     [{lv}% Conf. Interval]\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * (cw - 14) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{term:>12} |\n", "text")

def cells_of(s: "Session", overs: list[str], mask: np.ndarray):
    """Cells of the over() variables (sorted) with their labels, and the cell number of each row."""
    from ..commands.inspect import cell_text
    ds = s.data
    cols = []
    for v in overs:
        var = ds.get(v)
        cols.append(np.asarray(var.raw, dtype=object) if var.is_string else var.data)
    keys = {}
    for i in np.flatnonzero(mask):
        keys.setdefault(tuple(c[i] for c in cols), i)
    order = sorted(keys)
    labels = ["#".join(cell_text(ds, ds.get(v), keys[k]).strip() for v, _ in zip(overs, k)) for k in order]
    ids = np.full(ds.nobs, -1)
    pos = {k: j for j, k in enumerate(order)}
    for i in np.flatnonzero(mask):
        ids[i] = pos[tuple(c[i] for c in cols)]

def _scores_hessian(s: "Session", est):
    """Per-observation scores (n × p) over all rows, Hessian (p × p), parameter names and the
    equation names, for regress, logit, probit and poisson."""
    from .postest import design_all
    cmd = getattr(est, "ml_cmd", est.cmd)
    if cmd == "logistic":
        cmd = "logit"
    ds = s.data
    X, ok = design_all(s, est)
    sample = np.asarray(ds.esample, dtype=bool) & ok if ds.esample is not None else ok
    y = ds.get(est.depvar).data
    n, k = X.shape
    b = np.asarray(est.b, dtype=float)
    xb = X @ b[:k] if len(b) >= k else X @ b
    if getattr(est, "offset_name", None):
        nm = est.offset_name
        xb = xb + (np.log(ds.get(nm[3:-1]).data) if nm.startswith("ln(") else ds.get(nm).data)
    smp = sample.copy()
    if cmd == "regress":
        e = np.where(smp, y - xb, 0.0)
        nn = smp.sum()
        sig2 = float((e[smp] ** 2).sum() / nn)
        S = np.column_stack([X * (e / sig2)[:, None], np.where(smp, 0.5 * (e ** 2 / sig2 - 1), 0.0)])
        H = np.zeros((k + 1, k + 1))
        Xs = X[smp]
        H[:k, :k] = -Xs.T @ Xs / sig2
        H[:k, k] = H[k, :k] = -(Xs.T @ e[smp]) / sig2
        H[k, k] = -0.5 * (e[smp] ** 2).sum() / sig2
        bnew = np.concatenate([b[:k], [np.log(sig2)]])
        names = list(est.names[:k]) + ["_cons"]
        eqs = ["mean"] * k + ["lnvar"]
        return S * smp[:, None], H, bnew, names, eqs, smp
    if cmd == "logit":
        pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-xb))
        S = X * np.where(smp, y - pr, 0.0)[:, None]
        w = np.where(smp, pr * (1 - pr), 0.0)
    elif cmd == "probit":
        eta = xb
        Phi, phi = st.norm.cdf(eta), st.norm.pdf(eta)
        lam1, lam0 = phi / Phi, phi / (1 - Phi)
        sc = np.where(y == 1, lam1, -lam0)
        S = X * np.where(smp, sc, 0.0)[:, None]
        w = np.where(smp, np.where(y == 1, lam1 * (eta + lam1), lam0 * (lam0 - eta)), 0.0)
    elif cmd == "poisson":
        mu = np.exp(xb)
        S = X * np.where(smp, y - mu, 0.0)[:, None]
        w = np.where(smp, mu, 0.0)
    else:
        raise StataError(322, f"suest is not available yet in OpenDTA after {cmd}")
    H = -(X * w[:, None]).T @ X
    eqs = [est.depvar] * k
    return S, H, b[:k], list(est.names[:k]), eqs, smp


def cmd_suest(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import _restore, _snapshot, _stored
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    names = (args if c == -1 else args[:c]).split()
    o = match_options("" if c == -1 else args[c + 1:], {"vce": 3, "svy": 3, "cluster": 2}) if c != -1 else {}
    if o.get("svy"):
        raise StataError(198, "option svy is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(198, "at least two models are required")      # VERIFY
    store = _stored(s)
    snap0 = _snapshot(s)
    parts = []
    try:
        for nm in names:
            if nm not in store:
                raise StataError(111, f"estimation result {nm} not found")
            _restore(s, store[nm])
            parts.append((nm,) + _scores_hessian(s, s._estimates))
    finally:
        _restore(s, snap0)
    sizes = [len(p[3]) for p in parts]
    total = sum(sizes)
    n = s.data.nobs
    S = np.hstack([p[1] for p in parts])
    H = np.zeros((total, total))
    pos = 0
    for p, k in zip(parts, sizes):
        H[pos:pos + k, pos:pos + k] = p[2]
        pos += k
    b = np.concatenate([p[3] for p in parts])
    cnames = [x for p in parts for x in p[4]]
    ceqs = [f"{p[0]}_{q}" for p in parts for q in p[5]]
    union = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
    for p in parts:
        union |= p[6]
    clustvar = ""
    if isinstance(o.get("cluster"), str):
        clustvar = o["cluster"]
    elif isinstance(o.get("vce"), str) and o["vce"].split()[0].lower().startswith("cl"):
        clustvar = o["vce"].split()[1]
    Su = S[union]
    if clustvar:
        cv = s.data.get(clustvar)
        key = np.asarray(cv.raw if cv.is_string else cv.data)[union]
        ids = np.unique(key, return_inverse=True)[1]
        Sg = np.zeros((ids.max() + 1, total))
        np.add.at(Sg, ids, Su)
        G = Sg.shape[0]
        adj = G / (G - 1)
        meat = adj * Sg.T @ Sg
    else:
        N = int(union.sum())
        meat = N / (N - 1) * Su.T @ Su
    Hinv = np.linalg.inv(-H)
    V = Hinv @ meat @ Hinv
    Nobs = int(union.sum())
    est = Estimates("suest", "", cnames, b, V, Nobs, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = ceqs
    est.vcetype = "Robust"
    est.title = "Simultaneous results for " + ", ".join(names)
    est.level = float(s.settings.get("level", 95))
    rows = []
    last = None
    for j, (nm_, eq_) in enumerate(zip(cnames, ceqs)):
        if eq_ != last:
            if last is not None:
                rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
            rows.append(CoefRow("eq", eq_))
            last = eq_
        rows.append(CoefRow("coef", nm_, float(b[j]), float(np.sqrt(max(V[j, j], 0))), name=nm_))
    est.rows = rows
    scalars = [("N", float(Nobs))]
    if clustvar:
        scalars.append(("N_clust", float(G)))
    macros = [("cmd", "suest"), ("names", " ".join(names)), ("vce", "robust"), ("vcetype", "Robust"),
              ("title", est.title), ("properties", "b V")]
    if clustvar:
        macros.append(("clustvar", clustvar))
    post(s, est, list(reversed(scalars)), list(reversed(macros)), union)
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\n{est.title}\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':<48}{'Number of obs':<18}= ", "text")
    out.write(f"{Nobs:>10,}\n", "result")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if clustvar:
        out.write(f"{'':>48}(Std. Err. adjusted for {G} clusters in {clustvar})\n", "text")
    coef_table(s, "", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=est.level, vcetype="Robust")

"""prais: linear regression with AR(1) errors (Prais-Winsten and Cochrane-Orcutt)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats as st

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from . import fvars
from .results import Estimates, post, rows_from_columns, coef_table, CoefRow
from .tsops import require_ts

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
RHOTYPES = ("regress", "freg", "tscorr", "dw", "theil", "nagar")


def transform(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, lagged: np.ndarray, rho: float, pw: bool):
    """AR(1) transformation. `lagged[i]` says that row i has a valid previous period (the previous
    row); rows without it keep the first-observation treatment: scaled by sqrt(1-rho^2) in
    Prais-Winsten, dropped in Cochrane-Orcutt. Returns the transformed data and the kept rows."""
    Z = np.column_stack([X, y])
    T = Z.copy()
    prev = np.vstack([np.zeros((1, Z.shape[1])), Z[:-1]])
    T[lagged] = Z[lagged] - rho * prev[lagged]
    keep = np.ones(len(y), dtype=bool)
    if pw:
        T[~lagged] = Z[~lagged] * np.sqrt(1 - rho * rho)
    else:
        keep = lagged
    return T[keep, :-1], T[keep, -1], keep


def ols(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray):
    XtXi = np.linalg.pinv(X.T @ X)
    b = XtXi @ X.T @ y
    return b, y - X @ b, XtXi


def estimate_rho(e: np.ndarray, lagged: np.ndarray, rhotype: str, k: int) -> float:
    """Autocorrelation of the residuals `e` (in time order) by the chosen estimator."""
    cur = e[lagged]
    prev = np.vstack([[0.0], e[:-1].reshape(-1, 1)]).ravel()[lagged]
    n = len(e)
    if rhotype == "regress":
        return float(cur @ prev / (prev @ prev))
    if rhotype == "freg":
        nxt = np.append(lagged[1:], False)          # rows whose successor has a valid lag
        c2 = e[np.flatnonzero(nxt) + 1]
        p2 = e[nxt]
        return float(p2 @ c2 / (p2 @ p2))
    tscorr = float(cur @ prev / (e @ e))
    if rhotype == "tscorr":
        return tscorr
    if rhotype == "theil":
        return tscorr * (n - k) / n
    d = e[lagged] - prev
    rdw = 1 - float(d @ d) / (e @ e) / 2
    if rhotype == "dw":
        return rdw
    return (rdw * n * n + k * k) / (n * n - k * k)      # nagar


def durbin_watson(e: np.ndarray, lagged: np.ndarray) -> float:
    d = e[lagged] - np.concatenate([[0.0], e[:-1]])[lagged]
    return float(d @ d / (e @ e))


def fit_prais(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, lagged: np.ndarray, *, pw: bool, rhotype: str,
              twostep: bool, ssesearch: bool, maxiter: int, tol: float, k_slopes: int, log):
    """Returns rho, the OLS estimates of the transformed model and the iteration count."""
    b0, e0, _ = ols(X, y)
    k = X.shape[1]
    sse = lambda r: float(np.sum(ols(*transform(X, y, lagged, r, pw)[:2])[1] ** 2))
    if ssesearch:
        grid = np.linspace(-0.999, 0.999, 400)
        r = grid[int(np.argmin([sse(g) for g in grid]))]
        lo, hi = max(r - 0.005, -0.9999), min(r + 0.005, 0.9999)
        for _ in range(60):
            m1, m2 = lo + (hi - lo) * 0.382, lo + (hi - lo) * 0.618
            lo, hi = (lo, m2) if sse(m1) < sse(m2) else (m1, hi)
        rho, it = (lo + hi) / 2, 0
    else:
        rho, it = 0.0, 0
        log(0, rho)
        e = e0
        while it < maxiter:
            new = estimate_rho(e, lagged, rhotype, k)
            it += 1
            log(it, new)
            done = abs(new - rho) < tol
            rho = new
            Xt, yt, _ = transform(X, y, lagged, rho, pw)
            _, et, _ = ols(Xt, yt)
            if twostep or done:
                break
            # residuals of the original model at the transformed estimates
            bt = ols(Xt, yt)[0]
            e = y - X @ bt
    Xt, yt, keep = transform(X, y, lagged, rho, pw)
    b, et, XtXi = ols(Xt, yt)
    return rho, b, et, XtXi, Xt, yt, keep, e0, it

              ("depvar", smp.depname), ("predict", "prais_p"), ("rhotype", rhotype)]

def _lag_after_keep(lagged: np.ndarray, keep: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Lag indicator for the rows of the transformed sample (the first row never has one)."""
    lag = lagged[keep].copy()
    if len(lag):
        lag[0] = False
    return lag

"""regress ([R] regress): least squares with weights, vce(robust) and
vce(cluster), the ANOVA table and the coefficient table of Stata 14."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from . import fvars
from .results import Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def sig5(x: float) -> str:
    """Root MSE: five significant digits, without the leading zero."""
    if not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    t = f"{x:.5g}"
    if "e" in t:
        return format_value(x, "%9.0g", pad=False).strip()
    if t.startswith("0."):
        t = t[1:]
    elif t.startswith("-0."):
        t = "-" + t[2:]
    return t


def g(x: float, fmt: str) -> str:
    if x is None or not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    return format_value(float(x), fmt, pad=False).strip()


def comma(n: float) -> str:
    return f"{int(round(n)):,}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# preparation shared by the estimation commands
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Sample:
    """Dependent variable, columns and sample of an estimation command."""

    def __init__(self, s: "Session", args: str, *, opts_spec: dict[str, int], weights=("aweight",
                 "fweight", "iweight", "pweight"), need_dep: bool = True, constant_opt: bool = True,
                 extra_vars: str = "", restrict: np.ndarray | None = None):
        """restrict: observations the command may use at all (stcox and streg: _st == 1),
        combined with if/in before anything else."""
        with fvars.caching():
            self._init(s, args, opts_spec=opts_spec, weights=weights, need_dep=need_dep,
                       extra_vars=extra_vars, restrict=restrict)

    def _init(self, s: "Session", args: str, *, opts_spec: dict[str, int], weights,
              need_dep: bool, extra_vars: str = "", restrict: np.ndarray | None = None) -> None:
        from ..commands._util import touse
        from ..commands.summarize import weights as get_weights
        self.s = s
        p = parse_standard(args)
        self.p = p
        spec = dict(opts_spec)
        spec.update({"noconstant": 4, "level": 1, "vce": 3, "robust": 1, "cluster": 2})
        self.o = match_options(p.options, spec) if p.options.strip() else {}
        ds = s.data
        toks = fvars._split_tokens(p.varlist)
        if need_dep and not toks:
            raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
        self.depname = ""
        dep_terms = []
        if need_dep:
            dep_terms = fvars.expand_fv(ds, toks[0])
            if len(dep_terms) != 1 or dep_terms[0].is_interaction or dep_terms[0].comps[0].factor:
                raise StataError(198, "depvar may not be a factor variable")   # VERIFY
            self.depcomp = dep_terms[0].comps[0]
            self.depname = self.depcomp.tsname
        rest = " ".join(toks[1:] if need_dep else toks)
        self.terms = fvars.expand_fv(ds, rest) if rest.strip() else []
        mask = touse(s, p)
        if restrict is not None:
            mask &= restrict
        extra = fvars.expand_fv(ds, extra_vars) if extra_vars.strip() else []
        bad = fvars.term_missing(ds, dep_terms + self.terms + extra)
        mask &= ~bad
        self.w, self.wtype, mask = get_weights(s, p, mask, weights)
        self.mask = mask
        self.constant = not self.o.get("noconstant")
        self.level = float(self.o["level"]) if self.o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
        if self.level < 10 or self.level > 99.99:
            raise StataError(198, "level() must be between 10 and 99.99 inclusive")
        # vce
        vce = str(self.o.get("vce", "") or "").strip()
        self.vce = "ols"
        self.clustvar = ""
        if self.o.get("robust"):
            self.vce = "robust"
        if self.o.get("cluster"):
            self.vce, self.clustvar = "cluster", str(self.o["cluster"]).strip()
        if vce:
            w = vce.split()
            kind = w[0].lower()
            if "robust".startswith(kind) and len(kind) >= 1:
                self.vce = "robust"
            elif "cluster".startswith(kind) and len(kind) >= 2:
                if len(w) < 2:
                    raise StataError(198, "option vce() misspecified")   # VERIFY
                self.vce, self.clustvar = "cluster", w[1]
            elif kind in ("ols", "oim", "opg"):
                self.vce = kind
            elif kind in ("hc2", "hc3"):
                self.vce = kind
            else:
                raise StataError(198, f"vcetype '{w[0]}' not allowed")   # VERIFY
        if self.wtype == "pweight" and self.vce in ("ols", "oim"):
            self.vce = "robust"
        if self.clustvar:
            from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
            self.clustvar = resolve_name(ds, self.clustvar)
            cv = ds.get(self.clustvar).data
            if ds.get(self.clustvar).is_string:
                codes = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(sorted(set(cv[self.mask])))}
                self.cluster = np.array([codes[v] for v in cv[self.mask]], dtype=float)
            else:
                cm = cv >= SYS
                if np.any(cm & self.mask):
                    self.mask &= ~cm
                    # VERIFY: Stata excludes observations with a missing cluster
                self.cluster = cv[self.mask]
        mask = self.mask
        n = int(mask.sum())
        if n == 0:
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        self.y = fvars.comp_values(ds, self.depcomp)[mask] if need_dep else None
        self.cols = fvars.build_design(ds, self.terms, mask, constant=self.constant)
        self.n = int(mask.sum())

    def weights_for_fit(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
        """(weights used in the computations, reported N)."""
        n = self.n
        if self.w is None:
            return np.ones(n), float(n)
        w = self.w[self.mask].astype(np.float64)
        if self.wtype == "fweight":
            return w, float(w.sum())
        if self.wtype in ("aweight", "pweight"):
            return w * n / w.sum(), float(n)
        return w, float(w.sum())    # iweight: N = sum of the weights (compat 0505)


def cmdline(name: str, args: str) -> str:
    return f"{name} {args.strip()}".strip()


def wexp_macros(smp: Sample) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    if smp.p.weight is None:
        return []
    return [("wtype", smp.wtype), ("wexp", f"= {smp.p.weight[1]}")]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# regress
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_regress(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        from .postest import replay
        replay(s, "regress", args)
        return
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"beta": 4, "noheader": 6, "notable": 5, "hascons": 7,
                                     "tsscons": 7, "depname": 4, "mse1": 4, "plus": 4})
    o = smp.o
    ds = s.data
    w, N = smp.weights_for_fit()
    out = s.output
    if smp.wtype in ("aweight", "pweight"):
        tot = float(smp.w[smp.mask].sum())
        out.write(f"(sum of wgt is {format_value(tot, '%12.4e')})\n", "text")
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant, w)
    for nm in notes:
        out.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols] + ([np.ones(smp.n)] if smp.constant else [])) \
        if (est_cols or smp.constant) else np.zeros((smp.n, 0))
    y = smp.y
    k = X.shape[1]
    beta, XtWXi = _ols(X, y, w, smp.constant)
    yhat = X @ beta if k else np.zeros(smp.n)
    resid = y - yhat
    rss = float(np.sum(w * resid ** 2))
    if smp.constant:
        ybar = float(np.sum(w * y) / np.sum(w))
        tss = float(np.sum(w * (y - ybar) ** 2))
    else:
        tss = float(np.sum(w * y ** 2))
    mss = tss - rss
    rank = k
    df_m = rank - (1 if smp.constant else 0)
    df_r = N - rank
    if df_r <= 0:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    s2 = rss / df_r
    r2 = mss / tss if tss > 0 else SYS
    r2_a = 1 - (1 - r2) * ((N - 1) if smp.constant else N) / df_r if tss > 0 else SYS
    rmse = np.sqrt(s2)
    Vb = s2 * XtWXi
    vcetype = ""
    n_clust = None
    if smp.vce in ("robust", "hc2", "hc3", "cluster"):
        wr = w if smp.wtype != "fweight" else w
        if smp.vce == "cluster":
            ids = smp.cluster
            uniq = np.unique(ids)
            n_clust = len(uniq)
            meat = np.zeros((k, k))
            sc = X * (wr * resid)[:, None]
            for u in uniq:
                sg = sc[ids == u].sum(axis=0)
                meat += np.outer(sg, sg)
            q = (n_clust / (n_clust - 1)) * ((N - 1) / (N - k))
            Vb = q * XtWXi @ meat @ XtWXi
            df_r = n_clust - 1
        else:
            if smp.vce == "robust":
                sc = X * (wr * resid)[:, None]
                if smp.wtype == "fweight":
                    meat = (X * (w * resid ** 2)[:, None]).T @ X
                else:
                    meat = sc.T @ sc
                Vb = (N / (N - k)) * XtWXi @ meat @ XtWXi
            else:
                h = np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", X, XtWXi, X) * w
                e2 = resid ** 2 / ((1 - h) if smp.vce == "hc2" else (1 - h) ** 2)
                meat = (X * (w * w * e2)[:, None]).T @ X
                Vb = XtWXi @ meat @ XtWXi
        vcetype = {"robust": "Robust", "cluster": "Robust", "hc2": "Robust HC2",
                   "hc3": "Robust HC3"}[smp.vce]
    Vb = (Vb + Vb.T) / 2
    # F
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    F = SYS
    df_m_robust = len(slopes)
    if smp.vce == "ols":
        F = (mss / df_m) / s2 if df_m > 0 else 0.0
    elif smp.vce == "cluster" and np.linalg.matrix_rank(Vb, tol=1e-12 * max(np.abs(Vb).max(), 1e-300)) < k:
        # few clusters: V has rank smaller than k; Stata shows F(rank-1, G-1) with a missing value
        # (compat 0501). VERIFY the general case.
        rk = np.linalg.matrix_rank(Vb, tol=1e-12 * max(np.abs(Vb).max(), 1e-300))
        df_m_robust = rk - (1 if smp.constant else 0)
        F = SYS
    elif slopes:
        bb = beta[slopes]
        VV = Vb[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)]
        try:
            F = float(bb @ np.linalg.solve(VV, bb)) / len(slopes)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            F = SYS
    ll = -0.5 * N * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(rss / N) + 1) if rss > 0 else SYS
    ll_0 = -0.5 * N * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(tss / N) + 1) if tss > 0 and smp.constant else SYS
    # results by name (includes bases and omitted terms with zero)
    names = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in smp.cols]
    if smp.constant:
        names.append("_cons")
    kk = len(names)
    b_full = np.zeros(kk)
    V_full = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    b_full[pos] = beta
    V_full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = Vb
    bmap = {}
    semap = {}
    for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols):
        bmap[c.name] = b_full[i]
        semap[c.name] = np.sqrt(V_full[i, i]) if V_full[i, i] > 0 else 0.0
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = b_full[-1], np.sqrt(max(V_full[-1, -1], 0))
    df_m_report = df_m if smp.vce == "ols" else df_m_robust
    est = Estimates("regress", smp.depname, names, b_full, V_full, smp.n, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols = smp.cols
    est.constant = smp.constant
    est.terms = smp.terms
    est.depcomp = smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = vcetype
    est.clustvar = smp.clustvar
    est.n_clust = n_clust
    est.extra = {"N": N, "df_m": df_m_report, "df_r": df_r, "F": F, "r2": r2, "rmse": rmse,
                 "mss": mss, "rss": rss, "r2_a": r2_a, "ll": ll, "ll_0": ll_0, "rank": rank,
                 "tss": tss, "anova_df_m": df_m}
    est.wtype = smp.wtype
    est.resid_df = df_r
    est.s2 = s2
    est.XtWXi_full = None
    scalars = [("N", N), ("df_m", df_m_report), ("df_r", df_r), ("F", F), ("r2", r2), ("rmse", rmse),
               ("mss", mss), ("rss", rss), ("r2_a", r2_a), ("ll", ll), ("ll_0", ll_0), ("rank", rank)]
    if n_clust is not None:
        scalars.insert(1, ("N_clust", n_clust))   # VERIFY position
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("regress", args)), ("title", "Linear regression"),
              ("marginsok", "XB default"), ("vce", smp.vce if smp.vce != "hc2" else "hc2")]
    if vcetype:
        macros.append(("vcetype", vcetype))
    if smp.clustvar:
        macros.append(("clustvar", smp.clustvar))
    macros += wexp_macros(smp)
    macros += [("depvar", smp.depname), ("cmd", "regress"), ("properties", "b V"),
               ("predict", "regres_p"), ("model", "ols"), ("estat_cmd", "regress_estat")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    if o.get("beta"):
        est.beta = _std_coefs(smp, w, bmap)
    display_regress(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"),
                    beta=bool(o.get("beta")))


def _ols(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, w: np.ndarray, constant: bool):
    """Coefficients and (X'WX)⁻¹ (order: slopes, then the constant).

    set numerics stata: like Stata's regress, cross products of the
    deviations from the means (the constant comes from ȳ - x̄'b), inverted
    without truncating small eigenvalues.
    set numerics precise: QR decomposition of W^(1/2)X (error proportional to
    κ(X), not to κ(X)²)."""
    from .numerics import precise
    k = X.shape[1]
    if k == 0:
        return np.zeros(0), np.zeros((0, 0))
    if precise():
        sw = np.sqrt(w)
        Q, R = np.linalg.qr(X * sw[:, None])
        beta = np.linalg.solve(R, Q.T @ (sw * y))
        Rinv = np.linalg.solve(R, np.eye(k))
        return beta, Rinv @ Rinv.T
    W = float(w.sum())
    if constant:
        Xs = X[:, :-1]
        m = (w @ Xs) / W
        ybar = float(w @ y) / W
        Xc = Xs - m
        yc = y - ybar
        if Xs.shape[1]:
            A = np.linalg.inv((Xc * w[:, None]).T @ Xc)
            b = A @ (Xc.T @ (w * yc))
        else:
            A = np.zeros((0, 0))
            b = np.zeros(0)
        cons = ybar - float(m @ b)
        full = np.zeros((k, k))
        full[:-1, :-1] = A
        full[:-1, -1] = full[-1, :-1] = -(A @ m)
        full[-1, -1] = 1.0 / W + float(m @ A @ m)
        return np.append(b, cons), full
    A = np.linalg.inv((X * w[:, None]).T @ X)
    return A @ (X.T @ (w * y)), A


def _std_coefs(smp: Sample, w: np.ndarray, bmap: dict) -> dict:
    def sd(x):
        m = np.sum(w * x) / np.sum(w)
        return np.sqrt(np.sum(w * (x - m) ** 2) / (np.sum(w) - 1))
    sy = sd(smp.y)
    return {c.name: bmap[c.name] * sd(c.values) / sy for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None}


def display_regress(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
                    level: float | None = None, beta: bool = False) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        if not est.vcetype:
            _anova(s, est)
        else:
            _robust_header(s, est)
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        if est.vcetype == "Robust" and est.clustvar:
            # VERIFY texto e alinhamento
            out.write(f"{'(Std. Err. adjusted for ' + format(int(est.n_clust), ',') + ' clusters in ' + est.clustvar + ')':>78}\n",
                      "text")
        coef_table(s, getattr(est, "depvar_cell", est.depvar), est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=lev, vcetype=est.vcetype,
                   coef_title=getattr(est, "coef_title", "Coef."), eform=getattr(est, "eform_on", False))   # glogit, or


def _anova(s: "Session", est: Estimates) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    df_m, df_r = x["anova_df_m"], x["df_r"]
    N = x["N"]
    msm = x["mss"] / df_m if df_m > 0 else SYS
    msr = x["rss"] / df_r if df_r > 0 else SYS
    mst = x["tss"] / (N - (1 if est.constant else 0))
    right = [
        ("Number of obs", comma(N)),
        (f"F({int(df_m)}, {int(df_r)})", g(x["F"], "%9.2f")),
        ("Prob > F", g(st.f.sf(x["F"], df_m, df_r) if x["F"] < SYS else SYS, "%9.4f")),
        ("R-squared", g(x["r2"], "%9.4f")),
        ("Adj R-squared", g(x["r2_a"], "%9.4f")),
        ("Root MSE", sig5(x["rmse"])),
    ]
    left = [
        f"{'Source':>12} |       SS           df       MS   ",
        "-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 34,
        _ss_row("Model", x["mss"], df_m, msm),
        _ss_row("Residual", x["rss"], df_r, msr),
        "-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 34,
        _ss_row("Total", x["tss"], N - (1 if est.constant else 0), mst),
    ]
    for lft, (lab, val) in zip(left, right):
        out.write(f"{lft:<48}   ", "text")
        out.write(f"{lab:<16}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{val:>9}\n", "result")


def _ss_row(name: str, ss: float, df: float, ms: float) -> str:
    return f"{name:>12} | {g(ss, '%11.0g'):>11}{int(df):>10,}{g(ms, '%11.0g'):>12}"   # 2,996 (compat 1926)


def _robust_header(s: "Session", est: Estimates) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    df_m, df_r = x["df_m"], x["df_r"]
    right = [
        ("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
        (f"F({int(df_m)}, {int(df_r)})", g(x["F"], "%10.2f")),
