"""Fitting machinery of sem: groups, missing values and the ADF discrepancy.

A `Problem` holds one `Model` per group, the data summary of each group, and the map from each
group's free parameters to the global parameter vector (parameters constrained equal across
groups share one global entry). The objective is the log likelihood summed over groups for
method(ml) and method(mlmv) (the data summary is one pattern for ml and one per missing-value
pattern for mlmv), and minus the sum over groups of N_g F_WLS for method(adf), where
F_WLS = (v - tau)' W^-1 (v - tau), v = [z; vech(S)], tau = [mu; vech(Sigma)] and W is the sample
covariance of the observation-level moment contributions ([SEM] methods and formulas for sem).
The details Stata does not document (starting values, the iteration log) are marked VERIFY."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import numpy as np

from ..core import mvnmiss
from ..core.errors import StataError
from .results import g9
from .sem import (Model, _dmoments, _grad_blocks, _loglik_blocks, _start, baseline_ex_correlated)

PCLASSES = ("scoef", "scons", "mcoef", "mcons", "serrvar", "merrvar", "smerrcov", "meanex", "covex")


@dataclass
class GroupData:
    label: float
    N: int
    pats: list                       # data summary: one pattern (ml) or one per missing pattern
    mean: np.ndarray                 # saturated mean
    cov: np.ndarray                  # saturated covariance (divided by N)
    ll_s: float                      # saturated log likelihood
    ll_b: float                      # baseline log likelihood
    X: np.ndarray | None = None      # complete raw data (adf)
    adf: dict | None = None          # v, Wi and the baseline discrepancy (adf)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# data summaries
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _structure_blocks(model: Model):
    """Column blocks of the baseline model: the observed exogenous variables may be correlated
    with each other when the model has observed endogenous variables."""
    obs = model.spec.observed
    ex = [i for i, n in enumerate(obs) if n in model.exog]
    return [ex] if (ex and baseline_ex_correlated(model)) else []


def build_group_data(model: Model, X: np.ndarray, method: str, label: float = 0.0) -> GroupData:
    """Summarize the rows of X (columns = model.spec.observed; NaN = missing) for the method."""
    N, p = X.shape
    if method == "mlmv":
        pats = mvnmiss.patterns(X)
        N = sum(q.n for q in pats)
        mean, cov, ll_s, _ = mvnmiss.em_mvn(X)
        _, _, ll_b, _ = mvnmiss.em_mvn(X, blocks=_structure_blocks(model))
        return GroupData(label, N, pats, mean, cov, ll_s, ll_b)
    mean = X.mean(axis=0)
    D = X - mean
    cov = D.T @ D / N
    pats = [mvnmiss.Pattern(np.arange(p), np.zeros(0, dtype=int), N, mean, cov)]
    ll_s = float(-0.5 * N * (p * math.log(2 * math.pi) + np.linalg.slogdet(cov)[1] + p))
    Sig = np.diag(np.diag(cov)).copy()
    for blk in _structure_blocks(model):
        Sig[np.ix_(blk, blk)] = cov[np.ix_(blk, blk)]
    ll_b = float(-0.5 * N * (p * math.log(2 * math.pi) + np.linalg.slogdet(Sig)[1]
                             + np.trace(cov @ np.linalg.inv(Sig))))
    gd = GroupData(label, N, pats, mean, cov, ll_s, ll_b)
    if method == "adf":
        gd.X = X
        gd.adf = _adf_summary(model, X, mean, cov)
    return gd


def _vech(M: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    return M[np.tril_indices(M.shape[0])]


def _adf_summary(model: Model, X: np.ndarray, mean, cov) -> dict:
    N, p = X.shape
    D = X - mean
    il = np.tril_indices(p)
    H = np.column_stack([D, D[:, il[0]] * D[:, il[1]] - _vech(cov)])
    W = H.T @ H / N
    q = W.shape[0]
    if np.linalg.matrix_rank(W) < q:
        raise StataError(498, "the weight matrix of method(adf) is singular; more observations "
                              "than moments are required")   # VERIFY
    Wi = np.linalg.inv(W)
    v = np.concatenate([mean, _vech(cov)])
    # baseline model: tau = A phi is linear in the free means, variances and covariances
    cols = []
    for i in range(p):
        e = np.zeros(q)
        e[i] = 1
        cols.append(e)
    allowed = {(i, i) for i in range(p)}
    for blk in _structure_blocks(model):
        allowed |= {(i, j) for i in blk for j in blk if i > j}
    for k, (i, j) in enumerate(zip(*il)):
        if (int(i), int(j)) in allowed:
            e = np.zeros(q)
            e[p + k] = 1
            cols.append(e)
    A = np.column_stack(cols)
    phi = np.linalg.solve(A.T @ Wi @ A, A.T @ Wi @ v)
    r = v - A @ phi
    return dict(v=v, Wi=Wi, F_b=float(r @ Wi @ r))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# parameter classes and the map to the global vector
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def item_class(model: Model, item: tuple[str, str, str]) -> str:
    """The parameter class of a free item (for ginvariant())."""
    kind, a, b = item
    spec = model.spec
    endog_obs = [n for n in model.endog if n in spec.observed]
    meas = {n for n in endog_obs if all(x in spec.latent for x, y in spec.paths if y == n)}

    def error_kind(n):
        return "m" if n in meas else "s"
    if kind == "path":
        return "mcoef" if (a in spec.latent and b in meas) else "scoef"
    if kind == "mean":
        if a in model.exog:
            return "meanex"
        return "mcons" if a in meas else "scons"
    if kind == "var":
        if a in model.exog:
            return "covex"
        return "merrvar" if a in meas else "serrvar"
    if a in model.exog and b in model.exog:
        return "covex"
    ka, kb = error_kind(a) if a in model.endog else "x", error_kind(b) if b in model.endog else "x"
    if ka == kb == "m":
        return "merrvar"
    if ka == kb == "s":
        return "serrvar"
    return "smerrcov"


def parse_ginvariant(text: str | None) -> set[str]:
    if text is None or not str(text).strip():
        return {"mcoef", "mcons"}
    out: set[str] = set()
    for w in str(text).split():
        w = w.lower()
        if w == "none":
            continue
        if w == "all":
            out |= set(PCLASSES)
            continue
        hit = [c for c in PCLASSES if c == w]
        if not hit:
            raise StataError(198, f"invalid ginvariant() class {w}")   # VERIFY
        out.add(hit[0])
    return out


@dataclass
class Problem:
    models: list[Model]
    data: list[GroupData]
    method: str
    inv: set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    gmap: list[np.ndarray] = field(default_factory=list)
    nglob: int = 0
    classes: list[list[str]] = field(default_factory=list)
    ilog: list[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    split: set = field(default_factory=set)        # (group, item) pairs freed from ties and invariance
    split_all: set = field(default_factory=set)    # items freed in every group

    def __post_init__(self):
        G = len(self.models)
        self.classes = [[item_class(m, it) for it in m.free] for m in self.models]
        keys: dict = {}
        self.gmap = []
        for g, m in enumerate(self.models):
            ids = []
            for it, cl in zip(m.free, self.classes[g]):
                if it in m.ties and (g, it) not in self.split and it not in self.split_all:
                    key = ("label", m.ties[it]) if G == 1 else ("label", g, m.ties[it])
                elif it in self.split_all or (g, it) in self.split:
                    key = ("split", g, it)
                else:
                    key = (cl, it) if (G > 1 and cl in self.inv) or G == 1 else (g, it)
                if key not in keys:
                    keys[key] = len(keys)
                ids.append(keys[key])
            self.gmap.append(np.asarray(ids, dtype=int))
        self.nglob = len(keys)

    # global <-> group parameters
    def group_theta(self, th: np.ndarray, g: int) -> np.ndarray:
        return th[self.gmap[g]]

    def expand(self, th: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.concatenate([self.group_theta(th, g) for g in range(len(self.models))])

    def expand_matrix(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """T such that the expanded vector is T @ (global vector)."""
        rows = sum(len(m) for m in self.gmap)
        T = np.zeros((rows, self.nglob))
        r = 0
        for ids in self.gmap:
            for i in ids:
                T[r, i] = 1.0
                r += 1
        return T

    # objective --------------------------------------------------------------
    def f(self, th: np.ndarray) -> float:
        tot = 0.0
        for g, (m, d) in enumerate(zip(self.models, self.data)):
            t = self.group_theta(th, g)
            if self.method == "adf":
                tot -= d.N * _adf_F(m, t, d)
            else:
                v = _loglik_blocks(m, t, d.pats)
                if not np.isfinite(v):
                    return -np.inf
                tot += v
        return tot

    def grad(self, th: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        out = np.zeros(self.nglob)
        for g, (m, d) in enumerate(zip(self.models, self.data)):
            t = self.group_theta(th, g)
            if self.method == "adf":
                gg = _adf_grad(m, t, d)
            else:
                gg = _grad_blocks(m, t, d.pats)
            np.add.at(out, self.gmap[g], gg)
        return out

    def hess(self, th: np.ndarray, exact: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
        """Hessian of the objective; for adf the Gauss-Newton -2N J'WiJ unless exact, which
        differentiates the gradient numerically, as the variance of Stata's adf does (compat 1909)."""
        if self.method == "adf" and not exact:
            H = np.zeros((self.nglob, self.nglob))
            for g, (m, d) in enumerate(zip(self.models, self.data)):
                J = _adf_jacobian(m, self.group_theta(th, g))
                Hg = -2 * d.N * J.T @ d.adf["Wi"] @ J
                ids = self.gmap[g]
                np.add.at(H, (ids[:, None], ids[None, :]), Hg)
            return (H + H.T) / 2
        k = len(th)
        H = np.zeros((k, k))
        for i in range(k):
            e = np.zeros(k)
            hh = 1e-5 * (abs(th[i]) + 1)
            e[i] = hh
            H[:, i] = (self.grad(th + e) - self.grad(th - e)) / (2 * hh)
        return (H + H.T) / 2

    def start(self) -> np.ndarray:
        acc = np.zeros(self.nglob)
        cnt = np.zeros(self.nglob)
        for g, (m, d) in enumerate(zip(self.models, self.data)):
            t0 = _start(m, d.mean, d.cov)
            np.add.at(acc, self.gmap[g], t0)
            np.add.at(cnt, self.gmap[g], 1)
        return acc / np.maximum(cnt, 1)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ADF pieces
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _tau_and_jacobian(model: Model, th: np.ndarray):
    mu, Sig, dm = _dmoments(model, th)
    p = model.p
    il = np.tril_indices(p)
    tau = np.concatenate([mu, _vech(Sig)])
    J = np.zeros((len(tau), len(th)))
    for k, (dmv, dSv) in enumerate(dm):
        if dmv is not None:
            J[:p, k] = dmv
        if dSv is not None:
            J[p:, k] = dSv[il]
    return tau, J


def _adf_jacobian(model: Model, th: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    return _tau_and_jacobian(model, th)[1]


def _adf_F(model: Model, th: np.ndarray, d: GroupData) -> float:
    try:
        mu, Sig, _ = model.implied(th)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return np.inf
    tau = np.concatenate([mu, _vech(Sig)])
    r = d.adf["v"] - tau
    return float(r @ d.adf["Wi"] @ r)


def _adf_grad(model: Model, th: np.ndarray, d: GroupData) -> np.ndarray:
    """Gradient of -N F_WLS: 2 N J' W^-1 (v - tau)."""
    tau, J = _tau_and_jacobian(model, th)
    r = d.adf["v"] - tau
    return 2 * d.N * J.T @ d.adf["Wi"] @ r


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# maximization
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def fit_problem(prob: Problem, s, log: bool, maxiter: int = 300):
    """Quasi-Newton to approach the optimum, then Newton steps (Gauss-Newton for ADF) to finish.
    Returns (theta, objective, V, converged); V is the inverse of minus the Hessian for ml and
    mlmv, and twice the inverse of minus the numerical Hessian of the discrepancy for adf."""
    from scipy import optimize
    f, gr = prob.f, prob.grad
    th = prob.start()
    ll = f(th)
    if not np.isfinite(ll):
        raise StataError(430, "initial values not feasible")   # VERIFY
    lines = [ll]
    # the quasi-Newton phase works on the log of the variances, which keeps them positive (a
    # model with simple structure can otherwise run off to a spurious optimum with negative
    # variances); the Newton steps that finish are unconstrained
    vi = np.zeros(prob.nglob, dtype=bool)
    for g, m in enumerate(prob.models):
        for k, it in enumerate(m.free):
            if it[0] == "var":
                vi[prob.gmap[g][k]] = True
    u0 = th.copy()
    u0[vi] = np.log(np.maximum(th[vi], 1e-8))

    def to_theta(u):
        t = u.copy()
        t[vi] = np.exp(np.clip(u[vi], -50, 50))
        return t

    def fu(u):
        v = f(to_theta(u))
        return -v if np.isfinite(v) else 1e100

    def gu(u):
        t = to_theta(u)
        gg = -gr(t)
        gg[vi] = gg[vi] * t[vi]
        return gg
    res = optimize.minimize(fu, u0, method="BFGS", jac=gu, options={"maxiter": maxiter, "gtol": 1e-7})
    th = to_theta(res.x)
    lines.append(f(th))
    converged = False
    for _ in range(50):
        g = gr(th)
        H = prob.hess(th)
        try:
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, -g)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            break
        lam = 1.0
        base = f(th)
        while lam > 1e-6 and not (f(th + lam * step) >= base - 1e-12):
            lam /= 2
        th = th + lam * step
        lines.append(f(th))
        if abs(lines[-1] - lines[-2]) < 1e-10 and np.max(np.abs(lam * step)) < 1e-8:
            converged = True
            break
    shown = [lines[0]] + [x for i, x in enumerate(lines[1:], 1)
                          if abs(x - lines[i - 1]) > 1e-9 or i == len(lines) - 1]
    if log:
        out = s.output
        out.write("\nFitting target model:\n\n", "text")
        word = "discrepancy" if prob.method == "adf" else "log likelihood"
        for i, x in enumerate(shown):
            val = -x if prob.method == "adf" else x
            out.write(f"{'Iteration ' + str(i) + ':':<14} {word} = {g9(val, '%10.0g'):>10}  \n", "text")
    H = prob.hess(th, exact=True)
    try:
        V = np.linalg.inv(-H)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        V = np.linalg.pinv(-H)
    if prob.method == "adf":
        V = 2 * V        # the objective is -N times the discrepancy; its curvature is doubled
    prob.ilog = shown
    return th, f(th), (V + V.T) / 2, converged

"""sem with group(): results, display and e() of multiple-group models ([SEM] sem group options).

Each group has its own copy of the model; the parameters of the classes in ginvariant() are
constrained equal across groups (default: measurement coefficients and intercepts). The expanded
e(b) has one column per group and parameter, named after the factor-variable notation
(1bn.group#c.F); the covariance matrix of the expanded vector is T V T' with T the map from the
global to the expanded parameters. The layout of the table and of the header is VERIFY (compat
case 1909)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M

from .sem import Model, _param_names, _standardized, st

    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _gname(lev: float) -> str:
    return f"{lev:g}"


def _col_name(model: Model, item, lev: float, gvar: str, first: bool) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(equation, name) of an item of group `lev` in the expanded e(b)."""
    kind, a, b = item
    prefix = f"{_gname(lev)}{'bn' if first else ''}.{gvar}"
    eq, nm = _param_names(model)[model.free.index(item)]
    if kind == "path":
        return eq, f"{prefix}#c.{nm}"
    return eq, prefix


def finish_groups(s: "Session", args: str, prob, spec, th, obj, V, conv, o, info: dict) -> None:
    models, datas = prob.models, prob.data
    G = len(models)
    gvar, levels = info["gname"], info["levels"]
    meth = info["meth"]
    N = info["N"]
    model = models[0]
    # observed exogenous variables are conditioned on unless noxconditional (VERIFY)
    oxset = {n for n in model.exog if n in spec.observed}
    xcond = bool(oxset) and not o.get("noxconditional") and meth == "ml"
    hidden = set()
    if xcond:
        hidden = {it for it in model.free if it[0] in ("mean", "var", "cov")
                  and it[1] in oxset and it[2] in oxset}
    T = prob.expand_matrix()
    th_exp = T @ th
    V_exp = T @ V @ T.T
    cols = []          # (group, item index, eq, name)
    keep = []
    r = 0
    for g, m in enumerate(models):
        for i, it in enumerate(m.free):
            if it not in hidden:
                eq, nm = _col_name(m, it, levels[g], gvar, g == 0)
                cols.append((g, i, eq, nm))
                keep.append(r)
            r += 1
    est = Estimates("sem", " ".join(model.endog), [c[3] for c in cols], th_exp[keep].copy(),
                    V_exp[np.ix_(keep, keep)], N, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = [c[2] for c in cols]
    est.model = model
    est.level = info["level"]
    ll = info["ll"]
    est.extra = dict(N=N, ll=ll, df=info["df"], chi2_ms=info["chi2_ms"], p_ms=info["p_ms"],
                     chi2_bs=info["chi2_bs"], df_bs=info["df_bs"], p_bs=info["p_bs"],
                     mean=datas[0].mean, cov=datas[0].cov, ll_s=info["ll_s"],
                     standardized=bool(o.get("standardized")), th=th.copy(), V=V, xcond=xcond,
                     method=meth, prob=prob, mask=info["mask"], gvar=gvar, levels=levels,
                     hidden=hidden, T=T, cols=cols, groups=True)
    est.display = display_groups
    est.predict = None
    from .semestat import estat_table
    est.estat = estat_table()
    ilog = list(prob.ilog) if prob.ilog else [ll]
    pobs = model.p
    df_s = pobs * (pobs + 3) // 2
    scalars = [("converged", 1.0 if conv else 0.0), ("rc", 0.0), ("ic", float(len(ilog) - 1)),

               ("chi2_bs", info["chi2_bs"]), ("p_ms", info["p_ms"]), ("df_ms", float(info["df"])),

    if meth == "adf":
        scalars = [(k, v) for k, v in scalars if k not in ("ll", "critvalue_s", "critvalue_b")]
    macros = [("cmdline", f"sem {args.strip()}"), ("groupvar", gvar),

def constraint_lines(est: Estimates) -> list[str]:
    """The linear constraints of the model as Stata lists them: equalities across groups, then
    the loadings fixed at 1 and the other fixed paths (VERIFY order and labels)."""
    x = est.extra
    prob = x["prob"]
    gvar, levels = x["gvar"], x["levels"]
    models = prob.models
    eqs = []
    # equalities: items sharing a global entry
    first: dict[int, tuple[int, int]] = {}
    for g, m in enumerate(models):
        for i, gid in enumerate(prob.gmap[g]):
            if x["hidden"] and m.free[i] in x["hidden"]:
                continue
            if gid in first:
                g0, i0 = first[gid]
                eq0, nm0 = _col_name(models[g0], models[g0].free[i0], levels[g0], gvar, g0 == 0)
                eq1, nm1 = _col_name(m, m.free[i], levels[g], gvar, g == 0)
                eqs.append(f"[{eq0}]{nm0} - [{eq1}]{nm1} = 0")
            else:
                first[gid] = (g, i)
    # Stata's order (case 1909): the fixed paths of the first group, the equalities, the fixed
    # paths of the other groups, then the latent means fixed at 0
    fixed = []
    for g, m in enumerate(models):
        spec = m.spec
        pre = f"{_gname(levels[g])}{'bn' if g == 0 else ''}.{gvar}"
        lines = []
        anchors = sorted(m.anchor.items(), key=lambda la: la[0] not in m.endog)
        for L, a in anchors:
            lines.append(f"[{a}]{pre}#c.{L} = 1")
        for (a, b), v in spec.fixed.items():
            lines.append(f"[{b}]{pre}#c.{a} = {v:g}")
        fixed.append(lines)
    means = []
    for g, m in enumerate(models):
        pre = f"{_gname(levels[g])}{'bn' if g == 0 else ''}.{gvar}"
        for L in m.spec.latent:
            if L in m.exog and ("mean", L, L) not in m.free:
                means.append(f"[mean({L})]{pre} = 0")
    return fixed[0] + eqs + [x for lines in fixed[1:] for x in lines] + means


def display_groups(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
                   level: float | None = None, **_kw) -> None:

        out.write(f"{'Grouping variable  = ' + gvar:<48}{'Number of groups':<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{G:>10,}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"Estimation method  = {x['method']}\n", "text")
        if x["method"] != "adf":

            out.write(f"{g9(x['ll'], '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "result")
        out.write("\n", "text")

"""estat scoretests, estat mindices and estat ginvariant after sem ([SEM] estat scoretests,
estat mindices, estat ginvariant): Lagrange multiplier tests of omitted paths and of the
constraints across groups."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import math

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lazy import lazy
from .sem import Model, _dmoments
from .semestat import MINCHI2, _fv, _nobs, _opts

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _extended(prob, split=frozenset(), split_all=frozenset()):
    from .semfit import Problem
    return Problem(prob.models, prob.data, prob.method, prob.inv, split=set(split), split_all=set(split_all))


def _theta_in(prob, th_glob, ext):
    t = np.zeros(ext.nglob)
    for g in range(len(prob.models)):
        t[ext.gmap[g]] = th_glob[prob.gmap[g]]
    return t


def _info(ext, t):
    """Information of the extended problem: expected information for ml (as Stata's score tests
    and modification indices, case 1909), minus the Hessian otherwise."""
    if ext.method != "ml":
        return -ext.hess(t)
    I = np.zeros((ext.nglob, ext.nglob))
    for g, (m, d) in enumerate(zip(ext.models, ext.data)):
        ids = ext.gmap[g]
        Ig = _eim(m, t[ids], d.N)
        np.add.at(I, (ids[:, None], ids[None, :]), Ig)
    return I


def _lm(prob, th_glob, ext, t=None) -> tuple[float, int]:
    t = _theta_in(prob, th_glob, ext) if t is None else t
    sc = ext.grad(t)
    info = _info(ext, t)
    stat = float(sc @ np.linalg.pinv(info) @ sc)
    return max(stat, 0.0), ext.nglob - prob.nglob


def _th_glob(est):
    x = est.extra
    return x.get("th_glob", x["th"])


def _label(model: Model, it) -> str:
    kind, a, b = it
    if kind == "path":
        return f"{b} <- {a}"
    if kind == "mean":
        return f"mean({a})" if a in model.exog else f"{a} <- _cons"
    if kind == "var":
        return f"var(e.{a})" if a in model.endog else f"var({a})"
    ea = f"e.{a}" if a in model.endog else a
    eb = f"e.{b}" if b in model.endog else b
    return f"cov({ea},{eb})"


def estat_scoretests(s, est, args):
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    _, o = _opts(args, {"minchi2": 3})
    minchi2 = float(o["minchi2"]) if o.get("minchi2") else MINCHI2
    prob = est.extra["prob"]
    th = _th_glob(est)
    out = s.output
    cons = []      # (text, ext problem)
    for g, m in enumerate(prob.models):
        groups: dict[str, list] = {}
        for it, lab in m.ties.items():
            groups.setdefault(lab, []).append(it)
        for lab, items in groups.items():
            for it in items[1:]:
                text = f"[{items[0][2]}]{items[0][1]} - [{it[2]}]{it[1]} = 0"
                cons.append((text, _extended(prob, split={(g, it)})))
    rows = []
    for k, (text, ext) in enumerate(cons, 1):
        stat, df = _lm(prob, th, ext)
        rows.append((k, stat, max(df, 1)))
    shown = [r for r in rows if r[1] >= minchi2]
    if not shown:
        from ..core.formats import format_value
        # Stata's own value of invchi2tail(1, .05) (case 1909)
        lim = "3.841458820694123" if not o.get("minchi2") else format_value(minchi2, "%18.0g").strip()
        out.write(f"(no score tests to report; all chi2 values less than {lim})\n", "text")
    else:
        # VERIFY: the layout when some test is shown
        out.write("\nScore tests for linear constraints\n\n", "text")
        for k, (text, _ext) in enumerate(cons, 1):
            out.write(f" ({k:2d}) {text}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"\n{'':>8}{'chi2':>10}{'df':>6}{'P>chi2':>9}\n", "text")
        for k, stat, df in shown:
            out.write(f" ({k:2d}) ", "text")
            out.write(f"{stat:>9.3f}{df:>6}{float(st.chi2.sf(stat, df)):>9.2f}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"N_groups": float(len(prob.data)), "nobs": _nobs(s, est)}
    if rows:
        s.r["Cns_sctest"] = Matrix(np.array([[r[1], r[2], float(st.chi2.sf(r[1], r[2]))] for r in rows]),
                                   [f"c{r[0]}" for r in rows], ["chi2", "df", "p"])


def _augment(model: Model, item):
    kind, a, b = item
    spec = copy.deepcopy(model.spec)
    covs = list(model.covs_in)
    if kind == "path":
        spec.paths.append((a, b))
    else:
        covs.append((a, b))
    return Model(spec, covs, dict(model.var_fixed))


def _eim(model: Model, th: np.ndarray, N: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Expected information of the normal likelihood: N (dmu' Si dmu + tr(Si dS Si dS) / 2)."""
    mu, Sig, dm = _dmoments(model, th)
    Si = np.linalg.inv(Sig)
    k = len(dm)
    I = np.zeros((k, k))
    for a in range(k):
        ma, Sa = dm[a]
        for b in range(a + 1):
            mb, Sb = dm[b]
            v = 0.0
            if ma is not None and mb is not None:
                v += float(ma @ Si @ mb)
            if Sa is not None and Sb is not None:
                v += 0.5 * float(np.sum((Si @ Sa) * (Si @ Sb).T))
            I[a, b] = I[b, a] = N * v
    return I


def estat_mindices(s, est, args):
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    from .semfit import Problem, item_class, parse_ginvariant
    _, o = _opts(args, {"showpclass": 5, "minchi2": 3})
    minchi2 = float(o["minchi2"]) if o.get("minchi2") else MINCHI2
    want = parse_ginvariant("all" if str(o.get("showpclass") or "all").strip() == "all"
                            else str(o["showpclass"]))
    if est.extra.get("groups"):
        raise StataError(198, "estat mindices after sem with group() is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    prob = est.extra["prob"]
    model = est.model
    spec = model.spec
    th = est.extra["th"]
    data = prob.data[0]
    mu, Sig, (A, S, m, B, Sv, mv) = model.implied(th)
    sd = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(Sv), 1e-300))
    cands = []
    exo_obs = {n for n in model.exog if n in spec.observed}
    for to in model.names:
        if to not in model.endog:
            continue
        for fr in model.names:
            # VERIFY (case 1909): Stata does not consider paths out of observed endogenous variables
            if fr == to or (fr, to) in spec.paths or (fr in spec.observed and fr in model.endog):
                continue
            cands.append(("path", fr, to))
    err = [n for n in model.names if n in model.endog]
    have = {tuple(sorted(c, key=lambda n: model.idx[n])) for c in model.covs_in}
    for i, a in enumerate(err):
        for b in err[i + 1:]:
            key = tuple(sorted((a, b), key=lambda n: model.idx[n]))
            if key in have:
                continue
            cands.append(("cov", key[0], key[1]))
    rows = []
    for it in cands:
        try:
            aug = _augment(model, it)
        except StataError:
            continue
        cls = item_class(aug, it)
        if cls not in want:
            continue
        th_aug = np.array([th[model.free.index(x)] if x in model.free else 0.0 for x in aug.free])
        sub = Problem([aug], [data], prob.method, set())
        # the observed exogenous variables stay unconstrained as in the fitted model
        gr = sub.grad(th_aug)
        info = _eim(aug, th_aug, data.N) if prob.method == "ml" else -sub.hess(th_aug)
        p = aug.free.index(it)
        c = [i for i in range(len(th_aug)) if i != p]
        ieff = info[p, p] - info[p, c] @ np.linalg.pinv(info[np.ix_(c, c)]) @ info[c, p]
        if ieff <= 1e-12:
            continue
        mi = gr[p] ** 2 / ieff
        epc = gr[p] / ieff
        if it[0] == "path":
            sepc = epc * sd[model.idx[it[1]]] / sd[model.idx[it[2]]]
        else:
            va, vb = S[model.idx[it[1]], model.idx[it[1]]], S[model.idx[it[2]], model.idx[it[2]]]
            sepc = epc / math.sqrt(va * vb) if va > 0 and vb > 0 else SYS
        rows.append((it, cls, mi, epc, sepc))
    order = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(model.names)}
    shown = sorted([r for r in rows if r[2] >= minchi2],
                   key=lambda r: (r[0][0] != "path", order[r[0][2]], order[r[0][1]]))
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nModification indices\n\n", "text")
    if not shown:
        out.write(f"(no modification indices to report; all chi2 values less than {minchi2})\n", "text")
    else:
        line = "-" * 14 + "+" + "-" * 46
        out.write("-" * 61 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':14}|{'Standard':>46}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':14}|{'MI':>10}{'df':>7}{'P>MI':>7}{'EPC':>11}{'EPC':>11}\n", "text")
        out.write(line + "\n", "text")

        def vals(mi, epc, sepc):
            return (f"{mi:>10.3f}{1:>7}{float(st.chi2.sf(mi, 1)):>7.2f}{_fv(epc, '%9.0g'):>11}"
                    f"{_fv(sepc, '%9.0g'):>11}\n")
        paths = [x for x in shown if x[0][0] == "path"]
        covs = [x for x in shown if x[0][0] != "path"]
        # VERIFY: the Structural section (paths into latent variables) is not in case 1909
        for sec, members in (("Structural", [x for x in paths if x[0][2] in spec.latent]),
                             ("Measurement", [x for x in paths if x[0][2] in spec.observed])):
            if not members:
                continue
            out.write(f"{sec:<14}|\n", "text")
            cur = None
            for it, cls, mi, epc, sepc in members:
                if it[2] != cur:
                    cur = it[2]
                    out.write(f"  {cur + ' <-':<12}|\n", "text")
                out.write(f"{it[1][-12:]:>13} |", "text")
                out.write(vals(mi, epc, sepc), "result")
            out.write(line + "\n", "text")
        for it, cls, mi, epc, sepc in covs:
            out.write(f"{_label(model, it):<14}|", "text")
            out.write(vals(mi, epc, sepc), "result")
        out.write("-" * 61 + "\n", "text")
        out.write("EPC = expected parameter change\n", "text")
    classes = ["scoef", "scons", "mcoef", "mcons", "serrvar", "merrvar", "smerrcov", "meanex", "covex"]
    r = {"N_groups": 1.0, "nobs": _nobs(s, est)}
    if shown:
        r["mindices_pclass"] = Matrix(np.array([[classes.index(x[1]) + 1] for x in shown], dtype=float),
                                      [_label(model, x[0]) for x in shown], ["pclass"])
        r["mindices"] = Matrix(np.array([[x[2], 1, float(st.chi2.sf(x[2], 1)), x[3], x[4]] for x in shown]),
                               [_label(model, x[0]) for x in shown], ["MI", "df", "P>MI", "EPC", "stdEPC"])

def _tcell(t, wide=False) -> str:
    """Wald cells are 10, 11 and 10 wide; score cells 11, 12 and 10 (case 1909)."""
    stat, df, p = t

    if df == 0 or not np.isfinite(stat):
        return f"{'.':>{w1}}{'.':>{w2}}{'.':>10}"
    return f"{stat:>{w1}.3f}{df:>{w2}}{p:>10.4f}"


def _ginv_order(m0, res):
    """Equations in the order of the variables, each with its paths and then its intercept;
    variances and covariances after them."""
    pos = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(m0.names)}

    def key(x):
        kind, a, b = x[0]
        if kind == "path":
            return (0, pos[b], 0, pos[a])
        if kind == "mean":
            return (0, pos[a], 1, 0)
        return (1, 0 if kind == "var" else 1, pos[a], pos[b])
    return sorted(res, key=key)


def _lm_anchor(prob, th_glob, it):
    """Score test of a path fixed in every group: the path becomes free (at its fixed value) in
    the groups after the first, which leaves the model identified."""
    from .semfit import Problem
    kind, a, b = it
    models = []
    for g, m in enumerate(prob.models):
        if g == 0:
            models.append(m)
            continue
        mm = copy.copy(m)
        mm.fixed_A = dict(m.fixed_A)
        key = (m.idx[b], m.idx[a])
        v = mm.fixed_A.pop(key)
        mm.free = list(m.free) + [it]
        mm.nfree = len(mm.free)
        mm._anchor_value = v
        models.append(mm)
    ext = Problem(models, prob.data, prob.method, prob.inv,
                  split={(g, it) for g in range(1, len(models))})
    t = np.zeros(ext.nglob)
    for g, m in enumerate(models):
        local = prob.group_theta(th_glob, g)
        vals = np.concatenate([local, [m._anchor_value]]) if g else local
        t[ext.gmap[g]] = vals
    return _lm(prob, th_glob, ext, t=t)


def _class_tests(s, est, prob, th, Vg, show):
    from .semfit import PCLASSES
    out = s.output
    G = len(prob.models)
    m0 = prob.models[0]
    out.write("-" * 76 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Class':>14} |{'Wald Test':^30}|{'Score Test':^30}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>14} |{'chi2':>10}{'df':>6}{'p':>9}   |{'chi2':>10}{'df':>6}{'p':>9}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 15 + "+" + "-" * 60 + "\n", "text")
    for cls in PCLASSES:
        if cls not in show:
            continue
        its = [it for i, it in enumerate(m0.free) if prob.classes[0][i] == cls
               and all(it in m.free for m in prob.models) and it not in est.extra["hidden"]]
        if not its:
            continue
        constrained = cls in prob.inv
        wald = score = (np.nan, 0, np.nan)
        if constrained:
            ext = _extended(prob, split_all=set(its))
            stat, df = _lm(prob, th, ext)
            score = (stat, df, float(st.chi2.sf(stat, df)) if df > 0 else np.nan)
        else:
            rows = []
            for it in its:
                ids = [prob.gmap[g][prob.models[g].free.index(it)] for g in range(G)]
                for g in range(1, G):
                    r = np.zeros(prob.nglob)
                    r[ids[g]] += 1
                    r[ids[0]] -= 1
                    rows.append(r)
            R = np.array(rows)
            d = R @ th
            Vd = R @ Vg @ R.T
            stat = float(d @ np.linalg.pinv(Vd) @ d)
            df = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(Vd))
            wald = (stat, df, float(st.chi2.sf(stat, df)) if df > 0 else np.nan)
        out.write(f"{cls:>14} |", "text")
        out.write(_tcell(wald).replace("", "") + "   |" + _tcell(score) + "\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * 76 + "\n", "text")

"""Linear Gaussian state-space models (Kalman filter) shared by ucm, sspace and dfactor.

    y_t = D z_t + d_t + e_t,        e_t ~ N(0, H)
    z_t = A z_{t-1} + c + w_t,      w_t ~ N(0, S)

Initial state: mean a0 and covariance P0. States flagged diffuse get a very large variance and the
observations they make uninformative are left out of the likelihood (the limit of De Jong's diffuse
filter)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from scipy import linalg

KAPPA = 1e7


def stationary_cov(A: np.ndarray, S: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray | None:
    """Solution of P = A P A' + S, or None if A has eigenvalues on or outside the unit circle."""
    if A.size and np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(A))) >= 1 - 1e-9:
        return None
    try:
        return linalg.solve_discrete_lyapunov(A, S)
    except (np.linalg.LinAlgError, ValueError):
        return None


def initial_state(A: np.ndarray, S: np.ndarray, diffuse: np.ndarray | None = None):
    """(a0, P0): diffuse states get variance KAPPA; the rest the stationary covariance (zero
    mean). If nothing is declared diffuse and A is not stable, every state is diffuse."""
    r = A.shape[0]
    mask = np.zeros(r, dtype=bool) if diffuse is None else np.asarray(diffuse, dtype=bool)
    P0 = np.zeros((r, r))
    st = ~mask
    if st.any():
        Pst = stationary_cov(A[np.ix_(st, st)], S[np.ix_(st, st)])
        if Pst is None:
            mask[:] = True
            st = ~mask
        else:
            P0[np.ix_(st, st)] = Pst
    P0[np.ix_(mask, mask)] = KAPPA * np.eye(int(mask.sum()))
    return np.zeros(r), P0, mask


def kalman_loglik(y: np.ndarray, D: np.ndarray, A: np.ndarray, S: np.ndarray, H: np.ndarray,
                  c: np.ndarray | None = None, d: np.ndarray | None = None,
                  diffuse: np.ndarray | None = None, return_states: bool = False):
    """Log-likelihood contributions (length T; zero for the missing observations, only the constant for the diffuse ones).
    y: (T, m) with NaN for missing. Returns None when the filter breaks down."""
    T, m = y.shape
    r = A.shape[0]
    a, P, mask = initial_state(A, S, diffuse)
    c = np.zeros(r) if c is None else c
    d = np.zeros((T, m)) if d is None else d
    out = np.zeros(T)
    fa = np.zeros((T, r)) if return_states else None
    fP = np.zeros((T, r, r)) if return_states else None
    log2pi = np.log(2 * np.pi)
    for t in range(T):
        a = A @ a + c
        P = A @ P @ A.T + S
        obs = np.isfinite(y[t])
        if obs.any():
            Dt = D[obs]
            v = y[t, obs] - Dt @ a - d[t, obs]
            F = Dt @ P @ Dt.T + H[np.ix_(obs, obs)]
            try:
                Fi = np.linalg.inv(F)
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                return None
            sign, ld = np.linalg.slogdet(F)
            if sign <= 0:
                return None
            if not (mask.any() and np.max(np.diag(Dt @ P @ Dt.T)) >= KAPPA / 100):
                out[t] = -0.5 * (obs.sum() * log2pi + ld + float(v @ Fi @ v))
            else:
                out[t] = -0.5 * obs.sum() * log2pi      # VERIFY (case 1904): a diffuse observation keeps its constant
            K = P @ Dt.T @ Fi
            a = a + K @ v
            P = P - K @ F @ K.T
            P = (P + P.T) / 2
        if return_states:
            fa[t], fP[t] = a, P
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(out)):
        return None
    return (out, fa, fP) if return_states else out


def kalman_onestep(y: np.ndarray, D: np.ndarray, A: np.ndarray, S: np.ndarray, H: np.ndarray,
                   c: np.ndarray | None = None, d: np.ndarray | None = None,
                   diffuse: np.ndarray | None = None, full: bool = False):
    """One-step-ahead predictions of y (T, m) and the variances of the prediction errors, from the
    same filter as kalman_loglik; missing observations are predicted but do not update the
    states. full: also the covariance matrices of the prediction errors (T, m, m)."""
    T, m = y.shape
    r = A.shape[0]
    a, P, _mask = initial_state(A, S, diffuse)
    c = np.zeros(r) if c is None else c
    d = np.zeros((T, m)) if d is None else d
    yhat = np.full((T, m), np.nan)
    fvar = np.full((T, m), np.nan)
    Fs = np.full((T, m, m), np.nan)
    for t in range(T):
        a = A @ a + c
        P = A @ P @ A.T + S
        yhat[t] = D @ a + d[t]
        Fall = D @ P @ D.T + H
        fvar[t] = np.diag(Fall)
        Fs[t] = Fall
        obs = np.isfinite(y[t])
        if obs.any():
            Dt = D[obs]
            v = y[t, obs] - Dt @ a - d[t, obs]
            F = Fall[np.ix_(obs, obs)]
            K = P @ Dt.T @ np.linalg.inv(F)
            a = a + K @ v
            P = P - K @ F @ K.T
            P = (P + P.T) / 2
    return (yhat, fvar, Fs) if full else (yhat, fvar)

"""Cox proportional-hazards model: stcox, its predictions and estat phtest ([ST] stcox,
[ST] stcox postestimation, [ST] stcox PH-assumption tests).

The Cox partial likelihood with the Breslow (default) or Efron approximation for ties; delayed
entry and strata enter through the risk sets. The robust variance uses the efficient score
residuals (Lin and Wei 1989). Layout details carry the VERIFY mark
(compat/do/0902_stcox_streg.do).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core import survival as SV
from ..core.grouping import group_ids
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..lazy import lazy
from . import fvars
from .ml import maximize, print_log, refine
from .ml import options as ml_options
from .results import Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns
from .st import require_st, st_data
from .stfit import STSample, cluster_note, fmt, header_block, place
from .vce import bread, sandwich

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# partial likelihood
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _Stratum:
    def __init__(self, t, t0, d, X, w):
        self.t, self.t0, self.d, self.X, self.w = t, t0, d, X, w
        self.ot = np.argsort(t, kind="stable")
        self.ts = t[self.ot]
        self.ot0 = np.argsort(t0, kind="stable")
        self.t0s = t0[self.ot0]
        fail = d > 0
        self.ft = np.unique(t[fail])                      # distinct failure times
        self.fidx = np.searchsorted(self.ft, t[fail])
        self.fail = fail
        m = len(self.ft)
        self.D = np.bincount(self.fidx, weights=w[fail], minlength=m)         # weighted failures
        self.sx = np.zeros((m, X.shape[1]))
        np.add.at(self.sx, self.fidx, X[fail] * w[fail][:, None])
        self.ia = np.searchsorted(self.ts, self.ft, "left")
        self.ib = np.searchsorted(self.t0s, self.ft, "left")

    def sums(self, r: np.ndarray, order: int):
        """S0, S1, S2 over the risk sets of the failure times (weights w·r)."""
        wr = self.w * r
        X = self.X

        def rev(a, o):
            c = np.cumsum(a[o][::-1], axis=0)[::-1]
            return np.concatenate([c, np.zeros((1,) + c.shape[1:])], axis=0)

        S0 = rev(wr, self.ot)[self.ia] - rev(wr, self.ot0)[self.ib]
        S1 = S2 = None
        if order >= 1:
            a1 = X * wr[:, None]
            S1 = rev(a1, self.ot)[self.ia] - rev(a1, self.ot0)[self.ib]
        if order >= 2:
            a2 = X[:, :, None] * X[:, None, :] * wr[:, None, None]
            S2 = rev(a2, self.ot)[self.ia] - rev(a2, self.ot0)[self.ib]
        return S0, S1, S2

    def fsums(self, r: np.ndarray):
        """Sums over the failures tied at each time (for Efron)."""
        f = self.fail
        wr = (self.w * r)[f]
        m = len(self.ft)
        X = self.X[f]
        F0 = np.bincount(self.fidx, weights=wr, minlength=m)
        F1 = np.zeros((m, X.shape[1]))
        np.add.at(F1, self.fidx, X * wr[:, None])
        F2 = np.zeros((m, X.shape[1], X.shape[1]))
        np.add.at(F2, self.fidx, X[:, :, None] * X[:, None, :] * wr[:, None, None])
        return F0, F1, F2


def _cox_fun(strata: list[_Stratum], ties: str, k: int):
    def fun(b, todo):
        ll = 0.0
        g = np.zeros(k)
        H = np.zeros((k, k))
        for sr in strata:
            xb = sr.X @ b
            r = np.exp(xb)
            S0, S1, S2 = sr.sums(r, 0 if todo == 0 else 2)
            ll += float(np.sum((sr.w * xb)[sr.fail]))
            if ties == "efron":
                F0, F1, F2 = sr.fsums(r)
                cnt = np.bincount(sr.fidx, weights=sr.w[sr.fail], minlength=len(sr.ft))
                for j in range(len(sr.ft)):
                    m = int(round(cnt[j]))
                    for l_ in range(m):
                        c = l_ / m
                        s0 = S0[j] - c * F0[j]
                        ll -= np.log(s0)
                        if todo:
                            s1 = S1[j] - c * F1[j]
                            s2 = S2[j] - c * F2[j]
                            a = s1 / s0
                            g -= a
                            H -= s2 / s0 - np.outer(a, a)
                if todo:
                    g += sr.sx.sum(axis=0)
            else:
                ll -= float(np.sum(sr.D * np.log(S0)))
                if todo:
                    a = S1 / S0[:, None]
                    g += sr.sx.sum(axis=0) - (sr.D[:, None] * a).sum(axis=0)
                    H -= np.einsum("j,jkl->kl", sr.D / S0, S2) - np.einsum("j,jk,jl->kl", sr.D, a, a)
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        return ll, g, H
    return fun


def _exact_fun(strata: list[_Stratum], method: str, k: int):
    """Log likelihood, gradient and Hessian of exactm/exactp: a sum over the failure times of the
    strata. A time with a single failure has the same term in every method."""
    sets = []
    for sr in strata:
        for u in sr.ft:
            risk = (sr.t0 < u) & (sr.t >= u)
            fail = sr.fail & (sr.t == u)
            sets.append((np.flatnonzero(risk), fail[risk], sr.X))

    def fun(b, todo):
        ll, g, H = 0.0, np.zeros(k), np.zeros((k, k))
        for idx, isf, X in sets:
            xr = X[idx]
            if isf.sum() == 1:
                r = np.exp(xr @ b)
                S0 = r.sum()
                a = (r[:, None] * xr).sum(axis=0) / S0
                ll += float((xr[isf] @ b)[0]) - float(np.log(S0))
                g += xr[isf][0] - a
                H -= np.einsum("j,jk,jl->kl", r, xr, xr) / S0 - np.outer(a, a)
            elif method == "exactp":
                l_, g_, H_ = SV.exactp_term(xr, isf, b)
                ll, g, H = ll + l_, g + g_, H + H_
            else:
                l_, g_, H_ = SV.exactm_term(xr[isf], xr[~isf], b)
                ll, g, H = ll + l_, g + g_, H + H_
        return (ll, None, None) if todo == 0 else (ll, g, H)
    return fun


def _cox_score_resid(strata_obs, b, ties):
    """Efficient score residuals per observation (Breslow form; with Efron ties the
    risk-set means of the Breslow form are used: VERIFY)."""
    out = []
    for sr, idx in strata_obs:
        r = np.exp(sr.X @ b)
        S0, S1, _ = sr.sums(r, 1)
        xbar = S1 / S0[:, None]
        haz = sr.D / S0                       # baseline hazard increments
        # cumulative sums over failure times of haz and haz*xbar, evaluated at t and t0
        ch = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(haz)])
        chx = np.concatenate([np.zeros((1, sr.X.shape[1])), np.cumsum(haz[:, None] * xbar, axis=0)])
        jt = np.searchsorted(sr.ft, sr.t, "right")
        jt0 = np.searchsorted(sr.ft, sr.t0, "right")
        A = ch[jt] - ch[jt0]
        AX = chx[jt] - chx[jt0]
        U = -r[:, None] * (sr.X * A[:, None] - AX)
        f = sr.fail
        jf = np.searchsorted(sr.ft, sr.t[f])
        U[f] += sr.X[f] - xbar[jf]
        out.append((idx, U))
    return out


def _coefs(est: Estimates) -> np.ndarray:
    """The estimated coefficients (without the omitted columns)."""
    return est.b[[i for i, c in enumerate(est.cols) if c.values is not None]]


def _strata_of_all(ds, strata_vars: list[str], mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Stratum index (as in the fit) of every observation whose strata values occur in the
    estimation sample; -1 for the others. Without strata, 0 everywhere."""
    if not strata_vars:
        return np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=np.int64)
    gid = group_ids(ds, strata_vars)[0]
    present = np.unique(gid[mask])
    h = np.searchsorted(present, gid)
    ok = (h < len(present)) & (present[np.minimum(h, len(present) - 1)] == gid)
    return np.where(ok, h, -1)


def _efron_hazard(sr: "_Stratum", r: np.ndarray, S0: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Baseline hazard increments with Efron's correction for the failures tied at each time."""
    F0, _, _ = sr.fsums(r)
    cnt = np.rint(np.bincount(sr.fidx, weights=sr.w[sr.fail], minlength=len(sr.ft))).astype(int)
    return np.array([sum(1.0 / (S0[j] - (l_ / cnt[j]) * F0[j]) for l_ in range(cnt[j]))
                     for j in range(len(sr.ft))])


def cmd_stcox(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "cox", args)
        return
    spec = {"nohr": 4, "breslow": 6, "efron": 5, "exactm": 6, "exactp": 6, "strata": 3, "nolog": 4,
            "log": 3, "noshow": 6, "iterate": 4, "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4, "nrtolerance": 4,
            "estimate": 3, "basesurv": 6, "basechazard": 6, "basehc": 5, "noheader": 6}
    stx = STSample(s, args, spec)
    o = stx.o
    ties = "efron" if o.get("efron") else "exactm" if o.get("exactm") else "exactp" if o.get("exactp") else "breslow"
    if ties.startswith("exact"):
        if stx.robust:
            stx.notes_and_header(s)
            raise StataError(198, f"may not specify both {ties} and robust options")
        if stx.wtype:
            raise StataError(198, f"weights are not available yet in OpenDTA with {ties}")
    stx.notes_and_header(s)
    X = stx.X
    k = X.shape[1]
    if k == 0:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")   # VERIFY: stcox, estimate
    strata_var = s.expand_varlist(o["strata"]) if isinstance(o.get("strata"), str) else []
    sgrp = group_ids(s.data, strata_var, stx.mask)[0][stx.mask] if strata_var else np.zeros(stx.n, dtype=int)
    strata_obs = []
    for h in np.unique(sgrp):
        idx = np.flatnonzero(sgrp == h)
        strata_obs.append((_Stratum(stx.t[idx], stx.t0[idx], stx.d[idx], X[idx], stx.w[idx]), idx))
    strata = [sr for sr, _ in strata_obs]
    tied = any(np.any(np.bincount(sr.fidx, weights=sr.w[sr.fail], minlength=len(sr.ft)) > 1)
               for sr in strata)
    fun = _exact_fun(strata, ties, k) if ties.startswith("exact") else _cox_fun(strata, ties, k)
    # VERIFY: stcox stops one iteration earlier than ml when g H^-1 g' is already tiny (stratified
    # model in compat 0902: 1.9e-8 stops, 7.4e-7 does not)
    res = maximize(fun, np.zeros(k), nr_stop=1e-7, **ml_options(o))
    refine(fun, res)              # "Refining estimates", outside the iteration log
    ll0 = res.log[0][1]
    robust = stx.robust
    lab = "log pseudolikelihood" if robust else "log likelihood"
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        print_log(s.output, res, lab)
        s.output.write("Refining estimates:\n", "text")
        s.output.write(f"{'Iteration 0:':<14} {lab} = {fmt(res.ll):>10}  \n", "text")
    V = bread(res.H)
    clusters, clustvar = stx.clusters()
    n_clust = None
    if robust:
        U = np.zeros((stx.n, k))
        for idx, Ui in _cox_score_resid(strata_obs, res.b, ties):
            U[idx] = Ui
        # compat 0902: the standard errors include the factor n/(n-1)
        V, n_clust = sandwich(V, U, stx.w, fweight=stx.fweight,
                              n=float(stx.w.sum()) if stx.fweight else float(stx.n), clusters=clusters)
    b = res.b
    if robust:
        chi2type = "Wald"
        try:
            chi2 = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(V, b))
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            chi2 = SYS
    else:
        chi2type = "LR"
        chi2 = 2 * (res.ll - ll0)
    pval = float(chi2_tail(chi2, k)) if chi2 < SYS else SYS
    smp = stx.smp
    names, bf, Vf, _pos, bmap, semap = place(smp, b, V, constant=False)
    est = Estimates("cox", "_t", names, bf, Vf, stx.n, "z", None)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=False)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, False, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = "Robust" if robust else ""
    est.clustvar, est.n_clust, est.robust = clustvar, n_clust, robust
    x = stx.scalars()
    x.update({"ll": res.ll, "ll_0": ll0, "chi2": chi2, "p": pval, "df_m": k, "chi2type": chi2type})
    est.extra = x
    est.ties, est.tied, est.strata_vars = ties, tied, strata_var
    est.hr = not o.get("nohr")
    est.display = _display_cox
    est.predict = _predict_cox
    est.predict_opts = {"hr": 2, "basesurv": 5, "basechazard": 5, "basehc": 5, "csnell": 3,
                        "mgale": 2, "schoenfeld": 3, "scaledsch": 3, "esr": 3, "partial": 4}
    est.estat = {"phtest": (3, _phtest)}
    est.cox = {"strata": strata_obs, "sgrp": sgrp, "mask": stx.mask.copy()}
    _post_cox(s, est, args, stx, res, clusters)
    _stcox_basevars(s, est, o)
    _display_cox(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"))


def _post_cox(s: "Session", est: Estimates, args: str, stx: STSample, res, clusters) -> None:
    """e() in the order Stata lists it (compat 0902)."""

def _stcox_basevars(s, est, o):
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    for opt in ("basesurv", "basechazard", "basehc"):

def _baseline(s, est):
    """Baseline cumulative hazard (covariates at zero) at each observation's _t and _t0,
    the hazard contribution at failure times and the baseline survivor at _t, by stratum."""
    ds = s.data
    info = require_st(s)
    n = ds.nobs
    H_t = np.full(n, SYS)
    H_t0 = np.full(n, SYS)
    S_t = np.full(n, SYS)
    h_c = np.full(n, SYS)
    cox = est.cox
    st_ok = (ds.get("_st").data == 1)
    t_all = ds.get("_t").data.astype(float)
    t0_all = ds.get("_t0").data.astype(float)
    d_all = ds.get("_d").data
    # strata of all st observations: those of the estimation sample, by value of the strata vars
    sgrp_all = _strata_of_all(ds, est.strata_vars, cox["mask"])
    b = _coefs(est)
    for h, (sr, idx) in enumerate(cox["strata"]):
        r = np.exp(sr.X @ b)
        S0, _, _ = sr.sums(r, 0)
        haz = _efron_hazard(sr, r, S0) if est.ties == "efron" else sr.D / S0
        ch = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(haz)])
        # baseline survivor: Kalbfleisch-Prentice product of the conditional survival
        # probabilities alpha_j, which solve sum_D r/(1 - alpha^r) = sum_R r ([ST] stcox
        # postestimation, Methods and formulas)
        alpha = np.ones(len(sr.ft))
        fr = r[sr.fail]
        fw = sr.w[sr.fail]
        for j in range(len(sr.ft)):
            rj, wj = fr[sr.fidx == j], fw[sr.fidx == j]
            if len(rj) == 1 and wj[0] == 1:
                alpha[j] = max(1 - rj[0] / S0[j], 0.0) ** (1 / rj[0])
                continue
            lo_, hi_ = 0.0, 1.0
            for _ in range(200):
                mid = (lo_ + hi_) / 2
                f_ = np.sum(wj * rj / (1 - mid ** rj)) - S0[j]
                if f_ > 0:
                    hi_ = mid
                else:
                    lo_ = mid
            alpha[j] = (lo_ + hi_) / 2
        cs_ = np.concatenate([[1.0], np.cumprod(alpha)])
        m = st_ok & (sgrp_all == h) & (t_all < SYS)
        S_t[m] = cs_[np.searchsorted(sr.ft, t_all[m], "right")]
        H_t[m] = ch[np.searchsorted(sr.ft, t_all[m], "right")]
        H_t0[m] = ch[np.searchsorted(sr.ft, t0_all[m], "right")]
        mf = m & (d_all == 1)
        j = np.searchsorted(sr.ft, t_all[mf])
        okj = (j < len(sr.ft)) & (sr.ft[np.minimum(j, len(sr.ft) - 1)] == t_all[mf])
        vals = np.where(okj, haz[np.minimum(j, len(haz) - 1)], SYS)
        h_c[mf] = vals
    return H_t, H_t0, h_c, S_t, info


def _predict_cox(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    from .postest import design_all, xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    ds = s.data
    if stat in ("", "hr"):
        return np.where(ok, np.exp(xb), SYS), ("" if stat else "(option hr assumed; relative hazard)")
    if stat == "xb":
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ""
    if stat == "stdp":
        X, _ = design_all(s, est)
        sp = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", X, est.V, X), 0))
        return np.where(ok, sp, SYS), ""
    H_t, H_t0, h_c, S_t, info = _baseline(s, est)
    if stat == "basechazard":
        return H_t, ""
    if stat == "basesurv":
        return S_t, ""
    if stat == "basehc":
        return h_c, ""
    if stat in ("csnell", "mgale"):
        cs = np.where(ok & (H_t < SYS), np.exp(xb) * (H_t - H_t0), SYS)
        d = ds.get("_d").data
        mg = np.where(cs < SYS, d - cs, SYS)
        val = cs if stat == "csnell" else mg
        if info.idvar and not getattr(est, "_partial", False):
            # one value per subject, on its last record (VERIFY: Stata's default without partial)
            ids = ds.get(info.idvar).data
            tt = ds.get("_t").data
            res = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
            acc: dict = {}
            last: dict = {}
            for i in np.nonzero(val < SYS)[0]:
                acc[ids[i]] = acc.get(ids[i], 0.0) + val[i]
                if ids[i] not in last or tt[i] >= tt[last[ids[i]]]:
                    last[ids[i]] = i
            for kk, i in last.items():
                res[i] = acc[kk]
            val = res
        return val, ""
    if stat in ("schoenfeld", "scaledsch", "esr"):
        raise StataError(198, f"use estat phtest; predict {stat} with several new variables is not "
                         "available in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")

def _schoenfeld(est):
    """Unscaled Schoenfeld residuals of each failure (rows) and their times."""
    b = _coefs(est)
    res, times = [], []
    for sr, _idx in est.cox["strata"]:
        r = np.exp(sr.X @ b)
        S0, S1, _ = sr.sums(r, 1)
        xbar = S1 / S0[:, None]
        f = np.nonzero(sr.fail)[0]
        j = np.searchsorted(sr.ft, sr.t[f])
        for i, jj in zip(f, j):
            reps = int(round(sr.w[i]))
            for _ in range(max(reps, 1)):
                res.append(sr.X[i] - xbar[jj])
                times.append(sr.t[i])
    return np.array(res), np.array(times)


def _phtest(s: "Session", est: Estimates, rest: str) -> None:
    from ..lang.syntax import match_options
    from .km import km
    o = match_options(rest.lstrip(", "), {"detail": 1, "log": 3, "km": 2, "rank": 4, "time": 4,
                                          "plot": 4}) if rest.strip(" ,") else {}
    R, tt = _schoenfeld(est)
    if o.get("log"):
        g, tlab = np.log(tt), "Log(t)"
    elif o.get("km"):
        sd = st_data(s, est.cox["mask"])
        k = km(sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d, sd.w)
        j = np.searchsorted(k.times, tt, "right") - 1
        g, tlab = 1 - k.S[j], "1-KM"     # VERIFY: Stata's km scale
    elif o.get("rank"):
        g, tlab = st.rankdata(tt), "Rank(t)"
    else:
        g, tlab = tt.astype(float), "Time"
    xx = g - g.mean()
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(est.cols) if c.values is not None]
    V = est.V[np.ix_(pos, pos)]
    nd = R.shape[0]
    names = [est.names[i] for i in pos]
    out = s.output
    out.write("\n      Test of proportional-hazards assumption\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"      Time:  {tlab}\n", "text")
    out.write("      " + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    if o.get("detail"):
        out.write("                  |       rho            chi2       df       Prob>chi2\n", "text")
        out.write("      " + "-" * 12 + "+" + "-" * 51 + "\n", "text")
        r2 = R @ V * nd
        for j, nm in enumerate(names):
            test = float(xx @ r2[:, j])
            z = test ** 2 / (V[j, j] * nd * float(xx @ xx))
            rho = float(np.corrcoef(xx, r2[:, j])[0, 1])
            p = float(chi2_tail(z, 1))
            out.write(f"      {nm[:11]:<11} |", "text")
            out.write(f"{rho:>13.5f}{z:>13.2f}{1:>9}{p:>15.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write("      " + "-" * 12 + "+" + "-" * 51 + "\n", "text")
    else:
        out.write("                  |                      chi2       df       Prob>chi2\n", "text")
        out.write("      " + "-" * 12 + "+" + "-" * 51 + "\n", "text")
    test = xx @ R
    zg = float(test @ V @ test) * nd / float(xx @ xx)
    df = len(names)
    pg = float(chi2_tail(zg, df))
    out.write(f"      {'global test':<11} |", "text")
    out.write(f"{zg:>26.2f}{df:>9}{pg:>15.4f}\n", "result")
    out.write("      " + "-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
    s.r = {"chi2": zg, "df": float(df), "p": pg}
