"""Competing-risks regression: stcrreg ([ST] stcrreg).

The Fine-Gray subhazard model: the Breslow partial likelihood in which subjects that had a
competing event stay in the risk sets with weight S_c(t)/S_c(t_j), S_c being the Kaplan-Meier
survivor function of the censoring times. The variance is the sandwich estimator with the scores
of the weighted likelihood plus the term for the estimation of S_c (Fine and Gray 1999). Layout
details carry the VERIFY mark (compat/do/1901_survival.do)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..lang.words import parse_numlist
from .km import km
from .ml import maximize, print_log
from .ml import options as ml_options
from .results import Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns
from .st import _fail_text
from .stcox import _Stratum
from .stfit import STSample, cluster_note, fmt, place
from .vce import bread, sandwich

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


class FineGray:
    """Data of the weighted partial likelihood: t, t0, d (failure of interest), comp (competing
    event at the exit of the record), cens (censoring at the exit of the record), weights and
    the design matrix X."""

    def __init__(self, t, t0, d, comp, cens, w, X):
        self.t, self.t0, self.d, self.comp, self.cens, self.w, self.X = t, t0, d, comp, cens, w, X
        self.km = km(t, t0, cens.astype(np.float64), w)
        self.risk = _Stratum(t, t0, d, X, w)
        self.ft = self.risk.ft
        self.sc_ft = self.sc_left(self.ft)
        c = np.flatnonzero(comp)
        c = c[np.argsort(t[c], kind="stable")]
        self.ic = c
        self.tc = t[c]
        self.invsc = 1.0 / self.sc_left(self.tc) if len(c) else np.zeros(0)
        self.cnt = np.searchsorted(self.tc, self.ft, "left")      # competing before each failure time

    def sc_left(self, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        """Kaplan-Meier survivor function of the censoring times just before x."""
        k = self.km
        j = np.searchsorted(k.times, x, "left") - 1
        return np.where(j >= 0, k.S[np.maximum(j, 0)], 1.0)

    def _csum(self, a: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.concatenate([np.zeros((1,) + a.shape[1:]), np.cumsum(a, axis=0)], axis=0)

    def sums(self, r: np.ndarray, order: int):
        """S0, S1, S2 over the weighted risk sets of the failure times."""
        S0, S1, S2 = self.risk.sums(r, order)
        if len(self.ic):
            wr = (self.w * r)[self.ic] * self.invsc
            Xc = self.X[self.ic]
            S0 = S0 + self.sc_ft * self._csum(wr)[self.cnt]
            if order >= 1:
                S1 = S1 + self.sc_ft[:, None] * self._csum(wr[:, None] * Xc)[self.cnt]
            if order >= 2:
                S2 = S2 + self.sc_ft[:, None, None] * self._csum(
                    wr[:, None, None] * Xc[:, :, None] * Xc[:, None, :])[self.cnt]
        return S0, S1, S2

    def fun(self, b, todo):
        rk = self.risk
        xb = self.X @ b
        S0, S1, S2 = self.sums(np.exp(xb), 0 if todo == 0 else 2)
        ll = float(np.sum((self.w * xb)[rk.fail])) - float(np.sum(rk.D * np.log(S0)))
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        a = S1 / S0[:, None]
        g = rk.sx.sum(axis=0) - (rk.D[:, None] * a).sum(axis=0)
        H = -(np.einsum("j,jkl->kl", rk.D / S0, S2) - np.einsum("j,jk,jl->kl", rk.D, a, a))
        return ll, g, H

    def baseline(self, b) -> np.ndarray:
        """Breslow cumulative baseline subhazard at the failure times."""
        S0, _, _ = self.sums(np.exp(self.X @ b), 0)
        return np.cumsum(self.risk.D / S0)

    def scores(self, b) -> np.ndarray:
        """Score of each record: the partial-likelihood term plus the one for the estimation of
        the censoring distribution (VERIFY: derived from Fine and Gray 1999)."""
        t, t0, d, w, X = self.t, self.t0, self.d, self.w, self.X
        rk = self.risk
        n, k = X.shape
        r = np.exp(X @ b)
        S0, S1, _ = self.sums(r, 1)
        a = S1 / S0[:, None]
        c = rk.D / S0
        Cc, Ca = self._csum(c), self._csum(c[:, None] * a)
        lo = np.searchsorted(self.ft, t0, "right")
        hi = np.searchsorted(self.ft, t, "right")
        eta = -r[:, None] * (X * (Cc[hi] - Cc[lo])[:, None] - (Ca[hi] - Ca[lo]))
        f = np.flatnonzero(d > 0)
        eta[f] += X[f] - a[np.searchsorted(self.ft, t[f])]
        cs = c * self.sc_ft
        Ccs, Cas = self._csum(cs), self._csum(cs[:, None] * a)
        ic = self.ic
        if len(ic):
            T0 = Ccs[-1] - Ccs[hi[ic]]
            T1 = Cas[-1] - Cas[hi[ic]]
            eta[ic] -= (r[ic] * self.invsc_of(ic))[:, None] * (X[ic] * T0[:, None] - T1)
        psi = self._psi(r, a, c, cs, Ccs, Cas)
        return eta + psi

    def invsc_of(self, rows: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return 1.0 / self.sc_left(self.t[rows])

    def _psi(self, r, a, c, cs, Ccs, Cas) -> np.ndarray:
        t, t0, X, w = self.t, self.t0, self.X, self.w
        n, k = X.shape
        kk = self.km
        grid = np.flatnonzero(kk.d > 0)
        psi = np.zeros((n, k))
        if not len(grid):
            return psi
        s = kk.times[grid]
        ybar, dN = kk.n[grid], kk.d[grid]
        wr = (w * r)[self.ic] * self.invsc
        Xc = self.X[self.ic]
        P0, P1 = self._csum(wr), self._csum(wr[:, None] * Xc)
        up = np.searchsorted(self.tc, s, "right")
        lw = np.searchsorted(self.tc, s, "left")
        nf = np.searchsorted(self.ft, s, "right")
        q = P1[up] * (Ccs[-1] - Ccs[nf])[:, None] - P0[up][:, None] * (Cas[-1] - Cas[nf])
        at = np.searchsorted(self.ft, s, "left")
        edge = (at < len(self.ft)) & (self.ft[np.minimum(at, len(self.ft) - 1)] == s)
        m = at[edge]
        q[edge] += cs[m][:, None] * (P1[lw[edge]] - P0[lw[edge]][:, None] * a[m])
        G = self._csum(q * (dN / ybar ** 2)[:, None])
        hi = np.searchsorted(s, t, "right")
        lo = np.searchsorted(s, t0, "right")
        psi -= G[hi] - G[lo]
        ce = np.flatnonzero(self.cens)
        psi[ce] += q[np.searchsorted(s, t[ce])] / ybar[np.searchsorted(s, t[ce])][:, None]
        return psi


def _cox_start(t, t0, d, w, X) -> np.ndarray:
    """Starting values: the Cox (Breslow) estimates with the competing events censored, which is
    where Stata's log starts (compat 1901)."""
    k = X.shape[1]
    times = np.unique(t[d > 0])
    risks = [(t0 < tf) & (t >= tf) for tf in times]
    fails = [(t == tf) & (d > 0) for tf in times]

    def fun(b, todo):
        eta = X @ b
        ll, g, H = 0.0, np.zeros(k), np.zeros((k, k))
        for risk, fail in zip(risks, fails):
            e = w[risk] * np.exp(eta[risk])
            S0 = e.sum()
            Xr = X[risk]
            S1 = Xr.T @ e
            nd = float(w[fail].sum())
            ll += float((w[fail] * eta[fail]).sum()) - nd * np.log(S0)
            if todo:
                g += X[fail].T @ w[fail] - nd * S1 / S0
                H -= nd * ((Xr * e[:, None]).T @ Xr / S0 - np.outer(S1, S1) / S0 ** 2)
        return ll, g, H
    try:
        return maximize(fun, np.zeros(k)).b
    except (np.linalg.LinAlgError, StataError):
        return np.zeros(k)


def _competing(s: "Session", spec: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    """(indicator over the sample rows of mask, variable, text of the event) for compete()."""
    ds = s.data
    var, sep, rest = spec.partition("==")
    name = s.expand_varlist(var.strip())[0]
    v = ds.get(name)
    if v.is_string:
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    x = v.data[mask]
    if sep:
        vals = [float(z) for z in parse_numlist(rest.strip())]
        return np.isin(x, vals), name, f"{name} == {' '.join(f'{z:g}' for z in vals)}"
    return (x != 0) & (x < SYS), name, f"{name} != 0 & {name} < ."


_SPEC = {"compete": 4, "noshr": 4, "noshow": 6, "noheader": 6, "nolog": 4, "iterate": 4,
         "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4, "nrtolerance": 4, "noadjust": 5, "tvc": 3, "texp": 4,
         "offset": 3, "constraints": 1, "collinear": 4, "nodisplay": 6, "notable": 6}


def cmd_stcrreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        from .postest import replay
        replay(s, "stcrreg", args)
        return
    stx = STSample(s, args, _SPEC)
    o = stx.o
    for k in ("tvc", "texp", "offset", "constraints", "collinear", "noadjust"):
        if o.get(k):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {k} is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    if not o.get("compete"):
        raise StataError(198, "option compete() required")
    if str(o.get("vce", "")).strip().startswith(("oim", "ols")):
        raise StataError(198, "vcetype 'oim' not allowed")   # VERIFY
    comp_rec, cname, ctext = _competing(s, str(o["compete"]), stx.mask)
    if np.any(comp_rec & (stx.d > 0)):
        raise StataError(198, "competing events must be censored in stset")   # VERIFY
    stx.notes_and_header(s)
    ids = stx.sd.ids
    t, n = stx.t, stx.n
    last = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    comp = comp_rec.copy()
    if ids is not None:
        # only the last record of a subject carries the event (VERIFY: ties in t)
        last[:] = False
        for sid in np.unique(ids):
            j = np.flatnonzero(ids == sid)
            last[j[np.lexsort((j, t[j]))[-1]]] = True
        comp = comp_rec & last
    cens = last & (stx.d == 0) & ~comp
    X = stx.X
    k = X.shape[1]
    if k == 0:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    model = FineGray(t, stx.t0, stx.d, comp, cens, stx.w, X)
    res = maximize(model.fun, _cox_start(t, stx.t0, stx.d, stx.w, X), **ml_options(o))
    ll0 = res.log[0][1]
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        print_log(s.output, res, "log pseudolikelihood")
    b = res.b
    U = model.scores(b)
    cl, clustvar = stx.clusters()
    if stx.smp.vce == "cluster":
        clusters, clustvar = cl, stx.smp.clustvar
    elif ids is not None:
        clusters, clustvar = ids, stx.info.idvar
    else:
        clusters, clustvar = None, ""
    V, n_clust = sandwich(bread(res.H), U, stx.w, fweight=stx.fweight,
                          n=float(stx.w.sum()) if stx.fweight else float(n), clusters=clusters)
    try:
        chi2 = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(V, b))
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        chi2 = SYS
    pval = float(chi2_tail(chi2, k)) if chi2 < SYS else SYS
    smp = stx.smp
    names, bf, Vf, _pos, bmap, semap = place(smp, b, V, constant=False)
    est = Estimates("stcrreg", "_t", names, bf, Vf, n, "z", None)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=False)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, False, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype, est.robust = "Robust", True
    est.clustvar, est.n_clust = clustvar, n_clust
    wv = stx.w if stx.fweight else np.ones(n)
    sc = stx.scalars()
    sc.update({"N_fail": float(np.sum(stx.d * wv)), "N_compete": float(np.sum(comp * wv)),
               "ll": res.ll, "chi2": chi2, "p": pval, "df_m": k})
    sc["N_censor"] = sc["N_sub"] - sc["N_fail"] - sc["N_compete"]
    est.extra = sc
    est.shr = not o.get("noshr")
    est.fevent, est.crevent, est.cname = _fail_text(stx.info), ctext, cname
    est.display = _display
    est.predict = _predict
    est.predict_opts = {"xb": 2, "shr": 3}
    est.fg = {"ft": model.ft, "H0": model.baseline(b), "b": b,
              "cols": [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]}
    _post(s, est, args, stx, res, clusters, o, ll0)
    _display(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _post(s: "Session", est: Estimates, args: str, stx: STSample, res, clusters, o, ll0) -> None:
    from .regress import cmdline
    x = est.extra
    k = len(res.b)
    scalars = [("rank", float(k)), ("N", x["N"]), ("ic", float(res.iterations)), ("k", float(k)),
               ("k_eq", 1.0), ("k_dv", 1.0), ("converged", 1.0 if res.converged else 0.0),
               ("rc", 0.0), ("ll", res.ll), ("k_eq_model", 1.0)]
    if est.n_clust is not None:
        scalars.append(("N_clust", float(est.n_clust)))
    scalars += [("chi2", x["chi2"]), ("p", x["p"]), ("df_m", float(k)), ("fmult", 0.0),
                ("crmult", 0.0), ("fnz", 0.0), ("crnz", 0.0), ("N_sub", x["N_sub"]),
                ("N_censor", x["N_censor"]), ("N_compete", x["N_compete"]), ("N_fail", x["N_fail"])]
    mainvars = " ".join(c.name for c in est.fg["cols"])
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("stcrreg", args)), ("title", "Competing-risks regression"),
              ("mainvars", mainvars), ("fevent", est.fevent), ("crevent", est.crevent),
              ("compete", str(o["compete"])), ("predict", "stcrreg_p"),
              ("marginsnotok", "SCOres ESR DFBeta SCHoenfeld"), ("cmd", "stcrreg"),
              ("clustvar", est.clustvar), ("vce", "cluster" if est.clustvar else "robust"),
              ("vcetype", "Robust"), ("chi2type", "Wald"), ("opt", "moptimize"),
              ("user", "stcrr_lf"), ("ml_method", "d2"), ("technique", "nr"), ("which", "max"),
              ("depvar", "_t"), ("properties", "b V")]   # VERIFY: the e() lists
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, stx.mask)


def _display(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
             level: float | None = None, eform=None, **_kw) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    if header:
        left = ["Competing-risks regression", "", f"{'Failure event  :'} {est.fevent}",
                f"{'Competing event:'} {est.crevent}", "", "", f"Log pseudolikelihood = {fmt(x['ll'], '%10.0g'):>10}"]
        right = [("No. of obs", fmt(x["N"], "%12.0gc")), ("No. of subjects", fmt(x["N_sub"], "%12.0gc")),
                 ("No. failed", fmt(x["N_fail"], "%12.0gc")), ("No. competing", fmt(x["N_compete"], "%12.0gc")),
                 ("No. censored", fmt(x["N_censor"], "%12.0gc")), None,
                 (f"Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", f"{x['chi2']:.2f}" if x["chi2"] < SYS else "."),
                 ("Prob > chi2", f"{x['p']:.4f}" if x["p"] < SYS else ".")]
        out.write("\n", "text")
        lines = [(left[0], right[0]), ("", right[1]), (left[2], right[2]), (left[3], right[3]),
                 ("", right[4]), ("", None), ("", right[6]), (left[6], right[7])]
        for lft, rgt in lines:
            if rgt is None:
                out.write(lft + "\n", "text")
                continue
            out.write(f"{lft:<49}{rgt[0]:<17}=", "text")
            out.write(f"{rgt[1]:>11}\n", "result")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if not table:
        return
    cluster_note(s, est)
    shr = est.shr if eform is None else bool(eform)
    coef_table(s, "_t", est.rows, stat="z", df=None, level=level or est.level, vcetype="Robust",
               coef_title="SHR" if shr else "Coef.", eform=shr, footer=True)


def _predict(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    from .postest import xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        note = "" if stat else "(option xb assumed; fitted values)"   # VERIFY
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), note
    if stat == "shr":
        return np.where(ok, np.exp(xb), SYS), ""
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")
files.opendta/estimation/stcurve.py:
"""stcurve: curves of the survivor, hazard, cumulative hazard and cumulative incidence functions
after stcox, streg and stcrreg ([ST] stcurve). Covariates not given in at() are held at their
means in the estimation sample. Layout details carry the VERIFY mark
(compat/do/1901_survival.do)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import re

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
from .results import current
from .st import header, require_st

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
_AT = {f"at{i}": 3 for i in range(1, 11)}
_NOT_YET = ("outfile", "width", "kernel", "noboundary", "fixedonly",
            "marginal", "addplot")


def _values(est, spec: str) -> dict[str, float]:
    out: dict[str, float] = {}
    for tok in spec.split():
        name, eq, val = tok.partition("=")
        if not eq:
            raise StataError(198, f"at({spec}) invalid")
        try:
            out[name] = float(val)
        except ValueError:
            raise StataError(198, f"at({spec}) invalid") from None
    return out


def _xb(s: "Session", est, given: dict[str, float]) -> float:
    """Linear index at the covariate values: the means of the estimation sample, except for the
    variables in `given`."""
    cols = list(est.cols)
    known = {c.name for c in cols if c.values is not None}
    for k in given:
        if k not in known:
            raise StataError(198, f"{k} is not a covariate of the model")   # VERIFY
    xb = 0.0
    for i, c in enumerate(cols):
        if c.values is None:
            continue
        xb += float(est.b[i]) * (given[c.name] if c.name in given else float(np.mean(c.values)))
    if getattr(est, "constant", False):
        xb += float(est.b[len(cols)])
    return xb


def _step(times: np.ndarray, vals: np.ndarray, x0: float, x1: float, y0: float):
    xs, ys = [x0], [y0]
    cur = y0
    for t, v in zip(times, vals):
        if t > x1:
            break
        if t < x0:
            cur = v
            xs[0], ys[0] = x0, cur
            continue
        xs += [float(t), float(t)]
        ys += [cur, float(v)]
        cur = float(v)
    xs.append(float(x1))
    ys.append(cur)
    return xs, ys


def cmd_stcurve(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.graphcmd import finish
    from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
    from ..graphics.opts import axis_label, graph_options, split_layer_graph
    p = parse_standard(args)
    spec = {"survival": 1, "hazard": 1, "cumhaz": 2, "cif": 3, "at": 2, "range": 2, "noshow": 6,
            "outfile": 3, "width": 2, "kernel": 2, "noboundary": 3, "alpha1": 3, "fixedonly": 3,
            "unconditional": 3, "marginal": 3, "addplot": 3, **_AT}
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, spec)
    est = current(s)
    kind = ("cox" if est.cmd == "cox" else "crreg" if est.cmd == "stcrreg"
            else "streg" if hasattr(est, "dist") else "")
    if not kind:
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")   # VERIFY: stcurve after another command
    info = require_st(s)
    for k in _NOT_YET:
        if lopts.get(k):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {k} is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    what = [k for k in ("survival", "hazard", "cumhaz", "cif") if lopts.get(k)]
    if len(what) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "exactly one of survival, hazard, cumhaz, or cif must be specified")   # VERIFY
    what = what[0]
    if kind == "crreg" and what in ("survival", "hazard"):
        raise StataError(198, f"option {what} not allowed after stcrreg")   # VERIFY
    if kind != "crreg" and what == "cif":
        raise StataError(198, "option cif is allowed only after stcrreg")   # VERIFY
    if kind == "cox" and what == "hazard":
        raise StataError(198, "option hazard is not available yet in OpenDTA after stcox")
    if kind == "cox" and getattr(est, "strata_vars", None):
        raise StataError(198, "stcurve after a stratified stcox is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    nodraw = re.search(r"\bnodraw\b", args) is not None
    if not lopts.get("noshow") and not nodraw:   # VERIFY: nodraw prints no header
        header(s, info)
    uncond = bool(getattr(est, "frailty", "")) and not lopts.get("alpha1")
    if uncond and not lopts.get("unconditional"):
        s.output.write("(option unconditional assumed)\n", "text")
    ds = s.data
    tt = ds.get("_t").data
    mask = ds.esample if ds.esample is not None else np.ones(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
    tt = tt[mask & (tt < SYS)]
    lo, hi = (float(tt.min()), float(tt.max())) if len(tt) else (0.0, 0.0)
    if lopts.get("range"):
        rg = str(lopts["range"]).split()
        if len(rg) != 2:
            raise StataError(198, "range() invalid")
        lo, hi = float(rg[0]), float(rg[1])
    sets = [(lab, _values(est, str(lopts[lab]))) for lab in ["at"] + list(_AT) if lopts.get(lab)]
    curves = sets or [("", {})]
    base = _baseline(s, est, kind)
    layers = []
    for i, (lab, given) in enumerate(curves):
        xb = _xb(s, est, given)
        xs, ys = _curve(est, kind, what, xb, base, lo, hi, uncond)
        text = str(lopts[lab]).replace("  ", " ") if lab else ""
        layers.append(Layer("line", xs, ys, {}, {"_pal": i} if len(curves) > 1 else {}, text))
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    sub = {"cox": "Cox proportional hazards regression", "crreg": "Competing-risks regression"}.get(kind)
    if sub is None:
        from .streg import DISTS
        sub = DISTS[est.dist].title + " regression"
    opts.setdefault("subtitle", {"lines": [sub]})
    opts["_xtitle"] = "analysis time"
    opts["_ytitle"] = {"survival": "Survival", "hazard": "Hazard function", "cumhaz": "Cumulative hazard",
                       "cif": "Cumulative Incidence"}[what]   # VERIFY
    if what == "survival" and "ylabel" not in graw:
        try:
            opts["ylabel"] = axis_label("0(.25)1, format(%4.2f)")
        except Exception:   # noqa: BLE001
            pass
    if len(curves) == 1:
        opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    g = Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)])
    finish(s, g, graw)


def _baseline(s: "Session", est, kind: str):
    """(times, baseline cumulative hazard, baseline survivor) as step functions."""
    if kind == "crreg":
        return est.fg["ft"], est.fg["H0"], None
    if kind == "cox":
        from .stcox import _baseline as cox_baseline
        H_t, _H_t0, _hc, S_t, _info = cox_baseline(s, est)
        t = s.data.get("_t").data
        ok = (H_t < SYS) & (t < SYS)
        order = np.argsort(t[ok], kind="stable")
        tt, hh, ss = t[ok][order], H_t[ok][order], S_t[ok][order]
        keep = np.r_[tt[1:] != tt[:-1], True]
        return tt[keep], hh[keep], ss[keep]
    return None


def _unconditional(est, what, dist, t, xbv, th, aft, y):
    """Integrates the frailty out of the conditional curve y (survival, hazard or cumulative hazard)."""
    th_f = est.theta
    H = -np.log(dist.surv(t, xbv, th, aft))
    if est.frailty == "gamma":
        g, sc = (1 + th_f * H), 1 / (1 + th_f * H)
        return {"survival": g ** (-1 / th_f), "hazard": y * sc, "cumhaz": np.log(g) / th_f}[what]
    r = np.sqrt(1 + 2 * th_f * H)
    return {"survival": np.exp((1 - r) / th_f), "hazard": y / r, "cumhaz": (r - 1) / th_f}[what]


def _curve(est, kind: str, what: str, xb: float, base, lo: float, hi: float, uncond: bool = False):
    if kind == "streg":
        from .streg import DISTS
        dist, aft = DISTS[est.dist], est.aft
        th = est.th if dist.name == "ggamma" else (est.aux[0] if est.aux else 0.0)
        # after frailty(): unconditional (population-averaged) curves by default, conditional on a
        # frailty of one with alpha1 (VERIFY: the numbers; the manual describes the options)
        t = np.linspace(lo, hi, 200)
        t = np.where(t > 0, t, 1e-8) if what == "hazard" else t
        xbv = np.full_like(t, xb)
        if what == "survival":
            y = dist.surv(t, xbv, th, aft)
        elif what == "hazard":
            y = dist.hazard(t, xbv, th, aft)
        else:
            y = -np.log(dist.surv(t, xbv, th, aft))
        if uncond:
            y = _unconditional(est, what, dist, t, xbv, th, aft, y)
        return [float(v) for v in t], [float(v) for v in y]
    times, H0, S0 = base
    r = float(np.exp(xb))
    if what == "survival":
        return _step(times, S0 ** r, lo, hi, 1.0)
    if what == "cif":
        return _step(times, 1 - np.exp(-H0 * r), lo, hi, 0.0)
    return _step(times, H0 * r, lo, hi, 0.0)

"""What stcox and streg share: the estimation sample of st data, the header of their output
and the scalars that describe the survival data ([ST] stcox, [ST] streg)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, parse_standard
from . import fvars
from .results import Estimates
from .st import n_subjects, require_st, st_data

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def fmt(x: float, fmt_: str = "%10.0g") -> str:
    if x is None or not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    return format_value(float(x), fmt_, pad=False).strip()


class STSample:
    """Regressors and sample of stcox/streg: the observations with _st == 1, the weights given to
    stset, _t, _t0 and _d of the sample, and the design matrix after collinearity checks."""

    def __init__(self, s: "Session", args: str, spec: dict, extra_vars: str = ""):
        from .regress import Sample
        info = require_st(s)
        ds = s.data
        self.info = info
        if parse_standard(args).weight is not None:
            raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed; specify weights with stset")   # VERIFY
        # the regressors come after a dummy depvar (_t) so that Sample builds the design matrix
        c = find_top(args, ",")
        body, opts = (args, None) if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
        wt = f" [{info.wtype}={info.wvar}]" if info.wtype else ""
        text = f"_t {body.strip()}{wt}" + (f", {opts}" if opts is not None else "")
        extra = info.idvar if info.idvar and not ds.get(info.idvar).is_string else ""
        extra = f"{extra} {extra_vars}".strip()
        smp = Sample(s, text, opts_spec=spec, weights=("fweight", "pweight", "iweight"),
                     extra_vars=extra, restrict=ds.get("_st").data == 1)
        self.smp = smp
        self.o = smp.o
        self.mask = smp.mask
        self.sd = sd = st_data(s, smp.mask)
        self.t, self.t0, self.d = sd.t, sd.t0, sd.d
        self.w = smp.w[smp.mask].astype(np.float64) if smp.w is not None else np.ones(smp.n)
        self.wtype = smp.wtype or ""
        self.fweight = self.wtype == "fweight"
        self.n = smp.n
        self.notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, False, self.w)
        self.est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
        self.X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in self.est_cols]) if self.est_cols else np.zeros((smp.n, 0))
        self.robust = smp.vce in ("robust", "cluster") or self.wtype == "pweight"

    def scalars(self) -> dict:
        """N, N_sub, N_fail and risk (frequency weights count each observation w times)."""
        fw = self.w if self.fweight else np.ones(self.n)
        return {"N_sub": n_subjects(self.sd), "N_fail": float(np.sum(self.d * fw)),
                "risk": float(np.sum((self.t - self.t0) * fw)),
                "N": float(fw.sum()) if self.fweight else float(self.n)}

    def clusters(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray | None, str]:
        """Clusters of the robust variance: vce(cluster) or, with robust and stset id(), the
        subjects."""
        smp = self.smp
        if smp.vce == "cluster":
            return smp.cluster, smp.clustvar
        if smp.vce == "robust" and self.sd.ids is not None:
            return self.sd.ids, self.info.idvar
        return None, ""

    def notes_and_header(self, s: "Session") -> None:
        from .st import header
        if not self.o.get("noshow"):
            header(s, self.info)
        for nm in self.notes:
            s.output.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")


def header_block(s: "Session", title: str, est: Estimates) -> None:
    """No. of subjects, failures and time at risk at the left; N, the model test and its p-value
    at the right."""
    x = est.extra
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\n{title}\n\n", "text")
    llab = "Log pseudolikelihood" if est.robust else "Log likelihood"
    lw = len(llab) if est.robust else 15
    chi = f"{x['chi2type']} chi2({int(x['df_m'])})"
    left = [("No. of subjects", fmt(x["N_sub"], "%12.0gc")), ("No. of failures", fmt(x["N_fail"], "%12.0gc")),
            ("Time at risk", fmt(x["risk"], "%12.0g")), None, (llab, fmt(x["ll"], "%10.0g"))]
    right = [("Number of obs", fmt(x["N"], "%12.0gc")), None, None,
             (chi, f"{x['chi2']:.2f}" if x["chi2"] < SYS else "."),
             ("Prob > chi2", f"{x['p']:.4f}" if x["p"] < SYS else ".")]
    for lft, rgt in zip(left, right):
        line = f"{lft[0]:<{lw}} ={lft[1]:>13}" if lft is not None else ""
        if rgt is not None:
            out.write(f"{line:<48}{rgt[0]:<17}=", "text")
            out.write(f"{rgt[1]:>12}\n", "result")
        else:
            out.write(line + "\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")


def cluster_note(s: "Session", est: Estimates) -> None:
    if est.clustvar:
        msg = f"(Std. Err. adjusted for {int(est.n_clust):,} clusters in {est.clustvar})"
        s.output.write(f"{msg:>78}\n", "text")


def place(smp, b: np.ndarray, V: np.ndarray, *, constant: bool, aux: int = 0):
    """Coefficients and variance of the estimated columns placed in the full e(b) layout (omitted
    columns at zero), then _cons and `aux` ancillary parameters. Returns (names, b, V, positions,
    bmap, semap) with bmap/semap keyed by column name, as rows_from_columns expects."""
    names = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in smp.cols]
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols) if c.values is not None]
    if constant:
        pos.append(len(names))
        names.append("_cons")
    pos += [len(names) + j for j in range(aux)]
    names += ["_cons"] * aux
    k = len(names)
    bf, Vf = np.zeros(k), np.zeros((k, k))
    bf[pos] = b
    Vf[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(Vf), 0))
    bmap = {c.name: bf[i] for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {c.name: float(se[i]) for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if constant:
        j = len(smp.cols)
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = bf[j], float(se[j])
    return names, bf, Vf, pos, bmap, semap

"""Parametric survival models: streg with the exponential, Weibull, Gompertz, lognormal and
loglogistic distributions, and its predictions ([ST] streg, [ST] streg postestimation).

Each distribution is a small class that knows its log likelihood (with delayed entry, [ST]
streg, Methods and formulas), its survivor function, median and hazard, the labels of its

branches. Layout details carry the VERIFY mark (compat/do/0902_stcox_streg.do).

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..lazy import lazy
from .ml import ilog, maximize, print_log

from .results import CoefRow, Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Dist:
    """A streg distribution. The log likelihood returns, per observation, l and its first and
    second derivatives with respect to the linear index u and the ancillary parameter th:
    (l, l_u, l_th, l_uu, l_uth, l_thth); without an ancillary parameter the th terms are 0."""

    name = title = cmd = predict_sub = user = ""
    aux = ""                   # ancillary equation (ln_p, gamma...), "" for none
    metrics = ("hazard", "time")
    fits_time_metric = True    # False: fitted in the hazard metric, transformed afterwards

    def loglik(self, t, t0, d, aft: bool):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def start(self, rate: float, aft: bool) -> list[float]:
        """Constant-only starting values from the failure rate D/T."""
        return [float(np.log(rate)), 0.0]

    def aux_scalar(self, th: float) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
        return None

    def aux_rows(self, b: float, se: float, lo: float, hi: float) -> list[CoefRow]:
        """Transformed ancillary parameters shown under /aux (p and 1/p for the Weibull...)."""
        return []

    def surv(self, x, xb, th: float, aft: bool):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def median(self, xb, th: float, aft: bool):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def hazard(self, t, xb, th: float, aft: bool):
        eps = 1e-6 * np.maximum(t, 1e-8)
        return (np.log(self.surv(t, xb, th, aft)) - np.log(self.surv(t + eps, xb, th, aft))) / eps


def _exp_aux(label: str, b, se, lo, hi, sign: int = 1) -> CoefRow:
    v = np.exp(sign * b)
    a, z = (lo, hi) if sign > 0 else (-hi, -lo)
    return CoefRow("aux", label, v, v * se, eq=f"{float(np.exp(a))!r} {float(np.exp(z))!r}")


def _pos_log(x):
    return np.log(np.where(x > 0, x, 1.0))


class _PH(Dist):
    """Proportional-hazards distributions: S(x) = exp(-exp(eta) H0(x)); in the time metric the
    linear index enters as eta(xb)."""

    def eta(self, xb, th: float, aft: bool):
        return xb

    def surv(self, x, xb, th, aft):
        x = np.where(x > 0, x, 0.0)
        return np.exp(-np.exp(self.eta(xb, th, aft)) * self.cumhaz0(x, th))


class Exponential(_PH):
    name, title, cmd, predict_sub, user = "exponential", "Exponential", "ereg", "ereg_p", "ereg_lf0"

    def loglik(self, t, t0, d, aft):
        A = t - t0
        z = np.zeros_like(t)
        sgn = -1.0 if aft else 1.0          # time metric: eta = -u

        def lf(u, th):
            e = np.exp(sgn * u)
            return d * sgn * u - e * A, sgn * (d - e * A), z, -e * A, z, z
        return lf

    def start(self, rate, aft):
        return [float(np.log(rate)) * (-1 if aft else 1)]

    def eta(self, xb, th, aft):
        return -xb if aft else xb

    def cumhaz0(self, x, th):
        return x

    def median(self, xb, th, aft):
        return LN2 / np.exp(self.eta(xb, th, aft))

    def hazard(self, t, xb, th, aft):
        return np.exp(self.eta(xb, th, aft)) * np.ones_like(t)


class Weibull(_PH):
    name, title, cmd, predict_sub, user = "weibull", "Weibull", "weibull", "weibul_p", "weib_lf0"
    aux = "ln_p"
    # fitted in the hazard metric and transformed afterwards: Stata's iteration log is the same in
    # both metrics (compat 0902)
    fits_time_metric = False

    def loglik(self, t, t0, d, aft):
        lt, lt0, has0 = _pos_log(t), _pos_log(t0), t0 > 0

        def lf(eta, th):
            p = np.exp(th)
            tp = np.where(t > 0, t ** p, 0.0)
            t0p = np.where(has0, t0 ** p, 0.0)
            A = tp - t0p
            B = p * (tp * lt - t0p * lt0)
            C = tp * lt ** 2 - t0p * lt0 ** 2
            e = np.exp(eta)
            return (d * (eta + th + (p - 1) * lt) - e * A, d - e * A, d * (1 + p * lt) - e * B,
                    -e * A, -e * B, d * p * lt - e * (B + p * p * C))
        return lf

    def aux_scalar(self, th):
        return ("aux_p", float(np.exp(th)))

    def aux_rows(self, b, se, lo, hi):
        return [_exp_aux("p", b, se, lo, hi), _exp_aux("1/p", b, se, lo, hi, sign=-1)]

    def eta(self, xb, th, aft):
        return -np.exp(th) * xb if aft else xb

    def cumhaz0(self, x, th):
        return x ** np.exp(th)

    def median(self, xb, th, aft):
        return (LN2 / np.exp(self.eta(xb, th, aft))) ** (1 / np.exp(th))

    def hazard(self, t, xb, th, aft):
        p = np.exp(th)
        return np.exp(self.eta(xb, th, aft)) * p * np.where(t > 0, t, np.nan) ** (p - 1)


class Gompertz(_PH):
    name, title, cmd, predict_sub, user = "gompertz", "Gompertz", "gompertz", "gomper_p", "gomp_lf0"
    aux = "gamma"
    metrics = ("hazard",)

    @staticmethod
    def _G(x, gam):
        """Integral of exp(gam s) over (0, x) and its first two derivatives in gam (series near
        gam x = 0)."""
        gx = gam * x
        small = np.abs(gx) < 1e-4
        E = np.exp(gx)
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            g0 = np.where(small, x + gam * x ** 2 / 2 + gam ** 2 * x ** 3 / 6, (E - 1) / gam)
            g1 = np.where(small, x ** 2 / 2 + gam * x ** 3 / 3 + gam ** 2 * x ** 4 / 8,
                          x * E / gam - (E - 1) / gam ** 2)
            g2 = np.where(small, x ** 3 / 3 + gam * x ** 4 / 4,
                          x * x * E / gam - 2 * x * E / gam ** 2 + 2 * (E - 1) / gam ** 3)
        return g0, g1, g2

    def loglik(self, t, t0, d, aft):
        def lf(eta, gam):
            (a0, a1, a2), (b0, b1, b2) = self._G(t, gam), self._G(t0, gam)
            A, A1, A2 = a0 - b0, a1 - b1, a2 - b2
            e = np.exp(eta)
            return d * (eta + gam * t) - e * A, d - e * A, d * t - e * A1, -e * A, -e * A1, -e * A2
        return lf

    def aux_scalar(self, th):
        return ("gamma", float(th))

    def cumhaz0(self, x, th):
        return (np.exp(th * x) - 1) / th if abs(th) > 1e-12 else x

    def median(self, xb, th, aft):
        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
            if abs(th) > 1e-12:
                return np.log1p(th * LN2 / np.exp(xb)) / th
            return LN2 / np.exp(xb)

    def hazard(self, t, xb, th, aft):
        return np.exp(xb + th * t)


class _LocationScale(Dist):
    """ln t = u + sigma e, with sigma = exp(th): always in the time metric."""

    metrics = ("time",)

    def start(self, rate, aft):
        # VERIFY: Stata's starting values are undocumented; ln of the mean time at risk per failure
        return [-float(np.log(rate)), 0.0]

    def parts(self, z, density: bool):
        """ln f(z) or ln S(z) of the standard error distribution, and two derivatives in z."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def loglik(self, t, t0, d, aft):
        lt, lt0, has0, fail = _pos_log(t), _pos_log(t0), t0 > 0, d > 0

        def lf(u, th):
            sig = np.exp(th)
            z = (lt - u) / sig
            Tf, Tf1, Tf2 = self.parts(z, True)
            TS, TS1, TS2 = self.parts(z, False)
            T1 = np.where(fail, Tf1, TS1)
            T2 = np.where(fail, Tf2, TS2)
            l = np.where(fail, Tf - th - lt, TS)
            l_u, l_t = -T1 / sig, -z * T1 - fail
            l_uu, l_ut, l_tt = T2 / sig ** 2, (T2 * z + T1) / sig, z * T1 + z * z * T2
            if np.any(has0):
                # delayed entry: minus ln S at the entry time
                z0 = (lt0 - u) / sig
                S0, S1, S2 = (np.where(has0, a, 0.0) for a in self.parts(z0, False))
                l, l_u, l_t = l - S0, l_u + S1 / sig, l_t + z0 * S1
                l_uu, l_ut = l_uu - S2 / sig ** 2, l_ut - (S2 * z0 + S1) / sig
                l_tt = l_tt - (z0 * S1 + z0 * z0 * S2)
            return l, l_u, l_t, l_uu, l_ut, l_tt
        return lf

    def aux_scalar(self, th):
        return (self.aux_scalar_name, float(np.exp(th)))

    def aux_rows(self, b, se, lo, hi):
        return [_exp_aux(self.aux_scalar_name, b, se, lo, hi)]

    def surv(self, x, xb, th, aft):
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore"):
            z = (np.log(np.where(x > 0, x, 1e-300)) - xb) / np.exp(th)
        return np.where(x > 0, self.sf(z), 1.0)

    def median(self, xb, th, aft):
        return np.exp(xb)


class Lognormal(_LocationScale):
    name, title, cmd, predict_sub, user = "lognormal", "Lognormal", "lnormal", "lnorma_p", "lnorm_lf0"
    aux, aux_scalar_name = "ln_sig", "sigma"

    def parts(self, z, density):
        if density:
            return -0.5 * z * z - 0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi), -z, -np.ones_like(z)
        lS = special.log_ndtr(-z)
        lam = np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(z) - lS)
        return lS, -lam, -lam * (lam - z)

    def sf(self, z):
        return st.norm.sf(z)


class Loglogistic(_LocationScale):
    name, title, cmd, predict_sub, user = "loglogistic", "Loglogistic", "llogistic", "llogis_p", "llog_lf0"
    aux, aux_scalar_name = "ln_gam", "gamma"

    def parts(self, z, density):
        sp, sg = np.logaddexp(0, z), special.expit(z)
        if density:
            return z - 2 * sp, 1 - 2 * sg, -2 * sg * (1 - sg)
        return -sp, -sg, -sg * (1 - sg)

    def sf(self, z):
        return special.expit(-z)


DISTS: dict[str, Dist] = {d.name: d for d in (Exponential(), Weibull(), Gompertz(), Lognormal(),
                                              Loglogistic())}


def _dist(text: str) -> Dist:
    t = text.strip().lower()
    for full, k in (("exponential", 1), ("weibull", 1), ("gompertz", 1), ("lognormal", 4),
                    ("lnormal", 2), ("loglogistic", 4), ("llogistic", 2), ("ggamma", 2)):
        if len(t) >= k and full.startswith(t):
            if full == "ggamma":
                from .streg_ext import GGAMMA
                return GGAMMA
            return DISTS[{"lnormal": "lognormal", "llogistic": "loglogistic"}.get(full, full)]
    raise StataError(198, f"distribution({text}) invalid")   # VERIFY

def _model(lf, X, w, lnt_c: float, k_aux: int):
    """The maximize() function of a design X: log likelihood, gradient and Hessian in (beta, th),
    without the th row and column when the distribution has no ancillary parameter."""
    kx = X.shape[1]
    k = kx + k_aux

    def fun(b, todo):
        th = b[kx] if k_aux else 0.0
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            l, lu, lt, luu, lut, ltt = lf(X @ b[:kx], th)
        ll = float(np.sum(w * l)) + lnt_c
        if not np.isfinite(ll):
            return -np.inf, None, None
        if todo == 0:
            return ll, None, None
        g = np.concatenate([X.T @ (w * lu), [np.sum(w * lt)]])
        H = np.zeros((kx + 1, kx + 1))
        H[:-1, :-1] = (X * (w * luu)[:, None]).T @ X
        H[:-1, -1] = H[-1, :-1] = X.T @ (w * lut)
        H[-1, -1] = np.sum(w * ltt)
        return ll, g[:k], H[:k, :k]
    return fun


def _scores(lf, X, b, k_aux: int) -> np.ndarray:
    kx = X.shape[1]
    _l, lu, lt, *_ = lf(X @ b[:kx], b[kx] if k_aux else 0.0)
    return np.column_stack([X * lu[:, None], lt])[:, :kx + k_aux]


def _to_time_metric(b: np.ndarray, V: np.ndarray, kx: int):
    """Weibull: gamma = -beta/p, with ln_p right after the coefficients and the parameters that
    follow it unchanged (delta method for V)."""
    p = float(np.exp(b[kx]))
    beta = b[:kx]
    J = np.eye(len(b))
    J[:kx, :kx] = -np.eye(kx) / p
    J[:kx, kx] = beta / p
    V = J @ V @ J.T
    return np.concatenate([-beta / p, b[kx:]]), (V + V.T) / 2


def cmd_streg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "streg", args)
        return
    spec = {"distribution": 1, "time": 4, "nohr": 4, "tr": 2, "noshow": 6, "nolog": 4, "log": 3,
            "iterate": 4, "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4, "nrtolerance": 4, "noheader": 6,
            "nolrtest": 5, "frailty": 3, "shared": 2}
    stx = STSample(s, args, spec)
    o = stx.o
    if not isinstance(o.get("distribution"), str):
        raise StataError(198, "option distribution() required")   # VERIFY
    dist = _dist(o["distribution"])
    aft = bool(o.get("time")) or dist.metrics == ("time",)
    if aft and "time" not in dist.metrics:
        raise StataError(198, f"{dist.title} has no accelerated failure-time form")   # VERIFY
    if dist.name == "ggamma" and o.get("nohr"):
        raise StataError(198, "option nohr not allowed")   # VERIFY: before the header in Stata's log
    stx.notes_and_header(s)
    t, t0, d, w = stx.t, stx.t0, stx.d, stx.w
    if np.any((t <= 0) & (d > 0)):
        raise StataError(498, "failures at time 0")   # VERIFY
    if dist.name == "ggamma" or o.get("frailty") or o.get("shared"):
        from .streg_ext import fit_extended
        fit_extended(s, stx, dist, o, args, aft)
        return
    X = np.column_stack([stx.X, np.ones(stx.n)])
    kx = X.shape[1]
    k_aux = 1 if dist.aux else 0
    k = kx + k_aux
    fit_aft = aft and dist.fits_time_metric
    lf = dist.loglik(t, t0, d, fit_aft)
    # Stata reports the log likelihood of ln t rather than of t: the densities are multiplied by
    # t, which adds sum(d ln t) (compat 0902: the same constant in every distribution)
    lnt_c = float(np.sum(w * d * _pos_log(t)))
    rate = float(np.sum(w * d) / np.sum(w * (t - t0)))
    kw = ml_options(o)
    res0 = maximize(_model(lf, np.ones((stx.n, 1)), w, lnt_c, k_aux), np.array(dist.start(rate, fit_aft)), **kw)
    b0 = np.zeros(k)
    b0[kx - 1:] = res0.b
    res = maximize(_model(lf, X, w, lnt_c, k_aux), b0, **kw)
    robust = stx.robust
    lab = "log pseudolikelihood" if robust else "log likelihood"
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        # the exponential constant-only model has a closed form: Stata does not show its fit
        if k_aux:
            s.output.write("Fitting constant-only model:\n\n", "text")
            print_log(s.output, res0, lab)
            s.output.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(s.output, res, lab)
    V = bread(res.H)
    clusters, clustvar = stx.clusters()
    n_clust = None
    if robust:
        V, n_clust = sandwich(V, _scores(lf, X, res.b, k_aux), w, fweight=stx.fweight,
                              n=float(w.sum()) if stx.fweight else float(stx.n), clusters=clusters)
    if aft and not fit_aft:
        res.b, V = _to_time_metric(res.b, V, kx)
    nslope = kx - 1
    if robust:
        chi2type = "Wald"
        sl = list(range(nslope))
        chi2 = float(res.b[sl] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(sl, sl)], res.b[sl])) if sl else 0.0
    else:
        chi2type = "LR"
        chi2 = 2 * (res.ll - res0.ll)
    pval = float(chi2_tail(chi2, nslope)) if nslope and chi2 < SYS else SYS
    smp = stx.smp
    names, bf, Vf, full_pos, bmap, semap = place(smp, res.b, V, constant=True, aux=k_aux)
    est = Estimates("streg", "_t", names, bf, Vf, stx.n, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = ["_t"] * (len(names) - k_aux) + [dist.aux] * k_aux
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=True)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, True, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = "Robust" if robust else ""
    est.clustvar, est.n_clust, est.robust = clustvar, n_clust, robust
    x = stx.scalars()
    x.update({"ll": res.ll, "ll_0": res0.ll, "chi2": chi2, "p": pval, "df_m": nslope, "chi2type": chi2type})
    est.extra = x
    est.dist, est.aft = dist.name, aft
    est.aux = (float(bf[-1]), float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[-1, -1], 0)))) if k_aux else None
    est.eform_kind = "tr" if (aft and o.get("tr")) else ("hr" if (not aft and not o.get("nohr")) else "")
    est.display = _display_streg
    est.predict = _predict_streg
    est.predict_opts = {"median": 3, "mean": 4, "time": 4, "lntime": 3, "hazard": 3, "hr": 2,
                        "surv": 4, "csurv": 5, "csnell": 3, "mgale": 2}
    est.cmd = "streg"
    _post_streg(s, est, args, dist, res, res0, full_pos, stx.mask)
    _display_streg(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"))


def _post_streg(s: "Session", est: Estimates, args: str, dist: Dist, res, res0,
                full_pos: list[int], mask: np.ndarray) -> None:
    """e() in the order Stata lists it after streg, distribution(weibull) (compat 0902); the other
    distributions follow the same pattern (VERIFY, as their predict_sub and user)."""
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    from .regress import cmdline
    x = est.extra
    aft = est.aft
    k = len(full_pos)
    scalars = [("rank", float(k)), ("N", x["N"])]
    if est.n_clust is not None:
        scalars.append(("N_clust", float(est.n_clust)))   # VERIFY: position
    scalars += [("ic", float(res.iterations)), ("k", float(k)), ("k_eq", 2.0 if dist.aux else 1.0),
                ("k_dv", 1.0), ("converged", 1.0 if res.converged else 0.0), ("rc", 0.0),
                ("ll", res.ll), ("k_eq_model", 1.0), ("ll_0", res0.ll), ("df_m", float(x["df_m"])),
                ("chi2", x["chi2"]), ("p", x["p"])]
    if dist.aux:
        scalars += [dist.aux_scalar(float(est.b[-1])), ("k_aux", 1.0)]
    scalars += [("N_sub", x["N_sub"]), ("N_fail", x["N_fail"]), ("risk", x["risk"])]
    if dist.name in ("lognormal", "loglogistic"):
        # the accelerated failure-time distributions list e() in another order (compat 1902;
        # VERIFY for loglogistic)
        scalars = [("rank", float(k)), ("N", x["N"])]
        if est.n_clust is not None:
            scalars.append(("N_clust", float(est.n_clust)))
        scalars += [("ic", float(res.iterations)), ("k", float(k)), ("k_eq", 2.0), ("k_dv", 1.0),
                    ("converged", 1.0 if res.converged else 0.0), ("rc", 0.0), ("ll", res.ll),
                    ("k_eq_model", 1.0), ("ll_0", res0.ll), ("rank0", float(1 + 1)),
                    ("df_m", float(x["df_m"])), ("chi2", x["chi2"]), ("p", x["p"]), ("k_aux", 1.0),
                    ("N_sub", x["N_sub"]), ("N_fail", x["N_fail"]),
                    dist.aux_scalar(float(est.b[-1])), ("risk", x["risk"])]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("streg", args)), ("predict", "streg_p"),
              ("predict_sub", dist.predict_sub), ("cmd2", "streg"), ("title", dist.title + " regression"),
              ("title2", "accelerated failure-time form" if aft else "log relative-hazard form"),
              ("cmd", dist.cmd), ("dead", "_d"), ("frm2", "time" if aft else "hazard"),
              ("stcurve", "stcurve"), ("t0", "_t0"), ("chi2type", x["chi2type"]), ("opt", "moptimize"),
              ("clustvar", est.clustvar), ("vcetype", est.vcetype),
              ("vce", "cluster" if est.n_clust is not None else "robust" if est.robust else "oim"),
              ("user", dist.user), ("ml_method", "e2"), ("technique", "nr"), ("which", "max"),
              ("depvar", "_t"), ("properties", "b V")]
    if dist.name in ("lognormal", "loglogistic"):
        macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("streg", args)), ("stcurve", "stcurve"), ("predict", "streg_p"),
                  ("predict_sub", dist.predict_sub), ("cmd2", "streg"), ("frm2", "time"),
                  ("title", dist.title + " regression"), ("cmd", dist.cmd), ("dead", "_d"), ("t0", "_t0"),
                  ("title2", "accelerated failure-time form"), ("chi2type", x["chi2type"]),
                  ("opt", "moptimize"), ("clustvar", est.clustvar), ("vcetype", est.vcetype),
                  ("vce", "cluster" if est.n_clust is not None else "robust" if est.robust else "oim"),
                  ("user", dist.user.replace("_lf0", "_lf")), ("ml_method", "e2"), ("technique", "nr"),
                  ("which", "max"), ("depvar", "_t"), ("properties", "b V")]
    grad = np.zeros((1, len(est.names)))
    if res.g is not None:
        grad[0, full_pos] = res.g
    mats = [("ilog", Matrix(ilog(res), ["r1"], [f"c{i + 1}" for i in range(20)])),
            ("gradient", Matrix(grad, ["r1"], list(est.names)))]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, mask, extra_mats=mats)


def _display_streg(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
                   level: float | None = None, **_kw) -> None:
    dist = DISTS[est.dist]
    form = "accelerated failure-time form" if est.aft else "log relative-hazard form"
    if header:
        header_block(s, f"{dist.title} regression -- {form}", est)
    if not table:
        return
    cluster_note(s, est)
    lev = level or est.level
    rows = list(est.rows)
    if est.aux is not None:
        b, se = est.aux
        z = st.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - lev / 100) / 2)
        rows += [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("coef", f"/{dist.aux}", b, se, name=f"{dist.aux}:_cons", noeform=True)]
        extra = dist.aux_rows(b, se, b - z * se, b + z * se)
        if extra:
            rows += [CoefRow("sep")] + extra
    title = {"hr": "Haz. Ratio", "tr": "Tm. Ratio"}.get(est.eform_kind, "Coef.")   # VERIFY: Time Ratio label
    coef_table(s, "_t", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev, vcetype=est.vcetype,
               coef_title=title, eform=bool(est.eform_kind))


def _predict_streg(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    from .postest import xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    ds = s.data
    dist, aft = DISTS[est.dist], est.aft
    th = est.aux[0] if est.aux else 0.0
    t = ds.get("_t").data.astype(float)
    t0 = ds.get("_t0").data.astype(float)
    okt = ok & (t < SYS)
    if stat == "xb":
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ""
    if stat in ("", "median"):
        note = "" if stat else "(option median time assumed; predicted median time)"   # VERIFY
        v = dist.median(xb, th, aft)
        return np.where(ok & np.isfinite(v), v, SYS), note
    if stat == "hr":
        if aft:
            raise StataError(198, "option hr not allowed after accelerated failure-time models")   # VERIFY
        return np.where(ok, np.exp(xb), SYS), ""
    if stat in ("surv", "csurv", "csnell", "mgale"):
        S_t = dist.surv(t, xb, th, aft)
        if stat == "csurv":
            return np.where(okt, S_t, SYS), ""
        S_t0 = dist.surv(t0, xb, th, aft)
        if stat == "surv":
            return np.where(okt, S_t / S_t0, SYS), ""
        cs = -np.log(S_t) + np.log(S_t0)
        if stat == "csnell":
            return np.where(okt, cs, SYS), ""
        return np.where(okt, ds.get("_d").data - cs, SYS), ""
    if stat == "hazard":
        v = dist.hazard(t, xb, th, aft)
        return np.where(okt & np.isfinite(v), v, SYS), ""
    if stat in ("mean", "time", "lntime"):
        if stat == "lntime" and isinstance(dist, _LocationScale):
            return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ""
        raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} is not available in OpenDTA for this distribution")   # OpenDTA
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")
