def _g6(x: float) -> str:
    """DEFF and DEFT with six significant digits, without the leading zero
    (.64512, 1.05667, .803194; compat 0602)."""
    if x is None or x >= SYS or not np.isfinite(x):
        return "."
    t = f"{x:.6g}"
    if t.startswith("0."):
        t = t[1:]
    elif t.startswith("-0."):
        t = "-" + t[2:]
    return t


def estat_effects(s: "Session", est, rest: str) -> None:
    """DEFF = V/V_srswor and DEFT = sqrt(V/V_srswr) ([SVY] estat). Layout
    checked in compat 0602."""
    info = getattr(est, "svy_effects", None)
    if info is None:
        raise StataError(321, "estat effects not allowed after this command")   # VERIFY
    if rest.strip(" ,"):
        # validated only: the table always shows DEFF and DEFT
        match_options(rest.lstrip(", "), {"deff": 4, "deft": 4, "srssubpop": 3, "meff": 4, "meft": 4})
    V = np.asarray(info["V"], dtype=float)
    Vwor, Vwr = info["srs"]
    out = s.output
    width = 58
    if info.get("legend"):
        # same group legend as the command (compat 0602)
        out.write("\n" + "\n".join(info["legend"]) + "\n", "text")
    out.write("\n" + "-" * width + "\n", "text")
    vt = info["vcetype"]
    start = 28 + (9 - len(vt)) // 2
    out.write(f"{'':>12} |" + " " * (start - 14) + vt + "\n", "text")
    head = "Over" if info.get("over") else info.get("depvar", "")
    out.write(f"{head[:12]:>12} | {info['title']:>10}   Std. Err.       DEFF      DEFT\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 44 + "\n", "text")
    last = None
    deffs, defts = [], []
    for j, ((var, grp), b) in enumerate(zip(info["labels"], info["vals"])):
        v = V[j, j]
        deff = v / Vwor[j, j] if Vwor[j, j] > 0 else SYS
        deft = float(np.sqrt(v / Vwr[j, j])) if Vwr[j, j] > 0 else SYS
        deffs.append(deff)
        defts.append(deft)
        if grp:
            if var != last:
                if last is not None:
                    out.write("-" * 13 + "+" + "-" * 44 + "\n", "text")
                out.write(f"{var[:12]:<12} |\n", "text")
                last = var
            lab = grp
        else:
            lab = var
        out.write(f"{lab[:12]:>12} |", "text")
        out.write(f"  {g9(b):>9}  {g9(float(np.sqrt(v))):>9}{_g6(deff):>12}{_g6(deft):>10}\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * width + "\n", "text")
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    cn = [f"{a}:{b}" if b else a for a, b in info["labels"]]
    s.r = {"deft": Matrix(np.array([defts]), ["r1"], cn), "deff": Matrix(np.array([deffs]), ["r1"], cn)}

"""svy: regress, logit, logistic, probit, poisson and svy: tabulate
([SVY] svy estimation, [SVY] svy: tabulate oneway/twoway).

Point estimates use the sampling weights; the variance comes from
linearization (a sandwich with the "meat" computed from the design) and the tests
use the adjusted Wald F: F = (d - k + 1) W / (d k), df (k, d - k + 1).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.dataset import is_string_type
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.formats import format_value
from ..lang.syntax import match_options
from ..lazy import lazy
from . import fvars
from .regress import Sample
from .results import Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns
from .svy import DesignData, format_size, parse_svy_opts, require_design, srs_variances, subpop_mask

# imported on first use (start-up time; see opendta/lazy.py)
special = lazy("scipy.special")
st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

_TITLES = {"regress": "Linear regression", "logit": "Logistic regression", "logistic": "Logistic regression",
           "probit": "Probit regression", "poisson": "Poisson regression",
           "cloglog": "Complementary log-log regression"}


def g(x, fmt):
    if x is None or not np.isfinite(x) or abs(x) >= SYS:
        return "."
    return format_value(float(x), fmt, pad=False).strip()


def _adjusted_F(b, V, idx, d):
    k = len(idx)
    if not k:
        return SYS, 0, 0
    try:
        W = float(b[idx] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(idx, idx)], b[idx]))
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return SYS, k, d - k + 1
    F = (d - k + 1) / (d * k) * W
    return F, k, d - k + 1


def svy_model(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str, svyopts: str) -> None:
    d = require_design(s)
    ds = s.data
    so = parse_svy_opts(svyopts)
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"or": 2, "irr": 3, "nolog": 4, "coef": 4, "noheader": 6},
                 weights=("pweight",))
    out = s.output
    dd = DesignData(s, d, np.ones(ds.nobs, bool), vce=so.get("vce"), mse=so.get("mse"),
                    hadamard=so.get("hadamard"))
    subpop = subpop_mask(s, str(so["subpop"])) if so.get("subpop") else None
    inside_all = smp.mask & dd.mask & (subpop if subpop is not None else True)
    full = dd.mask
    inside = inside_all[full]
    # columns evaluated on all design observations (zeros outside the sample)
    est_mask = smp.mask & dd.mask
    if not est_mask.any():
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    w = dd.w * inside
    out.write(f"\n(running {cmd} on estimation sample)\n", "text")
    cols = fvars.build_design(ds, smp.terms, full, constant=smp.constant)
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear([c for c in cols], smp.constant, None)
    for nm in notes:
        out.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    est_cols = [c for c in cols if c.values is not None]
    n = int(full.sum())
    Xc = [np.where(inside, c.values, 0.0) for c in est_cols]
    X = np.column_stack(Xc + ([np.ones(n)] if smp.constant else [])) if (Xc or smp.constant) else np.zeros((n, 0))
    yv = fvars.comp_values(ds, smp.depcomp)[full]
    y = np.where(inside & (yv < SYS), yv, 0.0)
    k = X.shape[1]

    def fit(wv):
        """Estimates and linearized scores (n x k) with weights wv."""
        if cmd == "regress":
            XtWX = (X * wv[:, None]).T @ X
            A = np.linalg.inv(XtWX)
            b_ = A @ (X.T @ (wv * y))
            e = (y - X @ b_) * inside
            Z_ = (X * (wv * e)[:, None]) @ A
            ybar = float(wv @ y) / wv.sum()
            r2_ = 1 - float(wv @ e ** 2) / float(wv @ ((y - ybar) ** 2 * inside))
            return b_, Z_, {"r2": r2_}
        from .ml import maximize
        from .models import _cloglog, _logit, _poisson, _probit
        if cmd in ("logit", "logistic", "probit", "cloglog"):
            yb = (y != 0).astype(float)
            if cmd == "cloglog":
                fun, scores = _cloglog(yb, X, wv, np.zeros(n))
            else:
                fun, scores = (_probit if cmd == "probit" else _logit)(yb, X, wv)
            p0 = float(wv @ yb) / wv.sum()
            b0 = np.zeros(k)
            if smp.constant:
                b0[-1] = (np.log(p0 / (1 - p0)) if cmd == "logit" or cmd == "logistic"
                          else np.log(-np.log(1 - p0)) if cmd == "cloglog" else st.norm.ppf(p0))
        else:
            fun, scores = _poisson(y, X, wv, np.zeros(n))
            b0 = np.zeros(k)
            if smp.constant:
                b0[-1] = np.log(float(wv @ y) / wv.sum())
        # svy: does not show the iteration log (compat 0601)
        res = maximize(fun, b0)
        A = np.linalg.inv(-res.H)
        Z_ = (X * (wv * scores(res.b) * inside)[:, None]) @ A
        return res.b, Z_, {"_res": res, "_A": A}

    b, Z, extra = fit(w)
    res_ml, A_ml = extra.pop("_res", None), extra.pop("_A", None)
    n_rep = None
    if dd.replicated:
        V, n_rep = dd.rep_variance(lambda ww: fit(ww * inside)[0], b)
    else:
        V = dd.variance(Z)
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    srs = srs_variances(Z, w, dd, int((smp.mask & dd.mask).sum()))
    df = dd.df
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    F, df1, df2 = _adjusted_F(b, V, slopes, df)
    names = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in cols] + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    kk = len(names)
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    bf = np.zeros(kk)
    Vf = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    bf[pos] = b
    Vf[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    Swor, Swr = np.zeros((kk, kk)), np.zeros((kk, kk))
    Swor[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = srs[0]
    Swr[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = srs[1]
    bmap = {c.name: bf[i] for i, c in enumerate(cols)}
    semap = {c.name: float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[i, i], 0))) for i, c in enumerate(cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = bf[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates(cmd if cmd != "logistic" else "logit", smp.depname, names, bf, Vf, int(inside.sum()), "t", df)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = dd.vcetype
    est.ml_cmd = cmd if cmd != "regress" else "regress"
    N = int(est_mask.sum())
    pop = float(dd.w[est_mask[full]].sum())
    est.extra = dict(N=N, pop=pop, df=df, F=F, df1=df1, df2=df2, strata=dd.n_strata, psu=dd.n_psu, n_rep=n_rep,
                     sub=(int(inside.sum()), float(w.sum())) if subpop is not None else None, **extra)
    est.display = _display
    est.svy_effects = dict(V=Vf, srs=(Swor, Swr), labels=[(nm, "") for nm in names], vals=bf, title="Coef.",
                           vcetype=dd.vcetype, over="", level=smp.level, depvar=smp.depname)
    eform = ""
    if cmd == "logistic" and not smp.o.get("coef"):
        eform = "Odds Ratio"
    elif smp.o.get("or"):
        eform = "Odds Ratio"
    elif smp.o.get("irr"):
        eform = "IRR"
    est.eform_title = eform
    est.svytitle = _TITLES[cmd]
    from .models import predict_ml
    est.predict = predict_ml if cmd != "regress" else _predict_xb
    scalars = [("N", float(N)), ("N_pop", pop), ("N_strata", float(dd.n_strata)), ("N_psu", float(dd.n_psu)),
               ("df_r", float(df)), ("df_m", float(df1)), ("F", F)]
    if subpop is not None:
        scalars += [("N_sub", float(inside.sum())), ("N_subpop", float(w.sum()))]
    if "r2" in extra:
        scalars.append(("r2", extra["r2"]))
    macros = [("prefix", "svy"), ("cmdname", cmd), ("cmd", cmd if cmd != "logistic" else "logistic"),
              ("cmdline", f"svy: {cmd} {args.strip()}"), ("vce", dd.vce), ("vcetype", dd.vcetype),
              ("depvar", smp.depname), ("properties", "b V"), ("title", f"Survey: {_TITLES[cmd]}")]
    if cmd in ("logit", "probit", "cloglog") and res_ml is not None and subpop is None and not dd.replicated:
        _post_ml(s, est, cmd, args, d, dd, res_ml, A_ml, (Swor, Swr), pos, X, w, y, inside, N, pop, df, F, df1,
                 names, est_mask)
    else:
        post(s, est, scalars, macros, est_mask)
    _display(s, est)


def _post_ml(s, est, cmd, args, d, dd, res, A, srs, pos, X, w, y, inside, N, pop, df, F, df1, names,
             est_mask) -> None:
    """e() of svy: logit, probit and cloglog: the results of the command itself (iterations, ilog,
    gradient, ...) and those of the design, in the order of Stata's ereturn list (compat 1909 for
    cloglog, 1913 for logit; VERIFY probit, which is taken to be like logit)."""
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    from .ml import ilog
    kk = len(names)
    Vm = np.zeros((kk, kk))
    Vm[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = A
    nm = list(names)
    head = [("ic", float(res.iterations)), ("k", float(kk)), ("k_dv", 1.0),
            ("converged", 1.0 if res.converged else 0.0), ("rc", 0.0), ("k_eq_model", 1.0)]
    if cmd == "cloglog":
        yb = (y != 0) & inside
        head += [("N_f", float((inside & ~yb).sum())), ("N_s", float(yb.sum()))]
    else:
        head += [("N_cdf", 0.0), ("N_cds", 0.0)]
    pval = float(st.f.sf(F, df1, df - df1 + 1)) if F < SYS else SYS
    scalars = head + [("stages", 1.0), ("N", float(N)), ("N_pop", pop), ("N_strata", float(dd.n_strata)),
                      ("N_psu", float(dd.n_psu)), ("df_r", float(df)), ("N_strata_omit", 0.0),
                      ("singleton", 0.0), ("k_eq", 1.0), ("rank", float(np.linalg.matrix_rank(est.V))),
                      ("p", pval), ("F", F), ("df_m", float(df1)), ("census", 0.0)]
    command = f"{cmd} {args.strip()}".strip()
    macros = [("cmd", cmd), ("cmdline", f"svy : {command}"), ("prefix", "svy"), ("cmdname", cmd),
              ("command", command)]
    if d.weight:
        macros += [("wexp", f"= {d.weight}"), ("wtype", d.wtype or "pweight")]
    macros += [("estat_cmd", "svy_estat"), ("vce", dd.vce), ("vcetype", dd.vcetype),
               ("title", f"Survey: {_TITLES[cmd]}")]
    if d.weight:
        macros.append(("wvar", d.weight))
    macros.append(("singleunit", d.singleunit))
    if d.psu and d.psu != "_n":
        macros.append(("su1", d.psu))
    if d.strata:
        macros.append(("strata1", d.strata))
    macros.append(("properties", "b V"))
    tail = [("opt", "moptimize"), ("user", f"mopt__{cmd}_d2()"), ("ml_method", "d2"), ("technique", "nr"),
            ("which", "max"), ("depvar", est.depvar)]
    if cmd == "cloglog":
        macros += [("depvar", est.depvar), ("which", "max"), ("technique", "nr"), ("ml_method", "e2"),
                   ("user", "clog_lf"), ("opt", "moptimize"), ("predict", "clog_p")]
    else:
        macros += [("predict", f"{cmd}_p"),
                   ("marginsnotok", "stdp DBeta DEviance DX2 DDeviance Hat Number Residuals RStandard SCore")] + tail
    grad = Matrix(np.asarray(res.g).reshape(1, -1), ["r1"], [nm[i] for i in pos])
    mats = [("V_modelbased", Matrix(Vm, nm, nm)), ("V_srs", Matrix(srs[0], nm, nm)),
            ("_N_strata_certain", Matrix(np.zeros((1, 1)))), ("_N_strata_single", Matrix(np.zeros((1, 1)))),
            ("_N_strata", Matrix(np.array([[float(dd.n_strata)]])))]
    if cmd == "cloglog":
        mats += [("gradient", grad), ("ilog", Matrix(ilog(res)))]
    else:
        mns = (np.average(X[inside], axis=0, weights=w[inside]) if inside.any() else np.zeros(X.shape[1]))
        mats += [("mns", Matrix(mns.reshape(1, -1), ["r1"], [nm[i] for i in pos])),
                 ("rules", Matrix(np.zeros((1, 4)))), ("ilog", Matrix(ilog(res))), ("gradient", grad)]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, est_mask, extra_mats=mats)


def _predict_xb(s, est, stat, mask):
    from .postest import xb_all
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        return np.where(ok, xb, SYS), ("(option xb assumed; fitted values)" if not stat else "")
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")


def _display(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True, level=None, **_kw):
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"Survey: {est.svytitle}\n\n", "text")
        right = [("Number of obs", f"{x['N']:,}"), ("Population size", format_size(x["pop"]))]
        if x.get("sub"):
            right += [("Subpop. no. obs", f"{x['sub'][0]:,}"), ("Subpop. size", format_size(x["sub"][1]))]
        if x.get("n_rep"):
            right.append(("Replications", f"{x['n_rep']:,}"))   # VERIFY position
        right += [("Design df", f"{x['df']:,}"), (f"F({x['df1']:>4},{x['df2']:>7})", g(x["F"], "%10.2f")),
                  ("Prob > F", g(st.f.sf(x["F"], x["df1"], x["df2"]) if x["F"] < SYS else SYS, "%10.4f"))]
        if "r2" in x:
            right.append(("R-squared", g(x["r2"], "%10.4f")))
        left = [f"Number of strata   = {x['strata']:>9,}", f"Number of PSUs     = {x['psu']:>9,}"]
        for i, (rl, rv) in enumerate(right):
            lft = left[i] if i < len(left) else ""
            out.write(f"{lft:<48}{rl:<18}= ", "text")
            out.write(f"{rv:>10}\n", "result")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        title = getattr(est, "eform_title", "") or "Coef."
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=level or est.level,
                   vcetype=est.vcetype, coef_title=title, eform=bool(getattr(est, "eform_title", "")))

def svy_tabulate(s: "Session", args: str, svyopts: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from ..core.varlist import expand
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    d = require_design(s)
    ds = s.data
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"count": 3, "cell": 2, "row": 1, "column": 3, "se": 2, "ci": 2,
                                  "percent": 3, "format": 3, "missing": 4, "pearson": 4, "obs": 3,
                                  "proportion": 4}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    so = match_options(svyopts, {"subpop": 3}) if svyopts.strip() else {}
    names = expand(ds, p.varlist, allow_empty=False)
    if len(names) > 2:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    dd = DesignData(s, d, np.ones(ds.nobs, bool))
    full = dd.mask
    mask = touse(s, p)
    for n in names:
        mask &= ds.get(n).data < SYS
    if so.get("subpop"):
        mask &= subpop_mask(s, str(so["subpop"]))
    inside = mask[full]
    w = dd.w * inside
    out = s.output
    W = float(w.sum())
    pct = bool(o.get("percent"))
    mult = 100.0 if pct else 1.0
    vars_ = [ds.get(n) for n in names]
    data = [v.data[full] for v in vars_]
    levels = [sorted(set(x[inside].tolist())) for x in data]

    def lab(v, lv):
        t = ds.value_labels.get(v.value_label, {}).get(int(lv)) if v.value_label else None
        return t if t else (f"{int(lv)}" if lv == int(lv) else f"{lv:g}")
    N = int(inside.sum())
    out.write("\n(running tabulate on estimation sample)\n\n", "text")
    right = [("Number of obs", f"{N:,}"), ("Population size", format_size(W)), ("Design df", f"{dd.df:,}")]
    left = [f"Number of strata   = {dd.n_strata:>9,}", f"Number of PSUs     = {dd.n_psu:>9,}"]
    for i, (rl, rv) in enumerate(right):
        lft = left[i] if i < len(left) else ""
        out.write(f"{lft:<48}{rl:<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{rv:>10}\n", "result")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    stat_name = "percentage" if pct else "proportion"
    if len(names) == 1:
        v0 = vars_[0]
        cells = [(lv, float(w @ (data[0] == lv)) / W) for lv in levels[0]]
        Z = np.column_stack([w * ((data[0] == lv) - p_) / W for lv, p_ in cells])
        V = dd.variance(Z)
        se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
        # Stata 14 layout (compat 0601): variable name right-aligned in 9 columns, a column of 10
        # to 11 characters
        wl = max(9, max(len(lab(v0, lv)) for lv, _ in cells), len(names[0]))
        colw = max(len(stat_name), 10)
        extra_se = bool(o.get("se"))
        line = "-" * (wl + 1) + "-" + "-" * (colw + 1) + ("-" * (colw + 1) if extra_se else "")
        out.write(line + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{names[0]:>{wl}} | {stat_name:>{colw}}" + (f" {'se':>{colw}}" if extra_se else "") + "\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * wl + "-+-" + "-" * (colw - 1) + ("-" * (colw + 1) if extra_se else "") + "-\n", "text")
        for i, (lv, p_) in enumerate(cells):
            out.write(f"{lab(v0, lv):>{wl}} | ", "text")
            out.write(f"{_sig(p_ * mult):>{colw}}"
                      + (f" {_sig(se[i] * mult):>{colw}}" if extra_se else "")
                      + "\n", "result")
        out.write(f"{'':>{wl}} | \n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Total':>{wl}} | ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_sig(mult):>{colw}}\n", "result")
        out.write(line + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"  Key:  {stat_name}  =  cell {stat_name}\n", "text")   # VERIFY
        return
    # two-way: cell proportions and Pearson test with the Rao-Scott correction
    v0, v1 = vars_
    R, C = len(levels[0]), len(levels[1])
    ind = []
    for a in levels[0]:
        for b in levels[1]:
            ind.append(((data[0] == a) & (data[1] == b)).astype(float))
    P = np.array([float(w @ i_) / W for i_ in ind]).reshape(R, C)
    Z = np.column_stack([w * (i_ - P.ravel()[j]) / W for j, i_ in enumerate(ind)])
    V = dd.variance(Z)
    # layout (compat 0601): columns as wide as the longest label or value, separated by two spaces;
    # column name centered over them
    wl = max(9, max(len(lab(v0, a)) for a in levels[0]), len(names[0]))
    texts = [[_sig(P[i, j] * mult) for j in range(C)] + [_sig(P[i].sum() * mult)] for i in range(R)]
    tot = [_sig(P[:, j].sum() * mult) for j in range(C)] + [_sig(mult)]
    heads = [lab(v1, b) for b in levels[1]] + ["Total"]
    cw = max([len(h) for h in heads] + [len(x) for row in texts for x in row] + [len(x) for x in tot])
    body = len(heads) * cw + 2 * (len(heads) - 1) + 1
    out.write("-" * (wl + 2 + body) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'':>{wl}} |" + names[1].center(body) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{names[0]:>{wl}} | " + "  ".join(f"{h:>{cw}}" for h in heads) + "\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * wl + "-+" + "-" * body + "\n", "text")
    for i, a in enumerate(levels[0]):
        out.write(f"{lab(v0, a):>{wl}} | ", "text")
        out.write("  ".join(f"{x:>{cw}}" for x in texts[i]) + "\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'':>{wl}} | \n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Total':>{wl}} | ", "text")
    out.write("  ".join(f"{x:>{cw}}" for x in tot) + "\n", "result")
    out.write("-" * (wl + 2 + body) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  Key:  cell {stat_name}\n", "text")
    # Pearson: X² = n Σ (p - pr pc)² / (pr pc); 2nd-order Rao-Scott
    pr, pc = P.sum(1), P.sum(0)
    E = np.outer(pr, pc)
    X2 = N * float(np.sum((P - E) ** 2 / np.where(E > 0, E, 1)))
    df0 = (R - 1) * (C - 1)
    # interaction contrasts (generalized design effect, Rao & Scott 1984) [SVY] svy: tabulate
    # twoway: Δ = (C'D⁻¹V_srs D⁻¹C)⁻¹ (C'D⁻¹ V D⁻¹C), with D = diag(p̂) and V_srs of the observed
    # proportions (compat 0601: F = 4.9245)
    Cm = _interaction_contrasts(R, C)
    pv_ = P.ravel()
    Vsrs = (np.diag(pv_) - np.outer(pv_, pv_)) / N
    Di = np.diag(np.where(pv_ > 0, 1 / np.where(pv_ > 0, pv_, 1), 0.0))
    try:
        A = np.linalg.solve(Cm.T @ Di @ Vsrs @ Di @ Cm, Cm.T @ Di @ V @ Di @ Cm)
        tr, tr2 = float(np.trace(A)), float(np.trace(A @ A))
        dnum = tr ** 2 / tr2
        dden = dnum * dd.df
        Fv = X2 / tr
        pv = float(st.f.sf(Fv, dnum, dden))
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        Fv, dnum, dden, pv = SYS, SYS, SYS, SYS
    out.write("\n  Pearson:\n", "text")
    def _dfmt(x):
        return f"{x:.0f}" if abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-9 else f"{x:.2f}"   # VERIFY non-integer format
    ftxt = f"F({_dfmt(dnum)}, {_dfmt(dden)})"
    out.write(f"    Uncorrected   {'chi2(' + str(df0) + ')':<16}= {X2:>9.4f}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"    Design-based  {ftxt:<16}= {Fv:>9.4f}     P = {pv:.4f}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"N": float(N), "r": float(R), "c": float(C), "cun_Pear": X2, "F_Pear": Fv, "df1_Pear": dnum,
           "df2_Pear": dden, "p_Pear": pv}


def _sig(x: float, digits: int = 4) -> str:
    """Stata's %6.4g: 4 significant digits, without the leading zero."""
    if not np.isfinite(x):
        return "."
    t = f"{x:.{digits}g}"
    if "e" in t:
        return format_value(x, "%9.0g", pad=False).strip()
    return t[1:] if t.startswith("0.") else ("-" + t[2:] if t.startswith("-0.") else t)


def _interaction_contrasts(R: int, C: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """RC x (R-1)(C-1) matrix of interaction contrasts (centered effects)."""
    def contr(k):
        m = np.zeros((k, k - 1))
        for j in range(k - 1):
            m[j, j] = 1
            m[k - 1, j] = -1
        return m
    return np.kron(contr(R), contr(C))

# svy: with the other models (ologit, oprobit, mlogit, nbreg, glm, tobit)

_GENERIC_TITLES = {"ologit": "Ordered logistic regression", "oprobit": "Ordered probit regression",
                   "mlogit": "Multinomial logistic regression", "nbreg": "Negative binomial regression",
                   "glm": "Generalized linear models", "tobit": "Tobit regression"}


def svy_generic(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str, svyopts: str) -> None:
    """Runs the command with the design weights and replaces the variance with the
    design one: _Prep.vce receives the scores and returns the linearized V (or, with
    a replication vce, the command runs again with each replicate weight)."""
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    d = require_design(s)
    ds = s.data
    so = parse_svy_opts(svyopts)
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.weight:
        raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed with the svy prefix")   # VERIFY
    if "vce(" in p.options.replace(" ", ""):
        raise StataError(198, "option vce() not allowed")   # VERIFY
    dd = DesignData(s, d, np.ones(ds.nobs, bool), vce=so.get("vce"), mse=so.get("mse"),
                    hadamard=so.get("hadamard"))
    subpop = subpop_mask(s, str(so["subpop"])) if so.get("subpop") else None
    full = dd.mask
    if cmd == "clogit":
        import re as _re
        mg = _re.search(r"\bgr(?:oup)?\(\s*(\w+)\s*\)", p.options or "")
        if mg and ds.has(mg.group(1)):
            gv = ds.get(mg.group(1)).data[full]
            pairs = {}
            for gval, ps in zip(gv, dd.psu):
                if pairs.setdefault(gval, ps) != ps:
                    # case 1909; VERIFY the return code
                    raise StataError(459, "the group() variable is not nested within the final stage sampling units")

    inside_all = full & (subpop if subpop is not None else True)
    pos = np.full(ds.nobs, -1)
    pos[np.flatnonzero(full)] = np.arange(dd.n)
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\n(running {cmd} on estimation sample)\n", "text")
    wname, iname = "__svy_w", "__svy_in"
    for nm in (wname, iname):
        if ds.has(nm):
            ds.drop_vars([nm])
    wfull = np.zeros(ds.nobs)
    wfull[full] = dd.w
    ds.add(Variable(wname, "double", wfull))
    ds.add(Variable(iname, "byte", inside_all.astype(float)))
    cond = f"{iname}" + (f" & ({p.if_})" if p.if_ else "")
    rng = f" in {p.in_}" if p.in_ else ""
    opts = (p.options + " " if p.options else "") + "vce(robust)"
    if cmd not in ("tobit", "ivregress"):
        opts += " nolog"
    text = f"{cmd} {p.varlist} [pweight={wname}] if {cond}{rng}, {opts}"
    ctx = {"dd": dd, "pos": pos}
    s._svy_ctx = ctx
    try:
        with out.quietly():     # also silent under capture noisily (case 1909)
            s.interp._execute_expanded(text)
    finally:
        s._svy_ctx = None
    est = s._estimates
    b = np.asarray(est.b, dtype=float)
    n_rep = None
    try:
        if dd.replicated:
            def estimator(ww):
                wv = np.zeros(ds.nobs)
                wv[full] = ww
                ds.get(wname).data = wv
                with out.quietly():
                    s.interp._execute_expanded(text.replace(", vce(robust)", ",").replace("vce(robust)", ""))
                return np.asarray(s._estimates.b, dtype=float)
            saved = (s.e, s._estimates, ds.esample)
            V, n_rep = dd.rep_variance(estimator, b)
            s.e, s._estimates, ds.esample = saved
            est = s._estimates
            est.V = (V + V.T) / 2
            _refresh_rows(est)
    finally:
        ds.drop_vars([wname, iname])
    V = np.asarray(est.V, dtype=float)
    df = dd.df
    names = list(est.names)
    eqs = list(est.eqnames) if est.eqnames else ["_"] * len(names)
    aux_eq = {"lnalpha", "sigma", "/"}
    slopes = [j for j, (nm, eq) in enumerate(zip(names, eqs))
              if nm != "_cons" and V[j, j] > 0 and not eq.startswith("cut") and eq not in aux_eq
              and "b." not in nm and "o." not in nm]
    if cmd in ("heckman", "heckprobit", "zip", "zinb", "hetprobit") and eqs:
        # the model test covers the main equation only (case 1909)
        slopes = [j for j in slopes if eqs[j] == eqs[0]]
    F, df1, df2 = _adjusted_F(b, V, slopes, df)
    _svy_aux_ci(est, df)
    N = int(np.count_nonzero(ds.esample)) if ds.esample is not None else int(inside_all.sum())
    pop = float(dd.w[(ds.esample if ds.esample is not None else inside_all)[full]].sum())
    if subpop is not None:
        # with subpop(), Number of obs and Population size count the whole design sample (complete
        # cases in the model variables); compat 0602
        import re as _re
        ok = full.copy()
        for tok in set(_re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", _re.sub(r"\b[A-Za-z]+\.", " ", p.varlist))):
            if ds.has(tok):
                v = ds.get(tok)
                if not is_string_type(v.vtype):
                    ok &= ~(v.data.astype(float) >= M.MISSING_THRESHOLD)
        N = int(ok.sum())
        pop = float(dd.w[ok[full]].sum())
    est.vcetype = dd.vcetype
    est.stat = "t"
    est.df_r = df
    est.extra = dict(getattr(est, "extra", {}) or {})
    est.extra.update(dict(N=N, pop=pop, df=df, F=F, df1=df1, df2=df2, strata=dd.n_strata, psu=dd.n_psu,
                          n_rep=n_rep, sub=(int(inside_all.sum()), float(dd.w[inside_all[full]].sum()))
                          if subpop is not None else None))
    est.svytitle = (_GENERIC_TITLES.get(cmd) or getattr(est, "title", "") or est.extra.get("title") or cmd)
    # VERIFY: like the commands themselves, these leave the depvar out of the table header
    est.extra["blank_dep"] = cmd in ("intreg", "heckman", "heckprobit", "heckoprobit", "biprobit")
    est.display = _display_generic
    # pieces of the command's own output that Stata keeps under svy (case 1909)
    if cmd == "heckman":
        est.extra["subtitle"] = "(regression model with sample selection)"
    if cmd == "ivregress":
        est.extra["svy_r2"] = est.extra.get("r2")
    est.extra["svy_cmd"] = cmd
    est.extra["no_F"] = cmd == "glm"            # svy: glm does not show the F test (compat 0602)
    est.extra["dispersion"] = getattr(est, "dispersion", "") if cmd == "nbreg" else ""
    # under svy the cut points get t and P>|t| (compat 0602)
    for r in est.rows:
        if r.kind == "aux" and r.label.startswith("/cut") and not r.eq:
            r.kind = "coe"
    # exponentiated form requested in the command's options
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_options
    words = {n.lower() for n, _ in parse_options(p.options)} if p.options.strip() else set()
    title_ef = ""
    if "eform" in words or "ef" in words:
        title_ef = "exp(b)" if cmd == "glm" else getattr(est, "eform_title_opt", "exp(b)")
    elif "or" in words:
        title_ef = "Odds Ratio"
    elif "irr" in words:
        title_ef = "IRR"
    elif "rrr" in words:
        title_ef = "RRR"
    est.coef_title, est.eform_on = (title_ef, True) if title_ef else ("Coef.", False)
    Z = ctx.get("Z")
    if Z is not None:
        srs = srs_variances(Z, dd.w * inside_all[full], dd, N)
        labs = [("/" + eq if (eq.startswith("cut") or eq in aux_eq) and nm == "_cons" else nm, "")
                for nm, eq in zip(names, eqs)]
        est.svy_effects = dict(V=V, srs=srs, labels=labs, vals=b, title="Coef.",
                               vcetype=dd.vcetype, over="", level=est.level,
                               depvar=getattr(est, "depvar", ""))
    e = s.e
    e.update({"N_strata": float(dd.n_strata), "N_psu": float(dd.n_psu), "N_pop": pop, "df_r": float(df),
              "F": F, "df_m": float(df1)})
    e["prefix"] = "svy"
    e["vce"] = dd.vce
    e["vcetype"] = dd.vcetype
    e["cmdline"] = f"svy: {cmd} {args.strip()}"
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    if isinstance(e.get("V"), Matrix):
        e["V"] = Matrix(V.copy(), list(e["V"].rownames), list(e["V"].colnames))
        e["V"].roweq = eqs
        e["V"].coleq = eqs
    _display_generic(s, est)


def _svy_aux_ci(est, df) -> None:
    """Transformed ancillary rows (sigma, rho, alpha) get the interval of their parameter with the
    design degrees of freedom, and lambda its own interval with them (case 1909: svy: intreg,
    svy: heckman)."""
    import math as _m
    from .results import crit as _crit
    c = _crit("t", est.level, df)
    rows = est.rows
    by = {r.label.lstrip("/"): r for r in rows if r.kind == "coef"}
    tf = {"sigma": ("lnsigma", _m.exp), "alpha": ("lnalpha", _m.exp), "rho": ("athrho", _m.tanh)}
    for r in rows:
        if r.kind == "aux" and r.label == "lambda" and 0 < r.se < SYS:
            r.eq = f"{r.b - c * r.se!r} {r.b + c * r.se!r}"
            continue
        if r.kind != "aux" or r.label not in tf:
            continue
        par = by.get(tf[r.label][0])
        if par is None or not (par.se > 0):
            continue
        f = tf[r.label][1]
        r.eq = f"{f(par.b - c * par.se)!r} {f(par.b + c * par.se)!r}"


def _refresh_rows(est) -> None:
    """Standard errors of the table rows from est.V (same order as e(b))."""
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(est.V), 0))
    k = 0
    for r in est.rows:
        if r.kind in ("coef",):
            while k < len(est.b) and np.asarray(est.V)[k, k] == 0 and est.b[k] == 0:
                k += 1
            if k < len(se):
                r.se = float(se[k])
            k += 1
        elif r.kind == "aux" and not r.eq:
            if k < len(se) and r.se < SYS:     # a missing standard error stays missing
                r.se = float(se[k])
            k += 1


def _display_generic(s: "Session", est, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True, level=None, **_kw):
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"Survey: {est.svytitle}\n", "text")
        if x.get("subtitle"):
            out.write(x["subtitle"] + "\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        right = [("Number of obs", f"{x['N']:,}"), ("Population size", format_size(x["pop"]))]
        if x.get("sub"):
            right += [("Subpop. no. obs", f"{x['sub'][0]:,}"), ("Subpop. size", format_size(x["sub"][1]))]
        if x.get("n_rep"):
            right.append(("Replications", f"{x['n_rep']:,}"))
        right += [("Design df", f"{x['df']:,}")]
        if not x.get("no_F"):
            right += [(f"F({x['df1']:>4},{x['df2']:>7})", g(x["F"], "%10.2f")),
                      ("Prob > F", g(st.f.sf(x["F"], x["df1"], x["df2"]) if x["F"] < SYS else SYS, "%10.4f"))]
        if x.get("svy_r2") is not None:
            right.append(("R-squared", g(x["svy_r2"], "%10.4f")))
        left = [f"Number of strata   = {x['strata']:>9,}", f"Number of PSUs     = {x['psu']:>9,}"]
        if x.get("dispersion"):
            # "Dispersion         = mean" on the Prob > F line (compat 0602)
            left += [""] * (len(right) - 1 - len(left)) + [f"{'Dispersion':<19}= {x['dispersion']}"]
        for i, (rl, rv) in enumerate(right):
            lft = left[i] if i < len(left) else ""
            out.write(f"{lft:<48}{rl:<18}= ", "text")
            out.write(f"{rv:>10}\n", "result")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        if x.get("svy_cmd") == "slogit":
            out.write(" ( 1)  [phi1_1]_cons = 1\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, "" if est.extra.get("blank_dep") else est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=level or est.level,
                   vcetype=est.vcetype, coef_title=getattr(est, "coef_title", "Coef."),
                   eform=getattr(est, "eform_on", False))
        if x.get("svy_cmd") == "ivregress":
            out.write(f"Instrumented:  {x['instd']}\n", "text")
            out.write(f"Instruments:   {x['insts']}\n", "text")
            out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        elif x.get("svy_cmd") in ("intreg", "slogit") and getattr(est, "footer", None):
            est.footer(s, est)

def _constraints(s: "Session") -> dict:
    if not hasattr(s, "constraints"):
        s.constraints = {}
    return s.constraints


def cmd_constraint(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    """constraint define|dir|list|drop ([R] constraint). The expression is kept as text and is
    read against the coefficients of the command that uses it (cnsreg, ...)."""
    cons = _constraints(s)
    m = re.match(r"^(\w+)\s*(.*)$", args.strip(), re.S)
    if not m:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    sub, rest = m.group(1).lower(), m.group(2).strip()
    if sub.isdigit():
        sub, rest = "define", args.strip()             # constraint # exp: define is optional
    if "define".startswith(sub) and len(sub) >= 1 and sub not in ("dir", "di", "d") or sub == "def":
        mm = re.match(r"^(\d+)\s+(.+)$", rest, re.S)
        if not mm:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        n = int(mm.group(1))
        if not 1 <= n <= 1999:
            raise StataError(125, "constraint number must be between 1 and 1999")   # VERIFY
        cons[n] = mm.group(2).strip()
        return
    if sub in ("dir", "di", "list", "l", "li", "lis"):
        wanted = _numlist(rest) if rest and rest != "_all" else sorted(cons)
        for n in sorted(wanted):
            if n in cons:
                s.output.write(f"{n:>6}:  {cons[n]}\n", "text")
        return
    if sub == "drop":
        if rest == "_all":
            cons.clear()
            return
        for n in _numlist(rest):
            if n not in cons:
                raise StataError(111, f"constraint {n} not found")   # VERIFY
            del cons[n]
        return
    raise StataError(199, f"unrecognized command: constraint {sub}")


def _numlist(text: str) -> list[int]:
    out: list[int] = []
    for tok in text.replace(",", " ").split():
        if "-" in tok or "/" in tok:
            a, b = re.split(r"[-/]", tok, maxsplit=1)
            out += list(range(int(a), int(b) + 1))
        else:
            out.append(int(tok))
    return out

class _Sample:
    """If/in, weights and options of a command whose varlist this module reads itself."""

    def __init__(self, s: "Session", tail: str, spec: dict[str, int], weights=("aweight", "fweight", "iweight"),
                 var_terms=()):
        from ..commands._util import touse
        from ..commands.summarize import weights as get_weights
        self.s = s
        p = parse_standard(tail)
        spec = dict(spec)
        spec.update({"level": 1, "noconstant": 4})
        self.o = match_options(p.options, spec) if p.options.strip() else {}
        ds = s.data
        mask = touse(s, p)
        bad = fvars.term_missing(ds, list(var_terms)) if var_terms else np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
        mask &= ~bad
        self.w, self.wtype, mask = get_weights(s, p, mask, weights)
        self.mask = mask
        self.n = int(mask.sum())
        if self.n == 0:
            raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
        self.level = float(self.o["level"]) if self.o.get("level") else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
        if self.level < 10 or self.level > 99.99:
            raise StataError(198, "level() must be between 10 and 99.99 inclusive")
        self.constant = not self.o.get("noconstant")
        self.vce = "ols"
        self.clustvar = ""
        self.depname = ""


def _equations(text: str) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, str, str]], str]:
    """'(a b c) (n: d = e f) if x, opts' -> [(name, depvar, rhs)], 'if x, opts'."""
    t = text.strip()
    eqs, depth, start, end = [], 0, None, 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(t):
        if ch == "(":
            if depth == 0:
                start = i
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0 and start is not None:
                eqs.append(t[start + 1:i])
                end = i + 1
        elif depth == 0 and ch not in " \t":
            break
    out = []
    for body in eqs:
        name = ""
        mm = re.match(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*:\s*(.*)$", body, re.S)
        if mm:
            name, body = mm.group(1), mm.group(2)
        if "=" in body:
            dep, rhs = body.split("=", 1)
        else:
            toks = fvars._split_tokens(body)
            if not toks:
                raise StataError(100, "varlist required")
            dep, rhs = toks[0], " ".join(toks[1:])
        out.append((name, dep.strip(), rhs.strip()))
    if not out:
        raise StataError(198, "equation required")   # VERIFY
    return out, t[end:].strip()


def _dep(s: "Session", name: str):
    ds = s.data
    terms = fvars.expand_fv(ds, name)
    if len(terms) != 1 or terms[0].is_interaction or terms[0].comps[0].factor:
        raise StataError(198, "depvar may not be a factor variable")   # VERIFY
    return terms[0], terms[0].comps[0]


def _fake_pr(s, mask, n):
    return SimpleNamespace(s=s, smp=SimpleNamespace(mask=mask, n=n), w=np.ones(n))


def _est_names(blk: Block) -> list[str]:
    names = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in blk.cols if c.values is not None]
    if blk.constant:
        names.append("_cons")
    return names

def cmd_cnsreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import _constraint, replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "cnsreg", args)
        return
    from .regress import Sample, wexp_macros
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"constraints": 3, "collinear": 4, "noheader": 6, "notable": 5},
                 weights=("aweight", "fweight", "pweight", "iweight"))
    o = smp.o
    if not o.get("constraints"):
        raise StataError(100, "option constraints() required")
    ds = s.data
    w, N = smp.weights_for_fit()
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant, w)
    for nm in notes:
        s.output.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols] + ([np.ones(smp.n)] if smp.constant else []))
    names = [c.name for c in est_cols] + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    fake = SimpleNamespace(names=names, eqnames=[])
    cons = _constraints(s)
    R, r, texts = [], [], []
    for n in _numlist(str(o["constraints"])):
        if n not in cons:
            raise StataError(111, f"constraint {n} not found")
        coef, rhs = _constraint(s, fake, cons[n])
        row = np.zeros(len(names))
        for k, v in coef.items():
            row[k] = v
        R.append(row)
        r.append(rhs)
        from .postest import _ctext
        texts.append(_ctext(fake, coef, rhs))
    R, r = np.array(R).reshape(-1, len(names)), np.array(r)
    beta, A, rk = syseq.restricted_ls(X, smp.y, w, R, r)
    resid = smp.y - X @ beta
    rss = float(np.sum(w * resid ** 2))
    k = X.shape[1]
    df_r = N - k + rk
    if df_r <= 0:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    s2 = rss / df_r
    Vb = s2 * A
    if smp.constant:
        ybar = float(np.sum(w * smp.y) / np.sum(w))
        tss = float(np.sum(w * (smp.y - ybar) ** 2))
    else:
        tss = float(np.sum(w * smp.y ** 2))
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    df_m = len(slopes) - rk
    F = SYS
    if slopes and df_m > 0:
        bb, VV = beta[slopes], Vb[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)]
        F = float(bb @ np.linalg.pinv(VV) @ bb) / df_m
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(s2))
    kk = len(smp.cols) + (1 if smp.constant else 0)
    names_full = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in smp.cols] \
        + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    b_full, V_full = np.zeros(kk), np.zeros((kk, kk))
    b_full[pos] = beta
    V_full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = Vb
    bmap = {c.name: b_full[i] for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {c.name: float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[i, i], 0))) for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = b_full[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates("cnsreg", smp.depname, names_full, b_full, V_full, smp.n, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = smp.level, "", "", None
    est.extra = {"N": N, "df_m": df_m, "df_r": df_r, "F": F, "rmse": rmse, "rss": rss, "tss": tss,
                 "r2": 1 - rss / tss if tss > 0 else SYS, "ll": SYS, "rank": k - rk}
    est.wtype = smp.wtype
    est.cns_text = texts
    est.display = _display_cnsreg
    scalars = [("N", N), ("df_m", df_m), ("df_r", df_r), ("F", F), ("rmse", rmse), ("rss", rss),
               ("ll", -0.5 * N * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(rss / N) + 1)), ("r2", est.extra["r2"]),
               ("rank", k - rk)]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("cnsreg", args)), ("title", "Constrained linear regression"),
              ("marginsok", "XB default"), ("depvar", smp.depname), ("cmd", "cnsreg"),
              ("properties", "b V"), ("predict", "regres_p")] + wexp_macros(smp)
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    _display_cnsreg(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _flabel(df_m, df_r, w_m=3, w_r=10) -> str:
    return f"F({int(df_m):>{w_m}},{int(df_r):>{w_r}})"


def _display_cnsreg(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        out = s.output
        pF = g(st.f.sf(x["F"], x["df_m"], x["df_r"]) if x["F"] < SYS else SYS, "%10.4f")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        for lft, lab, val in (("Constrained linear regression", "Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
                              ("", _flabel(x["df_m"], x["df_r"], 4, 7), g(x["F"], "%10.2f")),
                              ("", "Prob > F", pF), ("", "Root MSE", sig5(x["rmse"]))):
            out.write(f"{lft:<48}{lab:<18}= ", "text")
            out.write(f"{val:>10}\n", "result")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        for i, t in enumerate(est.cns_text, 1):
            s.output.write(f" ({i:>2})  {t}\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=lev)

def cmd_eivreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "eivreg", args)
        return
    from .regress import Sample, wexp_macros
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"reliab": 1, "noheader": 6, "notable": 5}, weights=("aweight", "fweight"))
    o = smp.o
    ds = s.data
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    rel = np.ones(len(est_cols))
    if o.get("reliab"):
        for part in re.findall(r"\(([^)]*)\)", str(o["reliab"])) or [str(o["reliab"])]:
            mm = re.match(r"^\s*(\S+)\s+([0-9.eE+-]+)\s*$", part)
            if not mm:
                raise StataError(198, "option reliab() invalid")   # VERIFY
            nm = mm.group(1)
            val = float(mm.group(2))
            if not 0 < val <= 1:
                raise StataError(198, "reliability must be in (0, 1]")   # VERIFY
            idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(est_cols) if c.name == nm]
            if not idx:
                raise StataError(111, f"{nm} not found")
            rel[idx[0]] = val
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(rel)) or smp.n < len(est_cols) + 2:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    Xs = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols]) if est_cols else np.zeros((smp.n, 0))
    beta, a, V, see = syseq.eivreg(Xs, smp.y, rel, smp.constant)
    N = float(smp.n)
    p = len(est_cols)
    df_r = N - p - (1 if smp.constant else 0)
    r2 = max(1 - see * df_r / ((N - 1) * float(np.var(smp.y, ddof=1))), 0.0) if smp.constant else SYS   # VERIFY: matches the 1908 log
    kk = len(smp.cols) + (1 if smp.constant else 0)
    names_full = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in smp.cols] \
        + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    b_vec = np.concatenate([beta, [a]]) if smp.constant else beta
    b_full, V_full = np.zeros(kk), np.zeros((kk, kk))
    b_full[pos] = b_vec
    V_full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    bmap = {c.name: b_full[i] for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {c.name: float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[i, i], 0))) for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = b_full[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates("eivreg", smp.depname, names_full, b_full, V_full, smp.n, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = smp.level, "", "", None
    sl = list(range(p))
    F = float(beta @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(sl, sl)], beta)) / p if p else SYS
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(see)) if df_r > 0 else SYS   # VERIFY: Root MSE is sqrt(sigma_ee)
    relrows = [(c.name, float(rel[i])) for i, c in enumerate(est_cols) if o.get("reliab") and rel[i] != 1.0 or False]
    if len(relrows) < len(est_cols):
        relrows.append(("*", 1.0))
    est.extra = {"N": N, "df_m": p, "df_r": df_r, "F": F, "r2": r2, "rmse": rmse, "rel": relrows}
    est.display = _display_eivreg
    scalars = [("N", N), ("df_m", p), ("df_r", df_r), ("F", F), ("r2", r2), ("rmse", rmse)]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("eivreg", args)), ("title", "Errors-in-variables regression"),
              ("depvar", smp.depname), ("cmd", "eivreg"), ("properties", "b V"), ("predict", "regres_p")] \
        + wexp_macros(smp)
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    _display_eivreg(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _display_eivreg(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        out = s.output
        left = [" " * 19 + "assumed", "    variable     reliability", "-" * 28]
        left += [f"{nm:>12}{v:>13.4f}" for nm, v in x["rel"]]
        right = [("", ""), ("", ""), ("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
                 (_flabel(x["df_m"], x["df_r"], 3, 10), g(x["F"], "%10.2f")),
                 ("Prob > F", g(st.f.sf(x["F"], x["df_m"], x["df_r"]) if x["F"] < SYS else SYS, "%10.4f")),
                 ("R-squared", g(x["r2"], "%10.4f")), ("Root MSE", g(x["rmse"], "%8.0g"))]
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{left[0]:<48}Errors-in-variables regression\n", "text")
        left, right = left[1:], right[1:]
        m = max(len(left), len(right))
        left += [""] * (m - len(left))
        right += [("", "")] * (m - len(right))
        for lft, (rl, rv) in zip(left, right):
            if rl:
                out.write(f"{lft:<48}{rl:<18}= ", "text")
                out.write(f"{rv:>10}\n", "result")
            else:
                out.write(lft + "\n", "text")
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=lev)

def cmd_vwls(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "vwls", args)
        return
    from .regress import Sample
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"sd": 2, "noheader": 6, "notable": 5}, weights=(), extra_vars="")
    o = smp.o
    ds = s.data
    if not o.get("sd"):
        raise StataError(100, "option sd() required")
    from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
    sdname = resolve_name(ds, str(o["sd"]).strip())
    sd = ds.get(sdname).data[smp.mask].astype(float)
    if np.any(sd <= 0) or np.any(sd >= SYS):
        raise StataError(198, "sd() must be positive and not missing")   # VERIFY
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols] + ([np.ones(smp.n)] if smp.constant else []))
    beta, V, chi2_fit = syseq.vwls(X, smp.y, sd)
    N = float(smp.n)
    k = X.shape[1]
    df_gof = N - k
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    df_m = len(slopes)
    chi2_m = float(beta[slopes] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)], beta[slopes])) if slopes else SYS
    kk = len(smp.cols) + (1 if smp.constant else 0)
    names_full = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in smp.cols] \
        + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    b_full, V_full = np.zeros(kk), np.zeros((kk, kk))
    b_full[pos] = beta
    V_full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    bmap = {c.name: b_full[i] for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {c.name: float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[i, i], 0))) for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = b_full[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates("vwls", smp.depname, names_full, b_full, V_full, smp.n, "z", None)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = smp.level, "", "", None
    est.extra = {"N": N, "df_gof": df_gof, "chi2_gof": chi2_fit, "df_m": df_m, "chi2": chi2_m}
    est.display = _display_vwls
    scalars = [("N", N), ("df_m", df_m), ("chi2", chi2_m), ("chi2_gf", chi2_fit), ("df_gf", df_gof)]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("vwls", args)), ("title", "Variance-weighted least-squares regression"),
              ("depvar", smp.depname), ("cmd", "vwls"), ("properties", "b V"), ("sdvar", sdname),
              ("predict", "regres_p")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    _display_vwls(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _display_vwls(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        out = s.output
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Variance-weighted least-squares regression':<48}{'Number of obs':<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{comma(x['N']):>10}\n", "result")
        p_gof = chi2_tail(x["chi2_gof"], x["df_gof"])
        p_m = chi2_tail(x["chi2"], x["df_m"]) if x["df_m"] else SYS
        lab = f"Goodness-of-fit chi2({int(x['df_gof'])})"
        out.write(f"{lab:<27}={g(x['chi2_gof'], '%8.2f'):>8}".ljust(48)
                  + f"{'Model chi2(' + str(int(x['df_m'])) + ')':<18}= {g(x['chi2'], '%10.2f'):>10}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Prob > chi2':<27}={g(p_gof, '%8.4f'):>8}".ljust(48)
                  + f"{'Prob > chi2':<18}= {g(p_m, '%10.4f'):>10}\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev)

def _system(s: "Session", args: str, cmd: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return
    eqs, tail = _equations(args)
    tail = re.sub(r"(?<![\w])2sls(?![\w])", "twosls", re.sub(r"(?<![\w])3sls(?![\w])", "threesls", tail))
    ds = s.data
    deps = [_dep(s, d) for _, d, _ in eqs]
    terms = [fvars.expand_fv(ds, rhs) if rhs.strip() else [] for _, _, rhs in eqs]
    spec = {"corr": 4, "isure": 3, "iterate": 4, "small": 2, "dfk": 3, "dfk2": 4, "notable": 5, "noheader": 6,
            "constraints": 3, "nolog": 4, "tolerance": 3, "level": 1, "noconstant": 4, "log": 3,
            "nodfk": 4, "first": 3}
    if cmd == "reg3":
        spec.update({"ols": 3, "twosls": 4, "threesls": 4, "sure": 2, "ireg3": 4, "endog": 3, "exog": 3, "inst": 3,
                     "allexog": 3})
        spec.pop("isure")
    smp = _Sample(s, tail, spec, var_terms=[t for ds_ in deps for t in [ds_[0]]] + [t for tt in terms for t in tt])
    o = smp.o
    mask, n = smp.mask, smp.n
    pr = _fake_pr(s, mask, n)
    blocks, ys, depnames = [], [], []
    for (name, dep, rhs), (dterm, dcomp) in zip(eqs, deps):
        ys.append(fvars.comp_values(ds, dcomp)[mask].astype(float))
        depnames.append(dcomp.tsname)
        blocks.append(block_from_text(pr, name or dcomp.tsname, rhs, smp.constant))
    for blk in blocks:
        for nm in blk.notes:
            s.output.write(f"note: {nm} omitted because of collinearity\n", "text")
    Xs = [blk.X for blk in blocks]
    ks = [X.shape[1] for X in Xs]
    cons, cns_text = _system_constraints(s, o, blocks) if o.get("constraints") else (None, [])
    dfk = "small" if o.get("small") and cmd == "sureg" else ""
    if o.get("dfk"):
        dfk = "dfk"
    iterate = bool(o.get("isure") or o.get("ireg3"))
    method = "sure"
    if cmd == "reg3":
        method = "3sls"
        for key, opt in (("ols", "ols"), ("twosls", "2sls"), ("threesls", "3sls"), ("sure", "sure")):
            if o.get(key):
                method = opt
    if cmd == "sureg":
        fit = syseq.sure(Xs, ys, iterate=iterate, dfk=dfk, cons=cons)
        Zs = Xs
    else:
        rhs_names = []
        for blk in blocks:
            for c in blk.cols:
                if c.values is not None and c.name not in rhs_names:
                    rhs_names.append(c.name)
        all_vars = []
        for dep_, blk in zip(depnames, blocks):
            for nm in [dep_] + [c.name for c in blk.cols if c.values is not None]:
                if nm not in all_vars:
                    all_vars.append(nm)
        if o.get("inst"):
            # inst() is the complete list of exogenous variables; everything else is endogenous
            exog_list = list(dict.fromkeys(str(o["inst"]).split()))
            endog_list = [v for v in all_vars if v not in exog_list]
        else:
            endog_list = list(dict.fromkeys(list(depnames) + str(o.get("endog") or "").split()))
            exog_list = [v for v in rhs_names if v not in endog_list]
            exog_list += [v for v in dict.fromkeys(str(o.get("exog") or "").split()) if v not in exog_list]
        endog_names = set(endog_list)
        inst_cols = []
        for nm in exog_list:
            col = next((c.values for b_ in blocks for c in b_.cols if c.name == nm and c.values is not None), None)
            inst_cols.append(col if col is not None else ds.get(nm).data[mask].astype(float))
        if smp.constant:
            inst_cols.append(np.ones(n))
        Zfull = np.column_stack(inst_cols)
        P = Zfull @ np.linalg.pinv(Zfull.T @ Zfull) @ Zfull.T
        Zs = []
        for blk in blocks:
            cols = []
            for c in [c for c in blk.cols if c.values is not None]:
                cols.append(P @ c.values if c.name in endog_names else c.values)
            if blk.constant:
                cols.append(np.ones(n))
            Zs.append(np.column_stack(cols))
        # Stata scales the 2sls/ols covariance by the equation degrees of freedom (observed in the 1908 log)
        # with constraints the 2sls/ols covariance is not rescaled and the tests are z (compat 1918)
        fit = syseq.three_sls(Xs, Zs, ys, method=method, iterate=iterate,
                              dfk="small" if method in ("2sls", "ols") and not dfk and cons is None else dfk, cons=cons)
    foot = (endog_list, exog_list) if cmd == "reg3" else None
    if cmd == "sureg":
        exog = []
        for dep_, blk in zip(depnames, blocks):
            for nm in [dep_] + [c.name for c in blk.cols if c.values is not None]:
                if nm not in exog:
                    exog.append(nm)
    else:
        exog = exog_list
    _post_system(s, args, cmd, eqs, blocks, ys, Xs, fit, smp, o, method if cmd == "reg3" else "sure", dfk, foot,
                 cns_text=cns_text, cons=cons, exog=exog)


def _system_constraints(s, o, blocks):
    """(R, r) over the free coefficients of the equations, and the constraints as Stata lists
    them ([eq]name)."""
    from .postest import _constraint, _ctext
    names, eqn = [], []
    for blk in blocks:
        for c in blk.cols:
            if c.values is not None:
                names.append(c.name)
                eqn.append(blk.name)
        if blk.constant:
            names.append("_cons")
            eqn.append(blk.name)
    fake = SimpleNamespace(names=names, eqnames=eqn)
    cons = _constraints(s)
    R, r, texts = [], [], []
    for k in _numlist(str(o["constraints"])):
        if k not in cons:
            raise StataError(111, f"constraint {k} not found")
        coef, rhs = _constraint(s, fake, cons[k])
        row = np.zeros(len(names))
        for j, v in coef.items():
            row[j] = v
        R.append(row)
        r.append(rhs)
        texts.append(_ctext(fake, coef, rhs))
    return (np.array(R).reshape(-1, len(names)), np.array(r, dtype=float)), texts


def _post_system(s, args, cmd, eqs, blocks, ys, Xs, fit, smp, o, method, dfk, foot=None, cns_text=(), cons=None,
                 exog=()) -> None:
    ds = s.data
    n = smp.n
    m = len(blocks)
    b_all = np.concatenate(fit.b)
    names, eqnames, b_full, V_full, rows = assemble(SimpleNamespace(s=s), blocks, b_all, fit.V, [])
    use_t = bool(o.get("small")) or (cmd == "reg3" and method in ("2sls", "ols") and not cns_text)
    if cmd == "sureg" and o.get("isure") and not o.get("nolog"):
        s.output.write("\n", "text")
        for it, d in enumerate(fit.trace, 1):
            s.output.write(f"Iteration {it}:   tolerance = {g(d, '%10.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
    eq_info = []
    for i, blk in enumerate(blocks):
        e = fit.resid[:, i]
        rss = float(e @ e)
        y = ys[i]
        tss = float(np.sum((y - y.mean()) ** 2)) if blk.constant else float(y @ y)
        k = blk.k
        denom = n - k if use_t or dfk == "small" else n
        rmse = float(np.sqrt(rss / denom))
        r2 = 1 - rss / tss if tss > 0 else SYS
        off = int(sum(b.k for b in blocks[:i]))
        sl = list(range(off, off + blk.nslopes))
        if sl:
            bb, VV = b_all[sl], fit.V[np.ix_(sl, sl)]
            chi2 = float(bb @ np.linalg.solve(VV, bb))
        else:
            chi2 = SYS
        eq_info.append({"obs": n, "parms": blk.nslopes, "rmse": rmse, "r2": r2, "chi2": chi2, "df": len(sl), "rss": rss,
                        "mss": tss - rss})
    level = smp.level
    est = Estimates(cmd, blocks[0].name, names, b_full, V_full, n, "t" if use_t else "z",
                    float(m * n - sum(b.k for b in blocks)) if use_t else None)
    est.foot = foot
    est.cns_text = list(cns_text)
    est.iterated = bool(o.get("isure") or o.get("ireg3"))
    est.eqnames = eqnames
    est.rows = rows
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = level, "", "", None
    est.constant = smp.constant
    est.blocks = blocks
    est.depvar_cell = ""
    est.fit = fit
    est.eq_info = eq_info
    est.method = method
    est.names_eq = [b.name for b in blocks]
    est.corr_opt = bool(o.get("corr"))
    est.cons = smp.constant
    est.extra = {"N": n}
    est.display = _display_system
    est.depvar = " ".join(b.name for b in blocks)
    title = {"sureg": "Seemingly unrelated regression",
             "reg3": {"3sls": "Three-stage least-squares regression", "2sls": "Two-stage least-squares regression",
                      "ols": "Ordinary least-squares regression",
                      "sure": "Seemingly unrelated regression"}.get(method, "Three-stage least-squares regression")
             }[cmd]
    est.title = title + (", iterated " if cmd == "sureg" and o.get("isure") else "")
    # e() as Stata lists it after sureg (compat 1918; reg3 follows it, VERIFY)
    scalars = []
    for i, (blk, e) in enumerate(zip(blocks, eq_info), 1):
        p_i = chi2_tail(e["chi2"], e["df"]) if e["chi2"] < SYS else SYS
        scalars += [(f"cons_{i}", 1.0 if blk.constant else 0.0), (f"chi2_{i}", e["chi2"]), (f"p_{i}", p_i),
                    (f"df_m{i}", e["df"]), (f"rss_{i}", e["rss"]), (f"rmse_{i}", e["rmse"]), (f"mss_{i}", e["mss"]),
                    (f"r2_{i}", e["r2"])]
    S = fit.resid.T @ fit.resid / n
    ll = -0.5 * n * (m * (1 + np.log(2 * np.pi)) + float(np.linalg.slogdet(S)[1]))
    scalars += [("k", float(len(b_all))), ("N", n), ("rank", np.linalg.matrix_rank(fit.V)), ("ll", ll),
                ("dfk2_adj", float(n)), ("k_eq", m), ("ic", fit.iterations if est.iterated else 0)]
    macros = [("cmd", cmd), ("cmdline", cmdline(cmd, args)), ("method", method),
              ("marginsdefault", " ".join(f"predict(xb equation({b.name}))" for b in blocks)),
              ("marginsok", "XB default"), ("marginsnotok", "stdp Residuals stddp"), ("predict", "reg3_p"),
              ("corr", "unstructured"), ("exog", " ".join(exog)), ("depvar", est.depvar),
              ("eqnames", " ".join(b.name for b in blocks)), ("properties", "b V")]
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    mats = []
    if cons is not None:
        mats.append(("Cns", Matrix(np.column_stack([cons[0], cons[1]]), [str(i + 1) for i in range(len(cons[1]))],
                                   list(names) + ["_r"])))
    sig_names = [b.name for b in blocks]
    mats.append(("Sigma", Matrix(fit.sigma, sig_names, sig_names)))
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask, extra_mats=mats)
    _display_system(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _display_system(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    out = s.output
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        out.write(f"\n{est.title}\n", "text")
        bar = "-" * 74
        out.write(bar + "\n", "text")
        statcol = "F-Stat" if est.stat == "t" else "chi2"
        out.write(f'Equation             Obs   Parms        RMSE    "R-sq"{statcol:>11}{"P":>9}\n', "text")
        out.write(bar + "\n", "text")
        for nm, e in zip(est.names_eq, est.eq_info):
            if est.stat == "t":
                v = e["chi2"] / e["df"] if e["chi2"] < SYS else SYS
                p = st.f.sf(v, e["df"], est.df_r) if v < SYS else SYS
            else:
                v = e["chi2"]
                p = chi2_tail(v, e["df"]) if v < SYS else SYS
            out.write(f"{nm:<20}{int(e['obs']):>4}{int(e['parms']):>8}{g(e['rmse'], '%9.0g'):>12}"
                      f"{g(e['r2'], '%10.4f'):>10}{g(v, '%11.2f'):>11}{g(p, '%9.4f'):>9}\n", "text")
        out.write(bar + "\n", "text")
        if est.corr_opt:
            _corr_block(s, est)
        out.write("\n", "text")
        for i, t in enumerate(getattr(est, "cns_text", []), 1):      # VERIFY the place of the list
            out.write(f" ({i:>2})  {t}\n", "text")
        if getattr(est, "cns_text", []):
            out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, "", est.rows, stat=est.stat, df=est.df_r, level=lev)
        if est.foot:
            out.write(f"Endogenous variables:  {' '.join(est.foot[0])} \n", "text")
            out.write(f"Exogenous variables:   {' '.join(est.foot[1])} \n", "text")
            out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")


def _corr_block(s, est) -> None:
    out = s.output
    c = est.fit.corr
    nm = est.names_eq
    out.write("\nCorrelation matrix of residuals:\n\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 12 + "".join(f"{x[:8]:>9}" for x in nm) + "\n", "text")
    for i, x in enumerate(nm):
        out.write(f"{x[:12]:>12}" + "".join(f"{c[i, j]:>9.4f}" for j in range(i + 1)) + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"\nBreusch-Pagan test of independence: chi2({est.fit.df_bp}) = {est.fit.chi2_bp:>9.3f}, "
              f"Pr = {chi2_tail(est.fit.chi2_bp, est.fit.df_bp):.4f}\n", "text")   # VERIFY

def cmd_rreg(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "rreg", args)
        return
    from .regress import Sample
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"tune": 2, "tolerance": 3, "iterate": 2, "genwt": 3, "nolog": 4,
                                     "graph": 5, "noheader": 6, "notable": 5}, weights=())
    o = smp.o
    ds = s.data
    est_cols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    notes = fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant, np.ones(smp.n))
    X = np.column_stack([c.values for c in est_cols] + ([np.ones(smp.n)] if smp.constant else []))
    tune = float(o["tune"]) if o.get("tune") else 7.0
    tol = float(o["tolerance"]) if o.get("tolerance") else 0.01
    b, V, wts, keep, log, scale = syseq.rreg(X, smp.y, tune=tune, tol=tol)
    out = s.output
    ndrop = int((~keep).sum())
    if ndrop:
        out.write(f"\n   Cook's D > 1 dropped {ndrop} observations\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\n", "text")
        for kind, it, diff in log:
            out.write(f"{kind:>8} iteration {it}:  maximum difference in weights = {g(diff, '%9.0g').strip()}\n",
                      "text")
    if o.get("genwt"):
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        name = str(o["genwt"]).strip()
        if ds.has(name):
            raise StataError(110, f"{name} already defined")
        var = Variable(name, "double", np.full(ds.nobs, SYS))
        full = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        full[np.flatnonzero(smp.mask)] = wts
        var.data = full
        ds.add(var)
    N = int(keep.sum())
    k = X.shape[1]
    slopes = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    df_m = len(slopes)
    df_r = N - k
    F = float(b[slopes] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)], b[slopes])) / df_m if slopes else SYS
    kk = len(smp.cols) + (1 if smp.constant else 0)
    names_full = [c.name if not c.omitted else fvars.omitted_name(c.name) for c in smp.cols] \
        + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    pos = [i for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols) if c.values is not None] + ([kk - 1] if smp.constant else [])
    b_full, V_full = np.zeros(kk), np.zeros((kk, kk))
    b_full[pos] = b
    V_full[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    bmap = {c.name: b_full[i] for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {c.name: float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[i, i], 0))) for i, c in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = b_full[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(V_full[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates("rreg", smp.depname, names_full, b_full, V_full, N, "t", df_r)
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, ds, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.clustvar, est.n_clust = smp.level, "", "", None
    est.extra = {"N": N, "df_m": df_m, "df_r": df_r, "F": F}
    est.display = _display_rreg
    scalars = [("N", N), ("df_m", df_m), ("df_r", df_r), ("F", F), ("rmse", scale)]
    macros = [("cmdline", cmdline("rreg", args)), ("title", "Robust regression"), ("depvar", smp.depname),
              ("cmd", "rreg"), ("properties", "b V"), ("predict", "regres_p")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    _display_rreg(s, est, header=not o.get("noheader"), table=not o.get("notable"))


def _display_rreg(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw) -> None:
    x = est.extra
    lev = level if level is not None else est.level
    if header:
        right = [("Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
                 (_flabel(x["df_m"], x["df_r"], 3, 10), g(x["F"], "%10.2f")),
                 ("Prob > F", g(st.f.sf(x["F"], x["df_m"], x["df_r"]) if x["F"] < SYS else SYS, "%10.4f"))]
        _header(s, ["Robust regression"], right)
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=lev)

"""Treatment-effects commands: teffects (ra, ipw, ipwra, aipw, nnmatch, psmatch) and eteffects
([TE] teffects, [TE] eteffects). The estimators are in core/treatfx.py. Binary treatments only.

Layouts come from the manuals; the lines marked VERIFY wait for the Stata 14 log of case 1908."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core import treatfx as T
from .mleq import block_from_pr, block_from_text, names_in
from .models2 import _Prep
from .regress import cmdline, comma
from .results import CoefRow, Estimates, coef_table, post

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

_OMODELS = ("linear", "logit", "probit", "poisson")
_TMODELS = ("logit", "probit")
_ETMODELS = ("linear", "probit", "fractional", "exponential")


def _groups(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    """The parenthesised groups at the start of `text` and what follows them."""
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(text)
    while True:
        while i < n and text[i].isspace():
            i += 1
        if i >= n or text[i] != "(":
            return out, text[i:]
        depth, j = 0, i
        while j < n:
            depth += text[j] == "("
            depth -= text[j] == ")"
            j += 1
            if depth == 0:
                break
        out.append(text[i + 1:j - 1].strip())
        i = j


def _group(text: str, models: tuple[str, ...], default: str) -> tuple[str, str, bool]:
    """'y x1 x2, logit noconstant' -> ('y x1 x2', model, noconstant)."""
    head, _, tail = text.partition(",")
    model, noc = default, False
    for w in tail.split():
        if "noconstant".startswith(w) and len(w) >= 3:
            noc = True
        elif w in models:
            model = w
        elif w:
            raise StataError(198, f"option {w} not allowed")   # VERIFY: other models are not available
    return head.strip(), model, noc


def _level_label(s, tname, value) -> str:
    return f"{value:g}"


def _estat(o, default="ate") -> str:
    for k in ("ate", "atet", "pomeans"):
        if o.get(k):
            return k
    return default


def _effect_rows(tvar, levels, stat, mu, Vm, lv0, lv1):
    """(b, V, names, equation names, table rows) of the ATE/ATET and POmean estimates."""
    if stat == "pomeans":
        L = np.eye(2)
        b = mu.copy()
        names = [f"0.{tvar}", f"1.{tvar}"] if levels[0] == 0 and levels[1] == 1 else [f"{lv0}.{tvar}", f"{lv1}.{tvar}"]
        eq = ["POmeans", "POmeans"]
    else:
        L = np.array([[-1.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.0]])
        b = L @ mu
        names = [f"r{lv1}vs{lv0}.{tvar}", f"{lv0}.{tvar}"]
        eq = ["ATE" if stat == "ate" else "ATET", "POmean"]
    V = L @ Vm @ L.T
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
    if stat == "pomeans":
        rows = [CoefRow("eq", "POmeans"), CoefRow("header", tvar),
                CoefRow("coef", f"{lv0} ", b[0], se[0], name=names[0]),
                CoefRow("coef", f"{lv1} ", b[1], se[1], name=names[1])]
    else:
        rows = [CoefRow("eq", eq[0]), CoefRow("header", tvar),
                CoefRow("coef", f"({lv1} vs {lv0}) ", b[0], se[0], name=names[0]),
                CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("eq", "POmean"), CoefRow("header", tvar),
                CoefRow("coef", f"{lv0} ", b[1], se[1], name=names[1])]
    return b, V, names, eq, rows


def _effect_rows_multi(tvar, labels, ci, stat, mu, Vm):
    """_effect_rows for L treatment levels: the effects of each level against the control ci (and
    its POmean), or the L POmeans."""
    L = len(mu)
    if stat == "pomeans":
        M_ = np.eye(L)
        names = [f"{lb}.{tvar}" for lb in labels]
        eq = ["POmeans"] * L
    else:
        others = [l for l in range(L) if l != ci]
        M_ = np.zeros((L, L))
        for r, l in enumerate(others):
            M_[r, l], M_[r, ci] = 1.0, -1.0
        M_[L - 1, ci] = 1.0
        names = [f"r{labels[l]}vs{labels[ci]}.{tvar}" for l in others] + [f"{labels[ci]}.{tvar}"]
        eq = ["ATE" if stat == "ate" else "ATET"] * (L - 1) + ["POmean"]
    b = M_ @ mu
    V = M_ @ Vm @ M_.T
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
    if stat == "pomeans":
        rows = [CoefRow("eq", "POmeans"), CoefRow("header", tvar)]
        rows += [CoefRow("coef", f"{labels[l]} ", b[l], se[l], name=names[l]) for l in range(L)]
    else:
        rows = [CoefRow("eq", eq[0]), CoefRow("header", tvar)]
        rows += [CoefRow("coef", f"({labels[l]} vs {labels[ci]}) ", b[r], se[r], name=names[r])
                 for r, l in enumerate(others)]

def _et_aux(th, Vf, k1, Xo, Z, t, b, V, names, eq, ovar, tvar, omv, tmv):
    """e(b) and e(V) of eteffects with the auxiliary equations: the outcome equations of each arm
    (OME0, OME1), the treatment probit (TME1) and the coefficients of the residual in each arm
    (TEOM0, TEOM1: VERIFY names and order). The probit block of e(V) is its inverse information,
    with no covariance with the rest (the variance takes it as known)."""
    from scipy import stats
    ko = Xo.shape[1]
    xn = omv.split() + ["_cons"]
    zn = tmv.split() + ["_cons"]
    c0, c1, g = th[2:2 + k1], th[2 + k1:2 + 2 * k1], th[2 + 2 * k1:]
    bb = list(b) + list(c0[:ko]) + list(c1[:ko]) + list(g) + [c0[-1], c1[-1]]
    nm = list(names) + xn + xn + zn + [tvar, tvar]
    eqs = list(eq) + ["OME0"] * ko + ["OME1"] * ko + ["TME1"] * len(zn) + ["TEOM0", "TEOM1"]
    m = len(bb)
    Vb = np.zeros((m, m))
    Vb[:2, :2] = V
    # arms: from the sandwich (mu0, mu1, c0, c1); the first two rows are the reported effects
    sel = list(range(2, 2 + 2 * k1))
    pos = list(range(2, 2 + ko)) + [m - 2] + list(range(2 + ko, 2 + 2 * ko)) + [m - 1]
    Vb[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = Vf[np.ix_(sel, sel)]
    e = Z @ g
    F = np.clip(stats.norm.cdf(e), 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    f = stats.norm.pdf(e)
    info = (Z * (f * f / (F * (1 - F)))[:, None]).T @ Z
    zp = list(range(2 + 2 * ko, 2 + 2 * ko + len(zn)))
    Vb[np.ix_(zp, zp)] = np.linalg.inv(info)
    return nm, np.array(bb), Vb, eqs

def _run(s, cmd, sub, rest, full):

        head, omodel, onoc = _group(groups[0], omodels, oden)
        ovar, _, omv = head.partition(" ")
        omv = omv.strip()

    tvar, _, tmv = thead.partition(" ")
    tmv = tmv.strip()
    if cmd == "eteffects" and tmodel != "probit":
        raise StataError(198, "the treatment model of eteffects is probit")   # VERIFY

            "metric": 3, "aequations": 4, "osample": 3, "logit": 4, "probit": 4, "vce": 3,

    pr.write_notes(s.output)
    o = pr.o
    stat = _estat(o)
    if match and stat == "pomeans":
        raise StataError(198, "option pomeans not allowed")

    est_title = {"ra": "regression adjustment", "ipw": "inverse-probability weights",
                 "ipwra": "IPW regression adjustment", "aipw": "augmented IPW",
                 "nnmatch": "nearest-neighbor matching", "psmatch": "propensity-score matching",
                 "": "extended regression"}[sub]

    et_aux = None

        if sub == "psmatch":
            zb = T.glm_fit(tmodel, Z, t)
            X = T._mean(tmodel, Z @ zb)[0][:, None]
            metric = "euclidean"
        else:
            X = Xo
            m_ = str(o.get("metric", "maha")).lower()

        omodel_txt = {"ipw": "weighted mean", "aipw": "linear by ML"}.get(sub, omodel)

        tmodel_txt = tmodel if sub not in ("ra",) else "none"
        dist = ""
    title = "Endogenous treatment-effects estimation" if cmd == "eteffects" else "Treatment-effects estimation"
    _post(s, cmd, sub, full, ovar, tvar, levels, stat, names, b, V, eq, rows, n, level, mask, o, title=title,
          est_title=est_title, omodel_txt=omodel_txt, tmodel_txt=tmodel_txt, match=match, extra_hdr=extra_hdr,
          dist=dist, et_aux=et_aux, nt=float(t.sum()))

def _level_option(o, key, levels, default):

                              f"but {len(levels)} were found")   # compat 1925 (VERIFY: return code)

                 "ipwra": "IPW regression adjustment", "aipw": "augmented IPW"}[sub]
    omodel_txt = {"ipw": "weighted mean", "aipw": "linear by ML"}.get(sub, omodel)
    tmodel_txt = "(multinomial) logit" if sub != "ra" else "none"     # VERIFY
    # e(b) and e(V) with every parameter: the effects, the outcome equations OME0, OME1, ... and the
    # multinomial logit TME1, TME2, ... (compat 1925: 1 x 9 for ra with one regressor; VERIFY the
