_SMODELS = ("exponential", "weibull", "lognormal")


def _surv_outcome(name, t, t0, d):
    """LikOutcome of a streg distribution fitted to the potential-outcome mean survival time."""
    from scipy.special import gamma as gfun
    from .streg import DISTS
    dist = DISTS[name]
    lf = dist.loglik(t, t0, d, False)
    rate = float(np.sum(d) / np.sum(t - t0))
    start = dist.start(rate, False)
    if name == "exponential":
        return T.LikOutcome(lf, lambda eta, th: np.exp(-eta), 0, start)
    if name == "weibull":
        return T.LikOutcome(lf, lambda eta, th: np.exp(-eta / np.exp(th)) * gfun(1 + 1 / np.exp(th)), 1, start)
    return T.LikOutcome(lf, lambda u, th: np.exp(u + np.exp(2 * th) / 2), 1, start)

def _design(s, stx, tvar, tmv, noc):
    """Treatment-model design (with the constant) on the sample of an STSample."""
    from . import fvars
    ds = s.data
    with fvars.caching():
        terms = fvars.expand_fv(ds, tmv) if tmv.strip() else []
        cols = fvars.build_design(ds, terms, stx.mask, constant=not noc)
    fvars.drop_collinear(cols, not noc, stx.w)
    free = [c.values for c in cols if c.values is not None]
    parts = free + ([np.ones(stx.n)] if not noc else [])
    return np.column_stack(parts)

        noc = "noconstant".startswith(tail.split()[0]) if tail.split() else False
    head, sep, opts = args.partition(",")
    return f"{head.strip()} {tname}{sep}{opts}", tname, zvars, noc, o

def cmd_etregress(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    if _replay(s, "etregress", args):
        return
    pr, y, t, main, trt, tname, o = _setup(s, args, {"treat": 3, "twostep": 3})
    w = pr.w
    n = len(y)
    if o.get("twostep"):
        return _twostep(s, args, pr, y, t, main, trt, tname)

    def lik(etas, th):
        ll, d_eta, d_zeta, d_ath, d_ls = L.etreg(t, y, etas[0], etas[1], th[0], th[1])
        return ll, [d_eta, d_zeta], np.column_stack([d_ath, d_ls])

    eng = Engine(lik, [main, trt], w, 2)
    rp = _weighted_probit(t, trt.X, w)
    sw = np.sqrt(w)
    bo = np.linalg.lstsq(main.X * sw[:, None], y * sw, rcond=None)[0]
    rss = float(np.sum(w * (y - main.X @ bo) ** 2))
    n1 = float(w.sum())
    b0 = np.concatenate([bo, rp.b, [0.0, 0.5 * np.log(rss / n1)]])
    res = pr.maximize(eng.fun, b0)

    V, n_clust = pr.vce(res.H, eng.scores(res.b) if pr.robust else None)
    ath, lns = float(res.b[-2]), float(res.b[-1])
    V2 = V[-2:, -2:]
    ll_ols = -0.5 * n1 * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + 1 + np.log(rss / n1))
    lr = max(2 * (res.ll - (rp.ll + ll_ols)), 0.0)
    p_lr = _chi2p(lr, 1)

    p_w = _chi2p(w_rho, 1)

                transformed_row("rho", np.tanh, lambda x: 1 - np.tanh(x) ** 2, ath, float(np.sqrt(V[-2, -2])), level),

                       blocks=[main, trt], eng=eng, res=res, V=V, n_clust=n_clust, ll0=SYS,

                       depvar_cell="", footer=footer, wald=True, k_eq=4, test_idx=list(range(main.nslopes)),

def _predict(what, etas, th, est):
    if what == "xb":
        return etas[0]
    if what == "xbtrt":
        return etas[1]
    if what in ("ptrt", "pr"):
        return st.norm.cdf(etas[1])

def _twostep(s, args, pr, y, t, main, trt, tname):
    """Two-step estimates: probit for the treatment, then OLS of the outcome on the covariates and
    the hazard (Maddala 1983; Greene). VERIFY: variance and sigma formulas."""
    from .ml import MLResult
    if pr.smp.wtype:
        raise StataError(101, "weights not allowed")   # VERIFY
    n = len(y)
    ps = _weighted_probit(t, trt.X, np.ones(n))
    Vg = np.linalg.inv(-ps.H)
    zg = trt.X @ ps.b
    q = 2 * t - 1
    lam = q * np.exp(st.norm.logpdf(zg) - st.norm.logcdf(q * zg))
    delta = lam * (lam + zg)
    Xs = np.column_stack([main.X, lam])
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(Xs, y, rcond=None)[0]
    beta, theta = coef[:-1], coef[-1]
    e = y - Xs @ coef
    sig2 = float(e @ e / n + theta ** 2 * delta.mean())
    sig = float(np.sqrt(sig2))
    rho = float(np.clip(theta / sig, -1.0, 1.0))
    XtXi = np.linalg.inv(Xs.T @ Xs)
    Fm = Xs.T @ (trt.X * delta[:, None])
    mid = Xs.T @ (Xs * (1 - rho ** 2 * delta)[:, None]) + rho ** 2 * Fm @ Vg @ Fm.T
    Vs = sig2 * XtXi @ mid @ XtXi
    k1, k2 = main.k, trt.k
    b_all = np.concatenate([beta, ps.b, [theta]])
    V_all = np.zeros((k1 + k2 + 1, k1 + k2 + 1))
    pos = list(range(k1)) + [k1 + k2]
    V_all[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = Vs
    V_all[k1:k1 + k2, k1:k1 + k2] = Vg
    res = MLResult(b_all, SYS, np.zeros(len(b_all)), np.zeros((len(b_all), len(b_all))), 0, True, [])
    se_l = float(np.sqrt(Vs[-1, -1]))

    def aux_rows(level):
        return [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("eq", "hazard"), CoefRow("coef", "lambda", theta, se_l, name="lambda"),
                CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("value", "rho", rho, eq=f"{rho:.5f}"),
                CoefRow("value", "sigma", sig, eq=g(sig, "%10.8g"))]

    def hdr(est):
        x = est.extra
        def write(s_):
            o_ = s_.output
            o_.write("\n", "text")
            for lft, lb, val in (("Linear regression with endogenous treatment", "Number of obs", comma(x["N"])),
                                 ("Estimator: two-step", f"Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g(x["chi2"], "%10.2f")),
                                 ("", "Prob > chi2", g(x["p"], "%10.4f"))):
                o_.write(f"{lft:<48}{lb:<19}=", "text")
                o_.write(f"{val:>10}\n", "result")
            o_.write("\n", "text")
        return write

    eng = Engine(lambda e_, th: (np.zeros(n), [np.zeros(n)], None), [main], np.ones(n), 0)
    order = (["N", "df_m", "chi2", "p", "rho", "sigma", "lambda"],
             ["cmdline", "cmd", "title", "chi2type", "vce", "depvar", "properties"], [])
    est = finish_model(s, pr, "etregress", args, title="Linear regression with endogenous treatment",
                       blocks=[main, trt], eng=eng, res=res, V=V_all, n_clust=None, ll0=SYS,
                       aux_names=[("hazard", "lambda")], aux_rows_fn=aux_rows, hdr_fn=hdr, depvar_cell="",
                       wald=True, k_eq=3, test_idx=list(range(main.nslopes)) + [main.k + trt.k], order=order,
                       extra_scalars=[("rho", rho), ("sigma", sig), ("lambda", theta)],
                       predict_opts={"xbtrt": 4, "ptrt": 4})
    est.predict = make_predict(_predict, "xb")
    est.pred_label = "fitted values"
    display_eq(s, est)

"""Time-series models and tests: arima, var, varsoc, vargranger, dfuller,
corrgram and newey ([TS] arima, [TS] var, [TS] varsoc, [TS] vargranger,
[TS] dfuller, [TS] corrgram, [TS] newey).

space form, stationary initial covariance), ar() and ma() lag lists or
arima(p,d,q); OPG variance by default, as in Stata. Stata optimizes with
BHHH and then BFGS (technique(bhhh 5 bfgs 10)), as OpenDTA does; the step
sizes are documented only in outline (VERIFY: compat/do/1101_ts.do).

def _scores(contrib, b: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Observation scores by central differences of the log-likelihood contributions."""
    kk = b.size
    c0 = contrib(b)
    S = np.zeros((len(c0) if c0 is not None else 0, kk))
    for j in range(kk):
        h = 1e-6 * (abs(b[j]) + 1)
        e = np.zeros(kk)
        e[j] = h
        cp, cm = contrib(b + e), contrib(b - e)
        if cp is None or cm is None:
            cp = contrib(b + e / 100)
            cm = contrib(b - e / 100)
            h = h / 100
        S[:, j] = (cp - cm) / (2 * h)
    return S


def _lags(text) -> list[int]:
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []

class _ARMA:
    def __init__(self, ar: list[int], ma: list[int], *, cond: bool = False, diffuse: bool = False):
        self.ar, self.ma = ar, ma
        self.cond, self.diffuse = cond, diffuse
        self.P = max(ar) if ar else 0
        self.Q = max(ma) if ma else 0
        self.r = max(self.P, self.Q + 1)

    def contributions(self, e: np.ndarray, phi: np.ndarray, theta: np.ndarray, sigma: float):
        """Log likelihood of each observation by the Kalman filter (None if not stationary)."""
        r = self.r
        if sigma <= 0:
            return None
        if self.cond:
            return self._conditional(e, phi, theta, sigma)
        T = np.zeros((r, r))
        for lag, c in zip(self.ar, phi):
            T[lag - 1, 0] = c
        if r > 1:
            T[:-1, 1:] += np.eye(r - 1)
        R = np.zeros(r)
        R[0] = 1.0
        for lag, c in zip(self.ma, theta):
            R[lag] = c
        if self.P and np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(T))) >= 1:
            return None
        RR = np.outer(R, R) * sigma ** 2
        try:
            Pm = np.eye(r) * 1e9 if self.diffuse else linalg.solve_discrete_lyapunov(T, RR)   # kappa = 1e9 reproduces the reference log of case 1904
        except (np.linalg.LinAlgError, ValueError):
            return None
        a = np.zeros(r)
        out = np.empty(len(e))
        pred = np.empty(len(e))
        for t, y in enumerate(e):
            F = Pm[0, 0]
            if F <= 0:
                return None
            v = y - a[0]
            pred[t] = a[0]
            out[t] = -0.5 * (math.log(2 * math.pi) + math.log(F) + v * v / F)
            K = T @ Pm[:, 0] / F
            a = T @ a + K * v
            Pm = T @ Pm @ T.T - np.outer(K, K) * F + RR
        self.pred = pred
        return out

    def _conditional(self, e: np.ndarray, phi: np.ndarray, theta: np.ndarray, sigma: float):
        """Conditional likelihood: the presample values of the innovations and of y - xb are zero and
        no observation is dropped (reproduces the reference log of case 1904)."""
        n = len(e)
        eps = np.zeros(n)
        pred = np.zeros(n)
        for t in range(n):
            m = sum(c * e[t - lag] for lag, c in zip(self.ar, phi) if t - lag >= 0)
            m += sum(c * eps[t - lag] for lag, c in zip(self.ma, theta) if t - lag >= 0)
            pred[t] = m
            eps[t] = e[t] - m
        self.pred = pred
        return -0.5 * (math.log(2 * math.pi * sigma ** 2) + eps ** 2 / sigma ** 2)


def _expand_seasonal(phi, theta, sphi, stheta, ar, ma, sar, sma, period):
    """Coefficients (and their lags) of the multiplicative ARMA: (1 - phi(L))(1 - Phi(L^s)) and
    (1 + theta(L))(1 + Theta(L^s)). Returns (ar_lags, phi_full, ma_lags, theta_full)."""
    pa = max(ar + [lg * period for lg in sar] + [0])
    pm = max(ma + [lg * period for lg in sma] + [0])
    A = np.zeros(pa + 1); A[0] = 1.0
    for lag, c in zip(ar, phi):
        A[lag] -= c
    SA = np.zeros(pa + 1); SA[0] = 1.0
    for lag, c in zip(sar, sphi):
        SA[lag * period] -= c
    Af = np.convolve(A[:max(ar + [0]) + 1], SA[:max([lg * period for lg in sar] + [0]) + 1])
    M_ = np.zeros(pm + 1); M_[0] = 1.0
    for lag, c in zip(ma, theta):
        M_[lag] += c
    SM = np.zeros(pm + 1); SM[0] = 1.0
    for lag, c in zip(sma, stheta):
        SM[lag * period] += c
    Mf = np.convolve(M_[:max(ma + [0]) + 1], SM[:max([lg * period for lg in sma] + [0]) + 1])
    ar_l = list(range(1, len(Af)))
    ma_l = list(range(1, len(Mf)))
    return ar_l, -Af[1:], ma_l, Mf[1:]


def _hr_start(e: np.ndarray, ar: list[int], ma: list[int]) -> np.ndarray:
    """Starting values of the ARMA coefficients and of sigma by the Hannan-Rissanen regressions:
    a long autoregression gives the innovations, then e is regressed on its lags and the lagged
    innovations. VERIFY: Stata's starting values are undocumented (they match for pure AR)."""
    na, nm = len(ar), len(ma)
    if not na and not nm:
        return np.zeros(0), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e * e)))
    n = len(e)
    m = min(max(8, (max(ar) if ar else 0) + (max(ma) if ma else 0)), max(n // 4, 1))
    a = np.zeros(n)
    if nm:
        Z = np.column_stack([e[m - j:n - j] for j in range(1, m + 1)])
        c, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, e[m:], rcond=None)
        a[m:] = e[m:] - Z @ c
    start = max([m if nm else 0] + [lg for lg in ar] + [m + lg for lg in ma])
    if start >= n - (na + nm) - 2:
        return np.zeros(na + nm), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(e * e)))
    Z = np.column_stack([e[start - lg:n - lg] for lg in ar] + [a[start - lg:n - lg] for lg in ma])
    c, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, e[start:], rcond=None)
    u = e[start:] - Z @ c
    # sigma: root mean square of the residuals of that regression (compat 1101: with it, the
    # iteration 0 of arima y, ar(1 2) is Stata's)
    # keep the start inside the stationary and invertible region
    return np.clip(c, -0.95, 0.95), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(u * u)))


def cmd_arima(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:

    sar, sma, period = [], [], 0
    if isinstance(o.get("sarima"), str):
        nums = [int(float(v)) for v in o["sarima"].replace(",", " ").split()]
        if len(nums) != 4 or nums[3] < 1:
            raise StataError(198, "sarima() invalid")   # VERIFY
        pp_, dd_, qq_, period = nums
        sar, sma = list(range(1, pp_ + 1)), list(range(1, qq_ + 1))
        if dd_:
            pre = (f"S{period}." if period > 1 else "S.") * dd_
            toks = [pre + t if not t.startswith(("i.", "c.")) else t for t in toks]
    for key, dest in (("mar", "sar"), ("mma", "sma")):
        if isinstance(o.get(key), str):
            lst, _c, per = o[key].rpartition(",")
            if not _c:
                raise StataError(198, f"{key}() invalid")   # VERIFY
            if period and int(float(per)) != period:
                raise StataError(198, "seasonal periods differ")   # VERIFY
            period = int(float(per))
            (sar if dest == "sar" else sma).extend(x for x in _lags(lst) if x not in (sar if dest == "sar" else sma))
    sar.sort(); sma.sort()
    rest_opts = " ".join(f"{k}({v})" if isinstance(v, str) else k for k, v in o.items()
                         if k in ("noconstant", "level", "vce", "robust"))
    text = " ".join(toks)
    if p.if_:
        text += f" if {p.if_}"
    if p.in_:
        text += f" in {p.in_}"
    smp = Sample(s, text + (f", {rest_opts}" if rest_opts else ""),
                 opts_spec={"noconstant": 4}, weights=())
    t0, t1 = _check_gaps(s, smp.mask)
    fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant)
    est_cols = [col for col in smp.cols if col.values is not None]
    n = smp.n
    X = np.column_stack([col.values for col in est_cols] + ([np.ones(n)] if smp.constant else [])) \
        if (est_cols or smp.constant) else np.zeros((n, 0))
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    order = np.argsort(s.data.get(info.tvar).data[smp.mask], kind="stable")
    X = X[order]
    y = smp.y.astype(float)[order]
    k = X.shape[1]
    na, nm, nsa, nsm = len(ar), len(ma), len(sar), len(sma)
    seasonal = bool(nsa or nsm)
    if seasonal:
        ar_f, _x, ma_f, _y = _expand_seasonal([0] * na, [0] * nm, [0] * nsa, [0] * nsm, ar, ma, sar, sma, period)
    else:
        ar_f, ma_f = ar, ma
    arma = _ARMA(ar_f, ma_f, cond=bool(o.get("condition")), diffuse=bool(o.get("diffuse")))

    def expand(b):
        """Coefficients of the (multiplicative) ARMA polynomials from the parameter vector."""
        ph, th = b[k:k + na], b[k + na:k + na + nm]
        if not seasonal:
            return ph, th
        sph, sth = b[k + na + nm:k + na + nm + nsa], b[k + na + nm + nsa:k + na + nm + nsa + nsm]
        _a, phf, _m, thf = _expand_seasonal(ph, th, sph, sth, ar, ma, sar, sma, period)
        return phf, thf

    def contrib(b):
        phf, thf = expand(b)
        return arma.contributions(y - X @ b[:k], phf, thf, b[-1])

    def ll(b):
        c_ = contrib(b)
        return -np.inf if c_ is None else float(c_.sum())

    def fun(b, todo):
        if todo == 0:
            return ll(b), None, None
        return _numderiv(ll, b)

    beta0 = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0] if k else np.zeros(0)
    res0 = y - X @ beta0
    arma0, sig0 = _hr_start(res0, ar + [lg * period for lg in sar], ma + [lg * period for lg in sma])
    if seasonal:
        # regression order: ar, seasonal ar, ma, seasonal ma -> ar, ma, seasonal ar, seasonal ma
        arma0 = np.concatenate([arma0[:na], arma0[na + nsa:na + nsa + nm], arma0[na:na + nsa],
                                arma0[na + nsa + nm:]])
    b0 = np.concatenate([beta0, arma0, [sig0 or float(np.std(res0)) or 1.0]])
    if not np.isfinite(ll(b0)):
        b0 = np.concatenate([beta0, np.zeros(na + nm + nsa + nsm), [float(np.std(res0)) or 1.0]])
    r = maximize_switching(ll, lambda bb: _scores(contrib, bb), b0, **ml_options(o))
    # the estimates are those of the last iteration, as in Stata (compat 1101: with the same
    # starting values the BHHH log and the estimates match); the variance needs the Hessian there
    _llm, _gm, Hm = _numderiv(ll, r.b)
    r.H = Hm
    out = s.output
    vce = str(o.get("vce") or ("robust" if o.get("robust") else "opg")).strip().lower()
    vce = "robust" if vce.startswith("r") else ("oim" if vce == "oim" else "opg")
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\n", "text")
        print_log(out, r, "log likelihood")
    b = r.b
    kk = b.size
    S = _scores(contrib, b)
    try:
        Hinv = np.linalg.inv(-r.H)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        Hinv = np.linalg.pinv(-r.H)
    if vce == "opg":
        V = np.linalg.inv(S.T @ S)
    elif vce == "oim":
        V = Hinv
    else:
        V = Hinv @ (S.T @ S) @ Hinv
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    # Wald test: everything except the constant and sigma
    idx = [i for i in range(kk - 1) if not (smp.constant and i == k - 1)]
    try:
        chi2 = float(b[idx] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(idx, idx)], b[idx])) if idx else SYS
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        chi2 = SYS
    pv = float(chi2_tail(chi2, len(idx))) if idx and chi2 < SYS else SYS
    base = smp.depcomp.name if hasattr(smp.depcomp, "name") else smp.depname.split(".")[-1]
    eqname = smp.depname.split(".")[-1]
    seq = f"ARMA{period}"
    names = [col.name for col in est_cols] + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else []) + \
        [f"L{l}.ar" if l > 1 else "L.ar" for l in ar] + [f"L{l}.ma" if l > 1 else "L.ma" for l in ma] + \
        [f"L{l}.ar" if l > 1 else "L.ar" for l in sar] + [f"L{l}.ma" if l > 1 else "L.ma" for l in sma] + ["_cons"]
    eqs = [eqname] * k + ["ARMA"] * (na + nm) + [seq] * (nsa + nsm) + ["sigma"]
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
    bmap = {col.name: b[i] for i, col in enumerate(est_cols)}
    semap = {col.name: se[i] for i, col in enumerate(est_cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = b[k - 1], se[k - 1]
    rows = []
    if k:
        rows.append(CoefRow("eq", eqname))
        rows += rows_from_columns([col for col in smp.cols if col.values is not None], bmap, semap, s.data,
                                  constant=smp.constant)
        rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    if na + nm:
        rows.append(CoefRow("eq", "ARMA"))
        j = k
        for lab, lags in (("ar", ar), ("ma", ma)):
            if not lags:
                continue
            if rows[-1].kind != "eq":
                rows.append(CoefRow("blank"))
            rows.append(CoefRow("header", lab))
            for l in lags:
                rows.append(CoefRow("coef", f"L{l}.", b[j], se[j], name=f"ARMA:L{l}.{lab}"))
                j += 1
        rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    if nsa + nsm:
        rows.append(CoefRow("eq", seq))
        j = k + na + nm
        for lab, lags in (("ar", sar), ("ma", sma)):
            if not lags:
                continue
            if rows[-1].kind != "eq":
                rows.append(CoefRow("blank"))
            rows.append(CoefRow("header", lab))
            for l in lags:
                rows.append(CoefRow("coef", f"L{l}.", b[j], se[j], name=f"{seq}:L{l}.{lab}"))
                j += 1
        rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    rows.append(CoefRow("coef", "/sigma", b[-1], se[-1], name="sigma:_cons", zero_lo=True))
    est = Estimates("arima", smp.depname, names, b, V, n, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = eqs
    est.rows = rows
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") else smp.level
    est.vcetype = {"opg": "OPG", "robust": "Semirobust", "oim": "OIM"}[vce]
    est.robust = vce == "robust"
    est.extra = {"N": float(n), "ll": r.ll, "chi2": chi2, "p": pv, "df_m": len(idx),
                 "sample": _sample_text(s, t0, t1), "cond": bool(o.get("condition"))}
    if o.get("condition"):     # VERIFY: Stata reports sigma2 (not sigma) and the ARCH-style header
        rows[-1] = CoefRow("coef", "/SIGMA2", b[-1] ** 2, 2 * abs(b[-1]) * se[-1], name="sigma:_cons")
    est.arima = {"arma": arma, "k": k, "ar": ar, "ma": ma, "order": order, "mask": smp.mask.copy(),
                 "expand": expand}
    est.display = display_arima
    est.predict = _predict_arima
    est.predict_opts = {"y": 1, "mse": 3, "structural": 6}
    scalars = [("N", float(n)), ("k", float(kk)), ("k_eq", float(1 + (na + nm > 0) + (nsa + nsm > 0) + 1)),
               ("k_dv", 1.0), ("ll", r.ll), ("chi2", chi2), ("p", pv), ("df_m", float(len(idx))),
               ("sigma", float(b[-1])), ("tmin", t0), ("tmax", t1), ("ar_max", float(arma.P)),
               ("ma_max", float(arma.Q)), ("rank", float(kk)), ("ic", float(r.iterations)),
               ("converged", 1.0 if r.converged else 0.0)]
    macros = [("cmd", "arima"), ("cmdline", cmdline("arima", args)), ("depvar", smp.depname),
              ("eqnames", " ".join(dict.fromkeys(eqs))), ("title", "ARIMA regression"),
              ("ar", " ".join(map(str, ar))), ("ma", " ".join(map(str, ma))), ("vce", vce),
              ("vcetype", est.vcetype), ("chi2type", "Wald"), ("tvar", info.tvar),
              ("predict", "arima_p"), ("properties", "b V")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    del base
    display_arima(s, est)


def display_arima(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
                  level: float | None = None, **_kw) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    cond = x.get("cond")
    if header and cond:
        from .archmodel import _right_arch
        out.write("\nTime-series regression -- ARMA disturbances\n\n", "text")
        _right_arch(out, x["sample"].replace("Sample:  ", "Sample: "), "Number of obs", f"{int(x['N']):,}")
        _right_arch(out, "Distribution: Gaussian", f"Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g9(x["chi2"], "%10.2f"))
        _right_arch(out, f"Log likelihood = {g9(x['ll'], '%9.0g')}", "Prob > chi2", g9(x["p"], "%10.4f"))
        out.write("\n", "text")
    elif header:
        out.write("\nARIMA regression\n\n", "text")
        _right(out, x["sample"], "Number of obs", f"{int(x['N']):,}")
        _right(out, "", f"Wald chi2({int(x['df_m'])})", g9(x["chi2"], "%10.2f"))
        _right(out, f"Log likelihood = {g9(x['ll'], '%9.0g')}", "Prob > chi2", g9(x["p"], "%10.4f"))
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="z", df=None, level=level or est.level,
                   vcetype=est.vcetype)
        if cond:
            return
        out.write("Note: The test of the variance against zero is one sided, and the two-sided\n"
                  "      confidence interval is truncated at zero.\n", "text")


def _predict_arima(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    """One-step predictions of the (differenced) dependent variable over the estimation sample."""
    A = est.arima
    ds = s.data
    k = A["k"]
    b = est.b
    rows = np.nonzero(A["mask"])[0][A["order"]]
    from .postest import xb_all
    xb_full, ok = xb_all(s, _fixed_part(est, k))
    yv = fvars.comp_values(ds, est.depcomp).astype(float)
    e = yv[rows] - xb_full[rows]
    arma = A["arma"]
    phf, thf = A["expand"](b)
    c = arma.contributions(e, phf, thf, b[-1])
    if c is None:
        raise StataError(498, "prediction failed")   # VERIFY
    pred = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
    pred[rows] = xb_full[rows] + arma.pred
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        note = "" if stat else "(option xb assumed; predicted values)"   # VERIFY
        if stat == "" and False:
            pass
        return pred, note
    if stat == "residuals":
        r = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        r[rows] = yv[rows] - pred[rows]
        return r, ""
    if stat == "structural":
        return np.where(ok, xb_full, SYS), ""
    if stat == "y":
        name = est.depvar
        if not name.startswith("D"):
            return pred, ""
        from .tsops import shift
        base = name.split(".", 1)[1]
        lagged = shift(ds, ds.get(base).data.astype(float), 1)
        return np.where((pred < SYS) & (lagged < SYS), pred + lagged, SYS), ""
    raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")


def _fixed_part(est: Estimates, k: int) -> Estimates:
    e2 = Estimates(est.cmd, est.depvar, est.names[:k], est.b[:k], est.V[:k, :k], est.N)
    e2.cols, e2.constant, e2.terms = est.cols, est.constant, est.terms
    return e2

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Fuller (1976), Table 8.5.2, by sample size 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, infinity
_FULLER_N = [25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1e12]
_FULLER = {
    "n": {1: [-2.66, -2.62, -2.60, -2.58, -2.58, -2.58], 5: [-1.95] * 6,
          10: [-1.60, -1.61, -1.61, -1.62, -1.62, -1.62]},
    "c": {1: [-3.75, -3.58, -3.51, -3.46, -3.44, -3.43], 5: [-3.00, -2.93, -2.89, -2.88, -2.87, -2.86],
          10: [-2.63, -2.60, -2.58, -2.57, -2.57, -2.57]},
    "ct": {1: [-4.38, -4.15, -4.04, -3.99, -3.98, -3.96], 5: [-3.60, -3.50, -3.45, -3.43, -3.42, -3.41],
           10: [-3.24, -3.18, -3.15, -3.13, -3.13, -3.12]},
}
# MacKinnon (1994), Tables 3 and 4: approximate asymptotic p-values of the tau statistic
# (one variable), p = Phi(polynomial in tau)
_MK = {"n": (-1.04, -19.04, np.inf, [0.6344, 1.2378, 3.2496e-2], [0.4797, 9.3557e-1, -0.6999e-1, 3.3066e-2]),
       "c": (-1.61, -18.83, 2.74, [2.1659, 1.4412, 3.8269e-2], [1.7339, 9.3202e-1, -1.2745e-1, -1.0368e-2]),
       "ct": (-2.89, -16.18, 0.7, [3.2512, 1.6047, 4.9588e-2], [2.5261, 6.1654e-1, -3.7956e-1, -6.0285e-2])}


def mackinnon_p(tau: float, kind: str) -> float:
    star, mn, mx, small, large = _MK[kind]
    if tau > mx:
        return 1.0
    if tau < mn:
        return 0.0
    coef = small if tau <= star else large
    return float(st.norm.cdf(sum(c * tau ** i for i, c in enumerate(coef))))


def _fuller_crit(kind: str, n: int) -> list[float]:
    out = []
    for lev in (1, 5, 10):
        vals = _FULLER[kind][lev]
        if n <= _FULLER_N[0]:
            out.append(vals[0])
            continue
        for i in range(len(_FULLER_N) - 1):
            a, b_ = _FULLER_N[i], _FULLER_N[i + 1]
            if n <= b_:
                if b_ >= 1e12:
                    out.append(vals[i])      # VERIFY: beyond 500 Stata uses the 500 row?
                else:
                    out.append(vals[i] + (n - a) / (b_ - a) * (vals[i + 1] - vals[i]))
                break
    return out


def cmd_dfuller(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    from .tsops import shift
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"noconstant": 4, "trend": 3, "drift": 3, "regress": 3, "lags": 3}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if names else 102, "too many variables specified" if names else "too few variables specified")
    ds = s.data
    yv = ds.get(names[0]).data.astype(float)
    L1 = shift(ds, yv, 1)
    dy = np.where((yv < SYS) & (L1 < SYS), yv - L1, SYS)
    lags = int(o["lags"]) if o.get("lags") else 0
    cols, cn = [L1], [f"L1.{names[0]}"]
    for k in range(1, lags + 1):
        cols.append(shift(ds, dy, k))
        cn.append(f"L{k}D.{names[0]}")
    info = require_ts(ds)
    if o.get("trend"):
        # the trend counts periods from the first observation of the series (compat 1101: with
        # t = 1, 2, ... Stata's _trend is t - 1; VERIFY when the series starts later)
        tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
        have = touse(s, p) & (yv < SYS)
        t_first = float(tv[have].min()) if have.any() else 0.0
        cols.append((tv - t_first) / (info.delta or 1.0))
        cn.append("_trend")
    X = np.column_stack(cols)
    ok = touse(s, p) & (dy < SYS) & np.all(X < SYS, axis=1)
    constant = not o.get("noconstant")
    Xo = X[ok]
    if constant:
        Xo = np.column_stack([Xo, np.ones(int(ok.sum()))])
        cn.append("_cons")
    yo = dy[ok]
    n, k = Xo.shape
    b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xo, yo, rcond=None)
    e = yo - Xo @ b
    s2 = float(e @ e) / (n - k)
    V = s2 * np.linalg.inv(Xo.T @ Xo)
    tau = float(b[0] / math.sqrt(V[0, 0]))
    kind = "ct" if o.get("trend") else ("n" if not constant else "c")
    out = s.output
    title = "Augmented Dickey-Fuller test for unit root" if lags else "Dickey-Fuller test for unit root"
    out.write(f"\n{title:<51}Number of obs   = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{n:>9,}\n\n", "result")
    if o.get("drift"):
        crit = [float(st.t.ppf(a, n - k)) for a in (0.01, 0.05, 0.10)]
        head = "Z(t) has t-distribution"
    else:
        crit = _fuller_crit(kind, n)
        head = "Interpolated Dickey-Fuller"
    nd = 47 - len(head) - 2          # the title is centred over the three critical values
    out.write(f"{'':31}{'-' * ((nd + 1) // 2)} {head} {'-' * (nd // 2)}\n", "text")
    out.write("                  Test         1% Critical       5% Critical      10% Critical\n", "text")
    out.write("               Statistic           Value             Value             Value\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(" Z(t)", "text")
    out.write(f"{tau:>19.3f}{crit[0]:>18.3f}{crit[1]:>18.3f}{crit[2]:>18.3f}\n", "result")
    pval = None
    if kind == "n" and not o.get("drift"):
        # noconstant: Stata stops after the statistic, without the closing line and the
        # MacKinnon p-value (compat 1101)
        pass
    elif not o.get("drift"):
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        pval = mackinnon_p(tau, kind)
        out.write("MacKinnon approximate p-value for Z(t) = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{pval:.4f}\n", "result")
    else:
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        pval = float(st.t.cdf(tau, n - k))
        out.write("p-value for Z(t) = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{pval:.4f}\n", "result")
    if o.get("regress"):
        se = np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
        # the lags are grouped under the variable name (L1., LD., L2D.)
        rows = [CoefRow("header", names[0])]
        for i, nm in enumerate(cn):
            lab = nm
            if nm.endswith("." + names[0]):
                lab = nm[:-len(names[0])]
                lab = {"L1D.": "LD."}.get(lab, lab)
            rows.append(CoefRow("coef", lab, b[i], se[i]))
        out.write("\n", "text")
        coef_table(s, f"D.{names[0]}", rows, stat="t", df=n - k, level=float(s.settings.get("level", "95")),
                   depvar_left=True)
    s.r = {"N": float(n), "lags": float(lags), "Zt": tau}
    if pval is not None:
        # r(p) only with a constant or trend in the model ([TS] dfuller, Stored results)
        s.r["p"] = pval

def _bar(v: float) -> str:
    k = int(math.floor(abs(v) * 8 + 1e-12))
    k = min(k, 8)
    if v >= 0:
        return " " * 8 + "|" + "-" * k
    return " " * (8 - k) + "-" * k + "|"


def cmd_corrgram(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"lags": 3, "noplot": 3, "yw": 2}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    ds = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds)
    mask = touse(s, p) & (ds.get(names[0]).data < SYS)
    t0, t1 = _check_gaps(s, mask)
    order = np.argsort(ds.get(info.tvar).data[mask], kind="stable")
    y = ds.get(names[0]).data[mask].astype(float)[order]
    n = len(y)
    maxlag = int(o["lags"]) if o.get("lags") else min(int(n / 2) - 2, 40)
    yc = y - y.mean()
    c0 = float(yc @ yc)
    ac = np.array([float(yc[k:] @ yc[:-k]) / c0 for k in range(1, maxlag + 1)])
    pac = []
    for k in range(1, maxlag + 1):
        if o.get("yw"):
            # Yule-Walker (Durbin-Levinson) partial autocorrelations
            r = np.concatenate([[1.0], ac[:k]])
            R = linalg.toeplitz(r[:k])
            phi = np.linalg.solve(R, r[1:k + 1])
            pac.append(float(phi[-1]))
        else:
            Xk = np.column_stack([y[k - j - 1:n - j - 1] for j in range(k)] + [np.ones(n - k)])
            bk, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xk, y[k:], rcond=None)
            pac.append(float(bk[k - 1]))
    Q = n * (n + 2) * np.cumsum(ac ** 2 / (n - np.arange(1, maxlag + 1)))
    out = s.output
    noplot = bool(o.get("noplot"))
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if not noplot:
        out.write(f"{'':42}-1       0       1 -1       0       1\n", "text")
        out.write(" LAG       AC       PAC      Q     Prob>Q  [Autocorrelation]  [Partial Autocor]\n", "text")
    else:
        out.write(" LAG       AC       PAC      Q     Prob>Q\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * (79 if not noplot else 42) + "\n", "text")
    for k in range(maxlag):
        line = f"{k + 1:<5}{ac[k]:>10.4f}{pac[k]:>9.4f}{Q[k]:>9.5g}{float(chi2_tail(Q[k], k + 1)):>8.4f}"
        if not noplot:
            line += f"  {_bar(ac[k]):<19}{_bar(pac[k])}"
        out.write(line.rstrip() + "\n", "result")
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    s.r = {"lags": float(maxlag), "ac": Matrix(ac.reshape(1, -1)), "pac": Matrix(np.array(pac).reshape(1, -1)),
           "Q": Matrix(Q.reshape(1, -1))}
    for k in range(maxlag):
        s.r[f"ac{k + 1}"] = float(ac[k])
        s.r[f"pac{k + 1}"] = float(pac[k])
        s.r[f"q{k + 1}"] = float(Q[k])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# newey
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cmd_newey(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    from .regress import Sample, cmdline
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "newey", args)
        return
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec={"lag": 3, "force": 5}, weights=("aweight",))
    o = smp.o
    if o.get("lag") is None or o.get("lag") is True:
        raise StataError(198, "option lag() required")
    L = int(o["lag"])
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    fvars.drop_collinear(smp.cols, smp.constant)
    est_cols = [col for col in smp.cols if col.values is not None]
    n = smp.n
    X = np.column_stack([col.values for col in est_cols] + ([np.ones(n)] if smp.constant else []))
    y = smp.y.astype(float)
    t = s.data.get(info.tvar).data[smp.mask].astype(float)
    order = np.argsort(t, kind="stable")
    X, y, t = X[order], y[order], t[order]
    if L > 0 and not o.get("force"):
        if np.any(np.abs(np.diff(t) - info.delta) > 1e-9):
            raise StataError(498, f"{info.tvar} is not regularly spaced -- use the force option to override")   # VERIFY
    k = X.shape[1]
    XtXi = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
    b = XtXi @ X.T @ y
    e = y - X @ b
    xe = X * e[:, None]
    Om = xe.T @ xe
    for l in range(1, L + 1):
        w = 1 - l / (L + 1)
        G = xe[l:].T @ xe[:-l]
        Om += w * (G + G.T)
    V = n / (n - k) * XtXi @ Om @ XtXi
    V = (V + V.T) / 2
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
    sl = list(range(len(est_cols)))
    df_r = n - k
    F = float(b[sl] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(sl, sl)], b[sl])) / len(sl) if sl else SYS
    pF = float(st.f.sf(F, len(sl), df_r)) if sl else SYS
    names = [col.name for col in smp.cols] + (["_cons"] if smp.constant else [])
    pos = [i for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols) if col.values is not None] + ([len(smp.cols)] if smp.constant else [])
    kk = len(names)
    bf, Vf = np.zeros(kk), np.zeros((kk, kk))
    bf[pos] = b
    Vf[np.ix_(pos, pos)] = V
    bmap = {col.name: bf[i] for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    semap = {col.name: float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[i, i], 0))) for i, col in enumerate(smp.cols)}
    if smp.constant:
        bmap["_cons"], semap["_cons"] = bf[-1], float(np.sqrt(max(Vf[-1, -1], 0)))
    est = Estimates("newey", smp.depname, names, bf, Vf, n, "t", float(df_r))
    est.rows = rows_from_columns(smp.cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=smp.constant)
    est.cols, est.constant, est.terms, est.depcomp = smp.cols, smp.constant, smp.terms, smp.depcomp
    est.level = smp.level
    est.vcetype = "Newey-West"
    est.extra = {"N": n, "lag": L, "F": F, "pF": pF, "df_m": len(sl), "df_r": df_r}
    est.display = display_newey
    # e() in the order Stata lists it (compat 1101)
    scalars = [("df_m", float(len(sl))), ("df_r", float(df_r)), ("F", F), ("N", float(n)), ("lag", float(L)),
               ("rank", float(k))]
    macros = [("title", "Regression with Newey-West standard errors"), ("cmd", "newey"),
              ("cmdline", cmdline("newey", args)), ("estat_cmd", "newey_estat"), ("predict", "newey_p"),
              ("vcetype", "Newey-West"), ("depvar", smp.depname), ("properties", "b V")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, smp.mask)
    display_newey(s, est)


def display_newey(s: "Session", est: Estimates, *, header: bool = True, table: bool = True,
                  level: float | None = None, **_kw) -> None:
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        _right(out, "Regression with Newey-West standard errors", "Number of obs", f"{int(x['N']):,}")
        _right(out, f"maximum lag: {x['lag']}", f"F({int(x['df_m']):>3},{int(x['df_r']):>10})",
               g9(x["F"], "%10.2f"))
        _right(out, "", "Prob > F", g9(x["pF"], "%10.4f"))
        out.write("\n", "text")
    if table:
        coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="t", df=est.df_r, level=level or est.level,
                   vcetype="Newey-West")

"""Unit-root tests: dfgls and pperron ([TS] dfgls, [TS] pperron).

dfgls: GLS detrending (Elliott, Rothenberg and Stock 1996) and the augmented Dickey-Fuller
regression without deterministic terms on the detrended series, for every lag up to the maximum;
the lag is chosen by the Ng-Perron sequential t, the Schwarz criterion and the modified Akaike
criterion. Critical values are interpolated from the ERS tables (VERIFY: Stata's default 5% and
10% values come from a response surface that the manual does not give).

pperron: Phillips-Perron Z(rho) and Z(t) with the Newey-West long-run variance; critical values
interpolated from Fuller's tables, p-value from MacKinnon (1994).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from .results import CoefRow, coef_table
from .tsmodels import mackinnon_p

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

# ERS (1996), Table 1, trend case (c = -13.5): N = 50, 100, 200
_ERS_TREND = {1: [-3.77, -3.58, -3.46], 5: [-3.19, -3.03, -2.93], 10: [-2.89, -2.74, -2.64]}
# mean-only case (c = -7); VERIFY: the manual does not print this table, the asymptotic
# values are used for every N
_ERS_MEAN = {1: [-2.58, -2.58, -2.58], 5: [-1.95, -1.95, -1.95], 10: [-1.62, -1.62, -1.62]}
_ERS_N = [50, 100, 200]


def ers_critical(trend: bool, n: int) -> list[float]:
    tab = _ERS_TREND if trend else _ERS_MEAN
    out = []
    for lev in (1, 5, 10):
        v = tab[lev]
        if n <= _ERS_N[0]:
            out.append(v[0])
        elif n >= _ERS_N[-1]:
            out.append(v[-1])
        else:
            i = 0 if n < _ERS_N[1] else 1
            n1 = _ERS_N[i]
            out.append(v[i] + (n - n1) / n1 * (v[i + 1] - v[i]))
    return out


def gls_detrend(y: np.ndarray, trend: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    T = len(y)
    c = -13.5 if trend else -7.0
    a = 1 + c / T
    ye = np.concatenate([[y[0]], y[1:] - a * y[:-1]])
    x = np.concatenate([[1.0], np.full(T - 1, 1 - a)])
    cols = [x]
    if trend:
        t = np.arange(1, T + 1, dtype=float)
        cols.append(np.concatenate([[1.0], t[1:] - a * t[:-1]]))
    Z = np.column_stack(cols)
    d, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, ye, rcond=None)
    fit = d[0] + (d[1] * np.arange(1, T + 1) if trend else 0.0)
    return y - fit


def adf_gls(ystar: np.ndarray, k: int, kmax: int):
    """Regression of dy*_t on y*_{t-1} and k lagged differences, no constant, on the sample
    t = kmax+1..T. Returns (coefficients, standard errors, rmse, N, sum y*_{t-1}^2)."""
    T = len(ystar)
    dy = np.diff(ystar)                       # dy[i] = y*_{i+1} - y*_i  (period i+2 in 1..T)
    rows = np.arange(kmax, T - 1)             # dy index of the dependent variable (VERIFY: N = T - 1 - kmax)
    y = dy[rows]
    cols = [ystar[rows]]                      # y*_{t-1}
    for j in range(1, k + 1):
        cols.append(dy[rows - j])
    X = np.column_stack(cols)
    n, p = X.shape
    b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    e = y - X @ b
    s2 = float(e @ e) / (n - p)
    V = s2 * np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
    # VERIFY: the root MSE reported with the lag choice divides by n, not n - p (reference log)
    return b, np.sqrt(np.diag(V)), math.sqrt(float(e @ e) / n), n, float(np.sum(X[:, 0] ** 2))


def cmd_dfgls(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.tsspectral import _sample_series
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"maxlag": 4, "notrend": 3, "ers": 3}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if names else 102, "too many variables specified" if names else "too few variables specified")
    y, _rows = _sample_series(s, p, p.varlist.strip())
    T0 = len(y)
    trend = not o.get("notrend")
    schwert = o.get("maxlag") is None
    kmax = int(math.floor(12 * (T0 / 100) ** 0.25)) if schwert else int(float(s.eval(str(o["maxlag"]))))
    if kmax < 0 or kmax > T0 - 4:
        raise StataError(198, "maxlag() out of range")      # VERIFY
    ystar = gls_detrend(y, trend)
    res = []
    for k in range(0, kmax + 1):
        b, se, rmse, n, sy2 = adf_gls(ystar, k, kmax)
        tau = float(b[0] / se[0])
        tlast = float(b[k] / se[k]) if k >= 1 else math.nan
        res.append({"k": k, "tau": tau, "rmse": rmse, "n": n, "b0": float(b[0]), "tlast": tlast, "sy2": sy2})
    N = res[0]["n"]
    for r in res:
        r["sc"] = math.log(r["rmse"] ** 2) + (r["k"] + 1) * math.log(N) / N
        tk = r["b0"] ** 2 * r["sy2"] / r["rmse"] ** 2
        r["maic"] = math.log(r["rmse"] ** 2) + 2 * (tk + r["k"]) / N
    zc = float(st.norm.ppf(0.95))
    opt = 0
    for r in reversed(res):
        if r["k"] >= 1 and abs(r["tlast"]) > zc:
            opt = r["k"]
            break
    # VERIFY: the information criteria are compared over lags 1..maxlag (the lines of the table)
    cand = [r for r in res if r["k"] >= 1] if kmax > 0 else res
    sc_best = min(cand, key=lambda r: r["sc"])
    maic_best = min(cand, key=lambda r: r["maic"])
    crit = ers_critical(trend, T0)      # VERIFY: interpolation uses the number of observations
    out = s.output
    from ..core.formats import format_value

    def g7(x: float) -> str:
        return format_value(x, "%9.7g", pad=False).strip()
    name = p.varlist.strip()
    out.write(f"\nDF-GLS for {name:<46}Number of obs = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{N:>5}\n\n", "result")
    lab = "tau" if trend else "mu"
    out.write(f"{'':15}{'DF-GLS ' + lab:<16}1% Critical       5% Critical      10% Critical\n", "text")
    out.write(f"  [lags]     Test Statistic        Value             Value             Value\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    for r in reversed(res):
        if r["k"] == 0 and kmax > 0:
            continue
        out.write(f"{r['k']:>5}{r['tau']:>18.3f}{crit[0]:>17.3f}{crit[1]:>18.3f}{crit[2]:>18.3f}\n", "result")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    if kmax > 0:
        rm = next(r["rmse"] for r in res if r["k"] == opt)
        out.write(f"Opt Lag (Ng-Perron seq t) = {opt:>2} with RMSE {g7(rm):>9}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"Min SC   = {g7(sc_best['sc']):>9} at lag {sc_best['k']:>2} with RMSE {g7(sc_best['rmse']):>9}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"Min MAIC = {g7(maic_best['maic']):>9} at lag {maic_best['k']:>2} with RMSE {g7(maic_best['rmse']):>9}\n", "text")
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    if kmax == 0:
        s.r = {"rmse0": res[0]["rmse"], "dft0": res[0]["tau"]}
    else:
        tab = np.array([[r["k"], r["maic"], r["sc"], r["rmse"], r["tau"]] for r in res])
        s.r = {"maxlag": float(kmax), "N": float(N), "sclag": float(sc_best["k"]),
               "maiclag": float(maic_best["k"]), "optlag": float(opt),
               "results": Matrix(tab, [f"r{i + 1}" for i in range(len(res))],
                                 ["k", "MAIC", "SIC", "RMSE", "DFGLS"])}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# pperron
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_FULLER_N = [25, 50, 100, 250, 500]
# Fuller (1976), Table 8.5.1: n(rho - 1), by 1%, 5%, 10%
_FULLER_RHO = {
    "n": {1: [-11.9, -12.9, -13.3, -13.6, -13.7], 5: [-7.3, -7.7, -7.9, -8.0, -8.0],
          10: [-5.3, -5.5, -5.6, -5.7, -5.7]},
    "c": {1: [-17.2, -18.9, -19.8, -20.3, -20.5], 5: [-12.5, -13.3, -13.7, -14.0, -14.0],
          10: [-10.2, -10.7, -11.0, -11.2, -11.2]},
    "ct": {1: [-22.5, -25.8, -27.4, -28.4, -28.9], 5: [-17.9, -19.8, -20.7, -21.3, -21.5],
           10: [-15.6, -16.8, -17.5, -18.0, -18.1]},
}
# Fuller (1976), Table 8.5.2: tau
_FULLER_TAU = {
    "n": {1: [-2.66, -2.62, -2.60, -2.58, -2.58], 5: [-1.95] * 5, 10: [-1.60, -1.61, -1.61, -1.62, -1.62]},
    "c": {1: [-3.75, -3.58, -3.51, -3.46, -3.44], 5: [-3.00, -2.93, -2.89, -2.88, -2.87],
          10: [-2.63, -2.60, -2.58, -2.57, -2.57]},
    "ct": {1: [-4.38, -4.15, -4.04, -3.99, -3.98], 5: [-3.60, -3.50, -3.45, -3.43, -3.42],
           10: [-3.24, -3.18, -3.15, -3.13, -3.13]},
}


def _interp(tab: dict, kind: str, n: int) -> list[float]:
    out = []
    for lev in (1, 5, 10):
        v = tab[kind][lev]
        if n <= _FULLER_N[0]:
            out.append(v[0])
        elif n >= _FULLER_N[-1]:
            out.append(v[-1])
        else:
            i = max(j for j in range(len(_FULLER_N) - 1) if _FULLER_N[j] < n)
            a, b = _FULLER_N[i], _FULLER_N[i + 1]
            out.append(v[i] + (n - a) / (b - a) * (v[i + 1] - v[i]))
    return out


def pp_stats(y: np.ndarray, q: int, trend: bool, constant: bool, t0: np.ndarray | None = None):
    """Phillips-Perron statistics of the regression y_t = a + rho y_{t-1} (+ d t) + u_t."""
    n = len(y) - 1
    cols = [y[:-1]]
    if trend:
        cols.append(t0[1:] if t0 is not None else np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float))
    if constant:
        cols.append(np.ones(n))
    X = np.column_stack(cols)
    yy = y[1:]
    b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, yy, rcond=None)
    u = yy - X @ b
    k = X.shape[1]
    s2 = float(u @ u) / (n - k)
    XtXi = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
    sig2 = s2 * XtXi[0, 0]
    sig = math.sqrt(sig2)
    g = [float(u[j:] @ u[:n - j]) / n for j in range(q + 1)]
    lam2 = g[0] + 2 * sum((1 - j / (q + 1)) * g[j] for j in range(1, q + 1))
    rho = float(b[0])
    sn = math.sqrt(s2)
    zrho = n * (rho - 1) - (n * n * sig2 / (2 * s2)) * (lam2 - g[0])
    zt = math.sqrt(g[0] / lam2) * (rho - 1) / sig - 0.5 * (lam2 - g[0]) * n * sig / (math.sqrt(lam2) * sn)
    return zrho, zt, n, b, np.sqrt(np.diag(s2 * XtXi)), X


def cmd_pperron(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.tsspectral import _sample_series
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"noconstant": 4, "trend": 3, "regress": 3, "lags": 3}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if names else 102, "too many variables specified" if names else "too few variables specified")
    if o.get("noconstant") and o.get("trend"):
        raise StataError(198, "options noconstant and trend may not be combined")
    y, rows = _sample_series(s, p, p.varlist.strip())
    constant = not o.get("noconstant")
    trend = bool(o.get("trend"))
    nobs = len(y) - 1
    q = int(float(s.eval(str(o["lags"])))) if isinstance(o.get("lags"), str) else int(4 * (nobs / 100) ** (2 / 9))
    zrho, zt, n, b, se, X = pp_stats(y, q, trend, constant)
    kind = "ct" if trend else ("c" if constant else "n")
    crho, ctau = _interp(_FULLER_RHO, kind, n), _interp(_FULLER_TAU, kind, n)
    out = s.output
    out.write(f"\n{'Phillips-Perron test for unit root':<51}Number of obs   = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{n:>9,}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'':51}Newey-West lags = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{q:>9}\n\n", "result")
    head = "Interpolated Dickey-Fuller"
    nd = 47 - len(head) - 2
    out.write(f"{'':31}{'-' * ((nd + 1) // 2)} {head} {'-' * (nd // 2)}\n", "text")
    out.write("                  Test         1% Critical       5% Critical      10% Critical\n", "text")
    out.write("               Statistic           Value             Value             Value\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(" Z(rho)", "text")
    out.write(f"{zrho:>17.3f}{crho[0]:>18.3f}{crho[1]:>18.3f}{crho[2]:>18.3f}\n", "result")
    out.write(" Z(t)", "text")
    out.write(f"{zt:>19.3f}{ctau[0]:>18.3f}{ctau[1]:>18.3f}{ctau[2]:>18.3f}\n", "result")
    pval = None
    if constant:
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        pval = mackinnon_p(zt, kind)
        out.write("MacKinnon approximate p-value for Z(t) = ", "text")
        out.write(f"{pval:.4f}\n", "result")
    if o.get("regress"):
        nm = p.varlist.strip()
        labels = [f"L1."] + (["_trend"] if trend else []) + (["_cons"] if constant else [])
        rws = [CoefRow("header", nm)]
        for i, lab in enumerate(labels):
            rws.append(CoefRow("coef", lab if lab != "L1." else "L1.", b[i], se[i]))
        out.write("\n", "text")
        coef_table(s, nm, rws, stat="t", df=n - X.shape[1], level=float(s.settings.get("level", "95")),
                   depvar_left=True)
    s.r = {"N": float(n), "lags": float(q)}
    if pval is not None:
        s.r["pval"] = pval
    s.r["Zt"] = zt
    s.r["Zrho"] = zrho

"""ucm: unobserved-components models ([TS] ucm): trend, seasonal and stochastic-cycle components
estimated by maximum likelihood with the (diffuse) Kalman filter of ssm.py."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options, parse_standard
from . import fvars
from .ml import maximize, options as ml_options, print_log
from .results import CoefRow, Estimates, coef_table, post, rows_from_columns
from .ssm import kalman_loglik
from .tsops import require_ts

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS

# (level variance, trend variance, irregular, fixed drift, fixed level) of each trend model
MODELS = {
    "none": (False, False, False, False, False), "ntrend": (False, False, True, False, False),
    "dconstant": (False, False, True, False, True), "llevel": (True, False, True, False, False),
    "rwalk": (True, False, False, False, False), "dtrend": (False, False, True, True, True),
    "lldtrend": (True, False, True, True, False), "rwdrift": (True, False, False, True, False),
    "lltrend": (True, True, True, False, False), "strend": (False, True, True, False, False),
    "rtrend": (False, True, False, False, False),

TITLE = {"none": "", "ntrend": "", "dconstant": "deterministic constant", "llevel": "local level",
         "rwalk": "random walk", "dtrend": "deterministic trend", "lldtrend": "local level with deterministic trend",
         "rwdrift": "random walk with drift", "lltrend": "local linear trend", "strend": "smooth trend",
         "rtrend": "random trend"}


@dataclass
class UCSpec:
    model: str = "rwalk"
    seasonal: int = 0
    depname: str = ""
    cycles: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)       # orders
    nreg: int = 0


def param_layout(spec: UCSpec, depname: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """[(name, transform)] in the order of e(b); transform: id, var, freq, damp."""
    lv, tv, irr, drift, _lvl = MODELS[spec.model]
    out = [(f"reg{i}", "id") for i in range(spec.nreg)]
    nc = len(spec.cycles)
    for i in range(nc):
        sfx = "" if nc == 1 else str(i + 1)
        out += [(f"frequency{sfx}", "freq"), (f"damping{sfx}", "damp")]
    if drift:
        out.append(("beta", "id"))
    if lv:
        out.append(("var(level)", "var"))
    if tv:
        out.append(("var(slope)", "var"))
    if spec.seasonal:
        out.append(("var(seasonal)", "var"))
    for i in range(nc):
        out.append((f"var(cycle{i + 1})" if nc > 1 else "var(cycle1)", "var"))
    if irr:
        out.append((f"var({depname})", "var"))
    return out


def to_nat(u: float, kind: str) -> float:
    if kind == "var":
        return math.exp(min(u, 700))
    if kind == "freq":
        return math.pi / (1 + math.exp(-u))
    if kind == "damp":
        return 1 / (1 + math.exp(-u))
    return u


def to_unc(x: float, kind: str) -> float:
    if kind == "var":
        return math.log(max(x, 1e-12))
    if kind == "freq":
        return math.log(x / (math.pi - x))
    if kind == "damp":
        return math.log(x / (1 - x))
    return x


def build_state_space(spec: UCSpec, nat: dict):
    """(D, A, S, H, c, diffuse) for the natural-scale parameters in `nat`."""
    lv, tv, irr, drift, fixlvl = MODELS[spec.model]
    blocks_A, blocks_D, vars_, diff, cvec = [], [], [], [], []
    shocks = []
    # trend
    if spec.model not in ("none", "ntrend"):
        slope = spec.model in ("lltrend", "strend", "rtrend")
        n = 2 if slope else 1
        A = np.eye(n)
        if slope:
            A[0, 1] = 1.0
        S = np.zeros((n, n))
        if lv:
            S[0, 0] = nat["var(level)"]
        if tv:
            S[n - 1, n - 1] = nat["var(slope)"]
        c = np.zeros(n)
        if drift:
            c[0] = nat["beta"]
        D = np.zeros(n); D[0] = 1.0
        blocks_A.append(A); blocks_D.append(D); shocks.append(S); diff.append(np.ones(n, dtype=bool)); cvec.append(c)
    # seasonal
    if spec.seasonal:
        ns = spec.seasonal - 1
        A = np.zeros((ns, ns))
        A[0, :] = -1.0
        if ns > 1:
            A[1:, :-1] = np.eye(ns - 1)
        S = np.zeros((ns, ns)); S[0, 0] = nat["var(seasonal)"]
        D = np.zeros(ns); D[0] = 1.0
        blocks_A.append(A); blocks_D.append(D); shocks.append(S); diff.append(np.ones(ns, dtype=bool))
        cvec.append(np.zeros(ns))
    # cycles
    nc = len(spec.cycles)
    for i, order in enumerate(spec.cycles):
        sfx = "" if nc == 1 else str(i + 1)
        lam, rho = nat[f"frequency{sfx}"], nat[f"damping{sfx}"]
        var = nat[f"var(cycle{i + 1})"]
        Rm = rho * np.array([[math.cos(lam), math.sin(lam)], [-math.sin(lam), math.cos(lam)]])
        n = 2 * order
        A = np.zeros((n, n))
        for j in range(order):
            A[2 * j:2 * j + 2, 2 * j:2 * j + 2] = Rm
            if j + 1 < order:
                A[2 * j:2 * j + 2, 2 * j + 2:2 * j + 4] = np.eye(2)
        S = np.zeros((n, n)); S[n - 2:, n - 2:] = var * np.eye(2)
        D = np.zeros(n); D[0] = 1.0
        blocks_A.append(A); blocks_D.append(D); shocks.append(S); diff.append(np.zeros(n, dtype=bool))
        cvec.append(np.zeros(n))
    from scipy.linalg import block_diag
    if not blocks_A:
        A = np.zeros((0, 0)); S = np.zeros((0, 0)); D = np.zeros((1, 0)); c = np.zeros(0); dm = np.zeros(0, dtype=bool)
    else:
        A, S = block_diag(*blocks_A), block_diag(*shocks)
        D = np.concatenate(blocks_D).reshape(1, -1)
        c, dm = np.concatenate(cvec), np.concatenate(diff)
    H = np.array([[nat.get(f"var({spec.depname})", 0.0) if irr else 0.0]])
    return D, A, S, H, c, dm


_OPTS = {"model": 3, "seasonal": 4, "cycle": 3, "constraints": 3, "collinear": 4, "vce": 3, "robust": 1,
         "level": 1, "nocnsreport": 5, "nolog": 3, "iterate": 4, "tolerance": 3, "ltolerance": 4,
         "nrtolerance": 4, "technique": 4, "difficult": 4, "from": 3, "trace": 5}


def cmd_ucm(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    from .regress import Sample, cmdline
    from .tsmodels import _check_gaps, _numderiv, _sample_text
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "ucm", args)
        return
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    body, opts = (args, "") if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
    # cycle() may be repeated: collect all of them before the option matcher keeps only the last
    import re
    cyc = [int(float(m_)) for m_ in re.findall(r"\bcycle\(\s*(\d+)", opts)]
    o = match_options(re.sub(r"\bcycle\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\)", "", opts), _OPTS) if opts.strip() else {}
    for bad in ("constraints", "from", "vce"):
        if o.get(bad):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {bad}() not implemented in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA

        raise StataError(198, "seasonal() must be at least 2")   # VERIFY
    spec.cycles = cyc
    for q in cyc:

            raise StataError(198, "cycle() order must be 1, 2 or 3")
    if len(spec.cycles) > 3:
        raise StataError(198, "at most three cycles")
    p = parse_standard(body)
    text = p.varlist + (f" if {p.if_}" if p.if_ else "") + (f" in {p.in_}" if p.in_ else "")
    smp = Sample(s, text + ", noconstant" + (f" level({o['level']})" if isinstance(o.get("level"), str) else ""),
                 opts_spec={}, weights=())
    t0, t1 = _check_gaps(s, smp.mask)

    n = smp.n

    order = np.argsort(s.data.get(info.tvar).data[smp.mask], kind="stable")
    X = np.column_stack([col.values for col in est_cols])[order] if est_cols else np.zeros((n, 0))

    names = [nm for nm, _k in layout]
    kinds = [k_ for _nm, k_ in layout]

    def natural(u):
        return {nm: to_nat(v, kd) for nm, v, kd in zip(names, u, kinds)}

    def contrib(u):
        nat = natural(u)

        beta = np.array([nat[f"reg{i}"] for i in range(nreg)])
        dd = (X @ beta).reshape(-1, 1) if nreg else None
        return kalman_loglik(y.reshape(-1, 1), D, A, S, H, cc, dd, dm)

    def ll(u):

            return -np.inf            # variances beyond exp(+-25) are numerically meaningless

        return -np.inf if c_ is None else float(c_.sum()) - (math.log(spec.seasonal) if spec.seasonal else 0.0)

             f"var({smp.depname})": 0.5 * vy}

            u0.append(float(beta0[int(nm[3:])]))

            f_ = freq0[ncyc] if ncyc < len(freq0) else None
            ncyc += 1

        elif nm.startswith("damping"):
            u0.append(to_unc(0.7, kd))
        elif nm.startswith("var(cycle"):
            u0.append(to_unc(0.3 * vy, kd))

        Vu = np.linalg.pinv(-Hm)

    nat_vals = np.array([to_nat(v, kd) for v, kd in zip(u, kinds)])

    # and 1915)

        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            chi2 = SYS

    blocks: list[list[CoefRow]] = []
    if nreg:
        bmap = {col.name: nat_vals[i] for i, col in enumerate(est_cols)}
        semap = {col.name: se[i] for i, col in enumerate(est_cols)}
        blocks.append(rows_from_columns(est_cols, bmap, semap, s.data, constant=False))
    enames, eqs = [], []
    others: list[CoefRow] = []
    vrows: list[CoefRow] = []
    for i, (nm, kd) in enumerate(layout):
        if nm.startswith("reg"):
            enames.append(est_cols[int(nm[3:])].name); eqs.append(smp.depname)
            continue
        (vrows if kd == "var" else others).append(CoefRow("coef", nm, nat_vals[i], se[i], name=nm, tight=kd == "var", zero_lo=kd == "var"))
        enames.append(nm); eqs.append("")

    comps = [TITLE[spec.model]] if TITLE[spec.model] else []

                     if len(spec.cycles) == 1 else f"{len(spec.cycles)} cycles of order " + " ".join(map(str, spec.cycles)))

                 "components": ", ".join(comps), "stationary": stationary, "nreg": nreg}
    est.ucm = {"spec": spec, "layout": layout, "u": u, "y": y, "X": X, "order": order, "mask": smp.mask.copy()}
    est.display = display_ucm

               ("rank", float(len(u))), ("ic", float(r.iterations)), ("rc", 0.0), ("converged", 1.0 if r.converged else 0.0)]

def _predict_ucm(s: "Session", est: Estimates, stat: str, mask: np.ndarray):
    """One-step predictions (xb, the default), residuals and standardized residuals over the
    estimation sample (VERIFY: trend, seasonal, cycle and the other smethod() options)."""
    from .ssm import kalman_onestep
    U = est.ucm
    spec, layout, u = U["spec"], U["layout"], U["u"]
    nat = {nm: to_nat(v, kd) for (nm, kd), v in zip(layout, u)}
    D, A, S, H, cc, dm = build_state_space(spec, nat)
    beta = np.array([nat[f"reg{i}"] for i in range(spec.nreg)])
    dd = (U["X"] @ beta).reshape(-1, 1) if spec.nreg else None
    yhat, fv = kalman_onestep(U["y"].reshape(-1, 1), D, A, S, H, cc, dd, dm)
    rows = np.nonzero(U["mask"])[0][U["order"]]
    # the first observations, one per diffuse state, have no prediction (compat 1915: 299 of 300
    # with a random walk; VERIFY with other models)
    nd = int(np.asarray(dm).sum())
    yhat = yhat.copy()
    yhat[:nd] = np.nan
    out = np.full(s.data.nobs, SYS)
    if stat in ("", "xb"):
        out[rows] = np.where(np.isnan(yhat[:, 0]), SYS, yhat[:, 0])
        return out, "" if stat else "(option xb assumed; fitted values)"
    e = U["y"] - yhat[:, 0]
    if stat == "residuals":
        out[rows] = np.where(np.isnan(e), SYS, e)
    elif stat == "rstandard":
        z = e / np.sqrt(fv[:, 0])
        out[rows] = np.where(np.isnan(z), SYS, z)
    else:
        raise StataError(198, f"option {stat} not allowed")                      # VERIFY
    return out, ""


def cycle_density(est: Estimates, which: int, omega: np.ndarray, normalized: bool = True) -> np.ndarray:
    """Spectral density of the cycle number `which` (1, 2, 3) of a ucm fit, from the state-space
    form of that cycle alone: (1/2pi) D (I - A z)^-1 S (I - A z)^-H D', z = exp(-i w); divided by
    the cycle's variance unless pspectrum (VERIFY: psdensity's normalization after ucm)."""
    from .ssm import stationary_cov
    U = est.ucm
    spec = U["spec"]
    if not spec.cycles:
        raise StataError(321, "no cycle in the model")                               # VERIFY
    if not 1 <= which <= len(spec.cycles):
        raise StataError(198, f"cycle({which}) not found")                          # VERIFY
    nat = {nm: to_nat(v, kd) for (nm, kd), v in zip(U["layout"], U["u"])}
    nc = len(spec.cycles)
    sfx = "" if nc == 1 else str(which)
    one = UCSpec(model="none", depname=spec.depname, cycles=[spec.cycles[which - 1]])
    sub = {"frequency": nat[f"frequency{sfx}"], "damping": nat[f"damping{sfx}"],
           "var(cycle1)": nat["var(cycle1)" if nc == 1 else f"var(cycle{which})"]}
    D, A, S, _H, _c, _d = build_state_space(one, sub)
    r = A.shape[0]
    f = np.empty(len(omega))
    for i, w in enumerate(omega):
        G = np.linalg.inv(np.eye(r) - A * np.exp(-1j * w))
        f[i] = float(np.real(D @ G @ S @ G.conj().T @ D.T)[0, 0]) / (2 * math.pi)
    if normalized:
        P = stationary_cov(A, S)
        f = f / float((D @ P @ D.T)[0, 0])
    return f

def _var_fit(s: "Session", deps: list[str], lags: list[int], exog: list[str], constant: bool,
             mask: np.ndarray | None = None):
    """Returns the design for all equations over the common sample."""
    from .tsops import shift
    ds = s.data
    n = ds.nobs
    Y = np.column_stack([ds.get(v).data.astype(float) for v in deps])
    cols, names = [], []
    for dv in deps:
        x = ds.get(dv).data.astype(float)
        for l in lags:
            cols.append(shift(ds, x, l))
            names.append((dv, l))
    for ev in exog:
        cols.append(ds.get(ev).data.astype(float))
        names.append((ev, 0))

    ok = np.all(Y < SYS, axis=1) & (np.all(X < SYS, axis=1) if X.size else True)
    if mask is not None:
        ok &= mask

        X = np.column_stack([X, np.ones(n)])

def _var_stats(Y, X):
    T = Y.shape[0]
    B, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, Y, rcond=None)
    U = Y - X @ B
    Sml = U.T @ U / T
    K = Y.shape[1]
    m = X.shape[1]
    _s, ld = np.linalg.slogdet(Sml)
    ll = -0.5 * T * (K * math.log(2 * math.pi) + ld + K)
    tp = K * m
    aic = -2 * ll / T + 2 * tp / T
    hqic = -2 * ll / T + 2 * math.log(math.log(T)) * tp / T
    sbic = -2 * ll / T + math.log(T) * tp / T
    fpe = math.exp(ld) * ((T + m) / (T - m)) ** K
    return B, U, Sml, ll, aic, hqic, sbic, fpe, math.exp(ld)

    o = match_options(p.options, {"lags": 3, "exog": 3, "noconstant": 4, "dfk": 3, "small": 2,
                                  "level": 1, "lutstats": 3, "noisure": 5, "constraints": 6}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    deps = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    lags = _lags(o.get("lags")) if o.get("lags") else [1, 2]
    exog = s.expand_varlist(o["exog"]) if isinstance(o.get("exog"), str) else []
    constant = not o.get("noconstant")
    Y, X, ok, xnames = _var_fit(s, deps, lags, exog, constant, touse(s, p))
    t0, t1 = _check_gaps(s, ok)
    Yo, Xo = Y[ok], X[ok]
    T, K = Yo.shape
    mpar = Xo.shape[1]
    B, U, Sml, ll, aic, hqic, sbic, fpe, det = _var_stats(Yo, Xo)
    Sig = U.T @ U / (T - mpar) if o.get("dfk") else Sml
    XtXi = np.linalg.inv(Xo.T @ Xo)

    b = B.T.ravel()
    small = bool(o.get("small"))

        ssr = float(U[:, j] @ U[:, j])

        rmse = math.sqrt(ssr / (T - mpar))      # VERIFY: Stata's RMSE divisor

            eqstats.append((dv, mpar, rmse, r2, stat, float(chi2_tail(stat, len(sl)))))
    rows = []
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
    i = 0
    for j, dv in enumerate(deps):

                    rows.append(CoefRow("header", vn))
                    last = vn
                rows.append(CoefRow("coef", f"L{l}.", b[i], se[i], name=f"{dv}:{names[i]}"))
            else:

    est.vcetype = ""
    est.extra = {"N": float(T), "ll": ll, "aic": aic, "hqic": hqic, "sbic": sbic, "fpe": fpe, "det": det,

                               ("Det(Sigma_ml)", x["det"], "SBIC", x["sbic"])):
            left = f"{lab:<15}= {g9(v, '%9.0g'):>10}"

        out.write(f"{'Equation':<15}{'Parms':>9}{'RMSE':>10}{'R-sq':>9}{stat_h:>10}{'P>' + stat_h:>11}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
        for dv, mp, rmse, r2, stat, pv in x["eqstats"]:

def cmd_varsoc(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:

    _Y, _X, ok, _n = _var_fit(s, deps, list(range(1, maxlag + 1)), exog, constant, touse(s, p))
    t0, t1 = _check_gaps(s, ok)
    K = len(deps)
    res = []
    for lag in range(maxlag + 1):
        Y, X, _ok, _nm = _var_fit(s, deps, list(range(1, lag + 1)), exog, constant)
        stats_ = _var_stats(Y[ok], X[ok] if X.shape[1] else np.zeros((int(ok.sum()), 0)))
        res.append(stats_)
    T = int(ok.sum())
    lls = [r_[3] for r_ in res]

    best = {k: int(np.argmin([r_[{"fpe": 7, "aic": 4, "hqic": 5, "sbic": 6}[k]] for r_ in res]))

    def star(key, i):
        return "*" if best.get(key) == i else " "
    for i, r_ in enumerate(res):
        # widths and digits from compat 1101 (six significant digits for FPE and the criteria),

        out.write(f"{line} |\n", "result")
    out.write("  +" + "-" * 75 + "+\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Endogenous:':>14}  {' '.join(deps)}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Exogenous:':>14}  {' '.join(exog + (['_cons'] if constant else []))}\n", "text")

"""Postestimation of var: varlmar, varnorm, varstable, varwle and fcast ([TS] varlmar, [TS] varnorm,
[TS] varstable, [TS] varwle, [TS] fcast). The statistics are plain functions of arrays; the
commands read the stored VAR, print and store r()."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from .results import current

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def lm_autocorr(U: np.ndarray, X: np.ndarray, lag: int) -> tuple[float, int]:
    """Johansen LM statistic for autocorrelation of order `lag`: the VAR is augmented with the K
    residual series lagged `lag` times (zeros for the missing initial values) and the statistic
    is (T - d - 0.5) ln(|Sigma| / |Sigma_s|). Returns (statistic, df = K^2)."""
    T, K = U.shape
    Ul = np.zeros_like(U)
    Ul[lag:] = U[:-lag]
    Xa = np.column_stack([X, Ul])
    B, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xa, U, rcond=None)
    Ua = U - Xa @ B
    d = X.shape[1] + K          # VERIFY: Stata's d in the statistic
    s0 = np.linalg.slogdet(U.T @ U / T)[1]
    s1 = np.linalg.slogdet(Ua.T @ Ua / T)[1]
    return (T - d - 0.5) * (s0 - s1), K * K


def normality(U: np.ndarray, Sigma: np.ndarray, P: np.ndarray | None = None) -> dict:
    """Skewness, kurtosis and Jarque-Bera tests of the residuals orthogonalised with P (default:
    Cholesky factor of Sigma). Returns the coefficients and the statistics by equation."""
    T, K = U.shape
    if P is None:
        P = np.linalg.cholesky(Sigma)
    W = np.linalg.solve(P, U.T).T
    b1 = (W ** 3).mean(axis=0)
    b2 = (W ** 4).mean(axis=0)
    sk = T * b1 ** 2 / 6
    ku = T * (b2 - 3) ** 2 / 24
    return {"skew": b1, "kurt": b2, "chi_skew": sk, "chi_kurt": ku, "chi_jb": sk + ku,
            "all_skew": float(T / 6 * (b1 @ b1)), "all_kurt": float(T / 24 * ((b2 - 3) @ (b2 - 3)))}


def companion(Alist: list[np.ndarray]) -> np.ndarray:
    K = Alist[0].shape[0]
    p = len(Alist)
    A = np.zeros((K * p, K * p))
    A[:K] = np.hstack(Alist)
    if p > 1:
        A[K:, :-K] = np.eye(K * (p - 1))
    return A


def lag_matrices(B: np.ndarray, xnames: list, deps: list[str], p: int) -> list[np.ndarray]:
    """A_1..A_p (K x K) from the coefficient matrix B (rows: regressors, columns: equations)."""
    K = len(deps)
    out = [np.zeros((K, K)) for _ in range(p)]
    for i, (vn, l) in enumerate(xnames):
        if l > 0:
            out[l - 1][:, deps.index(vn)] = B[i]
    return out


def wald_exclusion(B, Sig, XtXi, idx: list[int], j: int | None):
    """Wald chi2 and df that the coefficients in rows `idx` are zero in equation j (None: in all)."""
    if j is not None:
        b, V = B[idx, j], Sig[j, j] * XtXi[np.ix_(idx, idx)]
    else:
        b, V = B[idx, :].T.ravel(), np.kron(Sig, XtXi[np.ix_(idx, idx)])
    return float(b @ np.linalg.solve(V, b)), len(b)


def forecast_path(y_hist: np.ndarray, B: np.ndarray, xnames: list, deps: list[str], constant: bool,
                  steps: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Dynamic forecasts: y_hist holds the observed values before the first forecast (rows in time
    order, at least max lag rows); each step uses the previous forecasts."""
    K = len(deps)
    hist = [r for r in y_hist]
    out = []
    for _ in range(steps):
        x = []
        for vn, l in xnames:
            if vn == "_cons":
                x.append(1.0)
            else:
                x.append(hist[-l][deps.index(vn)])
        yhat = np.array(x) @ B
        out.append(yhat)
        hist.append(yhat)
    return np.array(out).reshape(steps, K)


def forecast_mse(B: np.ndarray, Sig: np.ndarray, XtXi: np.ndarray, X: np.ndarray, T: int,
                 A: list[np.ndarray], constant: bool, steps: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Asymptotic MSE matrices of the h-step forecasts (Lutkepohl 2005, section 3.5.1):
    Sigma_y(h) + Omega(h)/T. Returns an array (steps, K, K)."""
    K = Sig.shape[0]
    p = len(A)
    Phi = [np.eye(K)]
    for i in range(1, steps):
        Phi.append(sum(Phi[i - j] @ A[j - 1] for j in range(1, min(i, p) + 1)))
    # companion matrix of (1, y_t, ..., y_{t-p+1}); the regressors of the sample are Z_{t-1}
    n = K * p + (1 if constant else 0)
    Bc = np.zeros((n, n))
    o = 1 if constant else 0
    if constant:
        Bc[0, 0] = 1.0
        Bc[o:o + K, 0] = B[0]            # B has the constant in its first row
    Bc[o:o + K, o:] = np.hstack(A)
    if p > 1:
        Bc[o + K:, o:o + K * (p - 1)] = np.eye(K * (p - 1))
    # the regressor order of X may differ from Z: reorder to (1, lag1 block, lag2 block ...)
    Gam = X.T @ X / T
    Gi = np.linalg.inv(Gam)
    out = np.zeros((steps, K, K))
    acc = np.zeros((K, K))
    for h in range(1, steps + 1):
        acc = acc + Phi[h - 1] @ Sig @ Phi[h - 1].T
        Om = np.zeros((K, K))
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(h):
                tr = np.trace(np.linalg.matrix_power(Bc.T, h - 1 - i) @ Gi
                              @ np.linalg.matrix_power(Bc, h - 1 - j) @ Gam)
                Om += tr * Phi[i] @ Sig @ Phi[j].T
        out[h - 1] = acc + Om / T
    return out

def _var(s: "Session", name: str):
    est = current(s)
    if est.cmd not in ("var", "svar"):
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    return est, est.var


def _cg(x: float, n: int) -> str:
    """C-style %.<n>g without the leading zero, as the box tables of var postestimation show it."""
    r = format(float(x), f".{n}g")
    return r.replace("0.", ".", 1) if r.startswith(("0.", "-0.")) else r


def _cg7(x: float) -> str:
    """%10.7g: 7 significant digits, fewer when the value does not fit in 10 columns (varstable)."""
    for n in range(7, 0, -1):
        r = _cg(x, n)
        if len(r) <= 10:
            return r
    return r


def _opts(args: str, spec: dict) -> dict:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    if p.varlist.strip():
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    return match_options(p.options, spec) if p.options.strip() else {}


def cmd_varlmar(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    est, V = _var(s, "varlmar")
    o = _opts(args, {"mlag": 2, "estimates": 3, "separator": 3})
    m = int(o["mlag"]) if o.get("mlag") and o["mlag"] is not True else 2
    if m < 1:
        raise StataError(198, "mlag() must be greater than 0")   # VERIFY
    out = s.output
    rows = []
    for lag in range(1, m + 1):
        chi, df = lm_autocorr(V["U"], V["X"], lag)
        rows.append((lag, chi, df, float(chi2_tail(chi, df))))
    sep = int(o["separator"]) if o.get("separator") and o["separator"] is not True else 0
    bar = "|" + "-" * 6 + "+" + "-" * 31 + "|"
    out.write("\n   Lagrange-multiplier test\n", "text")
    out.write("  +" + "-" * 38 + "+\n", "text")
    out.write("  | lag  |      chi2    df   Prob > chi2 |\n", "text")
    out.write("  " + bar + "\n", "text")
    for i, (lag, chi, df, pv) in enumerate(rows):
        out.write(f"  |{lag:>4}  |{chi:>10.4f}{df:>6}{pv:>12.5f}   |\n", "result")
        if sep and (i + 1) % sep == 0 and i + 1 < len(rows):
            out.write("  " + bar + "\n", "text")
    out.write("  +" + "-" * 38 + "+\n", "text")
    out.write("   H0: no autocorrelation at lag order\n", "text")
    s.r = {"lm": Matrix(np.array([[r[1], r[2], r[3]] for r in rows]),
                        [str(r[0]) for r in rows], ["chi2", "df", "p"])}


def cmd_varnorm(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    est, V = _var(s, "varnorm")
    o = _opts(args, {"jbera": 1, "skewness": 1, "kurtosis": 1, "estimates": 3, "separator": 3, "cholesky": 4})
    if o.get("cholesky"):
        raise StataError(198, "option cholesky not allowed")    # only for svar
    which = [k for k in ("jbera", "skewness", "kurtosis") if o.get(k)] or ["jbera", "skewness", "kurtosis"]
    sep = int(o["separator"]) if o.get("separator") and o["separator"] is not True else 0
    deps = V["deps"]
    K = len(deps)
    r = normality(V["U"], V["Sig"])
    out = s.output
    tabs = {
        "jbera": ("Jarque-Bera test", None, r["chi_jb"], 2, r["all_skew"] + r["all_kurt"], 2 * K),
        "skewness": ("Skewness test", r["skew"], r["chi_skew"], 1, r["all_skew"], K),
        "kurtosis": ("Kurtosis test", r["kurt"], r["chi_kurt"], 1, r["all_kurt"], K),
    }
    res = {}
    for key in ("jbera", "skewness", "kurtosis"):
        if key not in which:

        title, coef, chi, df, chi_all, df_all = tabs[key]
        bar = "|" + "-" * 20 + "+" + "-" * 35 + "|"
        out.write(f"\n   {title}\n", "text")
        out.write("  +" + "-" * 56 + "+\n", "text")
        lab = "Skewness" if key == "skewness" else "Kurtosis"
        mid = f"{lab:>9}{'chi2':>7}{'df':>5}  Prob > chi2 " if coef is not None else \
            f"{'chi2':>16}{'df':>5}  Prob > chi2 "
        out.write(f"  |{'Equation':>19} |{mid}|\n", "text")
        out.write("  " + bar + "\n", "text")
        mat = []
        for i, dv in enumerate(deps):
            pv = float(chi2_tail(chi[i], df))
            mat.append([chi[i], df, pv])
            sk = f"{_cg(coef[i], 5):>8}" if coef is not None else " " * 8
            out.write(f"  |{dv[:19]:>19} |{sk}{chi[i]:>9.3f}{df:>4}{pv:>11.5f}   |\n", "result")
            if sep and (i + 1) % sep == 0:
                out.write("  " + bar + "\n", "text")

        out.write(f"  |{'ALL':>19} |{' ' * 8}{chi_all:>9.3f}{df_all:>4}{pv:>11.5f}   |\n", "result")
        out.write("  +" + "-" * 56 + "+\n", "text")
        res[key] = Matrix(np.array(mat), deps + ["ALL"], ["chi2", "df", "p"])
    if V["dfk"]:

    s.r = {k: res[k] for k in ("jbera", "kurtosis", "skewness") if k in res}

        s.r["jb"] = s.r.pop("jbera")
    if V["dfk"]:
        s.r = {"dfk": "dfk", **s.r}
    s.r = dict(reversed(list(s.r.items())))


def cmd_varstable(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:

    p = max(V["lags"])
    A = companion(lag_matrices(V["B"], V["xnames"], V["deps"], p))

        if abs(z.imag) < 1e-12:

    else:
        out.write("   At least one eigenvalue is outside the unit circle.\n   VAR does not satisfy stability condition.\n", "text")
    s.r = {"Modulus": Matrix(mod.reshape(-1, 1)), "Im": Matrix(ev.imag.reshape(-1, 1)),

    else:
