def _fcast_compute(s: "Session", rest: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.tshelp import append_periods, new_variable
    from .tsops import require_ts
    from scipy import stats as st
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    prefix = p.varlist.strip()
    if not prefix or " " in prefix:
        raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    o = match_options(p.options, {"step": 2, "dynamic": 3, "estimates": 3, "replace": 3, "nose": 2,
                                  "bs": 2, "bsp": 3, "bscentile": 3, "reps": 3, "nodots": 3,
                                  "saving": 3, "level": 1}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    if o.get("bs") or o.get("bsp") or o.get("bscentile"):
        raise StataError(198, "options bs, bsp and bscentile are not implemented in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
    if current(s).cmd == "vec":
        _fcast_vec(s, current(s), prefix, o)
        return
    est, V = _var(s, "fcast")
    if V["exog"]:
        raise StataError(198, "fcast after var with exog() is not implemented in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
    deps, xnames, B = V["deps"], V["xnames"], V["B"]
    K = len(deps)
    lags = V["lags"]
    pmax = max(lags)
    if lags != list(range(1, pmax + 1)):
        raise StataError(198, "fcast requires consecutive lags")   # OpenDTA
    steps = int(o["step"]) if o.get("step") and o["step"] is not True else 1
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") and o["level"] is not True else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    if info.panel:
        raise StataError(198, "panel data not allowed")   # VERIFY
    t0, t1, dl = V["t0"], V["t1"], info.delta
    start = t1 + dl
    if o.get("dynamic") and o["dynamic"] is not True:
        start = float(s.eval(str(o["dynamic"])))
        if start < t0 + pmax * dl or start > t1 + dl:
            raise StataError(198, "dynamic() must be within the estimation sample or one period after")   # VERIFY
    names = {}
    for dv in deps:
        for suf in ("", "_LB", "_UB", "_SE"):
            if suf and o.get("nose"):
                continue
            nm = f"{prefix}{dv}{suf}"
            if s.data.has(nm) and not o.get("replace"):
                raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
            names[(dv, suf)] = nm
    times = [start + h * dl for h in range(steps)]
    ds = s.data
    tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    have = {float(v) for v in tv[tv < SYS]}
    new = [(None, tt) for tt in times if tt not in have]
    if new:
        append_periods(s, new)
        ds = s.data
        tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    pos = {float(v): i for i, v in enumerate(tv) if v < SYS}
    hist = []
    for k in range(pmax, 0, -1):
        row = pos.get(start - k * dl)
        if row is None:
            raise StataError(198, "observations needed before the forecast period are missing")   # VERIFY
        hist.append([float(ds.get(dv).data[row]) for dv in deps])
    hist = np.array(hist)
    if np.any(hist >= SYS):
        raise StataError(198, "observations needed before the forecast period are missing")   # VERIFY
    fc = forecast_path(hist, B, xnames, deps, V["constant"], steps)
    cols = {}
    if not o.get("nose"):
        A = lag_matrices(B, xnames, deps, pmax)
        perm = ([xnames.index(("_cons", 0))] if V["constant"] else []) + \
            [xnames.index((dv, l)) for l in range(1, pmax + 1) for dv in deps]
        mse = forecast_mse(B[perm], V["Sig"], V["XtXi"], V["X"][:, perm], V["T"], A,
                           V["constant"], steps)
        z = float(st.norm.isf((1 - level / 100) / 2))
        se = np.sqrt(np.array([np.diag(m) for m in mse]))
    n = ds.nobs
    for j, dv in enumerate(deps):
        def put(suf, vals):
            col = np.full(n, np.nan)
            for tt, v in zip(times, vals):
                col[pos[tt]] = v
            if not suf and start == t1 + dl and pos.get(t1) is not None:
                col[pos[t1]] = ds.get(dv).data[pos[t1]]      # the last observation carries the actual value
            new_variable(s, names[(dv, suf)], col, vtype="double", replace=True)
        put("", fc[:, j])
        if not o.get("nose"):
            put("_LB", fc[:, j] - z * se[:, j])
            put("_UB", fc[:, j] + z * se[:, j])
            put("_SE", se[:, j])
    s.notify_state()


def _fcast_graph(s: "Session", rest: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.graphcmd import finish
    from ..commands.tshelp import to_nan
    from ..graphics.model import Graph, Layer, Panel
    from ..graphics.opts import graph_options, split_layer_graph
    from .tsops import require_ts
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, {"noci": 4, "observed": 3, "level": 1})
    est, V = _var(s, "fcast graph")
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    ds = s.data
    tv = to_nan(ds.get(info.tvar).data)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    panels_ = []
    for nm in names:
        dep = next((dv for dv in V["deps"] if nm.endswith(dv)), None)
        if dep is None:
            raise StataError(198, f"{nm} is not a forecast variable")   # VERIFY
        f = to_nan(ds.get(nm).data)
        ok = np.isfinite(f) & np.isfinite(tv)
        order = np.argsort(tv[ok])
        xs = tv[ok][order]
        layers = []
        lb, ub = f"{nm}_LB", f"{nm}_UB"
        if not lopts.get("noci") and ds.has(lb) and ds.has(ub):
            lo = to_nan(ds.get(lb).data)[ok][order]
            hi = to_nan(ds.get(ub).data)[ok][order]
            layers.append(Layer("rarea", xs.tolist(), lo.tolist(), {"y2": hi.tolist()},
                                {"_pal": 0, "_ci": True}, "95% CI"))
        layers.append(Layer("line", xs.tolist(), f[ok][order].tolist(), {}, {"_pal": 0}, "forecast"))
        if lopts.get("observed"):
            y = to_nan(ds.get(dep).data)
            ob = np.isfinite(y) & np.isfinite(tv) & (tv >= xs.min() if xs.size else False)
            oo = np.argsort(tv[ob])
            layers.append(Layer("line", tv[ob][oo].tolist(), y[ob][oo].tolist(), {}, {"_pal": 1}, "observed"))
        panels_.append(Panel(nm, layers))
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    opts["_xtitle"] = info.tvar
    finish(s, Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=panels_), graw)


def _fcast_vec(s: "Session", est, prefix: str, o: dict) -> None:
    """fcast compute after vec: dynamic forecasts of the levels with standard errors
    sqrt(diag(T/(T-d) sum Phi_i Omega Phi_i')) of the VAR representation (no parameter uncertainty)."""
    from scipy import stats as st
    from ..commands.tshelp import append_periods, new_variable
    from .irfext import _simulate_vecm, vec_inputs
    from .irf import _phis
    from .tsops import require_ts
    v = est.vec
    deps = v["deps"]
    K, p = len(deps), v["lags"]
    steps = int(o["step"]) if o.get("step") and o["step"] is not True else 1
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") and o["level"] is not True else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    info = require_ts(s.data)
    dl = info.delta
    t1 = v["t1"]
    start = t1 + dl
    if o.get("dynamic") and o["dynamic"] is not True:
        start = float(s.eval(str(o["dynamic"])))
    ds = s.data
    times = [start + h * dl for h in range(steps)]
    tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    have = {float(x) for x in tv[tv < SYS]}
    new = [(None, tt) for tt in times if tt not in have]
    if new:
        append_periods(s, new)
        ds = s.data
        tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    pos = {float(x): i for i, x in enumerate(tv) if x < SYS}
    hist = []
    for k in range(p, 0, -1):
        row = pos.get(start - k * dl)
        if row is None:
            raise StataError(198, "observations needed before the forecast period are missing")   # VERIFY
        hist.append([float(ds.get(dv).data[row]) for dv in deps])
    hist = np.array(hist)
    idx = int(round((start - v["t0"]) / dl))                   # 0-based position of the first period
    path = _simulate_vecm(v, np.zeros((steps, K)), hist, idx + 1)[p:]
    names = {}
    for dv in deps:
        for suf in ("", "_LB", "_UB", "_SE"):
            if suf and o.get("nose"):
                continue
            nm = f"{prefix}{dv}{suf}"
            if s.data.has(nm) and not o.get("replace"):
                raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
            names[(dv, suf)] = nm
    if not o.get("nose"):
        _d, A, Om = vec_inputs(est)
        Phi = _phis(A, steps)
        fac = v["T"] / (v["T"] - v["d"])
        acc, ses = np.zeros((K, K)), []
        for h in range(steps):
            acc = acc + Phi[h] @ Om @ Phi[h].T
            ses.append(np.sqrt(np.diag(fac * acc)))
        se = np.array(ses)
        z = float(st.norm.isf((1 - level / 100) / 2))
    n = ds.nobs
    for j, dv in enumerate(deps):
        def put(suf, vals):
            col = np.full(n, np.nan)
            for tt, val in zip(times, vals):
                col[pos[tt]] = val
            if not suf and start == t1 + dl and pos.get(t1) is not None:
                col[pos[t1]] = ds.get(dv).data[pos[t1]]      # the last observation carries the actual value
            new_variable(s, names[(dv, suf)], col, vtype="double", replace=True)
        put("", path[:, j])
        if not o.get("nose"):
            put("_LB", path[:, j] - z * se[:, j])
            put("_UB", path[:, j] + z * se[:, j])
            put("_SE", se[:, j])
    s.notify_state()

"""Variance of maximum-likelihood estimates: the model (OIM) variance and the robust
sandwich ([R] vce_option, [U] 20.22 Obtaining robust variance estimates).

One implementation for every ML command (logit, probit, poisson, the models of
models2.py, stcox and streg), so that weights and clusters are treated the same way
everywhere.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def bread(H: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """(-H)^-1, symmetric; the pseudo-inverse when -H is singular (collinear or flat directions)."""
    if H.size == 0:
        return np.zeros((0, 0))
    try:
        V = np.linalg.inv(-H)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        V = np.linalg.pinv(-H)
    return (V + V.T) / 2


def sandwich(V: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray, w: np.ndarray, *, fweight: bool, n: float,
             clusters: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int | None]:
    """Robust variance V M V with the small-sample factor; returns (variance, number of clusters).

    scores: derivative of each observation's log likelihood (n x k, unweighted); w: the weights
    used in the fit. With clusters, M sums the weighted scores within each cluster and the factor
    is G/(G-1). Otherwise M = sum w^2 s s' (frequency weights: sum w s s', each observation
    counting w times) and the factor is n/(n-1), n being the reported number of observations
    (the sum of the frequency weights)."""
    ws = scores * w[:, None]
    n_clust = None
    if clusters is not None:
        uq, inv = np.unique(clusters, return_inverse=True)
        n_clust = len(uq)
        G = np.zeros((n_clust, scores.shape[1]))
        np.add.at(G, inv, ws)
        meat = G.T @ G * n_clust / (n_clust - 1)
    else:
        # VERIFY: fweight as expanded data in every ML command (compat 0514)
        meat = ws.T @ (scores if fweight else ws) * n / (n - 1)
    out = V @ meat @ V
    return (out + out.T) / 2, n_clust

def critical_value(trend: str, kind: str, level: int, ntrends: int) -> float:
    """Critical value with `ntrends` = K - r common trends; missing when not tabulated."""
    tab = _CV.get((trend, kind, level))
    if tab is None or not 1 <= ntrends <= len(tab):
        return SYS
    return tab[ntrends - 1]

def _moments(Y: np.ndarray, p: int, trend: str):
    """Residuals R0 (differences) and R1 (lagged levels plus restricted terms) after partialling out
    the lagged differences and the unrestricted deterministic terms; T = n - p observations."""
    n, K = Y.shape
    dY = np.diff(Y, axis=0)                          # row i = Y[i+1] - Y[i]
    T = n - p
    Z0 = dY[p - 1:]                                  # Delta y_t, t = p..n-1
    Z1 = Y[p - 1:n - 1]
    tt = np.arange(p + 1, n + 1, dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)    # VERIFY: trend counted from the first observation
    one = np.ones((T, 1))
    if trend in ("rconstant",):
        Z1 = np.hstack([Z1, one])
    elif trend == "rtrend":
        Z1 = np.hstack([Z1, tt])
    lagged = [dY[p - 1 - i:n - 1 - i] for i in range(1, p)]
    unr = {"constant": [one], "rconstant": [], "trend": [one, tt], "rtrend": [one], "none": []}[trend]
    Z2 = np.hstack(lagged + unr) if (lagged or unr) else np.zeros((T, 0))
    if Z2.shape[1]:
        P = Z2 @ np.linalg.pinv(Z2)
        R0, R1 = Z0 - P @ Z0, Z1 - P @ Z1
    else:
        R0, R1 = Z0, Z1
    return Z0, Z1, Z2, R0, R1, T, K


def johansen(Y: np.ndarray, p: int, trend: str) -> dict:
    """Eigenvalues (descending) and eigenvectors v (v' S11 v = I) of the Johansen problem."""
    Z0, Z1, Z2, R0, R1, T, K = _moments(Y, p, trend)
    S00, S11, S01 = R0.T @ R0 / T, R1.T @ R1 / T, R0.T @ R1 / T
    L = np.linalg.cholesky(S11)
    Li = np.linalg.inv(L)
    Mx = Li @ S01.T @ np.linalg.solve(S00, S01) @ Li.T
    lam, U = np.linalg.eigh((Mx + Mx.T) / 2)
    o = np.argsort(-lam)[:K]
    lam, V = lam[o], (Li.T @ U)[:, o]
    return {"lam": lam, "V": V, "S00": S00, "S11": S11, "S01": S01, "T": T, "K": K, "Z0": Z0,
            "Z1": Z1, "Z2": Z2, "R0": R0, "R1": R1}


def loglik(S00: np.ndarray, lam: np.ndarray, r: int, T: int, K: int) -> float:
    return -0.5 * T * (K * (math.log(2 * math.pi) + 1) + np.linalg.slogdet(S00)[1]
                       + float(np.sum(np.log1p(-lam[:r]))))


def fit_vecm(Y: np.ndarray, p: int, trend: str, r: int) -> dict:
    """Johansen estimates for rank r: beta (normalized), alpha, the coefficients of the short-run
    equations given beta (rows: error-correction terms, lagged differences, unrestricted terms) and
    the ML covariance of the residuals."""
    J = johansen(Y, p, trend)
    T = J["T"]
    beta = normalize_beta(J["V"], r)
    alpha = J["S01"] @ beta @ np.linalg.inv(beta.T @ J["S11"] @ beta)
    W = np.hstack([J["Z1"] @ beta, J["Z2"]])
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(W, J["Z0"], rcond=None)[0]
    U = J["Z0"] - W @ coef
    return {"J": J, "T": T, "beta": beta, "alpha": alpha, "W": W, "coef": coef, "U": U,
            "Om": U.T @ U / T}


def var_matrices(coef: np.ndarray, alpha: np.ndarray, beta: np.ndarray, K: int, p: int) -> list[np.ndarray]:
    """A_1..A_p of the levels VAR implied by the VECM: A_1 = I + Pi + Gamma_1,
    A_i = Gamma_i - Gamma_{i-1}, A_p = -Gamma_{p-1}."""
    r = alpha.shape[1]
    Pi = alpha @ beta[:K].T
    G = [coef[r + i * K:r + (i + 1) * K].T for i in range(p - 1)]       # Gamma_i[j, k]
    A = [np.eye(K) + Pi + (G[0] if p > 1 else 0)]
    for i in range(1, p - 1):
        A.append(G[i] - G[i - 1])
    if p > 1:
        A.append(-G[p - 2])
    return A


def n_parms(K: int, p: int, trend: str, r: int) -> int:
    n_unr = {"constant": 1, "rconstant": 0, "trend": 2, "rtrend": 1, "none": 0}[trend]
    m1 = {"rconstant": 1, "rtrend": 1}.get(trend, 0)
    return K * K * (p - 1) + K * n_unr + (K + m1) * r + K * r - r * r


def info_criteria(ll: float, T: int, k: int) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    return (-2 * ll / T + 2 * k / T, -2 * ll / T + math.log(T) * k / T,
            -2 * ll / T + 2 * math.log(math.log(T)) * k / T)         # AIC, SBIC, HQIC


def normalize_beta(V: np.ndarray, r: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """Johansen normalization beta = (I_r, beta_breve')'."""
    Vr = V[:, :r]
    return Vr @ np.linalg.inv(Vr[:r])

def _data(s: "Session", p, deps_text: str, lags: int, trend: str):
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from .tsmodels import _check_gaps
    deps = s.expand_varlist(deps_text)
    if len(deps) < 2:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    ds = s.data
    mask = touse(s, p)
    cols = [ds.get(v).data.astype(float) for v in deps]
    for c in cols:
        mask &= c < SYS
    t0, t1 = _check_gaps(s, mask)
    info = require_ts(ds)
    tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(mask)
    rows = rows[np.argsort(tv[rows], kind="stable")]
    Y = np.column_stack([c[rows] for c in cols])
    if Y.shape[0] <= lags + 1 + len(deps) * lags:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    return deps, Y, rows, tv[rows], mask


def _trend_opt(o: dict) -> str:
    t = o.get("trend")
    if not t or t is True:
        return "constant"
    t = str(t).lower()
    for full in TRENDS:
        if full.startswith(t) and len(t) >= 1:
            if t == "r":
                break
            return full
    raise StataError(198, "option trend() incorrectly specified")


def cmd_vecrank(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"lags": 2, "trend": 2, "sindicators": 2, "noreduce": 3,
                                  "notrace": 4, "max": 3, "ic": 2, "level99": 7, "levela": 6}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    if o.get("sindicators"):
        raise StataError(198, "option sindicators() not implemented in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
    lags = int(o["lags"]) if o.get("lags") and o["lags"] is not True else 2
    if lags < 1:
        raise StataError(198, "lags() must be greater than zero")
    trend = _trend_opt(o)
    deps, Y, rows, times, _m = _data(s, p, p.varlist, lags, trend)
    J = johansen(Y, lags, trend)
    K, T, lam = J["K"], J["T"], J["lam"]
    ll = [loglik(J["S00"], lam, r, T, K) for r in range(K + 1)]
    parms = [n_parms(K, lags, trend, r) for r in range(K + 1)]
    trace = [-T * float(np.sum(np.log1p(-lam[r:]))) for r in range(K)]
    mx = [-T * math.log1p(-lam[r]) for r in range(K)]
    ic = [info_criteria(ll[r], T, parms[r]) for r in range(K + 1)]
    ds = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds)
    first, last = times[lags], times[-1]
    out = s.output
    show_trace = not o.get("notrace")
    two = bool(o.get("levela"))
    lev = 1 if o.get("level99") else 5
    fa, fb = _fmt_time(ds, info.tvar, first), _fmt_time(ds, info.tvar, last)
    out.write("\n" + " " * 23 + "Johansen tests for cointegration" + " " * 24 + "\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Trend: ' + trend:<56}Number of obs = {T:>7}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Sample:  ' + fa + ' - ' + fb:<65}Lags = {lags:>7}\n", "text")
    dash = "-" * 79 + "\n"
    out.write(dash, "text")
    stats = [("trace", trace)] if show_trace else []
    if o.get("max"):
        stats.append(("max", mx))
    sel = {}
    levels = [5, 1] if two else [lev]
    for kind, vals in stats:
        lab = "trace" if kind == "trace" else "max"
        out.write(" " * 57 + "".join(f"{str(l) + '%':<9}" for l in levels).rstrip() + "\n", "text")
        out.write((f"{'maximum':<45}{lab:>5}    critical" if kind == "trace" else
                   f"{'maximum':<46}{lab}     critical") + "\n", "text")
        out.write("  rank    parms       LL       eigenvalue  statistic    value\n", "text")
        chosen = None
        for r in range(K + 1):
            eig = f"{lam[r - 1]:>12.5f}" if r > 0 else f"{'.':>12}"
            line = f"{r:>5}{'':6}{parms[r]:<2}{ll[r]:>15.5f}{eig}"
            if r < K:
                cvs = [critical_value(trend, kind, l, K - r) for l in levels]
                mark = " "
                if kind == "trace" and chosen is None and cvs[0] < SYS and vals[r] < cvs[0]:
                    chosen, mark = r, "*"
                line += f"{vals[r]:>12.4f}{mark}" + "".join(
                    f"{c:>8.2f}" if c < SYS else f"{'.':>8}" for c in cvs)
            out.write(line.rstrip() + "\n", "result")
        out.write(dash, "text")
        sel[kind] = chosen
    if o.get("ic"):
        out.write("maximum\n  rank    parms       LL       eigenvalue     SBIC       HQIC       AIC\n", "text")
        best = [int(np.argmin([c[i] for c in ic])) for i in (1, 2, 0)]
        best = [b_ if b_ < K else -1 for b_ in best]       # VERIFY: no mark when the minimum is at the full rank (1904)
        for r in range(K + 1):
            eig = f"{lam[r - 1]:>12.5f}" if r > 0 else f"{'':>12}"
            cells = "".join(f"{ic[r][i]:>{w}.6f}{'*' if best[j] == r else ' '}"
                            for j, (i, w) in enumerate(((1, 12), (2, 10), (0, 10))))
            out.write(f"{r:>5}{'':6}{parms[r]:<2}{ll[r]:>15.5f}{eig}{cells}".rstrip() + "\n", "result")
        out.write(dash, "text")
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    k95 = sel.get("trace")
    if k95 is None and show_trace:
        k95 = K
    k_sbic = int(np.argmin([c[1] for c in ic]))
    k_hqic = int(np.argmin([c[2] for c in ic]))
    est = Estimates("vecrank", " ".join(deps), [], np.zeros(0), np.zeros((0, 0)), T, "z", None)
    scalars = [("N", T), ("k_eq", K), ("k_dv", K), ("tmin", first), ("tmax", last), ("n_lags", lags),
               ("k_ce95", k95 if k95 is not None else SYS), ("k_ce99", SYS), ("k_cesbic", k_sbic),
               ("k_cehqic", k_hqic)]
    mats = [("trace", Matrix(np.array(trace + [np.nan]).reshape(1, -1))),
            ("max", Matrix(np.array(mx + [np.nan]).reshape(1, -1))),
            ("lambda", Matrix(lam.reshape(1, -1))),
            ("k_rank", Matrix(np.array(parms, dtype=float).reshape(1, -1))),
            ("hqic", Matrix(np.array([c[2] for c in ic]).reshape(1, -1))),
            ("sbic", Matrix(np.array([c[1] for c in ic]).reshape(1, -1))),
            ("aic", Matrix(np.array([c[0] for c in ic]).reshape(1, -1)))]
    from .regress import cmdline
    macros = [("cmd", "vecrank"), ("cmdline", cmdline("vecrank", args)), ("trend", trend),
              ("tsfmt", ds.get(info.tvar).fmt)]
    est.names = []
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, _mask_of(s, rows), extra_mats=mats)
    s.e.pop("b", None)
    s.e.pop("V", None)


def _mask_of(s: "Session", rows: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    m = np.zeros(s.data.nobs, dtype=bool)
    m[rows] = True
    return m


def cmd_vec(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    from .regress import cmdline
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "vec", args)
        return
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"rank": 2, "lags": 2, "trend": 2, "bconstraints": 2,
                                  "aconstraints": 2, "sindicators": 2, "noreduce": 3, "level": 1,
                                  "nobtable": 3, "noidtest": 4, "alpha": 1, "pi": 2, "noptable": 4,
                                  "mai": 3, "noetable": 4, "dforce": 2, "nocnsreport": 4,
                                  "iterate": 4, "nolog": 3, "trace": 5, "tolerance": 3,
                                  "ltolerance": 4, "afrom": 2, "bfrom": 2}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    for bad in ("bconstraints", "aconstraints", "sindicators", "afrom", "bfrom"):
        if o.get(bad):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {bad}() not implemented in OpenDTA")   # OpenDTA
    r = int(o["rank"]) if o.get("rank") and o["rank"] is not True else 1
    lags = int(o["lags"]) if o.get("lags") and o["lags"] is not True else 2
    trend = _trend_opt(o)
    deps, Y, rows, times, _m = _data(s, p, p.varlist, lags, trend)
    K = Y.shape[1]
    if not 0 < r < K:
        raise StataError(198, "rank() must be between 1 and the number of variables minus one")   # VERIFY
    F_ = fit_vecm(Y, lags, trend, r)
    J, T, beta, alpha, W, coef, U, Om = (F_[k] for k in ("J", "T", "beta", "alpha", "W", "coef", "U", "Om"))
    S00, S11 = J["S00"], J["S11"]
    mpar = W.shape[1]
    nparms = n_parms(K, lags, trend, r)
    ll = loglik(S00, J["lam"], r, T, K)
    d = nparms // K
    fac = T / (T - d)
    # VERIFY (case 1904): with the unrestricted constant Stata splits it as mu = alpha rho + gamma, shows
    # rho = (alpha'alpha)^-1 alpha' mu in the cointegrating equation (no standard error) and estimates the
    # equations with the error-correction term shifted by rho, so that their constants are gamma
    rho = None
    coef0 = coef
    if trend == "constant":
        rho = np.linalg.solve(alpha.T @ alpha, alpha.T @ coef[-1, :])
        W = W.copy()
        W[:, :r] += rho
        coef = coef.copy()
        coef[-1, :] = coef[-1, :] - alpha @ rho
    XtXi = np.linalg.inv(W.T @ W)
    level = float(o["level"]) if o.get("level") and o["level"] is not True else float(s.settings.get("level", "95"))
    ds = s.data
    info = require_ts(ds)
    first, last = times[lags], times[-1]
    aic, sbic, hqic = info_criteria(ll, T, nparms)
    # coefficient names (the columns of W: error-correction terms, lagged differences, terms)
    ce = [f"_ce{i + 1}" for i in range(r)]
    unr = {"constant": ["_cons"], "rconstant": [], "trend": ["_cons", "_trend"], "rtrend": ["_cons"],
           "none": []}[trend]
    cn = [f"L._ce{i + 1}" for i in range(r)]
    for i in range(1, lags):
        cn += [f"{'L' if i == 1 else 'L' + str(i)}D.{dv}" for dv in deps]
    cn += unr
    names = list(cn) * K
    eqs = [f"D_{dv}" for dv in deps for _ in cn]
    b = coef.T.ravel()
    V = np.kron(Om, XtXi) * fac
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
    eqstats = []
    for j, dv in enumerate(deps):
        cols = list(range(mpar))
        bj = coef[cols, j]
        Vj = Om[j, j] * fac * XtXi[np.ix_(cols, cols)]
        chi = float(bj @ np.linalg.solve(Vj, bj))
        rss = float(U[:, j] @ U[:, j])
        z0 = J["Z0"][:, j]
        tss = float((z0 ** 2).sum())        # VERIFY: uncentered (reproduces the reference log of case 1904)
        eqstats.append((f"D_{dv}", mpar, math.sqrt(rss / (T - mpar)) if T > mpar else SYS,
                        1 - rss / tss if tss > 0 else SYS, chi, float(chi2_tail(chi, len(cols)))))
    rows_t = _arrange_rows(deps, unr, b, se, K, mpar, ce, lags)
    # variance of beta (free elements) and the table of the cointegrating equations
    nb = beta.shape[0]
    Ominv = np.linalg.inv(Om)
    info_mat = np.kron(alpha.T @ Ominv @ alpha, S11)       # information per observation, vec(beta)
    free = [i + e * nb for e in range(r) for i in range(nb) if i >= r]
    Vb_free = np.linalg.inv(info_mat[np.ix_(free, free)]) / (T - d)
    bvec = beta.T.ravel()
    sevec = np.zeros(nb * r)
    sevec[free] = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(Vb_free), 0))
    brn = deps + (["_cons"] if trend == "rconstant" else ["_trend"] if trend == "rtrend" else [])
    est = Estimates("vec", " ".join(f"D_{d_}" for d_ in deps), names, b, V, T, "z", None)
    est.eqnames = eqs
    est.rows = rows_t
    est.level = level
    est.vcetype = ""
    est.extra = {"N": T, "ll": ll, "aic": aic, "hqic": hqic, "sbic": sbic, "det": float(np.linalg.det(Om)),
                 "sample": f"Sample:  {_fmt_time(ds, info.tvar, first)} - {_fmt_time(ds, info.tvar, last)}",
                 "eqstats": eqstats, "beta": beta, "sebeta": sevec, "free": free, "Vb": Vb_free,
                 "r": r, "brn": brn, "ce": ce, "opts": o, "nb": nb, "rho": rho}
    est.display = display_vec
    est.vec = {"deps": deps, "lags": lags, "trend": trend, "r": r, "alpha": alpha, "beta": beta, "Om": Om,
               "coef": coef0, "T": T, "Y": Y, "J": J, "d": d, "XtXi": XtXi, "times": times, "t0": times[0],
               "t1": times[-1]}
    from ..commands.matrix import Matrix
    scalars = [("N", T), ("k_rank", r), ("k_eq", K), ("k_dv", K), ("k_ce", r), ("n_lags", lags),
               ("df_m", nparms - K * 0), ("ll", ll), ("aic", aic), ("hqic", hqic), ("sbic", sbic),
               ("tmin", first), ("tmax", last), ("detsig_ml", float(np.linalg.det(Om))), ("rank", nparms)]
    for j, (dv, mp, rm, r2, chi, pv) in enumerate(eqstats):
        scalars += [(f"rmse_{j + 1}", rm), (f"r2_{j + 1}", r2), (f"chi2_{j + 1}", chi), (f"k_{j + 1}", mp)]
    mats = [("beta", Matrix(beta.T, ce, brn)), ("alpha", Matrix(alpha, deps, ce)),
            ("pi", Matrix(alpha @ beta.T, deps, brn)), ("omega", Matrix(Om, deps, deps))]
    macros = [("cmd", "vec"), ("cmdline", cmdline("vec", args)), ("title", "Vector error-correction model"),
              ("trend", trend), ("endog", " ".join(deps)), ("tvar", info.tvar),
              ("cenames", " ".join(ce)), ("eqnames", " ".join(f"D_{d_}" for d_ in deps)),
              ("properties", "b V")]
    post(s, est, scalars, macros, _mask_of(s, rows), extra_mats=mats)
    display_vec(s, est)


def _arrange_rows(deps, unr, b, se, K, mpar, ce, lags):
    """Rows of the short-run table: for each equation the error-correction terms, the lagged
    differences of each variable and the unrestricted terms."""
    out = []
    nce, nlag = len(ce), lags - 1
    for j, dv in enumerate(deps):
        out.append(CoefRow("eq", f"D_{dv}"))
        base = j * mpar
        for k, c in enumerate(ce):
            out.append(CoefRow("header", c))
            out.append(CoefRow("coef", "L1.", b[base + k], se[base + k]))
        if nlag:
            for vi, vn in enumerate(deps):
                out.append(CoefRow("blank"))
                out.append(CoefRow("header", vn))
                for l in range(1, nlag + 1):
                    pos = base + nce + (l - 1) * K + vi
                    out.append(CoefRow("coef", "LD." if l == 1 else f"L{l}D.", b[pos], se[pos]))
        pos0 = base + nce + nlag * K
        for q, nm in enumerate(unr):
            if q == 0:
                out.append(CoefRow("blank"))
            out.append(CoefRow("coef", nm, b[pos0 + q], se[pos0 + q]))
        if j < K - 1:
            out.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    return out

        out.write(f"{'Log likelihood = ' + g9(x['ll'], '%9.0g'):<48}{'HQIC':<18}= {g9(x['hqic'], '%9.0g'):>10}\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Det(Sigma_ml)  = ' + g9(x['det'], '%9.0g').rjust(9):<48}{'SBIC':<18}= {g9(x['sbic'], '%9.0g'):>10}\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Equation':<15}{'Parms':>9}{'RMSE':>10}{'R-sq':>9}{'chi2':>10}{'P>chi2':>11}\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 64 + "\n", "text")
        for dv, mp, rm, r2, chi, pv in x["eqstats"]:
            out.write(f"{dv[:15]:<15}", "text")
            out.write(f"{mp:>8}{g9(rm, '%8.0g'):>12}{r2:>9.4f}{g9(chi, '%9.0g'):>11}{pv:>9.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 64 + "\n\n", "text")
    if table and not o.get("noetable"):
        coef_table(s, "", est.rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev)
    if table and not o.get("nobtable"):

        out.write("-" * 43 + "\n", "text")

        rows = []
        for e_, c in enumerate(x["ce"]):
            rows.append(CoefRow("eq", c))
            for i, nm in enumerate(x["brn"]):
                k = i + e_ * nb
                if i < r:
                    rows.append(CoefRow("coef", nm, float(bvec[k]), float("nan")))
                else:
                    rows.append(CoefRow("coef", nm, float(bvec[k]),
                                        float(est.extra["sebeta"][k])))

                rows.append(CoefRow("coef", "_cons", float(x["rho"][e_]), float("nan")))
        coef_table(s, "beta", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev)
    if table and o.get("alpha"):
        _display_alpha(s, est, lev)


def _display_alpha(s: "Session", est: Estimates, lev: float) -> None:
    """The `alpha` option: Wald tests and table of the adjustment parameters."""
    from .results import g9
    out = s.output
    x = est.extra
    r, ce = x["r"], x["ce"]
    K = len(x["eqstats"])
    mpar = est.V.shape[0] // K
    out.write("\nAdjustment parameters\n\n", "text")
    out.write("Equation           Parms    chi2     P>chi2\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * 43 + "\n", "text")
    rows = []
    for j, (name, *_rest) in enumerate(x["eqstats"]):
        idx = [j * mpar + k for k in range(r)]
        b = est.b[idx]
        chi = float(b @ np.linalg.solve(est.V[np.ix_(idx, idx)], b))
        out.write(f"{name[:18]:<18}{r:>5}{g9(chi, '%9.0g'):>11}{float(chi2_tail(chi, r)):>9.4f}\n", "result")
        rows.append(CoefRow("eq", name))
        for k, c in enumerate(ce):
            rows.append(CoefRow("header", c))
            rows.append(CoefRow("coef", "L1.", float(est.b[idx[k]]), float(np.sqrt(est.V[idx[k], idx[k]]))))
        if j < K - 1:
            rows.append(CoefRow("sep"))
    out.write("-" * 43 + "\n", "text")
    coef_table(s, "alpha", rows, stat="z", df=None, level=lev)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M

from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import find_top, match_options, parse_standard
from .tsops import panel_info, ts_info

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _panel_vars(s: "Session", opt_i=None, opt_t=None, need_t: bool = False):
    ds = s.data
    pvar = opt_i or panel_info(ds)
    if not pvar:
        raise StataError(459, "panel variable not set; use xtset varname ...")
    info = ts_info(ds)
    tvar = opt_t or (info.tvar if info is not None and info.tvar != pvar else "")
    if need_t and not tvar:
        raise StataError(459, "time variable not set; use xtset panelvar timevar ...")
    return pvar, tvar


def cmd_xtline(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands.graphcmd import _twoway
    c = find_top(args, ",")
    body, opt = (args, "") if c == -1 else (args[:c], args[c + 1:])
    own = {"overlay": 3, "i": 1, "t": 1}
    # take our options out of the text and keep the rest for twoway
    keep, mine = [], {}
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_options
    raw = opt.strip()
    parsed = parse_options(raw) if raw else []
    rest_txt = raw
    for name, arg in parsed:
        for full, minimum in own.items():
            if len(name) >= minimum and full.startswith(name):
                mine[full] = arg if arg is not None else True
                txt = name + (f"({arg})" if arg is not None else "")
                rest_txt = rest_txt.replace(txt, "", 1)
                break
    pvar, tvar = _panel_vars(s, str(mine["i"]).strip() if isinstance(mine.get("i"), str) else None,
                             str(mine["t"]).strip() if isinstance(mine.get("t"), str) else None, need_t=True)
    p = parse_standard(body)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    cond = ""
    if p.if_:
        cond = f" if {p.if_}"
    rest_txt = rest_txt.strip().strip(",").strip()
    if mine.get("overlay"):
        ds = s.data
        ids = ds.get(pvar).data
        vals = sorted(set(ids[ids < SYS].tolist()))
        plots = []
        for v in vals:
            e = f"{pvar}=={v:g}"
            cnd = f" if {e}" + (f" & ({p.if_})" if p.if_ else "")
            for n in names:
                plots.append(f"(line {n} {tvar}{cnd})")
        text = " ".join(plots) + (", " + rest_txt if rest_txt else "")
    else:
        plots = " ".join(f"(line {n} {tvar})" for n in names)
        text = plots + cond + f", by({pvar}, note(\"\"))" + (" " + rest_txt if rest_txt else "")
    _twoway(s, text)


def cmd_xttab(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    from ..commands.tabulate import _categories, _codes, _fmt_freq, _header_lines
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"i": 1}) if p.options.strip() else {}
    pvar, _ = _panel_vars(s, str(o["i"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("i"), str) else None)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if names else 102, "too many variables specified" if names else "varlist required")
    ds = s.data
    v = ds.get(names[0])
    mask = touse(s, p) & (ds.get(pvar).data < SYS)
    cats, labels, ok = _categories(s, v, mask, missing=False, nolabel=False)
    codes = _codes(v, cats)
    sel = ok & (codes >= 0)

        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")

    r = ps.xttab_counts(codes[sel], inv, len(cats))

    out = s.output
    N, G = r["N"], r["G"]
    out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{'Overall':>{W + 16}}{'Between':>20}{'Within':>18}\n", "text")
    out.write(f"{title:>{W}} |{'Freq.':>9}{'Percent':>9}{'Freq.':>11}{'Percent':>9}{'Percent':>15}\n", "text")
    rule = "-" * (W + 1) + "+" + "-" * 53 + "\n"

    out.write(rule, "text")
    # VERIFY: the total of the within column is the average of its percentages weighted by the between frequencies
    wtot = float((r["bfreq"] * r["within"]).sum() / r["bfreq"].sum())
    out.write(f"{'Total':>{W}} |", "text")
    out.write(f"{_fmt_freq(N):>8}{100.0:>10.2f}{_fmt_freq(r['bfreq'].sum()):>10}"
              f"{100 * r['bfreq'].sum() / G:>10.2f}{wtot:>15.2f}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"{'':>{W + 23}}(n = {G})\n", "text")

def cmd_xtdata(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    p = parse_standard(args)
    o = match_options(p.options, {"fe": 2, "be": 2, "re": 2, "fa": 2, "ratio": 3, "clear": 2, "i": 1}) \
        if p.options.strip() else {}
    modes = [m for m in ("fe", "be", "re", "fa") if o.get(m)]
    if len(modes) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, "one of fe, be, re or fa must be specified")                # VERIFY
    if modes[0] == "fa":
        raise StataError(198, "option fa not allowed")                 # compat 1914
    ratio = None
    if modes[0] == "re":
        if o.get("ratio") in (None, True):
            raise StataError(198, "ratio() required")                       # compat 1914
        ratio = float(s.eval(str(o["ratio"])))
    pvar, _ = _panel_vars(s, str(o["i"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("i"), str) else None)
    ds = s.data
    if ds.changed and not o.get("clear"):
        raise StataError(4, "no; dataset in memory has changed since last saved")     # VERIFY
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else [n for n in ds.names if n != pvar]
    mask = touse(s, p) & (ds.get(pvar).data < SYS)
    _, inv = np.unique(ds.get(pvar).data[mask], return_inverse=True)
    for n in names:
        v = ds.get(n)
        if v.is_string or n == pvar:
            continue
        x = v.data.astype(float)
        m = mask & (x < SYS)
        sub_inv = np.unique(ds.get(pvar).data[m], return_inverse=True)[1]
        new = x.copy()
        if ratio is not None:
            v.vtype = "double"                  # the transformed variables are doubles (compat 1914)
            # GLS transform of the random-effects model: x - theta_i * mean_i(x), with
            # theta_i = 1 - 1 / sqrt(T_i ratio^2 + 1), ratio = sigma_u / sigma_e
            cnt = np.bincount(sub_inv).astype(float)
            th = 1 - 1 / np.sqrt(cnt * ratio * ratio + 1)
            mean_i = np.bincount(sub_inv, x[m]) / cnt
            new[m] = x[m] - th[sub_inv] * mean_i[sub_inv]
        else:
            new[m] = ps.panel_transform(x[m], sub_inv, modes[0])
        ds.set_numeric(v, new)
    if ratio is not None:
        # the constant of the transformed model, 1 - theta_i, in a float variable; the data keep
        # the panel variable and the variables of the varlist, in reverse order and as doubles,
        # sorted by the panel variable (compat 1914; VERIFY: unbalanced panels)
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        cnt = np.bincount(inv).astype(float)
        th = 1 - 1 / np.sqrt(cnt * ratio * ratio + 1)
        s.output.write(f"(theta={th[0]:.4f})\n" if np.ptp(th) == 0 else
                       f"(theta from {th.min():.4f} to {th.max():.4f})\n", "text")
        const = np.full(ds.nobs, SYS)
        const[mask] = 1 - th[inv]
        if ds.has("constant"):
            ds.drop_vars(["constant"])
        keep = [pvar] + [n for n in reversed(names) if n != pvar]
        ds.drop_vars([n for n in ds.names if n not in keep])
        ds.vars.sort(key=lambda v: keep.index(v.name))
        ok_ = const < SYS
        const[ok_] = const[ok_].astype(np.float32)
        ds.add(Variable("constant", "float", const))
        ds.sortlist = [pvar]
        ds.label = "xtdata, re;"
    if modes[0] == "be":
        # VERIFY: the between-effects data keep one observation per panel (1905 log)
        ids_ = ds.get(pvar).data
        first = np.zeros(ds.nobs, dtype=bool)
        _, idx = np.unique(np.where(mask, ids_, np.nan), return_index=True)
        first[idx] = True
        ds.keep_obs(first & mask)
    s.notify_state()

"""Dynamic panel-data estimation: xtabond, xtdpdsys and xtdpd ([XT] xtabond, [XT] xtdpdsys,
[XT] xtdpd), with estat abond and estat sargan.

The three commands share one engine: an instrument specification (GMM-type and standard
instruments for the differenced equation and, in the system estimators, for the level equation)
built per panel on the grid of periods. The algebra is in core/panelgmm.py. The layouts follow the
manual's examples where they are shown; the rest carries a VERIFY mark (compat 1905)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import panelgmm as pg
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.stats import chi2_tail
from ..lang.syntax import match_options
from .regress import Sample, cmdline, comma
from .results import CoefRow, Estimates, coef_table, g9, post
from .tsops import panel_info, ts_info

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def _g(x, fmt="%10.0g") -> str:
    return g9(x, fmt)


def _varlist(s: "Session", txt) -> list[str]:
    if txt in (None, False, True) or not str(txt).strip():
        return []
    body = str(txt).split(",")[0]
    return s.expand_varlist(body)


def _lagrange(txt, default: tuple[int, int | None]) -> tuple[int, int | None]:
    m = re.search(r"lagrange\(\s*(\d+)\s*(\d+|\.)?\s*\)", str(txt))
    if not m:
        return default
    a = int(m.group(1))
    b = m.group(2)
    return a, (a if b is None else (None if b == "." else int(b)))


def _lab(a: int, b: int | None, name: str, diff: bool = False) -> str:
    d = "D." if diff else ""
    if b == a and diff:
        return f"L{a if a > 1 else ''}D.{name}"          # LD.y (compat 1914)
    return f"L({a}/{'.' if b is None else b}).{d}{name}" if (b is None or b != a) else (f"L{a}.{d}{name}" if a > 1 else f"L.{d}{name}")


class _Spec:
    """Instruments and regressors in terms of series on the grid of periods."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.dgmm: list[tuple[str, int, int | None]] = []     # (series key, first lag, last lag)
        self.div: list[str] = []
        self.lgmm: list[tuple[str, int, int | None]] = []
        self.liv: list[str] = []
        self.level = False
        self.cons = True


def cmd_xtabond(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _run(s, "xtabond", args)


def cmd_xtdpdsys(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _run(s, "xtdpdsys", args)


def cmd_xtdpd(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    _run(s, "xtdpd", args)


def _run(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return
    spec_o = {"twostep": 3, "noconstant": 4, "inst": 3, "pre": 3, "endogenous": 4, "lags": 3, "maxldep": 4,
              "maxlags": 4, "diffvars": 5, "teffects": 2, "small": 2, "hascons": 4, "nolevel": 4,
              "dgmmiv": 4, "lgmmiv": 4, "div": 3, "liv": 3, "h": 1, "artests": 3, "coldiag": 4, "vce": 3}
    if cmd == "xtdpd":
        spec_o = {k: v for k, v in spec_o.items() if k in ("twostep", "noconstant", "dgmmiv", "lgmmiv", "div", "liv",
                                                           "h", "artests", "hascons", "vce")}
    else:
        spec_o = {k: v for k, v in spec_o.items() if k not in ("dgmmiv", "lgmmiv", "div", "liv", "h")}
    # first pass: the option names without the model, to read the variable lists
    m = re.match(r"^(.*?)(,.*)?$", args, re.S)
    body, optxt = m.group(1), (m.group(2) or "")
    o0 = match_options(optxt[1:], dict(spec_o, robust=1, level=1)) if optxt.strip(" ,") else {}
    for bad in ("diffvars", "teffects", "small", "coldiag", "h"):
        if o0.get(bad):
            raise StataError(198, f"option {bad} is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    pre = _varlist(s, o0.get("pre"))
    endo = _varlist(s, o0.get("endogenous"))
    inst = _varlist(s, o0.get("inst"))
    extra = " ".join(pre + endo + inst + _varlist(s, o0.get("dgmmiv")) + _varlist(s, o0.get("lgmmiv"))
                     + _varlist(s, o0.get("div")) + _varlist(s, o0.get("liv")))
    opts = {k: v for k, v in spec_o.items() if k not in ("noconstant", "vce")}
    smp = Sample(s, args, opts_spec=opts, weights=(), extra_vars=extra)
    o = smp.o
    if smp.vce == "cluster":
        raise StataError(198, "option cluster() is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    robust = smp.vce == "robust"
    twostep = bool(o.get("twostep"))
    ds = s.data
    pvar, info = panel_info(ds), ts_info(ds)
    if not pvar or info is None or not info.tvar:
        raise StataError(459, "panel variable not set; use xtset panelvar timevar ...")
    ids = ds.get(pvar).data[smp.mask]
    uniq, inv = np.unique(ids, return_inverse=True)
    G = len(uniq)
    tv = ds.get(info.tvar).data[smp.mask].astype(float)
    # the time axis starts at the first period of the data, not at the first period of the sample
    # (the sample loses the first period when a lag is a regressor)
    t_full = ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    t_ok = (t_full < SYS) & (ds.get(pvar).data < SYS)
    t0 = float(t_full[t_ok].min())
    tix = np.rint((tv - t0) / (info.delta or 1.0)).astype(int)
    Tg = int(np.rint((t_full[t_ok].max() - t0) / (info.delta or 1.0))) + 1

    def grid(values):
        g = np.full((G, Tg), np.nan)
        g[inv, tix] = values
        return g
    y = grid(smp.y.astype(float))
    xcols = [c for c in smp.cols if c.values is not None]
    series: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
    reg_names: list[str] = []
    reg_series: list[np.ndarray] = []

    # instruments and lagged series come from every observation of the panel, not only from the
    # estimation sample (L.y is missing in the first period, which must still be a valid instrument)
    ids_all, t_all = ds.get(pvar).data, ds.get(info.tvar).data.astype(float)
    pos = np.searchsorted(uniq, ids_all)
    pos_ok = (pos < G) & (uniq[np.minimum(pos, G - 1)] == ids_all) & (ids_all < SYS) & (t_all < SYS)
    tix_all = np.rint((t_all - t0) / (info.delta or 1.0))
    pos_ok &= (tix_all >= 0) & (tix_all < Tg)

    def raw(name):
        if name not in series:
            g_ = np.full((G, Tg), np.nan)
            v_ = ds.get(name).data.astype(float)
            ok_ = pos_ok & (v_ < SYS)
            g_[pos[ok_], tix_all[ok_].astype(int)] = v_[ok_]
            series[name] = g_
        return series[name]

    def shift(a, j):
        out = np.full_like(a, np.nan)
        out[:, j:] = a[:, :Tg - j] if j else a
        return out
    sp = _Spec()
    # hascons: the constant is among the user's regressors, so none is added (VERIFY)
    sp.cons = not o.get("noconstant") and not o.get("hascons")
    artests = int(o["artests"]) if o.get("artests") not in (None, False, True) else 2
    if artests < 1:
        raise StataError(198, "artests() must be positive")                      # VERIFY
    lab_dgmm: list[str] = []
    lab_div: list[str] = []
    lab_lgmm: list[str] = []
    lab_liv: list[str] = []
    dname = smp.depname
    series[dname] = raw(dname)
    p = 1
    if cmd == "xtdpd":
        for c in xcols:
            if o.get("hascons") and np.ptp(c.values) == 0:
                # a constant regressor with hascons is dropped and the model gets _cons (compat 1914)
                s.output.write(f"note: {c.name} dropped because of collinearity\n", "text")
                sp.cons = not o.get("noconstant")
                continue
            reg_names.append(c.name)
            reg_series.append(grid(c.values))
        dg, lg = o0.get("dgmmiv"), o0.get("lgmmiv")
        for v in _varlist(s, dg):
            a, b = _lagrange(dg, (2, None))
            sp.dgmm.append((v, a, b))
            lab_dgmm.append(_lab(a, b, v))
        for v in _varlist(s, lg):
            a, b = _lagrange(lg, (1, 1))
            sp.lgmm.append((v, a, b))
            lab_lgmm.append(_lab(a, b, v, True))
        for v in _varlist(s, o0.get("div")):
            sp.div.append(v)
            lab_div.append("D." + v)
        for v in _varlist(s, o0.get("liv")):
            sp.liv.append(v)
            lab_liv.append(v)
        sp.level = bool(sp.lgmm or sp.liv)
        for v in sp.dgmm:
            raw(v[0])
        title = "Dynamic panel-data estimation"
    else:
        p = int(o["lags"]) if o.get("lags") not in (None, False, True) else 1
        if p < 1:
            raise StataError(198, "lags() must be positive")                # VERIFY
        maxldep = int(o["maxldep"]) if o.get("maxldep") not in (None, False, True) else None
        maxlags = int(o["maxlags"]) if o.get("maxlags") not in (None, False, True) else None
        for j in range(1, p + 1):
            reg_names.append(f"L{j}.{dname}" if j > 0 else dname)
            reg_series.append(shift(y, j))
        sp.dgmm.append((dname, 2, None if maxldep is None else maxldep + 1))
        lab_dgmm.append(_lab(2, None if maxldep is None else maxldep + 1, dname))
        for v in pre:
            reg_names.append(v)
            reg_series.append(raw(v))
            sp.dgmm.append((v, 1, maxlags))
            lab_dgmm.append(_lab(1, maxlags, v))
        for v in endo:
            reg_names.append(v)
            reg_series.append(raw(v))
            sp.dgmm.append((v, 2, None if maxlags is None else maxlags + 1))
            lab_dgmm.append(_lab(2, None if maxlags is None else maxlags + 1, v))
        # VERIFY: predetermined and endogenous variables come before the strictly exogenous ones
        for c in xcols:
            reg_names.append(c.name)
            reg_series.append(grid(c.values))
            sp.div.append(c.name)
            series[c.name] = reg_series[-1]
            lab_div.append("D." + c.name)
        for v in inst:
            sp.div.append(v)
            raw(v)
            lab_div.append("D." + v)
        if cmd == "xtdpdsys":
            sp.level = True
            sp.lgmm.append((dname, 1, 1))
            lab_lgmm.append(f"LD.{dname}")
            title = "System dynamic panel-data estimation"
        else:
            title = "Arellano-Bond dynamic panel-data estimation"
    k = len(reg_names) + (1 if sp.cons else 0)
    # ---- equations and instruments per panel
    gmm_keys: dict[tuple, int] = {}
    std_cols: list[str] = []
    nstd = len(sp.div) + len(sp.liv) + (1 if sp.cons else 0)
    rows_X, rows_y, rows_Z, rows_H, rows_t = [], [], [], [], []
    sparse: list[list[tuple[int, int, float]]] = []     # (row, col, value) per panel
    samp_counts: list[int] = []                         # observations per panel as the header reports them
    for g in range(G):
        X_i, y_i, t_i, ent = [], [], [], []
        lvl_rows = []
        for t in range(1, Tg):
            vals = [r[g, t] - r[g, t - 1] for r in reg_series]
            dy = y[g, t] - y[g, t - 1]
            if np.isnan(dy) or any(np.isnan(v) for v in vals):
                continue
            row = vals + ([0.0] if sp.cons else [])
            X_i.append(row)
            y_i.append(dy)
            t_i.append(t)
            e = []
            for key, (v, a, b) in enumerate(sp.dgmm):
                arr = series[v]
                hi = t if b is None else min(b, t)
                for l in range(a, hi + 1):
                    val = arr[g, t - l]
                    if not np.isnan(val):
                        col = gmm_keys.setdefault(("d", key, t, l), len(gmm_keys))
                        e.append((col, val))
            ent.append(e)
        nd = len(X_i)
        lvl_t = []
        n_samp = nd
        if sp.level or sp.cons:
            n_samp = 0
            # VERIFY: without a level equation the constant gets its own level equation, instrumented by
            # the constant alone (it is listed under "Instruments for level equation" in the 1905 log)
            for t in range(1, Tg):
                vals = [r[g, t] for r in reg_series]
                if np.isnan(y[g, t]) or any(np.isnan(v) for v in vals):
                    continue
                n_samp += 1
                inst_ok = True
                e = []
                for key, (v, a, b) in enumerate(sp.lgmm):
                    arr = series[v] if v in series else raw(v)
                    hi = t - 1 if b is None else min(b, t - 1)
                    got = False
                    for l in range(a, hi + 1):
                        if t - l - 1 >= 0:
                            val = arr[g, t - l] - arr[g, t - l - 1]
                            if not np.isnan(val):
                                col = gmm_keys.setdefault(("l", key, t, l), len(gmm_keys))
                                e.append((col, val))
                                got = True
                    inst_ok = inst_ok and got
                X_i.append(vals + ([1.0] if sp.cons else []))
                y_i.append(y[g, t])
                lvl_t.append(t)
                ent.append(e)
        if not X_i:
            continue
        rows_X.append(np.array(X_i, dtype=float))
        rows_y.append(np.array(y_i, dtype=float))
        rows_t.append(np.array(t_i + [-1] * len(lvl_t)))
        # standard instruments
        std = np.zeros((len(X_i), nstd))
        for r, t in enumerate(t_i):
            j = 0
            for v in sp.div:
                a = series[v] if v in series else raw(v)
                d = a[g, t] - a[g, t - 1]
                std[r, j] = 0.0 if np.isnan(d) else d
                j += 1
            j += len(sp.liv)
        for r2, t in enumerate(lvl_t):
            r = nd + r2
            j = len(sp.div)
            for v in sp.liv:
                a = series[v] if v in series else raw(v)
                std[r, j] = 0.0 if np.isnan(a[g, t]) else a[g, t]
                j += 1
            if sp.cons:
                std[r, j] = 1.0
        sparse.append((ent, std, nd, len(X_i)))
        samp_counts.append(nd if cmd == "xtabond" else n_samp)
    if not rows_X:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    ncols = len(gmm_keys)
    Zs, Hs = [], []
    for (ent, std, nd, n_i), t_i in zip(sparse, rows_t):
        Zg = np.zeros((n_i, ncols))
        for r, e in enumerate(ent):
            for col, val in e:
                Zg[r, col] = val
        Zs.append(np.hstack([Zg, std]))
        Hd = pg.tridiagonal(t_i[:nd])
        H = np.zeros((n_i, n_i))
        H[:nd, :nd] = Hd
        if n_i > nd:
            H[nd:, nd:] = np.eye(n_i - nd)
        Hs.append(H)
    # drop instruments that are zero in every panel
    keep = np.flatnonzero(np.any([np.any(z != 0, axis=0) for z in Zs], axis=0))
    Zs = [z[:, keep] for z in Zs]
    # and those equal to an earlier one in every panel (liv(one) with hascons, next to _cons:
    # compat 1914)
    stacked = np.vstack(Zs)
    uniq_cols = [j for j in range(stacked.shape[1])
                 if not any(np.array_equal(stacked[:, j], stacked[:, i]) for i in range(j))]
    Zs = [z[:, uniq_cols] for z in Zs]
    X, yv = rows_X, rows_y
    if len(keep) < k:
        raise StataError(481, "equation not identified; fewer instruments than parameters")   # VERIFY
    fit = pg.gmm_fit(X, yv, Zs, Hs, twostep, robust, nd=[sp_[2] for sp_ in sparse])
    b, V = fit["b"], fit["V"]
    Gu = len(X)
    # VERIFY: xtabond reports the rows of the differenced equation, xtdpd and xtdpdsys the observations of
    # the sample (1905 log)
    counts = np.array(samp_counts)
    nobs = int(counts.sum())
    names = list(reg_names) + (["_cons"] if sp.cons else [])
    slopes = list(range(len(reg_names)))
    try:
        chi2 = float(b[slopes] @ np.linalg.solve(V[np.ix_(slopes, slopes)], b[slopes]))
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        chi2 = SYS
    pchi = chi2_tail(chi2, len(slopes)) if chi2 < SYS else SYS
    # table rows: the lags of the dependent variable under its name, as Stata does
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
    rows: list[CoefRow] = []
    last_var = None
    for j, nm in enumerate(names):
        mm = re.match(r"^L(\d*)\.(.+)$", nm)
        var, lab = (mm.group(2), f"L{mm.group(1) or 1}.") if mm else (None, nm)
        if var is not None and var != last_var:
            rows.append(CoefRow("header", var))
        elif var is None and last_var is not None:
            rows.append(CoefRow("blank"))
        rows.append(CoefRow("coef", lab, b[j], se[j]))
        last_var = var
    est = Estimates(cmd, dname, names, b, V, nobs, "z", None)
    est.rows = rows
    est.eqnames = [dname] * len(names)
    est.level, est.vcetype, est.constant = smp.level, "", sp.cons
    est.cols, est.terms, est.depcomp = [], [], smp.depcomp
    L = Zs[0].shape[1]
    x = dict(N=nobs, G=Gu, tmin=int(counts.min()), tavg=float(counts.mean()), tmax=int(counts.max()), L=L,
             chi2=chi2, p=pchi, df=len(slopes), twostep=twostep, robust=robust, title=title, pvar=pvar, cmd=cmd,
             tvar=info.tvar, dgmm=lab_dgmm, div=lab_div, lgmm=lab_lgmm, liv=lab_liv, cons=sp.cons, level=sp.level,
             artests=artests)
    est.extra = x
    est.display = _display
    est.estat = {"abond": (2, lambda ss, ee, rest: _estat_abond(ss, ee, rest, fit, X, Zs, rows_t)),
                 "sargan": (3, lambda ss, ee, rest: _estat_sargan(ss, ee, fit, Zs, twostep, robust))}
    if cmd == "xtabond":
        # e() in the order of Stata's ereturn list (compat 1914); rss is 2 (N - k) sigma2, the
        # differenced errors having twice the variance (VERIFY)
        from ..commands.datacmds import _signature
        from .results import post as _post
        arm = [pg.ar_test(j, fit, X, Zs, rows_t)[0] for j in range(1, artests + 1)]
        sc = [("rank", float(k)), ("sig2", fit["sigma2"]), ("rss", 2 * (nobs - k) * fit["sigma2"]), ("N", float(nobs)),
              ("N_g", float(Gu)), ("g_min", float(counts.min())), ("g_max", float(counts.max())),
              ("g_avg", float(counts.mean())), ("t_min", t0), ("t_max", t0 + (Tg - 1) * (info.delta or 1.0)),
              ("chi2", chi2), ("df_m", float(len(slopes))), ("zrank", float(L)), ("artests", float(artests))]
        sc += [(f"arm{j}", z) for j, z in enumerate(arm, 1)]
        mc = [("cmdline", cmdline(cmd, args)), ("cmd", cmd), ("estat_cmd", "xtdpd_estat"), ("marginsok", "XB default"),
              ("predict", "xtdpd_p"), ("depvar", dname), ("transform", "difference"), ("hascons", "hascons"),
              ("tvar", info.tvar), ("ivar", pvar), ("datasignature", _signature(ds)), ("system", "system"),
              ("vce", "robust" if robust else "gmm"), ("vcetype", "Robust" if robust else ""), ("properties", "b V")]
        _post(s, est, sc, mc, smp.mask)
        _display(s, est)
        return
    sc = [("N", float(nobs)), ("N_g", float(Gu)), ("df_m", float(len(slopes))), ("g_min", float(counts.min())),
          ("g_avg", float(counts.mean())), ("g_max", float(counts.max())), ("t_min", float(Tg)), ("chi2", chi2),
          ("sig2", fit["sigma2"]), ("zrank", float(L)), ("rank", float(k)), ("artests", float(artests))]   # VERIFY
    mc = [("cmdline", cmdline(cmd, args)), ("cmd", cmd), ("depvar", dname), ("ivar", pvar), ("tvar", info.tvar),
          ("vce", "robust" if robust else "gmm"), ("twostep", "twostep" if twostep else "onestep"),
          ("title", title), ("properties", "b V"), ("estat_cmd", "xtdpd_estat"), ("predict", "xtdpd_p")]
    post(s, est, list(reversed(sc)), list(reversed(mc)), smp.mask)
    _display(s, est)


def _display(s, est, *, header=True, table=True, level=None, **_kw):
    out, x = s.output, est.extra
    if header:
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{x['title']:<48}{'Number of obs':<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{comma(x['N']):>10}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"{'Group variable: ' + x['pvar']:<48}{'Number of groups':<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{comma(x['G']):>10}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"Time variable: {x['tvar']}\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'':<48}Obs per group:\n", "text")
        for lab, v in (("min", _g(x["tmin"])), ("avg", _g(x["tavg"])), ("max", _g(x["tmax"]))):
            out.write(f"{'':<62}{lab} = ", "text")
            out.write(f"{v:>10}\n", "result")
        out.write("\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Number of instruments = ' + format(x['L'], '6d'):<48}"
                  f"{'Wald chi2(' + str(x['df']) + ')':<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_g(x['chi2'], '%10.2f'):>10}\n", "result")
        out.write(f"{'':<48}{'Prob > chi2':<18}= ", "text")
        out.write(f"{_g(x['p'], '%10.4f'):>10}\n", "result")
        out.write(("Two-step results" if x["twostep"] else "One-step results") + "\n", "text")
        if x["robust"] and (x["cmd"] == "xtabond" or not x["twostep"]):
            # xtabond, and xtdpd in one step (compat 1914; not after twostep: compat 1905)
            out.write(f"{'(Std. Err. adjusted for clustering on ' + x['pvar'] + ')':>78}\n", "text")   # VERIFY
    if not table:
        return
    if x["twostep"] and not x["robust"]:
        out.write("Warning: gmm two-step standard errors are biased; robust standard errors are recommended.\n",
                  "text")        # VERIFY
    coef_table(s, est.depvar, est.rows, stat="z", df=None, level=level or est.level,
               vcetype="WC-Robust" if (x["twostep"] and x["robust"]) else ("Robust" if x["robust"] else ""),
               footer=False)
    out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
    out.write("Instruments for differenced equation\n", "text")
    if x["dgmm"]:
        out.write("        GMM-type: " + " ".join(x["dgmm"]) + "\n", "text")
    if x["div"]:
        out.write("        Standard: " + " ".join(x["div"]) + "\n", "text")
    if x["level"] or x["cons"]:
        out.write("Instruments for level equation\n", "text")
        if x["lgmm"]:
            out.write("        GMM-type: " + " ".join(x["lgmm"]) + "\n", "text")
        std = x["liv"] + (["_cons"] if x["cons"] else [])
        if std:
            out.write("        Standard: " + " ".join(std) + "\n", "text")


def _estat_abond(s, est, rest, fit, X, Z, times) -> None:
    m = re.search(r"artests\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)", rest)
    top = int(m.group(1)) if m else est.extra.get("artests", 2)
    x_ = est.extra
    if (x_["level"] or x_["cons"]) and not x_["twostep"] and not x_["robust"]:
        raise StataError(321, "artests not computed for one-step system estimator with vce(gmm)")   # VERIFY
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nArellano-Bond test for zero autocorrelation in first-differenced errors\n", "text")
    out.write("  +-----------------------+\n  |Order |  z     Prob > z|\n  |------+----------------|\n", "text")
    res = {}
    for j in range(1, top + 1):
        z, _ = pg.ar_test(j, fit, X, Z, times)
        pv = float(2 * (0.5 * math.erfc(abs(z) / math.sqrt(2)))) if np.isfinite(z) else SYS
        out.write(f"  |{j:>4}  |{_g(z, '%7.0g'):>7}  {pv:>6.4f} |\n", "result")
        res[j] = (z, pv)
    out.write("  +-----------------------+\n   H0: no autocorrelation \n", "text")
    s.r = {}
    for j, (z, pv) in res.items():
        s.r[f"ar{j}"] = z
        s.r[f"ar{j}_p"] = pv


def _estat_sargan(s, est, fit, Z, twostep, robust) -> None:
    if robust:
        raise StataError(321, "estat sargan is not valid after vce(robust)")       # VERIFY
    stat, df = pg.overid_test(fit, Z, twostep)
    pv = chi2_tail(stat, df) if df > 0 else SYS
    out = s.output
    out.write("\nSargan test of overidentifying restrictions\n", "text")
    out.write("        H0: overidentifying restrictions are valid\n\n", "text")
    out.write(f"        {'chi2(' + str(df) + ')':<13}= ", "text")
    out.write(f"{format(stat, '.6g'):>9}\n", "result")
    out.write(f"        Prob > chi2  = ", "text")
    out.write(f"{_g(pv, '%9.4f'):>9}\n", "result")
    s.r = {"chi2": stat, "df": float(df), "p": pv}

"""xtfrontier: stochastic frontier models for panel data ([XT] xtfrontier).

The likelihood is in core/panelfrontier.py. Models: ti (time-invariant inefficiency, the default)
and tvd (time-varying decay). The layout of the table follows the manual's description; details
not settled by it carry a VERIFY mark and the case is in compat 1905."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import panelfrontier as pf
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..core.panelquad import Groups
from .ml import print_log
from .panel2 import _finish, _Panel
from .results import CoefRow, crit
from .tsops import ts_info
from .xtre import _numeric_fun, _vce

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS


def cmd_xtfrontier(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, "xtfrontier", args)
        return
    P = _Panel(s, "xtfrontier", args, extra_opts={"ti": 2, "tvd": 3, "cost": 2, "t": 1}, constant=None)
    o, pr, out = P.pr.o, P.pr, s.output
    if not o.get("ti") and not o.get("tvd"):
        raise StataError(198, "either ti or tvd must be specified")               # as in the 1905 log
    if o.get("ti") and o.get("tvd"):
        raise StataError(198, "only one of ti or tvd may be specified")           # VERIFY
    if o.get("fe") or o.get("re") or o.get("pa"):
        raise StataError(198, "option fe not allowed")                             # VERIFY
    tvd = bool(o.get("tvd"))
    cost = bool(o.get("cost"))
    ds = s.data
    info = ts_info(ds)
    tvar = str(o["t"]).strip() if isinstance(o.get("t"), str) else (info.tvar if info is not None else "")
    if not tvar:
        raise StataError(459, "time variable not set; use xtset panelvar timevar ...")
    delta = 1.0 if isinstance(o.get("t"), str) or info is None else info.delta
    t = ds.get(tvar).data[pr.smp.mask].astype(float)
    tidx = np.rint((t - t.min()) / (delta or 1.0)).astype(int)
    pr.write_notes(out)
    y = P.y
    X = np.column_stack([pr.X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else pr.X
    k = X.shape[1]
    grp = Groups(P.inv)
    d1 = np.ones(len(y))

    def unpack(par):
        b = par[:k]
        mu = par[k]
        j = k + 1
        eta = 0.0
        if tvd:
            eta = par[j]
            j += 1
        l2, lg = par[j], par[j + 1]
        s2 = math.exp(min(max(l2, -700), 700))
        g = 1 / (1 + math.exp(-lg))
        return b, mu, eta, s2, g

    def llg(par):
        b, mu, eta, s2, g = unpack(par)
        su2, sv2 = g * s2, (1 - g) * s2
        if su2 <= 0 or sv2 <= 0:
            return np.full(grp.G, -np.inf)
        d = pf.decay(tidx, grp, eta) if tvd else d1
        return pf.group_loglik(y - X @ b, d, grp, mu, su2, sv2, cost)

    def ll(par):
        v = float(llg(par).sum())
        return v if np.isfinite(v) else -np.inf
    b0 = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0]
    s2_0 = float(np.mean((y - X @ b0) ** 2)) or 1.0
    if pr.constant:
        b0[-1] += (-1 if cost else 1) * math.sqrt(2 / math.pi) * math.sqrt(0.5 * s2_0)
    start = np.concatenate([b0, [0.0], [0.0] if tvd else [], [math.log(s2_0), 0.0]])
    res = pr.maximize(_numeric_fun(ll), start)
    if not o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    V, robust = _vce(P, llg, res, grp)
    b, mu, eta, s2, g = unpack(res.b)
    n = len(res.b)
    j_mu = k
    j_eta = k + 1 if tvd else None
    j_l2 = n - 2
    j_lg = n - 1
    se = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(V), 0))
    z = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)

    def delta_se(grad):
        gr = np.zeros(n)
        for idx, v in grad.items():
            gr[idx] = v
        return float(math.sqrt(max(gr @ V @ gr, 0)))
    su2, sv2 = g * s2, (1 - g) * s2
    dg = g * (1 - g)
    aux = [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("aux", "/mu", mu, se[j_mu], name="mu")]
    names_extra = ["/mu"]
    if tvd:
        aux.append(CoefRow("aux", "/eta", eta, se[j_eta], name="eta"))
        names_extra.append("/eta")
    aux += [CoefRow("aux", "/lnsigma2", res.b[j_l2], se[j_l2], name="lnsigma2"),
            CoefRow("aux", "/ilgtgamma", res.b[j_lg], se[j_lg], name="ilgtgamma"), CoefRow("sep")]
    names_extra += ["/lnsigma2", "/ilgtgamma"]
    se_s2 = delta_se({j_l2: s2})
    se_g = delta_se({j_lg: dg})
    se_su = delta_se({j_l2: su2, j_lg: s2 * dg})
    se_sv = delta_se({j_l2: sv2, j_lg: -s2 * dg})
    for nm, val, sev in (("sigma2", s2, se_s2), ("gamma", g, se_g), ("sigma_u2", su2, se_su), ("sigma_v2", sv2, se_sv)):
        aux.append(CoefRow("aux", nm, val, sev, name=nm))
    title = "Time-varying decay inefficiency model" if tvd else "Time-invariant inefficiency model"
    sub = f"Time variable: {tvar}"
    extra_sc = [("sigma2", s2), ("gamma", g), ("sigma_u2", su2), ("sigma_v2", sv2), ("mu", mu)]
    if tvd:
        extra_sc.append(("eta", eta))
    _finish(s, P, "xtfrontier", args, res.b, V, res, names_extra, title, sub, np.ones(len(y), bool),
            aux_rows=aux, robust=robust, extra_scalars=extra_sc,
            extra_macros=[("function", "cost" if cost else "production"), ("tvar", tvar),
                          ("model", "tvd" if tvd else "ti")])
