def _ordered_re(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str, logistic: bool) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return
    P = _Panel(s, cmd, args, constant=False)
    _no_fe(P, cmd)
    pr = P.pr
    out = s.output
    pr.write_notes(out)
    nq, adaptive, meth = _quad_options(P)
    y = P.y
    levels = sorted(set(y.tolist()))
    J = len(levels)
    if J < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "outcome does not vary")                   # VERIFY
    yi = np.searchsorted(levels, y)
    X = pr.X
    k = X.shape[1]
    grp = pq.Groups(P.inv)
    Finv = special.logit if logistic else st.norm.ppf

    def llg(par):
        cuts = par[k:k + J - 1]
        if np.any(np.diff(cuts) <= 0):
            return np.full(grp.G, -np.inf)
        f = lambda u: pq.ll_ordered(u, yi, cuts, logistic)         # noqa: E731
        return pq.re_loglik_groups(f, X @ par[:k], grp, math.exp(0.5 * par[-1]), nq, adaptive)

    def ll(par):
        return float(llg(par).sum())

    def ll_pooled(b):
        cuts = b[k:]
        if np.any(np.diff(cuts) <= 0):
            return -np.inf
        return float(pq.ll_ordered(X @ b[:k], yi, cuts, logistic).sum())
    cum = np.array([np.mean(yi <= j) for j in range(J - 1)])
    rl = maximize(_numeric_fun(ll_pooled), np.concatenate([np.zeros(k), Finv(cum)]))
    # starting value of the variance: sigma2_u = 1 with the pooled estimates ("Grid node 0" of
    # compat 1905; for xtoprobit it is not the best of a small grid)
    base = rl.b
    best_ls = 0.0
    best_ll = ll(np.concatenate([base, [best_ls]]))
    res = pr.maximize(_numeric_fun(ll), np.concatenate([base, [best_ls]]))
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting comparison model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, rl, "log likelihood")
        out.write("\nRefining starting values:\n\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{'Grid node 0:':<14} log likelihood = {_g(best_ll):>10}\n", "text")
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    V, robust = _vce(P, llg, res, grp)
    # sigma2_u is reported in levels (Stata estimates it directly)
    l2 = float(res.b[-1])
    s2 = math.exp(l2)
    Jm = np.eye(len(res.b))
    Jm[-1, -1] = s2
    Vl = Jm @ V @ Jm.T
    b_rep = res.b.copy()
    b_rep[-1] = s2
    se_s2 = float(np.sqrt(Vl[-1, -1]))
    z = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    aux = [CoefRow("sep")]
    for j in range(J - 1):
        aux.append(CoefRow("coef", f"/cut{j + 1}", float(res.b[k + j]), float(np.sqrt(V[k + j, k + j])),
                           name=f"cut{j + 1}"))
    se_l2 = float(np.sqrt(V[-1, -1]))
    aux += [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("aux", "/sigma2_u", s2, se_s2, name="sigma2_u",
                                    eq=f"{math.exp(l2 - z * se_l2)} {math.exp(l2 + z * se_l2)}")]
    chib = max(2 * (res.ll - rl.ll), 0.0)
    pchib = 0.5 * chi2_tail(chib, 1) if chib > 0 else 0.5
    name = "ologit" if logistic else "oprobit"
    title = "Random-effects ordered logistic regression" if logistic else "Random-effects ordered probit regression"
    _finish(s, P, cmd, args, b_rep, Vl, res, [f"/cut{j + 1}" for j in range(J - 1)] + ["/sigma2_u"], title,
            "Random effects u_i ~ Gaussian", np.ones(len(y), bool),
            chibar=(f"LR test vs. {name} model", chib, pchib, 54, 4), aux_rows=aux, intpoints=nq, intmethod=meth,
            robust=robust, extra_scalars=[("sigma2_u", s2), ("ll_c", rl.ll), ("chi2_c", chib), ("p_c", pchib),
                                          ("k_cat", float(J))],
            extra_macros=[("distrib", "Gaussian")])
    _remember(s, cmd, args, nq, adaptive, res.ll, res.b)

def _limit(s, v, default):
    if v is None or v is False:
        return None
    if v is True or str(v).strip() == "":
        return default
    return float(s.eval(str(v)))


def _censored_re(s: "Session", cmd: str, args: str, interval: bool) -> None:
    from .postest import replay
    if not args.strip() or args.strip().startswith(","):
        replay(s, cmd, args)
        return
    ds = s.data
    opts = {"ll": 2, "ul": 2} if not interval else {}
    if interval:
        parts = args.split(None, 2)
        if len(parts) < 2 or parts[1].startswith(","):
            raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
        dep1, dep2 = parts[0], parts[1]
        rest = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
        P = _Panel(s, cmd, rest if rest.strip() and not rest.lstrip().startswith(",") else " " + rest,
                   extra_opts=opts, need_dep=False)
        from ..core.varlist import resolve_name
        n1, n2 = resolve_name(ds, dep1), resolve_name(ds, dep2)
        mask = P.pr.smp.mask
        y1 = ds.get(n1).data[mask].astype(float)
        y2 = ds.get(n2).data[mask].astype(float)
        y1 = np.where(y1 >= SYS, np.nan, y1)
        y2 = np.where(y2 >= SYS, np.nan, y2)
        P.pr.smp.depname = n1
        P.pr.smp.depcomp = None
    else:
        P = _Panel(s, cmd, args, extra_opts=opts)
        y = P.y
    _no_fe(P, cmd)
    pr = P.pr
    out = s.output
    pr.write_notes(out)
    nq, adaptive, meth = _quad_options(P)
    if interval:
        keep = ~(np.isnan(y1) & np.isnan(y2))
        if np.any(np.isnan(y1) & np.isnan(y2)):
            pass
        lo = hi = None
    else:
        lo = _limit(s, pr.o.get("ll"), float(y.min()))
        hi = _limit(s, pr.o.get("ul"), float(y.max()))
        if lo is None and hi is None and not interval:
            pass
        keep = np.ones(len(y), bool)
    Xc = np.column_stack([pr.X, np.ones(len(keep))]) if pr.constant else pr.X
    Xc = Xc[keep]
    inv_all = P.inv[keep]
    _, inv = np.unique(inv_all, return_inverse=True)
    grp = pq.Groups(inv)
    k = Xc.shape[1]
    if interval:
        a1, a2 = y1[keep], y2[keep]
        left = np.isnan(a1)
        right = np.isnan(a2)
        point = ~left & ~right & (a1 == a2)
        intv = ~left & ~right & (a1 != a2)
        unc = point
        yy = None
    else:
        yy = y[keep]
        left = (yy <= lo) if lo is not None else np.zeros(len(yy), bool)
        right = (yy >= hi) if hi is not None else np.zeros(len(yy), bool)
        unc = ~(left | right)
        intv = np.zeros(len(yy), bool)

    def obs_f(sig_e):
        if interval:
            return lambda u: pq.ll_interval(u, a1, a2, sig_e)
        return lambda u: pq.ll_tobit(u, yy, sig_e, lo, hi)

    def llg(par):
        return pq.re_loglik_groups(obs_f(math.exp(par[k + 1])), Xc @ par[:k], grp, math.exp(par[k]), nq,
                                   adaptive)

    def ll(par):
        return float(llg(par).sum())

    def ll_pooled(b):
        return float(obs_f(math.exp(b[k]))(Xc @ b[:k]).sum())
    # starting values: least squares on the points (or the midpoints), then the pooled tobit
    if interval:
        mid = np.where(left, a2, np.where(right, a1, (a1 + a2) / 2))
    else:
        mid = yy
    beta0, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xc, mid, rcond=None)
    sd0 = float(np.std(mid - Xc @ beta0)) or 1.0
    rl = maximize(_numeric_fun(ll_pooled), np.concatenate([beta0, [math.log(sd0)]]))
    se0 = math.exp(rl.b[k])
    # standard deviation of the effect: the best of a few values with the pooled coefficients
    cand = [se0 * m for m in (0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0)]
    vals = [ll(np.concatenate([rl.b[:k], [math.log(c), rl.b[k]]])) for c in cand]
    su0 = cand[int(np.argmax(vals))]
    start = np.concatenate([rl.b[:k], [math.log(su0), rl.b[k]]])
    res = pr.maximize(_numeric_fun(ll), start)
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        # Stata first fits a model for the starting values (its likelihood is not the pooled tobit's:
        # -492.07 where the pooled fit gives -545.44), then the full model (compat 1905)
        out.write("\nObtaining starting values for full model:\n\n", "text")      # VERIFY
        print_log(out, rl, "log likelihood")
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    Vl, robust = _vce(P, llg, res, grp)
    su, se_ = math.exp(res.b[k]), math.exp(res.b[k + 1])
    Jm = np.eye(len(res.b))
    Jm[k, k], Jm[k + 1, k + 1] = su, se_
    V = Jm @ Vl @ Jm.T
    b_rep = res.b.copy()
    b_rep[k], b_rep[k + 1] = su, se_
    rho = su ** 2 / (su ** 2 + se_ ** 2)
    g_ = np.array([2 * rho * (1 - rho), -2 * rho * (1 - rho)])
    se_rho = float(math.sqrt(g_ @ Vl[k:k + 2, k:k + 2] @ g_))
    # the interval of rho is built on the probit scale (found in compat 1905: the logit scale does not match)
    lr = float(st.norm.ppf(rho))
    se_lr = se_rho / float(st.norm.pdf(lr))
    z = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    aux = [CoefRow("sep"),
           CoefRow("coef", "/sigma_u", su, float(np.sqrt(V[k, k])), name="sigma_u"),
           CoefRow("coef", "/sigma_e", se_, float(np.sqrt(V[k + 1, k + 1])), name="sigma_e"),
           CoefRow("sep"),
           CoefRow("aux", "rho", rho, se_rho,
                   eq=f"{float(st.norm.cdf(lr - z * se_lr))} {float(st.norm.cdf(lr + z * se_lr))}")]
    chib = max(2 * (res.ll - rl.ll), 0.0)
    pchib = 0.5 * chi2_tail(chib, 1) if chib > 0 else 0.5
    counts = (int(left.sum()), int(unc.sum()), int(right.sum()), int(intv.sum()))

    def footer(ss, ee):
        nl, nu, nr, ni = counts
        w = ss.output
        w.write(f"{nl:>14,}  left-censored observations\n", "text")
        w.write(f"{nu:>14,}     uncensored observations\n", "text")
        w.write(f"{nr:>14,} right-censored observations\n", "text")
        if interval:
            w.write(f"{ni:>14,}       interval observations\n", "text")
    title = "Random-effects interval regression" if interval else "Random-effects tobit regression"
    sc = [("sigma_u", su), ("sigma_e", se_), ("rho", rho), ("ll_c", rl.ll), ("chi2_c", chib), ("p_c", pchib),
          ("N_lc", float(left.sum())), ("N_rc", float(right.sum())), ("N_unc", float(unc.sum()))]
    if interval:
        sc.append(("N_int", float(intv.sum())))
    else:
        if lo is not None:
            sc.append(("llopt", lo))
        if hi is not None:
            sc.append(("ulopt", hi))
    _finish(s, P, cmd, args, b_rep, V, res, ["/sigma_u", "/sigma_e"], title, "Random effects u_i ~ Gaussian",
            keep, aux_rows=aux, intpoints=nq, intmethod=meth,
            robust=robust, extra_scalars=sc, extra_macros=[("distrib", "Gaussian")], footer=footer)
    _remember(s, cmd, args, nq, adaptive, res.ll, res.b)

        drop_g = int((tot == 0).sum())
        if drop_g:
            out.write(f"note: {drop_g} group{'s' if drop_g > 1 else ''} ({int((~keep).sum())} obs) dropped because "
                      "of all zero outcomes\n", "text")
        Xk, yk, ok = X[keep], y[keep], off[keep]
        if pr.constant:
            # unlike the Poisson, the conditional negative binomial depends on the level of the means: _cons is estimated
            Xk = np.column_stack([Xk, np.ones(len(yk))])
            P.fe_cons = True
        _, invk = np.unique(inv[keep], return_inverse=True)
        grp = pq.Groups(invk)

        def llg(b):
            return pq.nbreg_fe_group_ll(np.exp(np.clip(Xk @ b + ok, -700, 700)), yk, grp)

        def ll(b):
            return float(llg(b).sum())
        Xp = Xk if pr.constant else np.column_stack([Xk, np.ones(len(yk))])
        pf, _ = _poisson(yk, Xp, np.ones(len(yk)), ok)
        rp = _max(pf, np.zeros(Xp.shape[1]))
        res = pr.maximize(_numeric_fun(ll), rp.b if pr.constant else rp.b[:-1])
        if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
            out.write("\n", "text")
            print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
        V, robust = _vce(P, llg, res, grp)
        _finish(s, P, "xtnbreg", args, res.b, V, res, [], "Conditional FE negative binomial regression", "", keep,
                eform=eform, robust=robust)
        return
    Xc = np.column_stack([X, np.ones(len(y))]) if pr.constant else X
    k = Xc.shape[1]
    grp = pq.Groups(inv)

    def llg(par):
        mu = np.exp(np.clip(Xc @ par[:k] + off, -700, 700))
        return pq.nbreg_re_group_ll(mu, y, grp, par[k], par[k + 1])

    def ll(par):
        return float(llg(par).sum())
    lg = special.gammaln
    lgy = lg(y + 1)

    def ll_c(b):
        # nbreg, dispersion(constant): variance mu (1 + delta); delta = exp(b[k])
        mu = np.exp(np.clip(Xc @ b[:k] + off, -700, 700))
        d = math.exp(b[k])
        lam = mu / d
        return float((lg(lam + y) - lg(lam) - lgy - lam * math.log1p(d) + y * (b[k] - math.log1p(d))).sum())
    pf, _ = _poisson(y, Xc, np.ones(len(y)), off)
    b0 = np.zeros(k)
    if pr.constant:
        b0[-1] = math.log(max(y.mean(), 1e-8))
    rp = _max(pf, b0)
    rc = _max(_numeric_fun(ll_c), np.concatenate([rp.b, [0.0]]))
    # the constant of the dispersion-constant model is ln(mu/lambda): the effect enters the other way
    bstart = rc.b[:k].copy()
    if pr.constant:
        bstart[-1] -= rc.b[k]
    best = None
    for lr_ in range(-1, 6):
        for ls_ in range(-1, 6):
            v = ll(np.concatenate([bstart, [lr_, ls_]]))
            if np.isfinite(v) and (best is None or v > best[0]):
                best = (v, lr_, ls_)
    res = pr.maximize(_numeric_fun(ll), np.concatenate([bstart, [best[1], best[2]]]))
    if not pr.o.get("nolog"):
        out.write("\nFitting negative binomial (constant dispersion) model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, rc, "log likelihood")
        out.write("\nFitting full model:\n\n", "text")
        print_log(out, res, "log likelihood")
    V, robust = _vce(P, llg, res, grp)
    lr_, ls_ = float(res.b[k]), float(res.b[k + 1])
    se_r, se_s = float(np.sqrt(V[k, k])), float(np.sqrt(V[k + 1, k + 1]))
    z = crit("z", pr.smp.level, None)
    r_, s_ = math.exp(lr_), math.exp(ls_)
    aux = [CoefRow("sep"), CoefRow("aux", "/ln_r", lr_, se_r, name="_cons"),
           CoefRow("aux", "/ln_s", ls_, se_s, name="_cons"), CoefRow("sep"),
           CoefRow("aux", "r", r_, r_ * se_r, eq=f"{_exp(lr_ - z * se_r)} {_exp(lr_ + z * se_r)}"),
           CoefRow("aux", "s", s_, s_ * se_s, eq=f"{_exp(ls_ - z * se_s)} {_exp(ls_ + z * se_s)}")]
    chib = max(2 * (res.ll - rc.ll), 0.0)
    pchib = 0.5 * chi2_tail(chib, 1) if chib > 0 else 0.5
    _finish(s, P, "xtnbreg", args, res.b, V, res, ["/ln_r", "/ln_s"], "Random-effects negative binomial regression",
            "Random effects u_i ~ Beta", np.ones(len(y), bool), chibar=("LR test vs. pooled", chib, pchib),
            aux_rows=aux, eform=eform, robust=robust,
            extra_scalars=[("r", r_), ("s", s_), ("ll_c", rc.ll), ("chi2_c", chib), ("p_c", pchib)])

def cmd_quadchk(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from .postest import _restore, _snapshot
    info = getattr(s, "_quadchk", None)
    est = getattr(s, "_estimates", None)
    if info is None or est is None or est.cmd != info["cmd"]:
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")
    head, _, opts = args.partition(",")
    nums = head.split()
    nq = info["nq"]
    if nums:
        try:
            n1, n2 = (int(v) for v in nums[:2]) if len(nums) >= 2 else (int(nums[0]), None)
        except ValueError:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
        if n2 is None:
            raise StataError(198, "invalid syntax")
    else:
        # VERIFY: Stata 14 gave 12 and 16 points for 8 fitted; the manual shows 8 and 16 for the
        # default 12. The rule between is unknown: n-4 and n+4 from 12 on, n+4 and n+8 below.
        n1, n2 = (nq - 4, nq + 4) if nq >= 12 else (nq + 4, nq + 8)
    show = "nooutput" not in opts.replace(" ", "").lower()
    snap = _snapshot(s)
    saved_info = dict(info)
    base_args = _drop_intpoints(info["args"])
    runs = [(nq, info["ll"], est.b.copy(), list(est.names), list(est.eqnames))]
    from ..commands.registry import lookup
    cmd_fn = lookup(info["cmd"]).fn
    out = s.output
    try:
        for n in (n1, n2):
            if show:
                out.write(f"\nRefitting model intpoints() = {n}\n", "text")
            run_args = f"{base_args}, intpoints({n})" if "," not in base_args else f"{base_args} intpoints({n})"
            s._qc_start = est.b.copy()
            try:
                if show:
                    cmd_fn(s, run_args)
                else:
                    with out.quietly():
                        cmd_fn(s, run_args)
            finally:
                s._qc_start = None
            e2 = s._estimates
            runs.append((n, float(s.e["ll"]), e2.b.copy(), list(e2.names), list(e2.eqnames)))
    finally:
        _restore(s, snap)
        s._quadchk = saved_info
    _quad_table(s, runs, est)


def _drop_intpoints(args: str) -> str:
    import re
    return re.sub(r"\bintpoints\s*\(\s*\d+\s*\)", "", args).rstrip()


def _quad_table(s, runs, est) -> None:
    from ..core.formats import format_value
    out = s.output

    def f(v):
        return format_value(float(v), "%10.0g", pad=False).strip()
    (n0, ll0, b0, names, eqs), (n1, ll1, b1, _, _), (n2, ll2, b2, _, _) = runs

    def row(label, a, b, c, tail=""):
        out.write(f"{label:<13}{a:>10}{b:>15}{c:>15}{tail}\n", "text")
    rule = "-" * 53
    out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 25 + "Quadrature check\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 15 + "Fitted" + " " * 7 + "Comparison" + " " * 5 + "Comparison\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 13 + "quadrature" + " " * 5 + "quadrature" + " " * 5 + "quadrature\n", "text")
    out.write(" " * 13 + f"{str(n0) + ' points':<15}{str(n1) + ' points':<15}{n2} points\n", "text")
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    row("Log", f(ll0), f(ll1), f(ll2))
    row("likelihood", "", f(ll1 - ll0), f(ll2 - ll0), "   Difference")
    row("", "", f((ll1 - ll0) / ll0), f((ll2 - ll0) / ll0), "   Relative difference")
    last_eq = None
    for i, nm in enumerate(names):
        eq = eqs[i] if i < len(eqs) else ""
        lab = {"/lnsig2u": "_cons"}.get(nm, nm)
        if nm == "/lnsig2u":
            eq = "lnsig2u"
        out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
        row(eq + ":", f(b0[i]), f(b1[i]), f(b2[i]))
        d1, d2 = b1[i] - b0[i], b2[i] - b0[i]
        out.write(f"{lab[:8]:>8}{'':>6}{'':>9}{f(d1):>15}{f(d2):>15}   Difference\n", "text")
        rel1 = d1 / b0[i] if b0[i] else float("nan")
        rel2 = d2 / b0[i] if b0[i] else float("nan")
        row("", "", f(rel1), f(rel2), "   Relative difference")
    out.write(rule + "\n", "text")
    out.write("\n", "text")

"""xtunitroot: panel unit-root tests ([XT] xtunitroot): ht, breitung, hadri and fisher.

The statistics are in core/panelroot.py. The layouts follow the manual's summary and carry a
VERIFY mark; the case is in compat 1905. llc and ips need the tabulated moments of the original
papers and are not available yet."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core import missing as M
from ..core import panelroot as pr
from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import match_options, parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from .tsmodels import mackinnon_p
from .tsops import panel_info, ts_info
from .results import g9

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session

SYS = M.SYSMISS
METHODS = ("llc", "ips", "fisher", "hadri", "breitung", "ht")


def _g(x, fmt="%9.4f") -> str:
    return g9(x, fmt)


def _matrix(s: "Session", name: str, mask: np.ndarray, require_balanced: bool):
    """Panels as rows of consecutive periods. Returns (Y, list of series for unbalanced use)."""
    ds = s.data
    pvar = panel_info(ds)
    info = ts_info(ds)
    if not pvar or info is None or not info.tvar:
        raise StataError(459, "panel variable not set; use xtset panelvar timevar ...")
    v = ds.get(name).data.astype(float)
    ok = mask & (v < SYS) & (ds.get(pvar).data < SYS) & (ds.get(info.tvar).data < SYS)
    ids = ds.get(pvar).data[ok]
    t = np.rint((ds.get(info.tvar).data[ok] - ds.get(info.tvar).data[ok].min()) / (info.delta or 1.0)).astype(int)
    y = v[ok]
    if len(y) == 0:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    uniq, inv = np.unique(ids, return_inverse=True)
    series = []
    for g in range(len(uniq)):
        m = inv == g
        o = np.argsort(t[m])
        tg, yg = t[m][o], y[m][o]
        if np.any(np.diff(tg) != 1):
            raise StataError(498, "panels contain gaps")           # VERIFY
        series.append(yg)
    lens = {len(x) for x in series}
    if require_balanced:
        if len(lens) != 1 or len({}) != 0:
            raise StataError(498, "xtunitroot requires strongly balanced data")   # VERIFY
        starts = set()
        for g in range(len(uniq)):
            starts.add(int(t[inv == g].min()))
        if len(starts) != 1:
            raise StataError(498, "xtunitroot requires strongly balanced data")   # VERIFY
        return np.vstack(series), series
    return None, series


def _header(out, title: str, name: str, left: list[str], right: list[str], extra_rule: int = 0) -> None:
    out.write(f"\n{title} for {name}\n", "text")
    out.write("-" * (len(f"{title} for {name}") + extra_rule) + "\n", "text")
    for lft, rgt in zip(left, right):
        out.write(f"{lft:<44}{rgt}".rstrip() + "\n", "text")


def cmd_xtunitroot(s: "Session", args: str) -> None:
    from ..commands._util import touse
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*(.*)$", args, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise StataError(198, "subcommand required")        # VERIFY
    sub = m.group(1).lower()
    rest = m.group(2)
    full = [x for x in METHODS if x.startswith(sub)]
    if sub in METHODS:
        full = [sub]
    if len(full) != 1:
        raise StataError(198, f"invalid subcommand {m.group(1)}")           # VERIFY
    sub = full[0]
    if sub in ("llc", "ips"):
        raise StataError(198, f"xtunitroot {sub} is not available yet in OpenDTA")
    spec = {"trend": 3, "noconstant": 4, "demean": 3, "lags": 3, "drift": 3, "robust": 3, "dfuller": 2,
            "pperron": 2, "noconstant": 4, "kernel": 3, "altt": 3}
    p = parse_standard(rest)
    o = match_options(p.options, spec) if p.options.strip() else {}
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if names else 102, "too many variables specified" if names else "varlist required")
    name = names[0]
    if o.get("altt"):
        raise StataError(198, "option not available yet in OpenDTA")
    if o.get("kernel") and sub != "hadri":
        raise StataError(198, "option kernel() not allowed")                      # VERIFY
    if sub == "fisher" and o.get("lags") in (None, True):
        raise StataError(198, "must specify lags()")                                # compat 1914
    if o.get("drift") and (sub != "fisher" or o.get("pperron") or o.get("trend") or o.get("noconstant")):
        raise StataError(198, "option drift may only be specified with dfuller, without trend or noconstant")  # VERIFY
    if sub == "fisher" and not o.get("dfuller") and not o.get("pperron"):
        raise StataError(198, "must specify one of dfuller or pperron")
    if sub == "hadri" and o.get("kernel") and o.get("robust"):
        raise StataError(198, "cannot specify both kernel() and robust")            # compat 1914
    mask = touse(s, p)
    out = s.output
    trend, const = bool(o.get("trend")), not o.get("noconstant")
    if trend and not const:
        raise StataError(198, "options trend and noconstant may not be combined")   # VERIFY
    Y, series = _matrix(s, name, mask, sub != "fisher" or bool(o.get("demean")))
    if o.get("demean"):
        if Y is None:
            raise StataError(498, "demean requires strongly balanced data")         # VERIFY
        Y = Y - Y.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
        series = list(Y)
    N = len(series)
    T = Y.shape[1] if Y is not None else None
    means = "Included" if const else "Not included"
    tr = "Included" if trend else "Not included"
    if sub == "ht":
        if trend:
            raise StataError(198, "option trend is not available yet for ht in OpenDTA")
        r = pr.harris_tzavalis(Y, const)
        _header(out, "Harris-Tzavalis unit-root test", name,
                ["Ho: Panels contain unit roots", "Ha: Panels are stationary", "",
                 "AR parameter: Common", f"Panel means:  {means}", f"Time trend:   {tr}"],
                [f"Number of panels  = {N:>6}", f"Number of periods = {T:>6}", "",
                 "Asymptotics: N -> Infinity", "             T Fixed", ""])
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write("                    Statistic         z         p-value\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{' rho':<20}{r['rho']:>8.4f}{r['z']:>14.4f}{r['p']:>13.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        s.r = {"N_g": float(N), "N_t": float(T), "rho": r["rho"], "z": r["z"], "p": r["p"]}
    elif sub == "breitung":
        if o.get("lags"):
            raise StataError(198, "option lags() is not available yet for breitung in OpenDTA")
        if not const:
            raise StataError(198, "option noconstant is not available for breitung")    # VERIFY
        r = pr.breitung(Y, trend)
        _header(out, "Breitung unit-root test", name,
                ["Ho: Panels contain unit roots", "Ha: Panels are stationary", "",
                 "AR parameter: Common", f"Panel means:  {means}", f"Time trend:   {tr}"],
                [f"Number of panels  = {N:>6}", f"Number of periods = {T:>6}", "",
                 "Asymptotics:  T,N -> Infinity", " " * 18 + "sequentially", "Prewhitening: Not performed"],
                extra_rule=2)
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write("                    Statistic      p-value\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{' lambda':<20}{r['lambda']:>8.4f}{r['p']:>14.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        s.r = {"N_g": float(N), "N_t": float(T), "lambda": r["lambda"], "p": r["p"]}
    elif sub == "hadri":
        kname, klags = "", 0
        if o.get("kernel") not in (None, True):
            kw = str(o["kernel"]).split()
            kname = {"ba": "bartlett", "bartlett": "bartlett", "pa": "parzen", "parzen": "parzen",
                     "qs": "quadraticspectral", "quadraticspectral": "quadraticspectral"}.get(kw[0].lower(), "")
            if not kname or len(kw) > 2 or (len(kw) == 2 and not kw[1].isdigit()):
                # VERIFY: the automatic lag choices (nwest, ...) are not available
                raise StataError(198, "kernel() must be bartlett, parzen or quadraticspectral with a number of lags")
            # without a number of lags Stata takes 1 with T = 20 (compat 1914; VERIFY: its rule)
            klags = int(kw[1]) if len(kw) == 2 else 1
        r = pr.hadri(Y, trend, bool(o.get("robust")), kname, klags)
        # with a kernel the heteroskedasticity line says Robust (compat 1914)
        lrv = {"bartlett": "Bartlett kernel", "parzen": "Parzen kernel",
               "quadraticspectral": "Quad. Spectral kernel"}.get(kname, "")
        if kname == "quadraticspectral":
            lrv += f", \n{'':<20}{klags:.2f} lags"
        elif kname:
            lrv += f", {klags} lag{'s' if klags != 1 else ''}"
        _header(out, "Hadri LM test", name,
                ["Ho: All panels are stationary", "Ha: Some panels contain unit roots", "",
                 f"{'Time trend:':<20}{tr}",
                 f"{'Heteroskedasticity:':<20}" + ("Robust" if o.get("robust") or kname else "Not robust"),
                 f"{'LR variance:':<20}" + (lrv if kname else "(not used)")],
                [f"Number of panels  = {N:>6}", f"Number of periods = {T:>6}", "",
                 "Asymptotics: T, N -> Infinity", " " * 18 + "sequentially", ""], extra_rule=2)
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write("                    Statistic      p-value\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(f"{' z':<20}{r['z']:>8.4f}{r['p']:>14.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        # in the order of return list (compat 1914)
        xi, zeta2 = (1 / 15, 11 / 6300) if trend else (1 / 6, 1 / 45)
        res = ([("lags", float(klags))] if kname else []) + [
            ("var", zeta2), ("mu", xi), ("p", r["p"]), ("z", r["z"]), ("N_t", float(T)), ("N_g", float(N)),
            ("N", float(N * T)), ("test", "hadri")] + ([("kernel", kname)] if kname else []) + [
            ("deterministics", "trend" if trend else "constant")]
        s.r = dict(reversed(res))
    else:
        pperron = bool(o.get("pperron"))
        drift = bool(o.get("drift"))
        if pperron and o.get("lags") in (None, False, True):
            raise StataError(198, "option lags() required with pperron")            # VERIFY
        lags = int(o["lags"]) if o.get("lags") not in (None, False, True) else 0
        ps = []
        for y in series:
            yy = y - 0.0
            try:
                if pperron:
                    from .tsunit import pp_stats
                    tau = pp_stats(yy, lags, trend, const)[1]
                elif drift:
                    tau, nn = pr.adf_tau(yy, lags, True, False)
                    # dfuller, drift: the t distribution with n - k degrees of freedom (VERIFY)
                    ps.append(float(st.t.cdf(tau, nn - lags - 2)))
                    continue
                else:
                    tau, _ = pr.adf_tau(yy, lags, const, trend)
            except (ValueError, np.linalg.LinAlgError):
                raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
            ps.append(mackinnon_p(tau, "ct" if trend else ("c" if const else "n")))
        r = pr.fisher_combine(np.array(ps))
        # the layout of compat 1914
        based = "Based on Phillips-Perron tests" if pperron else "Based on augmented Dickey-Fuller tests"
        out.write(f"\nFisher-type unit-root test for {name}\n{based}\n" + "-" * (len(based) + (2 if pperron else 0))
                  + "\n", "text")
        lens = [len(y) for y in series]
        per = (f"{'Number of periods':<18}= {lens[0]:>6}" if min(lens) == max(lens) else
               f"{'Avg. number of periods':<23}= {np.mean(lens):>6.2f}")                 # VERIFY: unbalanced
        lab = 17 if pperron else 14
        rows = [("Ho: All panels contain unit roots", f"{'Number of panels':<18}= {N:>6}"),
                ("Ha: At least one panel is stationary", per), ("", ""),
                (f"{'AR parameter:':<{lab}}Panel-specific", "Asymptotics: T -> Infinity"),
                (f"{'Panel means:':<{lab}}{means}", ""),
                (f"{'Time trend:':<{lab}}{tr}", "Cross-sectional means removed" if o.get("demean") else "")]
        ls = "" if lags == 1 else "s"
        rows.append((f"Newey-West lags: {lags} lag{ls}", "") if pperron else
                    (f"{'Drift term:':<{lab}}{'Included' if drift else 'Not included'}", f"ADF regressions: {lags} lag{ls}"))
        for lft, rgt in rows:
            out.write(f"{lft:<44}{rgt}".rstrip() + "\n", "text")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n" + " " * 34 + "Statistic      p-value\n" + "-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        for lab_, sym, key in ((f" Inverse chi-squared({r['df_P']})", "P", "P"), (" Inverse normal", "Z", "Z"),
                               (f" Inverse logit t({r['df_L']})", "L*", "L"),
                               (" Modified inv. chi-squared", "Pm", "Pm")):
            out.write(f"{lab_:<27}{sym:<3}", "text")
            out.write(f"{r[key]:>13.4f}{r['p_' + key]:>13.4f}\n", "result")
        out.write("-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        out.write(" P statistic requires number of panels to be finite.\n"
                  " Other statistics are suitable for finite or infinite number of panels.\n" + "-" * 78 + "\n", "text")
        opts_ = [w for w in ("noconstant", "trend", "drift", "demean") if o.get(w)] + [f"lags({lags})"]   # VERIFY: order

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

import numpy as np

from ..core.errors import StataError
from ..lang.syntax import parse_standard
from ..lazy import lazy
from . import data as D
from .model import Graph, Layer, Panel
from .opts import graph_options, split_layer_graph
from .twoway import layer_spec

st = lazy("scipy.stats")

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..session import Session


def _split(s: "Session", text: str, extra: dict):
    p = parse_standard(text)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, {**layer_spec(), **extra})
    return p, lopts, graw


def _own(lopts: dict, extra: dict) -> dict:
    """The layer options that are styles (not this command's own)."""
    return {k: v for k, v in lopts.items() if k not in extra}


def _vars(s: "Session", p, n: int) -> list[str]:
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) < n:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    if len(names) > n:
        raise StataError(103, "too many variables specified")
    return names


def _graph(s, graw, layers, xtitle, ytitle, legend_off=True, title=None, note=None):
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = xtitle, ytitle
    if legend_off:
        opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    if title:
        opts.setdefault("title", {"lines": [title]})
    if note:
        opts.setdefault("note", {"lines": [note]})
    return Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)])

def quantile(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Ordered values against the fraction of the data, (i - .5)/N ([R] diagnostic plots)."""
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"grid": 4})
    v = _vars(s, p, 1)[0]
    x = D.numeric(s, v)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x)
    xs = np.sort(x[mask])
    if len(xs) < 1:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    n = len(xs)
    frac = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.5) / n
    layers = [Layer("scatter", frac.tolist(), xs.tolist(), {}, _own(lopts, {"grid"}), D.var_title(s, v))]
    return _graph(s, graw, layers, "Fraction of the data", D.var_title(s, v)), graw


def symplot(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Distance above the median against distance below, for the pairs of ordered values
    equidistant from the median ([R] diagnostic plots)."""
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"grid": 4})
    v = _vars(s, p, 1)[0]
    x = D.numeric(s, v)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x)
    xs = np.sort(x[mask])
    n = len(xs)
    if n < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    med = float(np.median(xs))
    k = n // 2
    below = med - xs[:k]
    above = xs[::-1][:k] - med
    hi = float(max(below.max(), above.max()))
    layers = [Layer("scatter", below.tolist(), above.tolist(), {}, _own(lopts, {"grid"}), ""),
              Layer("line", [0.0, hi], [0.0, hi], {}, {"lcolor": "gs8"}, "")]
    g = _graph(s, graw, layers, "Distance below median", "Distance above median")
    return g, graw

def serrbar(s: "Session", text: str):
    """mvar +- scale*svar against xvar, with caps ([R] serrbar)."""
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"scale": 5, "rcapopts": 4})
    mv, sv, xv = _vars(s, p, 3)
    m, sd, x = D.numeric(s, mv), D.numeric(s, sv), D.numeric(s, xv)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(m) & D.valid(sd) & D.valid(x)
    scale = float(lopts["scale"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("scale"), str) else 1.0
    o = np.argsort(x[mask], kind="stable")
    xx, mm, ss = x[mask][o], m[mask][o], sd[mask][o]
    style = _own(lopts, {"scale", "rcapopts"})
    layers = [Layer("rcap", xx.tolist(), (mm - scale * ss).tolist(),
                    {"y2": (mm + scale * ss).tolist()}, {}, ""),
              Layer("scatter", xx.tolist(), mm.tolist(), {}, style, D.var_title(s, mv))]
    return _graph(s, graw, layers, D.var_title(s, xv), D.var_title(s, mv)), graw

def dotplot(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Dot plot of one or more variables, or of one variable over the groups of over().
    The vertical axis is binned into ny bins and the dots of a bin are stacked horizontally
    (VERIFY the default ny and the spacing against Stata)."""
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"over": 2, "by": 2, "nx": 2, "ny": 2, "center": 2,
                                      "nogroup": 3, "nogroupvars": 3, "bar": 3, "mean": 4,
                                      "median": 3, "xlabel": 2})
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    base = D.base_mask(s, p)
    over = lopts.get("over") or lopts.get("by")
    cols: list[tuple[str, np.ndarray]] = []
    if over and isinstance(over, str):
        if len(names) != 1:
            raise StataError(198, "over() requires a single variable")
        y = D.numeric(s, names[0])
        ov = D.numeric(s, s.expand_varlist(over)[0])
        m = base & D.valid(y) & D.valid(ov)
        for val in sorted(set(ov[m].tolist())):
            cols.append((D.value_text(s, over, val), y[m & (ov == val)]))
    else:
        for nm in names:
            y = D.numeric(s, nm)
            cols.append((nm, y[base & D.valid(y)]))
    allv = np.concatenate([c[1] for c in cols])
    if len(allv) == 0:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    ny = int(lopts["ny"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("ny"), str) else max(5, min(35, int(round(math.sqrt(len(allv)) * 2))))
    lo, hi = float(allv.min()), float(allv.max())
    step = (hi - lo) / ny if hi > lo else 1.0
    xs, ys = [], []
    for j, (_lab, y) in enumerate(cols, start=1):
        b = np.floor((y - lo) / step + 1e-9)
        b = np.minimum(b, ny)             # the maximum goes in the last bin
        yy = lo + b * step
        for val in np.unique(yy):
            cnt = int((yy == val).sum())
            off = (np.arange(cnt) - (cnt - 1) / 2) * (0.1 if len(cols) > 1 else 1.0)
            if len(cols) == 1:
                xs += (np.arange(1, cnt + 1)).tolist()
            else:
                xs += (j + off).tolist()
            ys += [float(val)] * cnt
    layers = [Layer("scatter", xs, ys, {}, _own(lopts, {"over", "by", "nx", "ny", "center", "nogroup",
                                                         "nogroupvars", "bar", "mean", "median", "xlabel"}), "")]
    if len(cols) == 1:
        g = _graph(s, graw, layers, "Frequency", D.var_title(s, names[0]))
    else:
        g = _graph(s, graw, layers, "", "")
        g.opts["xlabel"] = {"values": list(range(1, len(cols) + 1)), "labels": [c[0] for c in cols]}
    return g, graw

def sunflower(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Density-distribution sunflower plot: the plane is cut in square bins; bins with fewer
    than `light` observations show the observations, with at least `dark` a dark flower,
    otherwise a light one with one petal per `petalweight` observations (VERIFY the drawing)."""
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"binwidth": 4, "light": 3, "dark": 3, "petalweight": 6,
                                      "flowersonly": 4, "nograph": 4, "notable": 4, "marker": 3})
    yv, xv = _vars(s, p, 2)
    y, x = D.numeric(s, yv), D.numeric(s, xv)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x) & D.valid(y)
    xx, yy = x[mask], y[mask]
    n = len(xx)
    if n == 0:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    bw = float(lopts["binwidth"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("binwidth"), str) else \
        max((xx.max() - xx.min()), (yy.max() - yy.min()), 1e-9) / max(8.0, math.sqrt(n) / 1.0)
    light = int(lopts["light"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("light"), str) else 3
    dark = int(lopts["dark"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("dark"), str) else 13
    pw = float(lopts["petalweight"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("petalweight"), str) else 1.0
    ix = np.floor((xx - xx.min()) / bw).astype(int)
    iy = np.floor((yy - yy.min()) / bw).astype(int)
    key = ix * (iy.max() + 1) + iy

    for i, kk in enumerate(key):
        cells.setdefault(int(kk), []).append(i)
    single_x, single_y, lx, ly, dx, dy = [], [], [], [], [], []
    for idx in cells.values():

        cx, cy = float(xx[idx].mean()), float(yy[idx].mean())
        if c < light:
            if not lopts.get("flowersonly"):
                single_x += xx[idx].tolist()
                single_y += yy[idx].tolist()
        elif c >= dark:
            dx.append(cx)
            dy.append(cy)
        else:
            lx.append(cx)
            ly.append(cy)
    layers = []
    if single_x:
        layers.append(Layer("scatter", single_x, single_y, {}, {"msymbol": "oh"}, ""))
    if lx:
        layers.append(Layer("scatter", lx, ly, {}, {"msymbol": "T", "mcolor": "gs10"}, ""))
    if dx:
        layers.append(Layer("scatter", dx, dy, {}, {"msymbol": "T", "mcolor": "black"}, ""))
    g = _graph(s, graw, layers, D.var_title(s, xv), D.var_title(s, yv),
               note=f"bin width = {bw:g}; bin height = {bw:g}")
    if lopts.get("nograph"):
        return None, graw
    return g, graw

# lpoly (graph) -- the smoother is lpoly_fit, shared with the command-line output

_KERNELS = {
    "epanechnikov": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) < 1, 0.75 * (1 - u * u), 0.0),
    "epan2": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) < math.sqrt(5), 0.75 * (1 - u * u / 5) / math.sqrt(5), 0.0),
    "biweight": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) < 1, 15 / 16 * (1 - u * u) ** 2, 0.0),
    "cosine": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) < 0.5, 1 + np.cos(2 * math.pi * u), 0.0),
    "gaussian": lambda u: np.exp(-0.5 * u * u) / math.sqrt(2 * math.pi),
    "parzen": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) <= 0.5, 4 / 3 - 8 * u * u + 8 * np.abs(u) ** 3,
                                 np.where(np.abs(u) <= 1, 8 / 3 * (1 - np.abs(u)) ** 3, 0.0)),
    "rectangle": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) < 1, 0.5, 0.0),
    "triangle": lambda u: np.where(np.abs(u) < 1, 1 - np.abs(u), 0.0),
}


def lpoly_fit(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, grid: np.ndarray, h: float, degree: int = 0,
              kernel: str = "epan2") -> np.ndarray:
    """Local polynomial smooth of y on x at the points of `grid` ([R] lpoly, Methods and
    formulas): weighted least squares of degree `degree` with kernel weights K((x - g)/h)."""
    K = _KERNELS[kernel]
    out = np.full(len(grid), np.nan)
    for i, g0 in enumerate(grid):
        w = K((x - g0) / h)
        keep = w > 0
        if keep.sum() <= degree + 1:        # VERIFY: Stata leaves the point missing with one observation
            continue
        d = x[keep] - g0
        Z = np.vander(d, degree + 1, increasing=True)
        sw = np.sqrt(w[keep])
        try:
            b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z * sw[:, None], y[keep] * sw, rcond=None)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            continue
        out[i] = b[0]
    return out


def rot_bandwidth(x: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Default bandwidth: a reference-rule value, 0.9 min(sd, IQR/1.349) n^(-1/5). VERIFY: Stata
    uses the Fan-Gijbels rule-of-thumb plug-in estimator; the difference is checked in the
    1903 compat case."""
    n = len(x)
    sd = float(x.std(ddof=1))
    iqr = float(np.subtract(*np.percentile(x, [75, 25]))) / 1.349
    return 0.9 * min(sd, iqr if iqr > 0 else sd) * n ** -0.2


def lpoly(s: "Session", text: str):

                                      "generate": 3, "nograph": 3, "noscatter": 4, "ci": 2,
                                      "level": 3, "msymbol": 3})
    yv, xv = _vars(s, p, 2)
    y, x = D.numeric(s, yv), D.numeric(s, xv)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x) & D.valid(y)
    xx, yy = x[mask], y[mask]
    if len(xx) < 2:

    npts = int(lopts["n"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("n"), str) else min(50, len(xx))
    if isinstance(lopts.get("at"), str):

        names = lopts["generate"].split()

            if isinstance(lopts.get("at"), str):

        return None, graw

    if not lopts.get("noscatter"):

    ok = ~np.isnan(sm)
    layers.append(Layer("line", grid[ok].tolist(), sm[ok].tolist(), {}, {}, "lpoly smooth"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# cusum
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def cusum(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Cumulative sum of the standardized residuals of the regression of yvar on xvar, in the
    order of xvar ([R] cusum; VERIFY the test statistics, which are not displayed yet)."""
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"generate": 3, "yfit": 4, "cshighlight": 4})
    yv, xv = _vars(s, p, 2)
    y, x = D.numeric(s, yv), D.numeric(s, xv)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x) & D.valid(y)
    xx, yy = x[mask], y[mask]
    n = len(xx)
    if n < 3:
        raise StataError(2001, "insufficient observations")
    if ((yy < 0) | (yy > 1)).any():
        raise StataError(198, "Yvar has values outside range [0,1]")
    o = np.argsort(xx, kind="stable")
    xs, ys = xx[o], yy[o]
    Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), xs])
    b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, ys, rcond=None)
    e = ys - Z @ b
    sd = math.sqrt(float(e @ e) / (n - 2))
    cs = np.cumsum(e / sd)
    if isinstance(lopts.get("generate"), str):
        from ..core.dataset import Variable
        full = np.full(s.data.nobs, D.SYS)
        idx = np.flatnonzero(mask)[o]
        full[idx] = cs
        s.data.add(Variable(lopts["generate"], "float", full))
    layers = [Layer("line", list(range(1, n + 1)), cs.tolist(), {}, {}, "")]
    g = _graph(s, graw, layers, "Order of " + D.var_title(s, xv), "Cusum")
    return g, graw


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# gladder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gladder(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Histograms of the variable under the ladder-of-powers transformations, each with the
    normal density overlaid, combined in a 3x3 graph ([R] ladder)."""
    from ..commands.basestat2 import _LADDER
    p, lopts, graw = _split(s, text, {"bin": 3, "start": 3, "width": 3, "percent": 3,
                                      "fraction": 3, "frequency": 3, "density": 3,
                                      "normal": 3, "l1title": 4, "ycommon": 4, "xcommon": 4})
    v = _vars(s, p, 1)[0]
    x = D.numeric(s, v)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x)
    xs = x[mask]
    if len(xs) < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    kids = []
    for lab, form, f in _LADDER:
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            t = f(xs)
        t = t[np.isfinite(t)]
        if len(t) < 2:
            kids.append(Graph(family="twoway", opts={"legend": {"off": True}, "title": {"lines": [lab]}},
                              panels=[Panel("", [])]))
            continue
        h = D.hist_bins(t, None, {})
        mu, sd = float(t.mean()), float(t.std(ddof=1))
        lo, hi = float(t.min()), float(t.max())
        gx = np.linspace(lo, hi, 100)
        dens = np.exp(-0.5 * ((gx - mu) / sd) ** 2) / (sd * math.sqrt(2 * math.pi)) if sd > 0 else gx * 0
        layers = [Layer("histogram", h["centers"], h["heights"], {"width": h["width"]}, {}, ""),
                  Layer("line", gx.tolist(), dens.tolist(), {}, {"lcolor": "maroon"}, "")]
        kid = _graph(s, graw, layers, form if form != "x" else v, "Density")
        kid.opts = {k: val for k, val in kid.opts.items() if k not in ("name", "saving", "nodraw")}
        kid.opts["_xtitle"], kid.opts["_ytitle"] = form if form != "x" else D.var_title(s, v), "Density"
        kid.opts["title"] = {"lines": [lab]}
        kids.append(kid)
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    opts["cols"] = 3
    return Graph(family="combine", opts=opts, children=kids), graw

        else:
            ho2["bin"] = total["bins"]
            ho2.pop("width", None)
            ho2["_xmax"] = total["max"]
        h = _bins_fixed(xx, ww, ho2, total)
        out = [Layer("histogram", h["centers"], h["heights"], {"width": h["width"]}, dict(style), "")]
        W = float(len(xx) if ww is None else ww.sum())
        factor = {"density": 1.0, "fraction": h["width"], "frequency": h["width"] * W,
                  "percent": 100 * h["width"]}[scale]
        if ho.get("discrete"):
            lo, hi = total["start"] - total["width"] / 2, total["max"] + total["width"] / 2
        else:
            lo, hi = total["start"], total["start"] + total["width"] * total["bins"]
        if lopts.get("normal"):
            mu = float(np.average(xx, weights=ww))
            sd = float(math.sqrt(np.average((xx - mu) ** 2, weights=ww) * W / (W - 1))) if W > 1 else 0.0
            grid = np.linspace(lo, hi, 100)
            dens = np.exp(-0.5 * ((grid - mu) / sd) ** 2) / (sd * math.sqrt(2 * math.pi)) if sd > 0 else grid * 0
            out.append(Layer("line", grid.tolist(), (dens * factor).tolist(), {}, {"lcolor": "maroon"}, ""))
        if lopts.get("kdensity"):
            kd = D.kdensity(xx, ww, fw=D.is_fweight(p))
            out.append(Layer("line", kd["x"].tolist(), (kd["d"] * factor).tolist(), {}, {"lcolor": "navy"}, ""))
        if lopts.get("addlabels"):
            out[0].extra["blabel"] = True
        return out

    byo = opts.get("by")
    if byo:
        byvars = s.expand_varlist(" ".join(byo["vars"]))
        for key, gm in D.groups(s, mask, byvars, missing=bool(byo.get("missing"))):
            lys = panel_layers(gm)
            if lys:
                g.panels.append(Panel(D.group_title(s, byvars, key), lys))
        if byo.get("total"):
            g.panels.append(Panel("Total", panel_layers(mask)))
        opts.setdefault("note", {"lines": ["Graphs by " + ", ".join(D.var_title(s, b) for b in byvars)]})
    else:
        g.panels.append(Panel("", panel_layers(mask)))
    if lopts.get("horizontal"):
        opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = hist_ytitle(lopts), D.var_title(s, v)
    else:
        opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = D.var_title(s, v), hist_ytitle(lopts)
    opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    return g, graw, msg


def _bins_fixed(x: np.ndarray, w, ho: dict, total: dict) -> dict:
    """Bins with the start, width and number of bins of the whole sample
    (with by(), the panels use the same bins)."""
    k = total["bins"]
    width = total["width"]
    start = total["start"]
    ww = np.ones(len(x)) if w is None else w
    W = float(ww.sum())
    if ho.get("discrete"):
        idx = np.floor((x - start) / width + 0.5).astype(int)
        centers = start + width * np.arange(k)
    else:
        idx = np.floor((x - start) / width + 1e-12 * max(1.0, abs(total["max"]))).astype(int)
        centers = start + width * (np.arange(k) + 0.5)
    idx = np.clip(idx, 0, k - 1)
    counts = np.bincount(idx, weights=ww, minlength=k)[:k]
    scale = ho.get("scale", "density")
    h = {"frequency": counts, "fraction": counts / W, "percent": 100 * counts / W}.get(scale)
    if h is None:
        h = counts / (W * width)
    return {"centers": centers.tolist(), "heights": h.tolist(), "width": width}

# kdensity

KDEN_OPTS = {"kernel": 1, "bwidth": 2, "generate": 3, "n": 1, "at": 2, "nograph": 6, "normal": 4,
             "student": 3, "normopts": 8, "stopts": 6, "range": 1}


def kdensity(s: "Session", text: str) -> tuple[Graph | None, dict]:
    p = parse_standard(text)
    spec = {**layer_spec(), **KDEN_OPTS}
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, spec)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(103 if len(names) > 1 else 102,
                         "too many variables specified" if len(names) > 1 else "too few variables specified")
    v = names[0]
    if s.data.get(v).is_string:
        raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    x = D.numeric(s, v)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x)
    w, mask = D.weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight", "aweight"))
    if not mask.any():
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    kname = D.kernel_name(lopts.get("kernel") if isinstance(lopts.get("kernel"), str) else None)
    bw = float(lopts["bwidth"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("bwidth"), str) else None
    npts = int(lopts["n"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("n"), str) else None
    at = None
    at_rows = None
    if isinstance(lopts.get("at"), str):
        av = D.numeric(s, s.expand_varlist(lopts["at"])[0])
        at_rows = np.flatnonzero(D.valid(av))
        at = av[at_rows]
    xx = x[mask]
    ww = None if w is None else w[mask]
    kd = D.kdensity(xx, ww, kernel=kname, bw=bw, n=npts, at=at, fw=D.is_fweight(p))
    gen = lopts.get("generate")
    if isinstance(gen, str):
        _generate(s, gen, kd, at_rows)
    s.r = {"scale": 1.0, "n": float(kd["n"]), "bwidth": float(kd["bwidth"]), "kernel": kname}   # VERIFY
    if lopts.get("nograph"):
        return None, graw
    style = {k: (strip_outer_quotes(val) if isinstance(val, str) else val) for k, val in lopts.items()
             if k not in KDEN_OPTS}
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    layers = [Layer("kdensity", kd["x"].tolist(), kd["d"].tolist(), {}, style, "Kernel density estimate")]
    if lopts.get("normal"):
        mu = float(np.average(xx, weights=ww))
        n = float(len(xx) if ww is None else ww.sum())
        sd = float(math.sqrt(np.average((xx - mu) ** 2, weights=ww) * n / (n - 1))) if n > 1 else 0.0
        gx = np.asarray(kd["x"])
        nd = np.exp(-0.5 * ((gx - mu) / sd) ** 2) / (sd * math.sqrt(2 * math.pi))
        layers.append(Layer("line", gx.tolist(), nd.tolist(), {}, {}, "Normal density"))
    g = Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)])
    opts.setdefault("title", {"lines": ["Kernel density estimate"]})
    opts.setdefault("note", {"lines": [f"kernel = {kname}, bandwidth = {_fmt4(kd['bwidth'])}"]})
    opts["_xtitle"] = D.var_title(s, v)
    opts["_ytitle"] = "Density"
    return g, graw


def _fmt4(x: float) -> str:
    # VERIFY: Stata's note uses %9.4f without spaces
    t = f"{x:.4f}"
    return t[1:] if t.startswith("0.") else t


def _generate(s: "Session", spec: str, kd: dict, at_rows) -> None:
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    names = spec.split()
    ds = s.data
    if at_rows is not None:
        if len(names) != 1:
            raise StataError(198, "only one variable may be specified in generate() with at()")   # VERIFY
        dname = names[0]
        vals = np.full(ds.nobs, M.SYSMISS)
        vals[at_rows] = kd["d"]
        ds.add(Variable(dname, "double", vals, fmt="%10.0g"))
        return
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(198, "generate() requires two new variable names")   # VERIFY
    for nm in names:
        if ds.has(nm):
            raise StataError(110, f"{nm} already defined")
    n = len(kd["x"])
    if n > ds.nobs:
        ds.set_obs(n)   # VERIFY: does Stata increase _N when n() > _N?
    xs = np.full(ds.nobs, M.SYSMISS)
    ys = np.full(ds.nobs, M.SYSMISS)
    xs[:n] = kd["x"]
    ys[:n] = kd["d"]
    # double with format %10.0g (compat 0701: list shows -1.0146058)
    ds.add(Variable(names[0], "double", xs, fmt="%10.0g"))
    ds.add(Variable(names[1], "double", ys, fmt="%10.0g"))

# graph bar / hbar

BAR_OPTS = {"over": 4, "asyvars": 4, "stack": 5, "percentages": 7, "blabel": 3, "bargap": 6,
            "outergap": 6, "nofill": 6, "missing": 4, "cw": 2, "yvaroptions": 6, "showyvars": 5, "bar": 3, "nolabel": 7, "exclude0": 8, "yalternate": 4, "xalternate": 4}


def _yvars(s: "Session", text: str, default: str = "mean") -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """'(mean) a b (sum) c d=e' -> [(stat, var, label)]."""
    out = []
    stat = default
    t = text.strip()
    i = 0
    while i < len(t):
        if t[i].isspace():
            i += 1
            continue
        if t[i] == "(":
            j = t.index(")", i)
            stat = t[i + 1:j].strip().lower()
            if stat in ("p50",):
                stat = "median"
            if stat not in D.STATS and not (stat.startswith("p") and stat[1:].isdigit()):
                raise StataError(198, f"({stat}) invalid statistic")   # VERIFY
            i = j + 1
            continue
        j = i
        while j < len(t) and not t[j].isspace() and t[j] != "(":
            j += 1
        tok = t[i:j]
        i = j
        if "=" in tok:
            new, old = tok.split("=", 1)
            out.append((stat, s.expand_varlist(old)[0], new))
        else:
            for nm in s.expand_varlist(tok):
                out.append((stat, nm, ""))
    return out


_STAT_TITLE = {"mean": "mean", "median": "median", "sum": "sum", "rawsum": "sum", "count": "count",
               "percent": "percent", "max": "max", "min": "min", "sd": "sd", "first": "first",
               "last": "last", "firstnm": "first", "lastnm": "last", "iqr": "iqr", "semean": "semean"}


def _over_list(graw: dict, key: str = "over") -> list[dict]:
    """over() may be repeated; parse_options keeps only the last one, so
    we reopen the raw text (graw['_raw'])."""
    out = []
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_options
    for n, a in parse_options(graw.get("_raw", "")):
        if len(n) >= 4 and "over".startswith(n):
            main, subs = split_sub(a or "")
            out.append({"var": main.strip(), "subs": subs})
    return out


def _over_groups(s: "Session", m: np.ndarray, overvars: list[str], missing: bool):
    """over() groups with the first over() varying fastest (innermost) and the last one
    outermost, as in graph bar/box. Returns (cats, levels, keys): the labels of the first
    over(), one list of labels per outer over(), and the (key, mask) pairs."""
    if not overvars:
        return [""], [], [([], m)]
    keys = [(k[::-1], gm) for k, gm in D.groups(s, m, overvars[::-1], missing=missing)]
    cats = [D.group_title(s, overvars[:1], k[:1]) for k, _ in keys]
    levels = [[D.value_text(s, overvars[j], k[j]) for k, _ in keys] for j in range(1, len(overvars))]
    return cats, levels, keys


def _sort_cats(cats: list[str], levels: list[list[str]], series: list[dict], subs: dict) -> None:
    """over(var, sort(#) descending): orders the categories by the value of the #-th series,
    inside each outer group (in place)."""
    k = str(subs.get("sort", ""))
    if not k.isdigit() or not 1 <= int(k) <= len(series):
        return
    vals = series[int(k) - 1]["values"]
    sign = -1.0 if subs.get("descending") else 1.0
    key = lambda i: (tuple(lv[i] for lv in reversed(levels)), sign * (vals[i] if vals[i] is not None else math.inf))
    order = sorted(range(len(cats)), key=key)
    cats[:] = [cats[i] for i in order]
    for lv in levels:
        lv[:] = [lv[i] for i in order]
    for ser in series:
        if "stats" in ser:
            ser["stats"] = [ser["stats"][i] for i in order]
        else:
            ser["values"] = [ser["values"][i] for i in order]


def bar(s: "Session", text: str, family: str) -> tuple[Graph, dict]:
    p = parse_standard(text)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, BAR_OPTS)
    graw["_raw"] = p.options
    overs = _over_list(graw)
    if len(overs) > 3:
        raise StataError(198, "too many over() options")   # VERIFY
    ys = _yvars(s, p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p)
    w, mask = D.weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight", "aweight", "pweight", "iweight"))
    if lopts.get("cw"):
        for _, nm, _ in ys:
            mask &= D.valid(D.numeric(s, nm))
    overvars = [s.expand_varlist(o["var"])[0] for o in overs]
    if not ys and not overvars:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")   # VERIFY
    opts = graph_options({k: v for k, v in graw.items() if k != "_raw"})

    def series_for(m: np.ndarray) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[str]], list[dict]]:
        cats, levels, keys = _over_groups(s, m, overvars, bool(lopts.get("missing")))
        series = []
        if not ys:
            tot = float(m.sum() if w is None else w[m].sum())
            vals = [float(gm.sum() if w is None else w[gm].sum()) / tot * 100 if tot else M.SYSMISS
                    for _, gm in keys]
            series.append({"label": "percent", "values": vals})
        for stat, nm, lab in ys:
            xv = D.numeric(s, nm)
            vals = []
            for _, gm in keys:
                if stat == "percent":
                    tot = float(xv[m & D.valid(xv)].sum())
                    sub = float(xv[gm & D.valid(xv)].sum())
                    vals.append(100 * sub / tot if tot else M.SYSMISS)
                else:
                    vals.append(D.stat_value(stat, xv[gm], None if w is None else w[gm]))
            label = lab or f"{_STAT_TITLE.get(stat, stat)} of {nm}"
            series.append({"label": label, "values": [None if v >= M.SYSMISS else v for v in vals]})
        if lopts.get("asyvars") and overvars and len(series) == 1:
            # the first over() becomes the series (colors and legend)
            vals = series[0]["values"]
            series = [{"label": c, "values": [v]} for c, v in zip(cats, vals)]
            cats, levels = [""], []
        if lopts.get("percentages") and len(series) > 1:
            for k in range(len(cats)):
                tot = sum((ser["values"][k] or 0) for ser in series)
                for ser in series:
                    if ser["values"][k] is not None and tot:
                        ser["values"][k] = 100 * ser["values"][k] / tot
        if overs:
            _sort_cats(cats, levels, series, overs[0]["subs"])
        return cats, levels, series

    g = Graph(family=family, opts=opts)
    blabel = isinstance(lopts.get("blabel"), str) and lopts["blabel"].split(",")[0].strip() in ("bar", "total")
    bfmt = split_sub(lopts["blabel"])[1].get("format") if blabel else None
    byo = opts.get("by")
    if byo:
        byvars = s.expand_varlist(" ".join(byo["vars"]))
        for key, gm in D.groups(s, mask, byvars):
            cats, levels, series = series_for(gm)
            g.panels.append(Panel(D.group_title(s, byvars, key), [Layer("bars", extra={
                "cats": cats, "levels": levels, "series": series, "stack": bool(lopts.get("stack")),
                "blabel": blabel, "blabel_fmt": bfmt})]))
        opts.setdefault("note", {"lines": ["Graphs by " + ", ".join(D.var_title(s, b) for b in byvars)]})
    else:
        cats, levels, series = series_for(mask)
        g.panels.append(Panel("", [Layer("bars", extra={"cats": cats, "levels": levels, "series": series,
                                                       "stack": bool(lopts.get("stack")), "blabel": blabel,
                                                       "blabel_fmt": bfmt})]))
    first = g.panels[0].layers[0].extra["series"]
    opts["_ytitle"] = first[0]["label"] if len(first) == 1 else ""
    opts["_xtitle"] = ""
    return g, graw

BOX_OPTS = {"over": 4, "asyvars": 4, "nooutsides": 5, "missing": 4, "cw": 2, "medtype": 4,
            "box": 3, "marker": 3, "yvaroptions": 6, "showyvars": 5, "nolabel": 7}


def box(s: "Session", text: str, family: str) -> tuple[Graph, dict]:
    p = parse_standard(text)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, BOX_OPTS)
    graw["_raw"] = p.options
    overs = _over_list(graw)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if not names:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p)
    w, mask = D.weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight", "aweight", "pweight"))
    overvars = [s.expand_varlist(o["var"])[0] for o in overs]
    opts = graph_options({k: v for k, v in graw.items() if k != "_raw"})

    def series_for(m: np.ndarray):
        cats, levels, keys = _over_groups(s, m, overvars, bool(lopts.get("missing")))
        series = []
        for nm in names:
            xv = D.numeric(s, nm)
            st = []
            for _, gm in keys:
                mm = gm & D.valid(xv)
                if not mm.any():
                    st.append(None)
                    continue
                b = D.box_stats(xv[mm], None if w is None else w[mm])
                if lopts.get("nooutsides"):
                    b["out"] = []
                st.append(b)
            series.append({"label": D.var_title(s, nm), "stats": st})
        return cats, levels, series

    g = Graph(family=family, opts=opts)
    byo = opts.get("by")
    if byo:
        byvars = s.expand_varlist(" ".join(byo["vars"]))
        for key, gm in D.groups(s, mask, byvars):
            cats, levels, series = series_for(gm)
            g.panels.append(Panel(D.group_title(s, byvars, key),
                                  [Layer("boxes", extra={"cats": cats, "levels": levels, "series": series})]))
        opts.setdefault("note", {"lines": ["Graphs by " + ", ".join(D.var_title(s, b) for b in byvars)]})
    else:
        cats, levels, series = series_for(mask)
        g.panels.append(Panel("", [Layer("boxes", extra={"cats": cats, "levels": levels, "series": series})]))
    opts["_ytitle"] = D.var_title(s, names[0]) if len(names) == 1 else ""
    opts["_xtitle"] = ""
    return g, graw

PIE_OPTS = {"over": 4, "missing": 4, "allcategories": 3, "cw": 2, "noclockwise": 9, "angle0": 6,
            "plabel": 3, "ptext": 3, "intensity": 5, "line": 4, "pie": 3, "sort": 4, "descending": 4,
            "nolabel": 7}


def pie(s: "Session", text: str) -> tuple[Graph, dict]:
    p = parse_standard(text)
    from ..lang.syntax import parse_options
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, PIE_OPTS)
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist) if p.varlist.strip() else []
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p)
    w, mask = D.weights(s, p, mask, ("fweight", "aweight", "pweight"))
    over = None
    if isinstance(lopts.get("over"), str):
        over = s.expand_varlist(split_sub(lopts["over"])[0])[0]
    if not names and over is None:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    if len(names) > 1 and over is not None:
        raise StataError(198, "only one variable allowed with over()")   # VERIFY
    plabel = None
    for n, a in parse_options(p.options):
        if len(n) >= 3 and "plabel".startswith(n) and a:
            words = a.replace(",", " ").split()
            for k in ("percent", "sum", "name"):
                if any(k.startswith(x) and len(x) >= 3 for x in words[1:2]):
                    plabel = k
    opts = graph_options(graw)

    def slices(m: np.ndarray):
        if over is None:
            vals = [float((D.numeric(s, nm)[m & D.valid(D.numeric(s, nm))] *
                           (1 if w is None else w[m & D.valid(D.numeric(s, nm))])).sum()) for nm in names]
            return [D.var_title(s, nm) for nm in names], vals
        labels, vals = [], []
        for key, gm in D.groups(s, m, [over], missing=bool(lopts.get("missing"))):
            labels.append(D.group_title(s, [over], key))
            if names:
                xv = D.numeric(s, names[0])
                mm = gm & D.valid(xv)
                vals.append(float((xv[mm] * (1 if w is None else w[mm])).sum()))
            else:
                vals.append(float(gm.sum() if w is None else w[gm].sum()))
        return labels, vals

    g = Graph(family="pie", opts=opts)
    byo = opts.get("by")
    if byo:
        byvars = s.expand_varlist(" ".join(byo["vars"]))
        for key, gm in D.groups(s, mask, byvars):
            labels, vals = slices(gm)
            g.panels.append(Panel(D.group_title(s, byvars, key),
                                  [Layer("pie", extra={"labels": labels, "values": vals, "plabel": plabel})]))
    else:
        labels, vals = slices(mask)
        g.panels.append(Panel("", [Layer("pie", extra={"labels": labels, "values": vals, "plabel": plabel})]))
    return g, graw

def matrix(s: "Session", text: str) -> tuple[Graph, dict]:
    p = parse_standard(text)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, {**layer_spec(), "half": 4, "diagonal": 4, "maxes": 5,
                                                 "iscale": 6, "jitter": 6})
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise StataError(102, "too few variables specified")
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p)
    cols = []
    for nm in names:
        if s.data.get(nm).is_string:
            raise StataError(109, "type mismatch")
    # VERIFY: Stata uses, for each pair, the obs. without missing in that pair
    for nm in names:
        mask &= D.valid(D.numeric(s, nm))
    for nm in names:
        cols.append(D.numeric(s, nm)[mask].tolist())
    labels = [D.var_title(s, nm) for nm in names]
    g = Graph(family="matrix", opts=graph_options(graw),
              panels=[Panel("", [Layer("matrix", extra={"names": labels, "cols": cols,
                                                         "half": bool(lopts.get("half"))})])])
    return g, graw

def combine(s: "Session", text: str) -> tuple[Graph, dict]:
    from .store import gph_path, load_gph, store
    c = find_top(text, ",")
    body, opt = (text, "") if c == -1 else (text[:c], text[c + 1:])
    _, graw = split_layer_graph(opt, {"cols": 3, "rows": 3, "colfirst": 4, "holes": 4, "iscale": 6,
                                      "imargin": 6, "altshrink": 6, "commonscheme": 6, "ycommon": 7,
                                      "xcommon": 7, "nocopies": 8})
    st = store(s)
    kids = []
    from ..lang.words import split_words
    for nm in split_words(body):
        if nm in st.graphs:
            kids.append(Graph.from_json(st.graphs[nm].to_json()))
        elif nm.endswith(".gph") or gph_path(nm).exists():
            kids.append(load_gph(gph_path(nm)))
        else:
            raise StataError(111, f"graph {nm} not found")   # VERIFY
    if not kids:
        raise StataError(198, "nothing to combine")   # VERIFY
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    for k in ("cols", "rows"):
        if isinstance(graw.get(k), str):
            opts[k] = int(graw[k])
    g = Graph(family="combine", opts=opts, children=kids)
    return g, graw

"""Description of a graph, independent of how it is drawn.

A Graph keeps the layers (scatter, line, bars...), the general options
(titles, axes, legend) and, with by(), the panels. Drawing lives in
render.py; saving to .gph (OpenDTA's own JSON format) in store.py.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class Layer:
    kind: str                                   # scatter, line, connected, lfit, qfit, area, bar, ...
    x: list = field(default_factory=list)
    y: list = field(default_factory=list)
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)   # y2 (rcap), weights, labels...
    style: dict = field(default_factory=dict)   # mcolor, msymbol, lcolor, lpattern, lwidth...
    label: str = ""


@dataclass
class Panel:
    title: str = ""
    layers: list[Layer] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class Graph:
    family: str = "twoway"                      # twoway, bar, hbar, box, hbox, pie, matrix, combine
    panels: list[Panel] = field(default_factory=list)
    opts: dict = field(default_factory=dict)    # title, subtitle, note, caption, xtitle, ytitle, ...
    name: str = "Graph"
    data: dict = field(default_factory=dict)    # for bar/box/pie/matrix: their own structure
    children: list = field(default_factory=list)   # graph combine

    def to_json(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        d = asdict(self)
        d["children"] = [c.to_json() if isinstance(c, Graph) else c for c in self.children]
        return d

    @staticmethod
    def from_json(d: dict) -> "Graph":
        g = Graph(family=d.get("family", "twoway"), opts=d.get("opts", {}), name=d.get("name", "Graph"),
                  data=d.get("data", {}))
        for p in d.get("panels", []):
            g.panels.append(Panel(p.get("title", ""), [Layer(**ly) for ly in p.get("layers", [])]))
        g.children = [Graph.from_json(c) for c in d.get("children", [])]
        return g

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# lowess (Cleveland 1979, without the robustness iterations, like Stata's lowess)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def lowess_fit(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, bwidth: float = 0.8, mean: bool = False,
               noweight: bool = False) -> np.ndarray:
    """Smoothed value at each x ([R] lowess, Methods and formulas): with the
    data sorted by x, the window of i goes from max(1, i-k) to min(i+k, N),
    k = floor((N·bwidth - 0.5)/2), cut at the ends (not shifted); tricube
    weights with Δ = 1.0001·max(x(i+) - x(i), x(i) - x(i-)); weighted local
    regression (or weighted mean with `mean`). Checked in compat 0804."""
    n = len(x)
    order = np.argsort(x, kind="stable")
    xs, ys = x[order], y[order]
    half = max(int(math.floor((n * bwidth - 0.5) / 2)), 0)
    out = np.empty(n)
    for i in range(n):
        d = np.abs(xs - xs[i])
        lo = max(0, i - half)
        hi = min(n, i + half + 1)
        sel = np.arange(lo, hi)
        delta = 1.0001 * max(xs[hi - 1] - xs[i], xs[i] - xs[lo])
        if noweight or delta <= 0:
            wts = np.ones(len(sel))
        else:
            u = d[sel] / delta
            wts = np.where(u < 1, (1 - u ** 3) ** 3, 0.0)
        if mean:
            out[i] = float(wts @ ys[sel] / wts.sum()) if wts.sum() > 0 else ys[i]
            continue
        W = wts.sum()
        if W <= 0:
            out[i] = ys[i]
            continue
        xm = wts @ xs[sel] / W
        ym = wts @ ys[sel] / W
        sxx = wts @ (xs[sel] - xm) ** 2
        b = (wts @ ((xs[sel] - xm) * (ys[sel] - ym))) / sxx if sxx > 0 else 0.0
        out[i] = ym + b * (xs[i] - xm)
    res = np.empty(n)
    res[order] = out
    return res


LOWESS_OPTS = {"mean": 4, "noweight": 3, "bwidth": 2, "logit": 3, "adjust": 3, "generate": 3, "nograph": 6,
               "lineopts": 5}


def lowess(s: "Session", text: str):
    from ..core.dataset import Variable
    p = parse_standard(text)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, {**layer_spec(), **LOWESS_OPTS})
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 2:
        raise StataError(102 if len(names) < 2 else 103,
                         "too few variables specified" if len(names) < 2 else "too many variables specified")
    yv, xv = names
    y, x = D.numeric(s, yv), D.numeric(s, xv)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x) & D.valid(y)
    bw = float(lopts["bwidth"]) if isinstance(lopts.get("bwidth"), str) else 0.8
    fit = lowess_fit(x[mask], y[mask], bw, bool(lopts.get("mean")), bool(lopts.get("noweight")))
    if lopts.get("adjust"):
        fit = fit * (y[mask].mean() / fit.mean())
    if lopts.get("logit"):
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            fit = np.log(fit / (1 - fit))
    if isinstance(lopts.get("generate"), str):
        nm = lopts["generate"].split()[0]
        vals = np.full(s.data.nobs, D.SYS)
        vals[mask] = fit.astype(np.float32).astype(float)     # float variable, as in Stata
        s.data.add(Variable(nm, "float", vals))
    if lopts.get("nograph"):
        return None, graw
    o = np.argsort(x[mask], kind="stable")
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    layers = [Layer("scatter", x[mask].tolist(), y[mask].tolist(), {}, {"msymbol": "oh"}, D.var_title(s, yv)),
              Layer("line", x[mask][o].tolist(), fit[o].tolist(), {}, {}, "lowess")]
    opts.setdefault("title", {"lines": ["Lowess smoother"]})
    opts.setdefault("note", {"lines": [f"bandwidth = {bw:g}"]})
    opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = D.var_title(s, xv), D.var_title(s, yv)
    opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    return Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), graw

def _one_var(s: "Session", text: str, extra: dict):
    p = parse_standard(text)
    lopts, graw = split_layer_graph(p.options, {**layer_spec(), **extra})
    names = s.expand_varlist(p.varlist)
    if len(names) != 1:
        raise StataError(102 if not names else 103,
                         "too few variables specified" if not names else "too many variables specified")
    v = names[0]
    x = D.numeric(s, v)
    mask = D.base_mask(s, p) & D.valid(x)
    xs = np.sort(x[mask])
    if len(xs) < 2:
        raise StataError(2000, "no observations")
    return v, xs, lopts, graw


def qnorm(s: "Session", text: str):
    """Quantiles of x against those of the normal with the same mean and standard deviation;
    positions (i - .5)/n (VERIFY: does Stata use i/(n+1)?)."""
    v, xs, lopts, graw = _one_var(s, text, {"grid": 4})
    n = len(xs)
    q = st.norm.ppf((np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.5) / n) * xs.std(ddof=1) + xs.mean()
    lo, hi = float(min(q.min(), xs.min())), float(max(q.max(), xs.max()))
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    layers = [Layer("scatter", q.tolist(), xs.tolist(), {}, {}, D.var_title(s, v)),
              Layer("line", [lo, hi], [lo, hi], {}, {"lcolor": "gs8"}, "")]
    opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = "Inverse Normal", D.var_title(s, v)
    opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    return Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), graw


def pnorm(s: "Session", text: str):
    """P_i = Φ((x_i - mean)/sd) against i/(n+1) ([R] diagnostic plots)."""
    v, xs, lopts, graw = _one_var(s, text, {"grid": 4})
    n = len(xs)
    emp = np.arange(1, n + 1) / (n + 1)
    th = st.norm.cdf((xs - xs.mean()) / xs.std(ddof=1))
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    layers = [Layer("scatter", emp.tolist(), th.tolist(), {}, {}, D.var_title(s, v)),
              Layer("line", [0, 1], [0, 1], {}, {"lcolor": "gs8"}, "")]
    opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = "Empirical P[i] = i/(N+1)", f"Normal F[({v}-m)/s]"
    opts.setdefault("legend", {"off": True})
    return Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), graw

def _resid_fit(s: "Session"):
    from ..estimation.postest import esample, xb_all
    from ..estimation.results import current
    est = current(s)
    if est.cmd not in ("regress", "anova"):
        raise StataError(301, "last estimates not found")   # VERIFY
    mask = esample(s)
    xb, ok = xb_all(s, est)
    y = s.data.get(est.depvar).data.astype(float)
    m = mask & ok & (y < D.SYS)
    return est, m, xb, y

    est, m, xb, y = _resid_fit(s)
    opts = graph_options(graw)
    layers = [Layer("scatter", xb[m].tolist(), (y - xb)[m].tolist(), {}, {}, "Residuals")]
    opts["_xtitle"], opts["_ytitle"] = "Fitted values", "Residuals"
    opts.setdefault("yline", {"values": [0.0]})
    return Graph(family="twoway", opts=opts, panels=[Panel("", layers)]), graw


def rvpplot(s: "Session", text: str):
